tei:titleStmt.tei:title: pod 1 bod kyi rtsom rig byung 'phel gyi lo rgyus dang khyad chos rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho

tei:div.tei:p: ṭwāoṃ/sdu ༷ ṭwāoṃX riX // tha'/༷ tram̐ ོ༷ /sa ཿ// ༷/ ṭwāoṃXdi /༷ ༷dzi/khyi ṭwāṃ ༷/ sduoX ṭwāṃ py-io6210650
mi'askuX

gtsos mi rigs mtho rim dge thon ched gnyer slob grwa btsugalha snakā sbya zlo/kā ṭī dṛ lon par gtsos mi rigs mtho rim dge thon ched gnyer slob grwa btsugs nas lo 'khor nyi shu lon pa'i bkra shis pa'i dus bzang 'di la/ ngas snying thag pa nas 'di ga slob grwa'i phyogs gang ci'i 'dzugs skrun dang 'phel rgyas la byas rjesabazhag pa'i dge slob rnams la dus ston gyi rten 'brel zhu ba dang chabs cig slob grwa 'di nyid la thugs khur dang rgyab skyor gnang ba'i lhag bsam can thams cad la thugs rje che zhu ba yin/slob grwa 'di btsugs nas lo ngo nyi shu'i ring la/ dge rgan rnam pas hur brtson dang srid 'dzin mgo 'dren dag gis thugs khur gnang 'og slob ma brgyad stong la nye ba bskyed bsrings byas nas/ rang re'i zhing chen dang lhag par du grangs nyung mi rigs sa khul gyi dpal 'byor 'dzugs skrun dang spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas la nus pa gal chen bton pas/ srid gzhung dang sbyi tshogs kyiphyogs so so nas khyed cag gi khyad du 'phags pa'i grub 'bras la gzengs bstod dang gdengs 'jog mthon po byed kyin yod/khyen cag gis mkhyen gsal ltar rig gnas med pa'i mi rigs shig nam yang 'dzam gling gi sngon thon mi rigs kyi gras su tshud mi thub pas/ rgyal khab cig dang yang na mi rigs shig deng rabs can du 'gyur dgos na/ rig gnas slob gso gong du spel ba ni ches rtsa bar gyur ba'i thabs lam yi/ la/

slob grwa ni slob gso gong du spel ba'i gzhi sa gal chen zhig yin pas/ dge slobarnam pa chos 'bad brtson lhod med sgos slob grwa 'di nyid sngar las lhag par legs sgrub byed par thabs dang shes rab 'don dgos/slob grwa chen mo zer ba ni thog khang mthon po dang / slob gling gi sa rgya che bas thogs pa min te/ de ni mkhas dbang du ma 'du sa dang shes rig gi klong brdol sa yin phyir/ dge rgan ni slob grwa'i srog shing dang slob ma bskyed bsrings byed pa'i rten gzhi yin/ de bas slob grwa'i las 'gan gtso bo zhig ni chu tshad mtho ba'i dge rgan gyi dpung sde 'dzugs skun bya rgyu de yin/slob grwa chen mo ni shes ldan mi sna bskyed bsrings byed sa zhig tu 'gyur dgos te/ mi'i rigs kyi bsam blo'i nying bcud brgyud spel dang shes bya gsaragatod byed pa'i gzhi sa ches bzang bo dang / nam yang gsar gtod dnga'ags bcos la kha mi 'bral cing rang rkya 'pher bar kun nas phyogs pa/mgo yang klad med kyi bya spyod thams cad rnam par spangs pa/ rang gcun rang bdag byed cing bsam blo'i shes bya spyad nas sbyi tshogs kyi drang bden la gsal ktaspya /pa spra ༵ ༷kā sdo //sa/ /spyi tshogs sngon thon gyi bsam blor sne khrid byed pa'i der ma zad nga tshos bskyed bsrings byas pa'i slob ma ni yon tshad dang phugs bsam ldan la/ rgyal khab dang mi rigs la gces pa/ bca' khrims brtsi zhing spyi sems yod pa/ dka' spyad 'bad brtson gyis 'gan 'khri'i bya bar khag khur len pa/ kun spyod legs shing gsar gtod kyi snying stobs ldan pa/ 'o/ //na can mi rabs gsar ba zhig yin dgos/
gtsod thang bkra shis g.yang 'khyil du/ /slob gling dpag bsam ljon pa 'khrungs/ /shes rig lo 'dab rgyas pa yis/ /blo ldan yid la dga' ba byin/ /spyi lo 2༷༷5lo/ 3 /shā bye/ 〉kā snyi ṭī/ ba'o/
gtsod thang bkra shis g.yang 'khyil du/ /slob gling dpag bsam ljon pa 'khrungs/ /shes rig lo 'dab rgyas pa yis/ /blo ldan yid la dga' ba byin/ /spyi lo 2༷༷5lo/ 3 /shā bye/ 〉kā snyi ṭī/ ba'o/

slob gso 'chad khrid yon tshad mthor 'degs bgyis nas/mi rigs shes ldan mi sna skyed bsring byed dgos/gtsos mi rigs mtho rim dge thon ched gnyer slob grwa ni 1985lor gsar du btsugs pa'i gan su'u zhing chen mi rigs sa khul gyi mtho rim dge thon ched gnyer slob grwa kho na nyid yin zhing / bgrang bya nyi shu'i ring la/ tang dang rgyal khab dang / 'ing chen tang srid dang / kun lho khul tang srid bcas kyi thugs khur dang rgyab skyor gang legs mdzad par brten/ slob grwa 'di nyid lo re ba na dar rgyas gong 'phel du song ste/ phyogs gang ci'i thad nas tshad rim mtho sa zhig tu bslebs dang slebs kyin mchis pa dang / mi rigs sa khul gyi rig gnas slob gso dar rgyas su gtong ba dang dpal 'byor 'dzugs skrun gong 'phel du gtong ba la nye bar mkho ba'i mi rigs shes ldan mi sna stong phrag mang po skyed bsring mdzad nas/ krung hwa mi rigs kyi shes rig bskyar dar dang nub phyogs gsar spel chen mo'i bya bzhag la byas rjes chen po bzhag yod/de'i phyir/ slob grwa 'di nyid ni rgyal khab spyi dang khyad par du kun su'u zhing chen mi rigs sa khul gyi rig gnas dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas su gtong ba'i rmad byung stobs shugs su che la/ mi rigs sa khul gyi mthun sgril gcig gyur /dro spya dro/ hāng 'jags bya ba rtag brtan du gtong ba'i rmang gzhi dang srog krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi mtho rim slob gso'i bca' khripas kyi don tshan brgyad pa ru/ rgyal khab kyis grangs nyung mi rigs kyi khyad

chos dang dgos mkho la gzhigs nas grangs nyung mi rigs sa khul gyi mtho rim slob gso'i las don 'phel rgyas la rogs ram dang rgyab skyor byas te/ grangs nyung mi rigs la mtho rim ched las mi sna gso skyong bya dgos zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ nga tshos slob grwa 'di nyid kyi mi rigs kyi rang bzhin dang khyad chos dam por bzung nas slob grwa 'di nyid khyon yongs nas tshad rim nges can zhig tu mthor 'degs byed dgos pa dang / khyad par du bod yig slob skor gyi slob ma'i bdag gnyer dang / 'chad nyan yon tshan/ tshan rig zhib 'jug bya ba bcas gong 'phel du btang nas slob grwa 'di nyid kyi thun min khyad chos dang khyad 'phags srog shing brtan por 'dzin dgos/ lar phul du phyin pa'i dge rgan dang / spus ka legs pa'i bslab deb/ shes rig ldan pa'i slob ma bcas ni slob grwa chen mo'i ches gzhi mar gyur pa'i mthun rkyen rnam gsum yin pas na/ bod yig slob skor gyi 'go khrid rnam pas ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams skul slong byas nas kho tshos bgrang bya bcu phrag lhag la sgrig rtsom dang 'chad khrid mdzad pa'i ched gnyer bslab deb bcu phrag gcig par bskrun 'grem spel byas pa 'di ni ha cang gal che la rlabs che ba'i bya ba zhig yin zhing /bya bzhag 'di nyid kyis ni slob grwa'i slob gso 'chad nyan yon tshad gong 'phel du gtong ba dang / bod kyi shes rig zhib 'jug 'phrin las dar spel du gtong ba la phan nus gang legs shig thon par nges la/ slob grwa 'di nyid mgyogs myur du dngos gzhi slob chen rim pa la legs par 'phar ba'i mthun rkyen du 'gyur bar ma zad/ slob grwa 'di nyid tshugs nas lo ngo nyi shu lon pa'i bkra shis dga' ston la phul ba'i khyad mtshar 'bras bzang dang rin chen legs skyes su'ang lhun gyis grub pa yin no/ /mi rigs dpe bskrun khang gis mthun rkyen bsgrubs pa la brten nas par bsgrun 'grem spel bgyis pa'i bslab deb 'di rnams ni/ mi rigs /ba

gso'i las don la rnam par bzhag pa'i khyad 'phags mdzad rjes su 'khums la/ rang rgyal gyi mi rigs slob gso cis kyang mdzam gling la kha phyogs pa dang /'byung 'gyur la kha phyogs pa/ deng rabs can la kha phyogs pa'i nges legs ma rtsadang 'dzad med lam rgyags su nges pa dang / phugs bsam mchis la shes rig ldan pa dang kun spyod bzang la 'grig lam srung ba'i mi rigs shes ldan sna stong phrag skyed bsring bgyid pa'i rig pa'i chu gter du bltams pa dang shes rab nyi 'od du 'phro bar srid do snyam/ mthar phul byung shes ldan mi sna ni sngo bsangs rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs bzhin gcig rjes gnyis mthud du mtshar long 'byung ba dang / mi rigs slob gso'i las don ni dpyid kyi dpal yon dang yar ngos zla ba bzhin dar zhing rgyas pa'i bkra shis smon 'dun zhu'o/ /2༷༷4sdu'i rtswa ḍi zlo/ /sdu shā/nyi/na la/6

dkar chagale'u dang po/ bod gna'arabs rtsomarig (1)don tshan dang po/ sbyo //shā dang rtsom ri ga gi lo rgyu sa ma do ra (3)don tshan gnyis pa/ bod kyi gdod ma'i snyan ngag (15)don tshan gsum pa/ gna' rabs gtam rgyud/ (19)don tshan bzhi ba/ gna' rabs mgur glu/ (28)don tshan lnga ba/ /sdu sdus /la pos bod khams sbyi la 9 )don tshan drug pa/ //rdo/ /de/ sol ba'i rdo ri nga gi yi ge /shāshā/don tshan bdun pa/ jo bo rje'i bstod pa sum cu ba/ (53)don tshan brgyad pa/ rje btsun mi la ra sa pa 'i ma gu ra 'a bu ma / (59)don tshan dgu ba/ 'dzam gling ge sar rgyal bo'i sgrung / (83)don tshan bcu ba/ bod kyi zlos gar rtsom rig (107)don tshan bcu gcig pa/ bod 'gyur rtsom rig (128)dang bo/ skye bo gso thigs/ (128)gnyis pa/ khyad par 'phags bstod dang lha la sa phu la byung / (131)le'u gnyis pa/ bod sngar dar rtsom3ga (107)

don tshan dang po/ mbi //shā dang rtsom ri ga gi lo rgyu sa ma do ra (149)don tshan gnyis pa/ zhang ston la bstod pa/ (156)don tshan gsum pa/ rshadro hā /rnyi shā //pa kā gros su 'a de ba sa (160)don tshan bzhi ba/ sa skya'i legs bshad/ (167)don tshan lnga ba/ shātā /ba sems dpa' rta ga tu ngu 'i rto ga sa (179)don tshan drug pa/ /lha // ༵ / py-i sbyang /rdzu na ga sa kyi (198)don tshan bdun pa/ tram̐ // py-i zlo'i yon tan mdor bsdu sa par (207)don tshan brgyad pa/ rgyasdu po rā ma ṇa/ gtam rgyutā las bcoms don tshan dgu ba/ dasna trī rno ṭwāṃ rshakā rte //na ba sa/ /bye/shā/don tshan7 bcu ba/ bod 'gyucang /rdzom zirdog (243)rshatna ṭwāṃ pa/ snya/ skyi/ //wa/ dzo'i/ zlos ga ra / /༷///gsum pa/ rtogs brjod pa dpag bsam 'khri shing / (277)le'u gsum pa/ bod4) gyi dar rtsomatsardog (293)don tshan dang po/ kto //shā dang rtsom ri ga gi lo rgyu sa ma do ra (295)don tshan gnyis pa/ rje btsun 'jam dbyangs kyi bstod pa tam 2 bu ra'i rgyud mangs/ (307)

don tshan gsum pa/ dbyangs can ngag gi rol mtsho yid kyi ngang mo // dro/ drongs pa'i mgrin rgyan rab dag/ 321)don tshan bzhi ba/ gzhon nu zla med kyi gtam rgyud/ (335)don tshan lnga ba/ chu shing gi bstan bcos/ (348)don tshan drug pa/ gtam pad ma'i tshal gyi zlos gar/ (353)don tshan bdun pa/ rgyal po lugs kyi bstan bcos/ (358)don tshan brgyad pa/ bya mgrin sngon zla ba'i rtogs brjod/ (365)don tshan dgu ba/ ṭwāṃ tram̐ bye/zlos can ma 'i ba sto da pa u tpa la (371)don tshan bcu ba/ rje btsun shes rab rgya mtsho'i snyan rtsom/ (379)don tshan bcu gcig pa/ /khas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel 7 )mjug gi gtam/ — snya na nga ga ///sdu/3
banas

bod kyigana'arabasartsomarig 3——don tshan dang po/ spyi chogs dang rtsom rig gi lo rgyas mdor bstan pa/gangs can bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal ni gangs ljongs rig gnas kyi grub cha gal chen zhig dang 'dzam gling rig gnas bang mdzod khrod kyi ches 'od stong 'phro la rin thang che ba'i rig pa'i nor bu zhig yin zhing / las la brtson zhing dpa'angar ldan la/ lhag bsam dkar zhing blo gros ldan pa'i bod rigs mi dmangs kyis ni gdod ma'i dus nas da lta'i bar mi rigs kyi rig gnas dang lo rgyus gsar bsgrun bgyis pa'i go rim dang / kho tsho'i 'tsho ba'i spyod stangs dang / 'du shes 'dzin stangs/ chos lugs dad mos/ dpa' gdeng snying stobs/ phugs bsam re 'dun sogs gsal bar bgyid pa'i rin chen me long zhig yin no/ /de yis ni bod rigs mi dmangs kyi rin thang lta tshul dang mdzes dpyod rig pa rnam par mtshon pa dang / bod rigs mi dmangs kyis bdun dngos dang / bzang byed/ 'omadzes snang la re snyeg dang brtson len byas pa' rma/ /zlo zlo/ ༵༵ pa/ shaṃ nabarnyi// bya/ gting zab cing phun sum tshogs pa dang / rjod byed rmad du byung zhing mdzes sdug rdzogs pa zhig yin la/ de yi lo rgyus kyi phu shin tu ring zhing / 'phel rgyas kyi mda' rnam par yangs pa dang /rā dṛ ṭwāṃ // /zlo sdu/ / la rang rkya thub pa'i mi rigs kyi rang bzhin dang khyad de yang bod kyi gna' rabs rtsom rig ni bod kyi gdod ma'i spyi tshogs

4 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/nas sa skya gong ma'i bar byung zhing 'phel ba'i rtsom rig sgyu rtsal la ngos bzung ba yin zhing / dus yun ring ba'i lo rgyus kyi brgyud rim 'di'i khrod du/ spre'u byang chub sems dpa' dang brag srin mo 'dus pa las rkang gnyis mi yi 'gro ba byung zhing 'phel bar gyur nas/ gdod ma'i tsho khag dang spyi tshogs byung /de nas rim gyis rgyal phran sil ma bcu gnyis te/ mchims yul gru shul/ / (rgyal po mchims rje gu yong /) zhang zhung yul/(rgyal po lig snya bur/) myang ro phyong dkar/(rgyal po gtsang thong dkar/) gnubs yul gling dgu/(snubs rje dmigs pa/) nyang ro sham po/(rngam rje 'brom/) kyi ri ljon sngon/(kyi ri rmang po/) ngam shod khra sna/(zing rje khri 'phrang gsum/)'ol phu spang mkhar/(zing rje thon phreng /) srib yul ral gong/(brang rje gong nam/) kong yul bre sna/(kong rje kur po tug) nyang yul rnam gsum/shā/dī sdus na glang rgyal/) dwags yul gru bzhi (dwags rje mang po rgyal/)spyi lo'i sngon gyi126lor rje gna' khri btsan po rgyal sar bskos/ yar klung du pho brang yum bu bla sgang bzhengs/ dus de nas bzung bran g.yog lam lugs kyi spyi tshogs byung / tshe mi gshen gyis rmu rgyal gyi don bsgyur ba sogs mdzadanas btsan po'i rgyal srid thog mar bskyangs/ de nas mu khri btsan po/ding khri btsan po/ so khri btsan po/ mer khri btsan po/ gdags khri btsan po/srib khri btsan po sogs rim gyis 'das shing / de dag la gnam gyi khri bdun ༵༵ ba dang / rmu thag la 'jus nas nam mkhar gshegs pas na spur dang de nas gri gum btsan po dang spu de gung rgyal gnyis byon/ yab sras 'di gnyisakyi sku ring la/ ba glang 'bri g.yag khyim du gsos pa dang / spang thang zhing du rmos/ phu chu yur bar drangs/ gter rdo bzhus nas dngul zangs

bod kyi gna' rabs rtsom rig 5lcags gsum bton/ brjid chags ldan pa'i pho brang 'phying ba stag rtse rnam par bzhengs/ 'phying yul klung du grol brdal chags/ chu chen la zam pa btsugs/ sgrung dang lde'u/ gnam bon gshen po che byung nas rgyal srid skyong shā// /dro //sdu chenā sbyi1 lta/ chab srid dang dpal 'byor/ rig gnas de nas e sho legs/ de sho legs/ thi sho legs/ gu ru legs/'brong zhi legs/ i sho legs bcas rgyal rabs drug rim gyis 'das pa la sa'i legs drug zer ba dang / de nas za nam zin lde/ lde 'phrul nam gzhung btsan/ se snol nam lde/ se snol po lde/ lde snol po/ lde rgyal po/ lde sprin btsan dang rgyal rabs brgyad rim gyis 'das/ de nas rgyal to re long btsan/su khri btsan nam/ la khri sgra dpung btsan/ khri thog rje btsan te khyon bsdoms /byi /zlos nyer bdun gyi ring la rgyal srid sgrung lde'u bon gsum gyis rnam par spyi lo254la lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan 'khrungs/ rgya gar nas sman pa bi byi dang bi lha bla ma gnyis bod du phebs te/ reg pa rtsa yi mdo dang / 'tsho ba zas kyi mdo/ sbyor ba sman gyi mdo/ gtar sreg dpyad kyi mdo/ rma chas bzo'i mdo rnams brtsams pa dang / rtsa 'grel khog dbub dang / sa dpyad lag len sogs mdzad nas 'gro don rgya cher bsgrubs/ sbyi lo 333la paṇḍi ta blo sems 'tsho dang / lo tsā ba li the si rnam pa gnyis kyis gser shog ngos su bee skuryas bris pa'i dpang bkod phyag brgya ba dang / mdo sde za ma tog gi snying bo yige drug pa/ gser gyi mchod rten/ g.yu'i mchod rten/ mu dra'i phyag rgya/tsitta ma ṇi'i skor phor bcas phyag rgya drug ste sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs rten sbya nā trī snahā/ rsharshasdu nas/ gnyan po gsang ba zhes gsol te yum bu lha khang

6 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus riga'adzinabyeba'irolamatsho/ ———de nas khri gnyan bzung btsan dang 'bro gnyan lde ru gnyis rim gyis 'das/ spyi lo 579la dmus long dgon pa bkra'am stag ri gnyan gzigs 'khrungs/ btsan po 'di'i sku ring la bre phul srang bcos 'bru mar tshad la 'jal/ tshong las dar bar gyur/ spyi lo 601la gnam ri srong btsan 'khrungs/bod kyi rgyal phran sil ma rnams gcig sdud mdzad pa'i 'go tshugs/ rgya nag gi sman rtsis bod du dar bar gyur/ spyi lo 617la srong btsan sgam po pho brang byams pa mi 'gyur lha khang du sku 'khrungs/ bal bo'i rgyal po g.yang hru'u hpha rmos rang 'gul gyis bod dang 'brel btsugs/ lag shes bzo las pa mang po bod du btang / spyi lo 633la rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos sum bha sogs mtha' bzhi'i rgyal phran mang po dbang du bsdus/ nang khul gyi gyen log zing 'khrug zil gyis mnan te rgyal srid bde 'jags kyi lam du bkod/ rgyal sa lha sar spos/ de nas bzung lha sa ni chab srid dang dmag don/ dpal 'byor dang rig gnas sogs kyi lte bar gyur/ rgyal pos thon mi sam sto ṭa sogs blo rno ba rnams rgya gar du slob gnyer mdzad par mngags/ thon mi phyir phebs rjes bod kyi yi ge gsar bzo mdzad pa dang / brda spyod kyi gzhung bcoms pa dang / lo tsā ba'i sde btsugs nas rgya gar gyi sangs rgyas chos gzhung bod du bsgyur ba'i las brtsams/ spyi lo 639la bal bza' khri btsun srong btsan sgam po'i btsun mor gdan drangs pa dang / sbyi lo yo1la rgya bza' kong jo srong btsan sgam po'i btsun mor gdan drangs pa la/ bal bzas jo bo mi bskyon rdo rje gdan drangs nas ra sa 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa dang /rgya bzas jo bo shākya mu ne gnan drangs nas rgya stag ra mo che'i gtsug lag khang rnam par bzhings te/ dam pa'i chos kyi srol btod pa dang / dge ba bcu'i khrims kyi steng du mi chos gtsang ma bcu drug gi khrims gtan 'bebs mdzad nas lag bstar mdzad pa dang / zhing las dang bzo las/ dpal 'byor dang

bod kyi gna' rabasartsom rig 7rig gnas/ dmag don dang phyi 'brel sogs gang ci'i thad nas 'dzam gling // /shā/ rshabe/ gzhi~X gyu/ra/grags snyan gyi ba dan srid rtser 'bar ba'i rgyal rgyal po srong btsan sgam po dang mong bza' khri lcam gnyis kyi sras gung ri gung btsan dgung lo bcu gsum steng rgyal sar bzhag kyang / dgung lo bco brgyad steng 'das pas slar yang yab rgyal pos srid bskyangs/ de nas mang srong mang btsan gyis srid bskyangs/ blon po stong btsan yul srung sogs la nye bar brten nas yab mes kyi srid rting legs por mnan/ de nas 'dus srong mang po rje rlung nam 'phrul gyi rgyal pos srid bskyangs/ byang gru gu'i yul du gamag drangs pas 'bangs su bkug 'jang sa dam rgyal po'ang mna' rdzusal gyi grogs por sbran/ rgyal po 'di'i sku ring la blon po rtsal bo che bdun spyi lo 690la khri lde gtsug brtan nam mes ag tshom sku 'khrungs/ de dang btsun mo ljang mo khri btsun la sras ljang tsha lha dbon zhu ba byad gzugs lha la 'gran pa zhig 'khrungs shing / lang tsho dar la bab skabs rgya nag gi rgyal po thang krung tsung gi gsos phrug gyim shing kong jo dgung lo bco lngar son pa btsun mor bsus kyang / kong jo bod la ma thon sngon du rgyal bu gshegs pas/ rgyal po mes ag tshom gyi btsun mor dbang bskur/ rgya nag nas sangs rgyas chos dpe dang sman gzhung sogs bod yig tu bsgyur te bod kyi rig gnas 'phel rgyas la shugs rkyen thebs/ spyi lo 742la khri lde gtsug brtan dang btsun mo sna nam bza' mang mo rje gnyis la sras khri srong lde btsan 'khrungs/ sbyi lo 755la rgyal sar bzhugs/ za hor yul nas mkhan po zhi ba 'tsho dang / u rgyan gyi yul nas slob dpon padma 'byung gnas gnan drangs te/ rkyen ngan rnams bsal zhing rje blon rnams kyi blo sna sangs rgyas chos la bsgyur/ bsam yas mi

8 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyusarig 'dzinabye ba'i rol mtsho/'gyur gtsug lag khang legs par bzhings/ sgra sgyur gyi lo tsā ba mang po gso skyong byas te/ bka' mdo rgyud mang po bod skad du bsgyur/ sba gsal snang /sngakhri bzher/ bai ro tsa na/ ngan lam rgyal ba mchog dbyangs/ rma rin chen mchog 'khon klu'i dbang bo bsrungs pa/ gtsang legs grub ste sad mi mi bdun gyis 'go byas nas 'bangs mi sum brgya rab tu byung ste/ sgra dang lo tsā sbyangs nas mkhas par gyur pa dang / rgya gar gyi mkhas pa bi ma la mi tra sogs gdan drangs te ye shes dbang bo gtsos rgya gar gyi chos gzhung bod du bsgyur ba dang / rgya nag gi hwa shang ma zhang ma ko le sogs spyan drangs nas bran ka legs kong / lha lung klu gong / 'go gom klu gong rnams kyis lo tsā mdzad nas rgya nag gi bstan bcos mi nyung ba zhig bod du bsgyur/ rgyal srid rnam par dar ba'i rgyal po 'di'i ring la/ lo tsā ba rgan gsum zhes bee ro tsa na/ ldan ma rtse mang /kha che a nan ta dang / lo tsā ba bar gsum zhes gnyags dzñā na ku ma ra/'khon klu'i dbang bo/ rma chen rin chen mchog dang / lo tsā ba gzhon gsum zhes ska ba dpal brtsegs/ cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan/ zhang ye shes sde bcas snyan grags dbyar rnga phyogs su ldir ba'i lo tsā ba'am skyes chen dam pa mang du byon te bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i 'phrin las rgya cher mdzad/ khyad par du sba gsal snang ngam ye shes dbang bos bod kyi lo rgyus kyi deb ther sba bzhin legs par brtsams/ yig bsgyur gyi sde rnam par btsugs nas rgya gar gyi rtsom rig ste/mgon po klu sgrub kyi shes rab brgya ba dang / gtam rin po che'i phreng ba dang /shes rab sdong bu dang / skye bo gso thigs bcas bod du bsgyur ba dang / mtho btsun grub rje'i khyad par 'phags bston dang / bde byed bdag po'i lha las phul du byung ba'i bstod pa dang / mdzangs blun zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo sogs legs bshad dang / bston pa/ gtam rgyud gang mang bod du bsgyur nas gangs can bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal dar zhing rgyas par mdzad/

bod kyigana'arabasartsomarig 9——de nas mu ni btsan po dang khri lde srong btsan sku mched gnyis byon te/mu ne btsan pos 'bangs kyi dbul phyugs thengs gsum la bsnyams/ bsam yas su sde snod gsum gyi mchod pa btsugs/ rgyal srid bskyangs nas lo gcig dang zla ba bdun la yum tshe spong bza' yis dug drangs te bkrongs/ mu tig btsan po'am sad na legs mjing yon nam khri lde srong btsan gyis srid bskyangs/ yab mes kyi gtsug lag khang rnams la mchod pa dang / lo paṇa rnams la bsnyen bkur mdzad cing / sngar ma 'gyur ba'i gsung rab du ma bod du bsgyur/ skar chung rdo rje dbyings kyi lha khang bzhengs/ bod kyi lo tsā'i bya ba /hākā // sdirsha /da sgra spyor bam gnyis gtan la phab/ bod phan pa dang bde spyi lo 806la khri gtsug lde btsan nam khri ral ba can sku 'khrungs/ rgyal po 'di nyid kyi ring la/ dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs te/ grwa ba gcig la dud khyim bdun gyis zhabs tog bsnyen bkur mdzad pa'i srol btsugs pa dang /rgyal po'i dbu sku la dar yugs ring bor btags te g.yas g.yon gyi sa la legasapar bting ba'i steng du rab tu byung ba rnams bzhugs su gsol ba la sogs mdzad nas dam chos tshad med par spel/ sbyi lo 481la rgyal po khri ral ba can gyis 'bras chang gsol nas gzims pa'i skabs su blon po sbas stag sna dang cog ro lha lod sogs kyis zhal ltag pa'i ngos su gcus nas bkrongs mthar/ thub bstan la snang ba'i blon po sbas stag sna sogs kyis khri dar ma 'u dum btsan rgyal po ru bkur/ thub bstan bod yul du spel ba ma legs par bsnyad sna tshogs btags nas sangs rgyas chos lugs kun nas bsnubs/ lo paṇa phal cher yul gzhan du bros/ ma bros pa rnams bkum/ rab byung ba phalacher skya sar phab/ mi nyan pa rnams ri dwags rngon du bcug lha khang rnams bshig pa'i thog ma ra sa 'phrul snang byas/ rgya stag ra mo che sogs kyi sgo

10 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyusarig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/la zhal ba byas shing der btsun pa chang 'thung sogs kyi ri mo bris/ de la yer ba'i brag khung na sgom byed kyin pa'i lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje mi rkyang rta rkyang du lha sar chas nas/ lo rgyus kyi rdo ring la gzigs bzhin pa'i rgyal po la phyag swātshal ba ltar bgyis te 'da' 'phangs nas bkrongs mthar ri bya bzhin bros de nas dar ma 'u dum btsan gyi sras 'od srung dang yum brtan srid la ma 'cham par/ 'od srung gis g.yon ru bzung nas 'khrug pa byas shing / de'i sras rje dpal 'khor btsan/ skyid sde nyi ma mgon/ bkra shis brtsegs pa rnams mnga' ris su bros nas mnga' ris rgyal po mdzad/ yum brtan gyi sras khri de mgon snyan/ de'i sras rig pa mgon dang nyi ma mgon/ nyi ma mgon gyi /shā /tā )pal mgon/ 'di'i rgyud rlung shod/ 'phan yul/ mdo khams su de nas bzung / bod kyi btsan po'i rgyal rabs chad nas rgyal srid nyams dmas su gyur cing / rgyal khab gzhi nas sil bur 'thor nas rje'i mnga' thang ni dgun kha'i 'bab chu bzhin bri/ dge bcu'i rgyal khrims ni sog dul gyi phon thag bzhin zhig bod 'bangs kyi bsod nams ni snum zad kyi mar me bzhin song / chab srid phan bde ni nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon bzhin yal/nag phyogs kyi spyod pa ni yul ngan gyi 'tshub ma bzhin langs/ bzang byed kyi bsam blo ni mdang gsum gyi rmi lam bzhin brjed ces pa ltar gyur/dar ma 'u dum btsan gyis sangs rgyas bstan pa bsnubs rjes/ dpal chen chu bo ri nas g.yo dge 'byung / gtsang rab gsal/ dmar shākya mu ne gsum gyis 'dul ba'i pu ti drel rgyab gsum khyer nas khams su phebs te dan tig shel gyi brag phug tu bzhugs/ de'i rjes su ka 'od mchog grags pa dang rong ston seng ge rgyal mtshan gnyis kyis mngon pa dang mdzod kyi pu ti mang po

bod kyi gna' rabs rtsom rig 11khyer nas mdo khams su bros te/ an chung gnam rdzong gi brag khung du bzhugs/de nas bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal (952da wa1035)mdo smad dan tig tu phebs te/ mkhan po gtsang rab gsal dang slob dpon g.yo dge 'byung gnyis kyi drung du rab byung bsgrubs/ de la bsam yas kyi mnga' bdag tsha na ye shes rgyal mtshan mchog gis bdag rkyen mdzad nas mdo khams su sdom pa len pa'i thog mar klu mes shes rab tshul khrims sogs dbus gtsang gi mi bdun gyis grum ye shes rgyal mtshan mkhan po dang co ro shes rab byang chub slob dpon du bsten nas rab byung bsgrubs pa dang sdom pa blangs te/ de'i sngon la mdo khams su sdom pa len par phebs pa'i mtha' bzhi rgyal 'phags sogs mi lnga dang bcas phyir dbus gtsang du phebs nas bsam yas kyi mnga' bdag tsha naye shes rgyal mtshan gyi sras gtsad po khri bas bdag rkyen mdzad par brten/dbus gtsang kun tu lha khang bzhengs/ dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs/ sangs /dhisdo /sbyi /dri ṭwāṃ / sna py-i gzims nas dbus gtsang du rnam par gsos pas/rje dpal 'khor bkān gyi sras skyid lde nyi ma mgon gyis mnga' ris rgyal po mdzad/ spu rangs la dbang bsgyur/ de la sras gsum 'khrungs/ che ba dpal gyi mgon gyis mang yul bzung / bar ba bkra shes mgon gyis pu rang bzung / chung ba lde gtsug mgon gyis zhang zhung bzung / 'di gsum la stod kyi mgon gsum zer/ lde gtsug mgon la sras gnyis 'khrungs/ 'khor re dang srong nge gnyis yin/ srong nges sku tshe smad la btsun mo khab tu bzhes pas srasan ga ra tsa dang / dhe ba ra tsa gnyis 'khrungs/ sku tshe'i smad la rab tu byung nas lha bla ma ye shes 'od du mtshan gsol/ mthon mthing dpal gyi lha khang bzhengs/ lo chen rin chen bzang bo dang / rngog legs pa'i shes rab sogs blo rno ba nyi shu rtsa gcig rgya gar du chos slob par mngags/ paṇḍi ta sha

12 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyusarig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/ka ra dang warma ta gnyis spyan drangs te/ mtshan nyid kyi theg pa dang rgyud sde bzhi bsgyur cing gtan la phab/ 'dul ba stod lugs dar bar mdzad/gcen po 'khor re yis kha char gyi lha khang bzhengs/ de'i sras lha lde pos pa ta su bha shid dang pa ta me ru spyan drangs/ lha lde po la sras gsum 'khrungs pa'i che ba zhi ba 'od/ 'bring ba lha bla ma byang chub 'od/ chung ba 'od lde'o/ /'di gsum gyi dus su lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la dgongs nas/ rgya gar du parnyi ta gdan 'dren par byon pas lam du mu stegs pa gar log gis bzung ste/ dkon mchog gi skyabs 'gro 'dor ram/ lus kyi ljid dang mnyam pa'i gser byin na phyir gtong zhes smras pas/ dbon sras rnams kyis gser mang du btsal kyang / lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyis da nged na tshod mthon por gyur pas 'di nas thon kyang bstan 'gro la phan par dka' bas gser rnams kyis rgya gar gyi rgyal po dge ba dpal gyi sras/ bṛ ka ma la shī la'i gtsug lag khang na/ rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas pa'i parnyi ta lnga brgya'i nanganas gtsug gi nor bur gyur pa jo bo rje dī baṃ kā ra zhu ba spyan drongs la bstan 'gro'i 'phrin las spel bar mdzod ces gsungs pa bzhin/ nag tsho lo tsā ba rgya gar du jo bo rje gdan 'dren par phyin nas/ spyi lo 182la jo bo rje mnga' ris su 'byor/ spyi lo 1044la 'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyisajo bo rje mnga' ris la phebs pa gsan nas khams nas zhabs thang gis mnga' ris su phebs te jo bo rje'i zhal mjal/ jo bo rje mya ngan las 'das rjes/ sngon jo bo rje yis gso skyong gnangs pa'i slob ma'i tshogs nye bar khrid de rwa sgrong du phebs/ spyi lo 1057la rwa sgrong dgon pa btab/ po to ba rin chenagasdul dkā/ spyanasngabatshul khrimasa'abar/ phusna chung ba gshān nu rgyal /rdonā rngo pa/ /shā spra //sna bye gyu shāl du byung ba mang sa bskyangs tsho/ bka'

12 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyusarig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/ka ra dang warma ta gnyis spyan drangs te/ mtshan nyid kyi theg pa dang rgyud sde bzhi bsgyur cing gtan la phab/ 'dul ba stod lugs dar bar mdzad/gcen po 'khor re yis kha char gyi lha khang bzhengs/ de'i sras lha lde pos pa ta su bha shid dang pa ta me ru spyan drangs/ lha lde po la sras gsum 'khrungs pa'i che ba zhi ba 'od/ 'bring ba lha bla ma byang chub 'od/ chung ba 'od lde'o/ /'di gsum gyi dus su lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la dgongs nas/ rgya gar du parnyi ta gdan 'dren par byon pas lam du mu stegs pa gar log gis bzung ste/ dkon mchog gi skyabs 'gro 'dor ram/ lus kyi ljid dang mnyam pa'i gser byin na phyir gtong zhes smras pas/ dbon sras rnams kyis gser mang du btsal kyang / lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyis da nged na tshod mthon por gyur pas 'di nas thon kyang bstan 'gro la phan par dka' bas gser rnams kyis rgya gar gyi rgyal po dge ba dpal gyi sras/ bṛ ka ma la shī la'i gtsug lag khang na/ rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas pa'i parnyi ta lnga brgya'i nanganas gtsug gi nor bur gyur pa jo bo rje dī baṃ kā ra zhu ba spyan drongs la bstan 'gro'i 'phrin las spel bar mdzod ces gsungs pa bzhin/ nag tsho lo tsā ba rgya gar du jo bo rje gdan 'dren par phyin nas/ spyi lo 182la jo bo rje mnga' ris su 'byor/ spyi lo 1044la 'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyisajo bo rje mnga' ris la phebs pa gsan nas khams nas zhabs thang gis mnga' ris su phebs te jo bo rje'i zhal mjal/ jo bo rje mya ngan las 'das rjes/ sngon jo bo rje yis gso skyong gnangs pa'i slob ma'i tshogs nye bar khrid de rwa sgrong du phebs/ spyi lo 1057la rwa sgrong dgon pa btab/ po to ba rin chenagasdul dkā/ spyanasngabatshul khrimasa'abar/ phusna chung ba gshān nu rgyal /rdonā rngo pa/ /shā spra //sna bye gyu shāl du byung ba mang sa bskyangs tsho/ bka'

bod kyi gna' rabs ma rig 13spyi lo 1034la 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po 'khrungs/ sku na phra ba'i dus su yab dang gcen gnyis las gsang sngags rnying ma'i gdams pa sbyangs shing /phyis su 'brog mi lo tsā ba shākya ye shes sogs mkhas grub kyi bla ma rnams las lam 'bras gtsos pa'i gsang sngags phyi 'gyur rnams la sbyangs/ dgung lo bzhi bcu ba rab byung dang po'i chu glang lor (spyi lo1073)dbon po ri'i sa //drigyi byinādi ༵ ༵ ༵ skud//ga kā btab pas/ de nas bzung sa skya ba zhes spyi lo 1092la sa chen kun dga' snying bo ni yab 'khon dkon mchog rgyalapo dang yum ma gcig zhang mo gnyis kyi sras su sku 'khrungs/ bla ma zhang rin po che sogs mkhas thub mang po bsten nas gsang sngags gsar ma'i zab chos mtha' yas pa gsan/ mngon pa dang tshad ma/ phar phyin la mkhas par gyur/ mngon shes rdzu 'phrul la thogs pa med par grags/ gdul bya mang po smin grol la bkod pa dang bstan pa'i bya ba rgya cher mdzad/ phyi lo 1258la sku gshegs/ gsung rtsom pod gnyis bzhugs/ de nas kun dga' snying bo/bsod nams rtse mo/ grags pa rgyal mtshan/ sa skya paṇa chen/ 'gro mgon 'phags pa bcas sa skya gong ma rnam lnga byon te/ gsung ngag lam 'bras chos kyi snying dzur byed pa'i ring lugs 'dzin mkhan rjes 'brang dang bcas pa dang /chos rgyud dang gdung rgyud gnyis kyi sgo nas bstan 'gro'i 'phrin las spel ba dang / bod khams yongs la chos srid zung gis dbang bsgyur ba'i 'go tshugs/gong nas brjod zin pa 'di ni bod kyi gna' rabs kyi rig gnas lo rgyus dang / bod kyi gna' rabs rtsom rig gi gnad du bsdus pa'i lo rgyus rgyab ljongs yin zhing / dus yun ring ba'i lo rgyus 'di'i nang du/ gcig na srid pa chags glu sogs gdon ma'i snyan ngag dang / gna' rabs gtam rgyud dang ngag rgyun sna tshogs/ btsan po sru de gung rgyal nas bzung dar ba'i ro

14 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/sgrung / phun sum tshogs la lo rgyus don snying ldan pa'i gna' rabs mgur glu sogs bod kyi gdod ma'i dus nas dar zhing rgyas pa dang kun nas brgyud pa'i dmangs khrod rtsom rig gi rnam pa can 'di nyid gangs can bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal gyi 'go khungs dang gzhi ma ru byung zhing 'phel ba dang / gnyis na chos rgyalasrong btsan sgam pos mdzad pa'i ma ṇi bka' 'bum dang / slob dpon thon mi'i mgur dang / rdo ring gi yi ge dang dril bu'i kha byang / gter yig sna tshogs/ sba gsal snang gis mdzad pa'i sba bzhed dang bka' gnams bu chos/ 'brom ston pas mdzad pa'i jo bo rje'i bstod pa sum cu ba dang mi chos gnadakyi phreng ba dang rje btsun mi la ras pa'i mgur 'bum sogs rgyal blon dang mkhas grub rnams kyis yig thog nas legs par mdzad pa'i rtsom rig brtsams chos phun sum tshogs par byung ba dang / gsum na gong nas brjod zin pa ste rgya gar gna' rabs kyi legs bshad dang bstod pa/ gtam rgyud dang gzhung lugs mi nyung ba zhig bod yig tu legs par bsgyur nas/ de la slob sbyong dang de yi nying bcud sdud len byas te bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal gyi phung bo la zungs khrag gsar ba bstsal ba dang / de yi bsam blo rim bzhin rgya che ba dang sgyu rtsal sngar las bkrag mdangs dang ldan par gyur/

14 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/sgrung / phun sum tshogs la lo rgyus don snying ldan pa'i gna' rabs mgur glu sogs bod kyi gdod ma'i dus nas dar zhing rgyas pa dang kun nas brgyud pa'i dmangs khrod rtsom rig gi rnam pa can 'di nyid gangs can bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal gyi 'go khungs dang gzhi ma ru byung zhing 'phel ba dang / gnyis na chos rgyalasrong btsan sgam pos mdzad pa'i ma ṇi bka' 'bum dang / slob dpon thon mi'i mgur dang / rdo ring gi yi ge dang dril bu'i kha byang / gter yig sna tshogs/ sba gsal snang gis mdzad pa'i sba bzhed dang bka' gnams bu chos/ 'brom ston pas mdzad pa'i jo bo rje'i bstod pa sum cu ba dang mi chos gnadakyi phreng ba dang rje btsun mi la ras pa'i mgur 'bum sogs rgyal blon dang mkhas grub rnams kyis yig thog nas legs par mdzad pa'i rtsom rig brtsams chos phun sum tshogs par byung ba dang / gsum na gong nas brjod zin pa ste rgya gar gna' rabs kyi legs bshad dang bstod pa/ gtam rgyud dang gzhung lugs mi nyung ba zhig bod yig tu legs par bsgyur nas/ de la slob sbyong dang de yi nying bcud sdud len byas te bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal gyi phung bo la zungs khrag gsar ba bstsal ba dang / de yi bsam blo rim bzhin rgya che ba dang sgyu rtsal sngar las bkrag mdangs dang ldan par gyur/

bod kyi gna' rabs rtsom rig 15don tshan gnyis pa/ bod kyi gdod ma'i snyan ngagadabyin ji'i snyan ngag pa cho kri thang mu'u sun gyis/ gdod ma'i dus skabs su thon skyed ngal rtsol khrod du skad cha byung zhing / skad cha'ang 'phel rgyas kyi go rim khrod du spyir btang gi skad cha dang glu gnyis su gyes so zhes gsungs la/ snyan ngag gi 'byung khungs sam rmang gzhi yang glu ru bzhed pa dang / sku zhabs lu'u zhun gyis gdod ma'i mi rnams kyis shing sdong 'khur skabasnangag nas haspri yo ha/ yono zhes pa'i sgra 'byin pa de ni gdod ma'i snyan ngag ṭwāṃ sdu zlo /zlongatre zlo bye/sa wa/ snya/na ngag gi 'go khungs yin pas snyan ngag ma byung ba'i sngon la snyan ngag tu bgrang rung tsam yin na'ang / 'phel rgyas kyi brgyud rim khrod du snyan ngag mtshan nyid pa byung ste/ de gnyis khag gnyis su gyes pa yin no/ / snyan ngag ni ches thog mar dmangs glu nas byung yang phyis su snyan ngag pa rnams la dbang ba yin no/ /de yang mi'i rigs byung zhing 'phel ba'i sbyi 'gros dang so rim ltar na/ngal rtsol gyis mi'i rigs gsar bslun byas pa dang / ngal rtsol la brten nas skad cha byung zhing 'phel ba/ ngal rtsol la brten nas dngos po'i dpal yon dang bsam blo'i dpal yon gsar bskun byas pa yin phyir/ gangs can bod la mtshon na'ang gdod ma'i dus kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal yod pa ni smos ma dgos so/ /bod kyi gdod ma'i snyan ngag ni bod kyi gdod ma'i rtsom rig gi rnam pa gal chen zhig yin par ma zad/ bod kyi snyan ngag 'phel rgyas kyi lo rgyus khrod

16 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/du go gnas nges can bzung ba'i snyan ngag sgyu rtsal zhig kyang yin pas na//sa kyi mgur glu dang snyan ngag dar rgyas la shugs rkyen chen po thebs yod bod kyi gdod ma'i spyi tshogs su byung ba'i lha sgrung gi rnam pa ldan pa'i ngag rtsom ste srid pa chags glu dang / srid pa'i ba chung bsha' glu sogs ni gdod ma'i mi rnams kyis thon skyed ngal rtsol byed pa'i go rim khrod dang / rang byung khams la 'thab rtsod byed pa'i go rim khrod du thun mong gi blo gros kyi rtsal dang // snang gi phun tshogs 'char yan las thon pa'i ngag thog gi snyan ngag 'ba' ngag thog gi snyan ngag de dag gis ni gdod ma'i mi rnams kyis kha char bu yug dang 'brug sgra glog 'khyug ri mtho lam kyog zag gzar chu brub sogs rang byung khams chen po'i gsang ba la rtog zhib dang tshod dpag byas pa'i phul byung blo gros mtshon la/ rang byung khams kyi snang tshul gzhir bzung ste/ 'char yan gyi bsam blo dang rtsed mtshar gyi nyams 'gyur la brten nas gdod ma'i mi rnams kyi bsam blo 'du shes dang mdzes sdug re 'dun mtshon par byas yod/gdod ma'i mi rnams kyi bsam gzhigs kyi chu tshad dma' ba'am kho tsho'i blo gros ni nar ma son pa'i gdod ma'i dus skabs su gnas pa yin na'ang / kho tshos rang byung khams kyi snang tshul la rtog zhib byas pa khyab che ba ste/ che ba gnam sa ri ṭwāṃ dang / rwarsha bzhi 'dab chags /kā chags sogs ljokāng spro sems 'khol /bye (tā /dro bye/ sa spro /dro bri/ byanā ༵ /na mtshungs pa'i bas bshad/ 'char srid pa chags glu dang srid pa'i ba chung bsha' glu gnyis ni bod kyi gdod ma'i spyi tshogs kyi dpe mtshon rang bzhin ldan pa'i rtsom rig sgyu rtsal cig yin pa dang / brjod bya'i ma lag tshang zhing sgyu rtsal gyi khyad chos phun sum tshogs pa'i

16 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/du go gnas nges can bzung ba'i snyan ngag sgyu rtsal zhig kyang yin pas na//sa kyi mgur glu dang snyan ngag dar rgyas la shugs rkyen chen po thebs yod bod kyi gdod ma'i spyi tshogs su byung ba'i lha sgrung gi rnam pa ldan pa'i ngag rtsom ste srid pa chags glu dang / srid pa'i ba chung bsha' glu sogs ni gdod ma'i mi rnams kyis thon skyed ngal rtsol byed pa'i go rim khrod dang / rang byung khams la 'thab rtsod byed pa'i go rim khrod du thun mong gi blo gros kyi rtsal dang // snang gi phun tshogs 'char yan las thon pa'i ngag thog gi snyan ngag 'ba' ngag thog gi snyan ngag de dag gis ni gdod ma'i mi rnams kyis kha char bu yug dang 'brug sgra glog 'khyug ri mtho lam kyog zag gzar chu brub sogs rang byung khams chen po'i gsang ba la rtog zhib dang tshod dpag byas pa'i phul byung blo gros mtshon la/ rang byung khams kyi snang tshul gzhir bzung ste/ 'char yan gyi bsam blo dang rtsed mtshar gyi nyams 'gyur la brten nas gdod ma'i mi rnams kyi bsam blo 'du shes dang mdzes sdug re 'dun mtshon par byas yod/gdod ma'i mi rnams kyi bsam gzhigs kyi chu tshad dma' ba'am kho tsho'i blo gros ni nar ma son pa'i gdod ma'i dus skabs su gnas pa yin na'ang / kho tshos rang byung khams kyi snang tshul la rtog zhib byas pa khyab che ba ste/ che ba gnam sa ri ṭwāṃ dang / rwarsha bzhi 'dab chags /kā chags sogs ljokāng spro sems 'khol /bye (tā /dro bye/ sa spro /dro bri/ byanā ༵ /na mtshungs pa'i bas bshad/ 'char srid pa chags glu dang srid pa'i ba chung bsha' glu gnyis ni bod kyi gdod ma'i spyi tshogs kyi dpe mtshon rang bzhin ldan pa'i rtsom rig sgyu rtsal cig yin pa dang / brjod bya'i ma lag tshang zhing sgyu rtsal gyi khyad chos phun sum tshogs pa'i

bod kyi gna' rabs yorig 17gdod zlo/ /spya // byi / pa red/dang ma srid pa chags dus na/ / gnam sa gnyis ka 'dres bsdad yod/ /gnam sa phye no su yin shod/ /dang ma srid pa chags dus na/ /nyin /sdo /nyis ka 'dres bsdad yod/ /nyin srib phye no su yin shod/ /ces pa'i dang ma srid pa chags dus na/ / gnam sa gnyis ka 'dres bsdad yod/ /gnam sa phye no khyung chen red/ / dang ma srid pa chags dus na/ /spyan srib gnyisna'i ka 'dres /spras sbyatā/ /nyin srib phye no nyi ma red/ / ces pa /nga /sri/ dī ṭwāṃ ṭwāṃ rāswā dī // / ṭwāṃ rdo// /ba mgo blangs nas gang la bzhag /ma shes glu bar dris ni yin/ /srid pa'i ba chung bsha' dus na/ /ba ko blangs nas gang la bzhag /ma shes glu bar dris ni yin/ /zhes pa'i lan du/srid pa'i ba chung bshas dus na/ /ba mgo blangs nas thod la bzhag /thod 'bur 'bur yin no de don red/ /srid pa'i ba chung bsha' dus na/ /sdo tram̐ za~X nas thang la bting / /thang bde bde yin no de don red/ /ces srid pa'i ba chung bsha' dus na/ /ba sha dri zhig bor song zig /rku gi rkun ma su zhig red/ /ma shes glu bar dris ni yin/ /srid pa'i ba chung bsha' dus na/ /ba tshil dri zhig bor song zig / rku gi rkun ma su zhig red/ / ma shes sku bar dris ni yin/ /srid pa'i ba chung bsha' dus na/ /ba khrag dri zhig bor song zig /rku gi rkun ma su zhig red/ /ma shes glu bar dris ni yin/ /srid pa'i ba chung bsha' dus na/ /ba khrag dri zhig bor song zig /rku gi rkun ma su zhig red/ /ma shes bar dris ni yin/ /zhes pa'i lan du/

18 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/srid pa'i ba chung bsha' dus na/ / ba sha dri zhig bor song zig / rku gi rkun ma bya pho red/ / rku ma shes bya pho'i mgo na yod/ / srid pa'i ba chung bsha' dus na/ /ba tshil dri zhig bor song zig /rku gi rkun ma skya ga red/ /rku ma shes skya ga'i pho na yod/ / srid pa'i ba chung bsha' dus na/ / ba khrag dri zhig bor song zig /rku gi rkun ma lhung ga red/ /rku ma shes lhung ga'i mchu na yod/ / ces gangs can bod kyi mes po rnams gdod ma'i spyi tshogs su 'tsho zhing bzhes skabs su rang gi bsam blo shes rgya dang / phun tshogs 'char snang gis 'jig rten chags tshul dang rang byung snang tshul sogs skad cha'i sgyu rtsal la brten nas legs par mtshon yod pa ste/ gnam sa gnyis kha dbye mkhan dang nyin srib kha 'byed mkhan/ ri mtho ba dang lam kyog pa/ thang bde ba sogs kyi rgyu mtshan bshad yod la/ ba mgo dang ba rnga/ ba ko bcas legs par spyad nas rang byung khams na snang ba'i ri bo dang bgrod lam/ rtswa thang byung tshul zhib 'bri byas pa dang / ba sha dang ba tshil/ ba khrag bcas nye bar bkol nas 'dab chags kyi gzugs dbyibs dang spu mdog ze mchu sogs thun mong ma byi/ pa'i khyad chos de dag gson nyams ldan pa'i ngang nas mtshon par byas gong gsal gyi srid pa chags glu dang srid pa'i ba chung bsha' glu gtso byas pa'icad kyi gdod ma'i snyan ngag gi brjod don phun sum tshogs pa dang rjod /tā ༵ sna/ lha sdo / kā sdo / pas na/ bsam blo'i rang bzhin dang / sgyu rtsal gyi

bod kyi gna' rabs rtsom rig 19don tshan gsum pa/ gna' rabs gtam rgyud/dang po/ 'gro ba mi'i rigasaji ltar byung ba'i gtamargyud/mi'i 'gro ba ji ltar byung ba'i skor la/ 'di lta bu'i gtam rgyud cig khyab cing ste/ de yang gdon ma'i dus su/ yar klung gtsang bo'i 'gram gyi 'phyong rgyas sa cha ni/ mkha' dbugs 'jam zhing ljon shing gis kun nas dkrigs pa'i gnas mchog cig yin zhing / gnas de'i ri khrod na spre'u byang chub sems dpa' zhig bzhugs/ rjes su spre'u byang chub sems dpa' yul de'i brag srin mo zhig dang mnyam du rol pa las/ sprel phug drug 'khrungs pa la/ spre'u byang chub sems dpa' yis de tshor shing tog gis phyug pa'i nags rma bya tshogs bya ba'i gnas su bskyal nas 'tsho ba rol du bcug lo gsum 'gor ba dang /spre'u byang chub sems dpa' blta ru phyin pa na/ spre'u phrug lnga brgyar 'phel 'dug go / de nas cung ma 'gor bar shing tog rnams zad/ gzhan za rgyu med par gyur skabs/ spre'u phrug rnams phan tshun 'thab nas 'khrug rtsod byas shing / pha lags da ni ci bya/ za ma ci za zhes zhus pas/ spre'u byang chub sems dpas thabs brgya jus stong 'then nas/ gro dang nas dang / sran ma dang bra bo sogs sa bon btsal nas sa la gtor bas na/ yul gru der ma rmos pa'i lo tog gis gang bar gyur rto/ /de nas spre'u phrug rnams kyis lo tog zos pas tshim par gyur/ lus kyi sru thung ngur song la/ mjug ma yang thung du song ste/ gos su shing lo gyon par byed/ smra shes pa'i mir gtam rgyud 'di ni mi'

20 bod kyi rtsom rig lo sa rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/rigs byung tshul gyi tshan rig gi lta ba ste/ spra nas mir gyur pa'i rtsod sgrub dngos gtso smra ba'i lo rgyus kyi lta ba dang mthun la/ mi'i rigs 'phel rim gyi tshan rig lta bar yang mthun/ rtsod sgrub dngos gtso smra ba'i lta ba ltar na/ngal rtsol gyis mi gsar du bsgrun par bshad cing / de dag spra nas mir gyur ba'igo rim hril bo'i nang ngal rtsol dang kha bral thabs med pa'i rtsa ba'i lta tshul bton yod/ nga tsho bod kyi ngag rgyun du'ang de dang sgo mthun te/ thog mar ma rmos lo tog dang sil tog shing tog rnams la rol ba dang / phyis su rim gyis rdo dang rus pa sogs kyi yo byad bzo ba'i mi'i rigs 'phel rgyas kyi go rim yod par bshad/ tshan rig gi lta ba dang pon kyi ngag rgyun mthun pa ni mi la las bshad pa ltar stes dbang gis mthun par gyur pa ni gtan nas ma yin par/ nga tsho'i mes po rnams kyis mi'i rigs byung tshu la brtag dpyad byas pa mi rigs gzhan las snga ba bden dpang byed thub la/ lhag par du/bod kha ba can gyi mes po rnams gdod ma'i dus nas mdo dbus mtho sgang du rang byu1 /mas /'thabartsodad// srung byuXkhams sdu ba/paXsgyur spras // ḍi pre /ji / pa ṭwāṃ /nga gyuje /dī 'a la ba' rlabs —na — cigs 0ga gnyisab/ gnya' khri btsan po'igatamargyud/nide yang bod kyi rgyal po'i thog ma gnya' khri btsan po byon pa'i gtam rgyud ni/ sngon 'phags pa'i byin rlabs kyis mi las 'das pa zhig bltams par bshad pa ste/ mig mas 'gebs su yod pa/ g.yu'i smin ma can/ so dung so 'khor mar yod pa/ lag pa 'khor lo'i yan lag can lta bur yod pa'i mtshan

bod kyi gna' rabasartsomarig 21ldan zhig byung ba/ yab kyis lha'i sprul bar dgongs nas sprugs pas/ lha ri spyang tho'i rtse la byon nas gzigs pa na/ yar klung gi yul gyi mtho ris kyi yon tan sa la 'phos pa ltar gzigs pa na/ yar klung gi yul ni mtho ris kyi yon tan sa la 'phos pa ltar bzang zhing / yar lha sham po'i gangs ri 'di lhun po'i mdzes sdug la chags pa'i chu shel gyi dbang bo nya gang bas 'khyud pa ltar mkhyen nas/ lha ri rol ba'i rtse la gshegs nas lha skas las babs te/btsan thang sgo bzhir zhabs zung gi 'khor lo bskyod pa'i tshe na/ yon tan can gyi bon po bcu gnyis kyi phyugs skyong bzhin pa'i dus su mthong ste/ gam du phyin nas gang nas 'ongs zhes gtam dris par/ mkha' la mdzub mo ker bas lha las chad par gor ma chag par go nas bod khams kyi rje bor 'os so zhes kānya' bar khri byas shing bteg nas 'ongs pas rje gnya' khri btsan por grags lo rgyus dang 'brel ba'i gtam rgyud 'di ru/ zhib cha ldan la gson nyams yod pa'i ngang nas rje gnya' khri btsan po'i byon tshul bstan pa dang /skabs de dag tu/ mi rnams kyis mi las 'das pa'i nam mkha'i lha zhig 'gro ba mi'i rgyal por byon te/ skabs de'i bod spyi tshogs de gcig gyur gyis bde skyid kyi lam la bkod par re mos byas pa shugs nas mtshon thub bo/ / gsumapa/ gri gumabatsanapo'igatamargyud/de yang rgyal po gri gum btsan po sku na chung ba'i tshe mtshan la ci 'dogs zhes ma ma gro zha ma skyi brling ma la dris pas na/ a phyi na re/ skyi brag mar ba e nyil/ dang ma 'bri spang mes i tshig mtsho dam le dbal e skams zhes dris

22 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/pa'i lan du/ brag ma nyil/ spang ma tshig mtsho ma skams zhes zhus kyang / a phyi mo rgas nas rna log par thos pas rten 'brel ma 'grigs par bsams nas/'o na mtshan gri gum btsan por thogs shig ces lab/ phyis btsan po'i mtshan de ltar brtags pas/ btsan po'i thugs la ma babs par yab 'bangs pha tshan dgu dang yum 'bangs gnyen tshan gsum la dpa' rtsal 'gran zer ba na/thams cad kyis 'gran mi phod ces zhus/ btsan pos lo ngam rta dzi la 'gran byas pa la/ des kyang mi phod ces zhus/ yin na'ang btsan po dbang shed che bas lo ngam yang 'u thug ste des na btsan po khyed kyi mdung gri khrab phub la sogs bdag la gnang na phod ces zhus pa la/ btsan pos dkor thams cad kho la byin nas/ myang ro thal ba tshal du g.yul bkyes te gri gum btsan po bkrongs/ ro zangs kyi sgom bu la bcug ste chur bskur ba dang / ser tshangs bya ba'i yul du klu 'od de ring mo'i gam du mchis skad/ sras gnyis(yongs grags su sras sha khri dang bya khri/ nya khri bcas gsum yod zer/ mkhas pa'i dga' ston du ming sring bzhi yod par bshad cing / sring mo de lo ngam rta dzi'i /rsha zlo bye /zung skad)mchis pa sha khyi dang nya khyir btags te skong yul du de'i rjes su/ rgya mo rngul bzhi khugs dang sna nam btsan bzhing rgyal bya ba gnyisakyis khyi gnyis kyi spu la dug bskus te btang ba la/ myang ro sham po'i drung du slobs pa na lo ngam gyis mthong ste dug yod pa'i khyi gnyis ka khrid de phyin pa dang / khyi 'di snying rje ba la yang zer bzhin khyi'i spu la byil byil byas pas/ lo ngam la dug phog ste shi de ltar dgra sha yang blangs so/ /lo rgyus kyi gtam rgyud 'di/ rgyal po gri gum btsan po'i bkra mi shis pa'i ming thogs tshul nas mgo brtsams te/ skabs de'i spyi tshogs kyi 'thab rtsod mtshon par byas shing / rgya mtsho'i rlabs rgyun bzhin gcig 'jags gcig

bod kyi gna' rabasartsomarig 23kārdo kyi rgyal rabs kyi dar rgyad rnams gson nyams ldan pa'i sgo nas bstan bzhi ga srong btsanasgamapo'i gtamargyud/de yang chos rgyal srong btsan sgam pos rgya bza' kong jo btsun mor bsu bar dgongs nas blon chen mgar stong btsan rta ba brgya dang bcas par rgya nag tu mngags/ de dag rgya'i yul du 'byor ba na/ der rgya gar dang / stag gzig ge sar/ hor sogs rgyal khab kyi pho nya'ang kong jo slong bar bslebs 'dug de nas rgya nag gi rgyal pos kong jo rgyal khab gang la ster ba thag gcod dka' bar gyur nas/ rgyal khab so so'i blon po rnams la rig pa 'gran dubacug ste rig pa rtser son pa de la ster bar thag bcad/ thog mar rgyal po'i bla g.yu sgor mo mig gcig mtha' na yod pa dang / mig gcig dkyil na yod pa zhig gtad nas/ 'di'i mig tu dar yug sus rgyun cing tshud par byas na lha cig kong jo ster ro zer/ der blon po gzhan rnams kyis ma nus/ blon po mgar gyis rgya'i grog ma zhig gi sked par dar skud btags de g.yu mig tu btsud rjes phu btab ste mtha'i mig tu thon par mdzad pas/ bod rgyal bar gyur/ de nas rgyal pos rgod ma brgya la rte'u brgya gtad nas/ ma bu ngos zin pa la lha cig kong jo ster ro zer/ gzhan rnams kyis ma shes/ blon po mgar gyis rgod ma dang rte'u rnams kha bkar nas zhag ma gcig la rtswa byin yang chu ma blud par rwa bar bcug phyi'i nyin mor rte'u rnams ma rnams kyi sar btang ba la/ rang rang gi ma btsal nas nu ma nus pas ma bu ngos zin te bod rnams rgyal bar gyur/ de nas bya ma brgya bu brgya gtad nas/ ma bu ngo shes pa la lha

24 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyusarig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/cig kong jo ster ro zer/ yang gzhan rnams kyis ma shes/ blon po mgar gyis thang yangs sheg la sbang ma gtor nas bltas tshe/ der bya rnams kha gtad cing / gnyis gnyis lhan du za ba dang / ske'i 'og nas za zhing spyod pa rtsub pa rnams ni bu yin par shes pas bod rgyal bar gyur/ de nas shing skum po'i rtsa rtse shes pa la lha cig kong jo ster ro zer/ gzhan rnams kyis ma shes/ blon po mgar gyis shing rnams chu la 'phangs nas bltas tshe/ rtsa ba lci bas gting du nub cing rtse mo yang bas gyen du 'phags pas rtsa rtse shes par gyur/ bod rgyal bar gyur/ de nas mi res lug sha bubs re zos tshar zhing pags pa mnyes zin pa la lha cig kong jo ster ro zer/ gzhan rnams kyis gang yang ma nus/bod blon rnams kyis lug sha dang lug pags so sor spungs nas sha nyung ngu nyung ngu re tshwa la bsgros te zos pas tshar zhing / pags pa rnams gral 'go nas gral rnga bar phur ba re byas pas bul bar gyur bas/ bod rgyal bar gyur/ de nas nyi ma phyed tshun la chang ban re 'thung zin pa ma bzi ba la lha cig kong jo ster ro zer/ gzhan rnams bzi zhing skyugs/ bod blon rnams kyis snod chung ngur hub re hur re 'thungs pas tshar bar gyur la ma bzi ste/ bod rgyal bar gyur/de nas nub cig glo bur du rnga bo che brdungs pas thams cad pho brang du 'tshogs pa na/ do nub lam ma 'dzol bar rang rang gi mal khang rnyed pa la lha cig kong jo ster ro zer/ gzhan rnams kyis ma rnyed/ blon po mgar gyis rnyi/ /pa / /mas la rtags brgyab pas ma nor bar mal khang rnyed de/ bod mjug mthar/ rgyal pos rgya bza' kong jo mchog gzhon nu ma mtshar sdug dang ldan pa sum brgya'i khrod du bcug nas sus ngo shes par gyur ba la ster ro zer/ de la gnas mos rogs ram byas par brten nas blon po mgar gyis bu mo sum brgya'i khrod nas lha cig kong jo ngo shes par gyur pas/ bod

bod kyi gna' rabagacomarig 25rgyal bar gyur/ de ltar bun khrin kong jo chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i btsun mor bsus te/ bod rgya gnyis dbon zhang du gyur ba'i lo rgyus byung ngo / /lo rgyus dang 'brel ba'i gtam rgyud 'dir/ phyi 'brel 'phrin las kyi rnam pas khengs la 'tsho ba'i nyams 'gyur phun sum tshogs pa'i sgo nas chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i mkhas mdzangs dang blo gros la bsngags brjod mdzad pa dang / blon po mgar stong btsan gyi mtshungs med dpa' gdeng dang khyad 'phags blo rig la gdeng 'jog dang gzengs bstod mdzad pa dang / rgya bod gnyis kyi gnyen 'brel dang mdza' mthun la bstod glu blangs so/ /lngab/ ra sa'aphrulasnang gtsugalag khang bzhengasapa'i gtamargyud/de yang sngon gyi dus su lha sa khul ni mtsho ru 'dug pa la/ chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i dus su/ bal bza' khri btsun gyis lha khang bzhings par 'dod nas sa de ru rmang btings te lha khang brtsigs pa na/ bod kyi 'dre srin dag gis nyin mo brtsigs pa mtshan mor bshig go / de nas bal bza' khri btsun gyi bsam par bod kyi sa dpyad la blta dgos snyam nas/ rgya bza' kong jo la zhus pas na/ rgya bza' kong rjos bod khams kyi sa dpyad la zhib tu bltas nas sa 'dul mdzad tshul legs par bslabs nas/ 'phan yul nas ra dkar mo la sa skyos te 'o thang gi mtsho bsubs pa'i steng lha khang rtsigs shig ces gsungs pa la/ 'phrin skyel ba'i g.yog mo yis tshig snga phyi nor nas/sngon la ra dkar mo la sa skyos la 'o thang gi mtsho subs zer zhes zhus pas/bal bza' khri btsun gyis 'phan yul nas ra dkar mo la sa bskyas nas 'o thang

26 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/gi mtsho la btab kyang chu rnyog pa tsam las mtsho ma subs pas/ khri btsun gyis rgya bza' kong jos phrag dog byas 'dug snyam nas/ chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po la thabs dris pa la/ rgyal po'i zhal nas nga la gros shig 'dri sa yod zer nas tsan dan gyi sku la gsol ba btab pas spyan g.yas nas 'od zer 'phros te 'o thang gi mtsho mo 'od zer gyi dra bas khebs so/ /phyi'i nyin mor mtsho 'gram du phebs pa dang / rgyal po'i zhal nas/ nga'i gser gyi sor gdub 'di nyid gar lhung ba'i sar lha khang gi rmang thongs gsungs nas gnam la 'phangs pa mtsho nang du lhung ngo / / bal bza' khri btsun gyi bsam par/ rgyal po dang kongajo gnyis kyis gros byas 'dug snyam nas mig mchi mas gang bas/ rgyal po'i zhal nas/ bal mo khri btsun thugs chad byed mi dgos/ rgya bza' kong josaphrag dog byas pa min/ lha khang 'dir rtsigs dang ngas kyang rogs ram bgyi yi gsungs pas/ bal bza' khri btsun yid dga' bar gyur/de nas rgyal pos bka' phab ste bal bo'i bzo bo rnams dang / bod kyi blon 'bangs rnams la lha khang rtsig tu bcug pa la/ skabs 'gar rlung chen g.yo ba dang / skabs 'gar drag char 'bab pa/ skabs 'gar sprin 'khrigs shing na bun 'thibs pa sogs byed pa na/ rgyal po yang bzo bo lnga brgyar sprul nas thugs bkod 'then zhing las dar zhugs pas/ g.yog mo zhig bal bza'akhri btsun gyi tshab tu gsol zas 'dren du 'ongs pa na rgyal po gang yin ma shes so/ / de nas nyin zhig lha khang gi ka gdung sogs ra bar bskyur yod pa'idus su sa nub pa la/ blon po mgar stong btsan gyi zhal nas/ sprin nag kyang 'khrigs/ glog kyang 'gyu/ 'brug sgra yang ldir bas/ char ba 'ong ba 'dra na/ lha khang gi shing rtsi chud zos su 'gro bar nges pas/ myur du klad dgab par 'gro'o zer zhing rnga brdungs te brda btang bas/ mi rnams kyis lwa ba dang phyar ba khyer nas rgyug pa na/ rgyal pos srod la sprul ba mdzad nas lha

bod kyi gna' rabasartsom rig 27khangagi thog phub zin 'dug go / de ltar chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i blo gros dang thabs shes la nye bar brten nas/ bal bza' khri btsun gyis ra sa 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang legs par bzhengs so/ /lo rgyus kyi gtam rgyud 'dir/ bal bza' khri btsun gyis lha khang bzhengs par 'dod pa'i snying stobs chen po dang / chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i mtshungs pa med pa'i blo gros dang rmad du byung ba'i mdzad 'phrin la bsngags brjod tshad med pa dang / bod rigs ngal rtsol mi dmangs kyi brtson sems dang blo rig la gzengs bstod bcas mdzad nas/ gnas skabs der hā/ sdo ༵ sdu/ /na gnyis bar gyi 'gal ba dang 'thab rtsod kyang shugs su

7 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyusarig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/don tshan bzhi ba/ gna' rabs mgur glu/de yang gna' rabs mgur glu zhes pa ni bod btsan po'i dus skabs kyi rje blon rnams kyis blangs pa'i mgur la zer zhing / dus yun gyi khyab khongs ni spu de gung rgyal nas bod sil bur thor ba'i bar la ngos bzung ba yin/spyir bod kyi rgyal po thog ma gnya' khri btsan po nas bzung bod kyi btsan po rim byon rnams kyi ring la bod mi dmangs kyis mgur glu grangs las 'das pa zhig gsar rtsom byas yod pa ni gdon mi za mod/ 'on kyang skabs der bod rigs mang tshogs kyi ngag thog gi mgur glu de dag yi ger bkod ma thub pa'am lo zla'i 'khor 'gros dang bstun nas nyams par gyur pa yin pa/ gang ltar kyang da lta nga tshos mig mthong du yod pa ni bod kyi rgyal rabs dgu ba sru de gung rgyal ring nas bzung byung ba'i mgur dag yin/ la dwags kyi rgyal rabs su bod kyi rgyal rabs bcu gcig pa de sho legs kyi ring la glu dang bro dar zhes byung yang de ni de sho legs kyi skabs su glu dang bro dar che ba'i don yin pa ma gtogs glu dang bro thog mar byung ba'i don ni min no/ /mgur klu'i lo rgyus dang khyad chos ltar na/ spyir mgur zhes pa 'di 'dod rgyal gyi tha snyad cig yin pa dang glu yi go don dang yongs su mtshungs kyang / dus kyi dbang gis tha snyad 'di gnyis la dbye ba byung bar bzhed de/bstan pa snga dar gyi dus su mgur dang glu zhes pa'i tha snyad gnyis ka go don gcig 'dra yin la/ chos lugs kyi nang don ldan pa'i glu la'ang skabs rer mgur dang / skabs rer glu zhes 'bod/ dper na/ phyag rgya chen po man

7 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyusarig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/don tshan bzhi ba/ gna' rabs mgur glu/de yang gna' rabs mgur glu zhes pa ni bod btsan po'i dus skabs kyi rje blon rnams kyis blangs pa'i mgur la zer zhing / dus yun gyi khyab khongs ni spu de gung rgyal nas bod sil bur thor ba'i bar la ngos bzung ba yin/spyir bod kyi rgyal po thog ma gnya' khri btsan po nas bzung bod kyi btsan po rim byon rnams kyi ring la bod mi dmangs kyis mgur glu grangs las 'das pa zhig gsar rtsom byas yod pa ni gdon mi za mod/ 'on kyang skabs der bod rigs mang tshogs kyi ngag thog gi mgur glu de dag yi ger bkod ma thub pa'am lo zla'i 'khor 'gros dang bstun nas nyams par gyur pa yin pa/ gang ltar kyang da lta nga tshos mig mthong du yod pa ni bod kyi rgyal rabs dgu ba sru de gung rgyal ring nas bzung byung ba'i mgur dag yin/ la dwags kyi rgyal rabs su bod kyi rgyal rabs bcu gcig pa de sho legs kyi ring la glu dang bro dar zhes byung yang de ni de sho legs kyi skabs su glu dang bro dar che ba'i don yin pa ma gtogs glu dang bro thog mar byung ba'i don ni min no/ /mgur klu'i lo rgyus dang khyad chos ltar na/ spyir mgur zhes pa 'di 'dod rgyal gyi tha snyad cig yin pa dang glu yi go don dang yongs su mtshungs kyang / dus kyi dbang gis tha snyad 'di gnyis la dbye ba byung bar bzhed de/bstan pa snga dar gyi dus su mgur dang glu zhes pa'i tha snyad gnyis ka go don gcig 'dra yin la/ chos lugs kyi nang don ldan pa'i glu la'ang skabs rer mgur dang / skabs rer glu zhes 'bod/ dper na/ phyag rgya chen po man

bod kyi gna' rab rtsom rig 29ngag rdo rje gsang ba'i glu zhes dang / dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i glu zhes sam/yang na/ mkha' 'gro'i brda mgur zhes dang / mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gsang ba'i glu zhes pa lta bu dang / btsan po'i dus skabs kyi rje blon rnams kyis blangs pa'i glu la'ang mgur zhes 'bod pa lta bu'o/ /bstan pa snga dar gyi rjes nas mgur dang glu gnyis la don gyi dbye ba byung zhing / mgur zhes pa glu yi zhe tshig lta bur gyur nas/ rim gyis glu zhes pa dmangs khrod du dar ba'i glu dang mgur zhes pa chos pa rnams kyi glu la go ba lta bur snang / mgur dang glu zhes pa'i tha snyad 'di gnyis kyi gang rung zhig gis kyang brjod bya'i don ston thub kyang / phyis su mgur glu zhes ming gzhi gnyis sprel nas brjod bya'i don ston parasnyed cing / gzhan yang brjod bde'i dbang gis mgur ma dang / gus pa'i cha nas gsung mgur/ gzhan la sgrog tu mi rung ba'i cha nas gsang mgur/mang ba'i cha nas mgur 'bum sogs kyi ming byung bar bzhin/gna' rabs mgur sku'am btsan po'i dus skabs kyi rje blon rnams kyis blangs pa'i mgur glu ni brjod bya'i nang don dang grangs tshad sogs phyogs gang ci'i thad nas ha cang phun sum tshogs pa zhig yod mod/ 'dir mgur glu las ches snga shos dang nang don phan tshun 'brel ba yod pa'i mgur glu skor zhig ngo sprod byed pa la/ de yang bye brag don tshan gsum gyi sgo nas 'chad de/ (1)ṭwāṃ yig (2)go bder btang ba'i mgur/ (3)lo rgyus kyi rgyab ljongs bcas

30 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/dang po/ spu de gung rgyalagyisablangasapa'i mgur/(1)ma/ 3 nyi nye ba nyid/bya ro ro na mdung gi rtse rang sdig/rdzu ṭwāṃ ṭwāṃ ḍā rdom gyi gong ra /ga// sdo rnyi// spu de myed/ ces so/ /(2)go bder btang ba'i mgur/a pha ni nye bo kho na nyid/ /bya che che na mdung gi rtse nas shi /yos bu che drags na lham gyi yu ba byed/ /phas rgol gyi dgra bo'i brla yang brdungs/ /yab chen gyi a phar bang so brtsigs/ /gcan gzan de lus med ro med byas/ /zhes pa'o/ /(3)lo saspyi ba ljongs/de yang rgyal po gri gum btsan po lo ngam rta rdzi dang 'thab pas lo ngam gyis btsan po bkrongs nas rgyal sa bzung / de'i rjes su/ rgya mo rngul bzhi khugs dang sna nam btsan bzhong rgyal bya ba gnyis kyis khyi gnyis kyi spu la dug bskus te btang ba la/ myang ro sham po'i drung du slebs pa na lo ngam gyis mthong ste dug yod pa'i khyi gnyis ka khrid de phyin pa dang / khyi 'di snying rje yang

bod kyi gna' rabs rtsom rig 31zer bzhin khyi'i spu la byil byil byas pas/ lo ngam la dug phog ste shi / de ltar dgra sha yang blangs so/ / de nas rus bkrags can gyi pha tshan dang /rus rgya can gyi pha tshan gnyis ma 'chams par 'thab/ rgyas dmag drangs te bkrags la rgol du 'ong tsa na/ bkrags kyi bud med cig gis lto bar bu 'khyer te pha yul du bros/ phyis su bu de btsas nas cher skyes pa na/ a ma la sems can thams cad la pha yod na nga'i pha ga re zhes dris shing / cis kyang nga la ston dgos zer ba na/ a ma na re/ khyod mi chung chung kha ma che/ rte'u chung chung kha ma drag ngas mi shes zhes lan btab kyang / bu ngar las skyes na re/gal te khyod kyis mi bshad na nga 'chi ru 'gro ba yin zhes 'gro grabs byas pa la/a ma'ang bya thabs zad de khyod kyi pha ni rgyas bsad/ jo bo btsan po ni lo ngam rta rdzis bkrongs/ ro ni zangs kyi sgrom la bcug te chur bskur/ da lta chu mjug ser tshangs su klu 'od de ring mo'i gam du mchis/ spun mched gnyis ni sha khyi dang nya khyir btags te rkong yul du sgyugs so zhes bshad/ der bu ngar las skyes kyis nga 'tshol du 'gro'o zer nas skong yul gyi bre sna zhes bya ba'i yul du slebs te/ sras sha khyi dang nya khyi gnyis la mjal/ klu 'od de ring mo la'ang pajal te jo bo gri /ma btsan sdu'i spun nyo rshadod paX sdi yon trī zhig dgos /pa 〈sna /nasaklu ya/ ༵/ge// shā sdog ya /go ༷ hā/sa/ 0'a rig bya rnag dang 'dra de nas bu ngar las skyes kyis ga sa ga ru btsal kyang mi de lta bu zhig ma rnyed cing / brgyags bro yang tshar bas slar yang a ma'i gam du log rgyu mtshan rnams a ma la zhus te brgyags bro gra sgrig byos dang / da dung 'tshol du 'gro ba yin zhes zhus/ de nas gang bar 'phrun zhes bya ba'i sa char slebs pa dang / bu mo zhig gis yur ma yur bzhin pa de'i gam du bcar ba la/ de'i rgyab tu byis pa zhig khur yod pa de'i mig bya mig dang 'dra bar 'og nas yar

32 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/'gebs pa mthong / byis pa de nyos nas klu 'od de ming mo la phul nas btsan po'i spur lon/ sras nya khyi dang ngar las skyes gnyis kyis yab gri gum btsan po'i srur g.yang to bla 'bubs kyi sar gdan drangs nas bang so brtsigs so/ /gcen sha khyi yis dmag sum stong sum brgya khrid de men pa 'phreng ba'i la mo brgyab/ ting slob rong ring brgyud de mthar ba chos gung dang du song /myang ro sham po la slebs pa na/ lo ngam gyi 'khor pho brgya yod pa rnams lcebs/gasbyag mo zlorgya yod pa rnams bro1/ mkhar myang ro /ma po yang bdag tu blangs//rdo/ lta /ba kā/ /spya /rdzu pa pa/nā hā bzung / phyugs rnams bdag ༷ra 'di ni gong du bkod pa'i mgur glu tshig rkang drug po de'i lo rgyus kyi rgyab ljongs red/ lo rgyus kyi rgyab ljongs 'di la bltas na mgur tshig de dag gi don go ba'i tshan gting je zab tu 'gro thub/ des na tshig rkang dang po 'a ba nyid nye bas nyid ces pa 'di'i nang du/ gri gum btsan po khong ma ma gro zha mas mtshan de lta bu zhig btags pa la thugs ma dga' bar lo ngam rta rdzi dang 'thab ste 'das pa de spyir btsan po rang nyid kyis lan pa yin mod/ 'on kyang gnyen nye tshan gyi nang du'ang rang gi pha la snying nye ba dang sha tsha ba gzhan ma mchis na/ a pha ni nye bo las kyang nye ba'i mi yin pa'i don de bstan pa dang /tshig rkang gnyis pa dang gsum pa gnyis dpe yin te/ de'i go don ni/ lo ngam rta rdzi khyod rang tshod ma zin par btsan po bkrongs pa dang / sras rnams sa mthar sgyugs pa la sogs pa'i tshod med kyi bya ba byas na/ bya dang yos bu gnyis lus bongs che drags te/ bya mdung rtse nas shi ba dang / yos bu'i pags pa lham gyi yu ba byed pa'i dpe dang mtshungs par/ nged kyi lag tu srog 'dor bar 'gyur zhes pa'i don yin/ tshig rkang bzhi ba'i brla' brdungs zhes pa ni/ khyi'i spu la dug bskus te lo ngam dug gis bkrongs pa dang /

bod kyi gna' rabasartsom rig 33btsan po'i dgra sha blangs pa de bstan pa yin/ tshig rkang lnga ba'i spur btab ces pa ni bu ngar las skyes kyis mi mig bya mig can de nyos te/ klu 'od de ring mo'i drung nas btsanapo'i spur lon pa dang / g.yang to bla 'bubs su bang so brtsigs pa la bstan pa'o/ /tshig rkang drug pa4'ob de myed sru de myed ces pa ni gcen sha khyis dmag drangs te lo ngam gyi g.yog 'khor pho mo rnams rtsa med rmag med du btang ba sogs la zer ba yin pasalo ngam dang de'i rjes 'brangs rnams ming gi lhag ma tsam yang med par byas pa'i don bstan pa'o/ /gnyisapa/ myang tsang skusablangasapa'i mgur/(1)masdug chab n-i pha rol na/yar chab ni pha rol na/rgyu'i bu n-i myi'i bu ste/lha yi ni sras po bzhugs/rje bden ni bkol du dga'/sga bden gyis n-i bstan du dga'/(2)go bde'i mgur/chu bo chu bo'i phar 'gram du/ /yar chab gtsang po'i phar 'gram na/ /mi ni mi yi bu yin yang / /don la lha yi sras po bzhugs/ /bden pa'i rgyal pos g.yog tu bkol na dga'/ /

bod kyi gna' rabasartsom rig 33btsan po'i dgra sha blangs pa de bstan pa yin/ tshig rkang lnga ba'i spur btab ces pa ni bu ngar las skyes kyis mi mig bya mig can de nyos te/ klu 'od de ring mo'i drung nas btsanapo'i spur lon pa dang / g.yang to bla 'bubs su bang so brtsigs pa la bstan pa'o/ /tshig rkang drug pa4'ob de myed sru de myed ces pa ni gcen sha khyis dmag drangs te lo ngam gyi g.yog 'khor pho mo rnams rtsa med rmag med du btang ba sogs la zer ba yin pasalo ngam dang de'i rjes 'brangs rnams ming gi lhag ma tsam yang med par byas pa'i don bstan pa'o/ /gnyisapa/ myang tsang skusablangasapa'i mgur/(1)masdug chab n-i pha rol na/yar chab ni pha rol na/rgyu'i bu n-i myi'i bu ste/lha yi ni sras po bzhugs/rje bden ni bkol du dga'/sga bden gyis n-i bstan du dga'/(2)go bde'i mgur/chu bo chu bo'i phar 'gram du/ /yar chab gtsang po'i phar 'gram na/ /mi ni mi yi bu yin yang / /don la lha yi sras po bzhugs/ /bden pa'i rgyal pos g.yog tu bkol na dga'/ /

34 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyusarig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/(3)lozlosaṭwāṃ // shā spyab tu bstan na dga'/ /de yang rgyal po stag ri gnyan gzigs kyi ring la/ yar klung gi yul spu 'dir rgyal phran gsum mchis te/ stag ri gnyan gzigs ni mkhar phying ba stag rtse na bzhugs/ zing po rje stag skya bo ni nyen kur rnying ba na mchis/ zing po rje khri pangs sum ni mkhar spur ba'i yu sna na gnas pa la/ stag skya bo de legs nyes kyi dbye ba mi shes shing / dkar nag gi go ldog ste spang blang gi cha la shin tu rmongs pa zhig yin pas/ rje 'bangs rnams phanatshun la blo mi gtod par bsam pa tha dad du yod pa'i tshe/ de'i blon po mnyan 'dzi zung nag po bya ba zhig gis rje bo la/ rje bo khyod bya ba ci la'ang phyin ci log pa sha stag mdzad pas/ 'o skol gyi srid ni srid du ma rung / chos ni chos su ma rung ste/ yul gyi 'bangs ni dbul/ srid kyi nyams ni shin tu yang dma' ste/ gal te rgyal srid 'di nyid brlag par gyur na ci bya zhes gsol ba la/ zing po rje stag skya ༷sdu mi nyan par ma zad/ 'dzi zlong khyod de skad zer ba nyes so zer nas blon —'a gra/ ṭwāṃ sna ṭwāṃ /nga kārsha gā dī rte/ zu/nga yang stag skya bor ma rangs par/ zing po rje khri pangs sum la glo ba nye bar byas nas stag skya bo bsad pa dang / stag skya bo'i yul yel rab sde bzhi dang klung ya gsum rnams khri pangs sum gyi phyag tu dngar to/ / de la zing po rje khri pangs sum gyis klung ya gsum gyi smad mnyan 'dzi zung gi bran ris su bstsal ba dang / sbyang gi rus rgyud las nam to re khru gu dang / smon to re tseng sku pha tshan kyang 'dzi zung gi bran du byin no/ /yin na'ang / skabs der zing po rje khri pangs sum gyi chab 'og tu lugs dang mi mthun pa'i gnad don gnyis snga phyir byung ba dang / khri pangs sum gyis gnad don de dag la zhib 'jug dang thag gcod legs po ma byas stabs

bod kyi gna' rabasartsom rig 35rangagi rgyal srid brlag pa'i rmang btings pa red/ dper na/ mnyan 'dzi zung gi chung ma pa tshab bza' bya bas myang tseng sku la sdug las sna tshogs btang ba dang / tha na gsang gnas ston pa sogs tshon med brnyas bcos mang po byas stabs/ myang tseng skus bzod bsran ma tshugs par zing po rje khri pangs sum la gsol ba na/ khri pangs sum gyis mnyan 'dzi zung las nga la snying nye ba med pas de'i bran du sprad bsdil sdi sta/ ba med/ derje mos parnyas ba/sa byas shātātā shārji sbyatāzlo trī ṭwāṃ sdu sdo chasdo do/ rgyas lab/ ltar myang byung sku 0na tu ma de'i rjes su/ dba' to re khru gu dang gshen khri bzher 'don kong gnyis 'phren pa'i rdzing khar 'thab nas/ gshin gyis dba' bsad pa la/ dba' yi phu bo phang to re dbyi tshab kyis nu bo gshen gyis bsad par stong gnang bar 'tshal zhes zhus kyang / zing po rje gshen khri bzher khol tshab nang blon byed pa'i ngo ma chod par/ dge bas mi dge ba bsad na/ bsad du zad do zhes bka' bsgos/ tshig de la dbyi tshab shin tu ma dga' bar yid chad do/ /de nas myang tseng sku dang dba' dbyi tshab gnyis 'grogs nas khyim du 'dongatsa//da myang tsherdo skus rang / dzom/ la dran pa'i tshig rnams glu ru blangs ༵ gu/ byeg gasna sdo ṅge sdu/ ༵ sna tse/ ba/'i ṭwāṃ/ma/sa kyi dga' sdang ste zing po rje la ma rangs pa'i bsam blo dang / stag ri gnyan gzugs la glo ba nye bar byed pa'i 'dun ma gsal bor mtshon yod/ myang tseng sku la 'dzi zung gi chung ma pa tshab bzas tshon med kyi brnyas bcos sna tshogs byas te rje bo ngan pa'i bran byed pa'i sdugabasngal mngon sum du myangs stabs/ yar klung gtsang bo'i pha rol na bzhugs pa'i mi'i bu stag ri gnyan gzigs kyi yon tan lhag par tshor thub pa'i phyir/ kho ni phyi bltas mi yi bu zhig yin rung don la lha yi sras po

36 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mcho/dang 'dra bar legs nyes spang blang gi cha la shin tu mkhas pas/ de'i g.yog tu 'gro thub na ci ma rung snyam pa'i bsam tshul de sba gsang med par dba' dbyi tshab la bshad pa dang / bsam blo de ji ma ji bzhin du mtshon pa'i slad du/rta bzang bo la sga yag pa bstan na de bas kyang mdzes pa la dpe byas pa red/dba' dbyi tshab la'ang myang tseng sku dang 'dra bar sems na rdog rdog cig yod pa dang / kho'i nu bo gshen gyis bsad pa la stong ma byin pas yi ma rangs par yod stabs/ myang tseng sku'i glu tshig des sems bkugs te/ tseng sku khyod zer ba las bden pa myed do/ kho bo yang 'di las ma rangs pa myed kyis/ khyod kyi /pa rnyi pa dang mi 'dra ri zhes tshig rnga mna' yis mnan te blo sems mthun par gsumapa/ stag ri gnyanagazigasakyi 'bangasakyisablangasapa'i mgur/(1)masagamyi bzangs ni rta bzangs zhiganyin zhing ni phag tshal na/mtshan zhidro ṭwāṃ gyidri bar mchi'/(2)go〈 snas hūṃ wang tsa'u/mi mdzes la rta yang bzang ba zhig /nyin re bzhin phag tshal nags na sdod/ /mtshan re bzhin gying ba mkhar du 'gro/ /

bod kyi gna' rabasartsom rig 37(3)lo/nā shlausdu sa ktasdu / yin cha ma 'tshal/ /mguraḥg tshan pa 'di don gyi cha nas dpyad na gong dang mu 'brel ba yin te/ myang tseng sku dang dba' dbyi tshab gnyis zing po rje khri pangs sum la blocag ste/ stag ri gnyan gzigs la glo ba nye bar byas nas mkhar phying ba stag rtser bro len du song ba'i brgyud rim mtshon pa red/ de yang dba' dbyi tshab kyis zhang bo mnon bzang to re sron bya ba la snying nye bar byas te mna' tho bcad na'ang / yun ring ma 'gor bar bzang to re shi stabs/ de'i bu pang sum 'dron po bya ba zhig zing po rje'i nang 'khor byed pa blo la btags te mna' bcad/ myang to re tseng skus tshes pong nag seng bya ba zhig blo la btags te mna' bcad/ der myang dba' mnon gsum gyis gros bgyis pa'i nang don rnams tshes pong nag seng la sbran nas rgyal po stag ri gnyan gzigs kyi snyan du gsol ba na/ btsan po'i zhal nas/ nga'i sring mo zhig kyang zing po rje'i gam du 'dug mod kyi/ da lan khyed zer ba bzhin bya'o zhes //rdo kā kto /sna/ myang dang dba'/ mnon gsum mkhar phying ba stag rtser bro kho tshos bro bor ba'i nang don ni zing po rje'i srid dbang rtsa med du gtong rgyu de yin pas re zhig gzhan la gsang ba mi byed ka med du gyur/ de'i phyir kho tsho nyin dkar phag tshal gyi nags gseb tu yib cing / mtshan mo da gzod mkhar phying ba stag rtse la song nas gros byed pa ltar byas kyang / 'bangs rnams kyi mig 'og nas thar ma thub/ yin na'ang / phying ba mkhar gyi 'bangasarnams kyis kyang kho tsho'i bya spyod ya mtshar ba de'i phugs shes ma thub pas ci yin gang yin snyam nas dogs pa skyes pa red/ gong gsal gyi mgur glu tshan pa de ni gnas tshul 'di lta bu'i thog tu byung ba yin no/ /

38 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/bzhi ba/ myang tseng sku dang dba' dbyi tshab kyisablangasapa'i mgur/(1)ma/ kā n-i lha bon to/// rdzu shā/ sbyinā pa/sna /zus rna lha bon to/trī kā /rdo /sdu tram̐ dī /sdu ltatags so/ṭwāṃ zlo// sprapa ṭwāṃ sdu/da do/(2)goX rdo kānālhar rum du 'khrungs so/rus ni lha bon yin te/ /slon btsan dang slon kol gyi rus ni lha bon no/ /srin bya 'ug pa rgod kyis bzung yang / /don la tshes pong nag seng gis bzung ba'o/ /bden pa'i sga ni rgyab tu bstad/ /mi la mi smon stobs 'byor ldan/ /bkra shis mtshe gzugs 'khrungs pa 'dra/ /(3)lo saspyi ba ljongs/myang dba' mnon gsum nyin re bzhin phag tshal nags su yib cing /

bod kyi gna' rab rtsom rig 39snardorsha/ sdo/shā / /she rsha sdu kār du song nas bro bor ba'i tshe/ stag ri gnyan stag ri gnyan gzigs la sras dang sras mo gsum mchis te/ sras gnyis ni slon btsan dang slon kol spun mched gnyis yin/ yab gshegs rjes rgyal srid slob btsan gyis bskyangs pa la/ myang dba' mnon gsum gyis kyang btsan po slon btsan spun mched gnyis la glo ba nye bar byas te/ btsan po slon btsan gyis ci gsung thams cad bka' ltar sgrub rgyu'i mna' tho bcad/de dus mna' gcod par zhugs mkhan ni/ myang tseng sku/ dba' dbyi tshab/dba' skyes snang / dba' pu tshab/ mnon 'dron po/ tshes pong nag seng bcas yin la/ gzhan yang / myang tseng cung dang / myang mu gseng / tshes pongan gu sogs kyang bro la gtogs so/ / kho tshos bro bor ba'i nang don ni/deng phan tshad zing po rje rgyab tu 'dor rgyu dang / btsan po sru rgyal la glo ba nye bar byed pa/ dus nam yang rang gi mna' bor ba'i man ngag 'dzin thub par byas te/ ngo lkog gang du'ang the tshom dang dogs pa spu tsam yang mi byed la/zing po rje la dmag byed dus snar ma'i rnam thar ring du spangs te/ dpa' zhing brtul phod pa dang / rang srog 'jom med du g.yul bkyes par bya ste/mdor na/ btsan po slon btsan gyis bka' ji ltar bstsal ba de bzhin du sgrub par 'bungs pa las/ gzhan su zhig gis g.yo dang phra ma bcug na'ang nyan par byed do zhes pa'o/ / de ltar kho tshos zing po rje la dmag 'dren pa'i /sna lha bkod la gros bsdur byas pa dang nyi chad byas te so so'i gnas su phyir chad byas pa'i nyin mo de slebs tsa na/ btsan po'i gcung slon kol dang yum stong btsun gnyis kyis rang yul srung zhing bzhugs/ btsan po khri slon btsan gyis dmag khri phrag gcig gi ru sna drangs te g.yul du chas/ myang tseng

40 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/sku dang mnon 'dron po gnyis kyis stag pa sha nu'i la tshun chad du bya ra byed pa dang gnas tshul myul zhib byas/ dba' dbyi tshab dang tshes pong nag seng gnyisakyis btsan po'i dpung gi sna drangs te chu dang 'phrad na myur du brgal/bkag rgyar 'phrad na lam gzur nas dpung 'jug byas te mkhar spur ba'i yu sna dbang du bsdus/ zing po rje ni bkums/ mang po rje sum bu ni dru gu yul du bros/ de ltar phag gi yung ba sna man chad dang / kong bre sna yan chad btsan hā'i chab 'og tu bsdus shing / yul ngas po bya ba'ang 'phan yul du ming spos gongagasal gyi mgur de ni gnas tshul de lta bu'i thog tu byung ba yin la/glu len mkhan ni myang tseng sku dang dba' dbyi tshab gnyis red/ gnam ri slon btsan zhes pa'i ming de ni dba' dbyi tshab la sogs pas/ chab srid gnam ༵༵ mtho/ dbu rmog ri bas btsan zhes che ba brjod pa'i cha nas btags desan/ tshes pong nag seng gis btags so zhes pa ni tshes pong nag seng gis btsan po'i dpung gi ru 'dren bgyis te srin bya 'ug pa rgod kyis bzung ba ltar/ zing po rje lag tu zin nas bsad pa'i don bstan pa yin la/rje bden gyis ni bkol to/ sga bden gyis ni bstan do zhes pa ni myang rtseng sku dngadaba' dbyi tshab gnyis kyi bsam don grub ste rje gnam ri srong btsan gyi 'khor du gyur pa bstan pa'o/ /mtshe gzugs rum du 'khrungs zhes pa ni zing po rje bsad pa dang / phag gi yung ba sna dang skong ze sna yan chad kyi sa cha dang ༵༵༵ kā /mas bdag tu thob pas bkra shes nyis brtsegs byung bar dpe gongagasal gyi mgur glu de dag gis btsan po'i dus skabs kyi lo rgyus gzhir bzhag skabs de'i bod kyi spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i dpe ris brjid chags

bod kyi gna' rabs rtsom rig 41 shing mdzes sdug ldan pa zhig nga tsho'i mig lam du bstan bar ma zad/ sgyu rtsal gyi thabs lam la brten nas skabs de'i rje blon bar gyi mthun 'gal dang /rgyal phran khag bar gyi dmag 'khrug sogs brjod bya'i don phun sum tshogs pa zhig bstan yod la/ bsam blo'i rang bzhin dang / sgyu rtsal gyi rang bzhin sogs phyogs gang ci'i thad nas kyang rin thang gzhal du med pa zhig red/nga chos btsan po'i dus skabs kyi mgur glu dag la bltas na/ skabs de'i lo rgyus dang chab srid/ dpal 'byor/ dmag don/ rig gnas/ skad yig gom gshes sogs kyi gnas tshul ji ltar yin pa shes thub la/ brjod bya'i srog gi cha dang sgyu rtsal mtshon stangs kyi cha gang zhig yin rung / sngar gyi gdod ma'i snyan ngag las chu tshad mthon po zhig tu slebs yod pa shes thub/brjod bya'i srog gi cha nas gdod ma'i snyan ngag gis gtso bo gdod ma'i spyi tshogs kyi snang tshul thun mong ba zhig ste/ mi dang rang byung khams bar gyi 'gal 'brel te 'jig rten chags tshul lam rang byung khams chen po'i snang tshul mtshon pa dang / mgur glus ni gtso bo mi dang mi'i bar gyi 'gal 'brel te mi'i rigs kyi spyi tshogs 'tsho ba dngos thad kur mtshon yod pas bod kyi snyan ngag byung 'phel gyi lo rgyus khrod shin tu gal che ba'i gom pa gcig spos pa yin/sgyu rtsal mtshon stangs kyi cha nas gdod ma'i snyan ngag ltar dri ba dris lan dang gab tshig tsam du ma zad par bsdus brjod dang dpe rgyan sogs snga ma las rgyan phun sum tshogs pas spras yod la/ dga' skyo chags sdang sogs tshor 'du zhugs pa'ang snga ma las ldab 'gyur gyis shugs drag pa yin no/ /ri mdor //dkāna' //sa samagur glu deg cig ni hākā gangs can gyi rtsom rte pa/ /༷ wa /bye ma ṭwāṃ spri na ཿkā / lhan/ yowa'i pa wa gyus go 4 rin thang dang sgyu rtsal

42 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/don tshan lnga ba/ sprul ba'i rgyal pos bod khams spyi la gdams pa/dang po/ rtsomapa po'i lorgyusamador bstan pa/chos kyi rgyal po srong btsan sgam po ni/ bod kyi rgyal po so gsum pa ste rgyal po gnam ri srong btsan dang tshe srung bza' gnyis kyi sras su me mo glang(spyi lo617)lor sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo bcu gsum bzhes pa'i sa glang(spyi lo629)lor bod kyi rgyal po'i khri la bzhugs/ po ta la'i ri la pho brang rmad du byung ba bzhengs/ bal bza' khri btsun khab tu bzhes/ spyi lo 641la rgya bza' kong jo btsun mor bsus/ thang gi rgyal pos khong nyid la dru ma du'u we zhes pa'i mag pa'i cho lo dang / mtsho nub ma'i rgyal po shis lha khyun dbang zhes pa'i cho lo bskur/ de nas ra sa 'phrul snang gtsug lag khang dang / rgya stag ra mo che zhes pa'i gtsug lag khang gnyis bzhengs/ rgyal po 'di nyid kyi sku ring la/ bod kyi yi ge gsar bzo mdzad/ sangs rgyas kyi chos gzhung thog mar bod yig tu bsgyur/ bka' yi khrims yig chen po drug gtan la phab pa dang /lha chos dge ba bcu dang mi chos gtsang ma bcu drug gi srol btod nas bod kyi rgyal da legs par bskyangs/ mi chen gyi bu rnams rgya nag tu yon tan slob tu btang ste/ rgya nag las chos dang / sman dang / rtsis dang / sgyu rtsal dang /dpal 'byor la sogs pa'i srol rgyun rig gnas bod du drangs te bod khams

bod kyi gna' rabs rtsom rig 43dar rgyas sbya btang ba spyang spun zla'i mi rigs bar spu phyi 'brel dang ma/na sbrel kṣiṃ /dzaṭwāṃ 6/rdzu shārjisasku ༷/ rshaswākā ༵ dang / dgung brgyad cu gya ga sa pa sa gnyisapa/ sprulaba'i rgyalaposabod khamasaspyi lagadamasapa zhesapadang de'i brjod don/༄7/ /oṃ ma ṇi patre hūṃ/ thugs rje chen po'i sprul ba chos skyong ba'i rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos/ bod 'bangs spyi mthun la gsungs pa/ bod kyi mi rnams nyon cig bod kha ba can gyi mi rnams spre'u dang brag srin mo'i bur song bas/ khong col chung la kha sprin/ khrel 'dzem dang ngo tsha chung la gsar 'grogs la dga'/ dad pa chung la sdig pa mi 'dzem/ 'gran sems che la phragadog che/ 'dod thag nye la tshig mi btsun pas/ dus phyi ma'i mi rnams chos dang gang zag gnyis ka la gsar 'grogs che bas/ chos byed pa la sgro bkur 'dogs/ chos la ni gsar sngas che bas dar skyen la nub skyen/ sgrub mi nus par bshad 'dod/ bsod nams dang 'du 'dzi la dga'/ chos brgyad kyi grags pa 'dod pa shes thag 'byung bas/ de'i dus su thugs rje chen po'i bstan pa dar bas lha dkar po sgom pa mang / rdo dkar po za ba'i dus/chos dar la ma smin pa'i bya ba yin pa/ de'i tshe thugs rje chen po'i chos byed par 'dod na 'khor ba'i mtshan nyid mi rtag pa yin/ rang rtag tu re ste tshe'i —'grub lugs bud med kyi gru'u 'thul ba bzhin 'dzad pa yin/ nyi ma nub kha'i grib so bzhin 'ded de/ bros pas mi thar/ tho yor la bya sgro btsugs pa rlung gis g.yo ba ltar nam 'chi cha med pa yin/ btson gsod sar khrid pa ltar
