slo bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/'chi ba la je nye je nyer song nas 'chi nges pa yin/ mi sha 'o dang mi dong ba phrad pa ltar 'chi ba la blu thabs med pa yin/ de la tshe 'di bas phyi ma mi dran pa yin/ de ltar dug lnga rang khar spyad na/ zhe sdang gi me 'bar bas dgra ma thul gyis dogs nas rang gi srog la mi lta/ 'dod chags kyi chu grugs pas gnyen ma skyongs kyis dogs nas/ nor rdzas la gdung sems kyi zas 'dod pa dang 'dra/ gti mug gi mun par tshud pas rang ngo rang gis ma shes pa mun khung du rdzas 'tshol ba dang 'dra/ nga rgyal gyi ri bo la 'jogs pas nga bdag gi 'gong bo dang ma bral ba chu rtsal can chus khyer ba dang 'dra/ phrag dog gi tshub mar tshud pas gnyis ka phung ba stobs can g.yang sar 'dzings pa dang 'dra/dug lnga rang khar spyad pas zhe sdang gis dmyal bar skye/ tsha grang gi sdug bsngal myong / ser snas yi dwags su skye/ bkres skom gyi sdug bsngal myong / gti mug gis byol song du skye/ bkol spyad kyi sdug bsngal myong / 'dod chags kyis mir skye/ 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal myong / nga rgyal gyis lhar skye/ 'pho ltung gi sdug bsngal myong / 'gro drug sdug bsngal gyis gcig nas gcig tu 'khor bas sdug bsngal gyi mtha' mi chod pa yin no/ / sdug bsngal de las bzlog pa'i thabs bka' rgya che lung grangs mang yang / 'gro drug gi sdug bsngal las thar bar byed pa la thugs rje chen po las lhag pa med/ snying bo yig ge drug pas rigs drug gi skye sgo gcod pa yin/ oṃ ma ṇi patre hūṃ/ oṃ ye shes lnga ldan lha yi skyabs/ 'pho sang zhi nas skye sgo gcod/ ma snying rje chen po lha min skyabs/'thab rtsod zhi nas skye sgo gcod/ ṇi byams pa chen po mi yi skyabs/ 'gyur ba zhi nas skye sgo gcod/ pad dga' ba chen po byol song skyabs/ glen lkugs zhi nas skye sgo gcod/ me btang snyoms chen po yi dwags skyabs/ bkres skom zhi nas skye sgo gcod/ hūṃ thugs rje chen po dmyal ba'i skyabs/ tsha grang zhi nas skye sgo gcod/ thugs rje chen po'i lta ba dgongs pa phyogs med mtha' bral/ sgom

bod kyi gna' rabasartsom rig 45pa rang gsal 'dzin med/ spyod pa mnyam pa ris med/ 'bras bu chos sku 'gyur da/ dam tshig dri med rnam dag 'phrin las 'gro don phyogs med/thugs rje chen po'i lta dgongs yin no/ / rang gi grogs su dam pa'i chos bzang bas thugs rje chen po'i chos la mchod cig skyel mar dkon mchog gsum bzang bas dkon mchog gsum la skyabs 'gro rgyun ma gcod cigasun mar bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro gsum bzang bas gsol ba rgyun ma chad par thob cig rgyab skyor du blta sgom spyod pa gsum bzang bas nyams su longs sheg /sdig pa phra mo nas spongs cig thigs pa bsags pas rgya mtsho tsam du 'gro'o/ / dge ba phra mo nas gyis shig ri rab chen po yang rdul phra rab nas grub bo/ /ci byas dge ba'i rtsa ba bla med byang chub tu bsngos sheg / phyi'i rgya mtsho la mchil ma gcig bor ba mi 'dzad pa ltar yin no/ /ches thugs rje chen po'i yang snying / oṃ ma ṇi padme hūṃ/ zhes pa 'di las lhag pa med do/ /bla na shātā pa/ /dri / rdzu /sna // / zlo zlo ma nor ba yin no/ / zhes sprul ba'i rgyal de yang sprul ba'i rgyal pos bod khams spyi la gdams pa zhes pa'i zhal gdams 'di nyid ni/ chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i bka' 'bum ste yongs grags su ma ṇi bka' 'bum zhes pa las legs par bshus pa yin zhing /bka' 'bum 'di nyid la stod cha dang smad cha zhes pod gnyis mchis te/ de'i brjod don ni thugs rje chen po'i sgrub skor dang / bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ thugs rje chen po'i sprul ba chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i zhal gdams/ lo rgyus chen mo sogs stod cha dang / zhal gdams kyi skor/ yi ge drug pa'i dgā khrigs bstod pa/4 skugasungathugs la 〉stod pa/ zhal gdamahā /// dīsna/ / sdo yi/ nab kta/'a —mas bka' khol ma rigs smad char bsdus tsho

46 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyusarig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/zhal gdams 'di nyid kyi brjod don gtso bo ni/ 'jig rten mi chos rmang gzhir bzung ste bod 'bangs rnams dkar po'i las dang dam pa'i chos la rnam par skul ba dang / nyon mongs dug lnga'i rang mtshang rjen par bton /sa ma ṇi yig drug gi byin rlabs dang phan yon gsal bar bstan pa de yin zhal gdams 'di nyid kyi rtsom lus ni lhug pa ru snang zhing / tshig sbyor bde zhing gcod mtshams phyed pa dang / gnad la 'khel zhing kha tshig gsal ba dang / tshig nyung zhing don 'dus pa dang / go ba bskon zhing slob gso gtong ba'i byin rlabs nus shugs dang ldan pa yin no/ /

bod kyi gna' rabasartsom rig 47don tshan drugardo pari/nga rshahā sna nga mol ba'i dbon zhang sol ba'i rdo ring zhes pa 'di ni spyi lo dus rabs dgu ba'i stod kyi cha ste/ bod kyi btsan po khri gtsug lde btsan dang thang rje mu'u tsung gnyis kyi sku ring la/ bod rgya gnyis kyi btsan po sku gong ma dag gi dus su yul zung gi sa la sa mtshams dang chu la chu mtshams bcad yod pa de(spyi lo783par cheng cu'i ru bzhag pa'i chings yig)gzhir bzhag nas dbon zhang gnyis slar yang mthun par gyur pa'i chings yig gi nang don rdo ring ngos la bris te ra sa 'phrul gyi gtsug lag khang gi mdun du bslangs yod pa de la zer zhing //hā/ lag khang mdun gyi rdo ring ngam khrang chin mthun 'brel rdo ring zhes kyang de yang bod kyi btsan po srong btsan sgam po'i ring la bod dang thang rgyal rabs gnyis bar mdza' brtse'i 'brel ba thog mar byung ba nas bzung /phyogs gnyis kyi rgyal pos phan tshun legs skyes 'bul ba dang rten 'brel zhu ba sogs kyi pho nya rgyun ma chad par btang ste mthun sgril 'brel 'dris kyi zam ma chad par byas shing / khyad par du srong btsan dang khri gtsug lde btsan gyi ring la gnyen 'brel thengs gnyis byung nas thang bod bar gyi mdza' brtse sngar las lhag par je zab tu btang / skabs de dag tu thang bod bar mthun 'brel gyi bka' mol gnang ste sa mtshams thengs du mar bcad par bshad kyang /chings yig yod pa ni thengs gnyis te/ spyi lo783par btsan po khri srong lde

4 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyusarig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/btsanadang thang rje ti tsung gnyis kyi sku ring la cheng chu'i sa char bzhag pa'i 'dum 'grig gi chings yig de dang / spyi lo 821dang822bar btsan po khri gtsug lde btsan dang thang rje mu'u tsung gnyis kyi sku ring la bzhag pa'i 'dum 'grig chings yig da lta'i rdo ring ngos su bris yod pa gnyis so/ /phyir rdo ring gi yi ge 'di thang bod bar 'dum 'grig yong ba'i mna' gan lta bu yin la/ rang re'i bod kyi lhag rtsom gyi ches thog ma'i gras su'ang bzhag chog rdo ring de'i mtho tshad la smis4 78dang zheng la smigazha 95/mthug tshad la smis0 5yod cing / ngos bzhir yi ge yod pa ste/ nub ngos su rgya bod shan sbyar gyi yi ge dang / byang ngos su bod phyogs kyi mna' gan 'jog par zhugs mkhan dpon rigs bcu bdun gyi ming tho de rgya bod shan sbyar gyi yi ger bkod yod/ lho ngos su rgya phyogs kyi mna' gan 'jog par zhugs mkhan dpon rigs bco brgyad kyi ming tho rgya bod shan sbyar gyi yi ger bkod yod/shar ngos su bod yig rkyang ba las rgya yig med/ga ma du rdo ring nub ngos g.yon gyi yi ge dang shar ngos kyi yi ge ngo sprod par bya( rte/ ring nub ngos kyi yi na)1 kho /shād kyi jul sbya chen po trī rnyihā ༵ ṭwāṃ kṣiṃ byi/ kā bye tā dngha/nga te/zhe dbon zhang gny-is/ /chab srid 5 gtsog tu sol nas/ mjal dum 6 chen po mdzad de gartsags bcas 7 pa/ /nam zhar yang my-i 'gyur bar/8 lha my-i kun rgyas shes shing dpang byas

bod kyi gna' rabasartsomarig mi9 te tshe tshe rabs rabs su gtam brjod 10 du yod pa' phyir/ /mjal dum gyi gtsigs 11 spyo mdo rdo rings la bris pa'o/ /12 ran /'phrul rgya lha btsan po khri gtsug 15 lde btsan rgya zha snga nas/ /rgya rje 14 2na glu /'u tig hwang te rkyenangaza / /ngodabon /shā /nga ga pa/layu// ṭwāṃ tā bye kā rshanā gas 17 nyes tso yang bsrung ste/ /thugs rje chen 18 pos 2/ /bka' drin gyis dgab pa 19 la lha nang snyed par/ /mang bo kun bde 20 skyid par bya ba la rna dgongs pa gtsog21 yun thang por legs pa' don chen po 22 la ni bka' gros mthun te/ /gnyen 23 rnyirdo ba' sdi 3 n-i dang snga'i sdum tshes ༷shā tā sna pa kupa // tt+waṃ ༵༵/kā tna ra 26 mdzad de/ /bod rgya gnyis/ da ltar 27 du mnga' ba' yul dang mtshams srung 28 zhing / /de'i shar phyogs thams cad ni 29 rgya chen po'i yul/ /nub phyogs thams 30 cad rna yang thag par bod chen po'i 31 yul te/ /de las phan tshun dgrar snye 32 'thab/ /dmag my-i drang / /yul my-i 33 marnam/ /yid ma ches pa zhag yod

50 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyusarig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/34 na/ /my-i bzung zhing gtam dres te/ /35 bzangs nas phyor gtang ngo / /36 da chab srid gcig cing / /mjal 37 dum chen po 'de ltar mdzad pas/ /38 dbon zhang dgyes pa'i bka' zind/ /39 lhan pas kyang 'drul dgos te/ /40 phan tshun rgya pho nya 'dong ba yang lam 41 rnying ba nas byung nas/ /snga lugs bzhin 42 / /bod rgya gnyis spyo bar/ /tsang kun 43 yog du rta brjes la/ /rtse zhung cheg du 44 rgya dang phrad pa man cad rna rgyas phu dud 45 bya/ /tseng shu spyan du bod dang phrad pa 46 yan cad rna bod kyis phu dud bya ste/ /47 dbon zhang nye zhong gnyen pa'o tshul bzhin 48 du/ /sro zhu dang bkur sto'i lugs 49 yod par sbyar te/ /yul gnyis kyi 50 bar na dud rdul 2 myi snang / /glo bur 51 du sdadu ba dang dgraX /nga n-i myi grag ste shāX dhi/ /snashā snadro drotta/zlo / // par 54 sa sa mal mal na bag brkyang ste/ bde 55 bar 'khod tsong / /skyid pa' bka' dren 56 ni rabs khro'i bar du thob/ /snyan pa' 57 sgra skad n-i gnyi zlas slebs so chog du 58 khyab ste/ /bod bod yul na skyid

bod kyi gna' rabasartsom rig 3159 rgya rgya yul na skyid pa' srid chen po (la 60 sbyar nas gartsags pa 'do/ /61 nam zhar my-i 'gyur bar/ /dkon mchog 62 gsum dang / /'phags pa' rnams dang 63 gnyi zla dang gza skar la yang dpang du 64 gsol te/ /tha lhage rnams pas kyang 65 bshad/ /srog chags bsad de mna' 66 yang bor nas/ /gtsigs bcas so/ /67 gtsigs 'do bzhin du ma byas sam/ /68 ba ga na/ /bod rgya gnyis gang gis sngar nyes 69 pa la sdig cing / /lan du dku sgyu tso byas kyang 70 gtsigs bzhag pa la ma gtogs so/ /71 'de ltar bod rgya gny-is spyo rje blon gyis zhal 72 rgyas bshags mna' bor te/ /gartsags 73 rgya bra ge zhab mor bris nas/ /rgyal po chen 74 po gny-is rgya ni phyag rgyas btab/ /blon po 75 gartsags 'dzin pa la gtogs pa rnams 76 0 ni lag yig du bris te/ /gartsags kyi 77 yi ge yang so po' phyag sbal du bzhag go/ /so/ /gzhan da rung rdo ring shar ngos su'ang yi ge tshig rkang don gcig mchis rdo ring gi yi ge 'di ni/ dus rabs bdun pa'i skabs su thang bod mi rigasaganyis bar mdza' brtse'i 'gro 'ong gi srol thog mar dar ba nas bzung lo ngo nyis brgya tsam gyi ring la/ phyogs gnyis kyi dpal 'byor dang rig gnas spel res byas pa dang / chab srid thog tu mdza' brtse'i 'brel ba dam zab

52 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/btsugs pa/ phan tshun dmag 'khrug byung ba'i skabs su'ang pho nya 'gro 'ong gi rgyu/ ma drodapa/gas/bod bar sdudza/ ba/'i mthun lam che ba'i 'brel ba ma na /sbyi shā wa sdiX wag ༵ sna kā sdo nā bye gag dīkā/ gsal gyi don gnad bdun gsal choswā kto sabo ba /ra/ dmag 'khrug thengs mang byung ba dang 'dum 'grig kyang gacho patā hā lda spra /bod kyi rgyal blon tshos mna' gan 'jog tshul/()rgya bzaX sa/ shing kong spya dang hām shing kong jo gnyis bod du bag mar ba/kāswā ༵༵ tre dīkā sakyi ga sna kā /dri snyeld zlo khri/ gtsug lde btsan gyi srid lo shan sbya/ dri/ / hāzlo ༵ spya) shā tā sna /'jog skabs kyi thang bod blon chen so so'i go gnapya gā /rdzu ༵ /dri 〉sna swārsha/ tā trī trī/thun pa'i don gnad dang lo tshigs rnams chorsha nākā lda/ sdi / ṭwā // nā shā rshaswā/ rtsom yig gi khyad chos shes thub pa bcas/ mdor na skabs de'i bod kyi chab srid dang dpal 'byor/ dmag shā ༵/sa ṭwāṃ sdursha snro kā/ che/ rsha rsha dme / rigs gzhan bar gyi 'brel ba shes thub pa'i rtsom stangs kyi cha nas bshad na/ rjod byed kyi tshig zhung ngu tsam las med rung brjod bya'i gnad don gsal zhing dag pa'i sgo nas ston thub pa dang /tshig sbyor bab chags shing tshags dam la/ gcod mtshams ran pas klog bde zhing 'gyur khug snyan pa'i khyad chos ldan no/ /

bod kyi gna' rabasartsomarig 53don tshan bdun pa/ jo bo rje'i bstod pa sum cu ba/dang po/ rtsomathapo'i lorgyusamador bsdus/rtsom pa po 'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas ni/ spyi lo 1004la yab rtagasum sku gshin dang yum khu 'od bza' gnyis kyi sras su stod lung phur sku 'khrungs/ sku na chung dus su yum gshegs pa dang yab kyis ma yar zhig blangs pa des ma gces par sdang bo byas rkyen khams su phebs te bla ma se btsun gyi sar yi ge 'bri klog sbyangs/ de nas paṇḍi ti dzha nakirti las sgra rig pa dang saṃ skṛ ta'i skad bslabs/ rab byung dang po'i chu rta(spyi lo182)la jo bo rje dpal ldanas ti sha mnga' ris su phebs pa gsan nas khams nas zhabs thang gis mnga' ris su phebs/ spu rangs su jo bo chen po dang mjal zhing bla mar bsten/ de nas jo bo rje gtsang du gdan drangs shing bla ma de las bka' chos mang du gsan/ jo bo rje sku mya ngan las 'das rjes sngon jo bo rjes gso skyong gnangs ba'i slob ma'i tshogs khrid de rwa sgreng du phebs/ rab byung dang po'i me bya(spyi lo1057)la yon bdag shākya mgon dang 'phreng kha ber chung bya ba gnyis la bsten nas bka' gdams bstan pa'i 'byung rtsa rwa sgrong dgon pa btab cing bka' gdams ring lugs pa'i grub mtha'i srol phyes/ de nas jo bo rje'i slob ma rnams 'brom gyis chos dang 'tsho ba gnyis ku'i sgo nas bskyangs te bka'agadams bstan pa'i bdag por gyur/ sras kyi thu bo po to ba rin chen gsal dang / spyan snga ba tshul khrims 'bar/ phu chung ba gzhon nu rgyal mtshan

54 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyusarig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/gtsobyas pa'i slob ma mkhas thub phul du byung ba mang bo bskyangs/ bcoms chos la jo bo rje'i bstod pa sum cu ba dang mi chos gnad kyi phreng ba sogs /shā/sdu/ rab byung dang po'i shing 'brug(sbyi lo10yo)la rwa sgrong du sku gnyisapa/ jo borje'i lorgyusamador bsdusadang khong nyid bod du gdan drangasatshul/de yang bstod pa 'di nyid ni jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha'i yon tan dang mdzad spyod la bsngags pa'i snyan ngag cig yin zhing / sum cu ba zhes pa ni bcoms chos la sho lo ga'i grangs tshad kyi sgo nas ming btags pa'o/ /jo bo rje a ti sha ni rgya gar lho phyogs rghaṃ ga la'i yul du yab za hor rgyal po dge ba dpal dang yum dpa' mo 'od zer can gnyis kyi sras su spyi lo 986la sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo bcu'i ring phyi rol mu stegs pa dang nang pa'i chos lugs kyi sgra tshad sogs la slob gnyer mdzad/ dgung lo nyer dgu bar rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi ma hā bodhi'i gtsug lag khang du rab byung mdzad de phyi nang thun mong gi rig gnas dang nang pa'i mdo sngags kyi gzhung lugs la sbyangs pa mthar phyin par mdzad/ paṇḍi ta chen po'i mtshan snyan thob/ gser gling ba sogs pa'i bla ma sum cu so bzhi tsam bsten nas rgya gar du mkhas pa grags che bar gyur/ ma gaṅgā'i gtsug lag gnas chen 'ga'i tshogs kyi bdag po mdzad/ de nas mnga' ris gu ge rgyal po lha bla ma ye shes 'od dang byang chub 'od kyis 'bad pas gdan drangs pas mnga' ris su phebs/ de rjes 'brom ston pas dbus gtsang du gdan drangs/ der lo ngo bcu bdun gyi ring la 'chad nyan gyi

bod kyi gna' rabasartsom rig 55'phrin las spel/ mdo sngags thams cad bsdus nas nyams su len pa'i rim par dril ba byang chub lam gyi sgron ma zhes bya ba gtsor byas te gzhung nyi shu lhag tsam mdzad nas bstan pa rgyas par spel bas bstan pa phyi dar dang bka' gdams pa'i grub mtha'i rmang gzhi btsugs/ khu ston brtson 'grus g.yung drung dang rngog lo tsā ba legs pa'i shes rab/ 'brom ston pa/ 'gos lo tsā ba hā/pa trī sna /// sogs slob ma mkhas pa mang du byung / spyi lo 1054la snye jo bo rje bod du gdan drangs tshul ni sngar brjod zin pa ltar dar ma 'u dum btsan gyis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsnubs rjes/ bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal sogs kyis bstan pa'i me ro mdo smad nas gsos/ de dang mtshungs su mnga' ris na lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyis srid bskyangs shing 'di bas bod du thub bstan gsal bar byed na paṇḍi ta chen po zhig dang rag las par dgongs nas thog mar rang gi 'khor 'bangs nang nas dbang bo rab can dang blo rno ba'i gzhon nu nyi shu lhag rgya gar du brdzangs/ de dag las rin chen bzang bo dang rngog legs pa'i shes rab gnyis phyir log ste bstan bcos mang bobasgyur bas lo chen lo chung du grags/ lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyis lo chen gyi gsung las skabs der 'phags yul nas snyan pa phyogs su khyab pa dpal ma gadha'i gtsug lag khang gi mkhan por bzhugs pa'i jo bo a ti sha ni paṇḍita chen por nges pa mkhyen nas/ jo bo rje gdan 'dren par byon pa'i lam du gar log gi rgyal pos btson du bzung / khong gi dbon po byang chub 'od kyis khu bo blu byed la gser mang du bsags yod pa khu bo'i zhal chems ltar rgya brtson 'grus seng ge dang nag tsho lo tsā ba gnyis la gser khyer du bcug ste rgya gar la jo bo rje gdan 'dren par bzangs/ bod rab byung dang po'i chu rta te sbyi lo 182la jo bo rje bod du phebs/ byang chub lam gyi sgron ma sogs mdzad pa'i

56 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyusarig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/sgo nas bstan pa la dag ther gnang thog bka' gdams ring lugs pa'i grub mtha'i gzhi bting / mdor na bod du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang rig gnas spel bar 'di nyid bka' drin shin tu che bas gangs can pas jo bo rje zhes zhe sdu/ //sdo sdu /thu/ sna ma khu dbon gyis jo bo nyid gdan 'dren pa'i dgongs gsumapa/ jo borje'i bstod gsumacu ba'i bsamablo'i rang bzhin/jo bo rjes sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rgyas pa'i ched dang nang sgos su bod kyi 'grob rnams rjes su 'dzin phyir lam thag ring bo'i ngal bar ma 'dzem par bod du phebs nas thub pa'i bstan pa dar rgyas su spel zhing 'gro don mdzad pa'i mdzad spyod rmad du byung ba la bsngags brjod dang / jo bo rje'i thun mong ma yin pa'i thugs rgyud kyi yon tan te/ gshes rgyud 'jam zhing thabs la mkhas pa dang shes rab ldan zhing snying rje che ba/ tshul khrims gtsang zhing rig pa'i gnas lnga kun la mkhas pa/ gzhan don khur du khyer bar 'jigs pa med pa'i snying stobs ldan pa bcas la bstod bsngags byas te/ rtsom pa pos rang gi bla ma'i bka' drin rjes su dran zhing lhag bsam bla na med pa bzung yod pa'i yin kyi nyams snang kun nas mtshon pa yin/ der ma zad/ dge rgan dang slob dpon gyi sbyi tshogs go gnas kyi gal chen rang bzhin ngos zin pa dang de la brtsi bkur bla med byed dgos pa sogs ya rabs bsam blo'ang mtshon yod/bstod tshul gyi cha nas bshad na dang po rigs rus cho 'brang dang / de nas thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rig gnas thams cad la ji ltar sbyang

bod kyi gna' rabs rtsom rig 57/shā nā ṭwā rdon hā che/ ḍi bye/da 'a /bye /kā shārnyi kāsu/ /dro zlo/ /zhi swākārji sdi spya rtogs khyad par can gyi sa lam yon tan mnga' brnyes tshul sogs la bsngags brjod byas pa ste brjod bya la go rim nges can zhig ldan pa yin/ dper na/po'i phun sum tshogs pa sdi galayiyu'asna/ /zacho rigs bsngon pa za hor rgyasdu /byed gi/spra /zhab/shā ༵ /byi la /kā /dros 'a 'khrungs pa' rgyud/ / mar — //snalhanasdo lu/gas kyi bstan bcos thams cad dang / / bzo dang gso sdu / ṭā sdu/ //sa zha /dri / la ga//kā ṭī nā /shā ༵ mkhas shing mkhyen pa rgyas/ /༵༵༵ byi trī/dzin pa'i mkhas pa mang bsten cing / / sde snod gsum dang / /kā shā/ ṭī rshakā la/ ba/ pa/ dro/ kun la mkhas shing mkhyen pa rgyas/ /dpal /lha/ /zlos/ sgyur dang bsgyur zin 'chos pa dang / / de nyid 'chad dang rang gis rtsom pa sogs/ / yang dag lam la legs par 'khrid mdzad pa'i/ zhe/zlo// ༵ rgyas mdzad khyod la gsol ba 'debs/mkho ba sbyin dang snyan par smra ba dang / /'jig rten don mthun gdul bya'i don la spyod/ / bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi yi dpal 'byor gyis/ / gzhan don lhu/ /rdo/ sprad la gsol ba 'debs/

58 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/rsha sbyin dbye spyal khrims bzodri dang brtson 'grus wang / /sdusam kātan /lha ṭwāṃ ༵ zlo sa ṭā bye/zlo ñtsha /sol/ ṭwāṃ ༵ /ba par yang yang sams pa / /—gas /sna/ ༵sa kārsha /du sku gsung thugs gsum/ phyin drug bsdu bzhi/'phags pa'i nor bdun/ 'phrin las rnam bzhi sogs kyi sgo nas bstod pa'i snyan ngag 'bri tshulakhyababarda/ du songazlo'isrolagyisgomo'ang phal cher 'di nas sbyisdo rsharsha kā zloX byi/ kā trī byi kā bod — snyan ngag gi lo rgyus khrod go gnas gal bzhi trī/'isbya ༵ // zlozlo tshom cu rtsom stangs khyad chos ni/ brjod bya'i go rim gsal zhing rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan gyis bcings pa gtso che la/ rab btags sogs 'khyog brjod kyi rgyan bkol ba nyung bas go sla ba'i rang bzhin can du gyur pa bcas dngos yod ring lugs kyi sgyu rtsal mtshon stangs shugs che bar snang / gzhan bstod pa 'dir 5byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsi'i sman blangs nas zhes dang / 'khor ba'i gcong rong / thugs rje'i lcags kyu/ thar 'dod ded dpon khyod la gsol ba 'debs/ nor bdun dag gis phyug par gyur par mdzod 7sogs mang du byung bar bltas na bod la dpe gzugs rgyan gyi rgyan bkod tshul phun sum tshogs pa yod pa rtogs nus so/ /

58 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/rsha sbyin dbye spyal khrims bzodri dang brtson 'grus wang / /sdusam kātan /lha ṭwāṃ ༵ zlo sa ṭā bye/zlo ñtsha /sol/ ṭwāṃ ༵ /ba par yang yang sams pa / /—gas /sna/ ༵sa kārsha /du sku gsung thugs gsum/ phyin drug bsdu bzhi/'phags pa'i nor bdun/ 'phrin las rnam bzhi sogs kyi sgo nas bstod pa'i snyan ngag 'bri tshulakhyababarda/ du songazlo'isrolagyisgomo'ang phal cher 'di nas sbyisdo rsharsha kā zloX byi/ kā trī byi kā bod — snyan ngag gi lo rgyus khrod go gnas gal bzhi trī/'isbya ༵ // zlozlo tshom cu rtsom stangs khyad chos ni/ brjod bya'i go rim gsal zhing rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan gyis bcings pa gtso che la/ rab btags sogs 'khyog brjod kyi rgyan bkol ba nyung bas go sla ba'i rang bzhin can du gyur pa bcas dngos yod ring lugs kyi sgyu rtsal mtshon stangs shugs che bar snang / gzhan bstod pa 'dir 5byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsi'i sman blangs nas zhes dang / 'khor ba'i gcong rong / thugs rje'i lcags kyu/ thar 'dod ded dpon khyod la gsol ba 'debs/ nor bdun dag gis phyug par gyur par mdzod 7sogs mang du byung bar bltas na bod la dpe gzugs rgyan gyi rgyan bkod tshul phun sum tshogs pa yod pa rtogs nus so/ /

bod kyi gna' rabs yorig 39don tshan brgyad pa/ rje btsun mi la nas pa'i mgur 'bum/dang po/ rtsomathapo'i lorgyusamador bsdus/mi la ras pa ni spyi lo 1040lor sku 'khrungs pa dang / spyi lo 1123lor mya ngan las 'das par bshad/ dus ni khyung bo/ rigs ni sngags rnying ma ba'i bla ma jo sras shig ste/ de yang gtsang spyon gyis mdzad pa'i rje btsun rnam thar du/ phanga'i nus dang rigs ni/ dbu ru byang phyogs kyi 'brog sde chen po zhig gi khrod nas rus khyung bo/ rigs sngags rnying ma ba'i bla ma jo sras shig gi bu rnal 'byor ba yi dam gyis rjes su bzung bas ngag nus dang ldan pa zhig rgyalakhams kyi gnas skor ba rten mjal bar phyin pas gtsang la stod byang gi phyogs gcong ba spyi zhes bya bar chag phebs te/ yul der gdon 'dre 'dul ba dang / byin rlabs byas pas nus pa dang ldan phyir phan pa shin tu mang bar byung nas gdul bya dang 'phrin las che bar 'byung ste/ mtshan khyung bo jo sras su gsol nas lo 'ga' bzhugs pa dang / gying bo jo sras la sras gnyis byung ba'i che ba ni mi la mdo ston seng ger grags/ de la sras mi la rdo rje seng ge bya ba zhig byung / 'di sho la dga' bas zhing khang nor gsum shor stabs yul las thon te/ mang yul gung thang gi skya rnga rtsa bya ba'i yul du gzhi bcas shing /yab mi la mdo ston seng gis grong chog rgyug pa dang / bu rdo rje seng ges tshong

yo bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyugarig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/byas te nor mang bo bsags/ de nas rdo rje seng gis skya rnga rtsa'i mi khyim zhig gi bu mo dang sanyen bsgrigs nas sras mi la shes rab rgyal mtshan 'khrungs pa dang /dgung lo nyi shu'i thog yul de ga'i bu mo myang tsha dkar rgyan bya ba chung mar ༵༵ /nyis sdun she ṭwāṃ rgyal dang myang tsha dkar rgyan gnyis ni mi la ras pa'i yab ༄ mi la ras pa khong 'khrungs dus yab mi la sher rgyal gyis lho rdzas mang bo khyer te byang stag rtse'i phyogs su tshong byed bzhin pa'i skabs yin la/ yum gyis pho nya mngags te gtam de yab la spran pa na/ yab kyi mchid nas thos pa'i gtam la dasa' ba cig byung bas nga'i bu'i ming la thos pa dga' thogs sheg zer ba la/ chung ming la thos pa dga' rang du thogs/skabs der mi la mdo ston seng ge yab sras kyi snyan pa'i grags pa byang la stod gcung ri bo che'i yul gru kun la khyab pas/ mi la rdo rje seng ge'i pha spun gyi bu g.yung drung rgyal mtshan gyis kyang gsan te/ rang gi bud med dang sring mo khyung tsha dpal 'gran bcas khrid de skyabs bcol bar 'ongs/ mi la ras pa dgung lo bzhir son pa'i tshe sring mo zhig skyes pa'i ming la pe ta mgon mo skyid du btags/ yun ring ma 'gor bar mi la ras pa'i spo bo mi la rdo rje seng ge tshe sduX lha/ rnyi ༵ rshang / thos pa dga' lo bdun la slebs tshe yab mi la sher rgyal yum tshe las 'das khar/ mi la ras pa ma bu gsum dang khyim tshang gi rgyu nor rnams a khu g.yung drung rgyal mtshan dang a ni khyung tsha dpal 'gran la bcolagadapasabya par/ zad/ thos pa dag khyim so pher dupa mdzesase byedro lja dī pa// zlo/ rnyipa rdorshaswā // dho sdu /bye bsheg rgyu dang / rgyu mar rnams yin na yang / a khu dang a ni gnyis kyis ma la sher rgyal gyi kha chems de

yo bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyugarig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/byas te nor mang bo bsags/ de nas rdo rje seng gis skya rnga rtsa'i mi khyim zhig gi bu mo dang sanyen bsgrigs nas sras mi la shes rab rgyal mtshan 'khrungs pa dang /dgung lo nyi shu'i thog yul de ga'i bu mo myang tsha dkar rgyan bya ba chung mar ༵༵ /nyis sdun she ṭwāṃ rgyal dang myang tsha dkar rgyan gnyis ni mi la ras pa'i yab ༄ mi la ras pa khong 'khrungs dus yab mi la sher rgyal gyis lho rdzas mang bo khyer te byang stag rtse'i phyogs su tshong byed bzhin pa'i skabs yin la/ yum gyis pho nya mngags te gtam de yab la spran pa na/ yab kyi mchid nas thos pa'i gtam la dasa' ba cig byung bas nga'i bu'i ming la thos pa dga' thogs sheg zer ba la/ chung ming la thos pa dga' rang du thogs/skabs der mi la mdo ston seng ge yab sras kyi snyan pa'i grags pa byang la stod gcung ri bo che'i yul gru kun la khyab pas/ mi la rdo rje seng ge'i pha spun gyi bu g.yung drung rgyal mtshan gyis kyang gsan te/ rang gi bud med dang sring mo khyung tsha dpal 'gran bcas khrid de skyabs bcol bar 'ongs/ mi la ras pa dgung lo bzhir son pa'i tshe sring mo zhig skyes pa'i ming la pe ta mgon mo skyid du btags/ yun ring ma 'gor bar mi la ras pa'i spo bo mi la rdo rje seng ge tshe sduX lha/ rnyi ༵ rshang / thos pa dga' lo bdun la slebs tshe yab mi la sher rgyal yum tshe las 'das khar/ mi la ras pa ma bu gsum dang khyim tshang gi rgyu nor rnams a khu g.yung drung rgyal mtshan dang a ni khyung tsha dpal 'gran la bcolagadapasabya par/ zad/ thos pa dag khyim so pher dupa mdzesase byedro lja dī pa// zlo/ rnyipa rdorshaswā // dho sdu /bye bsheg rgyu dang / rgyu mar rnams yin na yang / a khu dang a ni gnyis kyis ma la sher rgyal gyi kha chems de

bod kyi gna' rabs rtsom rig 61rna rgyab kyi lhags pa ji bzhin bor te/ pho nor rnams a khus byas/ mo nor rnams a nes byas/ gzhan rnams phyed mar bgos te khyer bas/ mi la ma bu gsum pos dbyar zhing las byed dus a khu'i g.yog dgun bal las byed dus a de'i g.yog byas nas lto khyi yi lto dang 'dra zhing / gos hral byul phrag rsharsha ༵ zlong rtswa gres ma'i ske rags bcangs te/ lus dal med du g.yog byed mkhu dang a ne gnyis kyis sdang mig dang mnar gcod tshad med byas stabs/ mi la ma bu gsum pos snying nad bcangs te dgra sha len 'dod byung na yang / a khu dang a nee gnyis la bu rabs tsha brgyud mang bas 'thab tu ma btub/ der a ma sbyang tsha dkar rgyan yang 'u thug ste mi la ras pa mthu slob par btang ba la/ mi la ras pas kyang yum gyi zhal ta rnams blo la nges par byas te yar lung skyor bo grong du song nas bla ma gnyag pa g.yung ston khro rgyal dang / gtsang rong gi bla ma gnubs pa gnyis la brten nas mthu bslabs shing / mthu'i rtags thon nas a khu'i khyim brdibs te mi sum cu so lnga shi skad/der yang a mas zhu ba nan tan gyis da dung mthu gtong dgos tshul gyi gtam 'byor bas/ slar yang ser mthu btang ste lo tog rnams ma lus par bcom/kho mo ma bu gsum gyi snying nad brtsad de sangs na'ang / mthu btang ste lo tog bcom stabs mi la ras pa dang yul mi tsho'i bar la mthun thabs med pa'i 'gal ba byung ste/ mi la ras pa rang yul du log ma phod/ gnas tshul de ṭā zlo rsha // sbyang/ /mi la ras pa'ang sdig sgrib sbyangs pa'i chen du chos slob tu mi mi la ras pas thog mar gtsang rong sna nas bla ma rong ston lha dga' bsten pa dang / des lho brag gi bla ma mar pa bya ba mi la ras pa la ngo sprod byas rjes/ mi la ras pa yang bla ma mar pa'i zhabs la gtugs te mkhar las

62 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/sogs las ka mang bo byas te lo drug dang zla ba brgyad 'gor/de ltar bla ma mar pa'i drung du sgrub par dka' ba'i mkhar las rnams grub pa dang / bzod par dka' ba'i nyams sad rnams theg par byas mthar/thob par dka' ba'i gdams ngag zab mo thob ste/ bla ma'i bka' ltar ri khrod phyogs med 'grims/ sgrub pa snying bor mdzad/ dka' spyad dang du blangs te/bu slob bgrang las 'das pa zhig rjes su bzung nas bka' brgyud bstan pa khyab par spel ba yin la/ rje 'di ba dgung lo brgyad cu gya bzhi bzhes pa'i tshe/dge bshes rtsag phu ba bya ba zhig gis phrag dog byas nas/ kho rang dang lus 'brel yod pa'i bud med cig la dug 'dren du bcug ste sku'i bkod pa bsdus hārnyi nākās rje btsun gyi rnam thar du gsal bas/ 'dir rgyas spros kyi ngal ba mi la rarnyi pa'i /ma thar mdor bsdus shig rje btsun rang gi mgur glu'i nang du zlo ṣṭṛ pa~Xng/ ḍā bye/ rla/bas pa/ /ti lo na ro'i spyan snga ru/ / dka' ba spyad pa'i ngo mtshar can/ /pha skad gnyis smra ba'i lo tsā ba/ /sgra bsgyur mar pa ma lags sam/ / de yi thugs rjes bskyangs pa yi/ / nga rang mi la ras pa 'di'i/ / pha mi la shes rab rgyal mtshan dang / / a ma myang tsha dkar rgyan yin/ /nga rang thos pa dga' zhes zer/ / sngon gyi rgyu 'bras mi bsru bas/ /nged ma smad bsod nams chung ba'i phyir/ / yab mi la de nyid dgung du gshegs/ /sgyu ma'i zas nor gang yod rnams/ / a ne dang a khu gnyis kyis 'phrogs/ /nged ma smad kyis khong gi g.yog po byas/ / za ma khyi yi lto za la/ /gos su dug po tshem ber gyon/ /skyi bser rlung dang 'khrug pa shor/ /a khu'i 'thab brdung rgyun du khur/ / a de'i ngo 'dzum dkar nag bltas/ / bran gnya' shor gyi gdan sa nged kyis phrogs/ / nged ma smad la sdug pa'i re mos

bod kyi gna' rabasartsom rig 63bab/ /sdug bsngal gyi yin mug bzod glags med/ /bla ma g.yung ston dang rong ston lha dga' las/ /mthu ser gtad gsum po rdzogs par bslabs/ /a khu dang a de'i thog drangs pas/ /yul mi khyim mtshes 'phung la btang / /nga de phyir bsams shing 'gyod pa skyes/ / rje nā ro dang mi tris byin brlabs pa/ / lho chu khyer phu na bzhugs so skad/ / pha lo tsā ba'i snyan pa rgyang nas thos/ /lam dka' ba spyad nas drung du phyin/ /pha drin chen de yi zhabs drung du/ /kho bo mi la ras pa ngas/ /lo drug dang zla mthong brgyad du bsdad/ /sras mkhar dgu thog khyams dang bcas/ / de rnams nga yis sangs kyis brtsigs/ /pha drin can des kyang thugs rjes bzung / /lta ba'i mthar thug phyag rgya che/ / gnas lugs zab mo'i ngo sprod dang / / thabs lam nā ro chos drug dang / /smin lam dbang bzhi'i chu rgyun dang / /dpal ldan nā ro'i phyag lenas/ / yid ches zhal gdams bcas par gnang / / ngas kyang le lo ma snahā ༵ snashā/ /tshe 'di blos btang bsgoms pa las/ /gtan gyi skyid mgo de /lha// bu// la /ras pa ni dgung lo brgyad bcu gya bzhir bzhugs pa dang / khong 'jig rten mi yul du bzhugs pa'i lo ngo gya bzhi'i ring la/ rgyu nor longs spyod 'dzoms pa'i pha ma'i drung gi gces phug byas te lto gos gnyis la sdug mi dgos pa'i bde skyid kyi 'tsho ba rol myong ba dang / de nas bsags pa'i pha nor gzhan la shor nas a khu dang a ni'i g.yog po byas te sdang mig sna tshogs myangs la/ de'i rjes su 'khon 'dzin gyi bsam pa bcangs nas mthu btang ste sdig pa bsags pa/ bar du bla ma bsten nas man ngag thob pa/mjug tu ting 'dzin bsgoms nas grub pa thob pa bcas skyid sdug 'dres ma'i brgyud rim bzhi byung myong mod/ 'on kyang / mi la ras pa la mtshon na/ yab

'a bodakyirjomarigalorgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/mes kyi bka' drin la brten nas rgyu nor longs spyod 'dzoms pa'i bde skyid 'tsho ba rol ba'i dus skabs des khong gi sems la dran snang zab mo zhig 'jog ma thub par snang la/ de las ldog ste bzod par dka' zhing theg par mi nus pa'i sdug bsngal gyi 'tsho ba des khong gi sems na go gnas 'gangs chen zhig bzung yod pa 'dra/ rgyu mtshan 'di'i dbang gis mi la ras pa khong 'jig rten gyi 'khor ba la zhen pa log pa dang / gnyen dang nye du la yi mug pa zhig byung ste/ 'dir snang thams cad sgyu mar go ba dang / stong nyid bden par bzung /pa ṭwāṃ trī /dzin rtse gcig tu sgom pa'i rnal 'byor ba dka' thub can zhig tu gnyisapa/ mil rasapa'i mgur 'bumagyi lorgyusamador bstan pa/mi la ras pa'i mgur 'bum gyi ming cha tshang la rje btsun mi la ras pa'i rnam thar rgyas par phye ba mgur 'bum zhes bya zhing / de ni mi la ras pa'i rnam thar gyi kha skong ngam 'grel bshad lta bu zhig red/ mi la'i rnam thar dang mgur 'bum gnyis par gzhi so sor yod na'ang / don dam du de gnyis ni kha 'bral du mi rung ba'i rtsom pa cha tshang zhig yin la/ gal te mi la ras pa'i rnam thar la slob sbyong byed na mgur 'bum med tshe go ba zab mo zhig len mi thub pa dang / de mtshungs mi la ras pa'i mgur 'bum klog skabs rnam thar ༵ byes na'ang mgur de dag gi lo rgyus kyi rgyab ljongs shes mi thub pa lta ༄ mi la ras pa'i rnam thar gyi rtsom pa po dang mgur 'bum sogs phyogs

— bodakyigana' rabs rtsom rig 65bsgrigasakhyed mkhan ni gtsang smyon he ru ka dus pa'i rgyan can bya ba de yin zhing / gtsang smyon ho ru ka ni sbyi lo 1452lor sku 'khrungs pa dang /1507lor mya ngan las 'das/ mtshan dngos la sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan zhes bya/ pha yul ni gtsang myang ston stag tshal(da lta'i rgyal rtse zhan)yin pa dang /nus ni mi la ras pa'i yum dang mthun te/ myang la bya/ gdung rgyud ni mnga' bdag khri ral ba can gyi rgyud pa yin zer/ yab kyi mtshan la sangs rgyas dpa' ldan dang / yum gyi ming la sangs rgyas 'dren zhes bya/ dgung lo bdun la son pa'i tshe mkhan chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi drung du rab tu byung ste/ mtshan sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan du gsol/ dgung lo bco brgyad thog bros stabs kyis byon te zur mkhar ba a lo chos rje la bsten zhing / gsang mtshan mi bskyon rdo rjer btags/ snga phyir la phyi chubar dang gangs ti se sogs bka' brgyud bla ma'i gnas chen rnams su bzhugs myong la/ rgyal rtse dpal 'khor chos sder byon nas gur pa grwa tshang du slob gnyer kyang mdzad myong /khong gi sgrub gnas gtso bo ni tsa ri rtsa kong yin par snang /de yang gtsang smyon zhes pa'i mtshan de thogs pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ skabs 'ga' zhig tu sku gcer bu la g.yang gzhi khrag can gsol ba dang / rgyu rlon gyi ga sha dang / gdu bu/ mi thod sogs ho ru ma'i cha byad nus rgyan dag gsol te/durakhrod dang ri khrod 'grims nas skye bo phal ba'i blor mi chud pa'i tho co'i spyod pa sna tshogs mdzad pas gtsang smyon zhes pa'i ming de thogs pa yin zer/mi la ras pa'i mgur 'bum ni gtsang smyon sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyis phyogs bsgrigs byas pa zhig yin zhing / rgod tshang ras pa thar ba rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i gtsang smyon he ru ka phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i rnam thar rdo rje theg pa'i gsal byed nyi ma'i snying bo zhes par/ gtsang smyon gyis mi la ras pa'i mgur 'bum phyogs bsgrigs mdzad pa'i dmigs yul

— bodakyigana' rabs rtsom rig 65bsgrigasakhyed mkhan ni gtsang smyon he ru ka dus pa'i rgyan can bya ba de yin zhing / gtsang smyon ho ru ka ni sbyi lo 1452lor sku 'khrungs pa dang /1507lor mya ngan las 'das/ mtshan dngos la sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan zhes bya/ pha yul ni gtsang myang ston stag tshal(da lta'i rgyal rtse zhan)yin pa dang /nus ni mi la ras pa'i yum dang mthun te/ myang la bya/ gdung rgyud ni mnga' bdag khri ral ba can gyi rgyud pa yin zer/ yab kyi mtshan la sangs rgyas dpa' ldan dang / yum gyi ming la sangs rgyas 'dren zhes bya/ dgung lo bdun la son pa'i tshe mkhan chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi drung du rab tu byung ste/ mtshan sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan du gsol/ dgung lo bco brgyad thog bros stabs kyis byon te zur mkhar ba a lo chos rje la bsten zhing / gsang mtshan mi bskyon rdo rjer btags/ snga phyir la phyi chubar dang gangs ti se sogs bka' brgyud bla ma'i gnas chen rnams su bzhugs myong la/ rgyal rtse dpal 'khor chos sder byon nas gur pa grwa tshang du slob gnyer kyang mdzad myong /khong gi sgrub gnas gtso bo ni tsa ri rtsa kong yin par snang /de yang gtsang smyon zhes pa'i mtshan de thogs pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ skabs 'ga' zhig tu sku gcer bu la g.yang gzhi khrag can gsol ba dang / rgyu rlon gyi ga sha dang / gdu bu/ mi thod sogs ho ru ma'i cha byad nus rgyan dag gsol te/durakhrod dang ri khrod 'grims nas skye bo phal ba'i blor mi chud pa'i tho co'i spyod pa sna tshogs mdzad pas gtsang smyon zhes pa'i ming de thogs pa yin zer/mi la ras pa'i mgur 'bum ni gtsang smyon sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyis phyogs bsgrigs byas pa zhig yin zhing / rgod tshang ras pa thar ba rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i gtsang smyon he ru ka phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i rnam thar rdo rje theg pa'i gsal byed nyi ma'i snying bo zhes par/ gtsang smyon gyis mi la ras pa'i mgur 'bum phyogs bsgrigs mdzad pa'i dmigs yul

yo bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/dang / dgos pa rgyu mtshan rnams bkod yod pa ste/ rje yi thugs la da lta gangs can gyi ljongs 'di na rje btsun bzhad pa rdo rje'i rnam thar dang mgur 'bum mang po 'dug na'ang / thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam thar 'di rgyun chad 'dug pas gsal bar bya ba dang / kho bo rang gi gdul bya skal bar ldan pa rnams la ni zab rgyas chos dang gdams ngag bstan nas grol bar byas shing byed mod/ bsod nams bsags par kha 'chams la/ dam pa'i chos tshul bzhin du bya ba'i long med pa'i rgyal po dang / blon po/ mi che bar rlom pa'i dpon po so so nas dmangs phal ba'i bar rnams dang / chos byed par rlom zhing byed pa'i long yod la byas na chog kyang / zab mo'i gnad nyams su len mi shes par/ tha snyad tshig gi wu ba'i rjes su nyog pa las/ tshe gcig gi sangs rgyas kyi sar 'khrid pa'i thabs khyad par can yid bzhin gyi nor bu las/ phyi rol du gyur pa'i dge bshes su rlom pa rnams la rnam dkar gyi rigs sad par bya ba la/ rje btsun bzhad pa rdo rje'i rnam thar 'di nyid mig lam du gyur na 'dod yon dang tshe 'di la zhin pa rnams la dka' thub sdug khur gyi mig rkyen/g.yeng ba la dga'e ba rnams rtse gcig tu bsgrub pa'i mig rkyen/ tshe gcig gi sangs rgyas thob pa la the tshom za zhing / zab mo sgom pa'i dus min par 'dod pa rnams la/ de dag yin pa'i mthun dpe rnam dag tu gyur nas nges don dam pa'i chos la yid ches shing zhes pa sogs ni mgur 'bum bsgrigs te par du 'debs pa'i dmigs yul dang dgos pa yin la/ mgur ma re re'i phyir yang / mnga' ris dang / dbus gtsang / dgas po/ kong bo sogs la yang yang phebs te dka' ba du mas btsal zhing phyogs bsgrigs byas pa dang / tha na rang gi srog la nyen pa lta bu'i gnas tshul 'og tu'ang mi la ras pa'i mgur 'bum 'tshol bsdu byed pa la sems phyogs pa red/ gtsang smyon gyis 'bad brtson chen po byas pa brgyud nas mi la'i mgur 'bum phyogs bsgrigs byas te

— bodakyigana' rabs rtsom rig 67 —par shing bcad pa dang / par gyi mthun rkyen yod tshad legs par byung nas shel phug tu par thengs dang po brkos nas grub cing / rab gnas dang mnga' gsol ba yang mdzad de/ phyis par ma rnams gnya' nang grod phug tu gdan drangs pa dang / par mang du btab ste dbus gtsang sogs phyogs kun tu par 'dziX 11dge swāX rsha)spras/ — sna /pa pa'i mgur 'bum de bod gangs can gyi yul ༄ /shāng pa bye na ra du/ // ༵ ༵ ṭwāṃ/tshan gyis phyogs bsgrigs byas pa'i rje btsun mi la ras pa'i rnam thar rgyas par phye ba mgur 'bum zhes bya ba 'dir/le'u(1dang / mgur glu ring thung bsdoms pas384yod pa dang / mgur 'bum 'di rtsom tshul ni bcad lhug spel mar gnas la/ bcad pa rnams ni mgur gyi tshig dang / lhug pa rnams ni rje btsun yul gang du phebs pa dang /swā sbya /sdo /phrad pa/ de dang gtam ji ltar gleng ba sogs kyi lo rgyus rags mgur 'bum 'dis nga tshos mig sngar brjid chags shing gson nyams ldan pa'i spyi tshogs kyi lo rgyus dpe ris shig bstan par ma zad/ mi la ras pa'i sku tshe gcig gi gtam spyod sogs mdzad pa mang bo go rim yod pa'i sgo nas legs bsgrigs byas te/ mi la ras pa dang khong gi bsam blo/ khong gi mgur sku'i sgru rtsal gyi rang bzhin bcas la dbye zhib dang zhib 'jug byed pa'i dpyad gzhi'i yig rigs ngo ma zhig mkho 'don byas pa red/mdor na/ mi la ras pa'i mgur 'bum ni brjod bya'i don phun sum tshogs pa dang / rjod byed tshig gi sdeb sbyor legs shing / snyan zhing yid du 'ong ba'i rtsom pa phul du byung ba zhig go / mgur 'bum las byung ba'i mgur glu de dag la chos lugs kyi lta ba zab pa dang / sgyu rtsal gyi nyams 'gyur ldan pa'i khyad chos sheg yod stabs/ bka' brgyud pa'i grub mtha' la zhib 'jug

yo bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/byed pa'i dpyad gzhi zhig yin par ma zad/ bod kyi mgur glu 'phel ba'i lo rgyus la zhib 'jug byed pa'i dpyad gzhi 'gangs chen zhig kyang red/ rgyu mtshan nges can zhig gi thog nas bshad na/ mi la ras pa'i mgur glu des bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal gyi lo rgyus thog la shugs rkyen gting zab cing / rgyang ringab zhig bzhag yod la/ dus phyis kyi rab byung btsun pa dang bla ma rnal 'byor rnams kyis kyang mi la'i mgur la dpe bltas te rtsom pa bgrang las 'das pa zhig brtsams yod cing / bod gangs can gyi spyi tshogs thog tu'ang rlung ltar khyab ste skye pho mo rgan gzhon kun gyis shes pa'i glu zhig tu gyur pa 'di ltar lags shing / lar bod rang du ma zad mes rgyal snyan ngag gi lo rgyus thog tu'ang mi la'i mgur la go sa yod la/ tha na phyi'i rgyal khab kyi yi ge la'ang dro/sna lha 'dzam gling rig gnas kyi bang mdzod nang gi nor bu zhig tu gyur gsumapa/bzlozlozlodro/ /sna/ 'bumagyi mi'i ras pa ni bka' brgyud bstan pa'i srog shing lta bu zhig yin pas/// hā /star glu'i nang don phal che ba ni bka' brgyud pa'i chos lugs kyi lta mi la ras pa ni spyod pa tshul dang mthun pa'i rnal 'byor ba zhig yin stabs/ 'dul khrims dang 'gal ba'i chos pa'i ming 'dzin pa de dag gi gtam spyod la sun 'byin dang dgag pa brgyab yod/dper na rang nyid bstan pa'i bdag po yin zer nas rgyu nor zhing khang

bod kyi gna' rabs rtsom rig 69gnyer ba/ rab byung btsun pa yin bzhin du 'jig rten 'khor bar 'khyams pa/ mo bon rtsis gsum la brten nas mang tshogs kyi mgo bo bskor ba/ bla ma'igadams ngag yin par 'chos nas bu slob kyi sems rmongs par byed pa/dri/ nāswā ṣṭṛ // rdotā hā/ // rdo g.yar nas khrim pa'i bu slob bsdu ba sogs kyi nang rang rgyud sems nyid ma shes pa'i/ /phyi sems can dmu rgod ga la thub/ / gdugs dkar rma bya'i lding khang rnams/ / mi rtag bar snang glog dang 'dra/ /de e 'dra dge ba'i bshes rang soms/ / grong ltag dgon pa'i ja thab de/ /mgo g.yog 'phung bzhi'i g.yab mo 'dra/ / de e 'dra dge ba'i bshes rang soms/ / mgo nag mi yi 'du 'dzi de/ / sdang ba dgra bo'i skor rgyug 'dra/ / de e 'dra dge ba'i bshes rang soms/ / rta nor lug gsum 'tsho skyong de/ / rtswa thog zil ba'i rlung dmar 'dra/ / de e 'dra dge ba'i bzhes rang soms/ / sgyu lus nyon mongs phung bo de/ / mi ro gser chus byugs pa 'dra/ / de e 'dra dge ba'i bshes rang soms/ / kha za 'dod tshogs kyi 'khor lo 'di/ /khral 'u lag sdud pa'i hor 'dra 'dra/ /de e 'dra dge ba'i bshes rang soms/ / mo bon rtsis gsum grong chog 'di/ / hab rdzis thebs pa'i khrim pa 'dra/ /de e 'dra dge ba'i bshes rang soms/ /nya ma mgo skor glu chung 'di/ /'dod ngan byi bla'i gsung ngag 'dra/ /de e 'dra dge ba'i bshes rang soms/ / pha yul zhing khang bdag po de/ / byis pa 'ja' la lta ba 'dra/ / de e 'dra dge ba'i bshes rang soms/ / khrim pa 'dus pa'i bu slob de/ /dpon po mang bo'i g.yog po 'dra/ /de e 'dra dge ba'i bshes rang soms/ / don 'dzin med pa'i chos bshad de/ / rdzun mas mgo skosna // trī bye// /de e 'dra dge ba'i bshes rang soms/ /

070da da bodakyirtsomarig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/de mtshungs ser sna ma spangs par sbyin pa 'dod pa dang / g.yo sgyu ma spangs par phyi tshul bcos pa/ le lo ma spangs par dge ba brtson pa/ /nyon mongs ma spangs par ye shes 'dod pa/ / phrag dog ma spangs par byang sems sdo/ ṭī kā/ brdu/dro kā/ ṣṭṛ rdo rsha ma spangs par mnyam nyid 'dod pa'i chos pa de ser sna'i mdun pa ma grol ba'i/ /kha lan sbyin pas ci la phan/ /g.yo sgyu zol zog ma spangs pa'i/ /tshul 'chos khrims kyis ci la phan/ /tshig tsub mtshon cha mi thub pa'i/ /grags 'dod bzod pas ci la phan/ /le lo snyoms las ma spangs pa'i/ /dge la brtson pas ci la phan/ /gnad 'gag zab mo ma shes pa'i/ / thos pa che bas ci la phan/ / spang blang lag len mi bstun pa'i/ /rgyu 'bras bshad pas ci la phan/ / rang rgyud chos dang mi bsnan pa'i/ /ser mo'i gzugs kyis ci la phan/ /nyon mongs dug sbrul mi gsod pa'i/ /ye shes 'dod pa log lta yin/ / phrag dog 'tshub ma ma zhi ba'i/ /bya sepas 'dobye pa lo1 lta yin/ /'alha gal 'tshe ba trī spangs pa'i/ /rwakur ༵༵ ༵ /sdo /do/kā kā / py-i/ yin//ngar 'dan phyogs chis ma spangs pa'i/ //sna/ /sna 'o/sang/sa rgyas chos lugs dang pon po'i chos lugs bar gyi 'thab rtsod de ni bstan pa snga dar gyi dus nas bzung mtshams chad ma myong bas/mi la ras pa'i mgur glu'i nang du'ang 'thab rtsod de mtshon yod pa ste/ dper na/ mi la ras pa dpon g.yog rnams gangs ti se la sgom du 'gro ba'i lam // ṭwāṃ ṭwāṃ sdu ṭwāṃ ༵ ram̐ ༵ shā/ ṭā // ṭā ༵༵ zlo / nā ro bon chung bya ba'i ming sring gangs dkar ti se sgra che yang / /ri mgo kha bas g.yogs pa cig /ma

bod kyi gna' rabagatsom rig 71pham g.yu mtsho sgra che yang / /ko sog chu yis gang ba cig /mi la ras pa sgra che yang / /mi rgan gcer nyal byed pa cig /ces glu blangs te shags btab pa dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rtsal kyang lan bzhi lnga tsam la 'gran pa ni sangs rgyas chos lugs dang pon po'i chos lugs gnyis kyi 'thab rtsod de'i rgyun mthud pa zhig red/ yin na yang / dus phyis kyi bon po'i chos lugs dang sangs rgyas chos lugs gnyis ni sha khrag gi 'brel ba yod pa'i grub mtha' mi 'dra ba gnyis su gyur pa dang / de yang thu'u bkwan blo bzang chos kyi nyi mas bon la chos 'dres chos la bon yang 'dres zhes gsungs pa ltar yin la/ rje btsun mi la ras pas gshen sgom ras pa rjes su 'dzin skabs chos glu bon dbyangs su gyer ba'i le'u de rnams kyang / bon gyi rnam pa bedaspyad de sangs rgyas kyi chos lugs dril bsgrags byas/ mi la ras pa'i bu slob kyi nang du/ gshen sgom ras pa dang nā ro bon chung ming sring sogs bon po'i chos lugs la dad pa byed mkhan 'ga' zhig sangs rgyas chos lugs la dad pa byed mkhan du gyur na yang / nang bstan dang pon chos gnyis kyi sna/kā ༵ / kta /ma par ma gyur la/ 'thab rtsod kyang ma zhi bar da lta'i bar du der ma zad/ dus rabs bcu gcig pa dang bcu gnyis pa'i skabs su/sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi nang khul du'ang grub mtha' mi 'dra ba'i dbang gis 'gal ba dang 'thab rtsod mang bo gnas pa dang / skabs der 'gal ba de dza drag che ru gyur pa ste/ dper na/ le'u so bzhi ba phrag dog gi rtsod pa rdzu 'phrul dnganus pas bzlog pa'i skor gyi mgur de dag ni 'gal ba de'i mtshon byed gson nyams ldan pa zhig go / de yang mi la ras pa gnya' nang grod pa phug na bzhugs pa'i tshe mtshan nyid grwa sa zhig yod pa la/ de'i ston pa rnams kyis mi la ras pa la phrag dog byas te/ kho ni mu stegs chos log mkhan zhig red

72 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/ces skur ba btab pa dang / gnya' nang du mu ge byung ba'i tshe na/ yul mi rnams kyis mi la ras pa la skyabs bcol bar kha 'chams/ mtshan nyid grwa sa de'i lo ston dge 'dun 'bum dang / ra ston dar ma dbang phyug sogs kyis mi la ras pa 'di ma phud na yul 'dir 'o skol gyi bstan pa dang / gang zag la 'phrin las mi 'ongs par 'dug pas/ mi la'i chos 'di chos log cig yin rung min rung phud pa legs par 'dug ces gros byas pa sogs las/ skabs shā/lha //sdu // / paju /kā kāng khe grags kho na gnyer ba'i chos pa skor zhig yin na yang / spyod pa tshul khrims la mi gnas par rgyu nor longs spyod la ham pa'i 'gram chu ldang ba/ bud med la zhen chags che ba'i chos pa ni dar sna /zloshā // tram̐ // snag nge/ kyi/ skabs de'i sbyi tshogs thog tu khyab gdal du der ma zajo/ mi la ras pa 'jig rten du 'tsho ba'i dus su'ang / spyod ngan de dag la sun 'byin byas pa dang / ngang tshul de bcos thabs bral ba'i bsam tshul yang phyir bton myong ste/ dper na/'khor ba 'di rgya mtsho chen po zhig lags sam/ / ji tsam bcus kyang mi zad gda' ba/ / dkon mchog gsum po 'di ri rgyal lhun po cig lags sam/ /de sus kyang khur ba mi gda' bar lags pa/ / dam tshig 'di lam kha'i bya sgro cig lags sam/ /de sus kyang bsrung ba mi gda' ba lags pa/ /dam chos 'bul ba 'di lam kha'i mdze ro lags sam/ / de la su yang 'ju ba mi gda' lags pa/ / stan 'bog grul gyi steng na tsher ma yod dam/ / ston chen tsho stan thog tu mi tshugs gda' ba/ / 'dul khrims 'di 'bad pa don med cig lags sam/ / rab byung btsun pa tsho 'dul khrims mi bsrung gda' ba/ /gnas ri khrod na hor ban gyi jag pa yod dam/ /sgom chen tsho grong yul

bodakyigana'arabasartsomarig 0 73 0'grims shing gda' ba/ / bar do'i gnas na skye sgo zhen nam/ / nya ma tsho phyi bdar rim zhing gda' ba/ / tshe phyi ma'i yul na snam rin che'am/ / a ni btsun ma tsho snam thags rim zhing gda' ba/ / 'khor ba 'di stongs kyis dogs pa lags sam/ / skya btsun med bu slob rem zhing gda' ba/ / tshe phyi ma'i yul na bza' btung mod dam/ / yon bdag pho mo tsho sbyin pa mi gtong spyada'ab/ /ya gi dga' ldan lha yulan sdig bsngal lo/ /ma/ /de ru 'gro mi /sna ༵ ṭwā ṭwāṃ shā kāswā rnyi/da ci/dro ga // rdzu ba yul na ba —da ldan nam/ / kha /spra ṭwāṃ kto bu/ /la /ras pas rang gi thugs sras ras chung rdo rje grags pa sna // ༵ /sa /dro /sdo gi dbye ba ma nor bar 'byed dgos pa'i bslab bya bu gcig gson dang ras chung ba/ / da lta dam chos dar lags snang / /chos 'dra min masdo bos bsres bslad byas/ /bla ma slob dpon byed tre /zlos/ zhig/ kā sdu sbyang 'a da gtam chags par smra/ / brgyud pa bzang rgyu ṭwāṃ sdu /shā :/ /bsla/ba bya 'di ni lo ngo dgu brgya lhag gi yar sngon la khong tta //dri /sna ṭwāṃ sna / rsha ba la gnang ba yin mod/ 'on kyang da yod kyi don bzhi ba/ milarasapa'i mgur 'bumagyisna rtsalarang bzhin/mi la ras pa'i mgur 'bum du phyogs bsgrigs byas pa'i mi la rang

74 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/gis bzhings pa'i mgur 4322yod pa de rnams kyi brjod bya'i don phun sum tshogs pa zhig yin la/ phyi rol yul gyi 'jig rten du gnas pa'i nyi zla skar gsum gyi 'char nub dang / rlung sprin char gsum gyi rgyu phyogs/ mtsho dang mtshe'u/ ri dang nags tshal/ gnam la 'phur dgu dang sa la 'dzul dgu tshang mar dpe blangs te rjod byed kyi tshig snyan mo la brten nas/ brjod bya'i don rnamasago bde bar ston pa ni mi la ras pa'i mgur gyi khyad chos mngon par gsal ba zhig go / de dag cung zad cig 'chad na/gcig dpe la brten nas dpe can go bar byed pa/ dper na/phyi snang ba dpe ru bstan ma bstan/ / snang ba dpe ru bstan tsa na/ /gser lo thang dkar de dang gcig /g.yu lo me tog de dang gnyis/ /phu yi she'u de dang gsum/ / mda' yi 'bras drug legs dang bzhi/ / za 'og khrigs se de dang lnga/ nor bu rin chen de dang drug / tshes gsum zla ba de dang bdun/ / mi bu rin chen de dang brgyad/ / sngon chad tshig la skyor ma myong / /glu de yi phyi rjes ma bzlos na/ / tshig de'i don gyi brda mi khrol/ /tshig de don dang sbyor tsa na/ /gser lo thang dkar dgung dang yal/ /des kyang ma'i dpe cig mtshon/ / de yang mi rtag tshul du gda'/ / don de la soms la lha chos mdzod/ / g.yu lo me tog sad kyis 'khyer/ / des kyang sgyu ma'i dpe cig mtshon/ /de yang mi rtag tshul du gda'/ /don de la soms la lha chos mdzod/ /phu yi she'u chung mda' yis bsad/ /des kyang sgyu ma'i dpe cig mtshon/ / de yang mi rtag tshul du gda'/ / don de la soms la lha chos mdzod/ / mda' yi 'bras drug zor bas brngas/ / des kyang sgyu ma'i dpe cig mtshon/ / de yang mi rtag tshul du gda'/ / don de la soms la lha chos mdzod/ / za 'og khrigs se gzong gis dras/ / des kyang sgyu ma'i dpe cig mtshon/ / de yang mi rtag tshul du gda'/ / don de la soms la lha chos

bod kyigana'arabasartsomarig 7 tremadzod/ / nor bu rin chen rnyed nas stor/ / des kyang sgyu ma'i dpe cig marton/ / spya yang mi rtag tshul du gda'/ / do/ de la somaX la ṭwāṃ rdzus ༵༵// // rdo kā kā sbyi /ga batshu kā radu na/da /sa/ //do/sa dikya ༵ ṭwāṃ masdu bye/ /sdu mdzod/ / mi bu rin chen skyes nas shi/ / des kyang sgyu ma'i dpe cig sdu/// / de yang mi rtag tshul du gda'/ / don de la soms la lha chos dro/sdo ṭwāṃ // ni/ mi/ la ras pas dad ldan gyi bu slob rnams la 'di snang thams cad sgyu ma yin la/ dus skad cig tsam la'ang mi rtag pas/ don de la soms la khyed cag bu slob rnams kyis kyang lha chos gyis shig ces bskul ba'i mi rtag dpe brgyad kyi mgur zhig go / 'di'i nang du gser lo 'bar ba'i thang dkar dang / g.yu lo rgyas pa'i me tog de'i gseb na gnas pa'i she'u/ so nam zhing gi 'bras drug gos ri mo can gyi za 'og dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i nor bu/ tshes gsum nam mkha'i zla ba/ dal 'byor thob pa'i mi lus bcas dpe brgyad drangs te/ de rnams ni mig la mdzes shing / yid du 'ong ba/ bde bde skyid skyid ltar mthong na yang / don la snying bo cung zad tsam yang med de/ thang dkar dgung la yal ba dang / me tog sad kyis bcom pa/she'u chung mda' yis bkum pa/ 'bras drug zor bas brngas pa/ nor bu gzhan gyis brkus pa/ nya zla gang nas bri ba/ mi rnams skyes nas 'chi ba hā/sdu // ngan glo bur ba 'byung rgyu yod pa bstan nas/ chos la rnam par gnyis/ rtog pa 'char yan ring lugs kyi rnam pa dang zab mo chos kyi lta ba gnyis zung du sprel ba/ dper na/

76 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyusarig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/yang dpyid gsum sos ku'i zla ba la/ /bod mi res zhing re rmo tsa na/ /rnal 'byor nga yang zhing cig rmo/ /gzhi nyon mongs tha ba'i zhing sa la/ /sngon 'gro dad pa'i lud cig bkrams/ / bdud rtsi lnga yi brlan gyis sbangs/ /blo dang ldan pa'i zhing mkhan gyis/ / 'khrul rtog med pa'i sa bon btab/ /gnyis med glang bo dor sdebs nas/ / shes rab ldan pa'i thong gshol btags/ / dam tshig ldan pas sna khrid de/ / yengs pa med pa'i thong btsugs nas/ / brtson 'grus myur po'i lcags bcug pas/ / tha ba sra yang phen de mchi/ / byang chub myu gu thon te mchi/ / 'bras bu dus su smin te mchi/ /khyod 'jig rten 'di yi so nam mkhan/ / nga skye ba gtan gyi so nam /trī// /ston thog su mang blta yang blta/ / nam phugs su skyid 'gran yang zhes pa lta bu ste/ 'di ni rtog pa 'char yan ring lugs kyi rnam pa dang zab mo chos kyi lta ba gnyis zung du 'brel ba'i rtsom nyams shig yin la/ 'tsho ba'i rmang gzhi ldan la snyan ngag gi ro phun sum tshogs pa zhig 'dzoms par ma zad/ dpe rnams don dang mthun la/ don rnams dpe las go ba'i rtsom nyams khyad par can zhig kyang red/ mgur glu de dag las/ mi la ras pa ni sdu/ gyu phroṃ sdo // /na zlo/ ma darnyiwa/ nasnyan ngag mkhan phul du byung ba zhig kyang mi la'i rgyal srid 'di ltar yin/ /dad pa 'khor lo rin po che/ /nyin mtshan dge ba'i las la sbyor/ /ye shes nor bu rin po che/ /rang gzhan kun gyi re ba skong / /tshul khrims btsun mo rin po che/ / rab tu mdzes pa'i rgyan gyis spras/ /bsam gtan blon po rin po che/ / bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis bsags/ / khrel yod glang bo rin po che/ / sangs rgyas bstan pa'i khur chen khyer/ / brtson 'grub rta mchog rin po che/ / nyon rmongs bdag

bod kyi gna' rabasartsom rig 77med yul du skyel/ /thos bsam dmag dpon rin po che/ /log rtog dgra yi dmag dpung 'dzoms/tshi /khyed /la srid 'di dang ldan gyur na/ / rgyal po'i /sna sna rsha dā //sdu ༵ du/kho/da// rna mthun phyogs las rnam par rgyal/ / chab ces rgyal srid sna bdun la sbyar ba'i mgur 'di la ni snyan ngag gi rgyan phun sum tshogs pas mdzes par byas/ rgyal srid sna bdun la sbyar ba'i mgur 'di dang / dus phyis kyi snyan ngag mkhan po gung thang bstan pa'i sgron mes mdzad pa'i rje dkon mchog 'jigs med dbang bo'i rnam bar gyi mjug tu/gtam 'di srid pa'i tsha gdungs sel ba'i gdugs/ smra mkhas yongs kyi mgrin par chos kyi dung / / skal bzang yid la dge mtshan dpal be'u'i/ / bkra shis ri mo'i rnam par gnas gyur cig / mdzad pa'i chu mtsho mdzesakhyed pad ma dkar/ / gsang gsum gting mthar rol pa'i gser gyi nya/ /dge legs bdud rtsi'i bgo skal nod pa yi/ /rin chen bum bzang du yang 'gyur bar smon/ / dad brtson blo gros lte ba las thon pa'i/ / legs bshad rtsibs stong rdzogs pa'i 'khor lo 'dis/ /lung rtogs yon tan yangs pa'i sa chen la/ /dbang ra chos kyi rgyal srid thob par shog /tho cisabakrazhi shipa rtagapa brgyad la sbyar ba'i snyan ngag gnyis kyi sgru rtsal gyi ma da// sna ma/ nga 073 /ṭā/ bye /sdu //sa/ rnam par bkod pa/mi'i ras pa'i mgur glu'i nang du/ rang byung khams kyi yul ljongs la bstod pa'i mgur sku'ang mi nyung ba zhig mchis pa dang / mgur glu de dag gis pha yul gyi yul ljongs mdzes shing lta na sdug pa dang / mtshar sdug yid dbang 'phrog pa'i dpe ris shig bris yod par ma zad/ mi la ras pa khong pha yul la dga' zhen che ba'i 'dun ma'ang mngon par mtshon yod/ dper na/

bod kyi gna' rabasartsom rig 77med yul du skyel/ /thos bsam dmag dpon rin po che/ /log rtog dgra yi dmag dpung 'dzoms/tshi /khyed /la srid 'di dang ldan gyur na/ / rgyal po'i /sna sna rsha dā //sdu ༵ du/kho/da// rna mthun phyogs las rnam par rgyal/ / chab ces rgyal srid sna bdun la sbyar ba'i mgur 'di la ni snyan ngag gi rgyan phun sum tshogs pas mdzes par byas/ rgyal srid sna bdun la sbyar ba'i mgur 'di dang / dus phyis kyi snyan ngag mkhan po gung thang bstan pa'i sgron mes mdzad pa'i rje dkon mchog 'jigs med dbang bo'i rnam bar gyi mjug tu/gtam 'di srid pa'i tsha gdungs sel ba'i gdugs/ smra mkhas yongs kyi mgrin par chos kyi dung / / skal bzang yid la dge mtshan dpal be'u'i/ / bkra shis ri mo'i rnam par gnas gyur cig / mdzad pa'i chu mtsho mdzesakhyed pad ma dkar/ / gsang gsum gting mthar rol pa'i gser gyi nya/ /dge legs bdud rtsi'i bgo skal nod pa yi/ /rin chen bum bzang du yang 'gyur bar smon/ / dad brtson blo gros lte ba las thon pa'i/ / legs bshad rtsibs stong rdzogs pa'i 'khor lo 'dis/ /lung rtogs yon tan yangs pa'i sa chen la/ /dbang ra chos kyi rgyal srid thob par shog /tho cisabakrazhi shipa rtagapa brgyad la sbyar ba'i snyan ngag gnyis kyi sgru rtsal gyi ma da// sna ma/ nga 073 /ṭā/ bye /sdu //sa/ rnam par bkod pa/mi'i ras pa'i mgur glu'i nang du/ rang byung khams kyi yul ljongs la bstod pa'i mgur sku'ang mi nyung ba zhig mchis pa dang / mgur glu de dag gis pha yul gyi yul ljongs mdzes shing lta na sdug pa dang / mtshar sdug yid dbang 'phrog pa'i dpe ris shig bris yod par ma zad/ mi la ras pa khong pha yul la dga' zhen che ba'i 'dun ma'ang mngon par mtshon yod/ dper na/

78 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyusarig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/dkar kāswās/ byadri /dro rdo ༵ / tā// // pa/ dā/nga // phu//spra rno sdo/ /rshapa yol bas bcad/ /mdun na dgos 'dod nags tshal srungs/ /spang gshong ne'u gsing che la yangs/ /dri ldan yid 'ong pad ma la/ /rkang drug ldan pa'i dar dir can/ /rdzing bu lteng ka chu ngogs la/ /chu bya mgrin pa kyog nas blta//ljon shing rgyas pa'i yal ga la/ /mdzes pa'i bya tshogs skad snyan sgyur/ /dri bzhin yor bus btab pa la/ / rkang 'thung yal gas gar stabs byed/ /mtho zhing bsil ba'i ljon shing rtser/ /spra spre'u yang rtsal sna tshogs byed/ / sngo 'jamanyangs pa'i gsing ma la/ / rkang bzhi dud 'gro zas la bkram/ / de dag skyong byed rdzi bo rnams/ / glu dang gling bus skad snyan sgyur/ /'jig rten sred pa/ /zlo trī /zlos/ /zang zing las byed sa gzhi khebs/ /mgur glu drodi lta bu ni mi la ras pa'i mgur 'bum gyi nying bcud lta bu yin la/ rtsom pa po rnams kyis slob sbyong byed dgos pa'i rtsom nyams shig red/galasrid khyed rang byang chub rdzong gi gnas la 'grul bskyon byed du 'gro myong mkhan zhig yin na/ khyed la'ang ngo mtshar gyi 'char snang de lta bu zhig skyes srid la/ 'gro ma myong ba zhig yin na yang mi la'i mgur 'di bklags tshe dben gnas de'i mdzes sdug gi yul ljongs dang / khyad 'phags kyi dge mtshan rnams ji ma ji bzhin du mthong thub/ dbyar zla drug pa'i nang du'ang ri rtse yi gangs dkar mi zhu bar dngul 'od lam lam du 'khyug pa dang / ri bo'i sked du sprug pa lang long du rgyu ba/ mdun phyogs su nags tshal tshang tshing rgyas pa/ yangs shing rgya che ba'i spang ljongs la me tog sna tshogs khra chil ler bzhan pa dang / de la bung ba gzhon nu 'khor zhing snyan pa'i glu dbyangs dar dir sgrog pa/ mtsho yi rdzing bu dang lteng ma'i ngogs su chu bya pho mo bag phebs su rgyu ba

bod kyi gna' rab rtsomarig 79dang / de rnams kyis sgeg nyams dang bcas te thag ring nas phebs pa'i mgron po la mgrin pa bteg ste blta ba/ ljon shing yal ga'i steng na spu mdog bkra ba'i bya dang byi'u rnams kyis skad snyan sgrog pa/ skabs rer bser ma rlung gi pho nya 'ongs te rkang 'thung gi yal ga rnams shig shig tu g.yo ba ni mdzes mas gar stabs byed pa dang 'dra ba/ der ma zad ljon shing mthon po'i rtse na rtsed 'jo la dga' ba'i spra dang spre'u rnams kyis rang snang gang mos kyis yang rtsal sna tshogs sbyong ba/ rtswa thang du rta nor lug gsum la sogs pa'i rkang bzhi dud 'gro rnams kyis khengs pa dang / phyugs rdzi rnams kyis kyang dga' ba'i nyams dang bcas te glu dang gling bu gtong ba/ de'i khor yug tu gnas pa'i mi rnams kyang khom long med par so so'i las la brel ba sogs ni pha yul la bstod pa'i glu dbyangs brjid nyams dang ldan pa zhig go /gzhan yang / mi la ras pa la phyi nang gsum gyi rdzong bco brgyad yod pa dang / de dag ni khong gi sgrub gnas yin pas sa de'i rang byung gi yul ljongs dang / dus bzhi'i gnam gshis kyi 'gyur ldog bcas la rgyus che ba dang / de la skyes pa'i nags/ bzhur ba'i chu/ 'phur ba'i bya sogs ni rnal 'byor ba khongagi skyo grogs yin stabs/ yul de ga'i ri chu bya bye'u rnams la brtse dung sdug sdi sbyad pa spyi smos ma dasdos/ dper na/ lha sman bkra shis tshe ring ma'i ri hwa la rshaXs pa zlodi ma // sduX/ shes ma shes/ / gangs 'di khyod kyis ma shes na/ /lha sman bkra shes tshe ring yin/ / sked pa yan chad rtse mo mtho/ / zur gsum dung gi bshos bzang 'dra/ / mgul chu dngul gyi dra ba la/ / nyi 'od 'char ba gzhan bas snga/ / cod phan shel gyi zur phud la/ / rgyun du sprin dkar lding ba yin/ /sked pa man chad rmang gzhi la/ /na bun skyi bun rgyun du 'thibs/ / char mi drag dal bu rtag tu 'bab/ / 'ja' 'od mchod sprin

80 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyusarig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/rtag tu 'char/ / de phyugs kyi rma g.yang 'dzoms pa'i rtags/ / ri dwags mang bo rgyun du 'khor/ /me tog spang rgyan sna tshogs bkra/ / sman nas pa can sbyirshakā spya / skye/ / de lha sman gangs kyi che brjod yin/ /mi nga yi sgrub gnas //dro snangabu / /rtsom/ pa po su zhig yin yang / rang byung khams kyi yul ljongs dpe ru drangs pa'am yang na yul ljongs kyi gnas tshul bkod pa rnams ni brjod :'ido/ngesacanazhigawadamigasdu pa yin sdusate/ mi ༵ ras pa'i mgur /la /kā ga /bye /snakā sprang kārsha paXdris ska lda rten sha tsha/ da/kā sdo/bang med sku mtshams dam du bcug / nga stag phrug gi rtsed 'phyo snying rje skye/ /des dbang med du byang sems bsgom du bcug / spre'u'i rtsi sgra zhe la gcugs/ /des dbang med du skyo shas skye ru bcug /spre phrug ku sgra dgod snying 'dod/ /des dbang med du sems bskyed bsgom du bcug /khu byug gi ngag skad yid rtsa skyo/ /des dbang med du mchi ma 'chor du bcug /co ga'i 'gyur skad rna bar snyan/ /des dbang med du rna ba snyan du bcug / bya rog gi skad sgra sna tshogs snas/ pa//pa ṭwāṃ/byor 'dug grogs sems la phan/ /bzhi/ 'jo ba mi yi phyi lus kyi rnam pa nye bar bkod pa/mi la ras pa'i mgur 'bum nang du/ mdzes shing lta na sdug pa'i rang byung khams kyi yul ljongs kyi skor mchis par ma zad/ mi'i cha lugs dang /gzugs byad sogs bkod pa'i mgur yang mchis shing / spyir btang du mgur de dag kyang gson nyams dang ldan pa zhig ste/ dper na/drang bor skyes pa'i lus po sgur/ / brtan por bzhag kyang gom pa

bod kyi gna' rabasartsom rig 81'khyor/ /nag por skyes pa'i skra lo dkar/ / dbang bo'i dngas ma mig kyang 'gribs/ / yan lag gtso bo mgo bo 'khor/ / sgra rnams nyan byed rna ba 'on/ / mkhur tshos khrag gi rgya mtsho skams/ / byad kyi rgyas shing sna yang zhom/ /rus pa'i dngas ma dung so bud/ / smra ba'i rgyal po lce yang ldib/ /shig sro'i bu lon bsad bzhin mang / / zas dang gnyen mdun bsdus kyang 'bros/ /sdug bsngal yi chad spangs shing 'khor/ /bden par smras kyang nyan mkhan med/ / gces par gsos pa'i bu tsha sdang / / bsags tshad byin la drin gzo med/ /shi 'phyis zer zhing dmod mi mang / /zhes pa lta bur mtshon na/ 'di ni lus kyi 'byung bzhi rgud pa'i rgan po zhig gi mi sdug pa'i nyams 'gyur bkod pa ste/ lang tsho yol ba'i rgan po de lo dang nam zla'i dbang gis drang mor skyes pa'i lus po thur du sgur ba dang /lam la 'gro ba'i tshe na gom pa brtan por spos kyang 'khyar 'khyor byed pa/mgo skyes skra yang kha dog nag po nas dkar bor gyur pa/ dbang bo rnams kyi dwangs ma dpral ba'i mig kyang khog la rdib pa/ yan lag rnams kyi gtso bo mgo bo yang yam yom du 'khor ba/ sgra rnams 'dzin par byed pa'i rna ba'ang 'on par gyur pa/ lang tsho rgyas pa'i dus kyi 'gram pa'i mkhur tshos dmar po de yang kha dog skya bor gyur pa/ sna ni gnyer ma bsdus te 'khums shing / kha yi dung so dkar bo rnams kyang lhung ba/ lce ldib cing smra brjod mi dag pa/ lus la shig dang sro ma yis khengs pa'i khyad chos rnams rang bzhin brjod pa'i tshul gyis bkod pa dang / drin chen la drin gzo mi byed pa'i gnyen nye du dang / tha na rang gi bu bu mo rnams kyis kyang kha ya mi byed par ma zad/ da dung rgas 'khogs 'di shi rgyu 'phyi drags song zer nas dmod pa 'bor ba'i tshul kyang bris 'dug 'di las rgan po sdug bsngal gyi nang du lhung ba rnams la gdung sems 'dzin pa dang / khrel gzhung med pa'i nye du bu tsha rnams la sdang sems

82 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyusarig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/bcangs yod pa'ang shes thub cing / klog mkhan rnams la dga' sdang gi dbye bye/ pa~X /sna ston pa 'di'ang mi la ras pa'i mgur gyi sgyu rtsal gyi shugs las lnga/ mi la ras pa'i mgur glu'i rjod byed kyi tshig rnams snyan zhing go bde ba dang / sdeb sbyor legs par ma zad/ yul skad dang grong tshig gis ma gos par sduX sdirsha // btang peba'i rmang gzhi'i thog tu sgyu rtsal gyi nyams 'gyur thon par cadro bye tshe — sdo /gro/ /spra nā/nga sgo bzhin/ / bdag kyang a de'i sgo drung slebs/ / gcan gzan khyi yi pho nya bkye/ / stobs med lus kyis gasdo/la ngo sprad/ / drag sngags tshig ngan dpon pa yis/ / blo mug khong gzer gting nas slong / /tshugs shing ber ma'i mtshon char gyis/ /bdag lus zug ju na tshas ba// da/nga/rinā tram̐ /srog dang do bral byung / /tshang mang ka bzhi gdung brgyad de/ / dus deng sang seng ge'i ya mgal 'dra/ / mkhar zur bzhi logs brgyad rtse dang dgu/ / dus deng sang bong buX rna ba 'dī/ / bsho/zhi~X 'oramagru/sum de/ / dusadershasang 'jag paX /byi/ ༵ dī nga/ sa//ga/mi/ ṭwāṃ zlong phami spu ṭwāṃ she bye zlomaṭwāṃ/ /// wadro shādri hā/ zlo/ ndhe trī snang med/ /a ma myang tsha dkar rgyan de/ /dus deng sang nus krang /lha/ / susbya/ la'i/ mgur gyi rjod byed tshig rnams gson nyams ldan la/py-i shāsbyi byin bu lha // sna'i khyad chos dang ldan pa zhig yin la/ sdeb sbyor tshig gi

bod kyi gna' rabs yorig 83don tshan dgu ba/ 'dzam gling ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung dang po/ 'dzamagling ge sar rgyalapo'i sgrung /byunga'aphelagyi lorgyus/de yang 'dzam gling ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung ni gna' snga mo nas bod rigs mi dmangs khrod dar zhing khyab pa'i bod rigs mi dmangs kyi dpa' bo'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i lo rgyus kyi snyan rtsom ches ring mo zhig dang ches khyad du 'phags pa zhig yin zhing / lo rgyus kyi snyan rtsom ring mo 'di ni/ bod btsan po'i rgyal khab sil bar thor rjes kyi dus rabs dgu ba'i smad dang dus rabs bcu gcig pa'i stod la mdo dbus khams gsum las khams kyi stod phyogs su 'khrungs pa'i gling ge sar gyi rmad du byung ba'i mdzad 'phrin dang / rgyal gces kyi dgongs pa/ 'thab 'dzing gi snying stobs/ khyad 'phags kyi blo gros bcas lo rgyus kyi don dngos gzhir bzung zhing / gnas skabs de'i rgya che ba'i bod rigs mi dmangs kyi thun mong gi shes rig dang / thun mong gi blo gros/ thun mong gi 'dod mos la rnam par brten nas byung ba zhig yin pas/ gangs can bod kyi 'das zin pa'i spyi tshogs kyi chab srid dang / dpal 'byor/ dmag don/ rig gnas sogs la rgyus lon dang zhib dpyod mdzad par rab tu mkho ba'i yig cha rin thang gzhal du bral ba zhig yin la/ dus skabs de'i bod rigs mi dmangs kyi yul srol goms 'dris/ 'tsho ba'i spyod stangs/ chos

phri bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/lugs dad pos/ bsam blo'i shes rtogs/ skad cha'i sgyu rtsal/ mdzes dpyod rig pa/ rin thang lta tshul/ phugs bsam re 'dun/ dga' sdang chags zhin la sogs kun nas mtshon pa'i rin chen me long lta bu zhig kyang yin no/ /lo rgyus kyi byung ba brjod pa'i snyan rtsom ring mo 'di nyid thog mar lha gling gab tse dgu skor dang 'khrungs skor rta rgyugs rgyal 'jog bdud 'dul/hor gling g.yul 'gyed sogs byung ba dang / phyis kyi dus yun ring bo'i lo rgyus 'phel rim khrod/ rgya che ba'i bod rigs mi dmangs kyi mos 'dun mchog dang blo gros rtsal las phyogs bzhi'i dgra bzhi btul tshul dang rdzong chen bco brgyad phab tshul sogs brjod don rgya che zhing rmad du byung ba dang / rjod byed ༵༵༵ shārgyu /na zhi spyangargya padapa kto dīrji kās re pa'i sgrung dpe gang mang zhig byung zhing da lta phyogs bsgrigs dang par bskrun byas pa ltar na/ sgrung dpe khag brgya dang nyi shu lhag mchis pas/ rgya gar gna' rabs kyi ma hā bha ra ta dang rgyal po rā ma ṇa'i rtogs brjod/ gna' rabs ke ri si rgyal khab kyi ho mā'i lo rgyus snyan rtsom ring mo yī le ya ji dang āo ti se dag las ring du brgal bas/ de la bod kyi rtsom pa po dang gling sgrung zhib 'jug pa 'jam dpal rgya mtsho mchog gis/ ring tshad kho na'i steng nas bltas na'ang / 'dzam gling ge sar rgyal po'i nga ni 'dzam gling steng na snyan grags che ba'i dpa' bo'i byung ba brjod ༵ sdi /na rdoswā /rdo sbya ṭwāṃ /sna // bsdoms las kyang ring nas ring du brgal lo rgyus gyi byung ba brjod pa'i snyan rtsom ring mo 'di rgyal khab nang rol gyi sog rigs dang hor rigs/ 'jang rigs sogs mi rigs khrod du dar zhing khyab par ma zad/ bal bo dang / phyi sog 'brug yul/ 'bras ljongs sogs phyi'i rgyal khab mi nyung ba zhig tu'ang gna' snga mo nas dar khyab tu song

phri bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/lugs dad pos/ bsam blo'i shes rtogs/ skad cha'i sgyu rtsal/ mdzes dpyod rig pa/ rin thang lta tshul/ phugs bsam re 'dun/ dga' sdang chags zhin la sogs kun nas mtshon pa'i rin chen me long lta bu zhig kyang yin no/ /lo rgyus kyi byung ba brjod pa'i snyan rtsom ring mo 'di nyid thog mar lha gling gab tse dgu skor dang 'khrungs skor rta rgyugs rgyal 'jog bdud 'dul/hor gling g.yul 'gyed sogs byung ba dang / phyis kyi dus yun ring bo'i lo rgyus 'phel rim khrod/ rgya che ba'i bod rigs mi dmangs kyi mos 'dun mchog dang blo gros rtsal las phyogs bzhi'i dgra bzhi btul tshul dang rdzong chen bco brgyad phab tshul sogs brjod don rgya che zhing rmad du byung ba dang / rjod byed ༵༵༵ shārgyu /na zhi spyangargya padapa kto dīrji kās re pa'i sgrung dpe gang mang zhig byung zhing da lta phyogs bsgrigs dang par bskrun byas pa ltar na/ sgrung dpe khag brgya dang nyi shu lhag mchis pas/ rgya gar gna' rabs kyi ma hā bha ra ta dang rgyal po rā ma ṇa'i rtogs brjod/ gna' rabs ke ri si rgyal khab kyi ho mā'i lo rgyus snyan rtsom ring mo yī le ya ji dang āo ti se dag las ring du brgal bas/ de la bod kyi rtsom pa po dang gling sgrung zhib 'jug pa 'jam dpal rgya mtsho mchog gis/ ring tshad kho na'i steng nas bltas na'ang / 'dzam gling ge sar rgyal po'i nga ni 'dzam gling steng na snyan grags che ba'i dpa' bo'i byung ba brjod ༵ sdi /na rdoswā /rdo sbya ṭwāṃ /sna // bsdoms las kyang ring nas ring du brgal lo rgyus gyi byung ba brjod pa'i snyan rtsom ring mo 'di rgyal khab nang rol gyi sog rigs dang hor rigs/ 'jang rigs sogs mi rigs khrod du dar zhing khyab par ma zad/ bal bo dang / phyi sog 'brug yul/ 'bras ljongs sogs phyi'i rgyal khab mi nyung ba zhig tu'ang gna' snga mo nas dar khyab tu song

bod kyi gna' rabagatsom rig 85yod/ der brten/ tang gi skabs bcu gsum pa'i tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs 'tshogs pa nas bzung mi rigs srid jus dngos 'bab lag bstar mdzad pa dang / de dang mtshungs su rgyal khab phyi nang gi 'brel yod las khungs kyis 'dzam gling ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung 'tshol sdud dang / legs bsgrigs/ dpe bsgrun bcas gang legs mdzad la/ de la slob sbyong dang zhib 'jug mdzad pa'i mtho rlabs kyang rab dang rim par 'phyur bzhin yod/da lta 'dzam gling ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung dbyin ji'i yi ge dang / hpha ran se'i ye ge su ru su'i ye gi rgya gar gyi yi ge sog po'i yi ge 'jar man gyiyi ge se phan yi ge lu tin yi ge rgya'i yi ge sogs rgyal khab dang mi rigasakhag gi yig rigs gang mang zhig la bsgyur nas rgyal khab so so'i rtsom rig gi bang mdzod khrod na lham mer snang zhing / 'dzam gling mi rigs so so'i 'dren byed kyi dpal du lhan nir ba da cing mchis so/ /gnyisapa/ gling ge sar dang 'dzamagling ge sar rgyalapo'i sgrung /mi gying ṭwāṃ sar rgyasdu shā ni sdud kyi tram̐ /sa steng dngos su byung ba'i bod rigs — dam/pa rte spya/ dī bye kārsha gā kā' ba dri kā/sa kyi rgyal mtshan gyi yongs 'dzin rinapo che blo bzang tshul khrims mchog gis/ gling ge sar rgyal po ni rgyal po dar ma 'u dum btsan gyi gzhug dang rjo bo a ti sha'i sngon du byung ba'i mi zhig yin zhes gsungs/ de ltar yin na/ rgyal po dar ma 'u dum btsan ni spyi lo 842la 'das par bshad cing / jo bo a ti sha ni spyi lo 1042la bod du phebs pa dang sbyi lo 1054la 'das pas/ gling ge sar rgyal po ni dus rabs dgu

86 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mcho/ba'i smad dang dus rabs bcu gcig pa'i stod la byung ba zhig yin dgos/2 brag dgon pa zhabs drung dkon mchog bstan pa rab rgyas kyis mdzad pa'i mdo smad chos 'byung las/ rma chu'i stod rgyud ni gling ge sar rgyal pos dbang bsgyur ba'i sa cha yin zhing / gling ge sar rgyal po ni lcags pho byi ba'i lo'am chu mo sprul gyi lo la 'khrungs zhes 'khrungs lo mi 'dra ba gnyis gsungs yod/ de ltar yin na/ lcags pho byi ba'i lo ni spyi lo 1060la babs pa dang / chu mo sbrul gyi lo ni sbyi lo 1053la babs 'dug go /3 mkhas pa sum pa ye shes dpal 'byor gyis gling ge sar rgyal po ni rma chu dang 'bru chu/ rdza chu gsum mtha' bskor nas 'bab pa'i gnas/ sde dge sa 'i g.yas phyogs kyi 'brog sde ru rus rgyud sdong gling gnyis las gling tshang /sasku'akhrungasashing / zlokhyazlos nas yun ring ma 'gor bar a khu khro thung rgyas rma 〈sman nā sna'i dī rten rtes /spya snar/ bu mchog gis/ gling ge sar du grags pa yang gnam lde 'od srung nas 'di yab sras kyi ring la byung bar mngon/rlangs kyi a mes byang chub 'dre bkol gyi sbyin bdag ge sar gyis byas shing /byang chub 'dre bkol rang nyid gu ru padma'i sprul ba dang / ge sar khri srong lde btsan gyi sprul bar khas blangs shing / ge sar lo gya brgyad thub pa'i lung bstan mdzad tshul rlangs kyi po ti bse nur yod pas ge sar nam byung gi dus des shes pas de las dus snga ba dang 'phyi bar ma sems shig ces gsungs/5 rgyal dbang lnga ba blo bzang rgya mtsho mchog gis/ mtsho bzang lha gzigs kyi sras a mi byang chub 'dre 'khol te/ dgung lo brgyad la o rgyan du byon pa dang / srin po btul nas phyir byon pa'i tshe yi dam gyi lha zhal gzigs pa dang / ge sar gyis gling yul du lan gnyis gdan drangs pa'i phyi ma'i tshe/pha bong gra ba rta 'dra ba la chibs nas phyogs bzhir gdon chen po bzhi btul

bod kyi gna' rabasartsom rig 87ba sog/ trī rshahā sna// ṭwāṃ rnyisna snas/ /sna tāswā/ga gis/ rgya gar gyi paṇḍi ta nor bzang grags pas tsānd+ra byā ka ra ṇa'i yan lag rab tu byed pa smra ba'i sgo zhes bya ba zhig brtsams pa las/ 'di dang dpal ldan nā ro pa gnyis kyi slob ma paṇḍi ta smṛ ti sto na gī rti/dran pa ye shes grags pa)bod du phebs nas 'brom ston pa dang / gling ge sar rgyal po'i slob dpon mdzad/ mthar khams kyi klong thang duyun ring bzhugs shing / bod kyi skad yig la byang bar lobs pa na/ rgya gzhung du ma rang 'gyur du mdzad skabs sgra dang sum rtags gang la'ang mkho che ba'i dag yig smra sgo mtshon cha zhes bya ba brtsams nas bod skad ltar rang 'gyur tna /rsharshang/ saces pa ni mkhas pa rnams la yongs su grags pa'i gtam mo/ /7 mi pham 'jam dpal rgyas pa'i rdo rje sogs mkhas dbang du mas /da spya spra/ stal po ra gi/ dad ngapo/zhe trī /ga spyi lo 1038la sku 'khrungs shing /ma'i byis 0de ༷ 1/hārngo ṭwāṃ waX patreju rsha 0/ bye/'i /'dod tshul ni/ gong gsal mkhas pa rnams kyis gsungs pa'i rab byung dang po'i lcags byi(spyi lo1060)dang / rab byung dang po'i sa pho stag(spyi lo1038)gi lo la sku 'khrungs pa gtsor 'dzin pa yin yang / grub thob pa byang chub 'dre bkol ni spyi lo 968lor sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo brgya dang brgyad bzhugs nas spyi lo 1076lor sku gshegs pa dang / 'khrungs gling me tog ra ba las gling ge sar rgyal po sa stag la 'khrungs zhes byung zhing / sa stag ni spyi lo 97zhal babs 'dug pas/ gling ge sar dgung lo gya brgyad bzhugs pa ltar brtsis na spyi lo 1076lor sku gshegs pa yin nam snyam/des na/ gling ge sar rgyal po ni bod kyi lo rgyus steng dngos su sku

ཿ bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/'khrungs pa'i skyes bu dam pa zhig yin zhing khong 'tsho zhing bzhes pa'i dus skabs de'i bod sbyi tshogs kyi gnas tshul ni/ rgyal po dar ma 'u dum btsan 'das rjes/ sras 'od srung dang yum brtan gnyis nang ma 'chams par sa gnas bcad bzung bgyis pas rgyal khab sil bur 'thor ba dang / rjes su sa gnas bcad bzung byed pa'i grub mtha'i phyogs khag mang bos phan tshun nang 'khrug dang nang dme bgyid pa'i 'thor rlung rgyun ma chad par bslangs pa'i thog la/ mtha' bzhi'i rgyal khab dag gis glags dang bstun nas mtho 'tshams pa dang zil shugs la brten nas btsan 'dzul byas/ de'i stabs kyis rgya che ba'i bod rigs mi dmangs ni gnya' gnon dang bshu gzhog myong ba'i gzhi mar gyur la/ btsan 'dzul dang khral dgus mnar ba'i phongs por gyur/ rang dbang dang bde skyid bral ba'i khol bor gyur zhing / srog dbang dang go cha shor ba'i bzung dmag lta bur gyur pa red/ yin na'ang shes rab che la blo gros ldan pa'i bod rigs mi dmangs kyis thog mtha' bar gsum du nang 'khrug dang gnya' gnon la gyen rgol byas nas/ mthun sgril dang gcig gyur la re mos mdzad/ kha bral dang dbang rtsod la ngo rgol byas nas/ spyi mthun dang zhi bde la yid smon mdzad/ btsan 'dzul dang dbang bsgyur la phyir rgol byas nas/ pha yul mtho sgang dang kha ba ri ba srung skyob mdzad/ de ltar 'thab rtsod byed pa'i go rim khrod du/ phyogs bzhi'i dgra bzhi 'dul ba'i rdo rje lha dmag gam btsan po'i mgo bo 'gems pa'i gnam lcags thog mda'/nyag thag bde la 'god pa'i gnyen po'am gnyom chung byams par skyong ba'i pha ma lta bu'i bod mi rigs kyi dpa' bo sngar byung ma myong ba zhig 'byon par re smon tshad med bgyid pa de ni dus skabs de'i bod rig spyi tshogs kyi bsam blo'i rlabs rgyun du grub pa red/ de lta bu'i bsam blo'i rlabs rgyun gyi skul 'ded 'og nyam chung dbul phongs kyi khyim nas sku 'khrungs pa'i bod mi rigs kyi

bod kyi gna' rabasartsomarig 89dpa'abo gling ge sar rgyal po la ngang ngam shugs kyis dran gso dang bsngags brjodabyas pa yin la/ rim bzhin du mdo dbus khams gsum du rlung ltar grags pa'i dmangs khrod kyi gtam rgyud du gyur cing / rjes su dpa' bo'i lo rgyus brjod pa'i ngo mtshar gtam rgyud de dmangs khrod rtsom rig gi rtsom stangs // yi ger bkod nas 'dzam gling ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung du rnam par grub pa derabarten/ 'dzam gling ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung ni bod kyi lo rgyus steng dngos su byung ba'i gling ge sar rgyal po'i gtam rgyud kyi rmang gzhi'i steng myu gu 'bus shing lo 'dab rgyas la me tog bzhan cing 'bras bu smin pa dang / rim gyis sa steng na snyan pa'i rdza rnga ldir ba'i 'dzam gling ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung zhes pa'i rmad byung dpag bsam gyi ljon shing lta bu 'di byung ba yin pa rtogs thub bo/ / de la mkhas pa sum pa ye shes dpal 'byor gyis/ gling ge sar ni lo rgyus steng byung ba'i mi sna zhig yin yang / 'dzam gling ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung gi nang gi ge sar rgyal po ni/ lo rgyus steng byung ba'i gling ge sar rgyal po rmang gzhi byas thog sgo btags dang 'ud brjod byas nas rgya cher spel ba zhig yin stabs/ lo rgyus steng byung ba'i gling ge sar rgyal po dngos ma las 'das pa'o /lta ṭā sbya dīkā ༵ bye so rtsom rig la blo gros kyi 'jug pa yangs pa'i mkhas pa'i

la bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/gsumapa/gi~X/ḍā sdi swā rsha snalas sgrung lo rgyus kyi byung ba brjod pa'i snyan rtsom ring mo 'di'i nang du btsan po'i mgo bo 'gems pa'i gnam lcags thog mda'/ gnyom chung legs par skyong ba'i drin can pha ma/ mes rgyal srung skyob mdzad pa'i rdo rje'i lha dmag ste/gling ge sar nor bu dgra 'dul gyis phyogs bzhi'i dgra bzhi btul nas bod 'bangs bde la bkod cing / rdzong chen bco brgyad phab nas pha gling yul srung skyob mdzad pa dang / rin chen gter dgu bton nas 'byor ba gong du spel zhing rgyal khab phan bde'i dpal gyis rnam par bskyangs pa'i dpa' nyams ring lugs dang rgyal gces ring lugs kyi rmad byung snying stobs la tshad mthon po'i sgo nas bsngags brjod kyi me tog rgya cher gtor yod pas/ de ni snyan rtsom 'di'i rlabs che ba'i bsam blo'i rang bzhin du mdzes par grub pa red/phyogs bzhi'i dgra bzhi btul ba dang rdzong chen bco brgyad phab pa gang yin yang de dag gi bsam blo'i nang don ni/ phyi'i btsan 'dzul pa rnams tshar du bcad nas bod 'bangs thams cad bde la bkod pa dang / mes rgyal gyi mthosgang srung skyob mdzad pa de yin pas/ 'dir dpe mtshon tsam bkod na/hor gling g.yul 'gyed las/ hor gur dkar rgyal pos/seng g.yu ral ngom pa'i spyan zur na/ /gcan wa mo bros kyang la thang med/ /stag dmar yag 'dzum pa'i tshang sgo nas/ /rta tho ru 'drogs rgyug la thang med/ /thig le gzig gi ngar lam na/ /khyi nag snar skad la thang med/ /a thong spyang gi 'dur lam nas/ /g.yang dkar 'thor yang la thang
