bon kyi gna' rabasartsom rig 91med/ / 'bum dmag dpung ba'i gzhi brling la/ / tsho chung khyim 'dzul la thang med/ / 'di 'dra gnam lha'i sku bsod yin/ / de tsho hor ser rting ma yin/ / de nas 'bum dmag khra bo 'di/ / sang nyin rma chu phar 'bud byed/ / rdzong chen thams cad smyogs rdos snyel/ / mi rgod thams cad khyu gsod byed/ /gling dkar mthong smon ra ba 'di/ /dmar bo me dang sngon mo chu/ / 'byung ba bzhi yi gsos la 'debs/ / skye tshad mi lus mgo ske 'phral/ / bsags tshad rgyu nor hor la len/ / thang stong skya mor ma btang na/ / hor rje sta1 zhu gur dasdur dā / / ral chen rgyal rgyud min pa'i rtags/zhes/rnyisdi mgu rten /// dro bye nā ༵ /spya gasnang/ lca/ma 'brug mo 'phrog par 'dod nas/ gdug rtsub dang gtum spyod ldan pa'i hor gyi 'bum chen dpung dmag gling dkar stod la dpung 'jug dang btsan 'dzul byed par drag tu bskul bas/ hor dmag gis gling gi mo ma drang thig gtsos bde srung mi bdun dang dpa' rgya tsha zhal dkar sogs bkrongs pa dang / gter zog nor bu 'dzad med pa rnams ham 'phrog dang seng lcam 'brug mo btsan 'phrog byas nas hor du khyer/ 'dzam gling ge sar rgyal po bdud nas phyir phebs skabs/gling la de lta bu'i chag sgo tshad med pa bzos pa gzigs nas/ gling gi dpa' rtul rnams la bka' bsgos mdzad de btsan 'dzul pa hor rnams tshar du bcad nas dbang du bsdus la/ seng chen nor bu dgra 'dul mchog gis gtumaspyod yongs su rdzogs pa'i hor gur dkar rgyal po la gser srab mgo bor bskon/ gser sga rgyab tu bstan/ zhabs g.yas pas gur dkar rgyal po 'og tu brdzis te/ glu khrom chen gong ba zil gnon gyi rta la drangs nas/pho nga dang nga ngo ma shes na/ /shar rma khams gling yul khra mo na/ /'brug lhang lhang nor bu'i gdan steng na/ / snyan lhang lhang khu byug grags

92 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyusarig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/na/ /dpal bde mchog nor bu'i pho brang gi/ /gling skyes bu seng chen rgyal po yin/ /hor ser rgyal po rang snang can/ / sngar gang byas las kyi 'bras bu de/ /da smin pa e shes gur dkar dpon/ / shar gling dkar ja mkhar ring mo der/ /mi su yin nang la 'gro ba dka'/ /khyod hor ser dmag gis thal phung bzos/ / nga'i gling sa mthong ba kun smon der/ / gling gces phrug me tog 'thu dbang med/ /khyod khyi ser hor gyis dmag sgar btab/ / lha ger 'tsho gling gi zo dor la/ / sde gling rus rdog pa bzhag le min/ /khyod hor ba ri rgyug thang rgyug byas/ / rma del yag stag thang khra mo der/ / gling phu nus mda' rtse chog le min/ / khyod hor ser sdug gis rkang bro 'khrab/ / dpon 'bum pa'i zhal gyi dung zla la/ /mi su yin mig zur blta ni med/ /dgra hor bas dung zla sgrub par byas/ /nga'i dpa' rtul phu nu sum cu la/ /byang phu nus tshigazur shor sa med/ / khyod hor bas dpung 'gran dgra ru bzung / / da 'gyod par e 'dug gur dkar dpon/ / shar gling mthong ba kun smon de/ / gong ma lha yi dkyil 'khor yin/ / chos dung dkar mo rgyang grags gtsos/ / gter zog nor bu cha brgyad dang / / stag sgam rnam sras bang mdzod gtsos/ /yang zog nor bu cha dgu de/ /hor ser dmag gis phrogs nas song / / gnyan chen sku lha ger 'tsho gcig / rma sbom ra zhal dkar mthon po gnyis/ / rma stod rtse lha bcu gsum gsum/ / stong bzang 'od kyi rgyal mo bzhi/ /rma lcam khra rdzong phyag mo lnga/ /gling yul zo dor spun lnga la/ /hor ser dmag gis mnol bar byas/ / de nas bdud rgan gur dkar bu/ /mo ma drang thig gtso byas pa'i/ /bde srung mi bdun sha lan dgos/ /nga gling gi lha chos gtor dang gcig / pho nga la 'gran ya bzung dang gnyis/ /dpa' rgya tsha bkrongs kyi sha lan gsum/ /gling dpa' rtul bkrongs kyi snying nad bzhi/ /gling mi mang sdug la sbyar dang lnga/ / de lnga byas pa'i rnam

bod kyi gna' rabagartsom rig 93smin la/ /mi ma shi gson snying khog nas len/ / sha kham gang skya khra'i kha zas spyanas/ le/ sprikā /phor gang skya khra'i btung ba byed/ / dpa' rgya tsha'i dgongs pa zhes tor gur dkar rgyal po lnga ba'i lam du brdzangs pa'i glu tshig 'di las/ gling dkar stod la 'phrog bcom gsod gsum byas pa'i btsan 'dzul pa ser po hor rnams gling ge sar rgyal po gtsos gling dmag gis rtsa med theg shātā sdo zlo/shā // /zlo nadakar stod kyi yul gru dang mnga' 'bangs srung skyob de dang mtshungs par bdud 'dul ni byang klu btsan rgyal pos gling ge sar rgyal po'i btsun mo me bza' 'bum skyid 'phrog rjes/ gling ge sar rgyal posade phyir len ched yar khams byang ma'i ri rgyud du phebs pa las byung ba dang / 'jang gling g.yul 'gyed ni da lta'i yun nan zhing chen gyi byang rgyud bde chen rdzong dang pod ljongs kyi smar khams rdzong gnyis 'dres mtshams su yod pa'i tshwa kha zhes pa phyir len ched byung ba dang / mon gling g.yul 'gyed ni gling ge sar rgyal po ma 'khrungs ba'i sngon la a khu khro thung gis gling gi dpon po byedaskabs/ lho phyogs mon gyi a chung ge ru dang / sprug chung sgur ru gnyis kyis dmag khri tsho bco lnga gling la drangs nas/ gling gi stag rong khro tsha rngam g.yagadang mi chen rgyal ba'i lha 'bum sogs bsad cing rmas shing / gter zogatam 'phrog byas pa'i 'khon lan ldog pa'i chen byung ba sha stag yin pas/'dzam gling ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung gi bsam blo'i rang bzhin ni dpa' nyams sdong lugs dang rgyal gces ring lugs la bstod bsngags mdzad pa de yin

94 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/bzhi ba/ 'asgozlosnroshā mi bye /las sgrung gcig brjod don rlabs che zhing sgrig gzhi che ba/'dzam gling ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung ni bod kyi btsan po'i rgyal khab sil bar bor rjes kyi dus rabs dgu ba nas bcu gcig pa'i bar mdo dbus khams gsum gyi bod rigs mi dmangs kyis phyogs bzhi'i btsan 'dzul pa rnams la dpa' ngar zhum med kyi ngang nas 'thab 'dzing byas te pha yul gyi mnga' khongs srung skyob mdzad pa dang / dus skabs de'i kha thor dang 'khrug rtsod kyi 'thor rlung drag po'i khrod du zhi bde dang spyi mthun la re snyeg bgyis te dpa' nyams ring lugs dang rgyal gces ring lugs la skad gseng mthon pos bstod glu blangs pa'i lo rgyus dngos dang / de lta bu'i lo rgyus kyi brgyud rim khrod du rgya che ba'i bod rigs mi dmangs kyis nyams su myangs pa'i dga' sdug skyo gdung gi 'tsho ba gzhir bzung nas legs par brtsams pa zhig yin phyir/ lo rgyus kyi byung ba brjod pa'i snyan rtsom ring mo 'di'i brjod bya phun sum tshogs shing brjod don ha cang rlabs che bar snang ngo / /de ltar rlabs che zhing phun sum tshogs pa'i brjod bya'i don ni 'go nas mjug bar bcad lhug spel ma'am 'chad gyer zung sprel du go rim ma 'chol la bskyar zlos ma mdzad par ring nas ring du brtsams pas/ snyan rtsom 'di nyid kyi sgrig gzhi'ang 'dzam gling steng na grags pa'i snyan pa 'phur ba'i lo rgyus kyi byung ba brjod pa'i snyan rtsom kun las khyad du mtshar zhing rgya che ba dang / sgrig rim gra dag cing spus legs la/ tshan rig dang ldan pa zhig go /

bod kyi gna' rabs rtsom rig 95zang dushā dzi ba// dngosacad 'cho ba dang rtog pa 'char yan ring lugs gnyis ga 'dzam gling ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung ni gangs can bod kyi lo rgyus gnas tshul gzhir bzung nas brtsams pa'i snyan rtsom ring mo zhig yin pas/ skabs der 'tsho zhing bzhes pa'i bod rigs mi dmangs kyi 'tsho ba'i spyod stangs/yul srol goms 'dris/ bsam blo 'du shes/ chos lugs dad mos/ dpal 'byor mnga' thang sogs dngos yod kyi 'tsho ba'i rnam pa de me long la gzugs brnyan 'char ba ji bzhin mngon par mtshon yod la/ 'thab 'dzing gi snying stobasadang rgyal gces kyi bsam pa/ rmad byung blo gros dang rnam dkar lhag bsam ldan pa'i bod rigs mi dmangs kyi rmad byung gzugs brnyan ni gson nyamasaldan la 'greng tshugs yod pa'i sgo nas zhib 'bri mdzad yod/ de ltar zhib 'bri mdzad pa'i rnam pa de ni kha ba ri ba'i dngos yod kyi 'tsho ba dang 'thab rtson kyi brgyud rim zhig yin la/ bod mi rigs kyi dngos yod kyi 'tsho ba'i brgyud rim de rtsom rig sgyu rtsal gyi lam nas legs par mtshon slad/dngos yod kyi 'tsho ba dang de dngos yod 'tsho ba las 'das pa'i rtog pa 'char yan ring lugs kyi sgyu rtsal dang zung du sprel nas brtsams pas na/ lo rgyus kyi byung ba brjod pa'i snyan rtsom ring mo 'di la dngos yod ring lugs kyi 'tsho ba'i ro snum la rtog pa 'char yan ring lugs kyi sgyu rtsal khyad chos kyis kun nas phyugago / 'o na snyan rtsom 'dir ldan pa'i rtog pa 'char yan ring lugs kyi sgyu rtsal khyad chos 'di'i 'byung gzhi gang yin nam zhe na/ de ni blo sems dkar zhing dpa' ngar ldan pa'i bod rigs mi dmangs thun mong gi khyad du 'phags pa'i blo gros dang / rmad du byung ba'i shes rig phun sum tshogs pa'i 'char snang bcas la brten nas gsar rtsom mdzad pa zhig yin la/ kho tshos nyams su sbyangs pa'i dga' sdug skyo gdung gi 'tsho ba'i brgyud rim khrod du

96 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/yid la rnam par bcangs pa'i bla na mtho zhing 'od stong 'bar ba'i phugs bsam la nye bar brten nas das mtshan ldan pa'i 'char yan gyi sgyu rtsal snang brnyan // kā rno snyam mas/ / /shām/ gling ge sar rgyal po'i mdzad spyod dang /gling dkar stod kyi bod 'bangs rnams kyi 'tsho ba'i spyod stangs/ gling gi dpa' rtul sum cu'i dpa' tshul dang gzugs brnyan/ de dang mtshungs su phas kyi rgol ba mtha' dag gi 'gro 'dug spyod gsum sogs la'ang mtha' gcig tu rtog pa 'char yan ring lugs kyi rab mdzes kha dog rnam par bkra ba ༵༵ pa /da/ rno/dir bsam gyis mi khyab la brjod kyi mi lang bas/ dper mtshon 'dzam gling ge sar rgyal po'i bcibs pa rta rkyang rgod ni/ phyi byol song rta mtshul du snang na'ang don dam par rta mgrin dmar bo'i sprul ba yin stabs/smra shes don go ba dang / blo gros dang ldan pa zhig yin pa dang / 'dzam gling ge sar rgyal po'i tshe gang bo'i blos thub sdongs grogs su snang zhing / ge sar sdilawobadud /sa phyir /bas te ser bo hor 'dul skabs kyang rta rkyang rgod lang da// /bye kā hā /bye/ kā trī sdi gā snar / gyis 'phrogs rjes/ kho mos hor /pa dī rno kā /sdo hā/kā /tā byin te/ ge sar rgyal po kho mo skyob par phebs pa lhakhya khrung khrung dkar mo mgur ring ma/ /dgung gnam la 'phur ba'i /spya ṭwāṃ / kā ma/ /thang sa la 'bab pa'i rkang ring ma/ /mar sgum bu 'thu ba'i ga zer ba'i lha bya khrung khrung dkar mo de gling nas 'brug mor skor rgyag par 'ongs pa na/ 'brug mos gling dkar stod kyi gnas tshul dang ge sar rgyal po

bod kyi gna' rabs rtsom rig 97bdud nas phyir phebs yod med kyi gtam sogs khrung khrung dkar mor dris pa dang / kho mos hor na myong bzhin pa'i sdug bsngal tshad med dang / rgyal po mchog dran pa'i sdug gtam sogs khrung khrung dkar mor ji bzhin zhus pa dang /ge sdar rgyal po myur du ser bo hor 'dul du phebs dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan yi ger bris nas khrung khrung dkar mo'i ske la btags nas brdzangs pas na/ khrung khrung dkar mo lha khang mthong grol sngon mo'i rtse na bzhugs pa'i ge sar rgyal po'i ga la bar 'phur nas 'brug mo'i yi ge phyag tu phul ba la/ rgyal pos 'brug mo dran nas sdug bsngal tshad med pa byas pa dang / mda' khrag 'thung thog rgod 'phur shes blangs te/ mi 'gyangs par khong nyid hor la phebs rgyu yin pa dang / de bar 'brug mo ma skyo yang zhes yi ge zhig bris nas mda' yi ske la btags nas ba ngas pas/ mda' de gur dkar rgyal po'i khri pha bong rta 'dra'i steng sgro la thug gi bar zug nas/ shan chung mang bo bsad/ gur nag //pa /shāX ṭwāṃ /nā pa shor/ de la 'brug mos 'bras chang la sman gyi ril bu gling gi grogs bzang lha mda' phebs lags sam/ /'o ma brgyal bde bar /bas lags sam/ /du/ kṇi ning gi lo /nga kham pa la/ /da lo'i 'bras shātā/ sdu/sdu sna gswā mee yi/ na// ring lha mdad zhal du gsol/ / sman 'brug zerabazhin chang mda' ltong du blugs pa na rkan sgra thag se bzhes/ de nas phyag gnyis chus bkrus/ phyag dar dkar gyis byibs te mda' de mar nas spu bton pa bzhin blangs/ yi ge la gzigs nas dga' spro dpag tu med pa skyes te/ da mang bo zhu rgyu med yi ge 'dis tshims pa yin/ rgyal po rang gang myur gyis phebs par mkhyen/ da nga gson bral gyi sems pa'i sdug bsngal sprin bzhin yal lo zhes zhus nas mda' de slar yang brdzangs pa lta bu dang /

98 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/yang / ma bzhi dpon po khro thung gis hor rta mang bo zhig ded nas ri khug cig la yar brgyab rjes/ hor rta rkyang rkyang zhig la zhon nas/ sku rje ge sar nor bu dgu 'dul yin pa'i tshul gyis dpa' bskyed nas hor sgar 'gram du slebs pa dang / lcag tshan de sga bar du gyen la bslangs/ de'i steng du rdo rje skyil krung zhig byas/ me khyer nyi ma'i 'od la brdzus pa'i glu blangs nas hor rnams la 'jigs snang skul mthar/ rta 'phar ba rnga nag gi kha ma blangs par/rang tshod rang gis ma zin par 'gag mo'i bu sdug jo ru la'ang hor rnams 'di ltar skrag cing 'jigs na/ nga ni stag rong khro rgyal yin zhes smras nas stag po'i ngar glu gcig blangs na/ kho gur dkar rgyal po dran med du brgyal 'gro ba thag gis chod bsams nas/ kha pho dang bcas rta sga'i steng du srin gri 'bar ba rtse rnon de gyen du bslangs nas btsugs/ de'i steng du rdo rje skyil krung zhig brgyab nas glu blangs pas/ hor kyi shan pa the ru rtse dang / rtsal chen shan pa lnga yis khro thung bda' byung ba la/ khro thung gis rmog dar 'phru dang bcas pa bskyur nas bros/ de nas khrab rgyab dar srungs se/ gri dpa' lung sha le/ rta sga srab byug ger re re bzhin bskyur nas/ rkang snam thar rkyang zhig gyu/ / ༵ / pab /snang bye/sa sdin bros pa dang / mthar 'phyi khung zhig tu 'dzul khro thung nang rul byas rkyen gyis/ / gling gi rgyal kha yod tshad brlag /ṭwāṃ /nga hor gyi ngan grogs su/ / gyur nas thabs jus bkod 'doms sdo padro sdishāshā // kārsha ṭā sbyisdo/ las/ ring du brgal zhing dngos yod kyi 'tsho ba'i chos nyid la mdzes pa'i rtog btags mdzad pa'i rtog pa 'char yan ring lugs kyi rmad byung sgyu rtsal gyi khyad chos phun sum tshogs pa zhig gis lo

bod kyi gna' rabs rtsom rig yargyus kyi byung ba brjod pa'i snyan rtsom ring mo 'di nyid rnam par brgyan pas na/snyan rtsom 'dir dngos yod ring lugs dang rtog pa 'char yan ring lugs kyi sgyu rtsal zung du sbrel ba'i rtsom stangs khyad chos ldan no/ /brnyan /sdu swā/khrishāshā/ 3/mas ldan la 'greng chugs yod pa'i mi sna'i snang lo rgyus kyi byung ba brjod pa'i snyan rtsom ring mo 'di'i khrod na gal 'gangs che ba'i mi sna brgya phrag lhag mchis shing / mi sna de dag las dkar phyogs kyi dpa' rtul rnams yin na'ang 'dra/ nag phyogs kyi dgra ya rnams yin yang rung / skyes pa yin na'ang 'dra/ skyes ma yin yang rung / rgan dar gzhonagasum sogs mi sna gang dang gang zhig yin yang de re re bzhin gson nyams ldan la 'greng tshugs yod pa dang / nyams 'gyur ldan la rang gshis chags pa'i sgo nas zhib 'bri mdzad yod pas/ mi sna de dag re re bzhin snyan rtsom 'di nyid kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i sgyu rtsal gyi snang brnyan du grub pa red/'dzam gling ge sar rgyal po ni snyan rtsom 'di nang gi mi sna gtso bo zhig yin zhing / khong nyid kyi steng nas rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs ston zhing / 'dre bdud kha lo bsgyur ba/ 'phur shes yang rtsal ldan zhing mthu stobs nus shugs mnga' ba sogs dkar phyogs lha yi yon tan 'dzom sa par ma zad/ blo sems dkar zhing blo gros 'bar ba dang / dpa' ngar che la brtul phod ldan pa dang / chos la dad cing snying rje che la dga' sdug skyo gdung sogs thugs yid kyi 'gyur bag mnga' ba dang / sha khrag nus gsum las grub pa'i 'gro ba mi yi khyad chos kyang ldan pas/ khong nyid ni snyan rtsom 'di'i khrod kyi gzi byin 'bar la rlabs che ba'i mi sna'i snang brnyan zhig tu rnam par grub la/ bod kha ba can gyis dad mos mdzad pa'i bla med skyabs mgon zhig tu gyur pa red/ khong nyid kyi thugs gshesadang mdzad spyod de khong nyid kyis blangs pa'i glu khrom chen gong ba zil

bod kyi gna' rabs rtsom rig yargyus kyi byung ba brjod pa'i snyan rtsom ring mo 'di nyid rnam par brgyan pas na/snyan rtsom 'dir dngos yod ring lugs dang rtog pa 'char yan ring lugs kyi sgyu rtsal zung du sbrel ba'i rtsom stangs khyad chos ldan no/ /brnyan /sdu swā/khrishāshā/ 3/mas ldan la 'greng chugs yod pa'i mi sna'i snang lo rgyus kyi byung ba brjod pa'i snyan rtsom ring mo 'di'i khrod na gal 'gangs che ba'i mi sna brgya phrag lhag mchis shing / mi sna de dag las dkar phyogs kyi dpa' rtul rnams yin na'ang 'dra/ nag phyogs kyi dgra ya rnams yin yang rung / skyes pa yin na'ang 'dra/ skyes ma yin yang rung / rgan dar gzhonagasum sogs mi sna gang dang gang zhig yin yang de re re bzhin gson nyams ldan la 'greng tshugs yod pa dang / nyams 'gyur ldan la rang gshis chags pa'i sgo nas zhib 'bri mdzad yod pas/ mi sna de dag re re bzhin snyan rtsom 'di nyid kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i sgyu rtsal gyi snang brnyan du grub pa red/'dzam gling ge sar rgyal po ni snyan rtsom 'di nang gi mi sna gtso bo zhig yin zhing / khong nyid kyi steng nas rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs ston zhing / 'dre bdud kha lo bsgyur ba/ 'phur shes yang rtsal ldan zhing mthu stobs nus shugs mnga' ba sogs dkar phyogs lha yi yon tan 'dzom sa par ma zad/ blo sems dkar zhing blo gros 'bar ba dang / dpa' ngar che la brtul phod ldan pa dang / chos la dad cing snying rje che la dga' sdug skyo gdung sogs thugs yid kyi 'gyur bag mnga' ba dang / sha khrag nus gsum las grub pa'i 'gro ba mi yi khyad chos kyang ldan pas/ khong nyid ni snyan rtsom 'di'i khrod kyi gzi byin 'bar la rlabs che ba'i mi sna'i snang brnyan zhig tu rnam par grub la/ bod kha ba can gyis dad mos mdzad pa'i bla med skyabs mgon zhig tu gyur pa red/ khong nyid kyi thugs gshesadang mdzad spyod de khong nyid kyis blangs pa'i glu khrom chen gong ba zil

100 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/gnon du'ang /dri pa/ patsho/ sbya/ ṭī/ nahor sdirji kāsna /sa/ 33 /yul khra mo na/ / 'brug lhang lhang nor bu'i gdan steng na/ / snyan lhang lhang khu byug grags sa na/ / dpal bde mchog nor bu'i pho brang gi/ / gling skyes bu seng chen rgyal po yin/ / skyabs bla ma yi dam dkon mchog gsum/ / rmog dung byang bzhin du klad na brjid/ / ma mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs/ /khrab dkar bo bzhin du lus la 'khri/ / bdud ma rung dgra bgegs log 'drenarnams/ /rkang lham chung bzhin du dog pas mnan/ / pho nga la mthun ya bzung ba'i mi/ / nga'i ske rags man la smad ma myong / /pho nga la 'gran ya 'tsholaba'i mi/ / rkang lham chung yan la btang ma myong / / dman nyam chung kun gyi pha ma yin/ / btsan tshod med rnams kyi gnya' gnon yin/ / dgra hā/ ser 'dul ba'i gshed ma yin/ / gling bde la 'god pa'i seng chen byedro rsha /spya hā hā kā ṭwāṃ / tā tna kā pa/ shā// dpa/ la gyis sgeg cing / bud med mdzangs ma'i yon tan dang ldan la/ blo gros dang shes rab che ba dang /yid gzhungs la zhi zhing dul ba/ bag yod la blo dkar ba/ rmad du byung la gting mtha' zab pa'i brtse dung gi slad du blo sems 'gyur med ngang nas brtson sems skyed nus la dpa' ngar zhum med ngang nas 'thab 'dzing byed spobasaho pa'i skyes ma khyad sbyi 'phags pa zhig tu zhib 'bri mdzad yod de/ dper na/ zur dkā kāsna /kṣe/ ṭwāṃ trī/dzes rgyan yag ma/ / kha tshur 'khor 'ja' ris mdangs ldan ma/ / 'gros phar 'gro gom pa rta brgya ri/ / ma mkha' 'grosagar stabs bsgyur ba 'dra/ /tshur 'ong lugs srug po drel brgya ri/ /

bod kyi gna' rab rtsomarig 101lha rig 'dzin rtse bro 'khrab pa 'dra/ / nyams dga' ba rtse lugs mdzo brgya ri/ /mi gzhan yid 'phrog pa'i lcags kyu 'dra/ / so 'dzum dkar bstan na lug brgya ri/ /shel mu tig phreng chung bsgrigs pa 'dra/ /sku g.yas pa g.yas su 'phangs pa na/ /rgod thang dkar gshog pa brkyangs pa 'dra/ /skra g.yo na pa g.yon du 'phangs pa na/ / rgod thang srug gnam 'phang gcod pa 'dra/ /rgyab skra rgyan g.yu byur 'phreng bsgrigs pa/ / lha'i bu mo mi yul 'ongs pa 'dra/ /mdun kha dog sna lnga'i rgyan cha de/ /bya rma byas sgro gur phub pa 'dra/ /yar langs na rgya dar 'phyar ba 'dra/ / mar bsdad na gur khang phub pa 'dra/ /mda' nyag phran zhig la ci tshang ba/ /'di seng lcam 'brug mor tshang nas yod/ /blo rno ba mde'u ngar ma 'dra/ /khog yid sems drang ba mda' mo /sbyan/ 'a/sbya/sa yangs pa thang dkar rtse sgro 'dra/ /yid drang ba me long gzugs zhes seng lcam 'brug po'i mdzes sdug dang ngang gshis ni nyams 'gyur mdzes la gson nyams ldan pa'i sgo nas zhib 'bri mdzad pa'o/ /gling gi ma bzhi dpon po khro thung ni/ wa mo bzhin du g.yo zol che la snar ma'i brtul zhugs 'dzin pa/ gyod dang kha mchu'i sna 'dren dang / phyi bshig gi sta / da nang bshig ṭwāṃ ste'u lta bu zhig tu zhib 'bri mdzad yod de/ dper na/ zur barsha pasdo pazlo rdokāsna kā/ khro thung lags/ /khro ba lha sde nang du khro/ /thung ba phu nu'i steng la thung / /chang skyems 'bar 'thung na dpa' bo stag /snang dgra bo mthong na sdar ma wa/ /mar khug phan pu snum thung la/ /rtsam khug phan pu skya thung yin/ /zho ru phan pu ze'u thung la/ /spang dkar rbab la bsgril /(sna /sna/ nas/ ṭwāṃ rno/grogs mgo gcig gi steng la zhon/ / glu brel thung tshig

wa 102 bodakyi rtsom rig lo rgyus riga'adzinabyiba'irolamatsho/ da wamadzad gā kāpo ba kyā khro thung gi spyod tshul dang rang gshis nyams ldan du zhib 'bri hor rte nagur dkar rgyal po ni las dang rgyu 'bras la mi bsam par ngo bstod dang bkur bsti la dga' ba/ lhag bsam dang snying rje mi ldan par kta/ driX rsha ༵༵ /spyi/ /lha shā zlo // slo ṭwāṃ zlo zlo/ mdzad yod de/ dper na/ sngalas gur dkar bo'i nang zhig na/ / stag bul khra mo'i nang shel na/ / rgyal po glang gnya' tshil rkyal nyon/ / khyod ngo stod a rgas sprel la rig /sprel bya byed mang na 'phung le yod/ /ngo smad rgya bo ra la rig /ra rogs dad che bas 'phung rabs yod/ / ngas kher nyin sngon nas bshad le yin/ /gling dkar bo'i 'gran ya mi yong byas/ /no/ /zhes le bda' dang mtshang 'bru'i tshig gis glu blangs pa lta bus mtshon de ma zad da rung bdud 'dul nang gi bdud gan klu btsan dang /'jang gling g.yul 'gyed nang gi 'jang sa dam rgyal po/ mon gling g.yul 'gyed nang gi shing khri rgyal po sogs nag phyogs pa'i rgyal po rnams dang / me bza' 'bum skyid dang / a stag lha mo/ me tog lha mdzes sogs gling ge sar rgyal po'i btsun mo rnams dang / gling ge sar rgyal po'i sku mched gdong 'bum pa'i rgya tsha zhal dkar/ dpa' 'gran med seng stag a dom/ tsha zhang 'dan ma byang khra/ 'bru sga sde chos skyong ber nag stag rong a nu gzig 'phen/dar seng dug gi sdong bo/ dpa' mi 'gyur nya tsha a brtan sogs gling gi yang tu( /ma spramibadun bcas lo rgyusakyibyung ba brjodasgru pa'isnyanartsom ring mo trī ṭwāṃ /shā bye // /rdzu shā/ sdus phu/da nā rgyung ba'i sgyu rtsal dngha snang brnyan du gyur pa

bod kyi gna' rabs rtsom rig 103ro bgā/calta 'dod ring pyinasbyo la/ go bla zhing sgor bde ba'i dmangs khrod stem tā rgyu ṭwāṃ /dro trī shātā ṅge ༵ ṭwāṃ py-i rno /rtsom ring mo 'di nyid kyi rtsom stangs ni bcad lhug spel ma yin zhing / tshigs bcad rnams len bde ba'i dmangs khrod glu tshig ltar bcoms yod pa dang / de dag ni thog mtha' bar gsum du phan tshun smra ba'i skad cha ste/ snyan rtsom khrod kyi mi snas phan tshun la len pa'i glu tshig yin pa red/ lhug pa rnams kha gsal zhing sbyor bde la/ tshig dam zhing rnyog rdzob med pa zhig yin pa dang / de dag ni yul ljongs dang tshogs ra/g.yul sa dang dmag 'thab/ mi sna dang mi sna phan tshun 'os 'tsham gyis mtshams sbyor ram zhib 'bri mdzad pa'i rjod byed du 'dug go /gtam rgyud khrod kyi mi snas phan tshun blangs pa'i glu tshig ste/ phan tshun smra ba'i skad cha'i khrod nas/ mi sna rang rang gi ming dang thob bang / byad gzugs dang bsam blo/ gshes ka dang spyod tshul/ blo spobs dang dpa' tshul sogs mngon gsal du mtshon yod la/ dga' sdang chags zhen gyi dbye ba'ang gsal rjen du bstan 'dug gtam rgyud kyi go rim khrod du phan tshun len pa'i glu tshig gi 'gros dang bstun nas dkar phyogs pa rnams dang nag phyogs pa rnams kyi mi sna re re bzhin gtam rgyud kyi gar stegs su phebs pa dang /gcig rjes gnyis mthun du 'ongs pa'i mi sna'i mdzad spyod dang 'gal 'brel rdo bye pa / ṭwāṃ /nga yongs su bstun nas brjod bya'i mtha' ring nas ring du snyan rtsom ring mo 'di nyid rgya che ba'i bod rigs ngal rtsol mi dmangs khrod du sa khyab rdo khyab tu song zhing kho tshos ha cang dga' bo byed pa'i rgyu rkyen gal che ba gcig ni snyan rtsom 'di'i rjod byed kyi tshig la lta 'dod cing nyan spro la go sla zhing sbyor bde ba'i dmangs khrod rtsom rig gi rtsom stangs khyad chos ldan

1slo bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyusarig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/pa'i stabs red/ khyad par du mi snas phan tshun len pa'i glu tshig gis phas rgol gyi dgra bo zil gyis gnon pa'am/ rang phyogs dpa' rtul g.yul du skul ba gang yin rung don de la 'tsham pa'i gna' mi bod kyi gtam dpe mdzes dgur bkol nas brjod bya'i nang don la ram bu 'degs pa dang gtan tshigs bsnan pas na/ yid la zad mtha' med pa'i mdzes snang skyed cing blo la gob bskon zhing slob gso gtong ba'i nus shugs ldan par gyur/ dper na/hor gling g.yul 'gyed las/ hor gur dkar rgyal pos hor dmag gling la ༵༵༵ 17gnu byed par skul ba'i tshe na/ shan pa the ru rtse yis bshol 'debs dmag khra bo gling la mi 'gro lags/ /mi 'gro'i rtsa ba bshad pa na/ /gling sa mthong ba kun smon de/ /'dzam bu gling gi lte ba red/ / sa de la dma' 'bebs phod sa min/ /'dzam gling dpa' rtul sum cu de/ /grub chen brgyad cu'i sprul ba red/ /las de la 'gran ya e dga' na/ /gna' mi bod kyi gtam dpe la/ / kha kha rog sdod dang kha mchu med/ / mgo rum nang pa// / sdu/ ༵ ༵ /da/ /rta ma rgyug bsdad na chad glo med/ /gzhu ma 'then ces don de la 'tsham pa'i gtam dpe bkol nas gur dkar rgyal po la bshol 'debs byas pa lta bu dang /yangahor gling g.yul 'gyed las/ tsha zhang 'dan ma byang khras mda' 'phangs kto hor gyi blon po sdig gcod shan pa the ru rtse'i klad phor bkog nas blangs pa glu gzhi/'a mi bod kyi gtam dpe la/ / skyen po'i mda' la rab bdun dgos/ / rmog dar 'phru ma 'gul skyen po'i mda'/ / khrab rgyab dar ma 'dar skyen po'i mda'/ /skra lcang lo ma 'gul skyen po'i mda'/ /sog me

bod kyi gna' rabs rtsom rig 105 3long thug na skyen po'i mda'/ / stod 'dom smad la khrid na skyen po'i mda'/ /smad 'dom stod la khrid na skyen po'i mda'/ /nyag phran rwa lcags 'phrod na skyen po'i mda'/ /'di skyen po'i mda' yi 'phen lugs red/ /ngas 'og gi rta la mi rgyag ste/ / rta dud 'gros byas pa ci yang med/ / de'i steng gi sga la mi rgyag ste/ / sga lhu bzhi gtor nas ci mkho med/ /de'i steng gi mi la mi rgyag ste/ /mi lus rin chen gser las dkon/ / mgo rmog dkar steng la rnga 'phru mda'/ / rnga 'phru steng la rgya khab tshugs/ / khab mig nang la dar lung drongs/ /hor gling mi sha bgos zhan 'dra/ /rmog pho byang zur nas 'buda'i gcig / mo byang dkyil nas 'don le gcig / yar sku mtshams yan la mi gtong le/ / mar klad 'phru man la mi mngags le/ / srog rta ngang tsam de ma chad le/ /mda' nyag phran mtheb tshod bzung bas chog /ces skyen po'i mda' 'phen lugs kyi gtam dpe legs par bkol nas )lha' bo'i gad rgyangs bsgrags te/ phas kyi rgol ba spa bkong bar byas pa lta ga der ma zad/ snyan rtsom 'di nyid kyi tshigs bcad khrod du skabs 'gar sdebasbyor legs shing 'gyur khug ldan pa'i sgra rgyan rang byon du thon yod pas/de dag ni dmangs khrod snyan ngag gi dwangs mar snang la/ glu tshig gyer 'don gyi dbyangs 'gros kyi rgyan du gyur pa dang / sgrung dper gzigs mkhan rnams dang sgrung bshad la nyan mkhan dag gi mig gi dpyid dang rna ba'i bcud du gyur ṭwāṃ /ru/dper na/ hor gling g.yul 'gyed du rgya tsha zhal dkar gyis blangs pa'i sa 'di yi sa ngo ma shes na/ /rma del yag stag thang khra mo red/ /pho nga dang nga ngo ma shes na/ /sa phu gsum kha ba gangs kyi ri/ /gangs la seng chen 'gying ba'i ri/ /seng la g.yu ral rgyas pa'i ri/ /sked gsum tsan dan

1yo bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/nags kyi ri/ /nags la rgya stag 'phyo ba'i ri/ / stag la 'dzum drug rgyas pa'i ri/ /mda' gsum gtsang rgyas chab kyi ri/ /chu la nya sram 'khor ba'i ri/ /nya la gser mig rgyas pa'i ri/ /shod gsum chu ma zhing gi ri/ /zhing la 'bras drugazin pa'i ri/ / 'bras la mgo nag 'khor ba'i ri/ / rma ri bo bzhi yi ༵༵༵ /spya /sdu /dka/zlo /// mi 'gyur dngul chu khro rdzong nas/ / dpa' mi zhes bo bzhur bzhur du shar mar thon pa lta bus mtshon no/ / de'i phyir lo rgyus kyi byung ba brjod pa'i snyan rtsom ring mo 'di nyid ni sdeb legs tshig gi rgya mtsho dang / yid dbang 'phrog cing 'gyur khug ldan pa'i sdeb legs sgra rgyan gyi 'byung gnas su gyur pas/ rtsom rig gsar rtsom gyi phyogs la brtson ༵༵ di/ kā pa'i gzhon nu rnams kyis cis kyang slob sbyong byed pa'i yul du

bod kyi gna' rabs rtsom rig 107don tshan bcu ba/ bodatpa zlos gar rtsom rigade yang zlos gar rtsom rig ces pa ni zlos gar 'khrab gzhung la zer zhing zlos gar sgyu rtsal kyi thub cha gtso bo yin la/ 'khrab gzhung gis thad kur zlos gar gyi brjod bya'i snying bo dang mi sna/ byung rim/ gar tshig sgrig gzhi /cas gtan 'khel byed pa dang gar stegs 'khrab ston gyi gzhi 'dzin sa yin zlos gar zhes pa ni lus kyi nyams 'gyur dang / rkang ba'i stangs stabs/ngag gi smra brjod du ma yang yang zlos shing gar byed pa'am/ ngag nas glu zlos shing lus kyis gar byed pa dang yang na gar stegs kyi snang brnyan dmigs yul du byed cing / 'khrab ston pa'i 'khrab bsgyur dkyil snying du gyur pa'i rtsom rig dang 'khrab ston/ rol dbyangs/ bro gar/ mdzes ris sogs rnam pa mang bo las grub pa'i sna 'dzoms kyi sgyu rtsal zhig yin la/ mi sna dang don rkyen/ dus tshod/ gnas yul rnams ches gcig bsdus kyi ngang nas/ tshad bkag yod pa'i gar stegs dang 'khrab ston dus tshod kyi nang du mi sna'i bya byed nyams 'gyur dang skad cha/ mi sna'i rang gshis 'bur don/ don gyi byung rim myur bar 'phel ba sogs zlos gar gyi 'phel 'gros mgyogs shing rno ngar ldan la dza drag che ba'i 'gal ba kha 'thab la brten nas spyi tshogs 'tsho ba mtshon zhing /mi rnams kyi tshor 'du brtse ba skyoms par byas te legs nyes spang blang gi cha la go bskon slob gso gtong ba zhig yin no/ /bod du zlos gar 'khrab ston gyi srol ni dus rabs bcu bzhi ba'i nang

bod kyi gna' rabs rtsom rig 107don tshan bcu ba/ bodatpa zlos gar rtsom rigade yang zlos gar rtsom rig ces pa ni zlos gar 'khrab gzhung la zer zhing zlos gar sgyu rtsal kyi thub cha gtso bo yin la/ 'khrab gzhung gis thad kur zlos gar gyi brjod bya'i snying bo dang mi sna/ byung rim/ gar tshig sgrig gzhi /cas gtan 'khel byed pa dang gar stegs 'khrab ston gyi gzhi 'dzin sa yin zlos gar zhes pa ni lus kyi nyams 'gyur dang / rkang ba'i stangs stabs/ngag gi smra brjod du ma yang yang zlos shing gar byed pa'am/ ngag nas glu zlos shing lus kyis gar byed pa dang yang na gar stegs kyi snang brnyan dmigs yul du byed cing / 'khrab ston pa'i 'khrab bsgyur dkyil snying du gyur pa'i rtsom rig dang 'khrab ston/ rol dbyangs/ bro gar/ mdzes ris sogs rnam pa mang bo las grub pa'i sna 'dzoms kyi sgyu rtsal zhig yin la/ mi sna dang don rkyen/ dus tshod/ gnas yul rnams ches gcig bsdus kyi ngang nas/ tshad bkag yod pa'i gar stegs dang 'khrab ston dus tshod kyi nang du mi sna'i bya byed nyams 'gyur dang skad cha/ mi sna'i rang gshis 'bur don/ don gyi byung rim myur bar 'phel ba sogs zlos gar gyi 'phel 'gros mgyogs shing rno ngar ldan la dza drag che ba'i 'gal ba kha 'thab la brten nas spyi tshogs 'tsho ba mtshon zhing /mi rnams kyi tshor 'du brtse ba skyoms par byas te legs nyes spang blang gi cha la go bskon slob gso gtong ba zhig yin no/ /bod du zlos gar 'khrab ston gyi srol ni dus rabs bcu bzhi ba'i nang

108 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/ches cher dar bar grags te/ de'ang grub chen thang stong rgyal po(1385da wa1509)yis lcags zam bsgrun pa'i mthun rkyen du las ka ba'i khrod na skyes gzugs mdzes pa'i bu mo spun bdun yod par grub chen rang gis rkang lag gi stangs stabs dang glu gar sogs khrid ston mdzad de/ dbus khul yul gru khag la phebs nas zlos gar 'khrab ston byas te dge skul dkar thigs bslangs/bu mo gzhon nu ma de dag gi 'khrab ston gyis skye bo kun gyi yid dbang 'phrog par byas pas/ thams cad kyis nam mkha'i lha mos gar 'khrab pa ltar ngo mtshar che zhes bstod bsngags byas pas lha po'i zlos gar zhes pa'i ming byung /bod kyi zlos gar thog mar dar dus rol cha'i ram 'degs nyung(rnga dang sbub ma gtogs med par bshad)zhing gar stegs kyang nges can zhig med la/phal cher skabs bstun gang bde'i sgo nas 'khrab ston byas chog par snang /'on kyang zlos gar gyi 'khrab ston sgrig gzhi la thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos shig ldan te/ gtam rgyud ji lta bu zhig 'khrab ston byed kyang / mdo dang /gzhung / bkra shis bcas kyi go rim gsum tshang dgos/ mdo zhes pa ni zlos gar gyi sngon 'gro lta bu yin la mdo 'dzin pa zhes pa gar stegs su zhugs nas dkon mchog la mchod brjod dang lta mkhan la bkra shis bde legs zhu ba dang sbrags skabs babs 'khrab ston byed pa'i zlos gar ngo sprod byed pa yin/ rjes su/ mdo de'ang rngon pas sa 'dul dang rgya lus byin 'bebs/ lha po'i glu gar zhes pa'i rnam pa gsum gyis grub par grags/ gzhung zhes pa ni skabs sdu/sna /trī kā kto ṭwāṃ /nā zlo'i zlos gar gyi gtam rgyud dngos dang bkra shis ni bod du 'khrab ston byed pa'i srol rgyun zlos gar gyi gtam rgyud dag las ches snga shos ni ras chung dbus phebs zhes pa yin par bshad cing / de rjes su rim bzhin chos rgyal nor bzang dang dri med kun ldan/ gzugs kyi nyi ma/

bod kyi gna' rabs rtsom rig glurgya bza' kong jo/ pad ma 'od 'bar/ don yod don 'grub/ 'gro ba bsdung mo/ snang sa 'od 'a/ma bcas srol rgyun gyi zlos gar chen mo brgyad du 'a da sna //༵༵sa // dro rte/sa ga/ra chen mo brgyad las la la ni sangs rgyas kyi skyes rabs dang mdo las byung zhing / 'ga' zhig ni bod kyi dmangs khrod gtam rgyud gzhir bzung ste bcos sgrig byas pa dang / la las ni bod kyi lo rgyus kyi don gnad mtshon pa yin te/ gsham nas de dag gi brjod don mdor rdzu/sa dang bsam blo'i rang bzhin gnyis kyi cha nas re re bzhin bshad par dang po/ chosargyalanor bzang /de yang chos rgyal nor bzang gi rnam thar 'di'i thog ma'i sa bon nam 'byung khungs ni sangs rgyas kyi skyes rabs rtogs brjod dpag bsam 'khri shing las yal 'dab drug cu re bzhi ba nor bzang gi rtogs brjod ces pa de yin/ dpag bsam 'khri shing gi bod 'gyur byung rjes nor bzang gi gtam rgyud 'di bod rigs dmangs khrod du dar khyab ha cang che la/ rjes su sdings chen tshe ring dbang 'dus kyis bod rang gi bsam blo dang mos 'dun/ mdzes dpyod lta ba dang mthun par sbyar nas bcos sgrig byas pa zhig yin no/ /chos rgyal nor bzang gi brjod don gtso bo ni/ sngon byang phyogs mnga' ldan pa dang lho phyogs rigs ldan pa zhes bya ba'i rgyal khab gnyis yod pa la/lho phyogs rigs ldan pa'i rgyal po shag pa gzhon nu zer ba de ni gdug tsub can dang nga rgyal can/ las rgyu 'bras la brtsi 'jog mi byed pa'i mi zhig yin

110 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/stabs/ snal khab der lo tog dang gnam chu mi lhags shing mi nad dang phyugapa /tā / ṭā bye /byes lda nākā /su // 'khrug dang mu rtag tu byung nas rgyal po'i de'i stabs kyis/ rgyal po shag pa gzhon nus byang gi phyogs na 'khyil ba'i mtsho mo dang mtsho der gnas pa'i klu'i rgyal po grogs su 'gugs pa'i blo log bcangs nas mnga' ldan padma bla ma mcho kha la sngags pa zhig mngags/sngags pa des klu'i rgyal po la gnod 'tshe gtong skabs rngon pa spang leb 'dzin gyis skyabs pas/ klu'i rgyal pos rngon pa'i drin lan 'jal ched rngon pa klu yul du gdan drangs te byin rlabs ldan pa'i nor bu rin chen dgos 'dod kun 'byung zhes bya ba phul/ de nas rngon pa spang leb 'dzin drang srong blo gros rab gsal gyi mdun du song nas sdod skabs/ dri za'i rgyal po'i sras mo yid 'phrog lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa tshangs pa 'du ba'i khrus kyi rdzing bu ru sku khrus gsol du phebs pa mthong bas/ dri za'i lha mo de dag gi khrod nas gcig bzung ste rang gi chung ma byed par 'dod nas/ klu yul nas nor bu don yod zhags pa khyer 'ongs te yid 'phrog lha mo bzung / 'on kyang / yid 'phrog lha mo rngon lta'i /tan grogs spyad par pyid ma 'thad pas drang srong blo gros rab /spra rnyi bye ṭā /dri pasdus sna bye/ napa zlor rna pye 'phrog lha mo byang phyogs mnga' ldan chos rgyal nor bzang gis yin 'phrog lha mo khab tu bzhes pas/ khong gnyisaphas tshun mdza/ zhi/ mthun par gyur pa dang bde skyid rdzogs ldan gsar sdu/ /sduX la shetsu wang zlo sbya kārnyi/ phrag dog skyes nas yin 'phrog lha mo med par gtong ched a mchod ha ri dang ngan 'brel byas/ a mchod ha ris g.yosgyu bkol te chos rgyal nor bzang byang phyogs su dgra 'dul bar bsdangs/

bod kyi gna' rabasartsom rig 111nor bzang phebs shul du/ a mchod ha ris thabs jus sna tshogs 'then nas ༷༷ 2phrog lha mo gsod par brtsams pas yid 'phrog lha mo dri za'i yul du /du /chos rgyal nor bzang byang phyogs nas phyir phebs tshe/ yid 'phrog lha mo dri za'i yul du gshegs pa shes te thugs la skyo snang tshad med skyes shing / rgyal srid snang med du bskyur nas drang srong blo gros rab gsal gyi drung du phebs pa na/ yid 'phrog lha mos bzhag pa'i rin chen gser gdub thob/ de nas chos /lha// ༵༵༵ // rdzu/ dgra ma lus par btul nas ljon pa'i yul du yid yin na'ang / dri za'i rgyal po rta mgo can gyis rang gi sras mo yid 'phrog lha mo chos rgyal nor bzang gi btsun mor ster ma 'dod pas thabs sna tshogs bkol nas bkag 'gog byas pa dang / dri za'i rtsal bo che dag dang dpa' rtsal 'gran par bcug ste nyams tshod blangs pa red/ de lta na'ang /chos rgyal nor bzang kun nas rgyal bar gyur pa dang / mda' phangs pa'ang yid 'phrog lha mor babs pas/ mjug mthar dri za'i rgyal pos yid 'phrog lha mo chos rgyal nor bzang gi btsun por mi ster ka med byung /gong gi brjod don mdor bsdus 'di la mno bsam zhib mos dpyad na/chos rgyal nor bzang gi bsam blo'i rang bzhin ni/ rgyal bu nor bzang dang yid 'phrog lha mo gnyis kyi 'gyur med brtan cing lhad med rnam dag gi brtse dung la bsngags brjod dang nor bzang gis lhad med brtse dung de'i ched du dka'ab brgya phrag khyad du gsod thub pa'i snying stobs la bstod glu blangs pa dang chabs cig tu gdug tsub che la las 'bras mi brtsi ba'i rigs ldan rgyal po shag pa gzhon nu dang / phrag dog gi dug chus kun nas myos pa'i btsun mo lnga brgya/ sbyor ba ngan pas gzhan la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i a mchod ha ri bcas

112 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyusarig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/kyis mtshon pa'i dngos yod sbyi tshogs khrod kyi dge mtshan dang legs tshogs la gtor brlag byed pa'i mi rnams la zur za dang mtshang 'byin byas yod/gnyisapa/ rgyalabu dri med kunaldan/dri med kun ldan gyi rnam thar gyi 'byung khungs ni 'phags pa rgyal bu don pa// // /snag kā swā rsha sna /yi//phags pa rgyal bu don grub kyi mdzad pa dang rgyal bu dri med kun ldan gyi brjod don gtso bo ni/ sngon yul ste ta'i grong khyer chen po na rgyal po sa skyong grags pa zhes bya ba zhig mchis pa der rgyal rgyud 'dzin pa'i sras gcig kyang ma byung bas/ rgyal pos yar dkon mchog la mchod pa dang mar dbul phongs la sbyin pa/ lha srin sde brgyad la gtor ma btang bar brten/ btsun mo dge ldan bzang mo la rgyal bu zhig 'khrungs pa la//byi /na thams cad dga' bar gyur nas mtshan la dri med kun ldan zhes denas rgyal bu rim gyis nar son pa na yul padma can gyi rgyal po zla ba bzang bo zhes bya ba'i sras mo man dhe bzang mo zhes pa btsun mor blangs pa las/ sras che ba legs ldan dang 'bring ba legs dpal/ chung ba sras mo legs mdzes ma gsum rim par 'khrungs/dri med kun ldan ni chung dus nas byams dang snying rje che ba/ gtong phod kyi lag pa ring zhing dbul phongs la sbyin pa gtong bar dgyes pa zhig yin/nyin zhig la/ rgyal bu dri med kun ldan blon 'khor rnams dang mnyam du skyed mos tshal du gzigs mor byon pa na/ pho brang phyi rol tu dbul sdug gis

bod kyi gna' rabasartsom rig 113mnar ba'i 'bangs mi mang bo 'dus nas rgyal bu dri med kun ldan la ce rer bltas 'dug pa mthong nas thugs la sdug bsngal bzod du med pa skyes te/yab rgyal po las sbyin pa gtong ba'i dbang cha zhus par yab rgyal po 'thad pa byung ba dang / rgyal po'i bang mdzod kyi sgo phye nas rin chen nor bu rnams //sdu pa/kā / /|sdu py-i yul khams kun gyi mnga' 'bangs la sbyin pa rgya cher de'i dus su/ yul mtha' 'khob bye ma shing drung gi rgyal po shing khri btsan po zhes bya ba yis gtam de thos pa dang bsam sbyor ngan pa bcangs nas/mnga' 'og gi bram ze blo gros zhes pa de nor bu dgos 'dod dpung 'joms slong bar mngags/ rgyal bu dri med kun ldan gyis phangs pa med par nor bu dgos 'dod dpung 'joms de bram ze blo gros la sbyin pa dang / gnas tshul de yab rgyal po sa skyong grags pas shes 'phral rab tu khros par gyur te rgyal bu dri med kun ldan bdud ri ha shang du bskrad nas lo bcu gnyis kyi ring la 'dugadagos pa'i khrims chad bcad/ dri med kun ldan bdud ri ha shang la /lha parji kā/braXhā / ṭwāṃ shā/ dhe bzang mo dang sras ming sring gsum po'ang rjes rgyal bu dri med kun ldan btsun mo dang bcas pa bdud ri ha shang du gshegs pa'i lam du rgyu nor thams cad slong mkhan rnams la phangs med du sbyin par ma zad/ rang gi snying dang 'dra ba'i sras ming sring gsum po'ang slong mkhan dag la sbyin/ tha na lha tshangs pas nyams sad kyi chen du man dhe bzang mo bslangs pa la de'ang phangs med du sbyin par mdzad/de nas rgyal bu dri med kun ldan dang btsun mo gnyis bdud ri ha shang du lobacu gnyis lon rjes phyir rang gi rgyal khab tu log pa'i lam du/ dri med kun ldan gyis bram ze long ba zhig la rang gi spyan gnyis kyang sbyin nas sbyin

114 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyusarig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/pa'i ma// /// parargya padza py-i /dri med kun ldan gyi sbyin pa'i stobs kyis spyan gnyisagasal bar gyur pa dang / sngar bram ze blo gros la sbyin pa btang ba'i nor bu dgos 'dod dpung 'joms de phyir sprad byung la/ sras ming sring gsum po'ang bram ze dag gis phyir gnang byung /de nas rgyal bu dri med kun ldan dang btsun mo man dhe bzang mo/ sras ming sring gsum po bcas rang yul du phebs nas yab yum dang mnyam 'dzoms byung ba dang / dri med kun ldan yab rgyal po'i rgyal tshab tu dbang ༵༵/ parsha / ༵ /da chos bzhin bskyangs shing mnga' 'bangs bde skyid kyi des na/ dri med kun ldan gyi bsam blo'i rang bzhin ni/ rgyal bu dri med kun ldan gyis nyam thag 'bangs mi rnams la snying rje chen po bcangs nas/rgyal po'i bang mdzod las nor bu dgos 'dod dpung 'joms sogs phangs pa med par sbyin pa btang bar ma zad/ rang gi chung ma dang sras ming sring gsum/ rang gi spyan la sogs pa'ang sbyin pabatangaste don dmagyi khyaskyi pa'i /byi(/ /pa/ ༵ /sdo tā sdo nā /da byung mdzad spyod la tshad mthon po'i nas gsumapa/ gzugasakyi nyi ma/gzugs kyi nyi ma'i rnam thar 'di ni btsan po khri srong lde btsan gyi ring la lo tsā ba gnyis kyis rgya gar nas bsgyur ba yin/gzugs kyi nyi ma yi brjod don gtso bo ni/ rgyal bu zla ba'i seng gis

bod kyi gna' rabs rtsom rig 115rigs ngan gyi bu mo zhig btsun mor blangs rjes/ yang drang srong sgom chen gyi bu mo gzugs kyi nyi ma btsun mor blangs pas/ rigs ngan bu mo zhe sdang dang phrag dog langs nas glu gar la mkhas pa'i gan dhe bzang mo dang gros ngan brtsamasate gzugs kyi nyi ma bsru brid byas pa dang sbrags ma nyes kha g.yogs gang mang byas mthar/ rgyal po'ang g.yo 'og tu tshud de gzugs kyi nyi ma gshed ma gsum gyi lag tu sprad nas dur khrod du gsod par btang mod/ gzugs kyi nyi ma mtshar sdug shin tu che bas gsod ma phod par ga nas 'ong ba de gar btang zhing / yab drang srong ni 'das zin pas mthar rnal 'byor ma byas te rgyal khams phyogs med du bskor ba'i rting ma la slar yang grong khyer sems kyi blo gros kyi phyogs su slebs pa dang / rgyal sras zla ba'i seng ge yang gzugs kyi nyi ma med pa'i mya ngan gyi khung bur tshud pa'i skabs dang 'phrad de blo rig gsal ba'i a bo na ges rnal 'byor ma de gzugs kyi nyi ma yin pa shes nas rgyal po'i pho brang du gdan drangs/ gan dhe bzang mo dang rigs ngan bu mo gnyis kyis btsams pa'i bya ngan rnams mthil brdol/ rgyal po rgyal sras bcas pa rmongs pa las sad de gzugs kyi nyi ma slar yang btsun mor mnga' gsol nas tshang ma dga' skyid kyi dpal la rol ba'i skabs gsar du rnyed pa'o/ /gong brjod don mdor bsdus 'dir mno bsam zhib mos dpyad na/'du bral las grub pa'i rgyal po zla ba'i seng ge dang btsun mo gzugs kyi nyi ma gnyis kyi lhan med brtse dung la bsngags brjod dang / de gnyis kyi mi phyed brtse dung de gzhan gyis gtor bsheg dang gnod 'tshe btang ba yis 'jig mi thub la/ kha bral dang dus tshod kyis gzhom du med pa mtshon pa dang chabs cig tu/ bsam sbyor ngan pas gzhan la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i mi de ci nas kyang pham nyes su 'gro ba'i chos nyid legs par bstan pa de red/

116 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyusarig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/bzhi ba/ rgya bza' kong jo/de yang dus rabs bdun pa'i skabs su bod rgyal srong btsan sgam pos rgya nag rgyal po thang the tsung gi sras mo rgya bza' kong jo de btsun mor bsu ched/blon po mgar dam pa dang rta ba brgya phrag lhan cig tu rgya nag tu mngags/de'i tshe rgya gar/ stag gzig na sar/ hor gyi rgyal po bzhi'i blon po yang lha ///snang jo gdan 'dren pa'i ched du mngags pa rgya rje'i pho brang du slebs der rgyas lha gcig bod la ster ma 'dod nas blon po rig pa rno ba zhig la ster bar byas te/ bla g.yu phub tsam pa dkyil dang mtha' na mig re yod pa zhig la dar yug sus tshud pa la sbyin no zer nas gtad pas/ blon po gzhan rnams kyis nyi ma mang bor thabs sna tshogs byas kyang tshud ma thub bo/ /mgar gyis grog ma byen po zhi/ gi byed dror dar skud btags te mig gcig nas phus btab sdu/ bye/ shā ༵ bye trī ༵ swā /snyi/ma pa brgya gtad nas so so'i ma bu ngo shes pa la ster zer bar/ gzhan rnams kyis ngo ma shes/ mgar gyis rte'u rnams pa// // ṭwāṃ ༵ ngom she nākā par sang nyin btang bas rang rang gi mas nu ma yang che chung mnyam pa'i bya ma brgya dang bu brgya gtad nas 'di rnams ma bu so sor phye zhig zer ba la/ gzhan rnams gyis ma shes/ mgar gyis thang che ༵ zhig la sbang ma gtor bas gnyis gnyis lhan du za bas bya ma bu ngo shes

bod kyi gna' rabs rtsom rig 117yang nyin gcig la mi res lug sha bubs re zos shing pags pa yang mnyes zin pa la ster ro zer ba dang / gzhan rnams kyis gang yang ma nus/bod blon rnams kyis sha dang pags pa so sor srungs nas sha nyung ngu re tshwa la bsgres te kham re kham re zos pas tshar zhing / pags pa rnams gral 'go nas rim bzhin phur ba re byas pas thul lo/ / riyang nyi ma phyed tshun la mi res chang ban re 'thung ba ma bzi ba la lha gcig ster zer nas chang ban re gtad pas/ gzhan rnams ni bzi zhing /sbyozlo so/ / bod blon rnams snod chung ngur hub re hub re 'thung tshar te ma yang nub cig rnga bo che drag tu brdungs pas thams cad pho brang du 'tshogs pa na/ rgya rjes do nub lam ma 'dzol bar rang gi 'dug sa sus rnyed pa la ster ro zer/ der blon po gzhan dag lam nor te rang gi 'dug sa ma rnyed do/ /mgar gyis sngar nas sgo rnams la rtags brgyab nas yong yod pas/sgron me btegs nas rtags la bltas shing 'ongs pas 'dug sar bde bar slobs so/ /'on kyang lhag gcig bod la ster ma 'dod do/ /mjug mthar/ rgyal pos kong jo gzhon nu ma mtshar sdug dang ldan pa sum brgya'i khrod du bcug nas/ sus ngo shes par gyur na der ster ro zer/de la gnas mos rogs ram byas par brten blon po mgar gyis bu mo sum brgya'i khrod nas lha gcig kong jo de'i ngo shes par gyur pas/ bod la rgyal kha thob/ lha gcig kong jo de bod rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i btsun mor thob byung / de nas blon po mgar dam pa dang lha gcig kong jo 'khor g.yog dang bcas pas rgya nag gi rgyal blon rnams la phyi phyag 'tshal te gangs can bod la chas shing bod du phebs nas gnyen ston gyi mdzad sgo rgya cher spel lo/ /desan/ rgya bza' kong jo yi bsam blo'i rang bzhin rnam pa gsum du

118 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/snang ste/ 1 mgar stong btsan gyis rin chen rgyan gos sogs lag rtags khyer nas rgya'i pho brang du 'byor ba dang btsan pos bris pa'i phyag bris gsum phul ba brgyud nas srong btsan sgam po'i mkhas mdzangs dang blo gros la bsngags brjod byas yod/ 2 mgar stong btsan gyis rgyal khab gzhan gyi pho nya dang blo rtsal 'gran pa bris pa brgyud nas mgar gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i blo rig gi rtsapal/sto/bsngag byarjiyokā/ 3 rgyabaza' kongajo bod rī 'ardor ba spyang //nā bye/ ṭwāṃ zlo/ṭā / / bye/ bye/ ༵ zlo/da nas rgya bod bar 4 ga na 'a4la lngab/ pad ma'od 'bar/rnam thar 'di'i brjod don gtso bo ni yul na kha mu ṇi zhes bya ba na rgyal po log pa'i mchod sbyin zer ba zhig yod pa de'i blon po nor bzang zhes pa gzhung drang zhing las la brtson pa des nor gyis dbul ba'i rgyal po'i khab 'di nyid stobs 'byor mnga' thang ldan pa zhig tu bsgyur bar/ rgyal pos bya dga' gzengs bstod byed rgyu lta bzhag slad rang nyid kyi rgyal gzhis shor bar dogs nas/ nor bzang rgya mtsho'i gling du nor bu len du 'gro dgos zhes btsan shed kyis brdzangs te phyir ldog pa'i skabs med par bzos pa ma zad/de'i bu pad ma 'od 'bar yang pha nor bzang bzhin du bzangs te lnga ba'i lam du skyel ba'i bsam ngan bcoms/ pad ma 'od 'bar gyis rgya mtsho'i gling nas nor bu blangs te phyir log pa ni rgyal po'i bsam yul las 'das pas/ slar yang med par bzo ba'i thabs su lho nub srin po'i yul du gser gyi sla nga dang mchong gi rnga yab len par btang ba'ang bka' bzhin bsgrubs nas phyir log

bod kyi gna' rabs rtsom rig 119'ongs par rgyal po shin tu 'jigs shing thabs kyang zad de mthar bshan pa'i lag tu sprad nas shar ri'i rtse la me mchod du byas te lus po sol ba'i rdul du btangab mkha' 'gro'i mthu nus kyis slar sos par mdzad de/ rgyal po log pa'i mchod sbyin dang / bdud blon de dag gser slang gis mkha' dbyings su btegs nas srin po'i kha nang du 'phangs te/ phyir log pa'i skabs nam yang med par gyur pa de las bsam pa ngan pa gzhan la byas na bya ba tsub po rang la 'khor zer ba'i dpe ltar byung bas/ yul de'i mnga' 'bangs mi ser dang blon po'i tshogs rnams spro ba rab tu 'phel nas pad ma 'od 'bar shar ri'i rtse nas gdan drangs te gser khrir mnga' gsol bas skye bo thams cad sdug bsngal las grol te bde skyid kyi dpal la rol ba'o/ /des na/ pad ma 'od 'bar gyi bsam blo'i rang bzhin ni/ rno ngar ldan lagand du 'khel ba'i sgo nas rgyal po log pa'i mchod sbyin gyi blun po'i ngang tshuladang gdug tsub che ba'i spyod tshul/ dgod bro ba'i bsam sbyor la mtshang 'byin byas nas/ gzhan phan las la brtson pa'i tshong dpon nor bzang gi mdzad rjes dang / nor bzang gi bu pad ma 'od 'bar gyi nus stobs dang blo gros/ rmad byung gzhan phan gyi 'phrin las/ 'dzad med rdo rje'i tshe srog bcas la 'ud bstod rgya cher mdzad de/ sbyir dam pa'i chos la blo kha phyogs nas mchogagasum skyabs su bzung na mi 'grub pa'i bya ba ci yang med la gzhan gyi gnod 'tshe mi thebs pa'i bsam blo rnam par bstan pa de yin no/ /drug pa/ don yod don grub/de yang rgyal bu don yod don grub kyi brjod don gtso bo ni/ sngon rgya

120 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mcho/gar 'phags pa'i yul gyi zangs gling zhes pa'i rgyal po stobs kyi lha dang btsun mo kun bzang ma gnyis la sras shig 'khrungs par don grub ces pa'i mtshan gsol/ rgyal bu don grub dgung lo lnga bzhes skabs yum kun bzang ma tshe las 'das/ de nas rgyal pos padma can zhes pa'i gzhon nu ma zhig btsun mor 〉zhes pa der yang sras shig 'khrungs par mtshan la don yod ces gsol sras don yod kyis chung dus su yum padma can las nu zho bzhes pa tsam du ma gtogs gcen po don grub dang mnyam rtse mnyam 'grogs dang sngas gcig ///gcig byas nas nyin mtshan khor mo yug tu phan tshun kha mi 'bral bar nyin zhig la/ btsun mo padma can gyis gzhan gyi ngag las rgyal bu don grub rgyal por 'os pa'i gtam thos pas rang gi bu don yod rgyal sar 'god pa'i ched du/ rgyal bu don grub med par gtong ba'i sbyor ngan bshams/de'ang thog mar btsun mo padma can gyis rang la snang gzhi drag po byung ba'i tshul bstan te/ sras don grub med par ma btang na rgyal po'i sku tshe dang dbang thang nyams par 'gyur zhing kho mo'i tshe srog la'ang gnod pa 'byung nges par sna/tā ༵ kā/sku//la bu don grub gcan gzan dang 'dre'i yul ko sha zhes pa'i 'on kyang spun mchen gnyis gcig sems gcig la 'brel yod pas/sras don yod kyang gsang stabs kyis don grub kyi rjes su gshegs song / khong gnyis mi med ko sha'i yul gyi lung ba zhig tu phebs pa na/ shin tu skom nas chu btsal kyang ma rnyed pas gcung bo don yod tshe las 'das/ sras don grub ri sna gsum brgal nas bla ma legs pa'i blo gros la mjal/ rgyal bu don grub song shul du/ lha tshangs pa bram ze zhig tu sprul nas don yod la 'chi gsos kyi

bod kyi gna' rabasartsom rig 121sman thum bu zhig bsnams su bcug pas don yod kyi dran pa sos par gyur/bla ma legs pa'i blo gros bzhugs pa'i ri khrod de nas dpas tshad lnga 'das pa'i sa na rgyal khab cig yod pa der char chu dus su ma babs pas mi nad dang phyugs nad/ mu ge tshabs chen byung / de la mo rtsis byas pa la/ byis pa 'brug lo can lo bco brgyad la son pa zhig klu'i rgyal po la mchod par phul na bkra shis lo legs phun sum tshogs par 'gyur ro zhes gsungs/ de nas bdud blon tri shus rgyal bu don grub ni 'brug lo dang lo na bco brgyad yin pa shes te rgyal po'i pho brang du bkugs/ rgyal po'i sras mo lha gcig 'od ldan bya ba de don grub la shin tu chags par gyur/ don grub rgya mtshor 'phen pa'i tshe/klu'i rgyal po rnams don grub kyi snying stobs la ngo mtshar skyes nas don grub phyir mngags pa dang phyin chad klur mchod pa byed mi dgos par byas/ de nas 1zung rgyal khab de/ lo legs byung zhing〉byor drirgya~X pa dang/ na/ ya~Xs /sna ༵ shā // /rgyal ༵ kau chagāl rgya ṭī kā ṭī ༵ dī ṭwāṃ gakā ga rin ldan ma bcun skur denas lo gnyis 'das pa na/ rgyal bu don grub 'khor dang bcas pa sngon rgyal bu don yod sku gshegs pa'i nags khrod der rtse dgar rol du phebs pa'i tshe/ gcung bo don yod dang mjal 'phrad byung / bdud blon tri shu rgyal bu don grub rgyal tshab tu bskos pa la yi ma rangs par gta pa gas zhes pa'i yul gyi jag dmag dang ngan 'brel byas te/ rgyal bu don grub dang g.yul 'gyed par 'ongs/ der rgyal bu don yod kyis dmag drangs te phas kyi rgol ba rnams theg med du bcom/ mthar rgyal bu spun mched gnyis kyis rang yul gyi pha ma dran nas 'khor dang bcas pa zangs gling rgyal khab tu phebs pa dang don yod rgyal khrir mnga' gsol/ de nas bzung / gcen po don grub dang gcung bo don yod gnyis kyis rgyal khab de gnyis chos bzhin du bskyangs so/ /

122 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyusarig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/desan/ rgyal bu don grub dang don yod kyi bsam blo'i rang bzhin ni/rgyal bu don grub dang don yod gnyis kyi mdza' brtse la bsngags brjod dang /khong gnyis kyi las dbang la gdung sems kyi mig chu gtor ba dang chabs cig tu/ btsun mo padma can gyi bsam sbyor ngan pa dang / rang tshugs med pa'i rgyal po stobs kyi lha'i ma rig pa'i mdzad spyod/ bdud blon tri shu'i phrag dog dang g.yo sgyu bcas la zur za dang ther 'dod byas nas/ spyir las rgyu 'bras la brtsi 'jog dang dam pa'i chos la rtun pa skyed na/ da gzod legs tshogs dang phan bde 'byung ba'i gnas lugs zab mo nan gyis bstan pa de red/bdun pa/ 'gro ba bzabamo/'gro ba bzang mo'i rnam thar 'di ni bstan pa phyi dar gyi rjes su bod yul /shā shā /snazlo papa bshā /nga ba'i dmangs khrod gtam rgyud cig gzhir bzung 'gro ba bzang mo yi brjod don gtso bo ni/ mon rta dbang dgon pa dga' ldan rnam rgyal chags sa'i sngar gyi ming rnying ma la sgang bya ba'i yul de na rgyalapo kā la dbang bo zhes bya ba zhig yod/ nyin zhig gi snga dror rgyal po dang blon po 'khor bcas kyis khyi mo khrid de khyi ra la byon zhing / de'i nyin mo ri dgasas sha mang du bzung / nyi ma dgong dro'i mtshams su khyi mo nam mkha'i 'ja' bzhin yal nas gar song cha med du gyur/ de'i nub mo rgyal blon 'bangs bcas ri rtser mal bcas/ phyi nyin nangs par rgyal po'i bka' ltar blon po tri na 'dzin song ste khyi mo'i rjes 'dra e 'dug bltas tsa na/ shar phyogs kyi nags gseb stug po zhig gi khrod na khang khyim bkod pa legs pa zhig

bod kyi gna' rabasartsom rig 123'dug pa de na khyi mo yod pa 'dra zhes snyan du gsol bas/ rgyal blon 'khor bcas nags khrod kyi khang khyim de'i sgo drung du phebs/ de ru 'gro ba bzang mo zhes pa'i bu mo na so dar la babs pa/ bltas na gzugs mdzes pa zhig yod pa gzigs nas rgyal pos yab yum bram ze rgan gon gnyis la bu mo 'di nga yi btsun mor bsu ba yin zhes bsu ba gzab rgyas kyis ma la sgang du gdan drangs/ de nas 'gro ba bzang mor sras mo gcig dang sras gcig 'khrungs/yumasras gsum po gzim chung sgrol ma lha khang du bzhugs/ de nas re zhig song ba'i tshe/ sngon rgyal po kā la dbang bo la btsun mo ha cang zer ba zhig yod pades yum sras gsum por gnod 'tshe bar chad byas pas 'gro ba bzang mo nam mkha'i mthongs la 'phur/ yab rgyal po kā la dbang bor smyo chu drangs te btson tu bcug gdug tsub chen pos lcam sring gnyis po thengs gsum tsam labakrongs rtsis byas med 'grub rgyu lta ci/ mi ring bar lha sras rgyal bu padma can gyi rgyal por mnga' gsol/ lcam sring gnyis yun ring kha bral ba slar yang mjal zhing padma can gyi rgyal srid bskyangs/ de rnams ha cang bdud mos tshor te dmag 'bum tsho gcig padma can du drangs/ de'i gdong len du lha sras rgyal bus dmag khri tsho gsum gyi ru sna mdzad de ha cang bdud mo ming gi lhag ma tsam ma lus par theg med du btang / yab kā la dbang bo mun pa'i btson nas bton te pho brang du gdan drangs/ drin che ba'i shan pa gan gzhon dang nya ba rgan gzhon la gzigs bzos gya nom pa gnang zhing rgyal gzhis gnyis kyi nang blon du bskos/ yab sras gnyis kyis rgyal srid chos bzhin bskyangs/ de nas /pa :spya ḍi patārsha :khor thams cad bde zhing skyid pa dang dga' spro'i dpal des na/ 'gro ba bzang mo yi bsam blo'i rang bzhin ni/ mkha' 'gro ma 'gro ba bzang mo'i sras mo kun tu bzang mo dang lha sras kun tu legs pa

124 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyusarig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/gnyis la/ phrag dog dang zhe sdang gis myos pa'i bdud mo ha cang gis thabs brgya jus stong gis thengs mang bor gnod 'tshe gtong bar brtsams na'ang /lha sras ming sring gnyis kyi tshe srog la gnod 'tshe ci yang ma thebs par/mthar rgyal khrir bzhugs pa la bstod bsngags mdzad nas/ bdud mo ha cang gi bsam sbyor ngan pa dang ham sems chen po la mtshang 'byin dgag rgyag nan mo byas la/ mkha' 'gro ma 'gro ba bzang mo'i khyad 'phags mdzad spyod dang ngo mtshar rdzu 'phrul la tshad mthon po'i sgo nas 'ud bstod mdzad pa de red/brgyad pa/ snang sa'od 'bum/de yang snang sa 'od 'bum gyi rnam thar gyi brjod don mdor bsdus ni/gtsangagi ya gyal myang stod rgyal rtse yul ljongs zhes bya ba na kun bzang bde chen dang myang tsha gsal sgron zhes pa'i khyo shug gnyis mchis pa dang / de gnyis kyis rgyun du sgrol ma'i bstod pa chags pa med par bton zhing bzhugs /sbya shā gā sdo dro/shā /lha ༵ mo khyad par du 'phags pa zhig skyes pa'i mtshan la sku byad mdzes shing thugs rgyud zhi zhing dul ba'i bu mo snang sa 'od 'bum 'jig rten gyi bya ba g.yos spyor dang / snam bu 'thag las/ zhing las sogs la mkhas pas sa phyogs der kho mo'i snyan grags kyis khyab/ der brten/gnyen slong mkhan gang pang sding yang snang sa chos sgor zhugs 'dod kyi bsam pa brta/ /sdu zlo/ ༵ /bye ༵ wa dbapa gyur / son pa'i lo la gnas snying gzungs drugagi ltad mor blta bar phebs pa'i tshe/ rgyal rtse ri nang dpon po sgra chen

124 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyusarig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/gnyis la/ phrag dog dang zhe sdang gis myos pa'i bdud mo ha cang gis thabs brgya jus stong gis thengs mang bor gnod 'tshe gtong bar brtsams na'ang /lha sras ming sring gnyis kyi tshe srog la gnod 'tshe ci yang ma thebs par/mthar rgyal khrir bzhugs pa la bstod bsngags mdzad nas/ bdud mo ha cang gi bsam sbyor ngan pa dang ham sems chen po la mtshang 'byin dgag rgyag nan mo byas la/ mkha' 'gro ma 'gro ba bzang mo'i khyad 'phags mdzad spyod dang ngo mtshar rdzu 'phrul la tshad mthon po'i sgo nas 'ud bstod mdzad pa de red/brgyad pa/ snang sa'od 'bum/de yang snang sa 'od 'bum gyi rnam thar gyi brjod don mdor bsdus ni/gtsangagi ya gyal myang stod rgyal rtse yul ljongs zhes bya ba na kun bzang bde chen dang myang tsha gsal sgron zhes pa'i khyo shug gnyis mchis pa dang / de gnyis kyis rgyun du sgrol ma'i bstod pa chags pa med par bton zhing bzhugs /sbya shā gā sdo dro/shā /lha ༵ mo khyad par du 'phags pa zhig skyes pa'i mtshan la sku byad mdzes shing thugs rgyud zhi zhing dul ba'i bu mo snang sa 'od 'bum 'jig rten gyi bya ba g.yos spyor dang / snam bu 'thag las/ zhing las sogs la mkhas pas sa phyogs der kho mo'i snyan grags kyis khyab/ der brten/gnyen slong mkhan gang pang sding yang snang sa chos sgor zhugs 'dod kyi bsam pa brta/ /sdu zlo/ ༵ /bye ༵ wa dbapa gyur / son pa'i lo la gnas snying gzungs drugagi ltad mor blta bar phebs pa'i tshe/ rgyal rtse ri nang dpon po sgra chen

bod kyi gna' rabasartsom rig 125gyis mthong nas/ bu mo snang sa de rang gi bu grags pa bsam 'grub kyi chung ma byed dgos zhes btsan dbang bkol nas gnyen rtags kyi mda' dar btsugs pas/ nyam thag gnyom chung gi tshul du gnas pa'i yab yum gnyis kyis bu mo gcig pu ri nang dpon po tshang la mna' mar mi ster thabs med byung /snang sa ri nang dpon po tshang la 'byor nas lo ngo bdun song ba'i ring la/rgan pa dang bdag po rnams la zhabs zhu gang legs bsgrubs/ 'khor g.yog dang mnga' 'bangs kun la nye ring med par mthun par 'grogs/ lag las kwa'i phyogs la 'bad pa lhod med mdzad par brten/ ri nang dpon g.yog thams cad kyis kho morang bsngags /rjo/ mdzad pa dang bang mdzod kyi lde mig thams // :dro snakā kṣiṃ kta/ zlo ṅge py-i /sna hā ṭwāṃ/sa bang mdzod kyi lde mig sogs kyi dbang cha snang sa'i lag tu shor bar phrag dog gis snang sa dang dpon po sgra chenayab sras kyi bar la dbyen dang phra ma mang du sbyar te/ snang sas gcar rdung thengs mang myong dgos par byas shing / mthar gdug tsub can gyi dpon sras de gnyis kyis gcar rdung tshad med kyis snang sa phyi ma'i yul du bskyal/snang sa'i rnam shes srid pa bar dor 'khyams pa dang / de nas gshin rje chos rgyal gyi mdun du phyin/ gshin rje chos rgyal gyis snang sa 'od 'bum ni rigs bzang gi mkha' 'gro ma zhig yin pa mkhyen nas mtho ris dang thar ba'i lam sna drangs pas/ snang sa'i rnam shes de slar yang rang gi sku gdung la zhugs nas dran pa sos par gyur la/ 'das log byung ba'i snang sa 'od 'bum 'jig rten 'khorabar nges 'byung drag po skyes te bla ma bzang bo shākya rgyal mtshan bsten nas rab tu byung zhing dam pa'i chos don du gnyer bar mdzad/ri nang dpon po sgra chen yab sras kyis snang sa 'od 'bum dgon pa skyid po g.ya' lung du rab tu byung ba'i gnas tshul thos 'phral drag po'i sbyor ba yis

126 bon kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/phyir 'phrog rtsis byas mod/ bla ma shākya rgyal mtshan gyi rdzu 'phrul dang / snang sa 'od 'bum gyi spub rtags la ha las shing ngo mtshar skyes nas/ sngon byas kyi bya spyod ngan pa la 'gyod bshags byas pa dang / mjug mthar/ ri nang dpon po sgra chen yab sras kyis snang sa 'od 'bum gyi zhal gsung ltar dben pa'i ri khrod 'grims nas dam pa'i chos la blo kha phyogs pa'o/ /desan/ snang sa 'od 'bum gyi bsam blo'i rang bzhin ni/ chung ngu'i dus nas dam pa'i chos la mos shing ya rabs lam du gzhol ba'i snang sa 'od 'bum gyis ri nang dpon po sgra chen yab sras kyi gcar rdung tshad med pa myangs pa dang / kho mor dam pa'i chos sgrub pa dang gzhan phan las la zhugs par rang dbang med pa'i gnas tshul der gdung sems bcangs pa dang / kho mo chags sdang rmongs gsum las grub pa'i 'jig rten 'khor ba'am ri nang dpon po sgra chen pa yab sras kyi btsan dbang dang gtum spyod kyi mdun du dpa' ma zhum blo ma pham par/ tshe gcig lus gcig la dam pa'i chos rma med pa zhig bsgrub rgyu'i mi 'gyur dam bca'i ri mo snying la bkod de khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung ste gzhi nas dam pa'i chos la gzhol ba'i ngo mtshar mdzad spyod dang phul byung snying stobs la bsngags brjod dang mos gus tshad med mdzad pa brgyud de/ gangs can bod kyi las la brtson zhing byams brtse ldan la dam chos la mos pa'i bud med ngal rtsol ba'i las dbang ngam snang brnyan la gdung sems bcangs yod la bsngags brjod kyang mdzad pa red/ khyad par du/ ri nang dpon po sgra chen pa yab sras kyi bya spyod ngan pas mtshon pa'i /nākā sngu kārji spyashā kārdokā yod spyi tshogs khrod kyi ngan rul gyi rnam pa gsal rjen spyir lha mo'i zlos gar 'di dag gi spyi'i brjod don ni 'jig rten mi chos dngabastun nas mi rnams dam pa'i lha chos la skul ma btang ba ste/ 'gro ba

bon kyi gna' rabasartsom rig 127bzang mo dang / rgyal sras don yod don grub/ snang sa 'od 'bum/ bram ze bu mo gzugs kyi nyi ma/ chos rgyal nor bzang / dri med kun ldan/ padma 'od 'bar sogs gtam rgyud 'di dag gi nang du/ dge sdig dang dkar nag gi shed shugs 'gran pa na/ re zhig dkar phyogs pham na'ang / mthar mthug dkar phyogs nag phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i bsam blo mtshon yod/gong gsal lha mo'i zlos gar brgyad kyi rtsom stangs kyi khyad chos kyang phal cher 'dra ste/ rtsom lus bcad lhug spel mar spyad pa dang go rim gsal zhing 'go mjug tshang ba/ byung rim rnyog 'dzing med pas go bde ba/ 'char yan shā / /zlo trī / nob/ skad cha brjod bde zhing gson nyams ldan pa bcas kyi

128 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyusarig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/don tshan drug pa/ bod 'gyur rtsom rigadang po/ skye bo gsathigs/lugs kyi bstan bcos skye bo gso ba'i thigs pa zhes bya ba 'di'i rtsom pa po ni rgya gar gyi slob dpon chen mo klu sgrub yin la/ khong ni 'dzam gling mdzes pa'i rgyan drug gi ya rgyal te/ ston pa thub pa'i dbang bo mya ngan las 'das nas lo bzhi brgya'i thog rgya gar lho phyogs be darbha'i yul du bram ze zhig gi khyim du 'khrungs/ dgung lo chung ngu'i dus nas gsang ba sngags kyi rgyud sde bzhi dang / sde snod gsum sogs thun mong dang thun min gyi rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag la mkhas par sbyangs/ dpal na lersha'i gtsug lag khang du grub chen sa ra ha pa'i sku mdun du rab tu byung / mtshan dge slong dpal ldan du grags/mtha' bral dbu ma rigs tshogs drug dang / rgyud kun las btus pa sogs stobs bcu mnga' ba'i dgongs don gsal bar byed pa'i bstan bcos kyi rgyal po mang du bsgrun/ khyad par du gso ba rig pa'i skor la 'tsho ba'i mdo tshigs su bcad pa/ rtswa a wa'i cho ga sman rin po che'i rim pa/ dngul chu'i sbyor ba rin chen phreng ba/ lhog pa spun bzhi'i gnyan bcos sogs bstan bcos shin tu mang / 'phags pa lha sogs slob ma nyi rdul ltar bskyangs/mchod rten dang lha khang mang bo btab/ rdo rje gdan la dra mig gi ra bas bskor/ lho phyogs dpal ldan 'bras srungs kyi bkod pa bzhengs/ spyi'i lugs la dgong lo drug brgya dang / snga 'gyur ltar na dgung lo chig stong bar

bod kyi gna' rab rtsom rig 129bzhuga~X // // sdo ṭwāṃ ṭwāṃ bye/ zlo/ / /pa/ mkhan ni rgya gar gyi mkhan po shī lenda bornyi dang lo tsā bande ye shes sde gnyis yin zhing / dus rabs brgyad pa'i dkyil shāX ñdza ṭwāṃ rdorsha lde btsan gyi skabs su bsgyur nas gtan la phab ste bstan 'gyur bye ༵ /bye bye/shā /kyi brjod don ni/ 'jig rten gyi skye bo spyi la mi chos tshul ldan gyi kun spyod bslab bya gtong ba'i brjod bya gtso bor bzung ba ste/don ldan dngos snang gi dpe mtshon ci rigs drangs te shugs don zab mo'i sgo nasaskye 'gro kun la lus ngag yid gsum drang zhing / lta spyod don la gnas sna/ tram̐ sdu/ / sdo sdu/ po rnam dag tshul ldan zhig byed dgos pa'i bslab bya bstan bcos 'dir khyon bsdoms sho lo ka gya drug yod pa las/ dang po dang gnyis pa ni mchod brjod dang rtsom par dam bca' ba yin zhing / ches shā ṭwāṃ sdu tā shā rnyi zlo/ dro/ ṭwāṃ lo ka yin la gzhan rnams nang don gyi cha nas dbye gcig nga rgyal med pa'i sgo nas rig pa'i gnas la 'bad dgos shing /lus ngag yid gsum tshul dang ldan par byed dgos pa'i skor bstan pa(sho lo ka gsum pa nas zhe gnyis bar)/ dper na/yon tan dag la 'bad bya yi/ /'gying tshul dgos pa ci zhig yod/ /'o ma medus ༷je gyur pa'i ba/ /dril bu btags kyang nyor mi 'don/ /mi gang sems ni mi rgod cing / /byas pa gzo dang byas pa tshor/ /byas pa chud snazlo/ /ma byed pa/ /de dag mkhas pas rab tu bsngags/ /

bod kyi gna' rab rtsom rig 129bzhuga~X // // sdo ṭwāṃ ṭwāṃ bye/ zlo/ / /pa/ mkhan ni rgya gar gyi mkhan po shī lenda bornyi dang lo tsā bande ye shes sde gnyis yin zhing / dus rabs brgyad pa'i dkyil shāX ñdza ṭwāṃ rdorsha lde btsan gyi skabs su bsgyur nas gtan la phab ste bstan 'gyur bye ༵ /bye bye/shā /kyi brjod don ni/ 'jig rten gyi skye bo spyi la mi chos tshul ldan gyi kun spyod bslab bya gtong ba'i brjod bya gtso bor bzung ba ste/don ldan dngos snang gi dpe mtshon ci rigs drangs te shugs don zab mo'i sgo nasaskye 'gro kun la lus ngag yid gsum drang zhing / lta spyod don la gnas sna/ tram̐ sdu/ / sdo sdu/ po rnam dag tshul ldan zhig byed dgos pa'i bslab bya bstan bcos 'dir khyon bsdoms sho lo ka gya drug yod pa las/ dang po dang gnyis pa ni mchod brjod dang rtsom par dam bca' ba yin zhing / ches shā ṭwāṃ sdu tā shā rnyi zlo/ dro/ ṭwāṃ lo ka yin la gzhan rnams nang don gyi cha nas dbye gcig nga rgyal med pa'i sgo nas rig pa'i gnas la 'bad dgos shing /lus ngag yid gsum tshul dang ldan par byed dgos pa'i skor bstan pa(sho lo ka gsum pa nas zhe gnyis bar)/ dper na/yon tan dag la 'bad bya yi/ /'gying tshul dgos pa ci zhig yod/ /'o ma medus ༷je gyur pa'i ba/ /dril bu btags kyang nyor mi 'don/ /mi gang sems ni mi rgod cing / /byas pa gzo dang byas pa tshor/ /byas pa chud snazlo/ /ma byed pa/ /de dag mkhas pas rab tu bsngags/ /

130 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/ya rabs tshul med khengs pas nga rgyal shin tu che/ /g.yo sgyu dad med khā bzhin shin tu mu cor smra/ / gzu lum phrag dog rkam dang khrel med ngo tsha bral/ zhe/tram̐ bye /shā gyur kyang ni gzhan bzhin spang bar bya/ /ji gaspras/ dosdudageba'/ sdig pa'i las spangs napa las dbras mi bsru ba |/ ṭā ka :sna //shā sna sad dro lnga/ba sdi/ nya/dro sdo nadan da sa pa'i skor bstan parang lus dag la tsher ma yis/ /rtse mo'ang bzod par mi 'gyur na/ /gzhan spra /sdu sdo /tshon dag gis/ /srog dang bral ba ci'i phyir bzod/ /yo byad ldan la ser snas bcings/ / bslangs na khro ba dang bcas pa/ /sna/ //sdu chen pos non gyur te/ /shu ma ri yi mi sdug bzhin/ /'gyod pa med ni sbyin pa'i tshul/ /tshul khrims tshul ni ma bcos pa/ /bzod pa'i tshul ni chos nyid shes/ / brtson 'grus tshul ni 'chi ba dran/ //sdum gtan tshul ni g.yeng ba med/ / rnam par 'byed shes shes rab /sna/ // /po/ na/ klu sgrub mchog la lugs kyi bstan bcos shes rab sdong bu dang shes rab brgya ba zhes pa'ang yod mod brjod don dang rtsom stangs phal cher 'dra mtshungs yin pas 'dir ma bkod do/ /

bod kyi gna' rabs rtsom rig 131gnyisapa/ khyad par 'phagasabastod dang lhalasaphulabyung /sngon rgya gar shar phyogs na khyad par can gyi bram ze las drug la mngon par dga' ba'i bram ze'i rigs su byung ba/ sngon legs par spyad pa nye bar brtsams pa las mtho btsun grub rje zhes bya ba dang / bde byed bdag po zhes bya ba spun gnyis su skyes par gyur to/ /de gnyis kyis bstan bcos thams cad rtogs par gyur pa dang / de'i tshe de gnyis 'di snyam du sems par gyur te/ 'di ltar bdag cag gi khyim na ni dbang phyug chen po mchod la/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi gsung rab shin tu phul du byung ba'ang bzhugs na/yang snying dbang phyug chen po khyad par du 'phags pa yin nam/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das khyad par du 'phags pa yin nges par brtag par bya'o snyam pa dang / de gnyis kyis/ ri bo ti se na dbang phyug chen po lha mo u ma dang khyu mchog dang bcas par mngon sum du gnas so zhes thos pas/ der song nas dbang phyug chen pos yu bu cag la ji ltar bstan pa de ltar bya'o zhes nges pa bskyed nas/ der myur bar song ste 'bad pa chen po byas pa dang lha rnams kyis grogs byas te/ ri bo ti se'i sa la mnyam par song ba dang / lha chen po'i khyu mchog sprin dkar bo'i dum bu lta bu gzan la yan pa mthong ngo /de mthong bas rab tu dga' ba dang / de'i rjes thogs nyid la lha mo u mas 'bras bu'i shing gi tshang tshing gi nags na shing tog 'thu ba mthong nas/ gus pas phyag byas te gtam dris pa las/ lha chen dbang phyug me tog rgyas pa'i nags tshal na gnas so zhes thos pa dang / yid rab tu dga' nas song ba na/lha chen po dbang phyug 'byor ba chen po dang ldan pa'i stan la bzhugs shing /

132 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/'khor gyi tshogs stong gis bskor ba mthong ngo / / de la tshogs kyi bdag pos nye bar khrid nas lha chen po'i mdun du song ba dang / lha chen pos de gnyis la /pa ༵/sa ṭwāṃ/da cag gang nas 'ongs zhes dris pa dang / de gnyis kyis rgyas denas ji tsam na dge slong rnams kyis zas gsol ba'i dus la nye bar gyur pa na/ ma dros pa'i mtsho la gnas pa'i dgra bcom pa lnga brgya bya gshog pa dmar bo dngar ba lta bur byon par gyur to/ / de nas lha chen po 'khor gyi tshogs dang bcas pas gus pa dang bcas par spos dang / byug pa dang /mchod pa'i yo byad rnams thogs te/ de dag gi thad du song nas de dag rang rang gi stan la bzhugs pa la re re bzhin gos rin po che bskon te bde bar 'dug pa dang / bza' ba dang / bca' ba rnams tshim par gsol ba na/ lha //mam kā snakā sdi // tāzlo ga/sa/'bras bus mchod de/ de dag las chos kyi dge slong rnams slar phebs pa dang / de gnyis la smras pa/ khyod cag rnyi/ra bya ba gang gi phyir 'ongs pa kho bos shes kyi/ de khyod gnyis la smra bar gang gi slob ma bdag cag nyin re dga' bas mchod byed yon tan dam par ldan/ 'jig rten nyes sel yon tan chen po'i mtshan gyi mchog ni rab tu grags gyur cing / /shin tu dga' ba'i yid kyis yang dag mchod byed tshe na mya hā// /pa ji nni kā /sdu kā/sa /mchi/ga/ rten gsum gyi bla ma yon tan mnyam med de bas na khyod cag gis ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dang /de'i gsung rab la mchod par gyis shig ces gsungs so/ /de nas mtho btsun grub rje dang bde byed bdag po gnyis kyis de ltar

bod kyi gna' rabasartsom rig 133rtogs par gyur nas slar rang gi yul du log ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung rab kha na ma tho ba med pa yin par mkhyen pas rig byed kyi tshig rnams rtswa ltar bor te rab tu byung nas/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la mtho btsun grub rjes khyad par du 'phags pa'i bstod pa dang / bde byed bdag pos lha las phul du byung ba'i bstod pa gnyis legs par brtsams pa'o/ /bstod pa'i snyan ngag 'di gnyis gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir rgya gar gyi mkhan po sarba dzñā de wa dang lo tsā ba ban de rin chen mchog gis bsgyur ba dang /tāshā kyis ban de dpal brtsegs rakṣi tas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab khyad par du 'phags pa'i bstod pa 'di'i 'grel ba ni slob dpon shes rab go chas mdzad pa yin yang / bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa bcu gnyis kyi 'grel ba'i rgya dpe ma rnyed nas/ dus phyis shākya'i dge slong kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang bo zhes bya bas dpal sa skya'i dgon par sbyar bdang / lha las phul du byung ba'i bstod pa 'di'i 'grel ba ni slob dpon shes rab go chas mdzad pa dang / dus gyis rgya gar gyi mkhan po thar na da na'i /lta / ༵ ṭā bzhu pa shān gyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang bos bsgyur cing jo /cig dokhyad par du 'phags pa'i bstod pa dang lha las phul byung gi ba da rtsordo / bye kā trī sta/zlo / grub rje yis khyad par du 'phags pa'i bstod pa mgo bcoms ma thag tu/ bdag ni ston pa gzhan spangs nas/ / bcom ldan khyod la skyabs mchis pa/ / de'i ci'i slad du zhe na khyod/ /skyon mi mnga' la yon tan ldan/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la skyon mi mnga' bar yon tan ldan phyir/ rtsom pa po mtho btsun grub rje dang

134 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/bde byed bdag po gnyis kyis skyon dang ldan pa'i ston pa gzhan thams cad ring du spangs nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la mos gus dang dad pa chen pos bstod pa'i snyan ngag de gnyis 'di ltar bcoms pa red/ dper na/lha chen khros pa'i mda' gcig gis/ /grong khyer sum brtsegs bsregs zhes gda'/ /khyod kyi ye shes mda' chen gyis/ /khro ba'i sems nyid nges par bsregs/ /sngon lha chen po dbang phyug gi yon tan 'jig rten du sgrogs shing ston pa na/ lha ma yin gyi grong khyer sum brtsegs sheg nam mkha' la rgyu ba zhig byung ba dang / de las lha ma yin rnams babs nas 'dzam bu gling gi mi rnams la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed do/ / de nas lha chen po dbang phyug gis mi rnams skyob pa'i phyir/ gzhu blangs te 'phrul gyi mda' gcig 'phangs nas lha ma yin gyi grong khyer sum brtsegs nam mkha' ru rgyu ba de bsregs par mdzad do/ /'on te sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das khyed nyid de las ldog ste/ bla na med pa'i ye shes kyi mda' chen pos 'gro ba'i rgyud kyi nyon mongs dug gsum las zhe sdang gi dbang du gyur pa'i khro ba'i sems pa de nyid nges par bsregs nas med par mdzad pa yin no zhes/ khro ba'i dbang du gyur pa'i lha chen dbang phyug gis mda' 'phangs nas lha ma yin gyi grong khyer sum brtsegs bsregs te/sdig pa bsags shing dmyal bar lhung ba'i las bsgrubs pa de ther 'don byas nas/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi bla na med pa'i ye shes kyis 'gro ba'i rgyud na tshang mal bca' ba'i nyon mongs kyi dug sbrul thal bar bsregs pa'i mdzad pa la bstod bsngags mdzad pa dang /

bod kyi gna' rabs rtsom rig 135spra // ༵ ṭwāṃ tram̐ /rdo sna /sna ba/zhi/ byung / //sdo/ spra rnyi sbyapa chi pa yis/ /sngon sun dha dang / mu pa sun dha zhes bya ba lha ma yin spun gnyis byung ba dang / de gnyis kyis tshangs pa bsgrubs te/ 'jig rten gsum gyis ma sod par gyur pa dang / bdag cag lus tsam tha dad kyi/ sems ni de lta ma yin par tha dad pa med par mdzod cig ces smras pa dang / tshangs pas kyang mchog byin no/ /de nas de gnyis kyis khams gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i byab la zhugs par gyur pa dang / tshangs pas smras pa/ de dag gcig gis gcig gsod pa'i thabs bsgrubs par bya'o zhes smras pa dang / lha rnams kyis rang gi lus las 'od til 'bru tsam byin nas/ /de las thig le mchog ma zhes bya ba'i lha'i bu mo mdzes sdug dpal gyis rnam par sgeg pa zhig bskyed nas/de yang tshangs pa la bskor ba byed du bcug pa dang / tshangs pa de'i byad gzugs la yid rab tu chags par gyur nas mgo bo gdugs ltar 'khor nas ltab na/ ngo tsha bar gyur pas gdong bzhi sprul nas der bltas so/ / 'on kyang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das khyod la/ bdud kyi bu mos sgeg pa ste dgod cing smra ba dang / gar byed pa sogs byas pas kyang / khyod kyi lus kyi ba spu'i rtse mo tsam yang mi g.yo bar gnas pa yin no zhes lha chen tshangs pa'i 'dod chags la zur za byas nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi mi 'gyur brtan brling gi dgongs pa la bsngags brjod mdzad pa dang /khyashā 'jug spra'u /kā gzugs bsgyur nas/ //sdo ṭwāṃ rshakā byeX bye bye/ trī /nā bslus/ /gzhan dag la yang bsku mi mdzad/ /

136 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/sngon stobs ldan zhes bya ba'i lha ma yin zhig byung ba dang / des khams gsum ma lus pa rnam par gnon pa na khyab 'jug gis bsam pa/ ngas 'di dang g.yul sprad na rgyal bar mi nus phyir/ nges par sgyu thabs kyis bsku bar bya'o snyam nas bram ze mi'u thung zhig gi gzugs su sprul nas song ba na/ lha ma yin gyi rgyal po stobs ldan des rta'i mchod sbyin byed pa dang / gang zhig 'dod/ gang la ci zhig sbyin par bya zhes zer ba de'i thad du phyin nas/ rgyal po lags bdag gi pha mes la mchod sbyin byed pas de'i don du sa gom pa nyid kyi tshad sbyin par mdzod ces smras pa dang / lha ma yin stobs ldan gyis smras pa/'di tsam zhig gis khyod la dgos pa ci zhig rdzogs par 'gyur/ gzhan du na glang bo dang / rta dang / shing rta dang / gser la sogs pa'i dngos po slongs shig dang / ngas sbyin par bya'o zhes smras kyang 'dod par ma gyur to/ / de nas stobs ldan gyis smras pa/ gal te de ltar 'dod na re zhig gom pa gsum yang khyer cig ces smras pa dang / khyab 'jug gis lus bskyed de gom pa gnyis kyis 'jig rten gsum brgal ba dang / gom pa gsum pa 'jog pa'i gnas ma rnyed par lha ma yin stobs ldan gyi mgo la bzhag nas sa 'og tu bcings par gyur to/ / 'on kyang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das khyod ni thams cad mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ kun nas nyon mongs dang / nyon mongs pa can ma yin pa'i dngos po thams cad mkhyen cing / nyon mongs pa can gang yin pa de ni spyod par mi mdzad pas na/ khyod kyis gzhan thams cad kyi g.yosgyu'ang kun nas mkhyen la/ khyod nyid kyis gzhan thams cad bslu brid kyang mi mdzad do zhes/ khyab 'jug gis g.yo sgyu bkol nas lha ma yin stobs ldanā sa 'og tu bcittas pa'i spyad tshupa de /rdong 'byin byas naX/ sangs rgyas pa/sna/ /shād /dza ṅge ṭā / nga /gad pa ma na pa dang lhag pa' bsam pa la

bod kyi gna' rabs rtsom rig 137bsdi byin gyis / bshol dzodamazhi/ ///shā // ḍi// ༵/ sdorshakā was grags/ /ma rmongs slad du btsun mo btang / /de yang 'di ltar thos te/ drang srong gita ma zhes bya ba zhig yod pa der bshol med ma zhes bya ba'i chung ma zhig yod pa de lang tsho'i mdangs yid du 'ongs pa zhig yin pas/ de la lha'i dbang bo brgya byin chags par gyur la/bshol med ma yang brgya byin la chags te/ de gnyis phan tshun 'brel bar gyur rto/ / nyin zhig drang srong gita ma dang bshol med ma gnyis drang srong gzhan zhigagi khyim du mgron la bos pas/ drang srong go ta ma legs skyes su 'bul ba'i me tog dang / yam shing / ka sha'i don du phyi rol du song ba'i shul du/brgya byin yang der 'ongs nas bshol med ma dang mngon par rol zhing 'dug pa'i tshe/ gota ma slobs byung ba dang brgya byin bshol med ma'i mngal du zhugs so/ /de nas gita mas chung ma bshol med ma nye bar khrid nas mgron du song ba na/ drang srong des rnal 'byor gyi stobs kyis ji ltar gyur pa rnams mkhyen par gyur te/ stan gsum btings so/ /de la gita mas bsam pa/ ci'i phyir stan gsum btings pa yin nam snyam nas brtag pa dang bshol med ma'i khog na brgya byin mchis pa mkhyen nas ngo tsha bar gyur pa dang / zas la spyad rjes skyen par rang gnas su song ste/ bshol med ma la da lta nyid du brgya byin tsugs shig ces smras pa dang / des kyang skyugs so/ / de nas drang srong gota mas/ khyod 'di ltar mo mtshan la dga' zhing chags na/ da nas bzung khyod kyi lus stong du mo mtshan stong gi mtshan par gyur cig ces dmod pa btab pa dang de ltar gyur pas/ lha rnams 'ongs te gita ma dga' zhing mgu bar byas shing / mo mtshan stong du snang ba 'di 'dren byed stong du gyur cig ces mchog
