138 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyusarig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/byin pas mig stong du gyur pa dang / rgyu mtshan 'di la brten nas mngon brjod du brgya byin gyi ming la mig stong can yang zer ro/ /thon te sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das lha khyab 'jug las ldog ste/ 'dod pa rnam par bcom pa'i phyir sngon rgyal khab na bzhugs pa'i skabs su'ang 'dod pa nyid kyis rmongs par gyur pa'i skabs med do/ /ci'i phyir zhe na/ ma rmongs pa'i phyir na btsun mo grags ldan ma dang / ri dwags skyes dang / sa mtsho ma la sogs pa'i btsun mo'i 'khor stong phrag drug cu thal ba bzhin du btang zhing yongs su spangs pa yin no zhes/ lha'i dbang bo brgya byin gyi chags pa'i rmongs pa la zur za byas /lda/nga /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi snying stobs la bsngags brjod mdzad mchod sbyin la ni byugs 'gums par/ /drang srong rnams ni smra zhes grags/ /sdig med khyod kyis grog ma la'ang / /gnod pa bgyid par rjes ma gnang / /mchod cing sbyin par byed pa la ba lang dang rta la sogs pa bsad nas sbyin sreg byed dgos zhes drang srong gzags gzan la sogs pas smra bar grags kyang / kun nas sdig pa dang bral ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das khyod kyis gzhan la smos ci dgos/ tha na srog chags ches phra mo grog ma la'ang gnod pa bgyid pa'i lo rgyus rjes su thos rgyu med do zhes/ sdig las la gzhol nas chos su sems pa'i drang srong gzegs gzan la sogs pa'i bstan pa la rnam par dgag nas/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi kun nas sdig pa bral ba'i chos lugs la mos gus mdzad pa dang /

bod kyi gna' rabs rtsom rig 139sprar skyas bdag gi mtshan nyid ni/ //sdo byedro sdo trī ༵ /rno / pa//sa/ /mi rtag nyid dang ldan zhes bstan/ /de yang bskal ba dang po'i tshe ser skya zhes bya ba'i drang srong zhig byung ste/des grangs can gyi bstan bcos rtsom pa yin la/ de'i slob mar yang ser skya ba bya'o/ /ser skyas skyes bu'i mtshan nyid ni shes pa'i ngo bo nyid du yongs su brtags pas/ shes pa dang ldan pa skyes bu rang gi ngo bor rtogs pa zhes skyes bu ni sems dang ldan pa dang / rtag pa nyid yin par khas 'che pa yin/ 'on te sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das khyod kyis/ de ltar khas blangs par gyur na bdag de mi rtag pa dang / mi brtan pa dang / skad cig mar 'jig pa nyid du thal bar 'gyur ro zhes bstan to/ /ci'i phyir zhe na/ dang por mig gi dbang bos gzugs shes par 'gyur ba na/ gal te shes pa'i gzugs can dang rtag pa yin na dus rtag tu yul gzugs shes pa nyid du 'gyur la/ de bas sgra la sogs pa la 'on pa dang lkugs pa dang 'dra bar 'gyur na/ 'jig rten na 'di lta bu mi snang ngo/ / yang na dbang bo gzhan dag gis gzugs shes par 'gyuran/ yang lan 'ga' sgra la sogs pa gzhan dag gis shes par 'gyur bas 'di ni shes pa dang ldan par 'gyur te/ rnam par 'gyur ba la sogs pa'i nyes pa yod par thal lo zhes/ drang srong ser skya'i lugs la dgag nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i rang lugs 'thad ldan du bzhag pa dang /gzegs zan gyis ni ༷sa las bkāg //sdo spya hārsha pa/ kā kā /rdos su bdad/ /shing dang 'dra bar thal 'gyur gsungs/ /

140 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/deyang 'di ltar drang srong chen po gzegs zan zhes bya ba bye brag pa'i bstan bcos rtsom pa po des 'di snyam du sems te/ gal te bdag rtogs pa'i rang bzhin can yin na ni mi rtag par thal bar 'gyur la/ bdag ni rtag pa nyid du khas blangs dgos so/ /de bas na bdag ni shes pa'i gzugs can ma yin gyi/ shes pa ni rtogs pa'i bdag nyid can yin te/ des kyang yul la nye bar spyad nas yul gyi gzugs brnyan gyis skyes bur nye bar gnas la/ de yang khyab pa dang rtag pa yin pas 'dir nyes pa 'ga' yang med do zhes zor ro/ /'on te sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das khyod kyis/ gal te de ltar yin na de shes pa med pas shing dang 'dra bar thal bar 'gyur ro zhes gsungs/ ci'i phyir zhe na/ gal te de bdag gis cung zad kyang mi shes na/ rtswa dang shing la sogs pas kyang cung zad kyang mi shes la/ de ltar yin na ni rtswa dang shing la sogs pa dang / bdag 'di yin no zhes phan tshun gcig gi khyad par 'ga' yang yod par mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes lung dang rigs pas gzhan lugs dgag pa dang ya/nga/dī sdigashā 'azlo /na du bzhag pa'o/ /dā yi 'asdo ༵ gasdod bye /'di nyid bsrung bya 'di/ /gsad bya zhes pa lha yi mchog gi gzhung lugs yin/ / sangs rgyas la ni dgra dang mdza' bshes mi mnga' bar/ / nges par legs dang mngon par mtho bas phan 'dogs mdzad/ / brgya byin rdo rje thogs shing stobs can gshol thogs khyab 'jug 'khor lo'i mtshon thogs dang / / skem byed mdung thung thogs shing lha chen rtse gsum mtshon thogs dur khrod gnas gyur pa/ / de dag byis pa snying brtse med pa sna tshogs mtshon thogs sdug bsngal 'jigs pas nyen/ / rtag tu srog chags 'joms par brtson pa de la mkhas pa su zhig 'dud par byed/ /gang zhig rtse gsum mi bsnams chags bcas mchan na chung ma med/ / 'khor lo

bod kyi gna' rabasartsom rig 141mdung thung drag po dang ni gshol mi bsnams/ / nyon mongs rnam grol mkhas zlo/ sdo nā pa// ṭwāṃ //sdu /sdu chipar brtson/ / 'jig rten skyabs gyur drang de yang lha khyab 'jug la sogs pas 'di ni nga yis bsrung bya yin zhes skya bseng la sogs pa bsrungs pa dang / 'di ni nga yis gsad bya yin zhes lha ma yin gser gyi stan can la sogs pa bsad pa ni lha chen po dag gi mchog tu gyur pa'i spyod tshul lam gzhung lugs yin pa red/ 'on kyang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de las ldog ste/ dgra bo gsad par bya ba 'ga' yang mi mnga' ste/ thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa'i phyir ro/ / bsru bar bya ba yang mi mnga'aste/ derathabasakyisdubasrudīsa'agra/zlamima~X'ab/phyir)gyi/ dos ṭā /sbya sna ༵ lda rdzu shā shā /rdzu //sa pa (tā sdo byer bar mdad pa' gzhan — can lha'i dbang bo brgya byin gyis lo bye ba phrag bdun gyi bar du dka' thub la gnas pa'i drang srong zho 'thung gi rdo rjer gyur pa'i rus pa las byas pa'i rdo rje thogs la/ stobs can gyis mtshon cha ru gshol 'dzin pa dang / lha khyab 'jug gis 'khor lo'i mtshon cha thogs shing / skem byed dam gdong drug pas lag la mdung thung 'dzin la/ lha chen po dbang phyug gis rtse gsum can gyi mtshon thogs te drag po'i gnas dur khrod du gnas pa'i bdag nyid can de dag ci las 'di las med pa'i bsam med byis pa rnams dang 'dra la/ snying rje dang brtse ba med par rnam pa sna tshogs kyi mtshon cha thogs te lus can dang srog chags rnams gzhom zhing bsad nas sdug bsngal gyi g.yang la 'phangs shing / 'jigs pa chen pos nyen kha bzos nas/ dus rtag tu srog chags 'jomasapar brtson pa'i lha de rnams la shes rab dang ldan zhing blang dor gyi rnam dbye shes pa'i mkhas pa su zhig gis 'dud par byed/ ces dang /

142 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyusarig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/gang zhig sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das khyod kyis rtse gsum la sogs pa'i mtshon cha phyag tu mi bsnams la/ chags pa dang bcas pas mchan du chung ma'ang mi 'dzin zhing / 'khor lo dang / mdung thung dang / gshol la sogs pa mi bsnams par/ 'dod chags la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pa'i tshogs las ngesapar grol zhing yongs su spangs te/ thugs rje chen pos mkhas pa gzhan dang gzhan la phan 'dogs par rnam par brtson pa'i ye shes phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa dang / spangs pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa'i 'jig rten gsum gyi skyabs mgon du gyur pa drang srong chen po sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mchog la 'dir skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes dang /bde bar gshegs pa bdag gi pha min mu stegs gzhan dag dgra ma yin/ /de bzhin gshegs des bdag nor ma bstsal gzegs zan sogs kyis cang ma phrogs/ /'on kyang sangs rgyas bcom ldan de ni gcig tu 'gro la sman sdurshanāgasung / / dri med dri ma thams cad sel ba gang yin de la bdag dad 'dirabade bar gshegs pa ni bdag gi phar gyur pa ma yin la/ lam gzhan la zhugs pa'i mu stegs can gzegs zan la sogs pa gzhan dag ni dgra bo ma yin no/ / de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa des bdag la nor bstsal cing gsung gis bsgrub pa ma yin la/ gzegs zan dang rkang mig la sogs pas nor gyi dngos po ci yang ma phrogs so/ /de yang gzegs zan zer don ni gzigs ma za zhing dka' thub bston pas brtul zhugs kyi dngos grub thob pa dang / mu stegs bye brag pa'i gzhung bcoms pa yin pa dang / rkang mig ni dpyod pa ba'i gzhung rtsom mkhan yin zhing / de yang rkang mig zer don ni lha chen po dbang phyug gis lha mo u ma rkang mig srung ba bor bzhag pa dang / rkang mig shin tu gzugs bzang bas mu ma la chags par gyur te/

bod kyi gna' rabasartsom rig 143mdun du drang mor langs te chags pa'i mtshan ma bstan pa dang / des mig gzhan du bsgyur to/ /de yang der 'ongs nas bstan pa dang / rkang mig gis mig gnyis rkang ba gnyis kyi mthil la bzhag nas bzhugs so/ / gtam de thos par gyur pa dang lha chen po dbang phyug mgu bar gyur nas dpyod pa ba'i gzhung rtsom pa'i ston par gyur cig ces mchog byin no/ / sogs sgras drang srong ser skya la sogs pa bzung ngo / /de ltar dgra dang mdza' bshes la sogs pa ma yin na'ang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de ni ye shes phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pas sangs rgyas yin pa dang / bag chags dang bcas pa'i nyon mongs pa'i phra rgyas spangs pas bcom ldan 'das yin zhing / sems can gyi don dgongs pa mdzad pa'i thugs rje chen po dang ldan pas/ 'gro ba la gcig tu phan pa mdzad pa yin no/ / de ltar yon tan gsum dang ldan pas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi gsung ni dri ma med pa ste/ nyes pa thams cad dang bral ba'i grub pa'i mtha' yin la/ de bzhin du dri ma thams cad sel ba yang yin te/ nyon mongs pa'i dri ma thams cad sel zhing 'joms pa'i ngang tshul can yang gsung 'di nyid yin te/ de thos pa tsam gyis nyon mongs pa'i bag la nyal ba mtha' dag sel bar byed pa yin pa'i phyir/ thub pa'i dbang bo'i gsung de la bdag snying nas dad pa yin no/ /zhes lha las phul du byung la/ khyad par du 'phags pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi gsung la snyinganas dad pa ma gtogs gzhan mu stegs pa'i gsung rab la dad pa'i spu /shā g.yos par ma gyur pa'i bsam pa lhad med de mngon sum du bstan rang ba/shāl/ / khyad par 'phags bstod dang lha las phul byung gi bsam blo'i bod du bsgyur ba'i bston pa'i snyan ngag 'di gnyis ni slob dpon mtho

1slo bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/btsun grub rje dang bde byed bdag po spun gnyis kyis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi sku gsung thugs gsum gyi yon tan la bstod pa'i phyir bcoms pa zhig yin pas/ bstod pa 'di gnyis kyi bsam blo'i rang bzhin gyi bdud rtsi yang don gyi bum pa gcig tu 'khyil yod par snyam ste/ de yang phan tshun bsdur ba'i rtsom stangs legs par spyad de/ lha chen dbang phyug zhe sdang gi dbang du gyur nas lha ma yin gyi grong khyer sum brtsegs 'phur shes can la mda' 'phangs te kun nas bsregs pa dang / lha'i dbang bo brgya byin 'dod chags kyi dbang du gyur nas drang srong gota ma'i chung ma bshol med ma dang lus 'brelakhyas pa dang / lha khyab 'jug gis g.yo sgyu byas nas lha ma yin stobs ldan sa 'og tu bcings pa dang / lha chen tshangs pa 'dod pa'i dbang du gyur nas lha mo thig le mchog ma'i mdzes sdug 'dren byed kyi dpal la rol phyir gdong bzhi sprul ba dang / gzhan de dag gis kyang rgyun par rdo rje dang /mdung thung dang / 'khor lo la sogs pa'i drag po'i mtshon cha thogs te lha ma yin la sogs pa dang drag tu 'thab ste/ gnod cing 'tshe ba dang / gsod cing 'jig rten gyi pha rol la skyod pa bcas chags snang rmongs gsum gyi mdzad spyod la mngon sum 'dzem med dang yang dag 'khrul med kyi sgo nas mtshang 'byin dang ther 'don/ zur za dang 'phya dmod/ smad pa dang dgag rgyag mdzad de/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi bzod pa dang / bsam gtan/ye shes/ tshul khrims/ sbyin pa/ brtson 'grus bcas kyi yon tan la mos gus dang bkur sti/ dad pa dang bsngags brjod tshad med mdzad yod la/sngon bskal ba dang po'i skabs su byung ba'i mu stegs pa'i ston pa'am grangs can pa'i bstan bcos rtsom mkhan drang srong ser skya dang / bye brag pa'i bstan bcos rtsom mkhan gzegs zan dang / dpyod pa ba'i bstan bcos rtsom mkhan rkang mig la sogs pa'i phyi rol mu stegs pa'i ston pa dang / de'i grub

bod kyi gna' rabasartsom rig 145mtha' la dgag bzhag gi 'khor lo bskor te/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi dri ma med la bla na 'phags pa dang / phul du byung la khyad par du 'phags sdu/ ༵ ṭā dang bstan pa la tshad mthon po'i sgo nas bstod bsngags mdzad pa de khyad chogāsu/ ma/ khyad par 'phags bstod dang lha las phul byung gi rtsom stangs bstod pa'i snyan ngag 'di gnyis kyi ches 'bur du thon pa'i rtsom stangs khyad chos ni/ 1 mgo nas mjug bar phan tshun bsdur ba'i rtsom stangs sbyad nas bstod pa'i yul la rnam par bstod pa de yin te/ dper na/ lha chen khros pa'i mda' mos lha ma yin gyi grong khyer sum brtsegs kun nas bsregs/'on kyang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das khyod kyi ye shes kyi mda' chen gyis gzhan rgyud kyi khro ba'i sems nyid bsregs zhes dang / tshangs pa lha mo thig le mchog ma la chags nas gdong bzhi sprul/ 'on kyang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'dasachod la bdud kyi bu mos sgeg nyams ji ltar bstan kyang ba spu'i rtse mo tsam yang mi g.yo bar brtan no zhes dang / mchod pa dang sbyin pa la ba glang sogs phyugs zog dmar gsod byas nas sbyin sreg byas na legs zhes mu stegs pa'i drang srong ser skya sogs kyis smra/ 'on kyang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das khyod kyis srog chags phra mo grog ma bsad pas kyang sdig par dgongs te deraganod pa mi byed do zhes dang / khyab 'jug dang / dbang phyug brgya byin/ skem byed sogs kyis gzhan la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i phyir/ rtag par lag la mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs pa yin/ 'on kyang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'dasakhyod la 'jigs pa med la/ gzhan su la'ang sdig pa'i rjes su 'brel ba'i gnod pa mi byed pas/ gzhan su yang khyod la mi 'jigs la khyod la gnod pa'ang mi bgyid pa'i phyir na/ khyod nyid kyis gzhar yang mtshon cha mi

146 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/thogs so zhes phan tshun bsdur ba'i rtsom stangs kyis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi sku gsung thugs gsum gyi yon tan dang / khyab 'jug dang dbang phyug la sogs kyi nyon mongs dug gsum gyi nyes skyon 'phro rim 'phror kun gsal gyi me long la 'jal ba dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi dri ma med pa'i gsung rab dang / phyi rol mu stegs pa'i grub mtha'i nyes skyon gom gang mdun spos kyis rgyu 'bras kyi rgya ma'i steng bzhag ste/ legs nyes kyi dbye ba rnam par phye zhing / blang dor gyi gdams pa legs par bstan pa red/2 bstod pa'i snyan ngag 'di gnyis kyi rtsom stangs khyad chos gnyis pa ni/ rjod byed tshig la 'ud bstod dang rab btags sogs 'char yan gyi ro mi ldan par/ rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan gyis ji ma ji bzhin dang yang dag bden drang gis bstod pa'i yul la bsngags brjod mdzad yod pa de red/deshā brten/ rjod byed kyi rtog kyang ngang ngam shugs kyis kha gsal zhing go bde ba rna/ rnyi /na pa sdi nākā ṅgi rngo nā/stod dang lha lagaphul byung gi rtsom stangs khyad chos gsum pa ni/ rjod byed tshig gi yig 'bru'i mang nyung ste/ khyad par 'phags bstod kyi tshig rkang rer mtha' gcig tu yig 'bru bdun ma yin yang /lha las phul byung de dang mi 'dra bar/ tshig rkang rer yig 'bru bcu gcig gam bco lnga/ yang na bcu bdun can yin pa de'o/ /
bod kyi snga dan

bod kyi snga dar rtsom rig 149don tshan dang po/ spyi chogs dang rtsom rig gi lo rgyas mdor bstan pa/de yang bod kyi snga dar rtsom ni sa skya ba nas kun gzigs rgyal dbang lnga ba ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho (7617da wa1682)mchog gi bar byung zhing 'phel ba'i rtsom rig sgyu rtsal la ngos bzung ba yin zhing / lo ngo lnga brgya yas mas song ba'i lo rgyus kyi brgyud rim 'di'i khrod du/ gong nas brjod zin pa ltar rab byung dang po'i dus su 'khon dkon mchog rgyal pos sa skya ba'i srol btod pa dang / de nas sa chen kun dga' snying bo sogs sa skya gong ma rnam lnga rim gyis byon te sa skya'i dgon pa legs par btab/ gsung ngag lam 'bras chos kyi snying bor byed pa'i ring lugs 'dzin mkhan rjes 'brang dang bcas pa la chos rgyud dang gdung rgyud gnyis byung zhing / dpon chen rnams kyis chab srid kyi bya ba mdzad de bgrang bya brgya phrag tsam gyi ring la bod khams yongs su dbang bsgyur ba dang gangs can bod kyi bstan srid kyi 'phrin las rgya cher spel/de nas phag mo gru ba rdo rje rgyal pos srol btod pa'i phag gru ba'i stobs shugs rim gyis che ru phyin/ 118lor phag gru khri dpon dang tshal ba khri dpon bar srid dbang 'phrog len byed pa'i 'thab rtsod byung nas phag gru bas tshal ba khridapon la dmag drangs te/ tshal ba'i sa cha dang mnga' 'bangs rnams la phag gru bas yongs su dbang bsgyur/ 1350lor phag spu khri dpon gyis 'bri gung du dmag drangs te 'bri gung la pham nyes chen po byung / de nas g.ya' bzang sogs dbus khul gyi sa cha yongs rdzogs dang sa skya'i mnga' khongs kyi sa

150 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin gye ba'i rol mtsho/cha skor zhig phag gru ba'i dbang du bsdus/ 1354lor phag gru ba'i dmag dpung sa skyar bskyod de zhi drag gnyis kyi thabs bkod sna tshogs la brten nas dpon chen rgyal ba bzang bo btson nas bton/ phag gru ba'i dmag dpung gis sa skya dgon pa'i mtha' gzhi yongs su bskor te sa skya ba'i dpon dmag bzhi brgya lhag bzung gsod byas pa dang / yon gong mas sa skya ba la gnang ba'i gna' rdzas dang dngos rigs 'bor chen ma lus par 'phrog bcom byas nas sa skya ba'i srid dbang kun nas bsgrubs/ de nas bzung / phag gru bas bod yongs la dbang bsgyur ba'i 'go bcoms pa dang phag gru khri rabs dang po byang chub rgyal mtshan la yon gong mas tā si tu'i cho lo dang pod yongs la dbang bsgyur chog pa'i bka' shog tham ka gnang / de nas 'jam dbyangs gu thidang / grags pa byang chub/ bsod nams grags pa/ dbang grags rgyal mtshan/ dbang grags pa 'byung gnas/ sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ dbang kun dga' legs/ dpal ngag gi dbang bo/ dpal ngag dbang bkra shes/zhabs drung ngag dbang grags pa bcas phag gru khri rabs bcu gcig gis bod kyi chab srid bskyangs pa dang / 1618lor garma bstan skyong dbang bos yongs su bsnubs nas bod yongs la dbang bsgyur zhing / 112lor guthi bstan 'dzin chos rgyal gyis dbus gtsang la drag po'i dmag dpung drangs nas gtsang ba sde srid kurma bstan skyong dbang bo'i srid dbang yongs su brlags pa dang / dbus gtsang dang mdo smad sogs kyi srid dbang rgyal dbang lnga ba mchog la phul ba dang / dga' ldan pho brang zhes pa'i chos srid zung 'brel gyi srid dbang brtan por btsugs so/ /de ltar bod kyi chab srid kyi dbang cha ni grub mtha' khag gis rang rang gi zil shugs la brten nas gcig 'jags gcig langs dang khyod shi nga gson gyi tshul gyis bzung bas na rnyog 'dzing che la ya nga ba zhig go / gnas skabs der grub mtha' 'dzin pa'i phyogs khag ni

bod kyi snga dar rtsom rig 151bka' brgyud che bzhi ru grags pa'i 'ba' rom pa dar ma dbang phyug nas brgyud pa'i 'ba' rom bka' brgyud dang / phag gru rdo rje rgyal po nas brgyud pa'i phag gru bka' brgyud/ dpal ldan dus gsum mkhyen pa nas brgyud pa'i kurma bka' brgyud/ dbon sgom tshul khrims snying bo'i slob ma zhang tshal ba brtson 'grus grags pa nas brgyud pa'i tshal ba bka' brgyud/ da rung rnying ma ba dang bka' bdams pa sogs dar che bar snang zhing / de dag las kurma bka' brgyud dang phag gru bka' brgyud kyi stobs shugs cung che bar mngon/dus skabs de dag tu bod kyi grub mtha' so so ru sngar byung ma myong ba'i rig pa'i dpa' bo mang du byon te/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nyin mo ltar gsal bar mdzad pa dang chabs cig tu gangs can bod kyi bcu phrag rig gnas dang rtsom rig sgyu rtsal sngar las lhag par dar rgyas gong 'phel tu mdzad do/ /1182lor 'jam dbyangs rnam sprul sa skya paṇa chen sku 'khrungs/ sgra dang tshad ma/ snyan ngag dang sdeb spyor/ mngon brjod dang zlos gar/ rol mo dang bzo rig pa/ gso ba rig pa dang theg pa thun mong ba/ bstod pa dang legs bshad/ rnam thar dang 'phrin yig sogs phun sum tshogs la khyad du 'phags pa'i brtsams chos shul bzhag gnang 129)lor bu ston rin chen grub sku 'khrungs/ rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul nas bod du 'gyur ba'i glegs bam mtha' dag la zhib tu dpyad de sgrig rim snga phyi gtan 'bebs mdzad pa dang /mdo sngags gnyis dang rig gnas che chung gi gzhung dang 'grel bshad brgya phrag du ma bcoms nas gsung 'bum pod nyer bdun shul bzhag gnang /1357lor rje bla ma blo bzang grags pa mdo smad du sku 'khrungs/ grub mtha' kun gyi bla ma ris med du bsten nas mdo sngags rig gnas kun la thos bsam sgomagasum mthil phyin par mdzad de mdo sngags kyi bstan pa la sgo kun nas dag ther nan tan mdzad/ legs bshad gser gyi phreng ba dang / byang chub

152 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/lam rim chen mo/ sngags rim chen mo/ byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngu'i rtogs pa brjod pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' dpal bzang bo'i rtog pa brjod pa dang / rtogs brjod 'dun legs ma dang / sangs rgyas la bstod pa legs bshad snying bo dang / rgyal ba byams pa mgon po la bstod pa tshangs pa'i cod pan dang / 'jam dbyangs bstod sprin rgya mtsho dang / rnam rgyal ma la bstod pa 'chi med grub pa bcas bstod chen bzhi dang / gzhan yang sgra dbyangs lha mo dbyangs can ma'i bstod pa dang / chos rje grags pa byang chub kyi bstod pa sogs mdzad nas rtsom pa'i 'phrin las rgya cher spel/ gsung rtsom pod bcu dgu bzhugs/ 1409lor lha ldan smon lam chen mo btsugs/ rgyal tshab dar ma rin chen dang mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang / rje dge 'dunagrub sogs bla na mtho la mtshungs zla med pa'i slob ma mkhas grub brgya phrag mang bo legs par bskyangs nas se 'bras dge gsum dang rgyud grwa stod smad rnam par btsugs nas dge lugs pa'i grub mtha' gsar 'dzugs mdzad/dus yun ring ba'i lo rgyus kyi dus skabs 'di'i ring la/ sa chen kun dga' snying bo (1092da wa1158)mchog gis dpal ldan bi rū ba la bstod pa dang /zhang ston la bstod pa bcoms pa dang / gsung rtsom pod gnyis bzhugs/'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa (1235da wa1280)mchog gis bstod dbyangs rgya mtsho snyan ngag rin po che'i rgyan rnam par bkra ba dang / rgyal po yab sras kyis mchod rten bzhings pa la bsngags pa'i sdeb sbyor da ka dang /rgyal bu no mo gan la things pa'i tshigs su bcad pa brgya rtsa brgyad pa sogs bcoms/ skad gnyis smra ba'i dbang bo shong ston rdo rje rgyal mtshan mchog gis dus 'khor 'grel ba dang bcas pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam 'khri shing / klu kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar/ bstod pa brgya ba/ tshig rgyan gyi bstan bcos snyan ngag me long sogs bod yig tu

bod kyi snga dar rtsom rig 153legs par bsgyur ba dang / dge slong byang chub rtse mo dang nam mkha' bzang bo rnam pa gnyis kyis snyan dngags sprin gyi pho nya bod yig tu legs par bsgyur ba dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba bande mdzi thi warmas skyes rabs so bzhi bod yig tu legs par bsgyur bar brten/ bod 'dis bstud mar rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul gyi gna' rabs rtsom rig gzhung lugs la slob sbyong dang rtsom rig sgyu rtsal nang 'dren byed pa'i bya ba rgya che la gting zab par gyur/ kurma pa sku phreng gsum pa rang byung rdo rje (1284da wa1339)mchog gis dpal gyi sde'i skyes pa'i rabs bcoms pa dang / gsung rtsom pod gsum lhag bzhugs/ klong chen rab 'byams pa dri med 'od zer mchog (1308da wa1363)gis po ta la kun tu dga' ba'i gtam zhes bya ba brtsams/ ngor chen kun dga' bzang bo (1382da wa1456)mchog gis chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan la bstod pa lnga zhub dbye /panyag ṭwāṃ gsang sngags la springs pa /smosabya ba brtsams pa ༷dzang //shātā byem / ༵༵ sa// rnyi/ bla ma/ ṭwā sdirji ) / wakāsapa 〉pazlo nab/sdo sdu/smra bsdus par bsngags pa'i rab tu byed pa dad pa'i rol mtsho dang / dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la bstod pa'i tshigs su bcad pa tshangs pa'i dbyangs dang / gu ge'i mnga' bdag khri nam mkha'i dbang bo phun tshogs sde dpal bzang bor phul ba'i yig lan sogs bcoms pa dang / gsung rtsom pod dgu bzhugs/rje dge 'dun grub mchog (1391da wa1474)gis bcom ldan 'das thub pa'idabang bo'i rnam par thar ba la bstod pa bdud dpung phye mar 'thag pa dang / sgrol ma'i pho brang seng ldeng nags kyi bstod pa yid kyi lcags kyu dang /rgyal tshab dar ma rin chen la bstod pa dad pa'i ljon shing sogs brtsams pa dang / gsung rtsom pod bdun bzhugs/ spyan snga ba blo gros rgyal mtshan mchog (1402da wa1472)gis rje btsun bzang bo skyong sems dpa' chen po la

154 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyusarig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/bstod pa dri za'i glu dbyangs dang / dgyer gzhin nu 'od ces sa gsum na yongs su grags pa la bstod pa nor bu'i phreng ba dang / spyan snga ba rin chen dpal la phul ba'i 'phrin yig sogs brtsams/ zhang zhung ba chos dbang grags pa mchog (1404da wa1469)gis bcom ldan 'das rje btsun bzhan pa'irdo rje la bstod pa'i tshigs bcad dang / rgyal po rā ma ṇa'i gtam rgyud las brtsams pa'i snyan ngag gi bstan bcos dang / lo tsā ba rin chen bzang bo'i rnam thar sogs brtsams/ go bo rab 'byams pa bsod nams seng ge mchog (1429da wa1489)gis rje btsun bla ma kun dga' bzang bo la bstod pa dang / rab 'byams pa sangs rgyas 'phel ba la bstod pa dang /kun mkhyen sangs rgyas 'phel ba la bstod pa sogs brtsams/ gsung rtsom pod bcu gsum bzhugs/ rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtsho mchog (1475da wa 1542)gis khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen po'i yon tan mdor bsdus par bsngags pa lha'i rnga bo che'i sgra dbyangs dang / klu sgrub zhabs la bstod pa mchog tu dad pa'i sgra dbyangs dang / gtam du bya ba bung ba'i glu dbyangs sogs bcoms pa dang / gsung rtsom pon lnga bzhugs pa dang 'di ba ni tā la'i bla ma sku phreng gnyis pa yin no/ / sde ba rin srungs pa ngag dbang 'jigs grags mchog gis (1482da wa15579 1565)sa paṇa rtogs brjod bskal bzang legs lam dang / chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang rnam par rgyal ba la phul ba'i zhu 'phrin rig 'dzin pho nya dang / mngon brjod mkhas pa'i rna rgyan dang / snyan 'grel mi 'jigs seng ge'i nga ro/ sham bha la'i lam yig sogs brtsams/ 'brug pa padma dkar po mchog (1527da wa1596)gis rgyal sras gcung rin po che'i rnam thar brtsams pa dang / gsung rtsom pon bcu bzhi bzhugs/ paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan mchog (1570da wa162)gis sems dpa' chen po zhi ba lha'i rtogs brjod dang /

bod kyi snga dar rtsom rig 155saskya paṇa chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi rtogs brjod/ bslab bya rin chen phreng mdzes sogs bcoms/ gsung rtsom pod bzhi bzhugs/ jo nang tā ra nā tha mchog (1575da wa1634)gis dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i rnam thar bstod pa dad pa'i ljon shing dang / jo nang gi gnas bshad sogs brtsams/gsung rtsom pon bzhi bzhugs/ shar skal ldan rgya mtsho mchog gis (1607da wa1677)rje btsun blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan la bstod pa byin rlabs kyi bang mdzod dang / mgur ma'i rim pa sogs brtsams/mdor na bod kyi snga dar rtsom rig ni rgya gar gna' rabs kyi skyes rabs dang rtogs brjod/ legs bshad dang snyan ngag zlos gar sogs bod yig tu legs par bsgyur nas de la slob sbyong dang de dag khyab gdal du btang bar brten/ bod kyi rtsom rig gi brjod bya la sngon med kyi bkrag mdangs gsar ba zhig chags pa dang rjod byed la mtshungs med kyi mtshon thabs gsar ba zhig ldan par gyur/ khyad par du sa dge rnying gsum sogs bod kyi grub mtha' so sor byon pa'i mkhas grub dam pa rnams kyis bstod pa dang rtogs brjod/rnam thar dang bslab bya/ 'azin yig mgur ma sogs brjod don phun sum tshogs la gting mtha' zab pa dang / tshig rgyan phun sum tshogs la khyad du mtsharab mang du brtsams nas/ gangs can bod kyi rtsom rig gi bsam blo'i shes rtogs dang sgyu rtsal rang bzhin tshad rim nges can zhig la slebs pa dang /bstanapadabyi 'grob masrid byorarig gsum gyi 'phrinalas yar rdosazla /dri/hādī ṅge /rdo /po shā sdo bye rabye /sa pa la zungs khrag gsar ba ba da pa

156 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/don tshan gnyis pa/ zhang ston la bstod pa/dang po/ rtsom pa po'i lo rgyusamador bstan pa/de yang sa skya ba chen po kun dga' snying bo ni/ rab byung gnyis pa'i chu pho sprel lo ste spyi lo 1092lor yab 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po dang yum ma gcig zhang mo gnyis kyi sras su 'khrungs shing / khong nyid sku skyed shin tu che bas kun gyis mthong ba'i tshe na dga' zhing yid du 'ong ba zhig byung bas mtshan la kun dga' snying bo zhes gsol/ sku na phra ba'i dus nas bzung yab kyi mdun du yi ge 'bri klog dang chos mi nyung ba gsan zhing / dgung lo bcu gcig la son pa'i lo der yab dkon mchog rgyal po sku gshegs/ gdan sa ba ri lo tsā ba rin chen grags la nye bar gtad/ de nas bzung sa chen kun dga' snying bos ba ri lo tsā ba dang / dge bshes brang ti ba dar ma snying bo la sogs pa'i bla ma mkhas pa gang mang legs par bsten nas mngon pa dang /phar phyin/ tshad ma/ gsang sngags gsar ma'i skor bcas la slob gnyer gang legs mdzad de thugs su chud par gyur/ dgung lo nyi shu ba lcags mo yos kyi lo ste spyi lo 1111lor bla ma ba ri lo tsā bas sa chen kun dga' snying bo la gdan sagatad de yun ma ring bar sku gshegs/ de nas sa chen gyis bla ma gnam kha'u pa dang / bla ma skyi chu ba/ bla ma zhang rin po che la sogs pa'i mkhas grub gang mang legs par bsten nas gsang sngags kyi zab chos mtha' yas pa gsan/ dad pa dang sgrub pa'i sgo nas bla ma rnams kyi thugs mnyes par mdzad/

bod kyi snga dar rtsom rig 157chos thams cad la mnga' brnyes pa dang / mngon shes dang rdzu 'phrul la thogs pa med par grags/ gdan sa mdzad nas bgrang bya zhe brgyad kyi ring la gdul bya mang bo smin grol la bkod/ bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i 'azin las rgya chen po mdzad/ dgung lo drug cu re bdun pa rab byung gsum pa'i sa stag ste spyi lo /sdo //kā //sna shā shā bo kha gdong du sku gshegs/ rje 'di nyid la gsung rtsom gnyisapa/ zhang stonalabastod gdang de'i brjod don/bla ma dam pa rnams la mgos phyag 'tshal/ / yon tan mchog mnga' gzhan la phan par thugs rje can/ / ting 'dzin mchog brnyes nyid kyi don yang mthar phyin pa/ / dam pa mchog chos don gnyis grub pas mngon shes dang / / rdzu 'phrul mchog 'bar sbas pa'i brtul zhugs can la 'dud/ /rab mchog gyur pa mthu stobs dbang phyug man ngag gis/ / grub pa'i dbang phyug dam par gyur pa'i bla ma mchog / zab lam chos kyis skal ldan mchog tu tshim mdzad pa/ /'bar ba'i mtshan can yid kyi mun sel khyed la 'dud/ /spangasartogs mthar phyin mdzad pa mtha' yas longs spyod rdzogs/ / rdo rje'i tshigarnams rgya cher 'grel mdzad sdud pa por/ / nges par mchis kyang mi yi gzugs 'dzin bla ma mchog / snyan brgyud bzhi ston yid kyi dpal gyur khyod la bstod/ / rang gis spyad pa'i las las gyur pa g.yo ba yi/ / nad kyis btabapa khyod kyi thugs rjes zil mnan nas/ / rmongs par gyur pa ye shes chen po'i ros gang ba/ / rnal 'byor dbang phyug khyed kyi mthu yis rjes su skyongs/ /dag pa rang bzhin dag pa'i mthu yis bla ma la/ / rnam grol 'thob

158 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/phyir rnam par mi rtog pa nyid du/ /dad pa chen pos dad pa'i shugs kyis //sdu 'debs na/ /thugs rje chen pos thugs rje'i lcags kyus gzung du gsumapa/ zhang ston labastod pa'i bsamablo'i nang don/de yang zhang ston zhes pa ni gung thang bla ma zhang brtson 'grus grags pa ste/rab byung gnyis pa'i chu stag ste spyi lo 1122lor yab sngags 'chang rdo rje sems dpa' dang / yum mang skyid gnyis kyi sras su yul ngam shod tsha ba grur sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo bdun nas bzung yum dang gcen po'i drung du yi ge 'bri klog sbyangs pa dang / de nas dgung lo nyi shu rtsa bzhi la son pa'i bar du slob dpon mang po bsten nas phar phyin dang / mngon pa/ tshan ma/ gsang sngags bcas la slob gnyer gang legs mdzad/ dgung lo nyi shu rtsa drug pa la slob dpon grab mkhar ba sogs kyi drung du bsnyen rdzogs bzhes/ mtshan la brtson 'grus grags par gsol/ de nas sga lo tsā ba sogs bla ma mang bo legs par bsten nas gsang sngags kyi chos mtha' yas pa gsan/ dgung lo so gsum par dwags sgom tshul khrims snying bo dang mjal nas dwags po bka' brgyud kyi chos gsan/ de nas lo mang bor ri khrod nges med du sgom sgrub mdzad/ rab byung gsum pa'i shing lug ste spyi lo 1175lor tshal yang dgon btab pa dang / me lug ste spyi lo 1187lor gung thang dgon pa btab nas lha chen dpal 'bar legs par bzhengs/ de nas rim bzhin dar spel byung ba'i chos lugs la tshal ba bka' brgyud zer/ rab byung gsum pa'i chu glang ste spyi lo 1193lor sku gshegs/ gsung rtsom pod lnga bzhugs so/ /

bod kyi snga dar rtsom rig 159bstod pa 'di nyid kyi bsam blo'i nang don ni/ rtsom pa pos rang gi bla ma zhang brtson 'grus grags pa'i 'chad pa dang / rtsod pa/ rtsom pa'i yon tan dang / mngon shes dang rdzu 'phrul/ thugs rje dang 'phrin las bcas la snying thag pa nas bsngags brjod mdzad nas/ nam yang thugs rje'i lcags kyus 'dzin par gsol ba btab pa de yin no/ /bzhi ba/ zhang ston 'asabastod pa'i sgyu rtsa'asakhyad chos/sa chen kun dga' snying bo ni sa skya gong ma rnam pa lnga yi khrod kyi gong ma sdig dang/memadobasngags la rnam par maspris spyang mngon shes dang /rdzu 'phrulalha byepa rnyi pa// mee ༵/ya ༵ sgri ṭwāṃ nad /gapa mawa/ wa/ sdu/ / //// tā/ nyi rnyi bye bcomasdu pa/ sna //sna byi/ spyanā ༵ sdi trī kā sdi sprihā /pa (spyi kārsha/ nā sprad/ pa'i tshig rgyas dzi /rdo/ // lha kālda rjitā bskyu/ zlo / ༵ /brten nas brjod don rgya cher ba/na byen da drog/ gi mjug mthar sbyor bde ba'i sgra rgyan la legs par bcings nas gsol ba btab pa'o/ /

1ཿ bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/don tshan gsum pa/ rang gi slob ma la zhe thag pa nas gros 'debs pa'i yi ge snying gi thur ma/gcig rtsomagapo'i lo rgyusamador bstan pa/rje bu ston rin chen spub ni/ gtsang ston khro phu'i phyogs kyi sha ba smad sgom gnas dgon par/ yab rnying ma'i bla chen brag ston rgyal mtshan dpal bzang dang / yum bsod nams 'bum gnyis kyi sras su spyi lo 129)lor sku 'khrungs shing / dgung lo drug pa nas ma yum las yi ge'i sbyor klog dang dpon rgyal seng las rtsis dang yi ge'i rig pa sbyangs pa dang / dgung lo brgyad par rnying ma'i bla ma tshul khrims dpal bzang gi spyan sngar rnying ma'i chos skor ma lus zhus/ gzhan yang gso ba rig pa'i skor gyi sman dpyad dang bzo rig skor gyi thig tshad kyang sbyangs brtson legs par mdzad/ dgung lo bco brgyad pa spyi lo 1307lor khro phu'i mkhan chen yang rtse ba rin chen seng ge yis mkhan po dang dge bshes bsod nams mgon gyis slob dpon mdzad de rab byung dge tshul gyi sdom pa yang dag par blangs/ slob dpon bsod nams mgon las phar phyin dang 'dul ba tshad ma'i gzhung sogs ma lus pa gsan te gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i pha rol du son/ lta ba log pa rnams lung dang rigs pas sun phyung / mkhas pa'i grags pa dbus gtsang kun tu khyab/ dgung lo nyer gsum pa spyi lo 1312lor/ dka' bzhi ba grags gzhon mkhan po dang

1ཿ bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/don tshan gsum pa/ rang gi slob ma la zhe thag pa nas gros 'debs pa'i yi ge snying gi thur ma/gcig rtsomagapo'i lo rgyusamador bstan pa/rje bu ston rin chen spub ni/ gtsang ston khro phu'i phyogs kyi sha ba smad sgom gnas dgon par/ yab rnying ma'i bla chen brag ston rgyal mtshan dpal bzang dang / yum bsod nams 'bum gnyis kyi sras su spyi lo 129)lor sku 'khrungs shing / dgung lo drug pa nas ma yum las yi ge'i sbyor klog dang dpon rgyal seng las rtsis dang yi ge'i rig pa sbyangs pa dang / dgung lo brgyad par rnying ma'i bla ma tshul khrims dpal bzang gi spyan sngar rnying ma'i chos skor ma lus zhus/ gzhan yang gso ba rig pa'i skor gyi sman dpyad dang bzo rig skor gyi thig tshad kyang sbyangs brtson legs par mdzad/ dgung lo bco brgyad pa spyi lo 1307lor khro phu'i mkhan chen yang rtse ba rin chen seng ge yis mkhan po dang dge bshes bsod nams mgon gyis slob dpon mdzad de rab byung dge tshul gyi sdom pa yang dag par blangs/ slob dpon bsod nams mgon las phar phyin dang 'dul ba tshad ma'i gzhung sogs ma lus pa gsan te gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i pha rol du son/ lta ba log pa rnams lung dang rigs pas sun phyung / mkhas pa'i grags pa dbus gtsang kun tu khyab/ dgung lo nyer gsum pa spyi lo 1312lor/ dka' bzhi ba grags gzhon mkhan po dang

bod kyi snga dar rtsom rig 161slob dpon bsod nams grags pas las slob/ 'dul 'dzin bsod nams bzang bos gsang ste ston pa'i slob dpon mdzad de bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa yang dag par mnos/ khro phur phar phyin/ 'dul ba/ mngon pa bcas kyi 'chad nyan legs par mdzad pas slob ma mkhas pa mang bo thon/ de nas thar ba gling du phebs nas lo tsā ba chen po thar lo nyi ma rgyal mtshan slob dpon du bstonanas lo bzhi tsam la 'bad pa lhod med mdzad pas 'gran zla dang bral ba'i lo tsā ba chen poragyur/ dgung lo so gcig pa spyi lo 1320lor zhwa lu chos sde chen mo'i gdan sa bzung / sngags pa dang mtshan nyid kyi bshad grwa btsugs nasadam chos 'chad spel mdzad pa dang / zhwa lu ri phug tu gtsug lag khang dge 'dun sde gsar du bzhengs/ snar thang gi bstan 'gyur la zhu dag mdzad cing / dkar chag yid bzhin nor bu dbang gi rgyal po'i phreng ba zhes pa legs par bsgrigs/ sngags dang mtshan nyid kyi bshad grwa chen po btsugs/dgung lo nga lnga ba spyi lo 1344lor gong ma'i gser yig pa 'byor nas rgya nag tu phebs dgos par zhus kyang dgos pa chen po med par dgongs te ma phebs par dben par sgra dang gsang sngags kyi gzhung mang bo 'phro bsgyur dang gzhi bsgyur mdzad/ re gnyis pa lcags yos lor g.ya' phag gnyis kyi 'khrug pa bsdum pa'i ched du dbus phyogs su chibs kha bsgyur/ phebs lam kun tu dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi bstsal nas skal ldan skye bo mang bo smin grol gyi lam la bkod/ de'i phyi lor byang chub mchod rten chen mo bzhengs shing rab gnas mdzad/ chu sprul lor dpal ldan sa skyar byon/ sa skya'i lha khang chen mor dpal rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor khru bcu gcig can rin thang ga'al du med pa'i rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa bkod pa phul du byung ba bzhings/tāḥkā / rnyihā/ sbya sdo ṭā zlo zlo sbyi lo 1364lor sku gshegs/ khong nyid la gsung

162 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/gnyis/ rang gi slob malazhe thag pa nasagrosa'adebasapa'i yoge snying gi thur mdang de'i brjod don/rang gi slob ma la zhe thag pa nas gros 'debs pa'i yi ge snying gi thur ma zhesakhya ba/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgya mtsho chen por phyogs bzhi'i rlung gis g.yeng ba yi/ / gnya' shing bu gar rus sbal mgrin pa chud pa ltar/ shin tu rnyedadaka'i mi lus rin chen thob gyur nas/ / don med chud zos byas nas 'gyod par ma gyur tam/ / shin tu rnyed dka' rnyed kyang ring du mi gnas shing / /tshe 'di mi brtan mar me rlung gis bskyod pa bzhin/ /yud tsam zhig kyang gnas par nus pa'i gdeng med la/ /gshin rje'i kha ru nges par chud pa mi shes sam/ /gal te khyod ni sdig lta'i dbang gyur te/ /ma mthong 'bras la yid mi ches na yang / /mthong ba'i chos kyi nyes dmigs mang bo zhig /rang giblo yis mthong bar ma gyur tam/ / dal 'byor lus la bslab gsum rgyan dang ldan/ / bstan la zhugs nas sgrub pa gtsor byed pa'i/ / dge slong 'dus nas las la spyod pa'i tshe/ / shing dul bzhin du spong ba ma mthong ngam/ / bstan pa'i mtshor skyes legs bshad 'dab stong can/ / bslab gsum dri bsung rab tu 'phro ba la/ / tshul khrims sprang rtsi don gnyer bung ba 'du/ / sad khyer me tog bung bas mi spong ngam/ / tshul khrims mchod rten legs bshad bang rim can/ /bshes gnyen gser gyi mchod rten mthong ba'i tshe/ /dad ldan skye bos phyag dang mchod pa byed/ /mi gtsang mi gtsang khyod dor ma mthong ngam/ /sde snod thos pa'i cha shas yongs rdzogs shing / /bslab

162 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/gnyis/ rang gi slob malazhe thag pa nasagrosa'adebasapa'i yoge snying gi thur mdang de'i brjod don/rang gi slob ma la zhe thag pa nas gros 'debs pa'i yi ge snying gi thur ma zhesakhya ba/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgya mtsho chen por phyogs bzhi'i rlung gis g.yeng ba yi/ / gnya' shing bu gar rus sbal mgrin pa chud pa ltar/ shin tu rnyedadaka'i mi lus rin chen thob gyur nas/ / don med chud zos byas nas 'gyod par ma gyur tam/ / shin tu rnyed dka' rnyed kyang ring du mi gnas shing / /tshe 'di mi brtan mar me rlung gis bskyod pa bzhin/ /yud tsam zhig kyang gnas par nus pa'i gdeng med la/ /gshin rje'i kha ru nges par chud pa mi shes sam/ /gal te khyod ni sdig lta'i dbang gyur te/ /ma mthong 'bras la yid mi ches na yang / /mthong ba'i chos kyi nyes dmigs mang bo zhig /rang giblo yis mthong bar ma gyur tam/ / dal 'byor lus la bslab gsum rgyan dang ldan/ / bstan la zhugs nas sgrub pa gtsor byed pa'i/ / dge slong 'dus nas las la spyod pa'i tshe/ / shing dul bzhin du spong ba ma mthong ngam/ / bstan pa'i mtshor skyes legs bshad 'dab stong can/ / bslab gsum dri bsung rab tu 'phro ba la/ / tshul khrims sprang rtsi don gnyer bung ba 'du/ / sad khyer me tog bung bas mi spong ngam/ / tshul khrims mchod rten legs bshad bang rim can/ /bshes gnyen gser gyi mchod rten mthong ba'i tshe/ /dad ldan skye bos phyag dang mchod pa byed/ /mi gtsang mi gtsang khyod dor ma mthong ngam/ /sde snod thos pa'i cha shas yongs rdzogs shing / /bslab

bod kyi snga dar rtsom rig 163gsum dri med ri dwags mtshan mas brgyan/ / snyan pa'i bsil zer 'phro ba'i 'od dkar can/ / gzas bzung mya ngan byed pa ma mthong ngam mi 'jigs smra ba'i spobs pa dang ldan yang / / lung rigs chos smra seng ge'i khri steng du/ / sngon chad rang bas dman dang mnyam pos kyang / / wa skyes yin zhes brnyas pa ma mthong ngam/ / sngon chad rang gi yon tan cha tsam yang / /bsgrun par mi nus gsar bu khu ta'i tshogs/ / thos pa'i nor bu'i gdengs nas mdzes pa'i sbrul/ / shi ba'i ro bzhin brnyas pa ma mthong ngam/ / sngon chad rang gis bskyangs shing smin pa'i 'khor/ / legs bshad zer gyis blo gros kha phye rnams/ /mtshan phyed dus kyi padmo ji bzhin du/ /ngo 'dzum rab tu zum pa ma mthong ngam/ / sngon chad rang gis rgyud gyong tshogs gsum gyis/ /phan btags gyur pa'i grogs ngan srin bya'i tshogs/ / gtam snyan nyi 'od nub nas gtam ngan gyis/ / skad ngan phyogs bcur sgrog pa ma mthong ngam/ /sngon nas rang la phan 'dogs 'dris 'brel ba'i/ / ma bzhin sha tsha snying nye'i grogs mchog kun/ /bu gces shi ba'i ma ma ji bzhin du/ / mya ngan khang bur bcug pa ma mthong ngam/ / sngon chad rang la phrag dog 'gran sems can/ / mi mnyam mnyam du re ba 'byung bo'i bya/ / gtam ngan mun pas 'thibs par shes nas ni/ / skad ngan gad mo dgod pa ma mthong ngam/ /sngon chad 'gras 'dris med pa'i lam chen mi/ / chags sdang gnyis gas dben pa'i skye bo yang / /lo legs snye ma sad kyis khyer mthong nas/ / mya ngan ca co sgrog pa ma mthong ngam/ /sngon chad chos dang zang zing gnyis ka yis/ /phan 'dogs bka' drin che ba'i slob dpon yang / / dkor mdzod rku la shor ba'i bdag po bzhin/ / mi dga' bzhin du thabs med ma mthong ngam/ /dge tshogs sa gzhir dal 'byor ljon shing skyes/ / bslab shes yal ga 'chad rtsod lo 'dab bklubs/ / tshul khrims me tog snyan pa'i sbrang rtsi 'dzin/ /

1yo bodakyirtsomarig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/grags pa'i dri bsung phyogs bcur ldang ba yi/ / bshes gnyen dpag bsam sdong bor re ba la/ / legs bshad char 'bab yongs 'dzin sprin tshogs dang / /ma bral bzhin du me tog sad kyis khyer/ /ljon shing 'bras bu med pa yi re mug /bslab gsum rin chen dgos 'dod kun 'byung ba/ /rig pa'i gnas lnga shes pa'i 'od dang ldan/ / mi shes mun sel nyin par tsha ba 'joms/ /bshes gnyen nor bu lta bur re ba la/ / dran dang shes bzhin go bcus pa chung / / chom rkun bdud mo'i tshogs ni stobs che bas/ / mngon sum rig bzhin chom rkun tshogs rnams kyis/ / nor bu rin chen 'phrog pa yid re mug / so thar sdom pa'i tshul khrims lhun stug cing / / byang sems sdom pa'i bang rim mdzes pa can/ / rig 'dzin sdom pa'i char khebs tog dang ldan/ / gser gyi mchod rten lta bur re ba la/ / nyon mongs mkhri ka yi rdzas sbyor dang / /bdud mos sol ba'i me yis bsregs pa'i mthus/ /yud tsam zhig la gser gyi mchod rten ni/ / thal ba'i phung bor byas pa yi re mug /tshul khrims srog shing rab tu brtan pa la/ / bshad sgrub snying brtses brgyan pa'i lhab lhub can/ / rtsod rtsom snyan pa'i ba dan phyogs bcur g.yo/ / mkhyen brtse rin chen tog dang ldan pa yi/ / bshes gnyen bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan re ba la/ /yongs 'dzin dge ba'i bshes kyis bzung bzhin du/ / bdud mos nyon mongs phyogs rdo 'phangs pa'i mthus/ / rgyal mtshan srog shing bcag pa yi re mug / dal 'byor rnyed dka' rnyed kyang myur du 'chi/ /tshul khrims 'chal ba'i nyes dmigs rnam pa mang / /de la skyob pa'i thabs ni gang zhig yod/ / rang gi snying la gros dris bsam mno thong / /bu sto/ kha ches rang gi slob ma la/ / nges par gros 'debs snying gi thur ma lta pa /nad/ rdorsha sdidī rdokā rsharshal nad rnams nges bcos ste/ /nges 'byung tshul

bod kyi snga dar rtsomarig 165gsum/ rang gi slob marnamasalagrosasu'adebasapa'i nage snying gi thur mazhesapa'i bsamablo'i nang don/de yang bslab bya 'di nyid kyi bsam blo'i nang don ni/ gcig sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa skyong ba'i dge slong ngam slob ma rnams kyis ni ci nas kyang spyod pa tshul dang ldan pa'i sgo nas tshul khrims legs par srung dgos pa dang /'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi sgo nas dam pa'i lha chos spel dgos pa/ bslab pa gsum gyi sgo nas bstan 'gror 'azin las bsgrub dgos pa nan gyis bstan pa dang / gnyis/ dal 'byor rnyed dka' ba'i rang bzhin dang mi tshe mi rtag pa'i chos nyid bden par brjod nas cis kyang blo kha chos la phyogs nas mi tshe don ldan yong bar hur brtson byed dgos pa rnam par bstan pa dang / gsum/drin byas drin tu mi go ba'i khrel med rnams dang phrag dog 'gran sems can gyi blo chung dag la mtshang 'byin byas nas ya rabs dam pa'i ngang tshul rgyun 'khyongs byed dgos pa'i go bskon slob gso btang ba de yin no/ /bzhi/ rang gi slobamarnamasalagrosa'adebasapa'i yege snying gi thur mazhesapa'i rtsomastangasakhyad chos/spyir bslab bya 'di nyid kyi tshig sbyor rmad du byung la brjod don phun sum tshogs pa dang / yar skul dang slob gso'i nus pa ha cang che ba yin te/gcig bslab bya 'di nyid la khyon bsdoms pas tshig rkang brgya dang go drug

166 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin gye ba'i rol mtsho/mchis pa dang / tshig rkang rer tsheg bar bcu gcig can dang tsheg bar dgu can du legs par brtsams 'dug pa dang / gnyis/ bslab bya 'di nyid kyi sho lo ka mang che shos sheg ni snyan ngag gi gzugs rgyan la rnam par bcings nas bcoms pas na snyan ngag gi mdzes nyams mngon par thon 'dug pa dang /gsum/ gson nyams ldan la phun sum tshogs pa'i dpe la nye bar brten nas brjod bya'i don gyi snying bo bden par bstan 'dug pa dang / bzhi/ mi gshes kyi 'gyur ldog dang mi sems kyi khrel gzhung mngon sum du ther 'don byas nas brjod don la bden snang nyams 'gyur kun nas bskyed pa bcas ni bslab bya 'di nyid kyi rtsom stangs khyad chos su mngon pa yin no/ /

bod kyi snga dar rtsom rig 167don tshan bzhi ba/ sa skya'i legs bshad/dang po/ rtsomathapo'i lorgyusamador bstan pa/saskya paṇa chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan ni 'khon dpal chen 'od po che dang yum gar phu mo nyi khri lcam gnyis kyi sras su chu pho stag gi lo'i (spyi lo1182)khra zla ba'i nyi shu drug la bkra shis pa'i ltas dang bcas legs par 'khrungs/sku na chung ngu'i dus su ming la dpal ldan don grub zer zhing rje grags pa rgyal mtshanagyi drung du dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa bzhes nas mtshan la kun dga' rgyal mtshan du gsol/ khong gis gzhon nu'i dus nas mkhas pa dang grub pa'i bla ma du ma ris med du bsten pa dang / khyad par du rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi drung nas sa skya gong ma'i gsung gi nying bcud mdo sngags kyi zab gnad ma lus par gsan pa dang / dgung lo nyer gsum nas bzung kha che paṇa chen mkhan slob kyi mdun nas sgra dang tshad ma/ bzo dang gso ba/ nang don rig pa dang / snyan ngag zlos gar/ skar rtsis/ mngon brjod/ sdeb sbyor sogs rig gnas che chung bcu la sbyangs pa mthar phyin par mdzad pas/mkhas pa'i grags snyan phyogs kun tu khyab pa dang parnyi ta zhes pa'i mtshan snyan thob pa'i bod kyi mkhas pa dang po yin no/ / de la sa paṇa rang nyid kyis rang la bstod pa nga brgyad ma zhig brtsams pa 'di ltar/sgra ba nga yin rtog ge ba nga smra ngan 'joms la nga 'dra med/ / sdeb sbyor nga mkhas snyan ngag nga nyid mngon brjod 'chad la 'gran med nga / / dus sbyor

168 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyusarig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/ngas shes phyi nang kun rig rnam dpyod blo gros mtshungs med nga / / 'di 'dra gang yin sa skya ba la mkhas pa gzhan dag gzugs brnyan yin/ /dngos gnas de ltar yin te/ khong gis bcu phrag rig gnas la de ltar sbyangs pa dbyis phyin par mdzad par ma zad/ mkhas pa'i bya ba rnam gsum ste 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi 'phrin las mchog dpyid kyi dpal yon bzhin rnam par spel bar mdzad de/ dang po 'chad pa nyi ma'i 'od zer gyis phan bde'i pad tshal rgyas par mdzad pa'i tshul ni/ khong gi legs par bshad pa'i 'od zer mtha' yas pa phyogs bcur 'phros te/ gdul bya rnams kyi mi shes pa'i mun pa drungs nas phyung zhing phan pa dang bde ba'i padmo'i tshal phyogs bcur rgyas par mdzad pas na/ legs par bshad pa'i rin po che'i tshogs kyi 'byung gnas su gyur rto/ / legs par gsungs pa'i rig pa'i gnas de dag slob ma'i tshogs la rang rang gi skal ba 'tshams par ston pa la nam yang g.yel ba mi mnga' zhing / khyad par du 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyi rtsa ba bdag tu mngon par zhen pa yin zhing / de'i gnyen po bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab dang /de yang rig pa'i gzhung lugs kyi shes pa sngon du 'gro ba yin la/ rig pa'i gtso bo mtha' bral dbu ma'i gzhung las 'byung zhing / de rtogs pa yang rnam 'grel mdzad pa'i gzhung la rag las par dgongs nas/ gzhung lugs chen po'i chos thun nyin re bzhin ma chag par mdzad pa'i dam bca' mdzad do/ /gnyis pa rtsom pa rin po che'i phreng bas mkhas pa'i yid 'phrog par mdzad pa'i tshul ni/ sgra'i phyogs la shes rab 'phro ba/ sgra la 'jug pa/ smra sgo'ibasdus don/ byis pa bde 'jug gi 'grel ba/ yi ge'i sbyor ba/ sgra nye bar bsdu ba rnams mdzad la/ tshad ma la rigs pa'i gter rtsa 'grel/ snyan ngag la mkhas pa'i kha rgyan bde bar gshegs pa'i thugs rje la bskul ba sogs mdzad/ sdeb sbyor la sdeb sbyor me tog gi chun po/ mngon brjod la tshig gi

bod kyi snga dar rtsom rig 169gter/ zlos gar la rab dga'i 'jug pa dang / rol mo'i bstan bcos/bzo rig pa la sku gzugs kyi bstan bcos dang / sa brtag pa'i rab byed/gso ba rig pa la yan lag brgyad pa'i don bsdus/ bstod pa'i skor la/sangs rgyas kyi bstod pa/ thub pa'i bston pa/ spyan ras gzigs kyi bstod pa gnyis/ 'jam dbyangs kyi phyag mtshan ri mo la bstod pa/ bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i gnas chen la bstod pa/ 'jam dbyangs kyi bstod pa'i rnam bshad rnams mdzad/ theg pa thun mong ba'i skor la/ grub mtha'i rnam 'byed/thub pa dgongs gsal/ sdom gsum rab dbye/ sems bskyed chen mo lung sbyor dang bcas pa/ chos nyams su blang ba'i rim pa/ chos spyod bcu ba/zhen pa bzhi bral/ theg pa chen po'i lam gyi rnam gzhag mdor bsdus/ bsngo ba'i yon bshad rnams mdzad/ gzhung lugs spyi la mkho ba mkhas pa 'jukhro pa'i sgo/ gzhung lugs legs bshad/ lugs kyi bstan bcos la sa skya legs bshad/ thor bu ba la 'phrog byed dga' bo pham par mdzad pa'i tshigs bcad/bdag nyid kyi rnam thar nga brgyad ma rtsa 'grel sogs mdzad/ gzhan yang pa// sdog dang zhus lan gyi skor la mang du 'dug pas 'dir re re bzhin mi khong gi sa skya legs bshad ni 'jig rten mi chos dang / dam pa'i lha chosaganyis kyi cha nas/ nga tsho la med du mi rung ba'i rmad byung slob deb lta bu dang / legs lam ston pa'i sgron me lta bur gyur 'dug pa dang / de yang gangs can gyi rtsom rig lo rgyus steng thengs dang por byung ba'i legs bshad gyi rtsom pa'i nor bu zhig yin pa red/ de la 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pas/rtsom pa 'di 'dra myur 'jug pa/ / glog 'gyu bas kyang ches myur zhing / / rtsol ba med par 'byung ba ni/ / mcho ltar ngang gis lhun grub lags/ /de don phun sum tshogs gyur pa/ /rlom chen blo yi dbang bo mchog

170 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho//'gas kyang sngon chad ma dpyad pa/ /dpyod ldan gang gis rnam dpyad pa/ /yidagasal bgyid pa gangs ri'i rtser/ / nyi ma shar ba lta bu ste/ / kun nas dga' ba bskyed pa ni/ /bsam gtan ro myong lta bur mchis/ /zhes bsngags brjod kyi me tog rnam par mchod pa de ltar lags so/ /gsum pa rtsod pa rdo rje'i shugs kyis lta ngan gyi brag ri bshig pa'i tshul ni/mkhas pa 'di nyid rigs pa'i dbang phyug chen por gyur pa'i grags pa'i snyan pa phyogs kun khyab pa na/ lho phyogs kyi rgyud du rgyu zhing rnam par 'phyan pa 'phrogakhyed dga' bo la sogs pa'i rgya gar phyi rol ba'i ston pa drug gis thos te/ 'u cag kha ba can gyi ljongs su 'gro la/ dge slong du khas 'che ba gang de bzlog par bya'o zhes gling ste 'ongs pa dang / mkhas pa chen po khong nyid byang phyogs su dpag tshad bcu phrag drug bgrod pa/ mang yul skyid grong 'phags pa wa ti'i gtsug lag khang dang 'dabs 'byor ba'i tshong 'dus na bzhugs pa'i tshe/ chos rje nyid dang / bde bar gshegs pa'i rten la phyag mi 'tshal ba'i 'phrog byed dga' bo la sogs pa'i ston pa drug po slebs pas/ de dag dang brtsad mthar rgol ba ngan pa de thams cad re re nas sun phyung zhing pham par mdzad de mi smra ba'i brtul zhugs la bkod pa dang / de thams cad kyi lta ba ngan pa'i snyems pa'i dri ma med par mdzad de/ ral ba'i khur rtsa ba nas bregasate gang nyid kyi mdun du rab tu byung ngo / / de dag gi ral ba dpal ldan sa skya'i dbu rtse rnying ma na da lta yang yod do/ / des na bod kyi paṇḍi tas rgya gar phyi rol pa mu stegs kyi rgol ba ngan pa bzlog cing pham par mdzad pa ni rje saskya parnyi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan 'di kho na yin no/ / de la rin spungs (sdu /ṭā/ py-i // sdu zlogs kyis brtsams pa'i sa paṇa rtogs brjod bskal de ltar rigs par smra ba'i nyi mas 'jig rten gsum gyi snying la gom pa

bod kyi snga dar rtsom rig 171bkod/ grib ma ring bo'i rang bzhin mi nag snang ba thams cad dkar bor bsgyur ba yi/ /dge ba mtha' dag spungs pa'i chos kyi blo gros nor ldan blo yis /sdorsha /bye /swādza/ da//cha shas res kyang lha dang mi yi ston pa'i bstan pa yongs su /sna shā spya )kā / ༵ dngha shā rnyi rjog zlo dro/nabu /'i/ bya/ ba ji ltar mdzad pa'i tshul ni/ rab byung bzhi ba'i shing 'brug lor (spyi lo1244)hor rgyal po o go ta'i sras go tan gyis gdan drangs pa bzhin khong rang dang / sku tsha 'gro mgon 'phags pa dang phyag na gnyis dang bcas lang cu sde bzhi ste deng sang kun su'u zhing chen gyi wu'u we sa char phebs nas rgyal po dang legs par mjal/sku gsung thugs kyi mdzad pa du mas mtha' 'khob kyi rgyal khams dam pa'i chos kyis gsal bar mdzad/ rgyal po go dan la sa bdag gi nad thebs pa'i rim gror chab gtor 'jam dpal ma mang du mdzad pa dang / 'phags pa seng ge sgra'i cho ga mdzad pas rgyal po nad las thar nas shin tu dad par gyur/ bod du dpon rigs bsko lugs dang / khral 'ul bskul tshul sogs la kha 'chams te/ bod kyi bka' gros la dbang ba'i bla dpon ser skya rnams la yi ge snga phyi lan gnyis btang nas dbus gtsang gi sa phyogs rnams hor rgyal po'i khongs su sgur na dmag 'khrug sogs drag po'i las mi 'ongs pa'i dgongs pa bstan no/ /dgung lo bdun cur bzhes pa rab byung bzhi ba'i lcags phag lor lang ṭā // / ༵sdu sa las 'das pa'o/ /de la sa paṇa rtogs brjod bskal bzang rgya chen sa yi lag dpya 'dzin pa de'i/ /g.yar gyi khral dang drag po'i ru sna/nā ṭwāṃ/sa tha/shā kāpa sbyaX / kā kā/ra 'phyar bar mi bgyid pa'i/ /'jigs pa

172 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyusarig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho//pa/sdu sdu// /sdu/ sa/ su bstan pa 'di ni/ sa skya paṇḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi lo rgyus yin pa dang lo rgyus de las nga tshos shes thub pa zhig ni/khong ni bcu phrag rig gnas la mkhas pa'i paṇḍi ta'i mtshan snyan thob pa'i bod kyi mkhas pa dang po dang / phyi rol mu stegs pa'i brag ri rtsod pa'i gnam lcags thog mdas gzhom par mdzad mkhan yin zhing / mkhas pa'i bya ba rnam gsum gyis gangs can bod kyi rig gnas dang rtsom rig dar rgyas gong 'phel du mdzad pa dang / sangs rgyas bstan pa dang kha ba ri ba'i zhi bde la nyams pa sdo tā /nga 'od stong 'phro ba'i byas rjes bzhag pa'i mi sna rlabs chen zhig yin pa gnyisapa/ saskya'i legasabashad kyi bsam blo'i rang bzhin/sa skya'i legs bshad la rab tu byed pa dgu yod cing / bsdoms pas sho lo ka bzhi brgya dang nga bdun mchis pa las/ 'jig rten gyi bya ba legs par shes pa'i gzhi rtsa'i thog dam pa'i chos lugs rnam par 'grub pa dang / chos sbyatā sdidī nā / kta na/ sa// rten skyong dgos pa'i bsam blo mtshon pa'i skor /trī / hā/ rnyi ༷hu ṭā sna /shes pa/ / de yis dam pa'i chos lugs sdu/ba/ /des na chos lugs spyod pa de/ /byang chub sems dpa'i rnam thar zhes dang / rab tu byed pa lnga ba las/

bod kyi snga dar rtsom rig 173rgyal pos chos bzhin sa bskyang ste/ / min na rgyal po nyams pa'i //sdu/ / nyi mas mun pa sel min na/ / de ni gza' yis zin pa'i /pa sdus rshakā ༵ rdo sa/ /cing/ dbye na/ rnam pa drug tu snang ste/gcig rje dpon rnams kyis 'os pa tshul mthun gyi sgo nas mnga' 'bangs skyong dgos par bstan pa/ dper na/ rab tu byed pa bdun pa las/rje bos bdag la gnod byed na/ / de la skyob par byed pa su/ / snang bas ga// sdo dṛ sgripa ṭī kā rnyi/da /pa deb rnyi / ༵ dī byibs gzhan med/ /rje bos 'bangs la mi gnod par/ /rigs pa'i lam gyis dpya rnams pa/ra/ / sa la'i shing las spos kyi bcud/ / gzags pa mang na skam par /sna /surshakā ༵ kṣiṃ ༵༷/ mang/ tshogs kyi blo gros ni bla na mtho ba dang 'gran zla bral ba zhig yin par bstan pa ni/ dper na/ rab tu byed pa dang po las/si blo gros ldanapa/tanyisa'agrogs na/jo / blo grosazhi le/stes pa gzhan 'byung sad/ ce/༵ ༵ sdo/ nga dro shā ༵ sdu/ /pa dru/tt+waṃ ༵ kā kāzhan 0ga snyo bar 'gyur/ /mang bo gcig tu blo mthun na/ /nyam chung gis kyang don chen 'grub/ /srog chags // sna/ //sdu trī /lha pas/ /seng ge'i phru gu bsad ces grags/ /gsum/ rig pa'i rtenas la slob pa'i dus su dka' sdug khyad du gsod dgos pa las/ brtson pa drag po dor nas rnam g.yeng gi dbang du song ba'am

174 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mcho/bde ba chung ngur chags nas bsdad na ni mkhas pa'i go 'phang thob mi srid la/rnyi/ ṭī /spya kā kāswā don yang mi 'grub par bstan pa ni/ dper na/ rab tu mkhas pa slob pa'i dus na sdug / bde bar sdod la mkhas mi srid/ /bde ba chung la chags pa des/ /chen po'i bde ba thob mi srid/ /ces pa dang / rab tu byed pa bdun pa las/rtsol ba dor nas 'dug pa la/ 'di phyi gnyis ka 'grub mi 'gyur/ /'bad rno // /nga sdingapa ba// zlong / /lo tog thob par mi 'gyur ro/ /bzhi/ mkhas pa rnazlos ni yon tan gyi mdzod du gyur na'ang nam yang le/sabashad kyis rdoms pa menā pa'i bdag nyid can yin pa bstan pa ni/da ra /kha/ sa/ba slon kto napa byerjod tre kāsna/ pa/ / de dag legs bshad rin chen /shāb/ / rgya mtsho chen po chu bo'i gter/ / yin phyir chu phran thams cad ṭwāṃ kāswā /zlo yi/sa mi ngoms shing / / rgyal po'i bang mdzod nor gyis byinā/sa//'dod yon spyad pas mi ngoms te/ / mkhas pa legs bshad kyis mi /sa kā rtswa sdu sna /'dī'o blu/na/ po'i spyod tshul ngan pa la ther 'don byas pa ni/ dper na/ rab tu byed pa gsum pa las/skye bo ngan pa 'byor thob kyang / /lhag par spyod pa ngan par 'gyur/ /'bab chu ji ltar bzlog gyur kyang / /thur du 'bab pa kho nar 'dod/ /

174 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mcho/bde ba chung ngur chags nas bsdad na ni mkhas pa'i go 'phang thob mi srid la/rnyi/ ṭī /spya kā kāswā don yang mi 'grub par bstan pa ni/ dper na/ rab tu mkhas pa slob pa'i dus na sdug / bde bar sdod la mkhas mi srid/ /bde ba chung la chags pa des/ /chen po'i bde ba thob mi srid/ /ces pa dang / rab tu byed pa bdun pa las/rtsol ba dor nas 'dug pa la/ 'di phyi gnyis ka 'grub mi 'gyur/ /'bad rno // /nga sdingapa ba// zlong / /lo tog thob par mi 'gyur ro/ /bzhi/ mkhas pa rnazlos ni yon tan gyi mdzod du gyur na'ang nam yang le/sabashad kyis rdoms pa menā pa'i bdag nyid can yin pa bstan pa ni/da ra /kha/ sa/ba slon kto napa byerjod tre kāsna/ pa/ / de dag legs bshad rin chen /shāb/ / rgya mtsho chen po chu bo'i gter/ / yin phyir chu phran thams cad ṭwāṃ kāswā /zlo yi/sa mi ngoms shing / / rgyal po'i bang mdzod nor gyis byinā/sa//'dod yon spyad pas mi ngoms te/ / mkhas pa legs bshad kyis mi /sa kā rtswa sdu sna /'dī'o blu/na/ po'i spyod tshul ngan pa la ther 'don byas pa ni/ dper na/ rab tu byed pa gsum pa las/skye bo ngan pa 'byor thob kyang / /lhag par spyod pa ngan par 'gyur/ /'bab chu ji ltar bzlog gyur kyang / /thur du 'bab pa kho nar 'dod/ /

bod gyi snga dar rtsom rig 175/sdu/ ṭā ༵/da pa bzang byung yang / / de ni bcos ma'i rnam thar byi// / shel la nor bus kha bsgyur yang / / chu dang 'phrad na rang mdog /sna ga~X kā trī /sna ༵/ me/da yin phyir dge ba'i las dang / shes bya'i nor la gnyer na de ring nyid nas brtun pa bskyed dgos pa las bya ba thams cad sang nyin nam sang lor bskyur ba ni blun rtags kho na yin pas/ cis kyang dus tshod brtson len byed dgos pa dang / de ltar mdzad na phyi mar phan pa nan gyis bstan pa ni/ dper na/ rab tu byed pa dang po las/rig pa nang bar 'chi yang bslab/ / tshe 'dir mkhas par ma gyur kyang / zhe/skye ba phyi mar bco1 ba yi/ /nor la rang nyid len pa 'dra/ /rte/ /dī /bya kāb // tā ༵ rshanā ba lasa'/chi bdag sdod par mi 'gyur gyis/ /nges par bya dgos yod na ni/ /de ring nyid du brtun la gyis/ /zhes gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /gsumapa/ saskya'i legasabashad kyisna rtsalarang bzhin/'dir legs bshad ces pa ni mtshan nyid rig pa'am bden lugs gyis kun nas phyug pa'i brjod bya'i don dang ldan la/ mi rnams legs lam du skul bar slob gso'i nus pa che ba'i yang dag pa'i gtam la go ba yin/ de'i rjod byed kyi tshig kyang mngon brjod brda rnying dang rmad byung rgyan gyis spud pa'i snyan

176 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/tshig gi rjod byed las kun nas ldog ste/ sdeb legs shing go sla ba'i tshig gis brjodaba'i gnas lugs kyi snying bo bsdus mar ston thub pa zhig yin dgos snyam/ sa paṇa gyi sa skya'i legs bshad ni de lta bu'i legs bshad kyi bstan bcos mchog tu gyur pa zhig red/ khong gis gangs can gyi skye bo kun la cha rgyusayod pa'i rang byung khams kyi srog chags dang skye dngos kyi rtsa ba'i gtan tshigasadang chos nyid de brjod don bde legs su go ba'i dpe ru legs par spyad de/ dam pa'i chos dang legs lam du rnam par skul cing / legs nyes blang dor la mi rmongs pa'i zhal gnams nan du mdzad pa red/bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus steng thog dang por byung ba'i legs bshad kyi bstan bcos 'di nyid ni rgya gar gyi rig gnas dang rtsom rig la slob sbyong byed pa'i mtho rlabs 'byur ba'i gnas skabs der bcoms pa zhig yin zhing / sa paṇa gyis legs bshad 'di nyid rtsom skabs/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyi shes rab sdong bu dang skye bo gso thigs sogs la lad zlos zur tsam re byas thog rang gi shes rab kyi rtsal dang / 'tsho ba'i nyams myong zung du sbrel nas mdzad pa zhig rsharsham/ ṭwāṃ sna snazlo // dkyi pa pa snyin ste bcos 'di'i rtsom stangs khyad chos rnam pa gcig legs par bshad pa'i sho lo ka phal cher ni dpe can sngon dang dpe gzhug na yod pa'i rnam pa can yin zhing / gzhug na mchis pa'i dpe yis brjod bya'i don dpe can gson nyams ldan la go sla ba'i ngang bstan yod pa red/ dper na/ rab tu byed pa dang po las/yon tan ldan na skye bo kun/ / ma bsdus par yang rang nyid 'du/ /dri ldan me tog rgyang ring yang / /bung ba sprin gyi tshogs bzhin 'khor/ /zhes par mtshon na/ dpe can te yon tan dang ldan pa'i mkhas pa dag gi mdun sar blo gsal don gnyer ba brgya phrag mang bo ma bsdus kyang rang

bod kyi snga dar rtsom rig 177shugs kyis 'du ba de ni/ dpe dri bsung 'thul ba'i me tog padma la sogs bung ba dang rgyang thag ring ba'i sar bzhad 'dug kyang / rkang drug tshogs ni le dbar bcu phrag gis bskal ba'i sa nas me tog gi sa la sprin bzhin 'khor ba yin pa des legs par bstan pa lta bu dang / rab tu byed pa gsum pa las/ngan pa phal cher rang gi skyon/ /gang yin gzhan la sgod par byed/ /kha tas mi gtsang zos pa'i mchu/ /sa gtsang gzhan la 'bad nas 'phyin/ /ces par mtshon na/ skye bo ngan pas rang gi skyon ngan pa de skyon med gzhan la sgod ci thub thub byed pa'i spyod tshul de/ 'dab chags khu tas mi gtsang ba'i zas zos nas rgyags mthar bsam gzas nas sa gtsang sa zhig tu babs te/ mchu to sa gtsang steng g.yas dang g.yon tu res mos su phyi ba'i dpe 'di yis gson nyams ldan pa'i ngang bstan pa lta bu'o/ /gnyis/ chos nyid kyi rang bzhin dang gtan tshigs kyi rang bzhin ldan /sbyatā shā yipa dro/sbyi sngu dī /snyi ṭī /dri ṭwāṃ 'khrul med bden par bstan pa ni/skye bo dam pa rgyad gyur kyang / /spyod pa'i khyad par lhag par mdzes/ /me ni thur du kha bstan kyang / /me lce gyen la 'bar ba mthong / /zhes par mtshon na/ skye bo dam pa rgyad par gyur nas dman sa la lhung na spyod pa lhag par mdzes pa'i ngang tshul de/ 'bar bzhin pa'i me ni kha thur du bstan tshe me lce gyen la 'bar ba las thur du 'bar mi srid pa'i chos nyid dang gtan tshigs kyi rang bzhin de yis mtshon par byas pa lta bu'o/ /gsum/ lo rgyus khrod kyi yang dag nyams myong dpe la bkod nas brjod don legs par bstan pa/ dper na/ rab tu byed pa gnyis pa las/chen pos dgra la byams byas na/ /dgra nyid de yi dbang du 'gyur/ /mang bo bkur bas kun bskyangs pas/ / kun gyis rgyal por dbang bskur

178 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/ro/ /zhes par mtshon na/ chen po ste rgyal po'am dpon po dag gis phas rgol gyi dgra rnams byams pa dang brtse bas bskyangs na dgra de yi blo kha tshur la bsgyur nas rang gi dbang du 'dus par 'gyur ba'i gnas lugs de/ sngon rgya gar gyi rgyal po mang bkur gyis phan bde'i dpal gyis skye bo thams cad ris med du bskyangs pas/ skye bo thams cad mang bkur rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dras /sdu/kā patā rgyal por bkur ba'i lo rgyus kyi nyams myong de yis mtshon par gzhasna yang / legs bshad kyi bstan bcos 'di nyid mngon brjod dang brda rnying gis ma bcings ba dang / sho lo ma'i tshig rkang phal che ba zhig tsheg bar bdun ma yin pa/ brjod bya gcig la dpe don zung 'brel yin pa/go bde la bden pa'i gnas lugs dang mthun pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rtsom stangs khyad chos kyang thon yod/ mdor na/ sa skya legs bshad ni bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus steng thog dang por byung ba'i legs bshad kyi bstan bcos khyad du 'phags pa zhig yin zhing / legs bshad 'di nyid kyi shugs rkyen zab mo thebs pa'i 'og tu/ phyis su bsod nams grags pas mdzad pa'i mkhas pa dang blun po brtag pa'i bstan bcos dge ldan legs bshad pad dkar chun po dang / 'ju mi pham rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i rgyal po lugs kyi bstan bcos sa gzhi skyong ba'i rgyan dang / gung thang bstan pa'i sgron mes mdzad pa'i chu shing bstan bcos sogs rim par byung nas/ gangs can gyi rtsom rig bang mdzod khrod du legs bshad kyi bstan bcos ji snyed cig 'phel rgyas su song ngo / /

bod kyi snga dar rtsom rig 179don tshan lnga ba/ byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngu'i rtogs brjod/dang po/ rtsomapa po'i lorgyusamador bstan pa/gangs can mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po shar tsongs pa chen po blo bzang grags pa mchog ni spyi lo 1357lo'i hor zla bcu ba'i tshes bcu'i nyin gyi snga dro'i char/ mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi zi ling grong khyer dang thag nye ba'i tsong kha'i yul du/ yab klu 'bum dge dang yum shing bza' a chos gnyis kyi sras su bkra shes pa'i ltas bzang bo dang bcas legs par 'khrungs so/ /yab yum gnyis la sras drug yod pa las khong rin po che ni srun bzhi ba yin la/ khong dgung lo gsum la bzhes skabs/ sha ba ri rdzong du kurma rol ba'i rdo rje las dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa bzhes te mtshan la kun dga' snying bo gsol/ dgung lo bdun la bzhes skabs/ bya khyung dgon pa ru chos rje don grub rin chen gyi drung du khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung ste mtshan la blo bzang grags pa zhes gsol/ de nas bgrang bya dgu'i ring la/ chos rje don grub rin chen mchog gi sku mdun du gus rtag sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus kyis chos dang rig gnas la slob gnyer legs par mdzad nas bzhugs pa dang /dgung lo bcu drug bzhes skabs/ chos rje don grub rin chen gyis legs par bskul ba dang / khyad par du rang nyid kyi thugs la phebs par dgongs pa'i spro shugs bzlog tu med pa skyes nas/ dgung lo bcu bdun bzhes skabs te/

180 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/chu glang gi lo'i ston kha der dbus ljongs su zhabs kyi padmo bskyod do/ /dbus ljongs su phebs rjes lo ngo drug gi ring la rim gyis 'bri khung dpal gyi nags khrod dang / gsang phu bde ba can/ myang stod dang / zhwa lu/snar thang dang / sa skya/ bo dong sogs su phebs nas/ lo tsā ba mkhan chen rin chen rnam rgyal dang / sa bzang paṇa chen ma ti ba/ dbu ma ba brtson 'grus seṅge/ lho brag grub chen nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ rje red mda' ba/bragor mkhan chen chos skyong bzang bo sogs bla na mtho ba'i mkhas grub skyesachen dam pa bcu phrag lhag gi zhabs sbyi bos legs par bsten nas/ mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i gzhung lugs mtha' dag la thos pa rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu phyin par mdzad pa dang / thos bsam sgom gsum gyi rim pa brgyud de 'chad pa dang / rtsod pa/ rtsom pa gsum gyi rmad byung 'phrin las kyis sangs rgyas bstan pa nyin mo ltar gsal bar mdzad pas/ mkhas pa'i grags snyan phyogs kun tu khyab bo/ / dgung lo so gnyis bzhes skabs/bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan 'grel ba dang bcas pa'i rnam bshad chen mo legs bshad gser gyi phreng ba bcoms pa dang / sbyi lo 1401la byang chub lam rim chen mo rtsom 'go btsugs shing / sbyi lo 1402la bcoms nas yongs su grub/ spyi lo 1406la gsang sngags lam rim chen mo bcoms nas yongs su grub bo/ /de la ngag dbang mkhyen rab bzang bos/mkhyen brtse nus pa'i bsil ri'i spor 'gying thos bsam sgom pa'i lus stobs rgyas/ / 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i nga ro cher sgrogs mkhas bzang bo'i g.yu ral ngom/ / rgol ngan log smra'i so can lto ba thal 'gyur sder mos 'dral /sprad sdu/ sbo/ khyab bdag 'jam dbyangs bla ma blo bzang grags pa gdong lnga'i /sang wa/ /zloktas/ shi/nga gsol ba ltar ro/ /

bod kyi snga dar rtsom rig 181de nas lha sar smon lam chen mo gsar du 'dzugs pa'i yo byad sna tshogs sta gon mdzad de/ ra sa 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang gi rten dang brten pa bcas la zhig gso dang sku brnyan la na bza'/ rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan la sogs pa'i mchod pa'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams tshags su chud par mdzad/ rje nyid dgung lo nga gsum bzhes skabs/ (spyi lo1409)rab byung bdun pa'i sa glang lo'i hor zla dang po'i tshes gcig nas bco lnga'i bar cho 'phrul chen mo'i dus mchod kyi mchod pa dngos gzhi mdzad la/ de'i dus su phyogs so so nas phebs pa'i dge 'dun brgyad stong lhag zhal 'dzoms byung ba la hor zla dang po'i tshes gcig nyin rje bdag nyid chen po nyid kyis bsnyen bkur mdzad cing / jo bo shākya mu de'i snang brnyan la rin chen sa le sbram gyi dbu rgyan/ rin po che sna tshogs pas phra bkod pa gser gyi dar dpyangs dang bcas legs par phul ba dang / jo bo mi bskyod rdo rje dang / thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal la dngul dkar gyi dbu rgyan bzo bkod rmad du byung ba 'bul bar mdzad pa sogs mchod pa'i sprin bzang bsam gyis mi khyab pas dkrigs shing / mdo dang rgyud sde nas byung ba'i cho ga rnam par dag pas legs par mchod de phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa yongs su mnyes par mdzad do/ /de nas lha sa'i shar byang sa khul dbang bskur ri'i ldebs su (deng sang stag rtse rdzong khongs la gtogs)dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling legs par btab pa dang / de nas rim bzhin bde chen gsang sngags mkhar phyag btab cing / se ra 'bras srungs dang rgyud grwa stod smad 'dzugs pa'i bkod pa bcas mdzad la/ rgyal tshab dar ma rin chen/ mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang /dge 'dun grub sogs slob ma mang du bskyangs nas/ ri bo dge ldan pa'i grub /shā kā sdu kāswā rnyidzñādhi mdzad pa dang zhwa ser bstan pa sa steng na 'gran pa'i zla

182 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/de ltar/ rje bdag nyid chen po 'di nyid kyis mkhas btsun bzang gsum dang thos bsam sgom gsum/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi 'phrin las brjod kyis mi lang zhing bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdzad pa dang / dgung lo drug cu re gsum bzhes pa'i spyi lo 141mil sku mya ngan las 'das nas dgongs pa chos dbyings su 'thims pa'o/ / de yang rje bdag nyid chen po'i gsung gi mdzad pa'i skor la khyon bsdoms bstan bcos po ti bcu dgu yod cing / de'i khrod na snyan rtsom dang rtogs brjod/ bston pa/ gsol 'debs/ 'phrin yig smon lam/ zhal gdams sogs brgya phrag lhag bzhugs/rtogs brjod kyi skor la/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngu'i rtogs pa brjod pa snyan ngag dpag bsam gyi ljon pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po grags pa byang chub dpal bzang bo'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i snyan ngag byin rlabs kyi lhun po dang / rang gi rtogs pa brjod pa rtogs brjod 'dun legs ma bcas bzhugs/bstod pa'i skor la/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten thams cad kyi ma 'dris pa'i mdza' bshes chen po ston pa bla na med pa la zab mo rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba gsungs pa'i sgo nas bstod pa legs par bshad pa'i snying bo dang / lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten kun gyi skyabs gcig pu rgyal ba byams pa mgon po la smre sngags kyi sgo nas bston pa tshangs pa'i co pan dang / rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs la bstod pa 'jam dbyangs mnyes par byed pa'i bstod thin rgya mtsho dang / bcom ldan 'das gtsug tor rnam rgyal ma la bstod pa 'chi med grub pa bcas yongs su grags pa'i bstod chen bzhi dang /gzhan yang sgra dbyangs lha mo dbyangs can ma'i bstod pa dang / chos rje grags pa byang chub kyi bstod pa sogs bzhugs pa yin no/ /dedag las snyan ngag rnams/ rgyan rnam pa sna tshogs kyis brgyan cing /

bod kyi snga dar rtsom rig 183ro nyams phun sum tshogs pa'i bsung ngan 'thul ba dang / rna bar snyan zhing yid 'phrog la/ rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i rmad byung sgyu rtsal gyi khyad chos dang ldan pa yin te/ 'jam dbyangs bstod sprin rgya mtsho las/bsod nams tshogs rab rab 'byams rgyu las 'khrungs pa'i sku mchog mchog tu mdzes pa khyod kyi sku/ / nam mkha'i mthas gtugs gtugs pa med pa'i zhing mchog kun du du ma'i 'gro la mig 'phrul bzhin/ / la lar bltam zhing zhing gzhan du yang byang chub tshul ston ston pa khyod kyi sku yi ni/ / bkod pa mchog 'di 'di dang gzhan du ma lus 'gro kun kun mkhyen gyur kyang brjod mi nus/ /phyogs bcu'i zhing kun kun nas 'gebs pa'i sgra skad skad kyi dbye ba mtha' yas pa/ / sems can kun yid yid dang mthun par tshim byed byed po'i gsungs kyang zil gnon pa/ / khyod kyi gsung dbyangs dbyangs kyi nga ro'i dkyil 'khor 'khor ba srid du rgyun chags pa'i/ / snyan pa'i gsung gang gang gi rna ba'i lam du lhung na na rga 'chi ba 'phrog par byed/ / dngos 'dzin chang gis rab tu myos pas blang dor dpyod pa'i blo gros nyams/ /nyon mongs gdug pa'i sna yi lag pas dge ba'i ljon pa kun tu 'joms/ / sred pa'i zhags pas yid ni drangs pas rnyed bkur glang mo'i phyir 'brang ba/ / bag med nags khrod kun tu rgyu ba'i gdul dka'i yid kyi glang bo che/ / dran shes bag yod thag pas dam bcings nas/ /yang dag rig pa'i lcags kyu rnon po yis/ /'phags mchog bye bas bgrod cing bsngags pa yi/ /rten 'brel dam pa'i lam bzang srol du btsud/ / byu nu'i mdangs dang 'dres pa'i gser zangs mdog /mdog legs shes bya ma lus lhang nger mkhyen/ /mkhyen rab ༵༵༵ // /// bye/ngas 'gro ba'i skyabs/ / skyabs mchog khyod kyis rab ces rna bar 'jebs shing yid dbang 'phrog pa'i sdeb legs snyan ngag

1phri bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/gi sgra rgyan la legs par bcings nas bcoms pa lta bu'o/ /gong nas mdor bsdus su bshad pa 'di ni rje tsong kha pa blo bzang grags pa'i lo rgyus yin zhing / nga tshos khong gi lo rgyus 'di las shes thub pa ni/ khong ni sangs rgyas bstan pa'i gser ri'i stong la rmad byung 'phrin las mchog gi 'odazer lam lam 'gyed pa'i chos kyi nyi ma'am sangs rgyas gnyis pa yin la/gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir mnyam pa med pa'i ri bo dge ldan pa'i grub mtha' gsar 'dzugs mdzad pa'i chos kyi rgyal po dang / 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi 'phrin las rgya cher spel ba'i gangs can mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan yin pa de red/gnyisapa/ rtag cangu'i rtogasabarjod kyi brjod don dang bsamablo'i rang bzhin/de yang rtag tu ngu'i rtogs pa brjod pa snyan ngag dpag bsam gyi ljon pa zhes pa 'di ni/ rtsom pa pos 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa brgyad stong ba las/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po rtag tu ngus sngon shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'tshol ba na ji ltar yongs su btsal ba'i lo rgyus te/ ji skad du/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor gyis 'di skad ces gsol rto/ / bcom ldan 'das/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rtag du ngus sngon shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di 'tshol ba na/ ji ltar yongs su btsal ba lags/ de skad ces gsol ba dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor la 'di skad ces bka' bstsal to/ / de skad byang chung sems dpa' rtag tu ngus shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ji ltar btsal ba'i lo rgyus gzhir bzung ste/ tshigs bcad lhug spel ma'i lam nas

bod kyi snga dar rtsom rig 18dra/galhab/du zitshu du/rtsams pa zhig ṭwāṃ / /gasna brjod 'di'i brjod spyan zlonabye nga ༵ ba bsdu zlos / zlo/ dhi / ༵ /shā rshaX nar ༵/ kyi pha rol tu phyin pa btsal ba'i ched du lus ngal ba dang / gnyid dang rmugs pa dang / bza' ba dang bca' ba dang / nyin mo dang mtshan mo dang / tsha ba dang grang ba sogs yin la ma shar zhing / phyogs dang phyogs mtshams su ma bltas par yul shar phyogs su song song ba na/ de'i mdun du de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs shin tu mdzes pa lta na sdug pa/ mthong ba tsam gyis yin 'phrog pa zhig byon nas/ legs so legs so/ rigs kyi bu shar phyogs su songs shig 'di nas dpag tshad lnga brgyar song ba'i sa na grong khyer spos ldan zhes bya ba yod de/de na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / de ni yun ring bor khyed kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen yin pas//rsha swākā / //rdzu ༵ / de las shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa thos par 'gyur de nas byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngus yin la gzhan ci yang ma bsam par/ dmigs pa'i tshang tshing ma lus par sreg par byed pa'i dus mtha'i nyin byed/ blo gros kyi mig sdongs pa rnams la shes rab kyi mig sbyin par byed pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags de bdagagis dus nam zhig na mthong bar 'gyur ram snyam du yid la byed kyin yul shar phyogs su song song ba na 'di ltar bsam ste/ bdag ni shin tu dbul bar gyur pas byang chub sems dpa' chos 'phags la gos rin po che'am/ gser dang dngul dang / mu tig dang byu ru dang / mu men dang beeḍūrya la sogs pa'i rigs sam/ spos dang me tog dang / phreng ba dang byug pa dang / bdug pa la sogs pa'i bsnyen bkur byed pa'i mchod rdzas ni bdag

186 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/la med/ bdag 'di bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' chos 'phags kyi drung du song na ni/ bdag gis tshul ma yin par byas pa yin no snyam du grong khyer zhig la song ste/ phangs pa dang 'gyod pa med par bdag gi lus btsongs te de yi rin thang gis dge ba'i bshes gnyen chos 'phags la bsnyen bkur byed do dgongs nas grong la bzhud do/ /de nas rtag tu ngus rang nyid kyi lus btsong bar 'don nas grong khyer gyi bzhi mdo zhig tu bsdad nas/ su la bdag gi lus 'di mkho/ su la bdag gi lus 'di dgos zhes yang yang skad brgyab/yin na'ang su zhig kyang ma slebs pas/ kye ma bdag ni skal ba dman pa zhig go snyam du sems shing 'dren byed las mchi ma bzhur bzhin bsdad do/ /tshul de lha'i dbang bo brgya byin gyis mthong nas/ byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngu'i lhag pa'i bsam pa brtag pa'i slad du/ bram ze khye'u zhig tu sprul nas de'i mdun du slebs te/ rigs kyi bu khyod ci'i phyir du yid khong du chud cing mig nas mchi ma bzhur ba yin zhes smras pa la/ rtag tu ngus/ bdag gis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'tshol ba'i phyir du rang gi lus btsongs nas de'i rin thang gis legs skyes shig nyos te byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags la bkur bste bya snyam pa yin yang / bdag gi lus nyo mkhan su yang ma rnyed pas/ de'i slad du'o zhes smras/ de nas bram ze khye'u des/ bdag gis mchod sbyin dang sbyin bsreg sgrub pa'i rdzas mi'i sha dang /snying dang / khrag dang / rkang dang nus pa la sogs 'tshol ba yin/ gal te khyod kyis de dag bdag la gtong nus na/ khyod la mkho ba'i rin po che dang mchod pa'i rdzas rnams bdag gis khyod la ci 'dod du sbyin no zhes smras pas/rtag tu ngu rab tu dga' bar gyur te/ tsham tshom med par rang gi brla g.yas sna // ṭwāṃ // sdos phug pa dang / khrag zags bzhin rtsig pa'i drung du rus pa

bod kyi snga dar rtsom rig 187tshulade yul de'i tshong dpon gyi bu mo gzugs mdzes shing lta na sdug pa/lang tsho dar la bab pa/ mig zung utpal sngon po 'dra ba/ sku mthon mthing gi mdog 'dzin pa/ nu ma rab tu rgyas pa/ dga' tshal gyi lha'i bu mo lta bu zhig yod pa de rang gi pha'i khang ba'i yang thog gi steng na/ gzhon nu ma 'khor brgya phrag du mas yongs su bskor te/ pha la rol mo dkrol zhing gnas pa des mthong bar gyur to/ /mthong nas kyang myur ba myur du khang ba'i yang thog nas mar babs te 'ongs shing / rtag tu ngu'i rnam pa mthong ba'i mod la/ lus ni rlung gis bskyon pa'i ljon shing ltar 'dar zhing / mig zung las mchi ma bzhur bzhin/ lang tsho dar la bab pa'i mi lus dal 'byor rin po che 'di/ khyod kyis ci'i phyir phangs pa med par bram ze 'di la gtong ba yin zhes smras pa la/rtag tu ngus/ sring mo lags/ bdag ni shin tu dbul bas dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten phyir mchod pa'i rdzas mkho bas lus bram ze 'di la gtong ba yin zhes smras pa na/ tshong dpon gyi bu mos/ khyod kyis der bsnyen bkur byas na yon tan ci zhig 'thob bam zhes dris pa la/ rtag tu ngus/ skye bo thams cad kyi rgyan du 'gyur ba dang gting mtha' zab pa'i stong nyid gsal ba'i phyir du/rmad byung brtson 'grus skyed nas rnam grol gyi go 'phang 'thob par spro bas yin zhes smras so/ /de la tshong dpon gyi bu mos 'di snyam du bsam pa/ kye ma skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis chos kyi phyir rang gi lus kyang rtsa ltar 'dor bar byed na/zang zing gi longs spyod la su zhig chags par byed/ de bas/ byang chub sems dpa' 'di la mkho ba'i nor bu dang mu tig dang / gser dang dngul dang / spug dang rdo'i snying bo dang / man shel dang byu ru dang / mu men dang beeḍūrya dang / gzhan yang gos dang rgyan cha dang / bza' ba dang bca' ba dang / myang ba dang bldag par bya ba rnams dang / me tog dang bdug pa dang dri bzang dang phye ma dang / rol mo la sogs pa thams cad bdag gi pha tshong
