188 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/dpon gyi khyim nas blangs te/ byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngu la byin nas/bdag kyang dge ba'i bshes gnyen der blta ba dang bsnyen bkur ba'i slad du zlo // ṭwāṃ du 'gro bar bya'o snyam nas/ rtag tu ngu la zhus pa na rtag tu ngus khas skabs der/ lha'i dbang bo brgya byin gyis kyang rtag tu ngu'i lhag pa'i bsam pa la dad pa skyes nas/ sprul ba'i khye'u'i lus gzugs mi snang bar byas shing rang gi lus gzugs mngon sum du bstan nas/ rigs kyi bu bdag la sha dang khrag dang rkang dag gis dgos pa med de/ bdag khyod kyi nyams sad pa'i phyir 'ongs so/ /rigs kyi bu legs so legs so/ /khyod la brtson pa 'di lta ṭī hā/ //ngadu bkā shādri rnyi 'di lta bu ldan na ni legs so legs so zhes smras de nas tshong dpon gyi bu mos rtag tu ngu khyim du gdan drangs nas kho mo'i pha las gser dang dngul/ nor bu dang mu tig byu ru dang man shel/ spug pa dang rdo'i snying bo/ beeḍūrya dang mu men/ gzhan yang gdugs dang rgyal mtshan/ ba dan dang phye ma'i phur ma/ gos rin po che dang smos/ me tog dang byug pa/ zhal zas dang rol mo'i tshogs sogs blangs te/ rgyan cha legs par spras pa'i g.yog mo lnga brgya dang / yab yum gnyis dang tshong dpon gyi bu mo//tā /sna ༵༵༵ kā ༵༵ spyu tu ngu bcas shing rta la bsdad nas grong khyer chen po de ltar song song ba las/ rtag tu ngus rgyang ring bo nas grong khyer spos ldan de'i dbus na byang chub sems dpa' chos 'phags kyis skye bo brgya stong du ma la zab yangs chos kyi dga' ston 'gyed bzhin pa mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang rgyang ring sa nas shing rta las babs te rkang thang du phebs pa dang / de nas rim gyis phebs pa na/ rin po che sna bdun las grub pa'i grong khyer de

bod kyi snga dar rtsom rig 189mdzes shing lta na sdug pa dang / grong khyer der 'byor ba rgyas shing skye bo mang bos gang ba/ khor yug kun tu 'bras ldan gyi smon shing rnam par brgyan pa/bkod legs khang bzang rnams la gser gyi dril bu dang g.yer dril gyi dra bas khebs pa la rlung gis btab tshe snyan pa'i sgra bar med du sgrog go / grong khyer gyi phyi rol du yan lag brgyad ldan gyi mtshe'u 'khyil ba dngag/ mtshe'u de dag gi khrod na me rtog padma dang utpal sogs rnam par bzhad pa las dri bsung kun tu 'thul ba la sogs pa'i mdzes sdug brjod kyis mi lang ba rnams mthong ngo / /de nas rim gyis song ba na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags rin po che'i khri la bzhugs nas skye bo'i tshogs du ma la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ston pa dang / sems can de dag gis kyang la la ni lung nod/ la la ni kha ton byed/ la la ni yi ger 'bri/ la la tshul bzhin yid la byed pa bcas so sor rtogs par byed pa la legs par mjal zhing /rin po che dang gos rgyan dang / me tog sogs byang chub sems dpa' chos kārjikāswā kā //ga par mchod pas na/ de dag gang gi mthong yangs su gur du du sdo /tre rte/ tu ngu/ dang tshong dpon gyi bu mo la sogs pa'i bu mo lnga brgyas byang chub sems dpa' chos 'phags kyi ga la bar zab mo stong ba nyid la sogs pa'i chos gsan nas re zhig song ba dang byang chub sems dpa' chos 'phags stan las bzhengs te rang gi pho brang du phebs nas/ pho brang nang du lo bdun gyi bar du ting nge 'dzin gcig la snyoms par bzhugs so/ /lo bdun gyi ring la/ byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngus gnod sems dang / 'dod pa dang / rnam par 'tshe ba'i rtog pa cung zad tsam yang yid la ma skyes par/ byang chub sems dpa' chos 'phags ting nge 'dzin las bzhengs nas bdag cag la chos nam zhig ston par 'gyur ram snyam pa yin la

17 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/shar na/ rno/ rsha // ring/ 'gor ba na/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po chos 'phags zhag bdun 'gor rjes ting nge 'dzin las bzhengs te grong khyer gyi dbus su byon nas chos ston par 'gyur ro zhes bar snang gi lha rnams kyis bsgrags pa rtag tu ngus thos pas/ yid la dga' ba dang mgu bas khengs nas tshong dpon gyi bu mo la sogs pa'i bu mo lnga brgya dang bcas pas sa phyogs der gtsang spra dang byi dor gang bzang byas pa dang / rin po che'i khri stong du bu mo de shākyā // // shā sprang go sna phun de byang chub sems dpa' chos 'phags bzhugs de nas rtag tu ngus sa phyogs der chu gtor nas chag chag 'debs par 'dod nas phyin pa na/ bdud sdig pa can gyis bar chad bzo bar bsam nas chu thams cad mi snang bar byas pas sa kun tu chu btsal kyang ma rnyed do/ / de la byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngus mtshon rnon pos rang gi lus phug ste bzhur ba'i khrag gis sa phyogs de'i kho ra khor yug tu chag chag btab pa la/tshong dpon gyi bu mo la sogs pa'i bu mo lnga brgyas kyang de ltar mdzad nas byang chub sems dpa' chos 'phags la bsu ba mdzad pa na/ lha'i dbang bo brgya byin de dag gi bla na med pa'i mdzad spyod la ngo mtshar zhing mos gus skyes nas sa la gtor ba'i khrag de rnams lha'i tsan dan gyi chu la byin gyis brlabs so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chos 'phags khri la bzhugs nas zab gsang chos kyi dga' ston bkyes pa na/ rtag tu ngus chos la dbyis phyin par gsan pas/ mthar khong nyid mang du thos pa rgya mtsho lta bur gyur cing / tshe /bas kun tu sangs rgyas mthong ba dang sangs rgyas dang mi 'bral bar gyur gong nas mdor bsdus pa 'di ni rtag tu ngu'i rtogs brjod kyi brjod

bod kyi snga dar rtsom rig 191don yin zhing / brjod bya'i don gyi snying bo 'di'i steng nas bsam gzhigs dang dpyad pa byas na/ rtogs brjod 'di nyid kyi bsam blo'i rang bzhin ni/byangachub sems dpa' rtag tu ngus sngon shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa btsal ba'i slad du/ brtson 'grus chen po bskyed nas dka' thub spyad pa dang /snying stobs chen po bskyed nas sbyin pa btang zhing bzod pa sgom pa dang /bsam pa brtan pos shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin par mdzad pa'i bla na med pa'i mdzad spyod la bsngags brjod kyi me tog gtor zhing dad gus kyi spos ngan bdugs pa dang / khyad par du/ snying rje chen po dang ldan zhing tshe rabs kun tu 'gro ba'i don la rab tu brtson pa'i khur chen khyer ba'i byang chub sems dpa'arnams byang chub kyi lam la phyogs pa'i tshe na kha phyir phyogs pa'i gnas skabasanam yang med par mthar thug bar du brtson pa ni/ rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i gang gā'i rgyun ni su zhig gis kyang phyir bzlog thabs med pa dang kun nas mtshungs so zhes byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi snang brnyan la tshad mthon po'i sgo nas bstod bsngags dang gdeng 'jog mdzad pa de yin no/ /gsumapa/ rtag cangu'i rtogasabarjod kyi rtsomastangasakhyad chos/gangs can mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po rje tsong kha pa blo bzang grags pa ni 'gran zla dang bral ba'i rtsom rig pa dang snyan ngag mkhan chen po zhig kyang yin te/ khong gis brtsams pa'i rtogs brjod dang bstod chen bzhi sogs la thun mong ma yin pa'i rtsom stangs khyad chos dang rmad du byung ba'i sgyu rtsal gyi rang bzhin ldan pas/ gangs can bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal dar rgyas gong 'phel du 'gro ba la shugs rkyen nges can zhig thebs

192 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyusarig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/yod pa bye/ tu/ ngu'i rtogs brjod ni bcad lhug spel mar bcoms pa zhig yin te/ tshig bcad rnams sdeb sbyor legs shing nyams 'gyur stong ldan gyis spras la chu bo bzhur bzhur du shar mar thon pa'am rang bzhin lhun gyis mdzes par grub pa ltar snang bas/ yin dbang 'phrog la yin la zad pa med pa'i mdze sa snang bskyed/ lhug pa rnams sbyor bde zhing kha gsal la gra dag pa'o/ /gsham du rtogs brjod khrod kyi snyan tshig skor zhig la blta bar bya'o/ /dpag med bskal bar gzhan dbang gyur pa'i snying rje shugs drag goms pa'i mthus/ /'gro ba'i don la rab tu brtson pa'i khur chen khyer bar gyur pa yi/ / sems dpa' mchog rnams byang chub spyod las phyir phyogs gyur pa'i /dro zlo drod de/ /rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i gang gā'i rgyun ni su zhig gis ni bzlog zhes rtogs brjod kyi 'go bcoms pa dang / de nas rtag tu ngus shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa btsal ba'i ched du yul shar phyogs su song song ba na/nam mkha' nas de bzhin gshegs pas lam bstan pa la/ rtag tu ngus/ji ltar rab dngas mtsho la gzugs brnyan ltar/ /dpag yas shes bya'i //sna rsha /sna /spra /zhekā/ gnye/ / dī rsha /hā/ nas srid pa mthar byed pa/ /zhes dris pa la/ nam mkhakhro nas de bzhin gshegs pas/bskal ba bskal bar 'bad pas bsnyen bkur ba'i/ / chos 'phags chos smra'i mchog de nyid dang mtshan/ / rtag tu rtag tu ngu yis brten nas su/ /snazlo hā/zlo /sta /chod pas mchod par gyis/ /de nas rtag tu ngus byang chub sems dpa' chos 'phags dge ba'i

bod khyi snga dar rtsom rig 193bshesaganyen la bsten na der bsnyen bkur byed pa'i rin chen nor bu med parabasam ste/ rang gi sha dang khrag sogs btsongs nas mchod rdzas nyo bar :spya kā /pa /dri sprar zhig gi bzhi mdo ru bsdad pa na nyo mkhan ma byung bas lhayi lam yangs ma yin zhing / / chu 'dzin gos dang bral na'ang / /khyod kyi gdong las mchi ma yi/ / char rgyun rtag tu 'bab pa 'di/ / 'jig rten char gyi rgyun dag gi / ya mtshan gzhom slad byas pa 'dra/ /zhes rtsom pa pos mdzes par brjod pa dang / skabs der lha'i dbang bo brgyasbyin gyis rtag du ngu la tshod bgam pa'i slad/ bram ze khye'u zhig tu sprul nasartag tu ngu'i sha dang rkang sogs nyo bar khas blangs pa na/ rtag tu ngus sdom /ma' dīkā rnyiswā ༷di gā /shā kārnyis pa gcog par brtsams pa'i gnas tshul skye ba gzhan du sbyangs (1 bsod nams mthus/ /de yi lus ni shin tu mdzes gyur te/ / 'chi med bu mo mngon sum snang ba bzhin/ / chags ldan skyesapo'i mig gi bdud rtsir gyur/ / de yi bzhin ras chu gter mdzes byed pa/ / mig gi utpal zung dag 'gran pa bzhin/ / brang gi dkyil 'khor nu ma'i khur gyis sgeg /ro smad rgyas shing skabs phyed yan lag mdzes/ / dul zhing yid gzhungs dbang bo nyer zhi ba/ / de ni na chung tshogs kyis yongs :sdi ṭwāṃ nā trī/nga 'a/rā //'i glu dbyangs lta bur snyan pa yi/ /pi wang sgra yis dga' de lta bu'i tshul gyis khang ba'i yang thog tu rang gi pha la rol mo dkrol bzhin dugapa de yis masang zheste/ skyen par rtag tu ngu'i gam du song nas gtam bye/ sna/ bye / /pa /kā /dri shā rsha/nga / / chags med 'od stong 'phro ba

194 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/can/ /rgyal sras spyod pa 'dab brgya'i gnyen/ / mthong bas bzang mo de yi yid/ /'jungs pa'i mun pa rab btang ste/ / gtong ba'i snang bas gsal gyur cing / / dang ba'i pad tshal cher rgyas nas/ / sems dpa' mchog la 'di skad smras/ / gang gis bdag nyid gdung byed pa'i/ / bya ba 'di las khyed thugs ldog / mchod pa'i yo byad mkho dgu dag /kho mos khyod la sbyin ṭī /dro ༵/ra 'a////ga kyang khyod la brten nas ni/ / sems dpa' mchog de ces tshong dpon gyi bu mos rtag tu ngu rang khyim la gdan drangs nas/ pha tshong dpon las mchod pa'i rin po che bsam gyis mi khyab pa blangs rjes/ tshong byeXnā ṭī zlo / ༵ /sdus pa'i bu mo lnga brgya dang bcas par grong khyer spos ldan sngonaspyad ma dros mtsho las legs 'ongs shing / / ngo mtshar spyod pa'i rlabs chen chal chil g.yo/ / brtson pa'i rba rlabs phreng ba drag tu 'khrugs/ /lhag bsam khur can rgyal sras gang gā'i rgyun/ /'jam pa'i lus mdzes dal ba'i 'gros dang ldan/ / snyan pa'i sgra sgrogs mdzes ma'i chu phran shā/sdu/sa/zhu/ /sdu/ //sa te shar gyi phyogs nyid du/ / spos ldan rgya mtsho'i — — rno tre byebyegatre /byed/ ma/dzad pa dang / de nas grong khyer spos ldan la 'byor ba na/ rtag tu ngus byang chub sems dpa' chos 'phags kyis skye bo'i // rdzu rjipa spyang du ma la chos ston bzhin pa'i tshul de rgyang ring bo nas mthong rgyu skar khrod na ku mun gnyen ltar mthong ba tsam gyis gdung ba sel /ri dgas khrod na seng ge lta bur 'khor du 'jigs pa kun dang bral/ / gling bzhi'i dbus na lhun po ji bzhin dge mtshan du mas kun nas brjid/ /ring

——— bodakyisngadar rtsom rig 195mo zhig nas yang yang yin la bcags pa'i chos 'phags de yis mthong / de tshe de yi yid kyi mtshor/ / dga' ba'i rlabs kyis bskyod pa ni/ / yang dag 'jog gi bsam gtan gyi/ / bde ba'i dper yang mi bzod do/ /zhes zhib 'bri mdzad pa dang de nas rim gyis song ba las/ grong khyer spos ldan gyi kho ra khor yug gi bkod legs khang bzang rnams dang / mtshe'u spyang / skyed mos tshal sogs kyi rmad byung mdzes sdug kyang mthong bar gyur pa 'og gzhi nor bu'i phung bo brdal ba bzhin/ / ngogs rnams ston ga'i 'ja' tshon bkra ba bzhin/ / 'di yi ngo mtshar rmad byung yon tan tshogs/ /mthong bar gyur tshe ches cher yid g.yo ba'i/ / beeḍūrya sngon po'i bzhu ba 'bab 'dra yi/ / rgya mtsho chen po'i lus kyi rlabs bskyod de/ / gang gi grong khyer mdzes pa skyed pa'i rgyan/ / gzugs mdzes yid thong dri dang ldan pa yi/ / sna sbyapas me tog gos bzang gyon nas su/ / lhun po dor te 'di ru 'ongs sam /lha/ ༵ ma/ 'i gos gyon cing / / me tog sar ba'i thod bcings te/ /bser bus dal gyis bskyod pa na/ / mgrin pa cung zad bkug nas ni/ /shub pa/ / /༷sa sngags zlo ba/ /'di dag sngon med rig sngags mkhan/ /ngogs rnams mdzes pa'i ljon shing du ma dkrigs/ / steng du sgru sdug bya rnams dga' bas rtse/ / 'gram na ldem ldem g.yo ba'i me tog tshogs/ / rdzing gi yon tan /thong tshe ngad/dazlo |/na/ / 'bad pas bsgrubs pa spyad /shā dū da/ // 'a/bye/ //byi nga gi/ bye/ bye/ rdzu la/ / bdag chur bzung ba cad

196 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/zhes zhib 'bri mdzad pa dang / de nas byang chub sems dpa'i zhabs kyi padmor legs par mjal nas/ gser dngul mu tig dang / chos gos rgyal mtshan dang / me tog bdug spos sogs bsnyen bkur byed pa'i mchod rdzas rnams chos 'phags la mchod pa na/ mchod pa rnams gang nyid kyi mthongs yangs / / ༵ nd+ra kṣiṃ /sdug kā sda/ste/ kā/kur phyir/ / phangs pa med par btang ba rnams/ /mkha' yis rang la byin snyam nas/ /lag pas dam du bzung ba 'dra/ / gzhan gyi 'byor ba du ma rnams/ / ma byin par yang bdag gir byed/ / rdzas la sred pa'i brnab sems can/ / khyod las khrel ba gzhan su zhig / yang na mchod rdzas mchod 'di mthong ba'i tshe/ / shin tu ya mtshan ldan pa'i blo skyes nas/ /'di la sa yis gos na mi rung zhes/ /mkha' yi bar snang dbyings la 'dir bkod pa bzhin/ /zhes rab rtog gi sgo nas brjod pa dang / de nas byang chub sems dpa' chos 'phags lo bdun gyi bar du ting 'dzin gcig la snyom par bzhugs pa dang / lo bdun nas slar yang grong khyer gyi dbus su chos ston par phebs pa la bsu ba byed slad/ rtag tu ngu dang tshong dpon gyi bu mo la sogs pa'i bu mo lnga brgyas sa la chag chag 'debs pa'i chu ma rnyed par/ rang gi lus mtshon non pos phug ste dmar bo khrag gis sa la chag chag btab pa la/de ltar khrag gi chag chag gis/ / sa gzhi kun nas bstar ba 'di/ /thun mtshams sprin gyi 'od dag gis/ / nam mkha'i ngos 'di khebs pa bzhin/ /gang gis 'bad pa rnam pa du ma yis/ /dpag yas bar chad rtsom la gzhol gyur kyang / / yar ngo'i zla ba 'phel ba ji bzhin du/ /'di yi snying stobs ches cher 'phel ba'i tshe/ / bdud dpung ma lus mya ngan gyur nas su/ / phyogs 'dir rang rang mgul ba bregs pa bzhin/ / chos smra bsten

bod kyi snga dar rtsom rig 197phyir chos la brtson tshul 'di/ / mig stong ldan pa'i mig gis mthong ba'i /ra/ bya/shā/ga gi chag chag ma la ya yi ri'i/ / tsan dan dri yis kun nas khyab zhes zhib 'bri mdzad pa las/ rje tsong kha pa'i snyan ngag gi rtsom stangs dngasgyu rtsal gyi khyad chos phyogs tsam rtogs nus la/ bod gangs can gyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal 'di tshad dma' sa zhig nas mtho sar gong 'phel dang dar rgyas su songaba'i go rim khrod du/ byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngu'i rtogs brjod snyan ngag dpag bsam gyi ljon pa 'di nyid ni/ rtog pa 'char yan ring lugs / hā/shā spras rnam par mdzes pa'i snyan rtsom mchog tu gyur pa zhig yin pa'ang

198 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/don tshan drug pa/ sgrol ma'i pho zang seng ldeng nags kyi bstod pa yid kyi lcags kyu/dang po/ rtsomapa po'i lorgyusamador bstan pa/rje stong kha pa chen po'i dngos slob dge 'dun grub pa ni/ gtsang ru lag gi sa'i cha dpal ldan sa skya'i nye 'dabs srad kyi lung lag gur me'i ru par yab mgon po rdo rje dang yum jo mo nam mkha' skyid gnyis kyi sras su spyi lo 1391lor sku 'khrungs/ mtshan padma rdo rjer btags/ dgung lo bdun lon pa'i tshe yab tshe las 'das/ khong rang 'khyar nas snar thang du slebs/ dpal snar thang gi mkhan rabs bcu bzhi ba'i sprul sku rje grub pa shes rab las dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa legs par bzhes/ brgya ston tsand+ra pa dang shākya dpal gyi drung du yi ge 'bri klog sbyangs pas tshegs chung ngus mkhas par mkhyen/ dgung lo bco lnga ba sbyi lo 1405lor gnas brtan chen po'i rnam 'phrul mkhan chen grub pa shes rab las rab tu byung zhing dge tshul gyi sdom pa mnos/ mtshan dge 'dunagrub pa dpal bzang bor gsol/ dgung lo nyi shu ba sbyi lo 1410lor grub pa shes rab kyis mkhan po dang / slob dpon chen po blo ldan pas las chog pa dang / chen po grags pa shes rab pas gsang ste ston pa mdzad de/ kha skong ba thos pa grangs tshang ba'i dge 'dun las bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i dge slong gi dngos po brnyes/ dgung lo nyer lnga ba shing lug ste spyi lo 1415lor dbus la phebs te rje bla ma dang mjal/ lo ngo bcu'i ring la gsang phu ne'u

bod kyi snga dar rtsom rig gluthog dang / ri bo dga' ldan dang / 'phan yul gros la sogs par mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi bla ma drug cu tsam gyi zhabs la gtugs/ khyad par bka' drin mtshungs med kyi bla ma gsum ste/ dang por bka' drin che ba mkhan chen rin po che grub pa shes rab dang / bar du bka' drin che ba thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang grags pa'i dpal/ tha mar bka' drin che ba mkhas grub shes rab seng ge zhes par grags/ de dag las mdo sngags kyi gsung rab mtha' dag la mkhas par sbyangs shing mi 'jigs pa'i spobs pa brnyes/dgung lo so lnga ba shing sprul lor gsung phu'i 'chad nyan mdzad/ so drug pa sbyi lo 1426lor gtsang du phebs/ snar thang byang chen dang / ri phun dang /brag dmar sogs su bzhugs te lo ngo bcu gnyis kyi ring la 'chad nyan dmar zhing grwa tshogs 'phel bar mdzad/ dgung lo zhe brgyad pa spyi lo 1438lor dbus su phebs/ dgung lo lnga bcu ba spyi lo 1440lor shes rab seng ge dang lhan du slar gtsang du phebs/ dgung lo nga bdun pa spyi lo 1447lor bkra shis lhun po dpal gyi sde chen po phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i gling btab cing rjes nas byams chen sku gsung thugs rten bsam gyis mi khyab pa bzhengs/ dgon pa btab nas lo ngo nye shu rtsa brgyad gyi ring la bstan pa'i bdag por mdzad de 'chad nyan nam yang chag pa med par gnangs/ dgung rsha ddhi sab shā kāṭā dī /sdo sdu/ rsha //sa nāng rta ste spyi lo 1474lor hor zla bcu khong nyid kyis dgung lo so lnga nas dgung lo gya bzhi'i ring la dam pa'i chosakyi 'chad nyan legs par mdzad pas/ skal ba dang ldan pa'i gdul bya mkhas pa dang / btsun pa dang / bzang bo dang / rnal 'byor la brtson pa'i slob mas gangs ri'i khrod ma khyab pa mi snang la/ ches phul du byung ba'i slob ma ni/ 'dul 'dzin dpal ldan bzang bo dang / rdo rje slob dpon bzang bo

— 2① bodakyirtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/bkra shes/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kun dga'i bde legs rin chen rgyal mtshan dpal bzang bo/ rab 'byams pa bstan pa'i nyi ma/ smon lam dpal legs pa'i blo gros/ mkhan chen bzod pa dpal grub/ mkhan chen shes rab rgyal mtshan sogs mchis so/ / khong nyid la brtsams chos 'dul ba'i gleng 'bum byeng / mdo smig dang / tshad ma'i ṭīkka sogs po ti bdun tsam bzhugs gnyisapa/ sgrolngama'i pho brang seng ldeng nagasakyi bstod pa yid kyi lcagasakyu dang de'i brjod don/'dren pa 'od dpag med pa'i smon lam dang / phyag na padmo'i spyan chab las 'khrungs nas/ / 'gro kun bde ba can du khrid mdzad ma/ / seng ldeng nags kyi lha mo'i zhabs la 'dud/ / rtag tu thabs mkhas thugs rje'i gru char gyis/ /mu med srid mtshor bying ba'i 'gro ba rnams/ / mchog tu zhi ba'i gling du sgrol mdzad ma/ /don la mtshan gsol sgrol ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ / khyod kyi gnas chen seng ldeng nags kyi tshal/ rnam dag zhing gi dpal la 'gran pa bzhin/ / rtsod dus 'dir yang nges par byung ba ni/ / yod ces 'di skad bdag gis gsal bar thos/ / seng ldeng mu dum wa ra rgya shug dang / / thang shing ta la dang ni nu gro dha/ /mya ngan med dang thal ba a ka ru/ /tsan dan dza ti li shi sogs kyi tshal/ /rkang 'thung bu mo lo 'dab gos kyis bklubs/ /me rtog thong mdzes 'bras bu'i rna rgyan 'chang / / phan tshun yal ga'i lag sprel do ra na/ / rlung gis skyod pa'i ljon shing gar mkhan ma/ / padma'i na chung sbrang rtsis myos pa rnams/ / glu len 'phur lding rol bas snang ba 'khrigs/ / ne'u

bod kyi snga dar rtsom rig 201tso smra mkhas bden pa'i tshig brjod cing / / rma bya mjug sgro bteg nas zlos gar byed/ /yid 'ong nags gyi bye'u sna tshogs dang / / zab mo'i gling bu sgyur ba'i khu byug sogs/ /'dab chags skad snyan sna tshogs sgrog pa ni/ / nags kyi bsngags pa brjod la 'gran pa bzhin/ / dom dang stag gzig dred dang ce spyang sogs/ /rgyug cing mchong dang dregs pas rnam par 'gying / / gdug pa'i rigs can gcan gzan de dag kyang / / gnod pa'i sems spangs ri dwags byams pas skyong / /spra dang spre'u yang rtsal 'gran byed cing / /kro sa ra yid phebs byi'u 'chun/ /nu zhos tshim pa'i ri dgas phru gu rnams/ /mig zum mjing ba bltabs nas bde bar nyal/ /'jigs med bde bar rgyu ba'i ri dwags rnams/ / phan tshun brtse bas 'ded pa'i bang ga sbyong / / kha cig mgrin pa bteg nas phyogs su lta/ / slar yang sngo ljang rtswa yi rtse mo 'dzin/ /nags tshal lta ba'i lha yi bu mo rnams/ / gdu bu 'khrol ba'i lag sbrel do ra bcas/ / 'jam mnyen yan lag skyod pa'i rnam 'gyur dang / / mgrin pa bsdebs nas drug ldan len la mkhas/ / rna ba'i dga' ston 'gyed pa'i dpal yon can/ / dri za'i na chung rgyud mangs sbreng byed cing / / dbyangs can mgrin par byed pa'i dpal yon can/ / ri dwags mig can bstod dbyangs rgya mtsho sgrog / 'bab chu'i na chung dbu ba'i 'dzum dkar can/ /yan lag brgyad ldan dal gyis 'bab pa'i rdzing / / gnam sngon zhun ma 'khyil 'dra'i chu ngogs na/ /rig 'dzin dga' ma rtse zhing khrus la 'jug / mthing ril ngur ba chu skyar gzhon nu dang / / bzhan dang khrung khrung ngang ba'i rgyal po sogs/ / mgrin pa'i nang nas snyan sgrog glu dbyangs mkhan/ / chu bya sna tshogs dga' zhing mtsho la lding / / phun tshogs nags tshal de yi dben pa'i ngos/ /yangs pa'i rdo leb zla ba lta bu'i steng / / me tog 'bras bu rgyas pa'i shing drung na/ /rig 'dzin grub pa rnyed pa'i rnal 'byor ba/ /'du 'dzis ma

202 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/gos zhi ba'i spyod lam can/ / drang por lus bsrang sems la blta ba bzhin/ /mig zur g.yo med ting 'dzin ro la chags/ / 'khrul med bsam gtan mdzad pa du ma bzhugs/ / steng nas chu 'dzin dkar bo'i stod g.yogs bgos/ / ngos nas 'bab chu'i mu tig do shal 'chang / / sked skabs nags tshal sngon po'i sham thabs can/ / sa 'dzin bu mos phyogs nas mdzes par bskor/ / lha yi lam la 'ja' 'od gus gyis phub/ /phyogs nas dkar 'jam sprin gyi bla res bres/ /de la 'phyang ba'i 'ja' tshon mdzes pa'i 'phan/ / sprin gseb lha rnams bla re 'dzin pa'i tshul/ / lha yi mkha' las babs pa'i me tog char/ / sa yi rdul gyis gos na mi rung zhes/ / rlung gis bteg nas bar snang 'khod pa rnams/ /nyi ma'i 'od dang 'grogs pas lhag par mdzes/ / 'og gzhi beeḍūrya yi ne'u gsing la/ / rin chen me tog du ma gcal du bkram/ /dzā ti tsam pa li shi sogs kyi dri/ /rlung gis bkug pa'i dri ngad bzang pos khyab/ /'chi med dbang bo'i bkod pa skyengs pa'i gnas/ /rgyal ba'i ye shes sgyu ma sprul ba der/ / mar gad ljon pa gom pa 'god pa bzhin/ /sgrol ma bzhengs dang 'byon gshegs spyod lam mdzad/ /de dbus rab gsal shel gyi sa gzhi bstar/ / rin chen tshon sna brgya yis rnam par bkra/ /rin chen sna tshogs 'bar ba'i khri steng na/ /dge ma mar gad mdog can nyi 'od 'phro/ /phyag g.yas sgrub la mchog sbyin phyag rgya dang / /g.yon pa 'jigs pa kun skyob skyabs sbyin can/ / gdul bya'i bung ba ye shes sprang rtsi'i ros/ /tshim mdzad utpal sngon pos phyag gnyis mdzes/ /g.yas na gser gyi mdog can 'od zer can/ /zhi ba'i nyams ldan rdo rje o sha 'dzin/ / g.yon na ral gcig sngon po khros pa'i sku/ / gri gug thod pa stag gi sham thabs can/ /gtso 'khor gsum ga lha yi na bza' dang / /mdzes sdug rgyan gyi khyad par sna tshogs kyis/ / brgyan pa'i mig gi bdud rtsir gyur pa ni/ / nags

bod kyi snga dar rtsom rig 203tshal de yi thig le lta bur bzhugs/ / rgyal yum mchod par rtsom pa'i lha mo ni/ / phul byung gzugs mdzes rnam dag zhing gi rgyan/ / yid 'phrog rgyan gyis spud pa sna tshogs kyis/ / mchod rdzas 'di dag gus pas bzung nas mchod/ /gnam sngon dri med 'ja' tshon sham bu can/ / khor yug skar ma'i do shal 'chang ba bzhin/ / mu tig chun 'phyang mdzes pa'i bla re dang / /dri zhim bdug pa'i sprin phung nam mkha'i rgyan/ / rgyab nas dar dkar brkyangs pa'i yol ba dang / / sna tshogs nor bu'i thig le bkra ba yi/ / lha yi gdugs dkar gser gyi yu ba can/ / rab mdzes rgyal mtshan ba dan gnam du bsgrengs/ / g.yas na rnga yab nor bu'i yu ba can/ / dril chung g.yer khas brgyan pa du ma dang / / rma bya gdong mdzes gshibs pa'i rlung g.yab rnams/ / zhi ba'i nags rlung g.yob la chas pa bzhin/ / g.yon na pi wang gling bu cang te'u/ / pa na ha dang rnga zlum rdza rnga dang / / 'bud dung g.yas 'khyil ka ling rnga bo che/ / tshangs pa'i dbyangs la 'gran phyir mchod pa 'dra/ /mdun du mchod yon rgya mtsho kun nas 'khyil/ /nyi zla la sogs nor bu'i snang ba gsal/ / ro brgya ldan pa'i lha yi zhal zas sogs/ / sna tshogs bcud 'dzin gser snod tshar du dngar/ / spel legs rin chen me tog phreng ba dang / / zla ba nya 'dra sgeg mo'i me long sogs/ / 'dzin mkhas lang tshos bsnyems pa'i mgrin snyan rnams/ / rtsed 'jo glu gar byed pas phyogs kun mdzes/ /gzhan yang lha mi'i mchod pa phul byung dang / / kun tu bzang bo'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho sogs/ /yid 'ong mchod rdzas ma lus gros byas nas/ /nags kyi lha mo'i drung du 'dus pa bzhin/ / lha dang mi dang rig pa 'dzin pa sogs/ / skal bzang du ma nyin bzhin 'ongs nas ni/ / sgrol ma'i zhal gyi bum pa bzang bo'i bcud/ /dad pa'i snyim pas 'thungs te rtag tu 'tsho/ /de ltar phun tshogs mtha' dag 'dus pa'i gnas/ / sgrol ma'i pho brang seng

bod kyi snga dar rtsom rig 203tshal de yi thig le lta bur bzhugs/ / rgyal yum mchod par rtsom pa'i lha mo ni/ / phul byung gzugs mdzes rnam dag zhing gi rgyan/ / yid 'phrog rgyan gyis spud pa sna tshogs kyis/ / mchod rdzas 'di dag gus pas bzung nas mchod/ /gnam sngon dri med 'ja' tshon sham bu can/ / khor yug skar ma'i do shal 'chang ba bzhin/ / mu tig chun 'phyang mdzes pa'i bla re dang / /dri zhim bdug pa'i sprin phung nam mkha'i rgyan/ / rgyab nas dar dkar brkyangs pa'i yol ba dang / / sna tshogs nor bu'i thig le bkra ba yi/ / lha yi gdugs dkar gser gyi yu ba can/ / rab mdzes rgyal mtshan ba dan gnam du bsgrengs/ / g.yas na rnga yab nor bu'i yu ba can/ / dril chung g.yer khas brgyan pa du ma dang / / rma bya gdong mdzes gshibs pa'i rlung g.yab rnams/ / zhi ba'i nags rlung g.yob la chas pa bzhin/ / g.yon na pi wang gling bu cang te'u/ / pa na ha dang rnga zlum rdza rnga dang / / 'bud dung g.yas 'khyil ka ling rnga bo che/ / tshangs pa'i dbyangs la 'gran phyir mchod pa 'dra/ /mdun du mchod yon rgya mtsho kun nas 'khyil/ /nyi zla la sogs nor bu'i snang ba gsal/ / ro brgya ldan pa'i lha yi zhal zas sogs/ / sna tshogs bcud 'dzin gser snod tshar du dngar/ / spel legs rin chen me tog phreng ba dang / / zla ba nya 'dra sgeg mo'i me long sogs/ / 'dzin mkhas lang tshos bsnyems pa'i mgrin snyan rnams/ / rtsed 'jo glu gar byed pas phyogs kun mdzes/ /gzhan yang lha mi'i mchod pa phul byung dang / / kun tu bzang bo'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho sogs/ /yid 'ong mchod rdzas ma lus gros byas nas/ /nags kyi lha mo'i drung du 'dus pa bzhin/ / lha dang mi dang rig pa 'dzin pa sogs/ / skal bzang du ma nyin bzhin 'ongs nas ni/ / sgrol ma'i zhal gyi bum pa bzang bo'i bcud/ /dad pa'i snyim pas 'thungs te rtag tu 'tsho/ /de ltar phun tshogs mtha' dag 'dus pa'i gnas/ / sgrol ma'i pho brang seng

2yo bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyusarig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/ldeng nags tshal dang / / rgyal yum dge ma 'khor dang bcas rnams la/ /zhing rdul mnyam pa'i lus kyis phyag 'tshal lo/ / dge ba 'di yis bdag gzhan 'gro ba rnams/ /skye ba kun tu sgrol ma'i zhabs pad la/ /btud nas dgyes pa'i phyag gis bzung ba'i mthus/ / rig 'dzin mchog gi go 'phang 'thob gyur cing / /legs bshad ri mo bkra ba'i lung gi gos/ /rnam dpyod gser gyi yu ba la brten cing / /bslab gsum nor bu'i tog gis rab mtshan pa'i/ /bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan phyogs bcur 'dzugs par shog /gsumapa/ bstod pa yid kyi lcagasakyu'i bsamablo'i nang don/bstod pa 'dir seng ldeng nags zhes pa ni gser ri bdun gyi ya gyal zhig ste/ ri'i rtse mo na seng ldeng nags tshal mdzes sdug dang ldan pa zhig yod pas na seng ldeng can zhes grags shing / gnas der bzhugs pa'i 'phags ma sgrol ma la seng ldeng nags kyi lha mo zhes zhu'o/ /lha mo 'di nyid ni ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas pas mchog sbyin/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis utpal thugs skar 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar sna tshogs kyis mdzes par spras pa/ ral ba'i cod pan can/ zhabs g.yas brkyangs shing g.yon bskums pa'i skyil krung phyed pas bzhugs pa/ g.yas su 'od zer can ma/g.yon du ral gcig ma bzhugs pa'o/ /de yang 'phags ma sgrol ma zhes pa ni 'jig rten gyi khams sna tshogs 'od ces bya bar rgyal po'i bu mo ye shes zla ba zhes bya bar 'khrungs te/ de bzhin gshegasapa rnga sgra'i mdun nas sems bskyed de bud med kyi rten la byang chub sgrub pa'i dam bcas/ sems can rnams bzod pa la ma bkod bar du 'tshang

bod kyi snga dar rtsom rig 205mi rgya bar gsungs te 'khor ba las sgrol bas na sgrol mar grags/ yongs grags su 'jigs chen brgyad las bskyabs pa'i lo rgyus ltar na/ shing 'thun zhig seng ge'i khar chud tshe 'di la skyabs su song bas bu mo shing lo rgyan pa zhig tu sprul te bskyabs pa dang / de bzhin phreng rgyud ma zhig glang smyon las dang /khyim me 'bar ba char gyis dang / smad 'tshong ma zhig dug sbrul gyis zin pa dang / tshong dpon zhig chom rkun gyis nyen pa las dang / chom thun zhig btson ra las dang / tshong ba mang bo rgya mtsho la nub pa las dang / dge tshul zhig sha zas zin pa lha mo nag mo zhig gis bskyabs pa sogs ltar ro/ /bstod pa 'dir sgrol ma'i pho brang seng ldeng nags kyi rang byung khor yug ste/ gnas der skyes pa'i ljon shing dang / nags la rol ba'i 'dab chags/mchong rgyug bgyid pa'i gcan gzan/ bag yangs rgyu ba'i ri dgas/ dwangs gtsang bsil ba'i 'bab chu/ /khral chil bzhad pa'i 'dab stong sogs mdzes tshon gyis ri mo bris pa ji bzhin zhib 'bri mdzad pa dang / khyad par du gang nyid la mchod par brel ba'i lha mo rnams kyi mtshar sdug nyams stabs dang bla bre dang yol ba/ rol mo/ zhal zas/ mchod rdzas sogs kun tu bzang po'i lha mi'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho dang / seng ldeng nags kyi thig le ru gyur pa'i 'phags ma sgrol ma mchog rin chen sna tshogs 'bar ba'i khri steng na bzhugs lha'i sku byad phul du byung la mdzes sdug rdzogs par 'bri bzhengs mdzad yod bstod pa 'di nyid kyi bsam blo'i nang don ni/ snyan ngag mkhan gyis bstod pa 'di nyid kyi mjug tu/ dge ba 'di yis bdag gzhan 'gro ba rnams/ / skye ba kun tu sgrol ma'i zhabs pad la/ / btud nas dgyes pa'i phyag gis bzung ba'i mthus/ / rig 'dzin mchog gi go 'phang 'thob gyur cing / /legs bshad ri mo bkra ba'i lung gi gos/ /rnam dpyod gser gyi yu

2yo bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/ba la brten cing / / bslab gsum nor bu'i tog gis rab mtshan pa'i/ /༵ / nā /shā rgyal mtshan phyogs bcur 'dzugs par shog / ces mdor bstan bzhi pa/ bstod pa yid kyi lcagasakyu'i sgyu rtsalakhyad chos/spyir rje dge 'dun grub dpal bzang bo'i snyan dngags kyi brjod don rgya che zhing tshig rgyan phun sum tshogs pas na bod kyi rtsom rig byung zhing 'phel ba'i lo rgyus steng go gnas nges can zhig bzung yod la/ dus phyis kyi rtsom rig la'ang dge mtshan ldan pa'i shugs rkyen thebs yod pa red/ sgrol ma'i pho brang seng ldeng nags kyi bstod pa yid kyi lcags kyu zhes pa 'di ni 'phags ma /rdo // // kā sdu / kta du phyin pa zhig yin phyir/ de la sgyu rtsal gyi khyad chos 1 seng ldeng nags tshal te rang byung khor yug ni mdzes tshon gyis ri /bye / ༵ sdo / bzhin zhib 'bri mdzad pas na yid la dga' ba dang mgu ba 2 snyan ngag gi rgyan gyis brgyan pa 'os shing 'tsham pas na tshig gi lo mas don gyi 'bras bu cher ma bsgribs pa'i khyad chos ldan pa dang /2 tshig la snyan pa dang / gsal ba dang / dag pa'i khyad chos ldan pas na bltar bde zhing de ma thag tu don rtogs pa dang /( sgrol ma gtso 'khor gsum dang / mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyi sku nyams cha byad mtshar sdug dang ldan par 'bri bzhings mdzad pas na yid la hārshasdu sdong zhi ba rgyas par byed la/ zad pa med pa'i mdzes snang stsol bar

2yo bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/ba la brten cing / / bslab gsum nor bu'i tog gis rab mtshan pa'i/ /༵ / nā /shā rgyal mtshan phyogs bcur 'dzugs par shog / ces mdor bstan bzhi pa/ bstod pa yid kyi lcagasakyu'i sgyu rtsalakhyad chos/spyir rje dge 'dun grub dpal bzang bo'i snyan dngags kyi brjod don rgya che zhing tshig rgyan phun sum tshogs pas na bod kyi rtsom rig byung zhing 'phel ba'i lo rgyus steng go gnas nges can zhig bzung yod la/ dus phyis kyi rtsom rig la'ang dge mtshan ldan pa'i shugs rkyen thebs yod pa red/ sgrol ma'i pho brang seng ldeng nags kyi bstod pa yid kyi lcags kyu zhes pa 'di ni 'phags ma /rdo // // kā sdu / kta du phyin pa zhig yin phyir/ de la sgyu rtsal gyi khyad chos 1 seng ldeng nags tshal te rang byung khor yug ni mdzes tshon gyis ri /bye / ༵ sdo / bzhin zhib 'bri mdzad pas na yid la dga' ba dang mgu ba 2 snyan ngag gi rgyan gyis brgyan pa 'os shing 'tsham pas na tshig gi lo mas don gyi 'bras bu cher ma bsgribs pa'i khyad chos ldan pa dang /2 tshig la snyan pa dang / gsal ba dang / dag pa'i khyad chos ldan pas na bltar bde zhing de ma thag tu don rtogs pa dang /( sgrol ma gtso 'khor gsum dang / mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyi sku nyams cha byad mtshar sdug dang ldan par 'bri bzhings mdzad pas na yid la hārshasdu sdong zhi ba rgyas par byed la/ zad pa med pa'i mdzes snang stsol bar

bod kyi snga dar rtsom rig 207don tshan bdun pa/ rje btsun bla ma chos rgyal po tsong kha pa chen po'i yon tan mdor bsdus par bsngags pa'i rab tu byed pa dad pa'i rol mcho/dang po/ rtsomapa po'i lo rgyusamador bstan pa/de yang mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang ni/ sbyi lo 1385lor yab kun dga' bkra shis dpal bzang dang yum bu 'dren rgyal mo gnyis kyi sras su gtsang la stod chu 'og tu sku 'khrungs/ sku na chung ngu'i dus nas tha mal ba'i spyod pa las ring du 'das shing / rig pa'i gnas kyi gzhung gang dang ci la gsan bsam mdzad rgyu'i dad brtson shugs chen pos drangs te ngam ring dang saskya sogs su phebs nas mkhas chen mang bo'i zhabs la gtugs te mkhyen rab kyi rtsal dang ldan par gyur pas kun gyi yid 'phrog par gyur/ de nas mkhas grub seng ge rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i drung nas rab tu byung zhing /mtshan la mkhas spub dge legs dpal bzang bo zhes gsol/ dgung lo nyer gcig pa spyi lo 1405lor rje btsun red mda' ba gzhon nu blo gros kyis mkhan po dang / rje dpal 'byor shes rab kyis las slob/ mnyam med blo gros mtshungs med kyis gsang ston mdzad nas bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi sdom pa yang dag par bzhes/ dgung lo nyer gsum pa sbyi lo 1407lor mnyam

208 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyu rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/med tsong kha pa chen po dang mjal/ de nas bzung dgung lo so lnga'i ring phal cher bcar bzhugs kyis mtshan mo tshun dbu sngas sprel te mdo rgyud man ngag gi gdams pa thams cad bum pa gang byo'i tshul du mnos pas mkhas btsun bzang grub dang 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi yon tan gyi gter du gyur/ rje tsong kha pa chen pos kyang 'phrin yig tshigs bcad ma'i mjug tu/ bstan pa'i rtsa lagadam pa sdom brtson chen po dka' bcu ba dge legs dpal pa zhes ched bsngags mdzad cing nang thugs kyi sras gcig pur gyur/ gzhan rgyal tshab dar ma rin chen dang 'dul ba 'dzin pa 'jam dkar ba sogs las zab chos mang du gsan/ de nas gtsang phyogs su phebs te/ bdag po rab brtan pa dang mchod yon du 'brel nas rgyal rtse dpal 'khor bde chen chos sde btab cing dge lugs pa'i grwa tshang mang du btsugs te 'jam mgon bstan pa'i snang byed dam par bzhings/ de nas ri bo mdangs can du byon te thugs dam mnyam bzhes la brtson pa dang / skal ldan gyi bu slob mang bor chos kyi dga' ston mdzad pa dang / mdo sngags kyi bstan bcos mang du mdzad/ dgung lo zhe bdun pa spyi lo 1431lor dga' ldan gser khrir mnga' gsol te gser tog cod pan 'chang ba'i mkhas grub rgya mtsho'i dbus su dpal mnyam med ri bo dge ldan pa'i bshad pa'i shing rta'i srol chen po legs par phye nas/ rje thams mkhyen pa'i dbu sngags zung 'brel gyi bstan pa rin po che cha thams cad nasagangs can bod nas shar rgya mtsho la thug gi bar du khyab gdal du spel ba'i phyag rjes khyad par can bskrun/ dgung lo nga bzhi ba sbyi lo 1438lor gzugs sku'i bkod pa bsdus te gshegs so/ / dam pa 'di nyid kyis chos kyi bdud rtsis rnam par bskyangs pa'i bu slob ni/ chos rje blo gros chos skyong dang /zhwa lu legs pa rgyal mtshan dang / rje shes rab seng ge dang / mkhas chen bsod nams mchog grub/ kun mkhyen 'phags pa 'od/ spyan snga ba blo gros

bod kyi snga dar rtsom rig 2glurgyal mtshan/ zhang zhung ba chos dbang grags pa sogs mkhas mchog grangs las 'das pa byung / gzhung rtsom pod dgu bzhugs so/ /gnyisapa/ rje btsun zamachosakyi rgyalapocong khapa po'i yon tan mdor bsdusapar bsngagasapa'i rab dubyed thadad pa'i rolamatsho dang de'i brjod don/oṃ bde legs su gyur cig bka' drin mnyam med de nyid kyi zhabs la gus pa chen pos phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ / phun tshogs dga' ldan lha brgya'i cod pan gyis/ / gang gi zhabs mthil padmo la reg pa/ /mi pham chos kyi mdun sa mdzes pa'i rgyan/ / 'jam dpal snying pos bdag la dge legs stsol/ /blo bzang mkhyen pa'i gting mtha' mi mngon zhing / / grags pa'i rlabs phreng rol ba'i 'jug ngogs las/ / dpal ldan yon tan chu yi thigs pa zhig / bzung phyir 'di ni dad pa'i 'bab stegs lags/ / thub bstan nub kyi ri rtser ni/ /thun mtshams gos dmar 'dzin gyur pa/ /de tshe khyod kyis shar ri'i rtser/ / legs bshad 'od brgya'i zeng ba 'dzin/ / de phyir rmongs pa'i tsha gdung gis/ / dus mthar nyen pa'i 'gro 'di la/ / rgyal ba'i legs bshad 'jug ngogs las/ / khyod kyi thugs rje'i 'od dkar bsil/ / rgyu med par yang mnyen gshin cing / / kun la snyoms par ches bsil ba/ /khyod kyi thugs rje'i zla ba ni/ /e ma snying la shin tu sman/ /nyid kyi don du skabs gsum pa'i/ / bde skabs me 'obs ltar 'khrigs kyang / /rang gi gnas bzhin 'khor ba 'di/ / gzhan phyir nyid kyis btang ma lags/ /blo gros mig ldongs 'gro 'di la/ /khyod thugs legs bshad rin

210 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/chen gter/ / da lta spo ba'i thabs gang zhes/ / e ma 'di nyid 'ba' zhig dgongs/ /thub pa'i legs bshad bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /'jam dbyangs zhal gyi bum pa las/ / legs 'ongs thos pa'i snyim pa yis/ / lus pa med par khyod kyis gsol/ / de lta'i bde bas khyod kyi thugs/ / rangs pa las kyang bde ba de/ / kun gyi longs spyod ma gyur pa/ / de yis khyod thugs lhag par gdungs/ /khyod kyi thugs rje'i ngang tshul 'di/ / mthong bas yid tshim gyur pa dag / rgyal ba kun gyi thugs rje yang / / ji 'dra snyam du khyogs la 'phyang / / rang don rtswa ltar dgongs khyod kyis/ / rgyal ba kun gyi dam pa'i chos/ /'dzin pa'i smon lam lus can gyi/ / dpung gnyen gyur pa ring nas mdzad/ / de phyir 'gro 'di dbugs 'byin cing / / bdud sde'i snying la 'jigs skyed pa/ /khyod kyi rlabs chen spyod pa yis/ / ma bslabs rgyal sras spyodade gang / /mi bzang dus mtha' 'di 'ongs tshe/ / khyod kyis ma bzung dam chos kun/ /chu dang bral ba'i padmo ni/ /ba mos reg pa lta bur gyur/ /dam chos gzung slad nyid kyi ni/ / sku srog la'ang ltos med par/ /dka' ba brgya phrag dag gis kyang / / zhi ba'i bde ba lta bur dgyes/ /snyigs ma las kyang ches snyigs pa'i/ /'jigs pa mi bzad 'jig rten 'dir/ /rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras po gzhan/ / mtha' dag mthong ba'i lam las 'das/ / de tshe thugs rje ldan pa khyod/ / so ga'i nyi mas 'gram pa'i chang / / zags ldan gnyis mthung padmo'i mtshos/ / ring nas bos ltar 'jig rten gzigs/ /gdugs pa'i sems can nyes pa yi/ /me lce shin tu bzod dka' ba/ /dam pa'i snying la brnag dka' ba'i/ /zug ju rnon po sbyin pa yang / /khyod thugs snying rje'i chu 'dzin ni/ /legs bshad dbyar skyes sprin gyi sgra/ /sgrog ldan chu char gzegs ma dag / phog pa tsam gyis zhi bar 'gyid/ / rgyal ba rnams kyang rang nyid kyi/ / bstan la btang snyoms mdzad gyur pa/ / gnas skabs

bod kyi snga dar rtsom rig 211'dir yang khyod kyis ni/ / rgyal ba bzhin du bstan pa spel/ / rgyal sras dag pa'i zhing gzhan na/ / dgyes dgur spyod pa mtha' dag las/ / snying stobs rmad byung mgon po khyod/ / mchog tu dga' ba bgyid pa lags/ / 'jig rten kun na mgon khyod dang / / phyogs gcig mtshungs pa'ang rnyed dka' nas/ /de phyir bdag gis khyod kyi dper/ / rgyal ba kho na yang yang sgrin/ /de tshe de nyid 'byed pa la/ / rgyal dang khyed dbyer ma mchis kyang / / thugs rjes rgyal ba'ang skyengs mdzad pa/ / de nas bdag cag dpe yis dbul/ /rgyalasras rgyu skar tshogs rnams kyis/ / yongs bskor rgyal ba'i zla ba ni/ /mtha' yas mngon sum mdzad pa yis/ / rab rgyas ku mun dgod par mdzad/ / 'on kyang rgyal bas rang gi sras/ / lung bstan dbugs dbyung mdzad pa gang / / de yi chos nyid de yin gyis/ / su zhig lhag par mtshar du brtsi/ / sdug pa'i bu la brtse ba'i mas/ / 'dzum pa'i bzhin ras bstan pa ni/ /kwa ye rab tu ya mtshan par/ /'dzin pa blo gros shin tu gzhon/ /khyod kyi thugs la nyon mongs kyis/ / glags skabs nam yang rnyed min pa/ /'di la'ang bdag ni de tsam du/ /ya mtshan gyur pa cang ma mchis/ /mtha' dag nor 'dzin mun pa'i gos/ /'phrog byed nyi ma'i 'od stong gis/ /skyed tshal mun pa bsal ba la'ang / /skye bo su zhig mtshar du brtsi/ / phyogs 'di thub pa'i gzhung lugs la/ /legs sbyangs blo gros ldan rnams dang / / rgyud ldan rnal 'byor brtson pa gang / / sus kyang spyod yul ma gyur pa/ / rgyal ba'i thugs kyi gces pa'i mdzod/ / ma lus rgyal ba'i dgongs pa bzhin/ / dri med rigs pa'i lam nas drangs/ /log pa'i g.yang sa kun las bsgral/ /de lta mod kyi khyod kyis ni/ / dus gsum rgyal ba'i dgongs pa bzhin/ /gcig tu sgrub pa snying bor mdzad/ / byang chub dam pa'i tshul yang bstan/ /tshul 'di gzhan du ma mthong bas/ /bdag nyid gnyis 'thung dad pa yi/ /

bod kyi snga dar rtsom rig 211'dir yang khyod kyis ni/ / rgyal ba bzhin du bstan pa spel/ / rgyal sras dag pa'i zhing gzhan na/ / dgyes dgur spyod pa mtha' dag las/ / snying stobs rmad byung mgon po khyod/ / mchog tu dga' ba bgyid pa lags/ / 'jig rten kun na mgon khyod dang / / phyogs gcig mtshungs pa'ang rnyed dka' nas/ /de phyir bdag gis khyod kyi dper/ / rgyal ba kho na yang yang sgrin/ /de tshe de nyid 'byed pa la/ / rgyal dang khyed dbyer ma mchis kyang / / thugs rjes rgyal ba'ang skyengs mdzad pa/ / de nas bdag cag dpe yis dbul/ /rgyalasras rgyu skar tshogs rnams kyis/ / yongs bskor rgyal ba'i zla ba ni/ /mtha' yas mngon sum mdzad pa yis/ / rab rgyas ku mun dgod par mdzad/ / 'on kyang rgyal bas rang gi sras/ / lung bstan dbugs dbyung mdzad pa gang / / de yi chos nyid de yin gyis/ / su zhig lhag par mtshar du brtsi/ / sdug pa'i bu la brtse ba'i mas/ / 'dzum pa'i bzhin ras bstan pa ni/ /kwa ye rab tu ya mtshan par/ /'dzin pa blo gros shin tu gzhon/ /khyod kyi thugs la nyon mongs kyis/ / glags skabs nam yang rnyed min pa/ /'di la'ang bdag ni de tsam du/ /ya mtshan gyur pa cang ma mchis/ /mtha' dag nor 'dzin mun pa'i gos/ /'phrog byed nyi ma'i 'od stong gis/ /skyed tshal mun pa bsal ba la'ang / /skye bo su zhig mtshar du brtsi/ / phyogs 'di thub pa'i gzhung lugs la/ /legs sbyangs blo gros ldan rnams dang / / rgyud ldan rnal 'byor brtson pa gang / / sus kyang spyod yul ma gyur pa/ / rgyal ba'i thugs kyi gces pa'i mdzod/ / ma lus rgyal ba'i dgongs pa bzhin/ / dri med rigs pa'i lam nas drangs/ /log pa'i g.yang sa kun las bsgral/ /de lta mod kyi khyod kyis ni/ / dus gsum rgyal ba'i dgongs pa bzhin/ /gcig tu sgrub pa snying bor mdzad/ / byang chub dam pa'i tshul yang bstan/ /tshul 'di gzhan du ma mthong bas/ /bdag nyid gnyis 'thung dad pa yi/ /

212 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/lcags kyus lan gcig min par drangs/ / ngo mtshar gyur nas spobs pa skyes/ /gang gi yon tan me tog gi / dog pa phyogs kyi mdzes ma'i rgyan/ /rab dkar grags pa'i dri bzhon ni/ / nor 'dzin bu mo'i yid srubs rgyal/ /mi mnyam mkhyen brtse'i rkang stegs kyis/ /mkhas mchog kun gyi mgo bo la/ / zhabs skyes rdul tshogs 'jogs pa gang / / zla med khyod la phyag bgyid do/ / dpal ldan sa yi mgon po bshes gnyen gyi/ / yon tan dri bzhin ma la ya yi rlung / /snying la reg pas dang ba'i yid g.yos te/ /mdor bsdus bstod pa'i tshig 'di gtam du byas/ /dge ba 'di yis tshe rabs kun tu bdag / khyod kyi legs bshad bdud rtsi 'thung ba la/ / ngoms pa med sdu/ rlabs chen spyod pa yis/ / rgyal ba'i dam chos mtha' dag 'dzin gyur gsum pa/ chosakyi rgyal po tsong khapa po'i yon tan mdor bsdusapar bsngagasapa zhesapa'i bsamablo'i nang don/de yang bstod pa 'di nyid kyi bsam blo'i nang don ni/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa blo bzang grags pa mchog gi thos bsam sgom gsum dang mkhyen brtse nus gsum/ mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi rmad byung yon tan dang / 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi khyad 'phags 'phrin las la sgo kun nas bsngags brjod mdzad pa dang / rje tsong kha pa chen pos dka' ba brgya phrag spyad nas sangs rgyas bstan pa dang gangs can 'gro ba la rlabs che zhing nyams pa med pa'i mdzad rjes bzhag par mi phyed gus pa chen pos gdeng 'jog

— bodakyipo〈lje —33 —mdzad pa de yin no/ /bzhi pa/ chosakyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen po'i yon tan mdor bsdusapar bsngagasapa zhesapa'i rtsom stangasakhyad chos/de yang mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang mchog ni rje rin po che'i slob ma brgya phrag mang bo'i khrod kyi snyan ngag mkhan phul du phyin pa zhig yin phyir/ khong nyid kyi snyan ngag la 'char snang rnam par mdzes pa dang tshig rgyan phun sum tshogs pa/ nyams 'gyur kun nas ldan pa sogs thun mong ma yin pa'i dge mtshan khyad chos ldan pa yin te/ gcig bstod pa 'di nyid la khyon bsdoms pas snyan ngag tshig rkang brgya dang bzhi bcu mchis pa dang / tshig rkang rer yig 'bru dgu ma can dang bdun ma can du bcoms 'dug pa dang /gnyis/ bstod pa 'di nyid kyi sdeb sbyor la ni tshig bsdu che zhing kha dam pa dang brjid chags pa'i khyad chos mngonagasal du thon 'dug pa dang / gsum/snyan ngag mkhan gyis bstod pa 'di nyid dpe rgyan sogs snyan ngag gi rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan pas na sgyu rtsal gyi nyams snang phun sum tshogs pa'o/ /

214 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus riga'adzinabyeba'irolamatsho/ da wadon tshan brgyad pa/ rgyal po rāmaṇa'i gtam rgyud las brtsams pa'i snyan ngag gi bstan bcos/dang po/ rtsom pa po'i lo rgyusamador bstan pa/de yang rgyal po rā ma ṇa'i gtam rgyud las bcoms pa'i snyan ngag gi bstan bcos dri za'i bu mo'i rgyud mangs kyi sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba'i rtsom pa po ni/ 'jam mgon chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen mo'i thugs sras/ mdo sngags kyi gzhung lugs rgya mtsho lta bu'i pha rol tu son cing / thos pa'i don la sgrub pa snying bor mdzad pas grub pa'i go 'phang mthon por gshegs pa/ tha snyad kyi gtsug lag ma lus pa la dbang 'byor zhing / kha ba ri ba'i snyan ngag mkhan mtha' dag gi ral ba'i zur phud kyi rtse mor zhabs kyi padmo ngal gso ba'i mkhas grub chen po zhang zhung ba chos dbang grags pa mchog yin la/ khong ni rje tsong kha pa chen mo'i slob ma mkhas chen brgya phrag mang bo'i khrod kyi snyan grags can zhig yin te/ mus sad pa blo gros rin chen seng ge dang 'di ba gnyis la rnam dpyod phul du byung ba'i mkhas pa gnyis zhes yongs su grags/'di ba rab byung bdun pa'i shing sprel (spyi lo1404)la 'khrungs shing / rab byung brgyad pa'i sa glang (spyi lo1469)la sku mya ngan las 'das so/ / rgyal po rā ma ṇa'i gtam rgyud las bcoms pa'i snyan ngag gi bstan bcos 'di nyid ni khong dgung lo so lnga bzhes pa sa pho rta'i lo (spyi lo1438)la rje tsong kha pa'i gdan sa dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling du sbyar ba'o/ /

bod skye snga dar rtsom rig 2smodasnyan ngag gi bstan bcos chen po 'di nyid zhang zhung bas rgya gar gyi rgyal po rā ma ṇa'i rtogs brjod la gzhi byas te brtsams pa zhig yin la/ rgya gar gyi rgyal po rā ma ṇa'i rtogs brjod ni ha lam sbyi lo sngon gyi dus rabs gnyis pa tsam nas rgya gar kha rgyun du grags shing / phyis su drang srong grog mkhar gyis bha ra ta zhes bya ba'i gzhung la brten nas kha rgyun du grags pa'i gtam rgyud de la snon 'phri gang legs mdzad de snyan grags kyi 'brug sgra 'dzam gling la 'phur ba'i snyan ngag gi bstan bcos ring mo zhig tu grub pa red/ snyan ngag gi bstan bcos de la khyon bsdoms le'u chen po bdun yod pa las/ le'u dang po gzhon nu'i dus kyi rtogs brjod la sho lo 41941dang / le'u gnyis pa nags su gshegs pa'i rtogs brjod la sho lo 43170dang / le'u gsum pa nags su byar ba'i rtogs brjod la sho lo 42060dang / le'u bzhi ba spre'u'i rgyal khams kyi rtogs brjod la sho lo ka 1984dang / le'u lnga ba spre'u ha nu man tha'i rtogs brjod la sho lo 42487dang / le'u drug pa g.yul gyi 'phrin las spel ba'i rtogs brjod la sho lo 44435dang / le'u bdun pa mjug tu dgyes 'dzoms /shā ༵༵ //sa brjod la sho lo 12668dang bcas khyon bsdoms sho lo kargya gar gyi rtogs brjod 'di yig bsgyur gyi bya ba'i thad la rang re'i gangs can pa rnams 'dzam gling gi mi rigs gang las kyang snga ba ste/ tun hong gter yig las thon pa'i rgyal po rā ma ṇa'i rtogs brjod kyi shog dril de dag dus rabs dgu ba'i skabs su bsgyur ba yin/ de'i rjes kyi dus rabs bcu dgu ba'i nang da gzod dbyin ji dang / hpha ran si/ e tha li/ mu ru su//dri /spya /pa/ kyis yig bsgyur byas shing / rgya yig tu bsgyur ba ni de las

/26da bodakyirtsomarigalorgyusariga'adzinabye'u'irolamatsho/gnyisapa/ rgyal po rā ma ṇa'i gtam rgyud lasabacomasapa'i snyan ngag gi bstan bcosakyi brjod don mdor bsdus/de yang sngon rnga yab gling gi srin po'i rgyal po mgrin pa bcu bas 'chi ba med pa'i dngos grub 'dod nas lha chen dbang phyug la me mchod sogs phul nas ngal ba bsten pa la/ dbang phyug gis 'chi med dngos grub ster ma 'dod par btsun mo u ma dang sras spre'u mig gsum pa snga phyir 'chi med dngos grub ster bar mngags pa'i tshe/ srin po mgrin bcus de gnyis las dngos grub len ma 'dod par tshod med du brnyas smon byas pas na/ lha mo u ma dang spre'u mig gsum pa khros par gyur nas dus mthar srin po khyod kyi rgyal srid 'di nu // /spya / bye /rdo / ṭī bye py-i gis nyams shing 'joms par byed par shog ces de lta na'ang / srin po mgrin bcus sngar bzhin dbang phyug la mchod bkur byas nas 'chi med dngos grub ster bar re mos bcangs pas/ dbang ṭī ṭī / ṭwāṃ dī / ṭwāṃ tā nā sbyi shā ṭwāṃ /ngo/sasri /ba gā paXrnyi bcu'i steng gdong ste rta mgo de nas lha mo u ma'i dmod pa'i dbang gis srin po mgrin bcu'i btsun mo zhig la sī tā zhes pa'i bu mo mdzes sdug dpal gyis sgeg pa zhig btsas nas ngo mtshar ba'i ngang mtshan mkhan la bstan pa na/ mtshan mkhan gyis zhib tu brtag ste/ srin po'i yul phung bar byed pa'i mi bzad pa'i dug kā ko la dang kun nas mtshungs pa'i bu mo 'di ni gzhan gang gi grogs su'ang mi 'os par/

— — bodakyisngadamartsomarig ge 2 0sta snrodu sbren po'i grogs su 'os pas chu py-i skyur cig ces smras pas/ sī tā rin —'a bye/de du zlo /shā /pa sdi ༵ kāhā kā bye/ ba/ las 'dzam bu gling gi zhing la chu 'dren pa'i yur ba ru thon pa de las la brel ba'i zhing ba dag gis rnyed nas skyed bsrings te/ 'di ni rgyal po rā ma ṇa'i dga' ba'i me long du 'os so zhes rgyal po rā ma ṇa la legs par phul ba na/ rgyal po sī tā'i mdzes sdug la yin rab tu chags par gyur te/ bu mo 'di yi rmad byung mdzes sdug ni nga las gzhan su zhig gi mig gi spyod bya ru gyur na'ang mi rung ngo zhes bsam nas rgyal khabakyi srid dbang rang nyid kyi nu bo lā thu ma na la gnang rjes sī tā khrid nas dben pa'i nags tshal du gshegs pa la/ bsam gtan pa lā thu ma nas kyang rgyal srid bskyangs ma 'dod par srid dbang nu bo tha chung 'jigs sde la byin te phu bo rā ma ṇa dang btsun mo sī tā gnyis kyi rjes 'brangs nas dben pa'i nags tshal du phebs so/ /de nas bzung lā sna ma ṇa bsam gtan gyi bde bas /sdu rno ṭwāṃ ༵ /snas gā rā ma ṇa dang btsun mo sī tā gnyis 'dod pa'i bde ba la de la/ srin po'i rgyal po mgrin pa bcu bas btsun mo sī tā'i snyan pa'i grags pa thos pas rang gi btsun mor 'phrog par bsam ste/ ri dwags shig tu sprul nas rgyal po rā ma ṇa dang btsun mo sī tā gnyis rol ba'i nags tshal der slebs pa na/ sī tā'i yid gdon gyis brlams pas ri dwags de mthong nas/rgyal po lags/ yid du 'ongs pa'i ri dwags 'di nyid da lta nyid du 'dzin par mdzod cig ces cal col du yang yang bskul bas/ rgyal po ri dwags de 'dzin par mi 'gro ka med du gyur te btsun mo sī tā dang lā byu ma na gnyis kyi mtha' la rtags kyi ri mo bkod nas/ 'di'i phyi la mi 'gro bar gyis zhes nan du gdams rjes/ mda' gzhu bzung nas ri dwags bda' bas na/ ri dwags

218 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/de ni srin po mgrin bcu'i cho 'phrul yin phyir bros pa'i mtha' mar nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon ji bzhin gar song cha med du gyur stabs/ rgyal po ngal ba 'bras med du gyur nas yid thang dang lus thang gnyis ka chad nas yun ring zhig la phyir ma slebs/ de la srin po mgrin bcu btsun mo sī tā dang lā byu ma na gnyis sdod pa'i gnas de'i nye 'dabs su 'ongs nas/ rgyal po rā ma ṇa'i skad gdangs kyis sī tā sī tā zhes nyam nyes pa'i skad du yang yang bos pa na/ lā ཿ mkhas bsam gtan sgom pa'i rkyen gyis ma thos kyang btsun mo sī tās gsal bor thos pas/ yid kyis ma bzod par na re/ lā thu ma na lags/ rgyal po nyid kyis nye 'dabs su nyam thag skad kyis bdag nyid 'bod kyin 'dug pa khyod kyis ma thos sam/ da lta nyid du songs la rgyal po la ci nyes ltos shig ces bskul ba na/ lā sna ma nas bdag gis de 'dra ma thos/ rgyal po re zhig phyir phebs nges yin zhes bshad nas ma song bar bsdad pa la/ sī tā na re/ 'o/da mi shes pa mi 'dug rgyal pos nye 'dabs su nyam thag skad kyis yang yang bos kyang khyod skyob par mi 'gro bar 'dug pa ni/ khyod kyis rgyal po med par gyur nas bdag thob pa la re bas red ces thol byung du gsang mthor smras pas/dṛ ṭī kṣiṃ /sbya tram̐ tā sdo /dro ṭā dang ngo tsha 'gran pa ltar skyes nas de ma thag rgyal po spre lā thu ma na song shul du/ srin po mgrin bcu drang srong zhig tu sprul nas btsun mo sī tā la kha zas slong ba ltar 'ongs te/ btsun mo sī tā de kho mo sdod gnas kyi sa gzhi dang bcas par srin po'i yul du khyer ro/ /yin na yang / srin po mgrin bcu'i 'dod pa de yid bzhin du 'grub ma thub pa dang / btsun mo si tā btson ma'i tshul du bza' shing ra bar bcug pas na/ srin po'i 'jigs snang tshad med myangs pa dang / khyad par du sngon rgyal po rā ma ṇa ri dwags 'dzin par nan gyis bskul ba ni rang nyid lan pa

218 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/de ni srin po mgrin bcu'i cho 'phrul yin phyir bros pa'i mtha' mar nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon ji bzhin gar song cha med du gyur stabs/ rgyal po ngal ba 'bras med du gyur nas yid thang dang lus thang gnyis ka chad nas yun ring zhig la phyir ma slebs/ de la srin po mgrin bcu btsun mo sī tā dang lā byu ma na gnyis sdod pa'i gnas de'i nye 'dabs su 'ongs nas/ rgyal po rā ma ṇa'i skad gdangs kyis sī tā sī tā zhes nyam nyes pa'i skad du yang yang bos pa na/ lā ཿ mkhas bsam gtan sgom pa'i rkyen gyis ma thos kyang btsun mo sī tās gsal bor thos pas/ yid kyis ma bzod par na re/ lā thu ma na lags/ rgyal po nyid kyis nye 'dabs su nyam thag skad kyis bdag nyid 'bod kyin 'dug pa khyod kyis ma thos sam/ da lta nyid du songs la rgyal po la ci nyes ltos shig ces bskul ba na/ lā sna ma nas bdag gis de 'dra ma thos/ rgyal po re zhig phyir phebs nges yin zhes bshad nas ma song bar bsdad pa la/ sī tā na re/ 'o/da mi shes pa mi 'dug rgyal pos nye 'dabs su nyam thag skad kyis yang yang bos kyang khyod skyob par mi 'gro bar 'dug pa ni/ khyod kyis rgyal po med par gyur nas bdag thob pa la re bas red ces thol byung du gsang mthor smras pas/dṛ ṭī kṣiṃ /sbya tram̐ tā sdo /dro ṭā dang ngo tsha 'gran pa ltar skyes nas de ma thag rgyal po spre lā thu ma na song shul du/ srin po mgrin bcu drang srong zhig tu sprul nas btsun mo sī tā la kha zas slong ba ltar 'ongs te/ btsun mo sī tā de kho mo sdod gnas kyi sa gzhi dang bcas par srin po'i yul du khyer ro/ /yin na yang / srin po mgrin bcu'i 'dod pa de yid bzhin du 'grub ma thub pa dang / btsun mo si tā btson ma'i tshul du bza' shing ra bar bcug pas na/ srin po'i 'jigs snang tshad med myangs pa dang / khyad par du sngon rgyal po rā ma ṇa ri dwags 'dzin par nan gyis bskul ba ni rang nyid lan pa

bod kyi snga dar rtsom rig 219yin pa shes nas nongs 'gyod tshad med skyes nas/ da ni 'chi ba las thabs gzhan med pas snga mo nas shi thabs shig byed dgos bsam nas bsdad do/ /de nas rgyal po rā ma ṇas btsun mo sī tā 'tshol phyir chu rgyun dron mo zhig gi mgo khungs ded nas song song ba las/ 'jigs su rung ba'i spu mdog dmar ser can gyi spre'u chen po ste nags kyi mi rgod 'dra ba zhig dang 'phrad pas/ rang la gnod pa byed par dogs nas mda' 'phen par brtsams pa na/gang des tshul ngan pa ci yang ma bstan phyir/ phan tshun yid ches pa'i ngang gtam dris tshe/ spre'u de'i ming la mgrin bzang zer zhing / kho la dgra zla zhig yod pa'i ming la spre'u 'ba' le zer ba dang / kho gnyis kyis spre'u'i rgyal srid bcodanas nyin 'ga'i ring la drag tu 'thab kyang rgyal pham gyi shan 'byed ma thub par lus pa yin pas/ rgyal po rā ma ṇa la 'ba' le 'dul ba'i grogs byed dgos pa'i 'dun pa zhus pa dang de ltar byas na btsun mo sī tā rnyed pa'i thabs yod par khas blangs pa la/ rgyal po rā ma ṇas spre'u mgrin bzang la 'ba' le 'dul ba'i grogs byed pa'i dam bca' bzhag go /phyi'i nyin mo/ mgrin bzang 'ba' le dang 'thab pa'i tshe/ de gnyis 'khoraca 'khor ba'am glog 'khyug pa ji bzhin lta bas mig gis mi zin par 'thab cing 'dzing bas na/ rgyal po rā ma ṇas mda' 'phen par ma spobs/de bas mgrin bzang gis rgyal po rā ma ṇa la slar yang nan gyis bskul ba dang /phyi'i nyi mar rgyab la me long zhig btags nas 'ba' le dang 'thab pa na/rgyal pos da gzod 'ba' le la mda' 'phangs nas bsad do/ /de ltar rgyal po rā ma ṇas spre'u mgrin bzang gi 'dod pa yin bzhin du bskangs pas/ mgrin bzang gis rang gi blon po spre'u ha nu man tha btsun mo sī tā 'tshol bar mngags so/ / spre'u ha nu man thas btsun mo sī tā srin po'i yul na yod par shes nas/ mchong thengs gcig gis srin po rnga yab gling du

220 da wabonagirtsomarigalorgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/mchong ba na mchong tshod ma zin par byang phyogs rlung lha'i yul du thon/ rlung lha'i yul na kho'i ma zhang rnams bzhugs pas kho rang tsha bo ru shes nas gsol ston rgya cher mdzad nas yun ring 'gor ro/ /de nas spre'u ha nu man tha slar yang srin po rnga yab gling la mchong nas btsun mo sī tā btsal bas na bza' shing gi ra bar btson 'jug byas yod pa mthong nas/ rgyal po rā ma ṇas bskur ba'i sor gdub sī tā la bstan te/ kho rang skyob par yong ba'i gnas tshul bshad pa la/ btsun mo sī tā'i yid la dga' ba dang bde bas khyab/ yin na yang / srin po rnams kyis spre'u ha nu man tha gson bzung byas pa dang / khyod ji ltar shi na 'dod ces dris pa la/ha nu man tha na re/ da ni gang ltar kyang bdag shi ba las 'os med/ khyod cag gis snying nad sangs pa zhig byed par gyis/ nga'i mjug ma'i steng la ras dar yug gang mang dkris/ de thog la snum yang yang blugs la mes sgron par gyis dang bdag ngan shi zhig byed nges yin zhes zhus pa na/ srin po rnams kyis de ni gsod srol ya nga ba zhig red snyam nas de ltar byas pa la/ spre'u ha nu man tha de nyid srin po'i pho brang gi kho ra khor yug tu rgyug cing mchong ba dang mchong zhing rgyug nas srin po'i yul thams cad dmar bo me la 'ur 'ur chem chem du sgron pa dang / rnga yab gling de 'ur zing gis kun nas 'khrugs par byas shing /srin po mgrin pa bcu ba ma gtogs pa'i srin po grangs mtha' med pa zhig ni yam shing bsreg pa ltar me la mchod do/ / de la spre'u ha nu man tha'i rnga ma'i steng la dkris pa'i ras dar de rnams 'bar tshar nas mjug ma'i snying bo la reg par rtsom pa'i tshe/ lho phyogs rgya mtsho'i khar rgyugs nas ja ma mtsho nang la btsugs pa na/ klu rnamasakyis spre'u waradi rdi/kyis srin yul thal bar brlags trī //snatā kyi/ saklu ba sbyikā kāms kyang spur bdag rgyu red snyam nas phu btab nas

bon kyi snga dar rtsom rig 221de nas spre'u ha nu man tha phyir 'dzam bu gling la gebs nas btsun mo sī tā srin yul na yod pa dang srin yul mer sgron pa sogs kyi gnas tshul rgyal po rā ma ṇa la zhus pa dang / rgyal po rā ma ṇas 'dzam bu gling nas yan lag bzhi ldan gyi dmag sna drangs nas srin po rnga yab gling la g.yul 'gyed par chas/rgyal po rā ma ṇas drangs pa'i yan lag bzhi ldan gyi dmag dpung gis srin po rnams ma lus par tshar bcad pa dang / rgyal po rā ma ṇas mda' 'phangs te srin po mgrigapa bcu ba'i rta mgo bcad nas 'jig rten pha rol tu bskrad cing / btsun mo sī tā bskyabs te phyir 'dzam bu gling la chas pa'i skab der/ g.yul las thar ba'i srin po zhig dben gnas su bsam gtan la sgom pa'i mgrin bcu'i nu bo la u pa gan zer ba'i zhabs la gtugs nas/rā ma ṇas yan lag bzhi ldan gyi dmag dpung drangs nas srin yul tshar bcad pa dang mgrin bcu yang bsad zin pa'i gnas tshul zhus pas na/ u pa darna khong khro bzod glags med pa skyes nas nus mthu cher bskyed kyis kha nang nas me 'phyur nas/ rgyal po rā ma ṇa dang spre'u ha nu man tha sogs skyes chen re gnyis tsam ma gtogs gzhan dmag dpung ma lus pa dar cig nyid du bsregs nas keng nus dkar bo ru btang ngo / / de la spre'u ha nu man tha rang gi yab dam pa'i zhabs la gtugs nas 'chi sos kyi thabs lam dris pa na/ yab mchog nas gangs ti se steng na shi sos kyi rtswa sman mchog tu gyur pa zhig yod par gsungs stabs/ spre'u ha nu man tha de med la gangs ti se steng la mchong nas sman gyi rig byed la ma goms phyir rtswa sdum gang mang zhig btus yong nas yab la phul ba na/ de'i khrod du nye bar mkho ba'i sman rtswa gcig kyang med par brten/ ha nu man tha slar yang song nas gangs ti se lag la pang nas khyer 'ongs pa la/ yab nas sman btus shing legs par bsdebs rjes/ keng rus su snang ba'i dmag dpung thams cad kyi steng la 'chi gsos kyi sman mchog

222 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/gtor ba'i mod la/ sha bral rus pa'i tshul du snang ba'i dmag gi dpung tshogs ṭā / /dri bye ṭwāṃ bzhin slar gson par gyur pas/ thams cad dga' ba dang sbo denas rgyal po rā ma ṇas yan lag bzhi ldan gyi dmag dpung khrid nas ༵༵ ṭwāṃ rsharnyi trī /shā la phebs rjes/ sngar bzhin btsun mo sī tā khrid nas nags gsum pa/ rgyalaporā maṇa'i gtamargyud lasabacomasapa'i snyan ngag gi bstan bcosakyi bsamablo'i rang bzhin/gong nas go bde'i tshig gis mdor bsdus pa de ni/ rgyal po rā ma ṇa'i gtam rgyud las bcoms pa'i snyan ngag gi bstan bcos 'di'i brjod don yin zhing / brjod don de'i steng nas bsam zhing gzhigs na/ snyan ngag gi bstan bcos 'di nyid kyi bsam blo'i rang bzhin ni/ 'di ltar yin par snyam ste/ gtam rgyud khrod du rgyal po rā ma ṇa la mdzes sdug dpal gyis sgeg pa'i bu moshrī tā thob pas na rgyal po de la yid rab tu chags par gyur te/ 'di yi mdzes sdug gzhan gyi mig gi spyod bya la gyur na'ang mi rung ngo snyam ste/ rgyal srid nu bo 'jigs sde la gnangs rjes/ btsun mo sī tā nye bar khrid nas mi med dben pa'i nags tshal du song nas dga' mgu'i brtse dung gi bdud rtsi la ngoms med du spyad nas bzhugs pa ni bcos ma min zhing 'gyur ba med pa'i brtse dung gi phyir yin pa thog mar bstan pa dang / de nas gom gang mdun spos kyis srin po'i rgyal po mgrin pa bcu bas btsun mo sī tā'i mdzes sdug gi

bod kyi gdar rtsom rig 223snyan pa'i grags pa thos nas nags tshal du 'ongs te btsun mo sī tā sgyu thabs kyis srin po rnga yab gling du 'phrogs song stabs/ rgyal po rā ma ṇa dang btsun mo sī kyā gnyis kyi brtse dung mi 'dod kha bral sdo sdug bsngal bzlos byi spyang /sdupa dī snye shā py-i /ji rshanā /dā ༵ /pa /rdzu kā shātā bye/ rjo dang / ba na rna dī tā yin na yang / rgyal po rā ma ṇas blo sems 'gyur med kyis dka' sdug khyad du bsad nas yun ring gi bar du btsun mo sī tā btsal ba'i mthar/spre'u mgrin bzang la 'phrad pa dang / de la btsun mo sī tā 'tshol ba'i thabs ༵༵ /da pa shes nas de'i dgra zla spre'u 'bar ler mda' 'phangs nas bsad denas spre'u mgrin bzang gi blon po spre'u ha nu man tha srin po'i yul la song nas/ btsun mo sī tā srin yul na mchis pa shes 'phral slar yang rgyal po rā ma ṇa'i zhabs la gtugs nas gnas tshul zhus pas na/ rgyal po rā ma ṇas rgyal khab kyi yan lag bzhi ldan gyi dmag sna drangs te srin po rnga yab gling la g.yul 'gyed par song ba dang / song nas kyang srin po ma lus par tshar bcad cing / srin po'i rgyal po mgrin pa bcu ba'i rta mgo bcad nas lnga ba'i lam du bzangs te/ btsun mo sī tā'am brtse dung de slar yang bskyabs nas 'dzam bu gling la log pa dang / de nas yang sngar bzhin rgyal srid la zhe ma chags par btsun mo si tā khrid nas dben pa'i nags tshal du song ba sogs dza drag che ba'i gtam rgyud kyi byung rim de dag 'phro rim 'phror bstan pa red/dza drag che ba'i byung rim de dag gi khrod du/ rgyal po rā ma ṇas mda' 'phangs nas spre'u 'ba' le bsad pa de ni gang dga' ci 'dod kyis ri dwags rngon pa ji bzhin srog ldan gyi spre'u zhig bsad pa ma yin te/ de ni 'gyur med kyi dga' ba zhig dang bla med kyi brtse dung zhig gi chen du yin la/ de ltar gsod

224 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/thub pa'i snying stobs chen po de yang 'gyur med kyi dga' ba dang bla med kyi brtse dung las thon pa red/ lhag par du/ rgyal po rā ma ṇas btsun mo si tā skyobacir/ rgyal khab kyi yan lag bzhi ldan gyi dmag dpung drangs nas srin po'i yul du g.yul 'gyed byas te/ rnga yab gling gi srin po rnams ma lus par tshar bcad pa dang / srin po'i rgyal po mgrin pa bcu ba'ang lnga ba'i lam du brdzangs pa red/ de ltar rgyal khab cig gi yan lag bzhi ldan gyi dmag dpung rnam par drangs nas rgyal khab gzhan zhig rtsa man theg med du btang ba ni/gzhan ci zhig gi don du yang ma yin par/ mdzes sdug dpal gyis sgeg pa'i btsun mo sī tā ste/ 'gyur ba med pa'i dga' ba dang bla na med pa'i brtse dung gi ched yin la/ de ltar g.yul gyi bya ba rlabs po che zhig spel thub pa'i snying stobs chen po de yang mdzes sdug dpal gyis sgeg pa'i btsun mo sī tā ste/'gyur ba med pa'i dga' ba dang bla na med pa'i brtse dung las thon pa red/der brten/ g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i rjes su rgyal po rā ma ṇas sngar bzhin rgyal srid thal ba bzhin spangs te/ btsun mo sī tā khrid nas mi med dben pa'i nags tshal du gshegs pa res de ltar byed pa'i rgyu mtshan yang brtse dung ni thams cad lags phyir rgyal srid mi dgos la go 'phang yang mi dgos pa bstan pa yin la/ brtse dung ni bde skyid kyi gzhi ma lags phyir/bde skyid kyi brtse dung de ldan na ni 'tsho bar dka' sdug med la pham nyes kyang med cing / skyo snang med la nyams nyes kyang med pa'i bsam blo de rnam par bstan pa red/ des na/ rgyal po rā ma ṇa'i gtam rgyud las bcoms pa'i snyan ngag gi bstan bcos 'dir rgyal po rā ma ṇa dang btsun mo sī tā gnyis kyi bcos ma min zhing 'gyur ba med pa'i brtse dung la bsngags brjod byas pa yin la/ btsun mo sī tā'i phyi lus kyi rmad byung mdzes sdug la bstod bsngags dang /rgyal po rā ma ṇas brtse dung de'i ched du mthu dang snying stobs bskyed pa'i dpa'

bod kyi snga dar rtsom rig 225nyams ring lugs la tshad mthon po'i sgo nas bstod glu blangs yod/bzhi ba/ rgyaXporā maṇawa gtamargyutā lasabacomasnruhā ༵༵ zlo/ nga bye// ba sasbyir 'dzam gling gi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal de dngos yod ring lugs dang rtog pa 'char yan ring lugs gnyis kyi rnam pa las ma 'das shing / de gnyis ni 'dzam gling gi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal byung zhing 'phel ba'i lo rgyus khrod kyi bzhur rgyun ches che ba gnyis yin/ 'o na ci zhig la dngos yod ring lugs kyi rtsom rig dang rtog pa 'char yan ring lugs kyi rtsom rig zer ram zhe na/ phyir dngos yod ring lugs kyi rtsom rig ces pa ni rtsom pa pos dngos yod 'tsho bar yang dag par gzigs shing gzab nan mdzad de/ 'tsho ba'i rang bzhin ngo ma nyid gzhir bzung nas 'tsho ba mtshon par bya ba dang / 'tsho ba ngo ma 'bri ba'i byed thabs legs par spyad nas/ yang dag pa'i zhib cha dang 'tsho ba ngo ma'i ro thon par gal cher 'dzin pa zhig la zer ba yin zhing / rtog pa 'char yan ring lugs kyi rtsom rig zhes pa ni phugs kyi 'dun pa mtshon par gzab nan sgos/ 'tsho bar yod 'os pa'i sems kyi re smon de gzhir bzung nas 'tsho ba zhib 'bri mdzad pa dang / rtag par stong bsam dang / 'ud bstod/ dpe mtshon gyi rtsom stangs spyad de/ dga' sdug sogs yin 'gyur gyi ro phun sum tshogs par thon par brtsams pa zhig la zer ba yin no/ /des na/ gangs can bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal yang rnam pa de gnyis las ma 'das par snyam zhing / rgyal po rā ma ṇa'i gtam rgyud las bcoms pa'i

bod kyi snga dar rtsom rig 225nyams ring lugs la tshad mthon po'i sgo nas bstod glu blangs yod/bzhi ba/ rgyaXporā maṇawa gtamargyutā lasabacomasnruhā ༵༵ zlo/ nga bye// ba sasbyir 'dzam gling gi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal de dngos yod ring lugs dang rtog pa 'char yan ring lugs gnyis kyi rnam pa las ma 'das shing / de gnyis ni 'dzam gling gi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal byung zhing 'phel ba'i lo rgyus khrod kyi bzhur rgyun ches che ba gnyis yin/ 'o na ci zhig la dngos yod ring lugs kyi rtsom rig dang rtog pa 'char yan ring lugs kyi rtsom rig zer ram zhe na/ phyir dngos yod ring lugs kyi rtsom rig ces pa ni rtsom pa pos dngos yod 'tsho bar yang dag par gzigs shing gzab nan mdzad de/ 'tsho ba'i rang bzhin ngo ma nyid gzhir bzung nas 'tsho ba mtshon par bya ba dang / 'tsho ba ngo ma 'bri ba'i byed thabs legs par spyad nas/ yang dag pa'i zhib cha dang 'tsho ba ngo ma'i ro thon par gal cher 'dzin pa zhig la zer ba yin zhing / rtog pa 'char yan ring lugs kyi rtsom rig zhes pa ni phugs kyi 'dun pa mtshon par gzab nan sgos/ 'tsho bar yod 'os pa'i sems kyi re smon de gzhir bzung nas 'tsho ba zhib 'bri mdzad pa dang / rtag par stong bsam dang / 'ud bstod/ dpe mtshon gyi rtsom stangs spyad de/ dga' sdug sogs yin 'gyur gyi ro phun sum tshogs par thon par brtsams pa zhig la zer ba yin no/ /des na/ gangs can bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal yang rnam pa de gnyis las ma 'das par snyam zhing / rgyal po rā ma ṇa'i gtam rgyud las bcoms pa'i

226 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/snyan ngag bstan bcos 'di nyid ni rang cag kha ba ri ba'i rtsom rig lo rgyus khrod kyi ches rmad du byung ba'i rtog pa 'char yan ring lugs kyi snyan ngag ring mo zhig go snyam/ rgyu mtshan gang gi phyir zhe na/ rgyal po rā ma ṇa'i gtam rgyud las bcoms pa'i snyan ngag gi bstan bcos 'di ni rtsom pa pos rgya gar gyi snyan ngag ring mo rā ma ṇa'i rtogs brjod kyi brjod don gzhir bzung nas brtsams pa zhig yin pa dang / rā ma ṇa'i rtogs brjod de ni rtsom pa po drang srong grog mkhar gyis sngar yod kyi kha rgyun rmang gzhi byas thog phun sum tshogs pa'i 'char snang la brten te sgyu rtsal gyi lam nas 'ud bstod dang rtog btags kyi sgo nas btsams pa'i rgya gar gna' bo'i khyad par du 'phags pa'i rtog pa 'char yan ring lugs kyi lo rgyus snyan rtsom zhig yin pa red/ dper na/ rā ma ṇa'i rtogs brjod khrod du/ rnga yab gling gi srin po'i rgyal po mgrin pa bcu bas btsun mo sī tā sa gzhi dang bcas par srin yul du 'phrog pa dang / spre'u ha nu man tha btsun mo sī tā 'tshol bar srin yul du mchong yang mchong tshod ma zin par byang phyogs rlung lha'i yul du thon pas na/ de na bzhugs pa'i ma zhang dgagis kho rang tsha bo ru shes nas gsol ston mdzad pas ring zhig lus pa dang / de nas srin yul du slebs dus srin po rnams kyis bzung nas rnga ma'i steng la dar yug dkris/ de'i steng la snum blugs te mer bsgron pa la/ spre'u ha nu man tha srin po'i pho brang du rgyug cing mchong la mchong zhing rgyug nas srin yul me la bsgron pas 'ur 'ur chem chem gyis khengs pa dang mthar klu rnams kyis mjug ma'i me lce dbugs kyis bcil ba/ g.yul gyi bya ba mjug rdzogs rjes/ mgrin bcu'i nu bo mu pa kun yis mthu nus bskyed de rgyal po rā ma ṇa'i yan lag bzhi ldan gyi dmag dpung sha bral rus pa'i tshul du bsregs pa'i tshe/spre'u ha nu man bas 'chi gsos kyi sman 'thu phyir gangs ti se lag tu pang nas yab kyi mdun sar khyer 'ongs pa dang / de nas thang chad pas phyir rang

226 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/snyan ngag bstan bcos 'di nyid ni rang cag kha ba ri ba'i rtsom rig lo rgyus khrod kyi ches rmad du byung ba'i rtog pa 'char yan ring lugs kyi snyan ngag ring mo zhig go snyam/ rgyu mtshan gang gi phyir zhe na/ rgyal po rā ma ṇa'i gtam rgyud las bcoms pa'i snyan ngag gi bstan bcos 'di ni rtsom pa pos rgya gar gyi snyan ngag ring mo rā ma ṇa'i rtogs brjod kyi brjod don gzhir bzung nas brtsams pa zhig yin pa dang / rā ma ṇa'i rtogs brjod de ni rtsom pa po drang srong grog mkhar gyis sngar yod kyi kha rgyun rmang gzhi byas thog phun sum tshogs pa'i 'char snang la brten te sgyu rtsal gyi lam nas 'ud bstod dang rtog btags kyi sgo nas btsams pa'i rgya gar gna' bo'i khyad par du 'phags pa'i rtog pa 'char yan ring lugs kyi lo rgyus snyan rtsom zhig yin pa red/ dper na/ rā ma ṇa'i rtogs brjod khrod du/ rnga yab gling gi srin po'i rgyal po mgrin pa bcu bas btsun mo sī tā sa gzhi dang bcas par srin yul du 'phrog pa dang / spre'u ha nu man tha btsun mo sī tā 'tshol bar srin yul du mchong yang mchong tshod ma zin par byang phyogs rlung lha'i yul du thon pas na/ de na bzhugs pa'i ma zhang dgagis kho rang tsha bo ru shes nas gsol ston mdzad pas ring zhig lus pa dang / de nas srin yul du slebs dus srin po rnams kyis bzung nas rnga ma'i steng la dar yug dkris/ de'i steng la snum blugs te mer bsgron pa la/ spre'u ha nu man tha srin po'i pho brang du rgyug cing mchong la mchong zhing rgyug nas srin yul me la bsgron pas 'ur 'ur chem chem gyis khengs pa dang mthar klu rnams kyis mjug ma'i me lce dbugs kyis bcil ba/ g.yul gyi bya ba mjug rdzogs rjes/ mgrin bcu'i nu bo mu pa kun yis mthu nus bskyed de rgyal po rā ma ṇa'i yan lag bzhi ldan gyi dmag dpung sha bral rus pa'i tshul du bsregs pa'i tshe/spre'u ha nu man bas 'chi gsos kyi sman 'thu phyir gangs ti se lag tu pang nas yab kyi mdun sar khyer 'ongs pa dang / de nas thang chad pas phyir rang

bod kyi snga dar rtsom rig 227 —gnas su 'khyer bar sgyid lug skyes nas gangs ti se spo lo 'phen pa nang bzhin sngar gnas su shugs kyis 'phangs pa bcas ni 'ud bstod dang rtog btags kyi 'char yan ring lugs kyi khyad jus su'akhumasaso/ / de nga gyirtog pa gānārji kā sna pa/ kārsha/ byi bye/ byedro rnyi shā/sdo sdo/ gakṣe gā / / /bye / khyad par du/ khong nyid rgya gar shar lho gnyis las shar ba'i rtsom lugs te/brjodakhya rjod byed gnyis ka sngon chad skye bo kun la rlung ltar grags pa zhig min yang / ngag sbyor de la nges tshig gis bshad rung tsam yod pa'i don can dang / 'jig rten gyi grags pa'i mtshams las ring du brgal nas 'ud che ba'i ngag gis sgro btags te brjod pa / rtsub pa'i yi ge mang zhing tshegs chen pos brjod par bya ba dang / yi ge'i 'jam tsub do mi mnyam par rtsom pa bcas lugs su 'dzin pa'i rtsom pa po yin phyir/ rgyal po rā ma ṇa'i gtam rgyud las bcoms pa'i snyan ngag gi bstan bcos 'di nyid shar ba'i lugs su legs par brtsams pa red/ der brten/ snyan ngag gi bstan bcos 'di'i brjod trī /shā /sbyi //sdu // // /sdo /ga pa 'char yan ring lugs kyi ngo mtshar sgyu gsham du/ snyan ngag gi bstan bcos 'di'i rjod byed tshig gi sgyu rtsal rnam pa /sna sgom /sa byu1sha byedapa kta /bste myu/ra/snyanangag gi bstan bcos 'di nyid thog mar bklag tshe/ de ma thag tu rtogs dka' zhing blo khog tu mi lon pa dang / tshig mi bde la sbyor mi legs pa lta bu'i tshor snang zhig ster na'ang / don dam du de ni rtsom rig gi skad cha'i sgyu rtsal gyi khyad chos thun mong ma yin pa zhig yin pa shes dgos so/ / rtsom pa pos brjod bya'i don gyi thad nas ma zad rjod byed tshig gi thad nas kyang rgya

228 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/gar shar phyogs pa'i lugs ltar bcoms pa yin phyir/ tshig bsdus che ba'am dam drag pa dang / tsub pa'i yi ge mang zhing tshegs chen pos brjod dgos pa/sdo ṭwāṃ zlo /ma tsub do ma mnyam pa bcas kyi khyad chos mngon gsal du thon yod/rnga ma'i snying bo 'bar byed ni/ /reg par rtsom tshe gzhil ba'i phyir/ /hā/ sdun phang bar 'jug rtsom pa/ / dug so skrag pa'i dbugs kyis ces pa lta bur mtshon na/ brjod don ni spre'u ha nu man thas srin yul me la sgron rjes/ mjug ma'i steng dkris pa'i dar yug rnams 'bar tshar nas rnga ma'i snying bo'ang 'bar bar rtsom pa'i tshe/ me gzhil ba'i skad du mjug ma dug can gyi mtsho ru 'dzugs par rtsom pa na dug can gyi klu rnams 'jigs shing skrag nas phu btab ste dbugs kyis lhag las med par bcil ba'o zhes pa yin zhing / 'dir sho lo ka gcig gi nang du'ang / rtsom tshe ma pa/gzhild wabacil/ dug cand wadug so sogs sgra dag la khar mi bde ba'i tha snyad bskyar zlos byas nas bkol stabs/ yi ge 'jam tsub do mi mnyam la bklag tshe tshegs chen pos brjod dgos par 'dug der ma zad/ tshig dam ṭwāṃ rsha rsharta/da drag pas kha mi gsal bar 'dug gal srid/ gong gsal gyi sho mjug ma'i snying bor 'bar byed me yis ni/ /reg par rtsom pa'i tshe na gzhil ba'i slad/ / dug can rgya mtsho'i phang bar 'jug pa na/ / gdengs can klu rnams skrag pa'i dbugs kyis bcil/ /ces pa ltar sbyar ba yin na/ ma mtha' yang rgya gar lho phyogs dngos yod /shā lugs pa'i kha gsal zhing lhod cha ldan pa'i tshig nyams thon pa yin no

bod kyi snga dar rtsom rig 229/sdidī/ sngo/ /rdor // rdo tātā dro sdu/ snyan rtsom la legs par mjal tshe/khong rnam par rang rang la thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyan spyod stangs dang rgyan sbyor tshul re mngon 'dug pa gsal bor mthong thub pa bzhin/ mkhas dbang zhang zhung chos dbang grags pas kyang snyan ngag gi bstan bcos de la rtog pa 'char yan ring lugs kyi khyad chos mngon par thon slad/ mgo nas mjug bar/shā/ kā // gyi // /rno / rab btags kyi rgyan sogs bkol ba cung zad mang 'dzin ma nus pa'i gos dkar can/ / bar bar khrag gi lteng ka 'khyil/ /la lar khrag rgyun dron mo 'bab/ / rgyu ma'i do shal can de dag /mche ba ring bos nu ma gnyis/ / 'dral dogs mgrin pa 'degs shing /// / drag shul spyod pa'i sa de yis/ / gshin rje'i grong la bag yod zhes par mtshon na/ don ni srin po'i grong khyer de'i sa gzhi phal cher/mi bsad pa'i rus pa'i gos dkar bo gyon pa dang / bar bar gyi sa'i gshong bu dma' ba dag tu khrag gi lteng ka 'khyil zhing / ngos gzar ba'i phyogs la lar bsad ma thag pa'i mi'i khrag rgyun dron mo 'bab pa/ gnas de dag tu sdod pa'i srin mo rnams kyis mi'i rgyu ma rlon pa'i ske rgyan ring bo ske la 'phangs nas/ mgo bo nang la sgur na/ mche ba ring bo dag gis rang gi nu ma gnyis ka 'dral bar dogs te/ mgo bo ltag par dgye nas ha ha'i gad mo gsang mthor rgod pa dang / gsod pa dang gcod pa sogs drag shul gyi las la rgyun du spyod pa'i srin po'i sa cha de yis/ lho phyogs gshin rje'i grong khyer yang 'jigs shing bag 'khum par byed do/ /zhes dang / 'dir/ tshigs bcad dang po mi sdug pa'i nyams dang / mche ba ring bos sogs rkang ba gnyis ni rab rtog dogs

230 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/༈ can /dro / /dro sdo / ma gnyis la 'jigs rung gi nyams dang ldan pa yin gshin rje mjug ma 'dzin de gnyis/ / lto 'gro dgra bo gzhom 'dod bzhin/ / phan tshun 'khyud de 'thab pa las/ / 'dzin ma'i lto bar ngal ba byin/ / nags tshal phreng ba'i tshogs dag ni/ / rdul gyi go skabs thob par gyur/ /kun gsal mdzes ma 'dar ldan ma/ / rdul 'tshub yol ba'i phag na 'chel/ /lha bu gzhin nu 'dzam gling mes/ / tshig pa'i dud tshogs yin zhes sems/ /zhe sdang tsha bas gdung ba yi/ /lus kyi gangs ri las 'ongs pa/ /rngul gyi 'bab chu'i klung chen tshogs/ / rgya mtsho chen po'i gsos su gyur/ /dgra gnyen mgal me'i 'khor lo ni/ /myur ba myur bar 'khor ba na/ / sa yi bdag po'i mig la ni/ /a long bzhin du de snang gyur/ /myur 'gro kri snga ra yi/ /rkang ba'i 'degs 'jog su yis bgrang / / gdong bzhi'i sung gi tshad kyis ni/ / mnyam par byas pa'i shugs 'chang des/ / pheg rdob sbyor ba'i lag pa bzhin/ /sgra bcas phan tshun gyes par gyur/ / nyi gzhon shar gyi grong las ni/ ltad mo'i slad du lhags pa gang / / mthon mthing mkha' yi khang bzang gi / ba gam rtse la 'jogs pa de/ / g.yul ngo'i 'jigs pas bred sha thon pa'i sbyan/ / phyi bzhin gzigs pa dang bcas rta bdun la/ / bzhon te /lha /sa nub kyi ri bo'i steng / / slebs ma thag tu mun pa'i 'obs la zhes pa'i don ni/ rgyal po rā ma ṇas chu rgyun zhig gi mgo khungs ded nas btsun mo sī tā btsal bar song song ba na/ spre'u mgrin bzang dang de'i dgra zla 'ba' le gnyis kyis rgyal sa brtsad nas g.yul 'thab pa mthong ba ste/'jigs rung gshen rje rnga ma can de gnyis ni/ dug sgrul gyis rang dgra gsod par 'dod tshe de'i lus la dam por 'khril nas mi gtong ba bzhin/ de gnyis

bod kyi snga dar rtsom rig 231phan tshun la 'khyud cing 'tham nas 'thab pas na/ sa gzhi'i lto ba la de gnyis kyi rkang bas bar med par brdung bas sa gzhi la ngal ba sbyin cing / nye 'khor gyi sngo ljang nags tshal ni rdul gyis g.yogs te skya bor gyur la/ sngo bsangs kyi mkha' dbyings mdzes ma g.yul po'i rnam par 'jigs nas lus 'dar ba dang / rdul 'tshub kyi yol ba'i phag na yib ste bag 'khum par gnas shing / 'dod gzugs kyi lha'i gzhon nu rnams kyis/ kye ma ma gi 'dzam gling chen po me yis tshig nas/ dud pa'i tshogs mkha' la 'khrigs pa yinano zhes bsam zhing mya ngan byed la/ de gnyis phan tshun la zhe sdang skyes pa'i tsha ba drag pos rab tu gdung ba'i lus phung gi gangs ri las 'ongs pa'i rngul chu'i thigs pa rgyas pa'i 'bab chu'i klung chen po'i tshogs rnams ni/ phyi'i rgya mtsho chen po rgyas pa'i gsos su gyur to/ /dgra 'ba' le dang gnyen mgrin bzang gnyis kyi lus kyi mgal me'i 'khorayo ni myur ba myur bar 'khor ba na/ sa yi bdag po rgyal po rā ma ṇa'i mig lam du/ a long zlum po bzhin du de gnyis kyi dbye ba mi phyed par snang bar gyur pas/ ri dwags kri sā ra yi rkang ba sa la 'degs 'jog byas pa'i grangs mtha' ni su zhig gis bgrang bar nus te bgrang bar nus pa ma yin la/lus rab tu myur ba'i spre'u'i dbang bo 'di gnyis 'thab pa'i rkang ba'i 'degs 'jog byas pa'i grangs ku'i mang nyung yang de bzhin du bgrang bar ga la nus te/ lha tshangs pa chen po'i srang gi tshad kyis ni gzhal te/ cung zad kyang mi mnyam pa med par shin tu mnyam par byas pa'i myur ba'i shugs ldan pa de gnyis/ nyin gang bor 'thab kyang rgyal pham gyi shan 'byed ma thub par dgong po'i dus tshod la/ lag pa phan tshun sbyor zhing brdab pas pheg rdob kyi sgra bzhin du pheg sgra dang bcas par phan tshun so sor kha bral to/ /de'i tshe/ nyi ma gzhon nu yang shar phyogs kyi grong khyer las ni/ stobs
