232 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/chen 'di gnyis kyi 'thab mo la ltad mo blta bar 'ongs pa de/ sngo bsangs nam mkha'i khang bzang gi ba gam gyi rtse por 'dzegs te bltas pa na/ de yang g.yul ngo'i 'jigs pa mi bzad pa'i ngang tshul de blta bar ma bzod par/ de la dngangs shing skrag pa'i mdangs shar ba'i spyan gnyis kyis phyi mig blta ba dang bcas/ rab tu mgyogs pa'i rta mchog bdun gyis drangs pa'i shing rta la bsdad de bros pas/ nub phyogs kyi ri bo'i steng du slebs pa na/ de nas kyang /// hā/ sna // hā sna //lha ma thag tu nub ri'i phag tu mun pa'i 'obs la 'dir/ rtsom pa pos rmad du byung ba'i rtsom rtsal dang phun sum tshogs pa'i 'char snang la brten nas/ spre'u 'ba' le dang mgrin bzang gnyis g.yul 'thab pa las bslangs pa'i rdul phung ni 'dod gzugs kyi lha bu gzhon nu dag gis 'dzam gling mes tshig pa'i du ba nam mkhar 'khrigs par 'khums shing mya ngan byed ces dang / zhe sdang gi tsha bas gdung ba'i lus kyi gangs ri las bzhur ba'i rngul chu'i klung chen mo ni/ rgya mtsho rnam par rgyas pa'i gsos su gyur to ces snga ma dpe rgyan las rmongs pa'i dpe dang phyi ma gzugs rgyan la sbyar nas zhud kyis brjod pa dang / nyi ma gzhon nu gang gnyis 'thab pa'i g.yul gyi rnam par ltad mor 'ongs kyang skrag cing 'jigs nas phyi mig blta bzhinanub phyogs ri bo'i phag tu yib song ngo zhes rab btags kyi rgyan las sems med rab btags la sbyar te/ 'jig rten gyi grags tshod las ring du brgal ba'i ngag sbyor gyis/ rtog pa 'char yan ring lugs kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal gyi khyad chos 'bur thon du mtshon par mdzad do/ /gsum/ legs bshad dpalams don gyi gzhon nu brgyan pa/rtsom pa pos rgyal po rā ma ṇa'i gtam rgyud las brtsams pa'i snyan ngag gi bstan bcos kyi brjod don gson nyams ldan zhing bden lugs yod pa'i

232 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/chen 'di gnyis kyi 'thab mo la ltad mo blta bar 'ongs pa de/ sngo bsangs nam mkha'i khang bzang gi ba gam gyi rtse por 'dzegs te bltas pa na/ de yang g.yul ngo'i 'jigs pa mi bzad pa'i ngang tshul de blta bar ma bzod par/ de la dngangs shing skrag pa'i mdangs shar ba'i spyan gnyis kyis phyi mig blta ba dang bcas/ rab tu mgyogs pa'i rta mchog bdun gyis drangs pa'i shing rta la bsdad de bros pas/ nub phyogs kyi ri bo'i steng du slebs pa na/ de nas kyang /// hā/ sna // hā sna //lha ma thag tu nub ri'i phag tu mun pa'i 'obs la 'dir/ rtsom pa pos rmad du byung ba'i rtsom rtsal dang phun sum tshogs pa'i 'char snang la brten nas/ spre'u 'ba' le dang mgrin bzang gnyis g.yul 'thab pa las bslangs pa'i rdul phung ni 'dod gzugs kyi lha bu gzhon nu dag gis 'dzam gling mes tshig pa'i du ba nam mkhar 'khrigs par 'khums shing mya ngan byed ces dang / zhe sdang gi tsha bas gdung ba'i lus kyi gangs ri las bzhur ba'i rngul chu'i klung chen mo ni/ rgya mtsho rnam par rgyas pa'i gsos su gyur to ces snga ma dpe rgyan las rmongs pa'i dpe dang phyi ma gzugs rgyan la sbyar nas zhud kyis brjod pa dang / nyi ma gzhon nu gang gnyis 'thab pa'i g.yul gyi rnam par ltad mor 'ongs kyang skrag cing 'jigs nas phyi mig blta bzhinanub phyogs ri bo'i phag tu yib song ngo zhes rab btags kyi rgyan las sems med rab btags la sbyar te/ 'jig rten gyi grags tshod las ring du brgal ba'i ngag sbyor gyis/ rtog pa 'char yan ring lugs kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal gyi khyad chos 'bur thon du mtshon par mdzad do/ /gsum/ legs bshad dpalams don gyi gzhon nu brgyan pa/rtsom pa pos rgyal po rā ma ṇa'i gtam rgyud las brtsams pa'i snyan ngag gi bstan bcos kyi brjod don gson nyams ldan zhing bden lugs yod pa'i

bod kyi snga dar rtsom rig 233ngang mtshon slad/ gtan tshigs kyi rang bzhin ldan pa'i 'jig rten gyi yang dag bden lugs de nyid go sla zhing don 'dus par brtsams nas mi rnams ya rsharshaswāswā/sna /ma lda /shā /'i gdams pa ste/ lags bshad mi nyung ba zhig rta mgo can de'i re ba yi/ /rgyu skar do shal 'god pa la/ /mtshan mo'i bu mo dmar ser can/ / yab kyi bka' las 'gong ma nus/ / bde 'byung ral ba'i skyed tshal du/ / mtho ris chu yis khrus rtsom pa/ / de'i tshe spre'u mig gsum can/ / 'di ni grub pa'i gegs yin zhes/ / yungs dkar rdo rje rdo tshogs dang / / hūṃ phaṭa 'brug sgras ri klung bkang / /gnyid myos byis pa'i kha /dro /zha/ na/ sna nyidri sna swāswā spyi/sna pa gang / / so rnon sta re'i 'jug pa ni/ /zhes par mtshorno na/ don ni rta mgo can gyi yid la re ba'i dngos grub zhu ba'i rgyu skar gyi do shal 'gon pa'i yul la/ mtshan mo'i nam mkha'i bu mo dmar ser can spre'u'i dbang bo khyod 'os so zhes lha chen dbang phyug gis rang gi bu spre'u'i gzugs can la bka' bab pa na/ spre'us kyang yab kyi bka' las 'da' bar ma nus par/ mgrin bcu'i gam du dngos grub ster du 'ongs so/ /mgrin bcus dbang phyug gi ral ba'i skyed tshal du gnas pa'i chu bo gang gā'i khrus la brten nas 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal gyi dri ma 'khrud pa zhig nam zhig na 'ong snyam du/ de'i don la rab tu brtson pa de'i tshe na/ spre'u mig gsum pa de nyid mthong ba la/ 'di ni kho bo'i 'chi med grub pa'i gegs shig yin par /don mi za'o/ / zhesabasamaste/ yuzlos dkar gyi thun rdo /'i rdo rdogs te ༵༵ sdo 〉pa /kā /tākā ༵ /sdo /sna/ byeg tu/ drag sngags gyu phaṭa dngha 'brug byed tshul 'di ni mi 'os pa'i bya ba chen po zhig ste/ dper na/ gnyid

2yo bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/kyis myos pa'i gyis pa'i kha nang du/ ma yi nu tog zhugs pa gang la so phreng rnon po'i sta re'i 'jug pas gcod pa ni/ gyis pa rang gis ma'i nu zho 'thung ba'i gegs dang / ma de yang rma yi zug ju la sbyor ba'i rang gzhan gnyis ka phung bar byed pa'i las te/ de dang kun nas mtshungs so zhes/ legs par bshad pa'i dpal mo 'di rjes su bkol nas/ don gyi gzhon nu ste/ srin po mgrin bcus rang la dngos grub ster bar phebs pa'i spre'u mig gsum pa la yungs dkar rdo rje'i ser bas brabs shing / hūṃ phaṭa kyi drag sngags zlos pa de ni rang gzhan /nyis ku phung ba'i rgyu lasna ma jidas pa gson nyams ldan zhing bden lugs // kta/ zlo( dri sdin ca sna cad/khyi sdo sna /spya/ mtshang gsang mthon pos/ /dgra bo'i skyon bzhin nags tshal du/ / nam mkha' 'gengs pa'i sgra chen byas/ /gzhu 'dzin rje bo rā ma ṇas/ / ri dwags bzung bar ma nus te/ /mtheb long sbyor ba med pa 'ga'i/ / tshig mna'i shugs kyis 'ben dag phug /yan lag cung zad nyams gyur na/ / sman dpyad dka' ba ma yin rdorsha 'a/ / snying la tsher ma zug na ni/ / tsher 'dzin dag gis 'don par zhes par mtshon na/ don ni rol rnyed ma ste btsun mo sī tā zhes don med par tshig tsub kyi nga ro sgrogs pa can des/ dper na/ mtshan mo'i dus su khyi ngan dag don la rang nyid rkun ma lta bu'i dgra la 'jigs nas skyon mtshang skad gsang mthon pos sgrog pa yin yang / de min par dgra bo'i skyon sgrog pa yin pa ltar skad byed pa de bzhin du/ nags tshal de nyid du rgyal po lags ri dwags chen mo gan zungs shig ces nam mkha' 'gongs pa'i sgra chen po sgrogs par byas so/ / mda' gzhu 'dzin la dpa' rtul can gyi rā ma ṇas/mda'agazhu mtheb sor rnams lhan cig tu sbyar ba'i mtheb long gi sbyor bas/

bod kyi snga dar rtsom rig 235sprul ba'i ri dwags de bzung bar ma nus te/ ma nus pa'i sngon la/ mtheb longagi sbyor ba med pa'i bud med 'gas tshig tsub kyi mda' rnon po'i shugs kyis tshur bdeg pas/ snying gi 'ben dag phug go /tshul 'di ni/ rkang lag la sogs pa'i yan lag mtshon gyis rmas te cung zad nyams par gyur na/ sman pas sman bcos mdzad pas gso dka' ba ma yin yang / snying la tsher ma zug na ni kha spu sogs 'don pa'i 'dzin spyad dag gis 'don par shin tu dka' ba dang kun nas mtshungs so zhes legs par bshad pa'i dpal mo 'di yis don gyi gzhon nu ste/ btsun mo sī tā yis rgyal po rā ma ṇa sprul ba'i ri dwags 'dzin par gsang mtho'i tshig tsub kyis skul ba rgyal po nyid kyi snying la mda' mo bzhin phog pa de gson nyams ldan zhing bden lugs yod pa'i ngang mtshon par mdzad/ yang dper na/gang yang mna' yi bka' mchid utpal sngon po'i phreng 'di mig zur dang 'grogs rna ba'i rgyan du 'os pa ste/ / rnam bkra dbang bo'i gzhu mchog la sred nu zho'i lto can gom pa'i 'gros 'khyor phyogs bskad mgron por gyur ces thos/ /bye ma'i rdul brtsegs phrag pa la zhon nyi ma'i chu rgyun me tog dus 'dir ri dwags lus la ngal ba ster/ /dri med shel gyi rtsig ngos la chags rab bkra'i pad tshal pir gyi ri mo bung ba'i 'gram pa nyams so lo/ /zhes par mtshon na/ gang yang rgyal po rā ma ṇa'i mna' yi bka' mchid utpal sngon po 'di ni/ btsun mo sī tā'i mig zur dang lhan cig 'grogs pa'i rna ba'i mdzes rgyan du 'os pa zhig yin srid de/ gzhan du na bud med kyi kha la rgyug pa las phongs pa mang ste/ dper na/ rnam par bkra ba'i 'ja' tshon gyi mdzes sdug la mngon par chags pa'i byis pa chung ngu 'ga' zhig gis de 'dzin par 'dod nas rgyug rgyug pas na/ skabs shig na thang chad de/ gom 'gros 'khyor zhing 'khyor zhing rang yul gang na yod pa'ang mi shes par phyogs bslad

236 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/pa'i mgron po lam stor ba lta bur gyur ces thos la/ gzhan yang / bye ma'i ri bo'i phrag pa la zhon pa'i nyi ma'i 'od snang las byung ba'i smig rgyu'i chu rgyun sngo dwangs dwangs 'gro ba lta bu'i snang ba 'dis/ dbyin kur skom pas gdung ba'i ri dwags rnams chu yod du re nas yun ring rjes la bsnyegs pas/ lus la ngal ba ster bar byed cing / dri med shel gyi rtsig ngos la chags pa'i rab mdzes padma'i dga' tshal ri mo 'bri mkhan gyi mdzes pa'i bar gyis bris pa mthong ba na/ rkang drug dag gis pad tshal du 'khrul nas sbrang rtsi spyod 'dod kyi bsam pas/ yang yang rtsig ngos la brdab pas na 'gram pa bcom zhing nyams par byas so zhes dgod bro la nyams snang mtshar ba'i legs par bshad pa'i mdzes sdug gi dpal mo de gsum gyis/ don gyi gzhon nu ste/ rgyal po rā ma ṇa btsun mo sī tā'i kha ngan pa'i rjes su rgyug pa de ni/ mthar rgyal po rang nyid phung ba'i rgyu'o zhes pa bden lugs yod pa'i sgo nas bstan pa lta bu'o/ /bzhi/ ka mad do shal mig gi mgul bar brgyan pa/nga tshos sngon byon mkhas pa rnams kyi gsung rab la legs par mjal tshe/rjodabyed kyi tshig rnams snyan ngag me long ma'i lus ltar phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyan sna tshogs la bcings yod par ma zad/ skabs skabs su bya dka' ba'i rgyan te ka rtsom la bcings yod pa'i snyan tshig rgyun du mthong rgyu yod pa red/debazhin du mkhas dbang zhang zhung chos dbang grags pas kyang rgyal po rā ma ṇa'i gtam rgyud las bcoms pa'i snyan ngag gi bstan bcos 'di'i rjod byed / // /ra zhig ka mad do shal gyis rnam par brgyan nas bcoms 'dug ste/ka ling ka yi bdag po de'i/ /kha yi rgya mtshor mchog sbyin gyi/ / ga bur gang gu'i ji snyed rgyun/ /nga las longs zhes drag pos smras/ / ca co'i glu yis co nas 'dren khyod ci yang mchod tshig ce spyang skad mtshungs lus gcu zhing / /

bod kyi snga dar rtsom rig 237cha lugs tsog pus cho ga la 'bad chu gtsang mchod yon rin thang che ba'i skyogs nang du/ / ja yi btung ba'i mu ma'i jo bo ji tsam dgyes pa'i je mang 'dod yon ju rtse'i gos sogs zong 'di dag / nya gang zla bar 'chi ba'i nyi 'od nye ba'i skabs med nyo tshong nyung ngu min 'di'i slad du'o/ / te bor yun ring bya tna kāswā /kā la/ byen tsho zlos mehās par spyad pa'i tshig / de ltar ga chad smra ba ni/ /zhes pa ni/ rnga yab gling gi bya ka yi ling ka bdag por gyur pa'i srin po'i dbang bo de nyid kyi kha yi rgya mtsho'i nang der ci 'dod pa'i mchog sbyin nam dngos grub kyi ga bur te zla 'od kyi bdud rtsi'i thigs pa gang gā'i rdul ji snyed pa de snyed kyi rgyun dgos na'ang ster bar byed kyi/ ci tsam dgos pa nga las longs shig ces lha chen dbang phyug gis smras so/ /srin po mgrin pa bcu bas ca co'i glu dbyangs kyis co nas 'dren pa po lha chen dbang phyug khyod la lan gcig min par ci yang mchod pa'i tshig gi nga ro gzengs mtho ba ce spyang gi skad dang mtshungs par sgrogs shing / lha chen dbang phyug yun ring bsgrubs kyang ma grub pas ma dga' bar lus gcu ba dang / cha lugs tsog pu'i 'dug stangs kyis lha khyod bsnyen pa'i cho ga la 'bad bzhin 'bab chu gtsang ma'i mchod yon sbrengs shing / rin thang che ba'i rin chen skyogs nang du blugs pa'i kha dog dri ro phun sum tshogs pa'i ja yi btung bas ni/ lha mo u ma'i jo bo'am bdag po lha chen dbang phyug nyid ji tsam dgyes pa'i mchod pa'i yo byad nyin re bzhin je mang du song ba'i gzugs sgra dri ro regs sogs kyi 'dod pa'i yon tan mtha' yas pa dang / ju rtse'i yul gyi gos khyad par ba dang / gzhan yang gser dngul sogs gces shing phangs pa'i zong 'di dag phangs pa med par phar btang nas/ tshur yid la re ba'i dngos po zhig nyo bar 'dod pa ni/ kho bo'i tshe srog nya gang ba bco lnga'i zla ba la
des/ byen rtangasna ra tshi zlo sdoka'/da shāku byenas rno / /dro spya je trī dasde 1byesdus yin bye/ /ba'i ṭwāṃ/sdu /gyur gyi rjod byed tshig gis brjod bya'i don rnams legs par bstan pa

bod kyi snga dar rtsom rig 239don tshan dgu ba/ dge ldan legs bshad/dang po/ rtsom papo'i lorgyusamador bstan pa/mkhas pa dang blun po brtag pa'i bstan bcos dge ldan legs bshad padma dkar bo'i chun po zhes bya ba'i rtsom pa po ni mkhas pa bsod nams grags pa yin te/ khong sbyi lo 1478la a mdo nas sku 'khrungs shing / dgung lo bcu drug bzhes skabs khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung ste mdo sngags rig gnas la gsan sbyong gang legs mdzad pa dang / rjes su mkhas pa'i grags snyan phyogs kun tu khyab par gyur nas lha sa'i 'bras spungs dgon pa'i dge bshes kyi go 'phang brnyes pa dang / dgung lo nga gnyis bzhes skabs dga' ldan dgon pa'i gser khrir bzhugs nas bstan pa la sman pa'i 'phrin las ༵༵ du mdzad/ dgung lo don drug bzhes pa spyi lo 1554la sku gshegs gnyisapa/ dge ldanalegasabashad kyi bsamablo'i nang don/de yang mkhas pa dang blun po brtag pa'i bstan bcos dge ldan legs bshad la sho lo ka brgya dang nyer lnga mchis shing / brjod don gtso bo ni mkhas

240 bodakyirtomarigalorgyus riga'adzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/pa'i rmad byung spyod tshul lam yon tan/ blo gros dang mkhyen dpyod la sgo kun nas bsngags brjod mdzad pa dang / blun po'i rmongs rtul dang tha shal spyod tshul la mtha' gcig tu ther 'don dang mtshang 'byin byas te/ legs nyes /nga blang gi cha la mi nor ba'i go bskon slob gso nan du mdzad pa'o/ /dper mkhas pa zhes bya 'jig rten dang / / chos kyi tshul la mkhas pa ste/ /rnam pa gnyis gsungs de bzhin du/ / blun po yang ni gnyis su bshad/ /mkhas pa khog yangs ca co med/ / de yis zab khyad mtshon pa ste/ / rgya mtsho dal bar 'bab pa yi/ / gting dpag mchog tu dka' la ltos/ / blun po khengs shing smra ba mang / / de yis blo chung mtshon pa ste/ / 'ur sgra 'byin pa'i chu phran gyi/ /gting dpag shin tu sla la ltos/ /des na mkhas dang blun po'i khyad/ / ri rab da ni rdul saphran dang / / rgya mtsho dang ni lteng ga dang / /nam ma// sdu/ sdu/sdu ṭā sna ṭwāṃ nā/ ni /chos 'jig rten gnyis la mkhas pa dang blun po rnams ni de gnyis la kun nas rmongs/ mkhas pa'i khog rgya yangs shing ca co med pa ni 'ur sgra med pa'i chu gter dang 'dra na'ang / blun por khengs dregs ldan zhing smra ba mang ba ni 'ur sgra bar med 'byin pa'i chu phran dang kun nas mtshungs pa'i phyir na/ mkhas pa dang blun po'i khyad par ni ri rab dang rdul phran/ rgya mtsho dang lteng ga nam mkha' dang lag mthil lta bu yin no /lha mkhas blun gyi mchog dman dang khyad par mngon gsal du bstan pa lta

— bodakyisngadarartomasdig yid gsumapa/ dge ldan legasabashad kyi rtsomastangasakhyad chos/rtsom pa po bsod nams grags pa mchog gis legs bshad kyi bstan bcos 'di nyid sa skya'i legs bshad la dpe bltas byas nas brtsams pa zhig yin pas/ rtsom stangs khyad chos sa skya'i legs bshad dang gcig mtshungs su snang ba dang / brjod don yang sa skya'i legs bshad las bstan pa'i mkhas blun gyi khyad par mchog dman dmigs su bkar nas brtsams pa zhig yin/der brten/ sgyu rtsal gyi khyad chos dang khyad par du bsam blo'i nang don ni sa skya'i legs bshad ltar phun sum tshogs pa zhig min par snyam mo/ /'on kyang /dge ldan legs bshad la rang gi khyad chos med pa'ang ma yin te/ rjod byed tshig gi sbyor ba bde zhing kha gsal ba dang / sho lo ka mang che ba'i tshig rkang rjes ma'i yig 'bru mtha' mar byed la ltos/ tshul la ltos zhes skul tshig bzhag nas/dpyod ldan gyi klog mkhan rnams kyis cis kyang legs nyes spang blang gi cha la sna/sdu kā/ kā sdi/ pa pa /snam gzhigs gtong dgos pa'i bslab bya nan du mkhas pas lto gos khyad bsad nas/ /bzang bo'i gtam la ngo sor byed/ dpa' bos gang la'ang mi blta bar/ /g.yul las rgyal bar byed la ltos/ blun pos snyan grags khyad bsad nas/ /cung zad 'byor la ngo sor spyad/ /rku 'phrog byed pa'i skye bo yang / /rgyan gyis mdzes par byed la tshos/zhe/sa dang /

wa 142 bodakyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/mkhas pa dang po bcoms phyin chad/ / ci la thug kyang pha mthar skyel/ /me thobs brgal nas tshong dpon gyis/ / drang srong mchod pa'i snying stobs ltos/ /blun po bya ba gang bcoms kyang / / phyis su 'tshengs pa gcig kyang med/ /khye'u ma skyes pha yis ni/ /bud med lto ba mnyes la ltos/ /zhes mkhas blun gyi mngon gsal khyad par rjen par bstan pa lta bu'o/ / dus rabs bcu bdun par mkhas pa dbyangs can dga' ba'i blo gros kyis dge ldan legs bshad la 'grel ba zhig bcoms tha'i khrod na/dper bkol ba'i gtam rgyud bdun cu lhag mchis pa dang / gtam rgyud de bye/ /dri // shā ṭā bltas tshe/ legs bshad kyi go don snying bo yid la bde

— bodakyisngadar rtsom rig 243 don tshan bcu ba/ bod 'gyur rtsom rigadang po/ snyan ngag sprin gyi pho nya/snyan ngag sprin gyi pho nya ni rgya gar gna' rabs kyi yid kyi 'gyur bag mtshon pa'i snyan dag ring mo zhig yin la/ gna' snga mo tshig nas 'dzam gling rgyalakhab khag gi yig rigs gang mang la bsgyur nas khyab gdal du song ba'i snyan ngag shin tu grags che ba zhig kyang yin/ gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir/lo ngo drug brgya lhag gi sngon du kha che'i paṇḍi ta su man shī dang / 'o tsā ba byang chub rtse mo dang / nam mkha' bzang bo bcas kyis dpal sa skya'i gtsug lag khang chen mo ru bod yig tu legs par bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa'o/ /gcig rtsom pa ponagastsokhol gyi lo samador bsdus/de yang sngon rgya gar 'phags pa'i grong khyer wa rā ṇa sī zhes bya ba'i yul gyi rgyal po sgyi ma shi kā la zhes pa la mdzes sdug dpal gyis sgeg pa'i sras mo dpyid ldan ma zer ba zhig mchis/ sras mo de rig gnas thams cad la mkhas paragyur pa la/ yab rgyal pos sgra la sogs par shin tu mkhas pa'i bram ze mchog sred ces bya ba dbyin ldan ma'i slob dpon du gnan drangs/ yun ring ma 'gor bar bram ze mchog sred sras mo la rab tu chags par gyur nas rang gi 'dod don sras mo la ji bzhin zhus pa na/ sras mo 'thad pa ma byung / de'i stabs kyis bram ze mchogasred sras mo la ma dga' bar gyur cing sems la jus ngan zhig shar nas rgyal por zhus pa/ rgyal po lags/ da ni khyed kyi sras mo la

/2sha —da — bo dkyirtsomarigalorgyug riga'adzinabyeba'irolamatsho/ — spre —mag pa len ran 'dug pas/ bdag spyod lam mdzes shing sgra sogs rig gnas la shin tu mkhasango pa'i mag pa mchos tu gyur pa zhig 'tshol du 'gro'o zhes zhus pa ṅgi na/sa yasamargya py-i ༵༵/ /sdo sbyirsha rngo ku/ na/ tu mag pa 'tshol du byin pa na/gzhon nu glang rdzi zhig g.yang gzar ngos su skyes pa'i sdong bo zhig gi yal ga'i rtse la zhon te yal ga'i rtsa bar sta res brgyab nas gcod kyin 'dug pa mthong nas/ bram ze'i sems la 'jig rten 'di na 'di las lhag pa'i blun po zhig med do snyam nas/ glang rdzi de rgyal po'i pho brang du gdan drangs te/ bdag gis 'jig rten na dkon pa'i mag pa mchog tu gyur pa zhig rnyed do zhes dril bsgrags/ rgyal pos mag pa bzang ngan brtag pa'i tshig 'ga' dris pa niglang rdzis dris pa'i skad char tshig lan gcig kyang 'debs ma shes par bsdad pa'i tshe/ bram ze mchog sred na re/ rgyal po lags/ khong mkhas pa chen pos/shā lta bye /dra'i don med 'dri tshig la lan mi gnang zhes zhus pas/ bde gnyen sgrig gi ston mo byed skabs mag pas bkra shes pa'i kha g.yang zhig brjod dgos mod/ 'on kyang glang rdzis kha g.yang brjod mi shes pa phar zhog tha nasngon nas bslabs pa'i oṃ su sti zhes pa'ang ston mo'i nyin der kha 'phyugs nas u sha ṭar zhes par bton/ de ni ngo tsha ba'i gtam zhig yin pas mgron po rnams kha skyengs nas 'dug ma bzod par byer bas/ yab rgyal po khros nas bram ze mchog sred la dris pa la/ bram ze na re/u ma dang bcas bdag po dang / / bde byed dang bcas 'jig sel te/ /ṭaṃ tshul phyag na mdung thung yang / /zhi ba rtag tu bsrung bar mdzod/ /ces shis pa brjod pa yin no zhes kha yag la bsgyur nas legs par 'grel bas gnyen ston sngar bzhin mdzad/ de nas dpyid ldan mas khyo bo la

bod kyi snga dar rtsom rig 245sgra'i don la sogs pa dris kyang lan mi smra ba la/ bram ze mchog sred kyis bdag gi slob dpon mkhas pa 'dis bud med kyis dris pa'i tshig la lan ci la 'debs zhes pa smras nas mgo bo rmongs par byas pa dang / yun ring ma 'gor bar bram ze mchogasred lho phyogs su bros so/ / de nas dpyid ldan mas khyo bo lha khang rnams su khrid kyang cang mi smra'o/ / mthar lha khang gi phyi khyams su srog chags sna tshogs kyi gzugs brnyan bris pa la gzigs mor khrid pa na/ ba glang gi gzugs brnyan mthong bas ha cang dga' ste phyugs skyong ba'i rnam 'gyur bstan pa la/ dpyid ldan mas/ kye ma'o 'di ni ba glang gi rdzi bo'o/ /mchogasred kyis bdag bslus so zhes smre ngag bton cing mag pa la sdang bar byas/ de nas blo dang ldan na sgra bslab par bya'o zhes sgra khrid kyang rig pa shin tu rtul bas ma shes so/ / rjes su/ yul ma ga dha'i phyogs shig na lha mo nag mo'i lha khang zhig yod pa der mchod bkur byed pa dang phyag 'tshal du mngags/khyo bos rtag par lha mo la mchod bkur gang legs mdzad na'ang dngos grub ci yang ma thob pas yid chad de 'gro ma 'dod par bsdad pa na/ dpyid ldan mas lha mo nag mo'i ltag rgyab tu g.yog mo zhig sped pa dang / kho mo'i khyo bos lha mo nag por phyag 'tshal skabs g.yog mos lha mo nag mo'i ltag rgyab nas la du (spod mang bo btab pa'i za ma zhim po zhig)gtor dgos pa'i bka' gsung gnang rjes/ khyo bo la/ mi la dad pa yod na/ lha la dngos grub los yod/khyodade ring song la mchod bkur gyis dang dngos grub stsol nges yin/ gal srid ma bstsal na sang nyin nas bzung 'gro mi dgos zhes bshad pas/ khyo bo 'thad ma 'thad kyi ngang nas lha mo nag mo'i lha khang du song nas mchod bkur byas pa dang phyag 'tshal skabs/ g.yog mos lha mo'i ltag rgyab nas gang nyid kyi klad la la du gtor ba na/ khos lha yis dngos grub bstsal bar sems nas yid la smra mi shes pa'i spro ba dang dad pa tshad med skyes te/ dga' ba'i 'bod

246 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/pa sgrog sdo // /// // gi /lus kyi sgrib pa dag cing blo rig pa je gsal du gyur nas rig gnas kun la gsan sbyangs legs par mdzad pas/ rtog ge dang / brda sprod pa dang / snyan ngag bcas la shin tu mkhas par gyur te/ kā byi / sas ku kto ṭwāṃ kā tram̐ ṭā 'bangs sam nag mo khol zhes mkhas pa'i snyan grags nyin zhig la/ nag mo khol dang dpyid ldan ma gnyis skyed mos tshal du rol rtsed bgyid skabs nag mo khol gyis lag pa g.yas par me tog padma dang //byi/ /snadame ba rdo/ //rnyi zhig bzung nas dpyid ldan ma'i gam du 'dzum bdag gi lag pa g.yas na padma dang / / g.yon na de bzhin utpala'i me /sdu'i/ bye/ sbya sdo ḍi/yu ba'am tsub pa'i yu ba can/ / gang 'dod longs shig zhes snyan 'jebs tshig gi phreng pa thog mar spel ba na/ dbyin ldan ma /rsha/ py-i /sna kā ༵ zlospriswā hās myos shing / kho tsho'i brtse dungs la'ang bde skyid de nas slob dpon nag mo khol ni phul du byung ba'i snyan ngag mkhan zhig tu gyur par ma zad/ bzo rig pa dang ri mo la'ang mkhas par gyur pas/rgyal po bhi ma shī kā la yis rang la btsun mo mchog tu mdzes pa zhig yod pa de ri mor 'bri dgos pa'i bka' bsgos/ slob dpon nag mo khol gyis btsum mo de'i byad gzugs ji bzhin ri mor 'bri skabs/ lus la gyon pa'i ka shi ku'i gos dang de las mthong ba'i lus kyi sme ma nag po zhig kyang ma bskyur bar mngon shes kyis bris pas rgyal blon thams cad ngo mtshar bar byas so/ /'on kyang blon po phra ma mkhan 'gas rgyal po'i mdun du phyin nas/ btsun mo dang

bod kyi snga dar rtsom rig 247nag mo khol gnyis la lus 'brel yod par 'dug gal te lus 'brel med na btsun mo'i lus kyi sme ba ji ltar mthong ngam zhes zhus pas/ rgyal pos e bden nam snyam nas gsung ma brjod kyang / nyin zhig la btsun mo'i lus kyi sme ba de gsal bor mthong bas blon po dag gis bshad pa bden par rlom nas/slobadapon nag mo khol sgyugs so/ / de nas bzung slob dpon nag mo khol sbyadro stags nges med du 'phyan zhing 'khyams nas 'tsho ba mi rol thabs med yun ring 'gor rjes/ rgyal po sgyi ma shī kā la yis slob dpon nag mo /sna ṭwāṃ kṣiṃ ṭwāṃ tā byi/ ṭwāṃ rashes ༵༵ poXd la 'gyod pa skyes pa dang / slob dpon mtsho yi nang gi padma de/ /'dar bar byed pa'i rgyu gang zhig/ces pa'i snyan ngag tshig rkang 'di gnyis yul phyogs kun tu sbyar nas/sna /pa /sna hā/ ṭī // snanā ༵debs nus na/ der rgyal po'i rgyal srid kyi phyed nyin zhig la/ slob dpon nag mo khol rgya gar byang phyogs sa char 'byor nas/ chang khang zhig tu phebs te chang btung bar rtsom pa na/ snyan ngag de mthonganas chang 'tshong ma la gnas tshul dris tshe/ chang 'tshong mas ji bzhin pa// pa la/ nag mo khol gyis der lan 'debs mi nus rgyu ci zhig yod zer tnahā shā //sdu ṭwāṃ nyi ma nub/ /'phur bar 'dod pa 'dar ba'i rgyu/ /de la chang 'tshong ma rgyal po'i rgyal srid kyi gyed ka la tam sems drag tu /sdu ṭwāṃ kā/cu/ dngha ṭā // // zlo khol la g.yo zol gyis chang yang yang drangs te

248 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/'dini snyan ngag mkhan po kā lī dā sa ste nag mo khol gyi lo rgyus gtam rgyud red/ nga tshos khong gi gtam rgyud 'di las rtogs thub pa zhig ni/ rtsom pa po nag mo khol ni mi las can zhig yin pa de red/ dang thog khong ba glang gi rdzi bo blun po zhig yin yang / bram ze mchog sred kyi bka' drin gyis khong rgyal po sgyi ma shī kā la'i pho brang du gdan drangs te/ bde blag ngang mdzes sdug dpal gyis sgeg cing rig gnas yon tan ldan pa'i sras mo dpyid ldan ma'i mag par gyur pa dang / de nas lha lcam dpyid ldan ma'i bka' drin gyis lus kyi sgrib pa dag cing yid kyi mun pa sangs nas rtog ge ba dang / brda sprod pa/ri mo ba chen mor gyur par ma zad/ phul du byung ba'i snyan ngag mkhan chen po zhig tu'ang gyur pa red/ 'di dman sar gnas pa'i ba glang gi rdzi bo zhig la cha mtshon na/ blo yid la'ang 'char dka' ba'i bde skyid kyi 'tsho ba zhig dang sdushā hā /rsha /sdo / lam zhig dang kun nas 'dra bas/ dngos gnas khong mi yin na'ang / khong nyid ni mi las ngan zhig kyang red/ khong gi bsod nams kyi bgo skal du rnam par smin pa'i phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyal po'i pho brang gi 'tsho ba de mi rtag sgyu ma'i cho 'phrul bzhin yal bar gyur te/ khong nyid rgyal po'i pho brang nas slar yang sprang bo'am 'khyam po'i 'tsho ba spyod pa'i nyam thag dman pa'i gnas su lhung ba red/ khong nyid de 'dra'i gnas su lhung ba'i rgyu rkyen gtso bo ni khong rang nyid kyi rig gnas yon tan dgra ru langs pa de yin te/ blon po tha shal 'ga' nyid la phrag dog skyes nas rgyal po dang khong gnyis kyi bar phra ma bcug pas/ rgyal pos khong nyid mthar bskrad pa red/ de nas bzungakhong nyid ni rgya gar yul phyogs kun tu 'phyan pa'i 'khyam por gyur pa red/ 'di ni rgya gar gna' rabs kyi ches phul du byung ba'i snyan ngag mkhan zhig la mtshon na/ ha cang yid skyo zhing snying na ba'i gnas tshul zhig yin pas/

bod kyi snga dar rtsom rig 249dngos sna/sna /zlo / lapa sdo spya / kā/sdo /kā lī dā sa ni/ skyid sdug res mos su 'gyur ba'i kyag kyog gi mi tshe'i bshul lam khrod du spro skyo 'du bral las grub cing/ ༷ngaraskyurakha gsum snro ro dang ldan sna'i resbyi tshogs 'tsho ba nyams su myangs sna/ sna/ bye/ sna sbyin ṭwāṃ // sbya sdirshaswā /sdu /spra/ nyams myong de rnams ni/khong gi phul du byung ba'i snyan rtsom gyi nor bu de dag 'byung ba'i rgya mtsho lta bu yin pas/ gal srid nyams su myangs pa'i 'tsho ba'i rgya mtsho de med pa yin na/khong gi dngos yod 'tsho ba'i ri mngar la sgyu rtsal gyi gting mtha' zab pa'i snyan rtsom gyi nor bu rnams thon khungs bral ba red/ dper na/ snyan ngag sprin gyi pho nya'i khrod du gnod sbyin ku pe ra yis dga' ma dang kha gtor nas lho phyogs rā ma'i ri bo'i steng mthar bskrad pa'i 'dod ldan gyi skyes bu de'i dran snang gi 'tsho ba de/ nag mo khol rang nyid kyis dngos su nyams su myangs pa'i 'tsho ba ste/ rgyal po : ma shī kā la yis khong nyid dbyin ldan ma dang kha gtor nas rgyal po'i pho brang las mthar bskud rjes/ rgya gar lho phyogs sogs su 'khyams nas bsdad pa'i 'tsho ba dang kun nas mtshungs so/ /des na khong nyid kyis 'khyam po'i 'tsho ba rol skabs/ rtag par zhe chags shing dran pa'i yul du gyur pa ni mdzes sdug dpal gyis sgeg cing / khong rang nyid la bka' drin shin tu che ba'i rgyal po'i pho brang nang gi dga' ma dpyid ldan ma yin pa mngon sum tshad mas grub 'dug pa dang / dga' ma dpyid ldan ma dran pa'i gdung ba yis sbyang yang ldaskul bar brten/ yiX 'gyur mtshon pa'i snyan ngag ring mo sprin gyi dzo nya kā /rsha pa/ga ba ṭwāṃ rshakā dī rna/na pa /sna /na/ gyi pho nya sogs pho nya brgyad dang / gzhon nu 'byung ba/ bya lan ma'i zlos gar/ kun khyab lha mo'i zlos

250 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/sdu kā/gas (353 // // / byed/ skasdis do drug brjod pa/ rma bya 'dra ba'i sgeg slob dpon 'di nyid kyi 'khrungs 'das lo'i skor la/ blo mthun ci zhan lin gyis ha lam sbyi lo 350nas450bar gyi mi e yin nam zhes gsungs/bram ze mchog sred ni mgon po klu sgrub dang dus mnyam pa'i mkhas pa zhig yin par grags pas/ gal srid de ltar yin na ha lam spyi lo'i sngon gyi lo200 yas mas su 'bab dgos/ mthar gtugs na slob dpon nag mo khol ni phal cher spyi lo'i dus rabs gsum pa nas lnga ba'i bar gyi mi zhig yin par 'dug ces rgyal khab phyi nang gi zhib 'jug pa kun gyis tshon rtsis tsam byas pa ma gtogs spyi rsharsha dīdzārsha sdidī kādhi/ ga tshod pa'i lo tshigs shig da lta da rung 'dren byed zhi gnyis/ snyan ngag ban gyi po nya'i brjod don dang de'i bsam blo'i rang ba na/de yang snyan ngag sprin gyi pho nya'i brjod don ni/ rgya gar byang phyogs sa char gnas pa'i nor lha ste gnod sbyin ku pe ra zhes bya ba la me tog gi ra ba skyong gnyer mdzad pa'i g.yog po zhig yod pa des/ rang 'gan la babs pa'i las la ma sgrim par rtag par bag med rnam g.yeng gi dbang du song nas bsdad pas/nyin zhig la/ glang chen gnyis 'ongs te skyed tshal gyi me tog kun nas bcom par nor lha ku pe ra ches cher khros te/ me tog skyong gnyer ba nor lha'i pho brang las mthar bskud nas lo ngo gcig gi ring rgya gar lho phyogs kyi rā ma'i ri bo'i steng yang dag spyod pas 'dug dgos pa'i btsan ljid bzlog tu med pa'i bka' lung gnang bas/ 'don ldan gyi g.yog po de rang gi snying sdug chung ma dang kha bral nas lho phyogs rā ma'i ri bo'i steng zla ba 'ga' zhig bsdad pas na/rang gi pha yul dang pha yul du lus pa'i snying sdug dga' ma nyid rab tu dran

bod kyi snga dar rtsom rig 231pa'i mi bzad gdung ba chen mos yid sems drag tu mnar nas/ lang tsho'i sha stobs rgyad cing lag pa zung gi dpung sha skam nas phra zhing rid par gyur te gser gyi lag gdub gnyis ka yang dpung mgo'i bar du thogs pa med par shud cing lhung bar gyur/ zla ba bdun pa'i zla stod kyi nyin zhig la/ rab dkar sprin gyi phung bo rnams mkha' la snyeg pa'i rā ma'i ri bo'i zom du dal gyis 'phags shing ri rtse ru g.yo zhing 'phyo bzhin byang gi phyogs su dal bur chas pa de mthong bas/ yid la byang phyogs lcang lo can na gnas pa'i rang gi snying sdug chung ma sngar las lhag par dran te/ lho nas byang du chas pa'i nam mkha'i rab dkar chu 'dzin la dga' ma dran pa'i 'phrin yig bskur ba de yin no/ /chu 'dzin la 'phrin yig skur skabs/ rtsom pa pos thog mar rtog pa 'charayan gyi khyug rtsal spyad nas/ nam mkha'i rab dkar chu 'dzin ni 'du shes dang dran rig yod la/ dga' sdang dang chags sems yod pa dang /nyam thag la gdung sems kyi mchi ma bsnyil zhing / sdang ba'i dgra la drag char gyis pham par mdzad pa'i smra shes don go ba'i sems ldan zhig tu rtog btags mdzad nas 'dod ldan gzhon nu de'i skyo gdung dang dran snang gi snying gtam mam 'phrin yig 'khyer ba'i pho nya ru byas/ de nas rā ma'i ri bo'i rtse nas lam du chas te/ byang phyogs gnod sbyin gyi gnas lcang lo can la thon pa'i bar du/chu 'dzin kyis cis kyang brgyud dgos pa'i ri lung dang chu klung / grong sde dang grong khyer/ 'brog dgon dang gna' shul grags can/ mtsho dang mtshe'u/nags tshal dang gangs ri sogs go rim de gson nyams ldan pa'i ngang zhib 'bri mdzad pa dang / de nas byang phyogs gnod sbyin yul gyi ri ra ba dang khang khyim/ pho brang dang thog khang / de na rol pa'i nor lha'i 'tsho ba/ rang gi pha yulagyi mdzes ljongs dang rta babs/ khang khyim sogs mdzes tshon gyi ri mor bris pa bzhin zhib 'bri mdzad cing / yul de na rang nyid kyi snying sdug dga'

252 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mcho/ma sdug bsngal du lhung 'dug pa'i rnam pa yid ngor cir yang 'char ba la sogs nyams 'gyur stong ldan du bris pa dang / mjug mthar/ 'dod ldan gyi g.yog po des rang gi dga' ma dran drags pa'i sems kyi skyo gdung zhib 'bri dang /gnod sbyin ku pe ra yis chad pa bcad pa'i lo gcig gi nyi ma yongs su rdzogs na nged gnyis mnyam 'dzoms kyi skal ba bzang bo de ldan par 'gyur pas yid ma skyo zhig ces dga' mar sems gso mdzad yod/gong nas mdor bsdus pa 'di ni snyan ngag sprin gyi pho nya'i brjod don yin pa red/ brjod don 'di la gzhigs na/ yid 'gyur mtshon pa'i snyan ngag ring mo 'di'i bsam blo'i rang bzhin ni 'di ltar yin par snyam ste/ dran pa'i skyo gdung las grub pa'i snyan ngag 'di'i khrod du/ na gzhon khyo shug zung kha thor rjes kyi khyo bo'i ngag tshig dang / spyod tshul/ bsam blo/ dran snang/sdug bsngal bcas zhib cha yod la gson nyams ldan pa'i sgo nas mtshon pa brgyud de/ khyo shug zung gi bcos ma min pa'i zhe 'dang dang / gting mtha' yas pa'i dga' zhen/ brjed thabs bral ba'i dung sems/ bla na med pa'i mdza' brtse de mdzes sdug ldan la yid 'gul thebs pa'i ngang bstan cing / de lta bu'i mchog gyur brtse dung la shugs sam zur nas bsngags brjod kyi me tog gtor yod la/ de lta bu'i brtse dung la kha bral gyi sdug bsngal bzo mkhan ///tānā spri /dza rshakā sdi dī ṭwāṃ /la ba'i btsan ljid khrims chad la shugs nas bzhin/gsum/ snyan ngag na gyi po nya'i da rgyad chig dang de'i sgru rtsal gyirang de yang yid 'gyur mtshon pa'i snyan ngag ring mo 'di ni rtog pa 'char yan ring lugs kyi ro ha cang mngar ba'i snyan rtsom bla na mtho zhing khyad du 'phags pa zhig yin par 'dod cing / 'di'i rjod byed kyi tshig la sgyu rtsal gyi

bod kyi snga dar rtsom rig 253khyad chostu ltasnyi ṭā kā /nā lja /shā sbyang/ du/ chas pa'i nam mkha'i rab dkar chu 'dzin gyi rtsa ba'i khyad chos gzhir bzung thog sems med sems ldan du rtog btags mdzad de/ rje bo'i bka' lung gis lho phyogs rā ma'i ri bor mthar bskrad pa'i 'dod ldan gyi skyes bu de'i dran snang dang skyo gdung gi snying gtam ste ༷phrinayigabaskur pa'i yuX du bzhan pa yin te/ (sems med kyi 'dzin de skams /ṭā trī dīkā ṅge kā ma// zlo/ ṭwā sku/ ṭwāṃ /la bgrod pa'i thabs kyi gtam ni mnyan par mdzod/ / de yi rjes su bdag gi 'phrin ni rna ba'i bde skyed khyod kyis rna bas gzung bar mdzod/ /shin tu ngal zhing rab tu ngal tshe ri bo'i rtse la rkang bkod ngal ba bsal nas gshegs/ /gang du skom zhing shin tu skom na nyung ngu'i chu dang che ba'i mtsho la'ang btung bar bya/ /zhes pa'i sho lo ka bcu gsum pa la mtshon na/ kye kye rab dkar chu 'dzin lags/ dus tshod cung zad tsam gyi ring la khyod kyis khyod nyid lam phyogs gang brgyud nas 'gro dgos pa dang / lam du ji ltar bgrod dgos pa sogs kyi thabs lam mchog gi skad cha 'di la rna ba blag ste nyan par mdzod/skad cha 'dir nyan rjes/ snyan zhing 'jibs la rna bar bde ba skyed pa'i bdag gi dran snang gi 'phrin yig 'di khyod kyi snyan dbang gis nye bar 'dzin par mdzod cig khyod nyid byang du skyod pa'i lam du/ shin tu ngal zhing rab tu thang chad nas bgrod par dka' ba'i dus su/ mkha' ru bsnyegs pa'i lhun brjid ri bo'i rtse mor rkang ba bkod de re zhig ngal gsos shing ngal dub sangs rjes mu mthud du gshegs par 'tshal/ gal srid gnas phyogs gang du kha skom zhing shin tu skom nas bskyod par mi nus tshe/ dwangs shing bsil ba'i chu klung dang chu phran nam/ sngo mer 'khyil ba'i mtsho dang mtshe'u sogs gang la thug kyang

254 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/de tshims par 'thungs nas skom pa sel bar gyis la/ byang phyogs lcang lo can du skyod par gyis shig/ ces zla bdun pa'i skabs su chu 'dzin lho nas byang du skyod pa dang / sprin dkar gyi rgyu ba dma' ba'i tshe na ri mthon po'i rtse mo la thogs 'dug pa dang / chu 'dzin ni chu klung dang rgya mtsho'i brlan zhing bsher ba'i rlangs pa mkha' la 'phags pa las grub pa yin pa sogs rang byung khams kyi chos nyid de chu 'dzin gyi rtsa ba'i rmang gzhi'i thog rab dkar chu 'dzin ni byangaphyogs su 'dod ldan gyi skyes bu de'i dran snang gi 'phrin yig 'khyer ba'i blos thub pho nya zhig tu rtog btags mdzad par ma zad/ thang chad tshe ri bo'i rtse mor rkang ba bkod nas ngal gso mdzad pa dang / kha skom tshe mtsho mo dang chu klungagi khar babs nas chu 'thung ba'i smra shes don go ba'i gang zag cig tu rab btags mdzad pa red/ de lta bu'i chu 'dzin la de ltar thugs khur dang dga'azhenatshadame/ mdzad palas/ nga'adod lda/ gyi skyes bu des rardo gi snyiX hā/ hā/shā shā sdu //zlo/ /lha /bye dro ṭwā dga~X nga na dang / bsgyur du cad pa' kwa ye grogs po khyod ni bdag gi dga' ma'i don la myur du 'gro snyam yod na yang / /ka ku bha yi dri ldan ri bo ri bo rnams la yun ring thogs par bdag gis shes/ / gtsug phud can gyi 'dren byed chu dang btsas par legs par 'ongs sam byas nas yun ring gnas par 'dod/ / de slad khyod ni shin tu myur bar 'gro bar 'gyur ba dag kyang ji ltar yin/ /zhes pa'i sho lo ka nyer bzhi ba la mtshon na/ kwa ye bdag gi grogs mchog chu 'dzin lags/ khyod nyid bdag gis snying sdug dga' mar bcangs pa'i dga' ba ste brtse dung gi ched du/ myur ba myur du byang phyogs lcang lo can du gnas pa'i bdag gi dga' ma'i gam du 'gro snyam yod na'ang / ka ku bha ste shing dug mo nyung gi bsung ngad kyis kun nas khyab pa'i ri bo rnams dang / de

bod kyi snga dar rtsomarig 255min ri bo gzhan dag la thogs pa'am 'khyud cing / chags nas dus yun ring bor lus 'gro ba bdag gis bsam na shes thub bo/ /rgyu mtshan gang gi phyir zhe na/ gnas de ru gtsug phud can te rma bya'i bu mo rnams nam mkha'i chu 'dzin khyod nyid dang mjal ba'i mod la/ mig zung la spro ba'i mchi ma 'khyil bzhin dga' ba'i sgro gur mdzes par phub pa dang bcas/ khyod nyid legs par 'ongs sam zhes chu 'dzin khyod la 'tshams 'dri byed cing / khyod nyid nam yang rmas kho mo dang mi 'bral bar gtan du gnas par 'dod pa'i rnam 'gyur ci yang ston pa'i phyir na/ chu 'dzin khyod nyid byang du skyod pa'i lam du mi 'gor bar shin tu myur ba'i sgo nas 'gro bar 'gyur ba ni ci la srid yang mi srid do/ /los yin te/ rab dkar chu 'dzin khyod kyang bdag dang 'dra bar dran snang dang chags sems ldan pa'i 'dod ldan gyi skyes bu zhig yin phyir/ byang du skyod pa'i lam du chu 'dzin khyod nyid la yang zhe chags sa'i snying sdug dga' ma yod pa dang / dga' ma de dag gis khyod la dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur ci yang bstan nas/ khyod nyid gnas de ru nam yang mi 'bral bar gtan du bzhugs pa la re mos dang zhu ba'ang yang yang byed par 'gyur ro/ / zhes rma bya ni chu 'dzinadang chu 'dzin khrod grags pa'i 'brug sgra la rab tu chags nas sgro gur phub pa dang / 'brug sgra thos tshe mngal 'dzin pa dang / chu 'dzin ni ri mthon po dag la zhe chags pa ji bzhin thogs nas 'dug pa sogs rang byung chos nyid gzhir bzung thog rab dkar chu 'dzin la dran shes dang bsam blo/ ngal dub dang ltogs skom sogs yod par ma zad/ dga' sdug dang chags sems kyang yod pa'i gang zag cig tu rtog btags mdzad pa red/ de lta bu'i chu 'dzin byang la skyod pa'i lam du rma bya'i bu mo sogs la sems pa chags nas re zhig 'gro dgos pa'ang brjed 'gro ba'i gnas tshul de 'phrin skur mkhan gyis rtogs thub la der dmigs bsal yang sbyin pa ni/ 'phrin skur mkhan kho rang

bod kyi snga dar rtsomarig 255min ri bo gzhan dag la thogs pa'am 'khyud cing / chags nas dus yun ring bor lus 'gro ba bdag gis bsam na shes thub bo/ /rgyu mtshan gang gi phyir zhe na/ gnas de ru gtsug phud can te rma bya'i bu mo rnams nam mkha'i chu 'dzin khyod nyid dang mjal ba'i mod la/ mig zung la spro ba'i mchi ma 'khyil bzhin dga' ba'i sgro gur mdzes par phub pa dang bcas/ khyod nyid legs par 'ongs sam zhes chu 'dzin khyod la 'tshams 'dri byed cing / khyod nyid nam yang rmas kho mo dang mi 'bral bar gtan du gnas par 'dod pa'i rnam 'gyur ci yang ston pa'i phyir na/ chu 'dzin khyod nyid byang du skyod pa'i lam du mi 'gor bar shin tu myur ba'i sgo nas 'gro bar 'gyur ba ni ci la srid yang mi srid do/ /los yin te/ rab dkar chu 'dzin khyod kyang bdag dang 'dra bar dran snang dang chags sems ldan pa'i 'dod ldan gyi skyes bu zhig yin phyir/ byang du skyod pa'i lam du chu 'dzin khyod nyid la yang zhe chags sa'i snying sdug dga' ma yod pa dang / dga' ma de dag gis khyod la dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur ci yang bstan nas/ khyod nyid gnas de ru nam yang mi 'bral bar gtan du bzhugs pa la re mos dang zhu ba'ang yang yang byed par 'gyur ro/ / zhes rma bya ni chu 'dzinadang chu 'dzin khrod grags pa'i 'brug sgra la rab tu chags nas sgro gur phub pa dang / 'brug sgra thos tshe mngal 'dzin pa dang / chu 'dzin ni ri mthon po dag la zhe chags pa ji bzhin thogs nas 'dug pa sogs rang byung chos nyid gzhir bzung thog rab dkar chu 'dzin la dran shes dang bsam blo/ ngal dub dang ltogs skom sogs yod par ma zad/ dga' sdug dang chags sems kyang yod pa'i gang zag cig tu rtog btags mdzad pa red/ de lta bu'i chu 'dzin byang la skyod pa'i lam du rma bya'i bu mo sogs la sems pa chags nas re zhig 'gro dgos pa'ang brjed 'gro ba'i gnas tshul de 'phrin skur mkhan gyis rtogs thub la der dmigs bsal yang sbyin pa ni/ 'phrin skur mkhan kho rang

256 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/spras rnyi/ tā / / gyi skyes bu zhig yin par ma zad/ 'dod gdung gis mnar der brten/ rtsom pa pos nam mkha'i rab dkar chu 'dzin gyi rtsa ba'i hākā shās gzhi/gabasprang ste/ shāX spyad kyi chu 'dzin de sems ldan gyi blos thub ( // /da rte/ hā/ rdzu /rte / pad byed rto/ga pa 'char yan ring lugs gnyis sdong sdi sprapa /sa brjod don nyams 'gyur 'bum ldan du mtshon par byas yod de na bdag po'i gnas su mchog gi btsun mo rnams ni rab dga' snyeg par byed pa na/ / mtshan mo'i mun pa stug po rnams kyis mi yi bdag po'i lam gyi snang ba 'gog byed pas/ /khyod kyi glog 'od gser mdog 'od kyi snang bas sa gzhi'i lam ni kun nas bstan par mdzod/ / chu char 'brug dbyangs sgra chen mang bo ma byed mdzes ma de rnams skrag cing 'chi bar 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i sho lo ka dgu ba la mtshon na/ gnas de na mchog tu mdzes shing 'dod pa'i bya ba la zhugs par rab tu spro ba'i btsun mo ste gzhon nu ma bzang mo rnams mtshan mo'i dus su/ gsang stabs kyis rang gi bdag po'i rtsar shin tu dga' ba'i yid kyis rkang 'jab lag 'jab byas nas 'gro ba na/mtshan mo'i mun smag stug po rnams kyis bsam pa gnag pa bzhin du lam gyi snang ba yongs su bsgribs pas/ phyogs gang la 'gro dgos pa'ang mi shes par rmongs pa'i gnas su lhung ba na/ chu 'dzin khyod kyis glog zhags gser mdog gi 'od snang gis bdag po'i sa gzhi'i steng gi skya mo lam ni gsal bor bstan nas 'gro bar 'jug rgyu mkhyen mkhyen/ 'on kyang chu 'dzin lags/ khyod kyis drag char bsnyil ba'am mi sems la zhed snang skyed pa'i 'ur 'ur 'brug sgra chen po sgrogs pa sogs gtan nas mi byed par kha khu sim mer 'dug rgyu mkhyen

bod kyi snga dar rtsom rig 257mkhyen/ gal srid khyod kyis de ltar byas na/ gcig na sems su ngo tsha yod pa dang / gnyis su yid kyi spobs pa chung phyir/ mdzes ma de rnams ches cher skrag par 'gyur zhing / 'jigs skrag des rkyen byas nas 'chi bar 'gyur ba'ang srid do zhes mun pa stug pos lam gyi snang ba yongs su 'gog pa'i mtshan mo'i dus su/ 'dod ldan btsun mo rnams gsang stabs kyis rang gi mdza' bo'igam du 'dod pa'i dga' ston la spyod par snyeg pa de ni dngos yod kyi 'tsho ba ngo ma zhig dang bden drang yin yang / nam mkha'i chu 'dzin la/ khyod kyis de'i skabs su drag char bsnyil ba'am 'brug sgra chen po sgrogs pa sogs gtan nas mi mdzad par/ btsun mo rnams 'gro sa'i lam de glog zhags 'khyug pa'i 'od snang gis gsal bar ston par mdzod cig ces smra ba ni rtog pa 'charayan gyi rnam pa zhig yin phyir/ gson nyams ldan pa'i dngos yod kyi 'tsho ba der rmad du byung ba'i rtog pa 'char yan gyi sgyu rtsal gyis rnam par brgyan nas/ brjod don nyams 'gyur ldan la mdzes sdug ldan pa'i sgo nas mtshon par byas pa red/ mtshan mor mdza' bo'i gam du gsang stabs kyis 'gro ba'i btsun mo rnams la de ltar thugs khur mdzad pa las/ 'dod ldan gyi skyes bu des byang phyogs lcang lo can na gcig pur lus pa'i rang gi snying sdug /ga' ༵ py-i ji 'dra'i mdza' brtse dang gdung sems bcangs yod pa shes thub khyodani bdag gi rmi lam dag tu 'ongs shing thob pa ci yang mthong bar gyurapa na/ / kho bos dam du 'khyud par bya ba'i ched du nam mkha' dag la lag yugs byas pa ni/ sa la gnas pa'i nags kyi lha rnams kyis ni nges par ma mthong ma yin mang bo ru/ / mu tig brgyus pa bzhin du shing gi yal ga rnams la mchi ma'i dum bu lhung bar gyur/ /zhes pa'i sho la ka brgya dang brgyad pa la mtshon na/ bdag mtshan mor

bod kyi snga dar rtsom rig 257mkhyen/ gal srid khyod kyis de ltar byas na/ gcig na sems su ngo tsha yod pa dang / gnyis su yid kyi spobs pa chung phyir/ mdzes ma de rnams ches cher skrag par 'gyur zhing / 'jigs skrag des rkyen byas nas 'chi bar 'gyur ba'ang srid do zhes mun pa stug pos lam gyi snang ba yongs su 'gog pa'i mtshan mo'i dus su/ 'dod ldan btsun mo rnams gsang stabs kyis rang gi mdza' bo'igam du 'dod pa'i dga' ston la spyod par snyeg pa de ni dngos yod kyi 'tsho ba ngo ma zhig dang bden drang yin yang / nam mkha'i chu 'dzin la/ khyod kyis de'i skabs su drag char bsnyil ba'am 'brug sgra chen po sgrogs pa sogs gtan nas mi mdzad par/ btsun mo rnams 'gro sa'i lam de glog zhags 'khyug pa'i 'od snang gis gsal bar ston par mdzod cig ces smra ba ni rtog pa 'charayan gyi rnam pa zhig yin phyir/ gson nyams ldan pa'i dngos yod kyi 'tsho ba der rmad du byung ba'i rtog pa 'char yan gyi sgyu rtsal gyis rnam par brgyan nas/ brjod don nyams 'gyur ldan la mdzes sdug ldan pa'i sgo nas mtshon par byas pa red/ mtshan mor mdza' bo'i gam du gsang stabs kyis 'gro ba'i btsun mo rnams la de ltar thugs khur mdzad pa las/ 'dod ldan gyi skyes bu des byang phyogs lcang lo can na gcig pur lus pa'i rang gi snying sdug /ga' ༵ py-i ji 'dra'i mdza' brtse dang gdung sems bcangs yod pa shes thub khyodani bdag gi rmi lam dag tu 'ongs shing thob pa ci yang mthong bar gyurapa na/ / kho bos dam du 'khyud par bya ba'i ched du nam mkha' dag la lag yugs byas pa ni/ sa la gnas pa'i nags kyi lha rnams kyis ni nges par ma mthong ma yin mang bo ru/ / mu tig brgyus pa bzhin du shing gi yal ga rnams la mchi ma'i dum bu lhung bar gyur/ /zhes pa'i sho la ka brgya dang brgyad pa la mtshon na/ bdag mtshan mor

258 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyusarig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/gnyid la yur skabs/ snying sdug dga' ma khyod nyid bdag gi rmi lam du 'ongs pa ste/ rmi lam du khyod nyid mthong zhing khyod nyid bdag la thob par gyur pa'i tshe na/ bdag gis khyod nyid dran drags pas dga' ma khyod nyid shor bar dogs nas/ khyod kyi mgrin pa la dam por 'khyud pa'i ched du lag pa zung phar bsrings nas tshur bsdams pa sogs nam mkha' la lag pa stong g.yug byed kyin/ dga' ma khyed kyi gces ming nas yang yang bos pa'i rnam 'gyur de/sa la gnas pa'i nags tshal gyi lha dang lha mo rnams kyis gsal bor mthong bas/bdagagi skyo ba'i las dbang la gdung sems chen po skyes nas rab dkar mu tigabastar la brgyus pa ji bzhin ljang mdzes ljon shing gi yal 'dab steng du mchisa'i dum bu ste thigs phreng mang du lhung 'dug pa de ni/ zhogs ku'i nyi gzhon shar ba'i dus su gsal ler mthong bar 'gyur ro zhes rmi lam du snying sdug dga' ma 'thob nas de la 'khyud pa'i slad du/ lag po zung phar bsrings nas tshur bsdams pa sogs lag pa stong g.yug byas pa de ni/ dngos yod kyi 'tsho ba ste bden pa bden drang yin yang / nags tshal gyi lha rnams kyis rnam pa de mthong nas gdung sems kyi mchi ma bzhur ba snga mor nyi ma shar tshe ljon shing gi yal 'dab steng (snga mo'i zil ba)rab dkar mu tig gi phreng thag chad pa bzhin thor 'dug go zhes pa ni rtog pa 'char yan gyi rnam pa zhig yin phyir/dngos yod kyi 'tsho ba der rmad du byung ba'i rtog pa 'char yan gyi sgyu rtsal gyis rnam par brgyan nas/ brjod don mdzes sdug 'bum ldan du mtshon par byas pa red/ 'dod ldan gyi skyes bu de'i dran snang gi las dbang la nags tshal gyi lha rnams gdung sems skyes nas mchi ma bzhur ba snga mor nyin byed shar tshe ljon shingagi yal 'dab dag las mthong bar 'gyur ro zhes brjod don ni/ rjod byed tshig gi cha nas rtog pa 'char yan gyi sgyu rtsal khyad chos 'bur du thon pa'i ched yin pa dang / brjod bya'i don gyi phyogs nas 'dod ldan gyi skyes bu de'i

bod kyi snga dar rtsom rig 259spyan pa'i /ga bsngaX dang / proga' masdu bcadros pa'i brtse sems yid 'gul —bas shārnyi (tā kārdonā ༵ bye/ ṭā kāX/ ༵ /tā /dga' mos dang / rang gi dga' ma dang las dbang gcig pa'i mdzes ma gzhan la gnang ba'i thugs khur/ yang na chags can gyi srog chags mo la bcangs pa'i gdung sems sogs brgyud nas/ rang gi snying sdug dga' ma la bcangs pa'i dga' zhen dang / mdza' gcugs/ brtse sems/ snying sdug dga' ma nyid dran pa'i sdug bsngal dang gdung sems de gting mtha' zab pa'i ngang mtshon yod de/ (de la gzhan dngos brgyud nas yid 'gyur bstan pa zer)dpen na/ngal sos gyur na bgrod bya gsar skyes rnams kyis me tog ser bo'i dra ba mdzes pa rnams/ / chu bo'i chu ngogs skyes pa rnams ni chu thigs rnams kyis bran pa 'phral du 'ongs 'gyur zhing / / chu skyes 'thog ma'i gdong gi 'gram pa'i rngul thigs sel la rna ba'i utpal ngal ba dang / / rnyings gyur la ni nyid kyis skad cig bde ba'i grib bsil yongs su gnang bar mdzod cig kye/ /zhes pa'i sho la ka nyer brgyad pa la mtshon na/ / chu 'dzin khyod kyi ngal dub sos par gyur rjes/ mu mthud du byang gi phyogs su skyod par gyis dang /chu bo rnams kyi 'gram ngogs su gsar du bzhad pa'i me tog ma li ka ser bo rnams la chu 'dzin khyod kyi lto ba las phab pa'i bdud rtsi'i char thigs kyis bran nas brlan par mdzad rgyu dang / de nas myur du phebs te/ chu skyes 'thog ma ste me tog ma li ka 'thu ba'i na chung gzhon nu ma'i 'gram pa g.yas g.yon gnyis su gcig rjes gnyis mthud du bzhur ba'i rngul chu'i thigs pa rnams la grib bsil bsgribs te tsha ba'i gdung ba kun nas sel bar gyis la/ me tog 'thuba'i gzhon nu ma des rang gi rna ba'i rgyan char mdzes par btags kyang rngul chu bzhur ba dang tsha ba'i gdung ba yis ngal zhing rnyid par gyur pa'i me

2yo bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/toga.utpal de la skad cig nyid la bde ba'i grib bsil yongs su gnang bar mdzod cig kye kye brtse ldan chu 'dzin lags/ zhes chu bo'i 'gram ngogs su rnam parabazhad pa'i me tog ma li ka dang utpal dag la mngon gsal du bcangs pa'i dga' mos dang brtse sems de brgyud nas/ brjod par bya ba'i gnad dam pa rang gi dga' ma la bcangs pa'i dga' zhen dang dran sems legs par mtshon pa red/ me tog la de ltar dga' mos byed pa'i don ni/ 'dod ldan gyi skyes bu de rā ma'i ri bo'i steng kher rkyang sdug bsngal gyi ngang nas sdod skabs/ mig mdun du rnam par bzhan cing 'dzum dmul dgod la mgo lcog ldem pa'i me tog ma li ka sogs mthong tshe/ rang nyid kyi snying sdug dga' ma rang dbang med par mig lam du shar 'ongs shing / dran sems kyi bung ba phyir dran gyi 'jig rten nam byang phyogs lcang lo can na gnas pa'i snying sdug dga' ma'i gam du 'phur 'gro ba'i bsam pa'i dran tshul de ma bshad kyang bsamagazhigs btang bas snang ngor shar thub pa zhig yin la/ spyir me tog gis bud med kye mdzes sdug mtshon par byed pa'am bud med kyi mdzes sdug de rnam par bzhan pa'i me tog ga ge mo zhig dang 'dra zhes dpe len pa ni rgya gar rtsom rig gam 'dzam gling rtsom rig gi skad cha'i sgyu rtsal gyi mtshon stangs shig yin pa'i phyir/ der brten/ 'dod ldan gyi skyes bu des me tog ma li ka rnams kyi gdong la chags pa'i sa rdul char thigs kyis sel bar mdzad rgyu dang /'dab ma rnyings par gyur pa'i me tog la skad cig bde ba'i grib bsil gnang bar mdzod cig ces chu 'dzin la zhu ba byas pa yin zhing / de ltar zhu ba byed don yang / rab mdzes me tog la drod skyid ldan pa'i nyi 'od dang bsil zhing 'jam pa'i sprang char gyi gso skyong mkho ba las/ mi gtsang sa rdul gyis gtses pa dang bzod pa bral ba'i tsha gdung gi gnod pa dgos pa med pa de dang 'dra bar/ 'dod ldan gyi skyes bu de la'ang khyo shug mnyam 'dzoms kyi brtse dung gi

bod kyi snga dar rtsom rig 261'tsho ba dgos pa las/ kha bral ba'i dran snang dang skyo gdung mi dgos pa'i bsam blo de shugs nas legs par mtshon slad du yin no/ /yang /de'i gal te rlung gis rab bskyod thang shing lag pa kun tu 'thabs pa las byung ba'i/ / me yi dugs dang me stag dag gis 'brong gi dga' ma'i spu tshogs mang bosreg byed na/ /khyod kyis de rnams zhi ba'i ched du chu 'dzin stong phrag mang po char ni bya bar 'os/ / gang phyir chen po rnams kyi phun tshogs 'bras bu mang bo'i sdug bsngal zhi bar byed pa nyid/ /ces pa'i sho lo ka nga lnga ba la mtshon na/ rab dkar chu 'dzin khyod nyid stug po'i nags tshal brgyud nas bgrod pa'i skabs su/ gal srid rlung chen po g.yug nas thang shing gi lag pa ste yal ga rnams drag tu g.yos shing bsgul nas phan tshun 'thab cing brdar ba las/ me yi dugs te me drod rab tu rgyas nas me stag 'tshub ste nags tshal 'bar bar gyur pa dang / nags tshal de la sdod pa'i 'brong gi dga' ma ste 'brong mo rnams kyi lus kyi spu tshogs mang bo sreg par byed pa'i 'jigs pa chen po byung ba'i tshe na/ chu 'dzin khyod kyis nags tshal du 'bar ba'i me dang / me yis 'bar ba'i 'brong po'i lus kyi spu tshogs de gzhil ba'i chen du skyen par chu 'dzin stong phrag mang bo gcig tu bsdus nas drag char bsnyil bar 'os so/ /khyod kyis de ltar byed dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yin zhe na/ skyes bu chen po dag gi phun sum tshogs pa'i 'bras bu rnams ni gzhan dag thams cad kyi sdug bsngal sel bar byed pa'i dpal yon kho na yin la/ phun tshogs kun gyi 'byung gnas su gyur pa yin pas/ skye bo dam pa'am chen po'i brtul zhugs 'dzin pa'i chu 'dzin khyod kyis kyang gzhan gyi sdug bsngal sel bar mdzad phyir rang gi phun sum tshogs pa'i 'bras bu ste bdud rtsi'i char rgyun 'bebs par rigs so zhes nags tshal gyi 'brong mo la bcangs pa'i brtse sems dang thugs khur de brgyud nas/ brjod par bya ba'i gnad

262 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/dam pa rang gi snying sdug dga' ma la bcangs pa'i dga' zhen dang dran sems/byams brtse dang thugs khral bcas gting mtha' zab pa'i ngang mtshon pa red/'dir 'brong mo'i tshe srog la thugs khur gnang don ni/ spyir 'brong mo gang dang gang zhig yin rung de la rang gi mdza' zhing brtse ba'i 'brong pho zhig yod par nges pas/ gal srid 'brong mo der gnod 'tshe re thebs pa'am tshe srog gi nyen kha zhig byung ba yin tshe/ 'brong pho der rang gi dga' ba'i 'brong mo med par gyur pas dran pa'i sdug bsngal myong bzhin kher rkyang du lus 'gro ba de dang 'dra bar/ gal srid 'dod ldan gyi skye bo de'i byang phyogs lcang lo can na gnas pa'i snying sdug dga' ma de'i tshe srog la gnod 'tshe re byung tshe/ gang nyid 'jig rten steng 'tsho ba rol pas kyang don snying med par gyur cing /sdug bsngal dang pham nyes kyi g.yang la lhung 'gro ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ des na/|/ hā/ rnyi sdo ñtsha dbo pa 〉kā /dri gā dga' ma'i bde sdug la ji 'dra ba'i thugs (4)rtsom pa pos rab dkar chu 'dzin lho nas byang du skyod pa'i lam gyi rang byung khor yug gi rnam pa dang / khor yug der gnas pa'i bya dngos ni /dzesad shādri sdis ri mor bris pa bzhin rnam pa sna tshogs su zhib 'bri mdzad yod khyod 'ongs tshe na grong khyer na chung dga' zhing chags pa'i mig rnams kyis ni smin ma yi/ / rnam 'gyur mngon par mi shes bzhin du blta zhing 'bru rnams kun ni 'phel bar byed pa'i phyir/ / khyod ni cung zad nub tu bskyod cing gnas bya 'phral la rmos kyi rol gyis dga' ba yi/ / gnam chu sgug pa'i zhing la gru char rgyas bya slar yang byang du myur bar dal gyis gshegs/ /zhes pa'i sho lo ka bcu drug pa la mtshon na/ chu 'dzin khyod nyid slebs pa'i tshe na/ grong khyer (grong sde yin par snyam)gyi yid 'phrog na chung ma rnams

bod kyi snga dar rtsomarig 263kyis mthong ste/ gzhan yid cig car 'phrog pa'i smin ma'i rnam 'gyur dang mig zur gyi lta stangs sogs sgeg pa'i nyams 'gyur ston mi shes bzhin du/dga' zhing zhen chags pa'i thong nas rab dkar chu 'dzin khyod la gus pa chen pos lta zhing re mos tshad med byed do/ / na chung gzhon nu ma rnams kyis chu 'dzinatsād la de ltar dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur ston pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yin zhe na/chu 'dzin khyod kyi phang ba las spu char legs par bsnyil nas khod snyoms zhing la btab ba'i lo tog rnam par skyed pa la kho mo tshos re ba chen po bcangs yod pa'i phyir ro/ /de'i phyir chu 'dzin khyod cung zad nub phyogs su song nas yud tsam sdod la/ legs par rmos shing sa bon btab pas dga' ba'i rnam pa snum shig shig tu 'dzin zhing / ltogs pa'i zas dang skom pa'i chu bzhin rtag par gnamachu zil mar re sgug byed cing 'dug pa'i zhing nang du bdud rtsi'i char rgyun gyi dngos grub rgya cher rtsol bar gyis shig de ltar mdzad rjes/ khyod nyid slar yang sngar gyi lam la zhugs te yang zhing zor ba'i gom 'gros kyis byang gi phyogs su myur bar gshegs par mdzod cig ces zhing sde'i so nam pa na chung gzhon nu ma rnams kyis chu 'dzin slebs pa la dga' zhen tshad med byed pa dang / zhing grong gi kho ra khor yug tu legs par btab pa'i khod snyoms zhing /pa pa/shā shā //pa /ra ṭwāṃ /ga byed cing 'dug pa'i zhing grong gi rnam pa de rlabs phreng g.yo ldan snyan par sgrogs shing 'dab chags phreng ba'i sked rgyan ska rags sil sil can/ /dal gyis dal gyis 'gro zhing lang ling mdzes pa'i skal bzang 'khor lo'i lte ba dang ldan pa/ /ro mchog dang ldan chu bo'i na chung bir bin dha ni khyod kyi lam na mngon bzhugs nas/ / dga' ma rnams hākā /dza' bo rnams la rol sgeg thog mar ston cing sked rgyan 'grol 'dra

2sto bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/zhes pa'i sho lo ka sum cu ba la mtshon na/ rab dkar chu 'dzin khyod mu mthun du byang gi phyogs su skyod par gyis dang / lam du/ rab dkar rlabs kyi phreng ba g.yo zhing 'phyo ba dang / snyan zhing 'jebs pa'i sgra dbyangs bar med du sgrogs la/ bya 'dab chags rnams phreng bar brten pa'i mdzes sdug sked rgyan nam ska rags sil sil can de phra zhing ldem pa'i sked par nye bar bcings nas sgeg cing mdzes pa'i nyams 'gyur gyis dal gyis 'gro zhing / phra lhag ldem zhing lang ling mdzes pa'i yid 'phrog byad bzhin dang byad gzugs ldem zhing skyod pa'i 'gros dang bstun nas/ skal bzang 'khor lo ste zab cing mdzes la g.yung drung bzhin du 'khyil ba'i lto ba'i lte ba nyid mngon gsal du ston cing ngom par byed cing / 'thung na ro mchog dang ldan la tsha ba'i gdung ba kun nas sel ba'i chu bo'i na chung ma thar bir dha ni chu 'dzin khyod kyi lam du bzhugs nas khyod la re sgug byed cing 'dug pas/ chu 'dzin khyod kyis chu bo'i na chung ma de yi rmad byung ro mchog longs spyod par gyis dang / chu bo des khyod la/ 'dod ldan dga' ma rnams kyis rang gi snying sdug mdza' bo rnams dang 'dod pa'i dga' mgur rol par 'dod nas mdzes pa'i sgeg nyams ston pa'am/ de ma thag tu 'dod pa'i dga' ston la rol pa'i slad du/ lus kyi sked rgyan dkrol nas gos rnams bshus te mdza' bo la 'dod pa'i brda ston pa ji bzhin du/ dga' zhing chags pa'i mdzes nyams ston par 'gyur ro zhes rab btags kyi sgo nas chu 'dzin skyon lam du legs par 'bab pa'i chu bo thar ben dha yi mdzes sdug gson nyams ldan pa'i ngang zhib 'bri mdzad pa red/der ma zad da dung grub rigs rnams bzhugs pa'i 'brog dgon dang /'dab chags rol pa'i mtshe'u/ 'du 'dzis khengs pa'i grong khyer dang grong khyer gyi rmad byung bkod pa/ rang byung ri klung gi mdzes ljongs dang / gna' shul grags can gyis mtshon pa'i ri chen sogs khra tshon gyis mdzes par bris

bod kyi snga dar rtsom rig 265༵༵/ tyā ༵༵ /spra ṭwāṃ dro par ma ༷ pazhin 'dren byed kyi dga' ston du rim bzhin gzhan/ bod 'gyur 'di la sho lo ka brgya dang bcu bdun yod pa las/sho lo ka bco brgyad pa dang nyer gsum pa ni rjes su gzhan gyis lan zlos byas nas kha snon du bcoms par grags shing / rgya nag pa'i 'gyur du 'di gnyis dor nas sho lo ka brgya dang bco lngar byas 'dug go /gnyisapa/ klu kunasadaga' ba'i zlosagar/gcig rtsom pa po dang lo tsā ba'i lo sa mdor bstan pa/de yang klu kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar zhes pa 'di ni rgya gar gna' rabs kyi rtsom rig bang mdzod las bod du 'gyur pa'i zlos gar rtsom rig cig ste/ rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul gyi rtsom rig pa'am zlos gar rtsom pa po dpal ldan dga' ba'i lha yis(spyi lo39)wa spyi lo648)legs par bcoms pa'i zlos gar 'khrab gzhung khyad du 'phags pa zhig yin zhing / 'gro mgon 'phags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dang sa skya dpon chen shākya bzang bo'i sku ring la/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po smika ra dang pod kyi lo tsā chen mo dge slong shong ston rdo rje rgyal mtshanarnam pa gnyis kyis dpal ldan sa skya'i gtsug lag khang du bod yig tu bsgyur nas bstan 'gyur gyi skyes rabs gras su bkod pa'o/ /gnyis/ zlos gar dang sa gar ma3ga gi dgesatshanabad chos/zlos gar ni rtsom rig dang mdzes ris/ rol dbyangs dang zhabs bro sogs phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa'i 'khrab ston sgyu rtsal zhig dang / gar stegs snang brnyan gnad du bzung ba'i thad mthong sgyu rtsal zhig yin/ de ni cis kyang

2yo bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyu rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/'khrab gzhung dang 'khrab ston pa/ gar stegs/ ltad mo ba bcas rten 'brel bzhi 'dzoms yin dgos/ zlos gar gyi 'khrab ston gang dang gang zhig yin yang gzhi 'dzin sa ni 'khrab gzhung yin zhing / 'khrab gzhung ni rtsom pa pos rtsom rig sgyu rtsal gyi lam nas brtsams pa yin yang / rtsom pa pos brtsams pa'i 'khrab gzhung gi mthar thug dmigs yul ni bam klog byed ched du min pa//ba kta/ // ༵ ḍi bye/ zlohā/ /nga thad mthong gi rang bzhin ldan pa'i ngang spyir zlos gar rtsom rig ces pa ni/ zlos gar khrod du mi sna dang byung rim/ dus tshod dang tshogs ra sogs dus yun thung ba'i gar stegs kyi 'khrab ston dus tshod nang tshad mthon pos gcig bsdus byas shing / rno ngar ldan la dza drag che ba'i gtam rgyud kyi 'gal zla'i 'thab rtsod mngon sum du thar bcad nas mi sna'i gshis gzugs dang mdzad spyod bye brag tu 'bur du thon par mdzad de/ khyad du 'phags pa'i bsam blo'i dgongs don nam dngos yod spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i 'thab rtsod gson nyams ldan pa'i sgo nas mtshon pa bcas byas nas/ 'gro ba mi rnams la sgyu rtsal gyi nyams bzhes gsar ba rtsol ba'i // rsha /sdu/ /sa spang blang gi go bskon slob gso gtong ba'i 'khrab ston sgyu zlosagar la mtshon bya don gyi sgo nas skyo ba'i zlos gar dang / spro ba'i zlos gar/ spro skyo gnyis ldan gyi zlos gar bcas gsum du dbye zhing / mtshon tshul thabs kyi sgo nas gtam brjod zlos gar dang glu gzhas zlos gar/ zhabs zlo / ṭwāṃ kā /ra/ glu ma gar gyi zlos gar/ snyan ngag zlos gar bcas rnam pa lnga dpal ldan dga' ba'i lha yis mdzad pa'i klu kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gara'i gong nas brjod zin pa'i zlos gar rtsom rig gi dge mtshan dang khyad

bod kyi snga dar rtsom rig 267chosayongs/ldanazhing / zlos gakā 'di nyid mtshon bya don sdi sbri nas bskyo /spra rnyi sbyinā // ༵ // sna py-i /sdu/ /nga / mtshon tshul thabs dngha nas glu ma gsum/ makunatu dga' ba'i sa gar sgru brjod donamador bsdus/klu kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar gyi gzhung dngos la 'khrab tshan drug dang 'go rtsom pa'i 'khrab tshan dang bdun yod pa las/ 'go rtsom pa'i 'khrab tshan du rgyal ba thub pa'i dbang bo la mchod par brjod pa'i sho lo ka gsum gyis mdunabasus te gtso bor mdo 'dzin pa gar stegs su zhugs nas ltad mo ba rnams zlos gar 'di mdzad mkhan dpal ldan dga' ba'i lha dang klu kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar gyi che ba mngon par brjod pa yin/ 'khrab tshan dang po ru/ rgyal po sprin gyi bzhon pas rang gi pha ma gnyis la bkur bste zhabs zhu bsgrub ched ri bo ma la yar phebs pa dang / tsan dan gyi nags khrod du sras mo ma la ya can ma dang 'phrad cing phan tshun brtse dung gi mdud rgyar tshud pa'i skor mtshon yod/ 'khrab tshan gnyis pa ru/ thin gyi bzhon pa dang sras mo ma la ya can ma gnyis phan tshun la sems rab tu shor nas mdza' zhing brtse bar gyur pa'i tshul dang / der phyogs gnyis kyi yab yum yang thugs dgyes shing 'thad par gyur pa mtshon yod/ 'khrab tshan gsum pa ru/ sprin gyi bzhon pa dang ma la ya can ma gnyis kyi gnyen ston gyi mdzad sgo spel ba dang de gnyis khor yug rnam par mdzes pa'i skyed mos tshal du gnas skabs/ ma la ya can ma'iming bo bshes gnyen gyi dbyig 'ong nas rgyal po sprin gyi bzhin pa'i rgyal srid la pha rol dgra bos gnod pa'i gtam spran la g.yul bshams par zhus kyang / sprin gyi bzhon pas dgra yang gnyen du 'dzin dgos pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i thugs dgongs bcangs nas 'thad par ma byung pa'i skor mtshon/'khrab tshan bzhi ba ru/ spyin gyi bzhin pa dang bshes gnyen gyi dbyig gnyis rgya

bod kyi snga dar rtsom rig 267chosayongs/ldanazhing / zlos gakā 'di nyid mtshon bya don sdi sbri nas bskyo /spra rnyi sbyinā // ༵ // sna py-i /sdu/ /nga / mtshon tshul thabs dngha nas glu ma gsum/ makunatu dga' ba'i sa gar sgru brjod donamador bsdus/klu kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar gyi gzhung dngos la 'khrab tshan drug dang 'go rtsom pa'i 'khrab tshan dang bdun yod pa las/ 'go rtsom pa'i 'khrab tshan du rgyal ba thub pa'i dbang bo la mchod par brjod pa'i sho lo ka gsum gyis mdunabasus te gtso bor mdo 'dzin pa gar stegs su zhugs nas ltad mo ba rnams zlos gar 'di mdzad mkhan dpal ldan dga' ba'i lha dang klu kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar gyi che ba mngon par brjod pa yin/ 'khrab tshan dang po ru/ rgyal po sprin gyi bzhon pas rang gi pha ma gnyis la bkur bste zhabs zhu bsgrub ched ri bo ma la yar phebs pa dang / tsan dan gyi nags khrod du sras mo ma la ya can ma dang 'phrad cing phan tshun brtse dung gi mdud rgyar tshud pa'i skor mtshon yod/ 'khrab tshan gnyis pa ru/ thin gyi bzhon pa dang sras mo ma la ya can ma gnyis phan tshun la sems rab tu shor nas mdza' zhing brtse bar gyur pa'i tshul dang / der phyogs gnyis kyi yab yum yang thugs dgyes shing 'thad par gyur pa mtshon yod/ 'khrab tshan gsum pa ru/ sprin gyi bzhon pa dang ma la ya can ma gnyis kyi gnyen ston gyi mdzad sgo spel ba dang de gnyis khor yug rnam par mdzes pa'i skyed mos tshal du gnas skabs/ ma la ya can ma'iming bo bshes gnyen gyi dbyig 'ong nas rgyal po sprin gyi bzhin pa'i rgyal srid la pha rol dgra bos gnod pa'i gtam spran la g.yul bshams par zhus kyang / sprin gyi bzhon pas dgra yang gnyen du 'dzin dgos pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i thugs dgongs bcangs nas 'thad par ma byung pa'i skor mtshon/'khrab tshan bzhi ba ru/ spyin gyi bzhin pa dang bshes gnyen gyi dbyig gnyis rgya

268 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/mtsho'i ngogs su spro bsangs su phebs pa na/ bya rgyal khyung gis klu rnams grangs med zas te rus pa ri bo ltar yod pa mthong nas thugs la snying rje tshad med skyes shing / klu dung gi gtsug skyob chen rang lus mkha' lding gi zas su phul ba'i tshul mtshon yod/ 'khrab tshan lnga ba ru/ sprin gyi bzhon pa'i yab yum dang btsun mo ma la ya can ma bcas kyis klu dung gi gtsug las rgyal bu sprin gyi bzhon pas gzhan srog rang lus kyis bskyabs pa'i gtam thos pas yab yum gnyis kyi sems sdug bsngal bar gyur pa dang ma la ya can ma brgyal bar gyur pa'i skor mtshon yod/ 'khrab tshan drug pa ru/ mkha' lding de nyid sprin gyi bzhin pa'i snying stobs dang sbyin pa chen po der ngo mtshar zhing ha las la/'gyodagadung tshad med skyes nas phyin chad klu la gnod 'tshe mi byed pa'i dme bcas pa dang / lha mo u mas 'chi sos ril bu'i chu bran par mdzad nas sprin gyi bzhon pa slar 'tsho bar gyur pa/ 'dab chags rgyal po mkha' lding gis lha'i 'jig rten nas bdud rtsi'i char phab ste sngar bsad zin la rus pa'i lhag mar gyur pa'i klu rnams slar yang 'tsho bar byas/ sprin gyi bzhon pa slar yang 'khor swā ṭwāṃ ༵ spyashā paX gā kā byi/ 〉sdong bskur te rgyal 'bangs thams cad bde skyid bzhi/ rmyakunatu dga' ba'i sa gar gyi bsam blo'irang bzhin/de yang rgya gar gna' rabs kyi khyad du 'phags pa'i zlos gar 'di nyid kyi bsam blo'i rang bzhin ni/ sras mo ma la can ma'i khyad du mtshar ba'i mdzes sdug ste/ rol sgeg dpal gyis khengs pa'i lang tsho'i mdzes pa dang /zhi dul bag yod dang yid gzhungs shing blo dkar ba'i sems gshes la bsngags brjod kyi me tog gtor zhing / rgyal bu sprin gyi bzhin pa dang sras mo ma la ya can gnyis kyi thog ma'i brtse dung dang bkra shis pa'i gnyen sgrig la bstod glu snyan par blangs pa dang / bden bzang mdzes gsum gyi ngo mtshar

bod kyi snga dar rtsom rig 269dge mtshan mngon par brjod pa bcas brgyud de/ snying rje chen po dang lhag pa'i bsam pa ldan la/ byang chub sems dpa'i brtul zhugs dang snying stobs 'dzin pa'i rgyal bu sprin gyi bzhon pa mchog gis khams gsum las 'og ma klu yi khamasakyi 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa sel phyir/ rang nyid kyi mchog gyur brtse dung dang rmad byung rgyal srid sogs rnam par spangs nas/ rang nyid kyi gces srog /pa //'a lding gi kha zas su phul te 'gro ba klu rnams yongs su bskyabs pa ste/skuni srung byed bdag gi bsod nams gang / / rang lus sbyin las de /sdo /dri the//sna pa'i/ lu/bye // rno/ga nyid srid pa srid par ni/ / gzhan ces rgyal bu sprin gyi bzhon pa'i sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa mchog la tshad mthon po'i sgo nas mos gus dang bstod bsngags mdzad nas/ 'gro ba mi rnams kyis bdag bas gzhan gces kyi kun /zlo bzung ste byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod par skul 'ded mdzad pa lnga/ kukunatwa dga' ba'i sa gar gyi skya la༄da chos/'go rtsom pa'i 'khrab tshan dang 'khrab tshan bdun gyis rnam par grub pa'i zlos gar 'khrab gzhung 'di nyid la ni zlos gar rtsom rig gi sgyu rtsal khyad chos yongs su rdzogs la/ glu dang gar/ mdzes ris dang rol mo sogs kyi mdzes nyams kun nas ldan no/ /khyad par du/ zlos gar khrod du mi snas phan tshun brjod pa'i skad cha'am phan tshun len pa'i glu tshig ni sdeb legs shing sbyor bde'i don bzang zhing snyan ngag gi ro phun sum tshogs pa'i snyan ngag 'ba' zhig tu brtsams pa dang / snyan ngag de rnams kyis zlos gar 'di nyid kyi sgyu rtsal khyad chos kun nas mtshon par mdzad yod pas/ 'dir rnam pa bzhi'i sgo

270 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/nas 'a//) pa/ bya sbyang/ kha/mas kyi mdzes pa ni mdzes dpyod rig pa'i gzung yul gyi ches gal che ba zhig yin zhing / rang byung khams kyi phun sum tshogs pa'i pa/ ṅgi pa yis gna' deng gi skye bo thams cad kyi yid kyi dbang bo 'phrog par khyad par du gna' deng gi phul byung sgyu rtsal pa su dang su yin rung rang byung khams kyi mdzes pa la shin tu zhen zhing / nam yang rang byung khor yug gi mdzes pa'i khrod spro bas myos te/ rang byung mdzes sdug gi khams su gsar rtsom gyi nges shes 'tshol bar bgyid do/ rol mo ba pe to kun na re/ 'jig rten 'di na rang byung khams la dga' ba ni kho bo las lhag pa zhig med do/ /bdagagi zhing ra'i mnyal dkrol rol dbyangs ni rang byung khams kyi brtse ba chen po'i phang bar legs par byung ba yin no/ / zhes dang / pho ran su'i 'bag bzo ba lo tan mchog gis/ /rang byung khams nam yang mdzes pa yin/rangabyung khams kyis nga tshor gsal 'debs su brjod pa de shes tshor byung tshe/des chog pa yin no/ / zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ dpal ldan dga' ba'i lha yis zlos gar 'dir rang byung khams kyi khyad mtshar mdzes pa phun sum tshogs ༵༵ ༵༵༵ byi pa/shā /zlo ga/ steder dpadā /ma tshon ri mo'i dge mtshan dang khyad dga' ldan phyogs kyi glang bos 'gram pa'i ngos brdar tsan dan dag ni chag cing zag /chu gter rlabs rnams rab tu bsnun pas phug dang lung ba dag ni cho nge sgrog/ grub pa'i bud med bgrod pa rnams kyi rkang ba'i skug rtsis dmar ba mu tig rdo/ / bsten bya ri bo ma la ya 'dis bdag gi sems ni ci yang sre/ // /da/ /

bod kyi snga dar rtsom rig 271rdo bungapa'i sgrayisalegasapara'ongasasam zhepa ni brjorsha pa bzhi~X/rto/sdu/ tā kā /dro wa //gartswa tārsha kāpa rnyinād ba kārsha /da pa ba na/ / /ga yal ga ldan pa yis kyang mgron gyi bsnyen bkur ji ltar bslabs/ /zhes rgyal bu sprin gyi bzhon pa dang khol bo bi dru ṣa ka gnyis yab yum zung la sri zhu bsgrub par bgrod skabs/ ri bo ma la ya'i rang byung khor yug gi macesas pa'i khu1da du 11 bas myosapashāstidra/dang / rngo ༅ ljo 'og/ patu spyan / zlo /sna pa/ /dri //na da/ tā ga~X /tā zlo ba / sna // wa dpas rdo/ /2de spyar ma bslapas /byor ba thamasacadarnyed pa'i nagasatshaX zirdo ṭwāṃ bye/ ṅge/ braX/ nyi/da /nga ga /kā /zlo ga da dka' gzhan rgyan bsgrub pa' /pa hārshas/ chu yi glang chen dbang bo'i shugs kyis bsnun pas rjes 'brel rab rgyas shing / / ri yi phug nang dag gi sa gzhi thams cad sgra snyan rab tu sgrog byed pa/ / thos pa'i lam 'gog sgra 'di ji ltar drag tu sgrog par /rsha ṅgi snye dṛ / /nga/sa /par /dra 'phar grangs med dung dang ldan pa'i rlabs 'di zhes rgyal bu sprin gyi bzhon pa dang bshes gnyen gyi dbyig gnyis rgya mtsho'i 'gram du lta skor la phyin pa na/ mal stan rtswa 'jam dang / ljon pa'i grib bsil/ btung ba chu rgyun dang kha zas shing tog sdod grogs ri dwags dang 'dug stegs rdo gtsang sogs phangs med du stsol ba'i rang byung khams kyi brtse ba chen po dang / gcig rjes gnyis 'brel gyis 'phyur zhing / ri bo'i phug pa dag tu rlabs kyi sgra snyan sgrog pa/ dung dang nya phyis ngogs kyi skyes su

272 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho//zlo sdo ༵ shā ༵༵ngas rgya mtsho'i rmad byung mdzes sdug la ngo mtshar zhing rnam par (2)snol dbyangs ni sems 'gyu mtshon pa'i sgru rtsal zhig ste/ bzhur 'gros kyi dus tshod sgyu rtsal zhig yin/ rol dbyangs gzugs med yin yang /gshes gzugs mtshon par nus shing / rol dbyangs la kha dog bral yang /kha dog mtshon par nus so/ / rang rgyal gyi rtsom pa po wang ming (1 )lags kyis/ bdag rol dbyangs la dga' 'o/ /rol dbyangs ni bdag gi tshe srog gi cha shas su gyur pa zhig yin/ rol dbyangs kyis bdag la mdzes pa'i longs spyod stob la/ gsar rtsom kyi dngos grub rtsol/ kye rol dbyangs la dga' bar mdzod cig rol dbyangs bral ba'i 'tsho ba ni phun sum tshogs pa'i 'tsho ba zhig ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin / rol dbyangs ni rig dar gyi mi rigs shig la mtshon na med mi rung ba zhig dang / rgyun ldan gyi 'tsho ba zhig la mtshon na mkho che ba zhig yin/ de'i phyir/ gna' deng gi sgyu rtsal pa thams cad rol dbyangs la mchog tu dga' zhing / kho tshos nam yang rol dbyangs kyi rmadabyung mdzes snang sgyu rtsal bcoms chos khrod mtshon par byed/ rtsom pa po dpal ldan dga' ba'i lha yis kyang 'khrab gzhung 'dir rol mo'i mdzes pa zhib 'bri mdzad yod pa red/ dper na/ rgyal bu sprin gyi bzhon pas sras mo ma la ya can mas sbreng ba'i rgyud mangs kyi sgra la gsan skabs/ e ma ho rol mo/'di la gsal byed kyi dbyangs rnam pa bcu bo 'dis gsal ba thob cing /myur ba dang / bar ma dang / dal ba'i stobs rnam pa gsum rab tu gsal bar yongs su bcad de/ ba lang gi rnga ma la sogs rnam pa gsum gyi rim pas ngal gso bar byas pa de kho na'i tshogs kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i rol mo'i cho ga yang dag pa gsum bstan to/ /zhes spros 'dug pa dang /gnas thob rab tu gsal ba'i 'gros can gdangs snyan ngag gis rnam

bod kyi snga dar rtsom rig 273par bzhag pa 'dzin byed pa/ /bung ba'i sgra bzhin nges par yid 'phrog rgyud mngasadag gi rgyud mangs sgra dang ldan pa yis/ / gsal zhing rol sgeg tshig ldan glu ni kun tu 'khyog pa'i lus can ri dwags 'di dag rnams/ /so yi bar na gnas pa rtswa yi kham ni gcod pa'i sgra dag bsdams nas nyan par byed/ /ces dben zhing 'jags la/ khor yug rnam par mdzes pa'i nags tshal de ru ri dwags shā ba yis kham gyis ldad bzhin pa'i gzan rtswa ldan mtshams bzhag ste/ mgrin pa dkyog dkyog dang rna ba cor cor gyis rgyud mangs sgra la // ༵༵ sdo ༵ sdoX las/ rol dbyangs kyi snyan 'gyur dang mdzes snang mtshon kye grogs po ltos sheg ltos sheg ngo mtshar ro ngo mtshar ro/ rgyud mangs kyi sgras rna ba'i bde ba skyed par byed pa 'ba' zhig tu ma zad de/ rnam par /sa pa'i rjes su mthun pa'i gzugs 'dis mig gi yang bde ba skyed par byed zhesagazugs med rol dbyangs kyi mdzes pa yis 'dren byed la mdzes snangalhal bar byed pa ste/ dbang shes tshor brje yi rol myong skyed par bgyid pa bstan pa red/ spyir rol mo ni rgyal mtshams bral ba'i sgyu rtsal zhig yin pas/ der spyi khyab kyi rang bzhin ldan la/ rol mo ni mi'i rigs spyi mthun gyi sems pa'i ngag tshig cig yin phyir/ skye bo kun la mdzes pa yin no/ / de la 'jam dbyangs rnam sprul sa skya paṇa chen mchog gis/ mkhas rmongs skyes pa shākya /ṭā //bying/ sa/ ñtsā/na la mdzes pa rol mo yin/ / zhes rol po'i bstan (3) 'gro ba mi yi mdzes pa ni gzugs byad kyi mdzes pa dang sems gshis kyi mdzes pa gnyis kyis grub pa yin zhing / gzugs byad kyi mdzes pa ni/ skyes gzugs dang cha byad/ ngang tshul dang nyams 'gyur/ rgyan gos dang

274 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/spun pa sogs la brjod pa dang / sems kyi mdzes pa ni/ mi de'i rang gshes dgu kun spyod/ she/ rig spyang phugs 'dun/de/ tshe'i spya tshul dang 'a/ga spyan ༵ tre/ rlo sdutsho sna sdor ba pye ṭwāṃ /spra rtso/ ma kṣiṃ po bye sna zhu/ da/cho rsha rsha shā 0tā bye ṭā mi yi yod tshad mdzes 'os pa zhig yin dgos te/ de'i cha byad dang rgyan gos/de'i sems gshis dang bsam blo sogs mdzes 'os pa zhig yin dgos/ zhes gsungs pa dang / mtshan nyid rig pa smra ba he ger mchog gis/ mi'i gzugs gzhi ni gzugs dbyibs gzhan kun las kyang ches mchog tu gyur la/ches rang dbang mchis pa/ ches mdzes sdug ldan pa zhig yin no/ / zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ 'khrab gzhung 'dir rtsom pa pos sras mo ma la ya can ma'i hā/ :shā /shā/sna /nga /dri /pas gshis kyi mdzes pa khyad du mtshar bar zhib lag g.yon yal 'dab dag la rnam par dkar ba'i gdong ba bzhag nas ni/ /shugs ring dbugs 'byin yid la khro ba des byas smin ma dag /cung zad bskyod cing yun ring thogs pa bdag la bsam pa gsal byas pa'i/ zhi/dga' ma gang du bdag gis mthong ba'i zla ba nor bu'i rdo 'di'o/ /zhib 'bye kāswālda sdi ṭwāṃ rjo ya can ma dran pa'i sdug bsngal la lhung ba'i ngang tshul bltas na mig ni 'og tu ster zhing smras pa dag la kun tu smra mi byed/ /mal bstan dag la bzlog nas 'khod cing stobs kyis 'khyud pa dag la 'dar bar byed/ /grogs mo rnams ni phyir song tshe na gnas khang dag las 'thon pa nyid du 'dod/ / mi mthun nyid kyis de ring bag gsar dga' ma bdag gi shin tu bye/sdo sprad gyur/ /

bod kyi snga dar rtsom rig 275nu ma'i khur nyid khyod kyi rten pa ngal slad gyur na do shal gzhan gyis ci/ /byin pa zung ni tshang ra'i khur gyis gdung bar byed na dril chung 'dis kyang ci/ /rkang gnyis dag gis byin pa zung ni khur nus min na rkang gdub ga sdu //na//rang lus nyid kyis brgyan pa khyod ni nyon mongs slad du rgyan dag ci zhes rgyal bu sbrin gyi bzhon pa'i dga' ba'i dpal du thob pa'i sras mo ma la ya can ma'i yid du 'ongs pa'i byed spyod dang dpal gyis sgeg pa'i gzugs byad kyi mdzes pa phul du phyin par zhib 'bri mdzad pa dang /nyin byed zer gyis reg pas yongs su dmar ba'i mdzes pa 'dzin byed cing / / rab 'phro so yi 'od zer rnams kyis ge sar dag ni gsal bar byas/ / e ma mdzes ma khyod kyi bzhin 'di bden par padma dang mtshungs te/ /thon kyang 'di la sprang rtsi byed pa 'thung zhing rnam par spyod pa med/ /zhicesapas spya ma la ya ca/ ma'i ngo gdong gi mdzes pa yid dbang 'phrog par /sna shā byebye tā kā rdo sdi rte/ ma/chog gis/ sgyu rtsal brtsams chos ni rgyas bshad ma yin par/ nyams 'gyur dang mdzes ris kyis mtshon par byed pa'i dngos yod kyi 'tsho ba yin zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ rtsom rig gi nyams 'gyur ni rtsom pa pos dngos yod kyi 'tsho ba'i khrod du bzhu sbyangs dang las snon mdzad pa'i gson nyams ldan zhing / 'bus gzugs grub la/ bden par nges pa'i 'tsho ba'i snang brnyan zhig yin/ de yang mi sna dang skyes dngos/ khor yug dang tshogs ra sogs kyis grub pa'o/ /'khrab gzhung 'dir/ rtsom pa pos mi sna dang khor yug skyes dngos dang tshogs ra sogs rtsom rig sgyu rtsal gyi nyams 'gyur gson nyams ldan pa dang phun sum tshogs par zhib 'bri mdzad 'dugakhyad par du snyan ngag me long ma las bstan pa'i nyams ldan gyi rgyan te/

276 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/sgeg pa dpa' ba drag shul dang / snying rje mi sdug bzhad gad dang / rmad du hā/ /sdo 'a//pa /nga sogs/ gar gyi nyams brgyad kyi sgo nas mtshon par kun tu rmongs shing yang yang mchi ma'i rgyun gtong smre sngags mang du brjod byas nas/ / bdag gi bu sdug skyob pa su zhes phyogs rnams dag tu phongs pas mig 'phen ba'i/ /ma yi pang na nye bar bsten pa'i bu 'di brtse ba /bye ༵༵ ༵ rdokā ༵/ / bya yi bdag po'i mchu nyid ma yin snying yang rdo rje dag zhes klu'i rgyal po nor rgyas kyis nam mkha' lding gi kha zas su phul ba'i /dro hā spra shāshā ༵ sdusasdu tsho lha /dri kāswā sdo kā //la chen pos mchi ma 'don pa de g.yo ba'i mchu yis drangs te phyed lhag sha yi cha ni zos pas 'dod pa 'phel gyur pa'i/ / bya rgod rnams kyi gshog pa gnyis ni spyong bar byed pas mun pa stug po nyid byas shing / / khrag gi rgyun 'bab mang bo'i zhag ni rgyun du zags shing rul ba'i dri ngad ldang ba 'dir/ / ce spyang rnams kyi kha nas rab 'bar me yi phreng ba lhung zhing lhab ces sgrog par byed/ /dang / ces drag shul gyi nyams dang de la mi sdug pa'i nyams 'dres mar sbyar ba 'jigs pa'i sprin dang mtshungs pa gshog rtse'i phreng ba dag gis nam mkha' rab tu sgrib byed cing / / shugs kyi rlung gis bskyod pa'i rgya mtshos sa gzhi 'gengs pa bzhin du chu dag ngogs su 'phen/ / phyogs kyi gnyis 'thung dbang bo rnams kyis dus mthar dogs pa byed cing 'jigs bcas bltas // ṭwāṃ /ser/ bye/ //sa nyi ma ltar 'bar lus kyi 'od kyis phyogs bcu dag ni
