bod kyi snga dar rtsom rig 277/sna /shā /brlan pa'i mchu dag brdar bas ri la dro ṇi gsar ba bzhin byed cing / /rang gi 'dren byed 'od zer me yi phreng bas nye ba'i nags kyi khongs dag bsregs/ /'jigs rung rdo rje ltar tsub sder mo dag ni mtha' ru sdo dhi sdo/ ༵ /dro bying / /sbrul gyi dgra 'di ma la ya yi cog gi rtse mor ring bo zhes gdengs can klu rnams za bar rab tu rngam pa'i mkha' lding de nyid kyi 'jigs su rung ba'i nyams 'gyur thon par mdzad pa dang /brtan pa'i rgya mtsho 'di yi khrag ni lhag par 'thungs kyang dman par 'gyur ba med/ /sha dag rab tu bcad pa las skyes gdung ba 'dzin yang dga' bas bzhin rab dwangs/ /gang zhig lus ni zos pa min pa de la spu long /// /sdo kā swārsha / / kā/lta//gnod byed bdag la yang ni 'di yi mig dag zhes byang chub sems dpa'i brtul zhugs rnam par 'dzin pa'i rgyal bu sprin gyi bzhon pa yis 'og ma klu rnams skyob par mdzad phyir/ /rang srog /trī/ /dri hā zlos ༵ ltas bu 〉la ba'i rmad byung mdzad pa dpa' ba'i nyams kyis gsumapa/ rtogasabarjod dpag bsama'akhri shing /gcig lhan ngag 'di nyid cam pa po dang skur ba po'i lo sa/snyan ngag byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam 'khri shing zhes bya ba ni chos rgyal dge ba'i dbang bo mchog gis sangs rgyas bcom

278 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rolamatsho/ldan 'das kyi skyes pa'i rabs snyan ngag gi lam nas drangs te brtsams par grags shing yal 'dab brgya rtsa bdun gyi bdag nyid can yin mod/ phyis su yal 'dab mtha' ma rgyal po sprin gyi bzhon pa'i rtogs brjod ces bya ba ni khong nyid kyi sras su gyur pa zla ba'i dbang bo la rtsom par bskul bas de nyid kyis yongs su rdzogs par mdzad do/ / des na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi rtogs pa brjod pa snyan ngag dpag bsam 'khri shing 'di nyid la khyon bsdoms yal 'dab brgya tso brgyad mchis so/ / rtsom pa po 'di nyid kyi 'khrungs 'das lo tshigs mthong thos kyi yul du ma gyur na'ang / phal cher snyan gzhung me long ma mdzad pa po slob dpon dbyug pa can dang dus mnyam yin par snyam mo/ /snyan ngag dpag bsam 'khri shing 'di nyid bod yig tu sgyur mkhan ni skad gnyis smra ba'i dbang bo shong ston rdo rje rgyal mtshan yin zhing / khong rab byung bzhi ba'i phyed snga mar da lta'i deng ri rdzong khongs la stod spyang lung shar kha'i bong ra zhes pa'i yul du sku 'khrungs shing / khong nyid kyis sku na chung ngu'i dus nas bzung stag sde ba seng ge rgyal mtshan sogs bla ma gang mang bsten nas rig pa'i gnas lnga la sbyangs pa gang legs mdzad pa dang / rjes su/ khong nyidakyis bod kyi chos srid zung gi 'gan bzhes pa'i 'gro ba'i mgon po chos rgyal 'phags pa mchog la bdag rgya gar du lo tsā slob tu 'gro 'dod che bas/bdag der rdzong bar zhu zhes zhus pa la/ bla ma 'phags pa'i zhal nas/ de lta bu'i blo skyes pa bzang / gzhung lugs gsar ba bod la bsgyur nus pa 'ong dka' ste/ rgya gar gyi paṇḍi ta legs par bsten nas slob gnyer dang dri gtugs legs par gyis shig kho thos kyang chos rje sa paṇa mchog bsten yun thung rkyen rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i sdeb sbyor me tog chun po dang / tshig gi gter la sogs pa'ang tshul bzhin du mi shes par 'dug pas/ 'di dag shes pa zhig ci nas kyang gyis la shog ces gsungs te/ de dag gi dpe dang /

bod kyi snga dar rtsom rig 279gser srang lnga/ dar yug bcu sogs gnang nas brdzangs so/ /de nas khong nyid bal yul la phebs nas paṇḍi ta bha dra zhes pa bgrang bya lnga la bsten nas rig gnas chung ba lnga la slob gnyer mthil phyin par mdzad pa dang / khyad bye/ hā / // pa la sbyangs pa dbyis phyin par mdzad de/ phyir dpal ldan sa de nas dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud 'grel dang bcas pa bsgyur nas 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa'i spyan sngar phul ba na/ chos rgyal gyis sngon byon lo tsā ba rnams kyis bsgyur ba'i dus 'khor rgyud dpe las kyang ches mchog tu gyur par 'dug ces bsngags brjod mdzad do/ /phyis kyi dus rabs bcu gsum pa'i nang snyan ngag gi lam nas bcoms pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs brjod yal 'dab brgya rtsa brgyad kyi bdag nyid can dpag bsam 'khri shing zhes pa 'di nyid rgya gar gyi paṇḍi ta la ka ra dang lhan du mang yul skyid /tta / ༵ pa/pa pa wa ti bzang bo bzhugs pa'i lha khang du bsgyur cing zhus te skad gnyis smra ba'i dbang bo shong ston rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis da dung tshig rgyan gyi bstan bcos snyan ngag me long dang / dus 'khor 'grel ba bcas pa dang / klu kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar dang / bstod pa brgya ba sogs bstan bcos du ma legs par bsgyur te/ gangs can bod kyi yig bsgyur bya bzhag la ༵༵༵ pa/ tāzlo/ sdu/ rgya pyir dīkā/ rsha dang / rtsom rig sgyu rtsal la 'od stong gnyis/ snyan ngag dpag bsam 'khri shing gi brjod don/shing zhenā sdu dīspra dīhā/ /sna lha py-i kā rdo rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam gyi 'khri dam pa'i sgrub bsil dang ldan brtan pa'i chos kyi rtsa bas bskor zhing

280 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/bsod nams ra bar gnas/ / blo dang rig pa snying rje la sogs chu yis rnam mdzes rnam par rgyas pa'i yal ga can/ / chog shes dri med yal 'dab grags snyan dkar ba'i me tog rtag tu dam pa'i 'bras bu ni/ / bsam kun yongs su sbyanas par mdzad pa dpal ldan sangs rgyas ljon pa rnam par rgyal gyur ba ces gzu/sa stan la basbyangs pa'i sho lo ka 'di nyid kyis mdor bstan pa rnan sdong/ po/ byeng nā sdidīṅge satu/ thugs bskyed de/ / bskal ba grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags shing / / bar du gcod pa'i bdud bzhi 'joms byed pa/ / bcom ldan seng ge de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes dang por byang chub tu thugs bskyed/ bar du tshogs bsags/mtha' mar bdud bzhi bcom nas sangs rgyas pa ni ston pa thub pa'i dbang bo'i rnam par thar ba'i rtsa ba yin pas/ dam pa'i grib bsil sogs kyi don tshul 'di dang mthun par 'chad tshul ji ltar zhe na/ dang por theg pa chen por rigs nges dam bca' mi 'gyur bar brtan pa'i chos smon pa dang 'jug pa'i sems bskyed kyi rtsa bas rab tu bskor zhing 'phel ba ni rgyas bshad yal 'dab dang po rab gsal gyi rtogs brjod dang / brgya ba bsod nams rab gsal gyi rtogs brjod gnyis kyis bstan/ bar du bsod nams dang ye shes kyi ra bar gnas pa la byang chub kyi blo dang rig pa shes rab dang brtse ba snying rje chen po gsum dngos su bstan la/ khongs nas sbyin tshul dang bzod pa/brtson pa dang bsam gtan/ tshul khrims sogs shugs kyis bstan pa'i sgo nas rgyal sras kyi spyod pa'i chu yis rnam par mdzes par byas nas grangs med gsum du tshogs gnyis kyi sdong bo ches cher rgyas pa yin pas/ de'i don rtogs brjod 'dir rgyas par phye ba'i skabs ni yal 'dab gnyis pa dpal sde/

bod kyi snga dar rtsom rig 281gsum pa gtsug nor/ bzhi ba nga las nu/ lnga ba zla 'od/ nyer bzhi ba thams cad sgrol/ zhe gsum pa gser mdog nga gcig pa gser ldan/ nga gnyis pa bsod nams mi dman/ nga lnga ba thams cad ster/ nga brgyad pa bsod nams stobs/ re bzhi ba nor bzang / don dgu ba dbang chen sde/ gya lnga ba phan pa 'tshol/ go lnga ba stag mo lus sbyin/ go drug pa glang bo/ go bdun pa rus sbal/ go dgu ba padma can/ brgya dang gsum pa dga' ba'i gong bu/brgya dang bzhi ba ri bong / brgya dang brgyad pa sprin bzhon rnams sbyin pa'i phar phyin la sbyar/ so gsum pa khyad par lo ma/ so brgyad pa lkugs pa 'phye bo/gya drug pa ba men gsum tshul khrims la sbyar/ sum cu ba kā shi mdzes dga'/soganyis pa dge byed/ so dgu ba bzod pa la dga' ba/ zhe drug pa zhe shes/go gnyis pa mdza' bo'i bu mo rnams bzod pa la sbyar/ drug pa ba da ra bgrod/zhe brgyad pa don grub/ brgya dang drug pa gser gyi go cha rnams brtson 'grus la sbyar/ nga bzhi ba sems can sman/ nga lnga ba rwa gcig pa/ gya brgyad pa nag po glang bo bstan/ go brgyad pa dka' thub pa/ brgya dang gcig pa sngo bsangs can rnams bsam gtan la sbyar/ bco brgyad pa me long bzhin/ so gcig pa gser logs/ nga gsum pa legs bshad 'tshol/ re drug pa snyan ngag mkhan/ go gcig pa shi bi'i legs bshad/ brgya dang gnyis pa seng gebargya dang bdun pa zas gtsang ma rnams shes rab la sbyar/ mthar mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i tshul rtag tu dam pa'i 'bras bu phun sum tshogs pa ni 'gro ba thams cad kyi rang rang gi re ba dang mthun par bsam pa kun yongs su rdzogs par mdzad pa yin la/ de ni/ bdun pa mu tig 'khri shing / brgyad pa dpal sbas/ dgu ba mes skyes/ bcu ba ngal 'byung / bcu gcig pa mdzes dga'/ bcu gnyis pa 'phags skyes po/ bcu gsum pa 'phrog ma/ bcu bzhi ba cho 'phrul bstan pa/ bco lnga ba lha babs/ bcu drug

282 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/pa brag 'phangs pa/ bcu bdun pa byams pa lung bstan/ bcu dgu ba shā ri'i bu/ nyi shu ba gro bzhin bye ba rna/ nyer gcig pa a ma skyong / nyer gnyis pa rgyal byed tshal yongs su bzung ba/ nyer gsum pa yab sras mjal ba/nyer lnga ba mngon par byung ba/ nyer drug pa bdud bcom pa/ nyer bdun pa shākya 'byung ba/ nyer brgyad pa gro bzhin bye ba/ nyer dgu ba nor skyong / so bzhi ba dga' bo nyer dga' btul ba/ so lnga ba legs sbyin/ so drug pa gdengs can/ so bdun pa gang bo/ bzhi bcu ba ser skya/ zhe gcig pa u tā ya na/ zhe gnyis pa mkhas pa/ zhe bzhi ba gser lag zhe lnga ba ma skyes dgra/zhe bdun pa sā la'i sdong bu/ zhe dgu ba glang po can/ lnga bcu ba las bcu spyad pa/ nga drug pa ba glang skyong btul ba/ nga bdun pa mchod rten/ nga dgu ba ku lā la/ drug cu ba klu gzhon/ re gcig pa zhing ba/ re gnyis pa grags sbyin/re gsum pa 'od srungs/ re bdun pa dge 'dun srungs/ re brgyad pa padma ldan/ re dgu ba chos rgyal rab gnas/ bdun cu ba nyi ma gung ba/ don gcig pa sha na'i gos can/ don gnyis pa nyer sbas/ don gsum pa klu la things pa/ don bzhi ba sa gzhi phul ba/ don lnga ba rten 'brel bcu gnyis/don drug pa bi du ra/ don bdun pa ke na ya ga don brgyad pa brgya byin lhung ba/ brgyad cu ba rab bzang / gya gcig pa rgyu'i mchog gya gnyis pa dmyal ba mngon ldan/ bya gsum pa sgra gcan zin/ gya bzhi ba sbrang rtsi dbyangs/ gya bdun pa pad can/ gya dgu ba chos sred/ dgu bcu ba nor can/ go gsum pa ma ga dha/ go bzhi ba grags pa'i bshes gnyen/ brgya dang lnga ba ri ba ti'i yal 'dab rnams mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa 'bras bu'i mdzes pa lasbyar ba yin no/ / de yang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis gdul bya'i nyon mongs brgyad khri bzhi stong la gnyen po chos kyi phung bo brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs pa'i don 'dul ba'i sde snod dang / mngon pa'i sde snod/ mdo sde'i

bod kyi snga dar rtsom rig 283ndhe snod bcas sde snod gsum du bsdus nas bstan pa yin no zhes gsungs gsum/ snyan ngag dpag bsam 'khri shing girtsom stangs khyad chos/snyanangag mkhan po dge ba'i dbang bo dang de'i sras su gyur pa zla ba'i dbang bo rnam pa gnyis kyis snyan ngag dpag bsam 'khri shing 'di nyid rgya gar lho phyogs pa'i snyan ngag gi lugs te/ 'jam pa'i yi ge mang zhing tsub pa'i yi ge yang nyung tsam bsres pa ste sbyar ba dang gcig brjod bya rjod byed gnyis ka 'jig rten na yongs su grags pa'i don can gtso bor sbyar bas go sla ba nyid de rab dwangs dang gnyis/ tshigs bcad gang la 'jam tsub kyi yi ge do mnyam zhing phyogs su ma lhung ba zhig gam yang na 'jam na 'jam par mnyam/tsub na tsub par mnyam/ bsres na bar mar mnyam pa can te mnyam nyid dang gsum/ rkang ba'am tshig la yi ge dang skye gnas dang brtsegs pa sogs ci rigs pa'i sgra mtshungs nye bar thos pa'i nyams dang ldan pa ste snyan pa dang bzhi/'jam pa'i yi ge shas che zhing ngag nas rang shugs kyis brjod bde ba ste shin gzhonadang lnga/ brjod bya gang yin pa de'i rjod byed kyi tshig thos ma thag tu sgra'am don la brten nas rtogs pa las slar brtag cing dpyad mi dgos pa ste gsal ba dang drug bsngags pa'i tshig spyor 'ga' zhig brjod pas gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa'i yon tan yod par shugs kyis go nus pa can te rgya che ba dang bdun/ yi ge'i 'jam tsub do mnyam zhing byed 'brel sogs bsdus pa'i tshig sdud mang ba can te ba da pa dang brgyad/ skye bo tshang ma'i rna bar 'gro zhing de tsam 'ud mi che bar ran par smras pa ste mdzes pa dang dgu/dngosapo gzhan gyi chos gang yang rung ba zhig chos can gzhan btags pa ba zhig la gdog ma 'gyur bar 'god pa ste ting nge 'dzin dang bcu bcas kyi srol ltar bcoms pa yin pas/ bod du 'gyur ba'i snyan ngag 'di nyid kyi rjod byed

284 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/tshig la'ang rgya gar lho phyogs bee dasgo'i snyan ngag gi rtsom stangs khyad chos ma nyams par thon yod pa dang / snyan ngag gi rgyan gyis brgyan pa 'os shing 'tsham pa/ sdeb sbyor legs shing tshig gi gcod mtshams gsal bas rna bar 'jibs shing dbang 'phrog la go sla ba'i khyad chos ldan phyir/ rang cag gi sngon byon mkhas pa dag gis kyang / rtogs brjod rin po che dpag bsam 'khri shing 'di nyid brjod bya don dang 'brel bas rtogs sla/ rjod byed rgyan dang 'brel bas rna bar snyan/ tshig rkang sdeb sbyor dang 'brel bas gcod mtshams phyed/ming mngon brjod dang 'brel bas ngo mtshar ba ste khyad chos bzhi dang ldan pa yin pas phun sum tshogs so zhes gsungs so/ / gsham du snyan ngag dpag byi(spra ṅgi trī hā trī /sa ༵ ba/dris pa shārnyi /sa sam sgyu col gyi rang bzhin rnam pa (1) spungs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi sku gsung thugs gsum gyi yon tan dang / rmad byung mdzad 'phrin la bsngags brjod kyi me tog gtor ba ni/dper na/ yal 'dab bdun pa mu tig 'khri shing gi rtogs pa brjod pa las/skyes dang 'chi ba'i nyon mongs kyis btab gdung ba drag po rab rgyas dag / mi bzad yul ni g.yo ba'i sbrul gyi 'phreng bas dkris shing dkrugs gyur pa/ / rab rib rab rgyas rab rmongs phug gi khang ba 'di las phyir thon kṣiṃ/da// /sangs rgyas chos la skyabs su song zhig der ni srid la 'jigs pa ces dang / yal 'dab bcu bzhi ba cho 'phrul gyi rtogs pa brjod pa las/der ni bcom ldan zhal gyi padma mchu yi 'dab dmar zhing / /'od zer dkar spras kun dkris/soyi nasnarardzoXpa pa las/ / bsod nams kyis /shāddhi // tram̐ pa~X ṭwāṃ )snye / hākā ṭwāṃ /dro tre / / rang nyams dang mthun dam

284 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/tshig la'ang rgya gar lho phyogs bee dasgo'i snyan ngag gi rtsom stangs khyad chos ma nyams par thon yod pa dang / snyan ngag gi rgyan gyis brgyan pa 'os shing 'tsham pa/ sdeb sbyor legs shing tshig gi gcod mtshams gsal bas rna bar 'jibs shing dbang 'phrog la go sla ba'i khyad chos ldan phyir/ rang cag gi sngon byon mkhas pa dag gis kyang / rtogs brjod rin po che dpag bsam 'khri shing 'di nyid brjod bya don dang 'brel bas rtogs sla/ rjod byed rgyan dang 'brel bas rna bar snyan/ tshig rkang sdeb sbyor dang 'brel bas gcod mtshams phyed/ming mngon brjod dang 'brel bas ngo mtshar ba ste khyad chos bzhi dang ldan pa yin pas phun sum tshogs so zhes gsungs so/ / gsham du snyan ngag dpag byi(spra ṅgi trī hā trī /sa ༵ ba/dris pa shārnyi /sa sam sgyu col gyi rang bzhin rnam pa (1) spungs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi sku gsung thugs gsum gyi yon tan dang / rmad byung mdzad 'phrin la bsngags brjod kyi me tog gtor ba ni/dper na/ yal 'dab bdun pa mu tig 'khri shing gi rtogs pa brjod pa las/skyes dang 'chi ba'i nyon mongs kyis btab gdung ba drag po rab rgyas dag / mi bzad yul ni g.yo ba'i sbrul gyi 'phreng bas dkris shing dkrugs gyur pa/ / rab rib rab rgyas rab rmongs phug gi khang ba 'di las phyir thon kṣiṃ/da// /sangs rgyas chos la skyabs su song zhig der ni srid la 'jigs pa ces dang / yal 'dab bcu bzhi ba cho 'phrul gyi rtogs pa brjod pa las/der ni bcom ldan zhal gyi padma mchu yi 'dab dmar zhing / /'od zer dkar spras kun dkris/soyi nasnarardzoXpa pa las/ / bsod nams kyis /shāddhi // tram̐ pa~X ṭwāṃ )snye / hākā ṭwāṃ /dro tre / / rang nyams dang mthun dam

bod kyi snga dar rtsom rig yo5brjod ṭī dī kāng / yal 'dab bzhi bcu rtsa gsum pa gser mdog gi rtogs pa bsam gtan la chags g.yo med spyan ldan mdzes sdug rdzogs pa'i rgya mtsho ste/ / shangs kyi rgyud ni yangs shing drang bo zam stegs dag tu gyur pa yin/ / rab brkyang mdzes ldan gyis rgyan stong ba'i snyan gyi zhags pa mngon dga' ste/ / mdzes pa nyid kyis mkhas rnams nang du zhi ba ci yang rgyas par byed/ / zla zer ltar mdzes de ni lag gnyis glang chen lag pa'i rnam pa dang / / snang ba rab rgyas dbu la lhan skyes rab bkrus rang bzhin nor bu dang / / lag mthil du son ri mo dung dang rgyal mtshan chu skyes 'phreng ba dang / / zhi ba'i rang bzhin rgyal srid chen po la 'os mtshan nyid rnam par 'dzin/ /thub chen rnams kyis mngon par 'dod pa skyed byed de yis ni/ /rang bzhin mngon par 'dod pa'i rtag pa kun dang bral ba nyid/ / dran pa'i sa gzhi bag med gnas ni lhag ma med par byas/ / chags pa rab tu btang ba'i mchu ni rab tu dmar dang bcas/ / grol ba lhag par 'grogs pa'i mdza' gcugs dang ldan byams pa dag ni yid la nyal/ /bzod pa de yi rang bzhin byed cing brtse ba snying la dam du mnyam par sbyor/ /yid 'ongs mang bo la chags kun gyi bsam pa rgyas byed sngon med thub pa ni/ / de yi zhi ba sngon med bsna/ /tā /spras bral snying bo can ni legs par mtshon/ /(2 )spyir 〉jig rten gyi khams su srid pa'i bde 'byor thams cad rtswa 'go'i zil ba bzhin mi rtag la/ 'gro ba mi yi lang tsho dang tshe srog kyang nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon bzhin skad cig skad cig tsam gyi yun la 'jig pa dang rgyad par 'gyur zhing / 'gro ba mi yi bde sdug dang dbul phyug sogs kyang skye ba sngon ma sngon mar byas pa'i dge sdig legs nyes kyi byed las kho na la rag las

bod kyi snga dar rtsom rig yo5brjod ṭī dī kāng / yal 'dab bzhi bcu rtsa gsum pa gser mdog gi rtogs pa bsam gtan la chags g.yo med spyan ldan mdzes sdug rdzogs pa'i rgya mtsho ste/ / shangs kyi rgyud ni yangs shing drang bo zam stegs dag tu gyur pa yin/ / rab brkyang mdzes ldan gyis rgyan stong ba'i snyan gyi zhags pa mngon dga' ste/ / mdzes pa nyid kyis mkhas rnams nang du zhi ba ci yang rgyas par byed/ / zla zer ltar mdzes de ni lag gnyis glang chen lag pa'i rnam pa dang / / snang ba rab rgyas dbu la lhan skyes rab bkrus rang bzhin nor bu dang / / lag mthil du son ri mo dung dang rgyal mtshan chu skyes 'phreng ba dang / / zhi ba'i rang bzhin rgyal srid chen po la 'os mtshan nyid rnam par 'dzin/ /thub chen rnams kyis mngon par 'dod pa skyed byed de yis ni/ /rang bzhin mngon par 'dod pa'i rtag pa kun dang bral ba nyid/ / dran pa'i sa gzhi bag med gnas ni lhag ma med par byas/ / chags pa rab tu btang ba'i mchu ni rab tu dmar dang bcas/ / grol ba lhag par 'grogs pa'i mdza' gcugs dang ldan byams pa dag ni yid la nyal/ /bzod pa de yi rang bzhin byed cing brtse ba snying la dam du mnyam par sbyor/ /yid 'ongs mang bo la chags kun gyi bsam pa rgyas byed sngon med thub pa ni/ / de yi zhi ba sngon med bsna/ /tā /spras bral snying bo can ni legs par mtshon/ /(2 )spyir 〉jig rten gyi khams su srid pa'i bde 'byor thams cad rtswa 'go'i zil ba bzhin mi rtag la/ 'gro ba mi yi lang tsho dang tshe srog kyang nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon bzhin skad cig skad cig tsam gyi yun la 'jig pa dang rgyad par 'gyur zhing / 'gro ba mi yi bde sdug dang dbul phyug sogs kyang skye ba sngon ma sngon mar byas pa'i dge sdig legs nyes kyi byed las kho na la rag las

286 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mcho/pa yin phyir/ ci nas kyang rang rgyud na dug sbrul bzhin 'khyil ba'i nyon mongs dug lnga yis rnam par bskul ba'i nyes ltung dang mi dge ba'i byed las dang bsam sbyor thams cad kun nas spangs te/ las rgyu 'bras la brtsi 'jog dang dkon mchog gsum la rtse gcig gis skyabs su re nas/ gtan du bde ba'i rshage bsta'ilapa la brtson dgos pa dang da/ pa'i chos la gzhol dgos pa'i byersha /rte /dro waṭwā /zlo pag /rjod kā ṭwāṃ/sa/dasar na/ yal 'dab bdun pa mu skyesabu rnams kyi dpral ba yangs pa'i rdo yi glegs bu la/ / bde med lasakyi sprul ba gsal ba'i rtags can gzong dag gis/ / skye dang 'chi bar /shā /shā ṭī bye // ṭwāṃ /kod gyur pa/ /'di dag rnams ni lag pas yongs su zhes dang / yal 'dab dgu ba mes skyes kyi rtogs pa brjod pa las/rtsod dang 'thab mo rmongs dang chags pa chen po rjes su 'brang ba'i ltas ngan nor gyis ci/ / rgud pa brgyar lhung yang dag chags pas nad skyed 'bral bar 'gyur ba'i longs spyod dag gis ci/ / yin nyams g.yog la mi bdag khengs pa thob pa'i mngon pa'i nga rgyal dag gis ci/ /'dir ni chags bral kho na 'jig dus 'jigs par nad med longs spyod dag tu 'os pa yin/ /brjod gā dī nāng / yal 'dab bcu gnyis pa 'phags skyes po'i rtogs pa longasaspyod rba rlabs dag dang mtshungs shing ri dgas 'jigs pa'i mig ltar g.yo/ / dpal 'byor skad cig mtshon bya skye ba'i chu gter rnam par gsal ba'i glog /lus kyi padmar lang tsho gsar ba'i nyi 'od gzhon nu dmar ༵ /byi/ / srog gi thigs pa sred pa'i mya ngam thang la myur du 'jig par

bod kyi snga dar rtsom rig 287zhes dang / brgya rtsa bzhi ba ri bong gi rtogs pa brjod pa las/bud med lcags sgrog mu cor bzod dka' bu yi zhags pa dang / /gāyoga'akror gyisan/gas/rtanaX'iganyenasbyod ba dang/ / mi zlosdin ༷kā kā snakā na rsha kā dī dri/ /kā /rdorshas mun —na can/ /btang ba rnam shā kārshatā /'bral ba'i mya ngan stug pos yang yang rmongs pa skyed par byed/ / nor ni lan tshwa'i zas rnams dag gis sred pa mchog tu yongs su spel/ /mi bzad yul la chags pa goms pas sems ni blun par byas gyur spragyu/ ra//nyon mongs zhing gi khyim na gnas pa rnams kyi dge ba zad par /lha kārdo /pa'i nags su zhi ba'i khyad par dag gis tshim pa rnams/ /yul gyi longs spyod la chags chang gis blo gros myos shing g.yo mi 'gyur/ /mdza' bo dang bral du ba rgyas pas mig ni mchi mas 'khrugs mi 'gyur/ //// dang 'thab mo khro dang gdung ba'i tshogs rnams dag gis sreg mi zhes dang / yal 'dab bcu bzhi ba cho 'phrul gyi rtogs pa brjod pa las/dpal 'byor g.yo zhing lang tsho nyid kyang rga bar rjes su 'gro/ / lus kyarji gno/ pas //sa rnams dag gi sdunas nyid gyur pa byin/ //ga ni ngan zlosde sdu kā ṭwāṃ // rdo // sa/dzo /gron rnan pas/ / chos 4 rang ba na rtag tu /sdu ༵ kṣiṃ baṃ sbyan/ mi/ yi 'tsho ba'i brgyud rim dang / 'tsho zhing rol ba'i

bod kyi snga dar rtsom rig 287zhes dang / brgya rtsa bzhi ba ri bong gi rtogs pa brjod pa las/bud med lcags sgrog mu cor bzod dka' bu yi zhags pa dang / /gāyoga'akror gyisan/gas/rtanaX'iganyenasbyod ba dang/ / mi zlosdin ༷kā kā snakā na rsha kā dī dri/ /kā /rdorshas mun —na can/ /btang ba rnam shā kārshatā /'bral ba'i mya ngan stug pos yang yang rmongs pa skyed par byed/ / nor ni lan tshwa'i zas rnams dag gis sred pa mchog tu yongs su spel/ /mi bzad yul la chags pa goms pas sems ni blun par byas gyur spragyu/ ra//nyon mongs zhing gi khyim na gnas pa rnams kyi dge ba zad par /lha kārdo /pa'i nags su zhi ba'i khyad par dag gis tshim pa rnams/ /yul gyi longs spyod la chags chang gis blo gros myos shing g.yo mi 'gyur/ /mdza' bo dang bral du ba rgyas pas mig ni mchi mas 'khrugs mi 'gyur/ //// dang 'thab mo khro dang gdung ba'i tshogs rnams dag gis sreg mi zhes dang / yal 'dab bcu bzhi ba cho 'phrul gyi rtogs pa brjod pa las/dpal 'byor g.yo zhing lang tsho nyid kyang rga bar rjes su 'gro/ / lus kyarji gno/ pas //sa rnams dag gi sdunas nyid gyur pa byin/ //ga ni ngan zlosde sdu kā ṭwāṃ // rdo // sa/dzo /gron rnan pas/ / chos 4 rang ba na rtag tu /sdu ༵ kṣiṃ baṃ sbyan/ mi/ yi 'tsho ba'i brgyud rim dang / 'tsho zhing rol ba'i

/ 288 bodakyirtsoparigalorgyusarig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/'gro ba mi'i rigs kyi dge sdug dang legs nyes kyi byed las sam spyod tshul rnams gcig bsdus kyi rang bzhin dang / kun khyab kyi rang bzhin/ chos nyid kyi rang bzhin dang / gtan tshigs kyi rang bzhin ldan pa'i legs bshad du bcoms nas/ 'gro ba mi rnams cis kyang 'jig rten mi chos dang dam pa'i lha chos la gzhol dgos pa'i go ba bskon zhing slob gso gnang ba ni/ dper na/yal 'dab bzhi bcu rtsa gcig pa u tā ya na'i rtogs pa brjod pa las/gang na nyi mas mun pa spro byed gang na zla ba me char 'bebs/ / gang na bdud rtsi las ni rab drag nag po brtsegs pa rab gsal skye/ / gang na skyob byed mi yi bdag pos skye rgu rnams kyi srog 'tsho 'phrog / nyer 'tshe che ba rab rgyas de na cho nge dag ni su zhig nyan/ /zhi ba zhi bar mi 'gyur bzod pa nyid ni nye bar zad mi 'gyur/ / khro ba tsub mo'i skyon rnams dag gis blo gros la yang reg mi 'gyur/ / ngan sems zug rngu dang mtshungs yid la mi gnas dam pa /sna/ hā/ la/ / 'jig rten na ni skye bo ngan pa rnam par spangs las bde pa brjo/ kā /dī / yal 'dab bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad pa don kun grub pa'i rtogs rin chen 'byung gnas rab rgyas pha rol med pa de srid chu yis dkrigs gyur cing / / byed po'i bde blag stobs las rba rlabs 'phreng bas mkha' la dgod pa nyid du thos/ dam pa rnams kyi mthu ni chen po'i bdag nyid gzhal swāhā / zlozlo /dro / shā// ya mtshan gnas gang bsam pa'i cho ga dag la blo ni rtogs ṭwāṃ kā )sdo /pa sdu// 'dab lnga bcu rtsa gsum pa legs bshad 'tshol ba'i mkhas pa nyid ni med na blo gros rnam nyams mi rnams 'tsho ba don yod

/ 288 bodakyirtsoparigalorgyusarig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/'gro ba mi'i rigs kyi dge sdug dang legs nyes kyi byed las sam spyod tshul rnams gcig bsdus kyi rang bzhin dang / kun khyab kyi rang bzhin/ chos nyid kyi rang bzhin dang / gtan tshigs kyi rang bzhin ldan pa'i legs bshad du bcoms nas/ 'gro ba mi rnams cis kyang 'jig rten mi chos dang dam pa'i lha chos la gzhol dgos pa'i go ba bskon zhing slob gso gnang ba ni/ dper na/yal 'dab bzhi bcu rtsa gcig pa u tā ya na'i rtogs pa brjod pa las/gang na nyi mas mun pa spro byed gang na zla ba me char 'bebs/ / gang na bdud rtsi las ni rab drag nag po brtsegs pa rab gsal skye/ / gang na skyob byed mi yi bdag pos skye rgu rnams kyi srog 'tsho 'phrog / nyer 'tshe che ba rab rgyas de na cho nge dag ni su zhig nyan/ /zhi ba zhi bar mi 'gyur bzod pa nyid ni nye bar zad mi 'gyur/ / khro ba tsub mo'i skyon rnams dag gis blo gros la yang reg mi 'gyur/ / ngan sems zug rngu dang mtshungs yid la mi gnas dam pa /sna/ hā/ la/ / 'jig rten na ni skye bo ngan pa rnam par spangs las bde pa brjo/ kā /dī / yal 'dab bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad pa don kun grub pa'i rtogs rin chen 'byung gnas rab rgyas pha rol med pa de srid chu yis dkrigs gyur cing / / byed po'i bde blag stobs las rba rlabs 'phreng bas mkha' la dgod pa nyid du thos/ dam pa rnams kyi mthu ni chen po'i bdag nyid gzhal swāhā / zlozlo /dro / shā// ya mtshan gnas gang bsam pa'i cho ga dag la blo ni rtogs ṭwāṃ kā )sdo /pa sdu// 'dab lnga bcu rtsa gsum pa legs bshad 'tshol ba'i mkhas pa nyid ni med na blo gros rnam nyams mi rnams 'tsho ba don yod

bod kyi snga dar rtsom rig 289min/ / mtshungs med rgyas pa'i snyan ngag med na mkhas pa nyid ni ni tso'i klog pa dang mtshungs/ /snying ldan rnams kyis nang gi de nyid dpyod pa med na rab /rdo/ shā/ dro/ // / stong ba nyid de dben sa'i khron pa'i mar me bzhin du brjod spya kā kāng / yal 'dab lnga bcu rtsa lnga ba thams cad ster ba'i rtogs pa gdug pa'i las ni sog le bzhin/ / drang bo gcod la mkhas gyur cing / / rang bzhin gyis ni 'khyog pa yi/ / gdug pa'i bdag nyid ci mi byed/ / gang gi mtshon gyis mi nus de dag kyal ku'i tshig gis 'joms par byed/ / gang zhig brjod par mi nus ci yang de dag 'phral la sgrub par byed/ /gang zhig bya bar mi nus de dag kyang ni yid kyis sems par byed/ /ma bsdams glang bo dag gi spyod pas ngo mtshar thams cad rgyas par byed/ /pa lasace/ sa dang / yal 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi ba nor bzang gi rtogs pa brjod mngon par zhen pa shin tu brtan ldan gzhan gyi gnod pas chu bzhin 'khrug / yon tan brgya phrag gis kyang mi mgu shin tu 'gal ba'i blo can rnams/ / rgya che mtshar la smra bcad 'dzin cing dam pa bstod la dgon par /shā/ / grags pa mchog la bzhin dag log cing 'gal ba brjod pa nyid du ces dang / yal 'dab bcu bzhi ba cho 'phrul gyi rtogs pa brjod pa las/sdigapa'i tha ba thong la bsod nams dag gis sa bon thob/ / khon ni yongs su dor la zhi ba'i bde ba bston par byos/ / 'chi ba'i dug ni nyams :nā ṭwāṃ / ṭwāṃ zlo /sdo ṭwāṃ dhi/rngo ṭwāṃ shig dang / / dge ba'i grogs por gyur pa'i

lhag bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho//sdu di ṭwāṃ sdo ṭwāṃ/gas/ gzhon nu rnams kyi lang tsho'i byad gzugs dang /lang tsho'i 'khril bag lang tsho'i 'jo sgeg dang lang tsho'i mdzes sdug dang /gzhon nu ma rnams kyis pho skyes la rnam par bcangs pa'i mdza' gcugs dang chags zhin/ brtse dung dang 'phreng sems zhib 'bri mdzad pa ni/ dper na/yal 'dab bcu gcig pa mdzes dga' bo'i rtogs pa brjod pa las/gang de'i rab tu 'dar zhing g.yo ba'i tshig gis 'gro bar mi bya zhes smras shing / / bla ma'i skye bo gnas tshe gang zhig rlung yab dor te thu ba nas kyang bzung / / gang zhig rkang bas sa la 'dri zhing mthong ba min yang bdag la zur mig mtshon/ / dgag pa mchog tu mdzes pa'i rim pa de yis bdag gi de yis bsdams/ / yid 'phrog ri dwags mig ni bung ba g.yo ba'i khyab pa'i utpal 'khyil ba bzhin/ / 'jo sgeg chu gter 'gram du byu ru'i nags ltar mchu ni tham pa'i 'od rab gsal/ / gang yang kha yi 'od de skyon med bdud rtsi'i zer nghru spya/ pahārsha nākā gā sdu// / mdzes ma lus ni ngo mtshar snying bo ri mo'i lam jo zhes dang / yal 'dab nyer lnga ba mngon par 'byung ba'i rtogs pa ba da zlo pazlo 'o/ da kyis rgyags pa'i rang bzhin mtshan mo lang tsho rgyas pa 'di la ni/ / 'di dag mig rnams gnyid kyi rgya yis nges byas gos rnams mal stan dag la lhung / /mi lam gyis bskyed rigs pa min pa'i tshig smra skra yis phrag pa sta nā ñtsha /byi)pa/ bzhi//sa/ pa'i dbugs kyi rlung gis bskyod pa'i mar me dag ni brjod nā dī nāng / yal 'dab brgya rtsa brgyad pa sprin gyi bzhon pa'i rtogs pa

bod kyi snga dar rtsom rig 291ri yid srubs bka' yi yul du gyur pa des/ / kun rtog bar gyis mdun 〉ga /sdu// /la gyi/sdu rsha sdung mngon bris mig ni g.yo med gyur/ /de nas me /shā / kā/ bur 'dar zhing g.yo ldan sgra dag sgrogs par byed pa'i 'og pag las/ /'jigs pas rab tu zhi bar byed bzhin yang yang gos dag byin nas lhags par byas/ /ngo chos mi smra dang ldan bzhin dud de yi rna ba'i utpal /dri ༵ sdum/ bya/zlo/khor zhing rgyu ba'i bung ba rnams kyi sgra yis bdag la legs par ze //sashā// sa phra numa'ingosal rin che//phreng ba'i khur gyisdu ci zhig tre//sa kya/tre py-i / ba/ zhipar raswārgya ṭwāṃ pa'i ma/snal tsho' rte/ /rshadī kā/ rnyi dīkā shā/ nas dga' par bsgrurdos ༷/ mtshon/ / gla rtsi dag gi dog pa rnams ni dri ma chags sna/ /tā rdzu zlo la tshos/ /
bong nasadabe

bod kyi phyi dar rtsom rig 295don tshan dang po/ spyi chogs dang rtsom rig gi lorgyus mdor bstan pa/deyang bod kyi phyi dar rtsom rig ni kun gzigs rgyal dbang lnga ba ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho mchog (1617da 1682)nas mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel (183—1951)gyi bar byung zhing 'phel ba'i rtsom rig sgyu rtsal la ngos bzung ba yin zhing / lo ngo nyis brgya lhag 'das pa'i lo rgyus kyi dus skabs 'di'i ring la/ sngar cung zad bshad zin pa ltar khyi lo 112lor gu thi bstan 'dzin chos rgyal gyis dbus gtsang la drag po'i dmag dpung drangs nas gtsang ba sde srid rkarma bstan skyong dbang bo'i srid dbang yongs su brlags te/ dbus gtsang mdo smad dang bcas pa'i bdag dbang rgyal dbang lnga bar phul ba dang dga' ldan pho brang zhes pa'i chos srid zung 'brel gyi sa gnas srid dbang brtan por btsugs nas dge lugs pa'i grub mtha' khyon yongs nas yar rgyas gong 'phel du song ngo / / rgyal dbang lnga ba sku gshegs rjes/ bod sog mchod yon bar gyi 'gal ba dang 'thab rtsod mngon gsal dang dza drag tu gyur/ spyi lo 1705lor lha bzang han gyis g.yo sgyu'i sbyor ba la brten nas sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho mchog bkrongs/ de nas lha bzang han gyis lo ngo bcu gnyis kyi ring la dbus gtsang la dbang bsgyur/ spyi lo 1717lor sog po jun gar ba tshe dbang rab brtan gyis lha sar dmag drangs nas lha bzang han dang 'thab pas lha bzang han kun nas pham ste rang srog shor/ jun gar ba tshe dbang rab brtan gyis lo ngo gsum tsam la bod kyi

296 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/dbang cha btsan bzung byas mthar/ mnga' ris spyi khyab khang chen po bsod nams rgyal po dang gtsang gi dmag dpon pho lha ba bsod nams stobs rgyas kyis bod kyi mang tshogs dang mnyam 'brel gyis jun gar bar rgol lan sprad pa dang gong ma khung shis kyang dmag dpung mngags te ram 'degs mdzad par brten/ sbyi lo 1720lor jun gar ba bod nas mthar bskrad do/ /de nas bzung khang chen pa bsod nams rgyal po dang pho lha ba bsod nams stobs rgyas/ nga phod pa rdo rje rgyal po/ lum pa ba bkra shis rgyal po/sbyar ra ba blo gros rgyal po bcas kyis srid dbang bzung ste lo ngo bdun 'das/spyi lo 1728lor pho lha ba dang gong ma'i dmag gis gyen log pa nga lum sbyar gsumakhrims la sbyar/ de nas bzung pho lha ba bsod nams stobs rgyas kyis bod sa gnas srid dbang rnam par bskyangs/ sbyi lo 1747lor pho lha ba'i sras chung ba 'gyur med rnam rgyal yab kyi go sar bzhag nas lo ngo bzhi'i ring la srid bskyangs/ sbyi lo 1751lo nas bzung ste bod kyi chos srid kyi dbang cha rgyal dbang tā la'i bla ma dang am ban gnyis thun mong nas 'dzin dgos pa'i srol rnam par btod do/ / spyi lo 1757lo'i zla gnyis pa'i tshes gsum nyin rgyal dbang bskal bzang rgya mtsho dgongs pa rdzogs/ bod spyi tshogs kyis am ban brgyud nas gong mar gser snyan sgron/ zla tshes5nyin gong mas bka' phab pa ltar/ de mo hu thog thu ngag dbang 'jam dpal bde legs rgya mtsho sde brtan glingade mo rgyal thog dang po zla 5tshes 1nyin srid skyong ba'i khri la mnga' gsol/des srid khri lo nyer gcig bskyangs/ spyi lo 1777lor de mo hu thog thu 'jam dbyangs bde legs rgya mtsho lha ldan bstan rgyas gling du dgongs pa rdzogs/dga' khri zur yer ti ni no pon tan tshe smon gling rgyal thog dang po ngag dbang tshul khrims srid khrir mnga' gsol/ des snga phyir srid lo nyi shur bskyangs/ spyi lo 1788dang spyi lo 1791lor/ bal bo gor kha'i dmag gis snga rjes su bod la

bon kyi phyi dar rtsom rig 297btsan 'dzul byas nas skyid grong dang rdzong dga' sogs kyi sa gnas khag gcig bdag 'dzin byas/ bod rigs mi dmangs kyis rdog rtsa gcig sgril dang dpa' ngar cher bskyed kyis ching gong ma'i dmag dpung dang mnyam 'brelabyas nas de dag pham par mdzad/ sbyi lo 1791lor tshe smon gling rgyal thog dang po ngag dbang tshul khrims rtse pho brang du dgongs pa rdzogs/ rta tshag rgyal thog dang po ye shes blo bzang bstan pa'i mgon pos tā la'i 'jam dpal rgya mtsho'i phyag rogs gnang ste srid lo bcu bzhir bskyangs/ 1804lor tā la'isku phreng brgyad pa 'jam dpal rgya mtsho dgongs pa rdzogs/ rta tshag rgyal thogadang po ye shes blo bzang bstan pa'i mgon po slar yang lugs gnyis kyi bdag por gyur/ des srid lo drug bskyangs/ 1808lor tā la'i sku phreng dgu ba lung rtogs rgya mtsho mi 'jigs gdong lnga'i khrir mnga' gsol/ 1810lor rta chog dang po ye shes blo bzang bstan pa'i mgon po sku gshegs/ 1811lor yongs 'dzin de mo blo bzang bstan 'dzin 'jigs med rgya mtsho srid skyong bar bskos te/ des khri lo dgu bskyangs/ 1819lor blo bzang bstan 'dzin 'jigs med rgya mtsho sku gshegs/ tshe smon gling rgyal thog gnyis pa ngag dbang 'jam dbyangs tshul khrims rgya mtsho srid skyong ba'i khrir mnga' gsol/ khong gis dbus gtsang khul gyi zhing las thon skyed la byas rjes chen po bzhag na'ang /dbang bsgyur gral rim gyi nang khul ma mthun par khong nyid kyi sger gzhis gzing du blarjis rjes meshā rgyal nang khusdo ṭwāṃ gnas /byung btang/ 143sbyar ༵༵༵ /zlol dag /zlo khri long/cu da/zlog dī /sdu hā/la khams rgyal mtshan sad byu ra 1855lor gong ma'i bka' ltar tā la'i sku phreng bcu ba mkhas grub rgya mtsho mchog gis lugs gnyis kyi 'gan bzhes/ 'on kyang zla12tshes 24nyin glo bur du dgongs pa rdzogs/ dgung lo bco brgyad yin/ de nas rwa sgrong

298 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyugarig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/ngag dbang ye shes tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyis slar yar lugs gnyis kyi 'gan bzhes/ 1863thar tā la'i sku phreng bcu gcig pa rje btsun ngag dbang blo bzang dpal bzang po 'phrin las rgya mtsho gser khrir mnga' gsol/ rwa sgrengangag dbang ye shes tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyis rgyal thog phyi mar srid lo brgyadabaskyangs/ de nas bod kyi dbang bsgyur gral rim gyi nang khul du srid dbang 'phrog rtsod byed pa'i 'thab rtsod tu dza drag tu gyur te/ rwa sgring rgyal tshab kyis srid dam khyer nas mes rgyal nang khul du bros byol du song / bshad sgra dbang phyug rgyal po srid kyi khrir bskos/ gong mas cho lo bstsal/ srid lo bcu tsam bskyangs/ 1872lor dga' ldan khri zur sku gshegs/ 1873lor tā la'i sku phreng bcu gnyis pa 'phrin las rgya mtsho dgung lo bco brgyad la phebs te lugs gnyis kyi 'gan yongs su bzhes/ 1875lor tā la'i sku phreng bcu gnyis pa sku gshegs/ rta tshag rje drung ho thog thu ngag dbang dpal ldan chos kyi rgyal mtshan te kun gling rgyal thog gnyis pa khri la bskos/ 1879lor tā la'i sku phreng bcu gsum pa thub bstan rgya mtsho gser khrir mnga' gsol/ srid skyong rta tshag tā la'i sku phreng gsum pa'i yongs 'dzin du bskos/ 1886lor srid skyong rta tshag gis khri lo bcu gnyis bskyangs te dgongs pa rdzogs/ de mo ho thog thu ngag dbang blo bzang 'phrin las rab rgyas te bstan gling de mo'i rgyal thog gsum pa srid skyong ba'i khrir mnga' gsol/ 1895lor tā la'i srid zhi'i phobang du rgyal dbang thub bstan rgya mtshos rgyal srid dang chos srid kyi 'gan dbang bzhes pa'i mdzad sgo tshugs/ 1lko4lor dbyin ji'i dmag dpung gis rgyal rtser btsan 'dzul byas/ tā la'i thub bstan rgya mtsho sog yul du bros byol la phebs/ dga' ldan khri ba blo bzang rgyal mtshan rgyal tshab tu bskos/1910lor khron gyi skam dmag mdo smad gzhung lam 'ba' dang / li thang /tsha ba rong / mdzar sogs brgyud nas bod du bskyod de/ bod dmag brgya

bod kyi phyi dar rtsom rig 28phrag lhag bsad/ tā la'i thub bstan rgya mtsho dang sde srid bka' blon bcas rgya gar du bros byol la phebs/ khri ba blo bzang rgyal mtshan gyis slar yang srid 'dzin mdzad/ 1933lor tā la'i thub bstan rgya mtsho sku gshegs/195lor go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung la gser snyan bsgran pa bzhin rwa sgring 'jam dpal ye shes srid blon dang glang mdun kun dga' dbang phyug srid blon las rogs su bskos/ 1935lo'i zla(tshes5nyin tā la'i bla ma bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho sku 'khrungs/ 1939lor rgyal tshab rwa sgreng thub bstan 'jam dpal ye shes dang / mtshan zhabs stag brag ngag dbang gsung rab gnyis nas tā la'i bla ma'i yongs 'dzin che chung gi 'gan bzhes te/ tā la'i bla ma'i mtshan la 'jam dpal ngag dbang blo bzang ye shes bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho srid gsum dbang 'dus mtshungs pa med pa'i sde zhes gsol/ 1940lor rtse pho brang du tā la'i bla ma bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho mi 'jigs gdong lnga'i khri la mnga' gsol/ 1950lor bod ljongs su bskyod pa'i mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gis chab mdor dpung 'jug byas/ zla10tshes8nyin tā la'i bla ma bstan 'dzin rgya mtshos lugs gnyis kyi 'gan yongs su bzhes/ 1956lor ma'o kru'u zhi dang / mu yon krang li'u hra'o chi/ tsung li kro'u en le bcas kyis bod rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang dngos su btsugs pa la rten 'brel zhu ba'i dar yig btang bar ma zad/ rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gis bod rangaskyong ljongs gra sgrig mu yon lhan khang gi mu yon rnams bsko bzhag mdzad/zla tshes 22nyin/ lha sa'i tshogs khang chen mo ru bod reng skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang dngos su dbu brnyes pa khyab bsgrags mdzad pa dang / krung dbyang sku tshab tshogs pa'i tshogs gtso dang rgyal srid sbyi khyab khang gi tsung li gzhonapa blo mthun khrin dbyis rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gi bka' yig yongs su bsgrags par ma zad/ rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gi sku tshab mdzad de srid dam

38 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/bstsal snang/ na/sa rags tsam brjod pa 'di ni bod kyi phyi dar rtsom rig gi lo rgyus rgyab ljongs yin zhing / brjod bya'i don snying phun sum tshogs shing rjod byed tshig gi sgyu rtsal khyad du 'phags pa'i phyi dar rtsom rig ni 'khrug rtsod kyi rba rlabs drag tu 'phyur ba'i spyi tshogs de las byung zhing 'phel ba yin phyir/ sgyu rtsal bcoms chos de rnams kyi brjod bya'i don gyi snying bos ni dus skabs de'i mi dmangs kyi 'thab 'dzing snying stobs dang / blo gros shes rab/ phugs bsam re 'dun bcas rnam par mtshon la/ dbang bsgyur gral rim bar gyi 'gal ba dang 'thab rtsod/ dmag 'khrug dang chags 'jig skabs de'i spyi tshogs kyi zing long dang nyams dmas sogs me long la gzugs brnyan 'char ba ji bzhin mngon par mtshon no/ /dper na/ rgyal dbang lnga ba ngag dbang blobazang rgya mtsho mchog (1617—1682)gis rje btsun 'jam dbyangs kyi bstod pa tam bu ra'i rgyud mangs dang / 'khrungs rabs kyi zhing bkod 'bri tshul kyi rtogs brjod kha byang dang bcas pa gsal ba'i me long / zhu yig bsod nams nyi ma stong 'bar/ deb ther dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs sogs mdzad/ gsung rtsom pod sum cu bzhugs/ bod mkhas pa mi pham dge legs rnam rgyal mchog gis (1618da 1678)dbyangs can ngag gi rol mtsho yid kyi ngang mo rnam rtsen tshangs pa'i mgrin rgyal rab dga'i rgyud mangs dang /zhu 'phrin ngag dbang dpyid kyi pho nya/ snyan ngag gi dper brjod sgra dbyangs rgya mtsho'i 'jug ngogs sogs mdzad/ lcang skya ngag dbang blo bzang chos ldan mchog gis (1642da 1714)lugs gnyis kyi bslab bya rab gsal dang /bslab bya gces pa bco brgyad pa sogs mdzad/ rje btsun 'jam dbyangs bzhan pa'i rdo rje mchog gis (1yonid 1722)rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi bdag po khyab bdag bla ma dkon mchog mtshan can gyi bstod pa dang /

bod kyi phyi dar rtsom rig 71zhal gdams mgur ma sogs brtsams/ rgyal ba tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho mchog gis (1693da 1746)tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho'i mgur glu bcoms/rgya nag pa 'jam dbyangs bstan pa'i nyi ma mchog gis (1686da 1738)rje 'jam dbyangs bstan pa'i nyi ma'i rnam thar dang / spyin gyi bzhon pa'i rtogs brjod sogs bcoms/ gsung rtsom pod gnyis bzhugs/ mdo mkhar ba tshe ring dbang rgyal mchog gis (1697da 1763)mi dbang rtogs brjod dang /gzhon nu zla med kyi gtam rgyud/ bka' blon rtogs brjod sogs brtsams/zhu chen tshul khrims rin chen mchog gis (1697da 1774)gsol 'debs snyan ngag chu gter bskyod pa'i rlabs phreng dang / slob dpon shī la ra ra bstod cing 'dod don gsol ba'i tshigs bcad dang / dpal sa skya ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan la phul ba'i zhu yig sogs mdzad/ gsung rtsom pod bcu gsum bzhugs/ kurma si tu paṇa chen chos kyi 'byung gnas mchog gis (1700da 1774)rig 'dzin dbang phyug rol ba'i rdo rje'i rnam thar bcoms/ gsung rtsom pod bcu bzhi bzhugs/sum pa ye shes dpal 'byor mchog gis (1704da 1788)mi'i chos lugs kyi bstan bcos me tog phreng mdzes dang / mtsho sngon gyi ljongs 'di gzhan gyi yul las khyad par du 'phags tshul bshad pa sogs mdzad/ gsung rtsom pod brgyad bzhugs/ rgyal ba bskal bzang rgya mtsho mchog gis (1708da 1757)spang gnyen sbyor tshul las brtsams pa'i gdams pa dang / rang gzhan dam pa'ichos la skul ba'i phyir mi rtag pa'i snang tshul mgur dbyangs su mdzad pa/lcang skya rol ba'i rdo rje'i zhu 'phrin gyi lan du bstsal ba sogs bcoms/ lcang skya rol ba'i rdo rje mchog gis (1717da 1786)ri bo rtse lnga'i gnas bstod 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i mchod sprin dang / bslab bya gzhan phan bdud rtsi'i snying bo/ bka' blon mdo mkhar bar gnang ba'i chab shog sogs brtsams/

302 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/gsung rtsom pod bdun bzhugs/ kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang bo mchog gis (1728—1791)rje tsong kha pa la bstod pa ngang ba'i bu mo'i 'phang 'gro'i sgra dbyangs dang / lha mo dbyangs can ma'i bstod pa dang / tsand+ra gi mi'i lo rgyus dang / zhu yig rdzogs ldan gsar ba'i dga' ston sogs bcoms/kun mkhyen 'jigs med gling ba mchog gis (1729da 1798)bstod pa snyan tshig dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i rgyang glu dang / dpal gyi bsam yas mchims phu la bstod pa dang / bya bral ba sos dal du mi 'jog par gzhon nu la yon tan bslab par bskul ba'i 'phrin yig sogs mdzad/ thu'u bkwan blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma mchog gis (1737da 1802)ye shes bstan pa'i sgron me la bstod pa dad pa'i padmo rgyas pa'i nyin byed dang / 'phags ma dbyangs can ma la bstod pa utpal phreng mdzes/ gzhon nu nor bzang gi rtogs brjod/ rgyal tig zhabs drung la things pa nyin dkar mthong ba'i mtshar glu sogs mdzad/gsung rtsom pod bco lnga bzhugs/ paṇa chen blo bzang dpal ldan ye shes mchog gis (1738da 1780)'phags pa'i gnas brtan bcu drug gi rnam par thar ba dang / gnas mchog bkra shis bsam gtan gling gi gnas bstod/rgyal ba 'jam dpal rgya mtsho la phul ba'i 'phrin yig sogs brtsams/ gsung rtsom pod dgu bzhugs/ gu ge yongs 'dzin blo bzang bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho mchog gis (1748da 1)yongs 'dzin yon tan rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar gsol 'debs dang / blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi rtogs brjod sogs brtsams/ a lag sha ngag dbang bstan dar mchog gis (1759da 1831)rtsom pa'i rnam gzhag bshad pa dang / bslab bya mi chos dga' ston sogs bcoms/ gung thang dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron me mchog gis (1762—1823)'jam mgon bla ma la bstod pa ka la piṅka'i glu dbyangs dang / kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang bo la bstod pa dge legs dpal

bod kyi phyi dar rtsom rig yo3mchog yid dga' chos 'dzin gyi zhing gi bsngags pa brjod pa dwangs pa'i me long / bslab bya nor bu'i gling du bgrod pa'i lam yig chu shing gi bstan bcos/ nyams myong gan po'i 'bel gtam yid 'byung dmar khrid sogs bcoms/ gsung rtsom pod bcu gnyis bzhugs/ rgyal mkhan po grags pa rgyal mtshan mchog gis (1762da 1836)dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron me dpal bzang bo'i rtogs brjod dang / ri bo rtse lnga'i gnas bstod don ldan tshangs pa'i sgra dbyangs sogs bcoms/ gsung rtsom pon drug bzhugs/bas pa ngag dbang mi pham zla ba mchog gis (1767da 1807)bkra shis dar rgyas gling gi bsngags brjod me tog g.yo ba'i 'khri shing dang / pha ma'i drin lan bsabs pa'i snying bo bsdus pa/ skyo glu dran pa'i snye ma sogs brtsams/gsung rtsom pod gsum bzhugs/ dngul chu dharma bha dra mchog gis (1772 1851)bslab bya rin po che'i do shal dang / ngag gdams le tshan dang / dge slong dge legs lags su phul ba chu 'dzin 'khyog po'i sgra dbyangs sogs bcoms/ gsung rtsom pod drug bzhugs/ khal kha ngag dbang blo bzang mkhas grub mchog gis (1779da 1838)rgan sgon pho mo'i lo rgyus dang sbyar ba'i bstan bcos dgra bo 'phrang sgug sogs brtsams/ sde khri 'jam dbyangs thub bstan nyi ma mchog gis (1719da 1862)rje btsun dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron me'i rnam thar dang / gil bar jo bo'i lo rgyus rin po che'i za ma togabakra shis dge 'phel gyi gnas bstod dang 'brel ba'i mgur ma/ byi la'i mgur sogs brtsams/ zhabs dkar tshogs drug rang grol mchog gis (1781da 1851)mgur glu bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang snyan ngag mang du brtsams/ gsung rtsom pod nyer lnga bzhugs/ paṇa chen bstan pa'i nyi ma mchog gis (1782da 1853)gsol 'debs dad pa'i rol mtsho spel ba'i zla 'od dang / slob dpon dpa' bo'i rnam thar mdor bsdus sogs brtsams/

mtha bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/gsung rtsom pod dgu bzhugs/ bka' 'gyur ba blo bzang tshul khrims mchog gis (1642da 1715)ri bo rtse lnga'i gnas bstod dang / bslab bya lhag bsam rnam dkar gyi chu skyes rab tu rgyas pa'i phreng ba sogs brtsams/ a khyung ngagadabang mkhyen rab mchog gis rje bla ma'i bstod pa nor bu dbang gi rgyal po'i do shal dang / thub dbang gi mdzad pa bcu gnyis las bcoms pa'i mgur ma/ rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa'i rnam thar mgur ma'i tshul sogs brtsams/ gsung rtsom pon gcig bzhugs/ a kyā yongs 'dzin blo bzang don grub mchog gis ri bo rtse lnga'i gnas bstod 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i mchod sprin dang / 'jam mgon rgyal ba gnyis pa tsong kha pa la gsol ba 'debs shing thugs rje bskul ba byin rlabs gru char g.yo ba'i sprin phung sogs brtsams/ bla brang a khu shes rab rgya mtsho mchog gis (1803da 1875)slob dpon mi tra dzo gi'i rtogs brjod dang / bslab bya gros 'debs kyi skor sogs bcoms/ gsung rtsom pod nyi shu bzhugs/ dpal sprul 'jigs med chos kyi dbang bo mchog gis (1808da 1887)kun bzang bla ma'i zhal lung dang /gtam padma'i tshal gyi zlos gar/ rgyal ba'i myu gu chos kyi rgyal mtshan la phul ba'i zhu yig sogs brtsams/ gsung rtsom pod bdun bzhugs/ dngul chu dbyangs can grub pa'i rdo rje mchog gis (1809—1887)dbyangs chung tshan pa gnyis dang / ngag dbang dpal ldan chos kyi rgyal mtshan la phul ba'i zhu yig sogs bcoms/ gsung rtsom pod gsum bzhugs/ kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho mchog gis (1813da 1890)slob dpon zla ba'i zhabs kyi rtogs brjod dbyangs kyi yan lag brgyad ldan sogs bcoms/ gsung rtsom pod dgu bcu tsam rtsom sgrig mdzad/ grub pa'i dbang phyug 'jigs med bsam gtan mchog gis (1814da 1897)byang phyogs sham bha la'i zhing gi bkod pa mdo tsam brjod pa dang / shel dgon bkra shis ljongs kyi gnas kyi rang bzhin

bod kyi phyi dar rtsom rig nya3mdo tsam brjod pa sogs bcoms/ dkyil zur blo bzang sbyin pa mchog gis (1821—9)bstod pa dad pa'i chu gter spel ba'i bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun dang /dpal snar bang chos sde la bstod pa skal bzang rna ba'i bdud rtsi/ lugs zung ba dan g.yo ba'i legs bshad rlung gi bstan bcos sogs brtsams/ gsung rtsom pod gsum bzhugs/ zhang ston bstan pa rgya mtsho mchog gis (1825da 1897)bslab bya nor bu'i phreng ba dang / rje btsun skal bzang thub bstan dbang phyug dpal bzang bo'i rnam thar dang / ngag dbang thub bstan rgya mtsho'i rnam thar sogs brtsams/ gsung rtsom pod bzhi bzhugs/ 'ju mi pham 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal rgya mtsho mchog gis (1846da 1912)sku bro sgyu ma'i rol mo dang / lugs kyi bstan bcos lha dang dpal 'du ba'i nor bu dang / rgyal po lugs kyi bstan bcos sa gzhi skyong ba'i rgyan sogs brtsams/gsung rtsom pod bcu phrag gsum bzhugs/ kirti blo bzang 'phrin las bstan pa rgya mtsho mchog gis (1849da 1905)mkhas grub chos kyi rgyal po la bstod pa mkhas pa'i mgrin rgyan dang / bslab bya smon tshig dang 'brel ba'i mgur dbyangs dang / klu rgyal byang chub sems dpa'i pho brang bdud rtsi'i sman chab khol ba'i gnas kyi bstod pa sogs brtsams/ gsung rtsom pon bcu gnyis bzhugs/ che shos blo bzang byang chub bstan pa'i sgron me mchog gis (1861da 1935)brag ri bsam gtan gling gi gnas bstod dang / things yig dpyid kyi rgyal po'i glu dbyangs sogs brtsams/ 'jam dbyangs thub bstan rgya mtsho mchog gis (1866da 1928)rtogs brjod ngo mtshar sprin gyi sgra dbyangs sogs brtsams/ gsung rtsom pod bcu bzhi bzhugs/ rgyal ba thub bstan rgya mtsho mchog gis (1876da 1933)rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi gnas bstod dwangs gsal mdzes pa'i me long sogs brtsams/ pha bong kha ba byams pa bstan 'dzin 'phrin las mchog gis (1878da 1941)bka'

306 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/'gyur dkar chag gi bar skabs tshigs bcad dang / dga' ldan khri byang mchog sprul rin po cher phul ba sogs bcoms/ gis steng blo bzang dpal ldan mchog gis (1881da 1944)zhu 'phrin pho nya gzhon nu don grub dang /rtogs brjod gser gyi me tog sogs btsams/ gsung rtsom pod gnyis bzhugs/ rdo sbis dge bshes shes rab rgya mtsho mchog gis (1884da 1968)rje bla ma'i bstod pa dad pa'i dri bsung 'thul ba'i spos kyi rdzing bu/ 'jam mgon bla ma dgyes pa'i mchod sprin sogs bcoms/ rje 'jigs med dam chos rgya mtsho mchog gis (1898da 1946)bstod pa 'jigs bral ngag gi snye ma dang / bstod pa dad pa'i spu long 'dren pa'i bser bu/ dan tig gi bstod pa lhun grub spobs pa'i 'dzum ris sogs brtsams/ gsung rtsom pon nyi shu bcoms/ mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel mchog gis (1903da 1951)'du bral snying bo med par rtogs pa'i glu dang / mi rtag dran pa'i gsung mgur sogs legs par brtsams nas/ bod kyi phyi dar rtsom rig ni brjod don phun sum tshogs la bsam blo'i rang bzhin gting mtha' zab pa dang / sgyu rtsal rang bzhin khyad du 'phags pa'i rnam pa gsar ba zhig tu bsgyur ba dang / bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig la gzhi rgya che ba'i rmang gzhi /rtan por bting ba dang / rin thang che ba'i bgrod lam rnam par bsrun

bod kyi phyi dar rtsom rig yo7don tshan gnyis pa/ rje btsun 'jam dbyangs kyi bstod pa tam bu ra'i rgyud mangs/dang po/ rtsomagapo'i lorgyusamador bstan pa/kun gzigs lnga ba chen po blo bzang rgya mtsho mchog ni/ yar lung 'phyongs rgyas yul du za hor gyi rigs las yab mi dbang bdud 'dul rab brtan dang / yum yar 'brog khri dpon gyi sras mo kun dga' lha mdzes gnyis kyi sras su rab byung bcu ba'i me sbrul te spyi lo 1617lor sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo drug pa chu byi ste sbyi lo 1622lor 'bras srungs su gdan drangs/ paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan las gtsug phud bzhes/ mtshan blo bzang rgya mtshor gsol/gling smad pa dkon mchog chos 'phel bsten nas bsdus tshad nas bzung pod chenarnams tshegs med du mkhyen/ paṇa chen rin po che las dbang lung man ngag mang du gsan/ smon 'gro parnyi ta tshe dbang don grub yab sras las snyan ngag dang / sgra/ sdeb sbyor sogs mthar phyin par sbyangs/ sgra yi ri mo yongs rdzogs rgyugs 'phrod pa'i kun bshad kyi mtshan la 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen zhes btags/ sdum po don grub dbang rgyal dang zur chen chos dbyings rang grol las skar nag dbyangs 'char rtsis sogs gsan te bcu phrag rig pa'i ma hwa paṇḍi ta chen por gyur/ dgung lo nyer gnyis pa rab byung bcugacig pa'i sa stag ste sbyi lo 1638lor paṇa chen rin po cher bla chen gyi

308 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/// // zlos bsnyen par rdzogs/ mtshan ngag gi dbang phyug ces gsar du dgung lo nyer drug pa chu rta ste spyi lo 112lor gu thi bstan 'dzin chos rgyal gyis bod khri skor bcu gsum mchod gzhis su phul nas dga' ldan pho brang gasrid dbang gzhi tshugs/ dmar po ri la pho brang chen po po ta la bzhengs/dgung lo so drug pa chu 'brug spyi lo 1652lor 'jam dbyangs gong ma shun ṭi rgyal po'i bka' bzhin pe cin du phebs/ gong mas nub phyogs mchog tu dge ba'i zhing gi rgyal dbang sa steng gi rgyal bstan yongs kyi bdag po thams cad mkhyen pa badzra dha ra tā la'i bla ma zhes pa'i go ming dang 'ja' sa gser tham gnang / gser tham gyi ngos su nub phyogs kyi phul byung zhi ba sangs rgyas rgya chen khyon la sangs rgyas bstan pa'i mnga' bdag thams cad mkhyen pa rdo rje 'chang tā la'i bla ma'i tham ga zhes rgya hor bod gsum gyi yi ge shan sbyar du /spyanā snatā /pa/ /|/ /ra rgya nag nas bod du phebs/ gong dkar bshad sgrub spyir rje 'dis paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan dang / khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel/ 'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub/ khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba/ dbu mdzad bsod nams mchog grub/ zur chen chos dbyings rang grol/rig 'dzin gter bdag gling ba/ sman lung ba blo mchog rdo rje sogs grub mtha' ris med kyi mkhas grub mang bo bsten nas gsar rnying gi chos tshul rgya mtsho lta bu bzhes par mdzad/ dbus gtsang khams sogs kyi yul du chos sde gsar bzhengs bgrang gis mi lang / rab byung bsnyen rdzogs 'bogs pa'i dge slong ni sa chen po'i rdul lta bur snang / gsung rtsom rang nyid kyi rnam thar dang / bla ma'i rnam thar/ snyan ngag gi 'grel ba/ rgyal rabs deb ther/mtshan nyid kyi yig cha/ lam rim sogs phyi nang pod chen sum cu bzhugs pa

bod kyi phyi dar rtsom rig 309dang / rdo rje phreng ba sogs dang rgyud sde bzhi'i dbang lung 'chad spel gnang ba sogs chu bo gaṅgā'i shar phyogs kyi bla chen dang mi chen phal mo che zhal slob tu ma gyur pa med pa lta bur snang / gsar phyogs la 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse dang / rnying lugs la byang ba bkras stobs kyi lugs kho na thugs rtsis su mdzad/ 'khor lo gsum gyi phyag rjes/ phyi nang gsang gsum gyi mdzad pa dang rnam thar bsam gyis mi khyab/ dgung lo re drug pa rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu khyi ste sbyi lo 1682lor sku gshegs so/ / mdor na/ rgyal dbang lnga ba ngag dpang blo bza~X rgya mtsho mchog gis ni gangs can /da kyi bstan srinā la /dzad byi'u nā shā ṭā ༵ ṭwāṃ mee / sa/ ༵ zlo/ rje/sa nārsha sna /na rig gnas dang tsam rig sgyu gnyisapa/ rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangasakyi bstod pyotamabu ra'i rgyud mngasadang de'i brjod don/na mo ā rya mdzi thi ye/ mkha' khyab don dam chos sku lha yi lam/ / bcu drugabade chen mtshan bzang dbang bo'i gzhu/ / gnyis med gnyis su 'char ba'i sgyu dra'i gar/ / ston mdzad 'jam mgon zur phud lnga bar 'dud/ / chu skyes 'dab brgya rgod pa'i ze'u 'bru'i rtser/ / rab gsal zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya rgyas steng / / gur kum rdul mang brtsegs pa'i lhun po ni/ /nyi ma bye ba'i 'od kyis 'khyud pa bzhin/ / bcu drug lang tsho dar ba'i 'jo sgeg can/ / rgyal sras gzhon nur ston 'di ring bo nas/ / rnam 'dren kun gyi yab ces rgan po'i mtshan/ / 'chang ba'i gtam 'di thol gyis sgrib pa bzhin/ / mtshams sprin gangs kyi ri bo padma rag / mdangs dbyibs

310 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyusarig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/gzugs sku'i bkod pa bye ba'i tshogs/ / mtha' med 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ma bskams bar/ / grangs med 'gro ba'i don du bstan las ci/ / mig gi bdud rtsir spyod pa'i mdzes sdug sku/ / phun tshogs mtshan dpe'i ri mo bkra ba gang / / mthong thos dran dang reg pas rnam grol ba/ / 'di ko skal bzang gdul bya'i bsod nams dpyid/ / de don rtogs pa'i blo gros ches phra rnams/ / sna tshogs rin chen phreng ba'i do shal dang / / pañtsa li ku'i dar gyi sham thabs la/ / bsngags brjod dar dir sgrog pa ngal ba'i gnas/ / srid zhi'i rgud pa mig sman ltar gnag pa/ /mthar byed nā da'i sgra dbyangs rta ljang can/ / rgol ngan smra ba'i ku mun zum pa dang / / dpyod ldan blo gros pad dkar 'dzum gyis bsu/ / dam pa'i chos kyi rgyud mangs 'khrol ba'i glu/ /skal bzang rna bar 'jebs pa tshangs pa'i gsung / / ches cher rmongs pa'i 'gro la brag ca'i sgra/ /mi bzad bdud sde'i snying la tsher ma bzhin/ /chu klung gcig la snag khrag bdud rtsi sogs/ / sna tshogs du mar snang zhing don byed pa/ /kun rdzob 'khrul ba'i chos kun don dam dbyings/ / ma rnyed dbu ma'i lam bzang ston pa bzhin/ / skad cig tsam la rgya chen shes bya'i mtha'/ /phul byung thugs rje'i laṅka'i bdag po'i gzugs/ / blo ldan snying gi rin chen rtsig ngos la/ / shar tshe lnga rig ha nu ma gang / /dga' ba'i zlos gar sgyur la ci yang brel/ / chos brgyad 'bod sgrogs 'phrul gyis nyer drangs pa'i/ /dam pa'i chos kyi si tā 'dor byas nas/ /'dir snang ri dwags snyeg la mgon khyod kyis/ / mi phan byang bstan phug par nyi gzer bzhin/ / gtan gyi skyabs su gsol na smos ci 'tshal/ / cung zad dran pas phan bde'i legs tshogs rnams/ /stsol mdzad 'dod pa'i re skong dbang gi rgyal/ / sngon med yid bzhin nor bu gzhan na su/ / 'gro ba'i dbang bor 'tsham pa'i 'phrin las kyi/ /pha mtha' kun gsal bu mo'i 'gram pa la/ /'jal byed 'dzad pa

bod kyi phyi dar rtsom rig 311med pa'i zhags pa yis/ / srid dang zhi ba'i dngos kun gcig tu bcings/ /phra zhib rnam par dpyod pa'i mkhyen pa'i spyan/ /dkyus ring zur gyis 'phangs pa'i nyag phran gyis/ / mtha' med khengs ldan shes bya lus phra ma/ /kun yid dga' ba'i 'dzum dang bcas te bsu/ / brtse chen dpyid kyi dpal mo'i mngal yangs nas/ / lhag bsam chu 'dzin gsar ba'i lang long can/ /rlabs chen spyod pa mchog gi char rgyun gyis/ /phan dang bde ba'i myu gu g.yur du za/ /dbang phyug mig las sbar ba'i me dpung gis/ /nyag phran bdag po bcom pa nges par thun/ / bden na khyod kyi nus mthu'i thog mda' yis/ /nag po'i phyogs rnams cig car bcom min nam/ / khyod dang ma la yar skyes ljon pa gnyis/ /mi shes tsha gdung 'joms la mtshungs na yang / /mgon khyod nyes pa'i skyon bral ngag gi lha/ /tsan dan shing de gdug pa'i sbrul gyis 'khril/ /e ma ngo mtshar mkha' la nyi zla zung / /chos bzang lha yi mdun sar mig stong can/ / grangs med rkang 'thung khrod na yongs 'du'i ljon/ /rgyalasras 'phags tshogs dbus na 'jam dbyangs khyod/ / mchog dman kun la nye dang ring med par/ /gsol ba btab pa tsam gyis 'bod pa'i don/ /lhun grub re ba ma lus skong byed pa'i/ /yid bzhin nor bu klu dbang gtsug na mdzes/ /rnam par 'byed pa'i shes rab ral gri yis/ /mi shes rmongs pa'i dra ba bcad pa dang / /lhan cig 'khor ba sdug bsngal kun gyi rgya/ / dral te 'gro rnams bde ba chen por 'khrid/ / gang gi gsang gsum byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /skye dgu'i yid kyi yol gor 'khyil ba na/ /shes ldan dad pa'i bstod bsngags zil mngar chu/ /mgon khyod thugs kyi padma'i ze'u 'brur 'bab/ /mtha' bral rlabs chen mdzad pa mchog gi nor/ /phyur bur spungs pa gcig tu shong ba'i snod/ /sprul la 'jig rten mes po ngal gyur na/ /srid gsum 'di yang da dung chung ngur khums/ /chos phung rgya mtshor shar ba'i pusti

312 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/ka/ / phrag gong utpal 'dab steng mngon chags pa/ / blta phyir lhun pos nyi zla'i sgron me zung / / bteg nas ngal med lta bar chas pa bzhin/ / thabs shes zung 'jug rgyud las drangs pa'i mdas/ / gti mug snying ga phug pa'i khrag gi rgyun/ / 'gro la rjes chags dmar bo'i 'od gzi la/ / thun mtshams mdangs su byed pos btegs sam snyam/ / rgod ma kha la 'gran bzod zhabs sen gyis/ /'jam mnyen chu skyes 'dab ma sreg go zhes/ / ri bong 'dzin de tsha ba'i gdung sel slad/ / mkha' las babs nas stan du 'ong ba bzhin/ /chos kun mkhyen yang slob pa 'phags pa'i tshul/ / drang po'i sku yang 'khyog po'i 'gying bag can/ /zhi zhing dul yang bdud sde'i tshogs la khro/ / kun la brtse yang skal ldan rjes su 'dzin/ / mgon khyod thugs rje'i zegs ma ma 'dris pa'i/ / lus can rnams la 'jug pa rdzun gtam ste/ / tsand+ra go mi mkhas pa'i mthar pon yang / / da dung skye dgu phal cher rnam par rmongs/ /'gro kun 'dzum gyis bsu ba'i zhal khyim la/ / gur kum gsar ba'i mdangs la dmar 'od can/ / 'khor ba'i ro la 'tshol ba'i spyan gyi dkyus/ / srid dang zhi ba'i mtha' las rnam par brgal/ / yin 'ong gdub sil 'khrol ba'i snyan po'i sgra/ / rna ba'i bdun rtsir byed pa'i 'od dkar can/ / yid bzhin 'o ma'i rgya mtsho 'khyil ba'i dbus/ / rtsed 'jor rol ba'i 'dab chags ngang ba su/ / rgyal ba rnams kyi mkhyen pa'i phung bo dang / /khyod kyi rnam par yangs pa'i blo gros gnyis/ / 'jig rten mes pos srang la bteg pa na/ / lci dang yangaba'i go skabs med 'di mtshar/ / dpal ldan stobs bcu'i rtsal 'chang 'dren pa kun/ / kun dga'i legs bshad spel phyir rgyal ba'i sras/ / sras bcas rnams kyi gtsug na mtho ba'i lha/ / lha mchog 'jam dpal dbyangs zhes grags pa 'bar/ / ngag gi dbang bo dbang phyug brgyad ldan pa/ /thams cad mkhyen de mkhyen brtse nus pa'i dpyid/ / sgrib gnyis las bral

bod kyi phyi dar rtsom rig 313las can 'gro ba'i mgon/ / mchog gi dngos grub dngos su stsol la mkhas/ /mtshams spyin mdangs 'dzin 'dzin ma yongs kyi rgyan/ /rgyan phreng gis mdzes mdzes sdug gzhon nu'i gzugs/ / gzugs sku ngo mtshar mtshar sdug 'dzin pa'i mgon/ / mgon po 'jam dbyangs dbyangs bdun legs bshad 'khrol/ / dung dung yid kyis rtag tu lhar bsten na/ / brtan brtan snying gi pad mtshor legs zhugs nas/ / 'grig 'grig gsung gi snang ba legs stsol zhing / /yang yang thugs rje'i phyag gis dbugs 'byung mdzad/ /ldem ldem padma'i 'dab ma rgyas pa'i dbus/ / dkar dkar chu shel dbang bo'i dkyil 'khor steng / / mdzes mdzes gcig tu bsdus pa'i mtshan dpe'i sku/ / gsal gsal kun rtog bar gyis ci yang 'bri/ / pha mtha' mi mngon tshang tshing rnam par 'khrigs/ / kha dog rab dkar kha ba'i reg byas gdungs/ /tsha grang mi snyoms tha ga pa yi yul/ / ṭha ka ra la 'thob byar 'dzin pa rnams/ /mi shes rmongs pa'i mun pas nyer bsgribs pas/ / mu med sdug bsngal rgya mtsho'i rgyu sgrub par/ / me tog bcud la bung ba ltar 'khor ba'i/ /ma lus 'gro ba drongs shig 'jam dpal dbyangs/ / ka ma la ltar 'jam mnyenagazugs kyi sku'i/ / kha dog rnam par bkra ba'i bkod pa dang / / ga bur ngad ltar gdung sel thugs rje'i phyag / nga rgyal can gyi 'gro ba'i gtsug nakhyongs/ / ca co legs par bshad pa'i dbyangs snyan po/ / cha shas res kyang yid dang rna ba la/ / ja dkar btung bas rig pa'i mdangs gsal ltar/ /nya rgyas zla ltar blo gros 'phel bar mdzod/ / ta la'i glegs bam rgya gar mkhas pa'i gzhung / /tha na chung ngu'i dka' gnad tsam la yang / /da lta thogs med smra ba'i spobs pa mchog / nā gā rdzu na'i rnam dpyod ltar mtshungs mdzod/ /pa sangs ltar dkar mkhas pa'i bya ba kun/ / pha rol rgol ba zil gyis gnon nus pa/ /ba gling dbus na khyu mchog ji bzhin du/ /ma lus shes

314 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/ldan rnams kyi mgon du mdzod/ / tsa pa yin kyang dngos su zhal bstan nas/ /tsha zer spyan dang padma ji bzhin du/ / dza ya'i gsung rab kun la lta ba'i mig / wa ler gsal ba'i shes rab gsal bar mdzod/ / zha yig ltar 'khyil 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho'i nang / / za byed nyon mongs chu srin gdug pas gtses/ /'a 'ur mi bzad sdug bsngal ldan pa rnams/ / ya mtshan dag pa'i 'ing du khyod kyis drongs/ /ra ba med pa'i phug pa'i blun sgom dang / /la lung 'khyam pa'i rtog ge kha bshad mkhan/ / sha khrag sdug la rol ba'i kla klo'i sde/ /sa yi rdul ltar khyab rnams rjes su zungs/ / ha cang dus ngan snyigs ma'i mthar thug 'dir/ / a don skye med rtogs pa'i nyin dkar tsam/ / ha la'i dug 'dra'i gnas ngan len gyi rgyu/ / a ma'i 'bras ltar myong rnams rjes brtser mdzod/ /de ltar dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi yab/ / rgyal sras gzhon nu'i tshul 'dzin ngag gi lha/ / dran pas rnam 'dren rin chen gling mchog tu/ /'khrid pa'i ded dpon brtan pa'i 'khor lo dgongs/ /mi 'phrog dad pa'i shing rtas rab drangs pa'i/ / shugs drag smon lam dkyil 'khor rta ljang can/ / snyan 'gyur tshig gi mkha' la nyer 'phags na/ / thugs rje'i pad dkar 'dab ma 'dzum las ci/ / bdag sogs mkha' mnyam sems can ma lus pa/ / nyon mongs dug gsum drag po'i nad kyis gtses/ / gnas ngan len pa'i rgyu yi khur chen blangs/ / blang dang dor byar lta ba'i blo mig ldongs/ /mngon mtho nges legs lam las rgyab kyis phyogs/ /mi bzad ngan song g.yang sar gom pa 'phyan/ / dge ba'i las kyi 'khar ba'i rten dang bral/ / nyam thag snying rje'i gnas su gyur rnams la/ / mgon po khyod kyis rjes su mi 'dzin na/ / gtan gyi skyabs gnas dam pa su la re/ / bdag gzhan brje ba'i byang chub sems ldan pa'i/ / snyan pa'i gtam yang ming gi lhag mar zad/ / ches cher snyigs ma lnga yis nyer sbags pas/ / ha cang

bod kyi phyi dar rtsom rig 315gdul bar dka' zhes btang snyoms su/ /'jog na bgrod par dka' ba'i chu bo la/ /mi phan gru dang za bas ci zhig byed/ /'gro ba'i khams dang bsam pa bag la nyal/ / ji bzhin rtogs nas rjes su 'dzin pa la/ / rmad byung mkhyen pa'i yon tan mtha' yas pa/ / rgyal sras dam pa khyod la lhag par mnga'/ /'gro ba kun la rang gi bu gcig ltar/ / rnam par brtse bas cung zad tsam du yang / /yal bar mi 'dor snying rje chen po ni/ / rje btsun khyod kyi rgyud la rtag tu ldan/ /gzhan la phan na dmyal ba'i me dong du/ /'jug pa mtsho dang rdzing bur ngang ba ltar/ / dga' zhing spro ba'i nus ldan lhag pa'i sems/ /'phags chen dam pa'i yul las gzhan du ci/ /skye dgu'i mgon skyabs dpung dang gnyen gyur pa'i/ / yon tan kun tshang dam pa khyed rnams kyis/ / 'gro rnams yal bar 'dor na skyabs gnas mchog / gsung rab mang bar bshad pa rdzun du bas/ / de phyir thugs rje chen po'i zhags pa yis/ /lus can mtha' dag mi gnas myang 'das mchog /rang gzhan don gnyisagrub pa'i gtan bde'i gzhir/ / khrid cig smra ba'i dbang phyug 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /lugs gnyis utpal 'khrigs pa rdzing bu la/ /rmongs pa'i glang chen rgyu ba'i gom stabs kyis/ / phan bde'i yal 'dab 'dam ltar dzi ba la/ / dran 'dzin lcags kyus thul zhig 'jam dpal dbyangs/ / me tog mda' yis dge ba'i sems kyi snying / /mngon par phug pa'i ri dwagasas sha ra khyu/ / phul byung byin rlabs dpyad kyis rab phral nas/ / log spyod zug ju choms shig 'jam dpal dbyangs/ / sgra tshad bzo gso nang don rig pa dang / /snyan ngag mngon brjod sdeb sbyor zlos gar gzhung / / skar rtsis bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas rnams kun/ / 'chad pa'i rnam dpyod rtsol cig 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /mtha' klas gtsug lag mngon par 'khyil ba'i chu/ /log rtog nyes bshad rtog ma'i lang long can/ / rigs lam nor bu ke ta gas

316 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/drangs pa'i/ / rtsod pa'i rnam dpyod stsol cig 'jam dpal dbyangs/ / phyi nang gsang ba'i gzhung lugs ma lus pa/ /nyung du spel dang rgya chen snying bor bsdu/ / ma tshang kha 'gengs shab dkrugs sdeb pa sogs/ / rtsom pa'i rnam dpyod stsol cig 'jam dpal dbyangs/ / blo gros dri ma med pa'i ā darsha/ /cung zad tsam la gsung rab bye ba'i gzugs/ / thogs med 'chad pa'i 'dzinadang mi brjed pa'i/ / gzugs kyi dngos grub stsol cig 'jam dpal dbyangs/ / phyogs res mi ngoms legs par bshad pa'i tshig / lus phra'i 'gram pa'i chang gi thigs pas kyang / /yon tan ba ku la yi kha 'byed pa'i/ /thos pa'i dngos grub stsol cig 'jam dpal dbyangs/ / sde snod gsum dang rdo rje'i rnal 'byor sogs/ / zab mo'i lam rnams rgyud ldan bla ma yi/ / man ngag ji bzhin nyams su rab len pa'i/ / sgom pa'i dngos grub stsol cig 'jam dpal dbyangs/ / phan bde'i 'byung gnas rgyal ba'i bstan pa mchog /dbyar gyi ljon pa'i lo 'dab ltar rgyas shing / / sems can mtha' dag skyid pa'i grib bsil la/ / yun ring 'tsho zhing spyod cig 'jam dpal dbyangs/ / gsol 'debs bkra shis g.yas su 'khyil ba'i dung / / dus gsum dge ba'i sgra dbyangs snyan po can/ / 'gro rnams yid kyi gdung sol bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /rgyal kun mchod pa'i rol mos mnyes gyur cig /ces 'phags pa 'jam dbyangs la bstod pa smon lam dang bcas pa'i tshigs su bcad pa dam bu ra'i rgyud mangs zhes bya ba 'di ni za hor gyi rigs las a wa ཿ) pa'i btsun pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sde yis/ rgya nag gi sa'i cha ri bo rtse lnga dang le bar bdun zloshā kā // /nā pa'i pho brang pe cin gyi nye 'dabs su ja sbyor gsum gyi yun la

bod kyi phyi dar rtsom rig 317gsumapa/ rje btsun 'jamadabyangasakyi bstod gtamabura'i rgyud mngasakyi bsamablo'i nang don/de yang rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs ni 'jam dpal gyi zhing mdor/bskalab 'di'i sngon rol du 'jig rten gyi khams 'byung ba bzang bo bya bar 'khor bsgyur nam mkha'i skye ba bzhes tshe sangs rgyas 'brug sgra'i dbyangs kyi rgyal po'i drung du sems bskyed pa dang / gzhan yang sangs rgyas rin chen snying bo'ispyan sngar sems bskyed cing zhing sbyong ba'i smon lam chen po btab par/sangs rgyas de nyid kyis sangs rgyas kun tu gzigs pa zhes bya bar lung bstan/de nas bya dka' la grangs med pa'i spyod pa nyams su blangs pa'i tshe ji ltar mdzad pa ni/ 'jam dpal rnam rol dang / 'jam dpal gnas pa'i mdo/byams pa seng ge sgra'i le'u/ blo gros bzang mos zhus pa/ blo gros rab gsal gyis zhus pa/ dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi mdo/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud sogs mdo rgyud mang bor rgya che bar gsungs pa ltar ro/ /bdag cag gi ston pa sngon tshong dpon gyi bu dri med dpung bar gyur pa na 'jam dpal chos smra ba ye shes rgyal por gyur pas byang chub tu sems thog mar bskyed du bcug pas/ ston pas kyang 'jam dpal ni nga'i slob dpon yin zhes gsungs pa ltar dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad la dang por sems bskyed pa/ bar du tshogs gsog pa/ tha mar chos 'khor bskor ba'i gnas skabs thams cad du slob dpon lta bu'i mdzad pa mdzad pas na rgyal ba kun gyi yab tu bsngags/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi dus su ma skyes dgras pha bsad pa dang /gzhan zhig gis ma bsad pa la 'di'i sprul bas dgra bcom pa thob par byas pa

bod kyi phyi dar rtsom rig 317gsumapa/ rje btsun 'jamadabyangasakyi bstod gtamabura'i rgyud mngasakyi bsamablo'i nang don/de yang rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs ni 'jam dpal gyi zhing mdor/bskalab 'di'i sngon rol du 'jig rten gyi khams 'byung ba bzang bo bya bar 'khor bsgyur nam mkha'i skye ba bzhes tshe sangs rgyas 'brug sgra'i dbyangs kyi rgyal po'i drung du sems bskyed pa dang / gzhan yang sangs rgyas rin chen snying bo'ispyan sngar sems bskyed cing zhing sbyong ba'i smon lam chen po btab par/sangs rgyas de nyid kyis sangs rgyas kun tu gzigs pa zhes bya bar lung bstan/de nas bya dka' la grangs med pa'i spyod pa nyams su blangs pa'i tshe ji ltar mdzad pa ni/ 'jam dpal rnam rol dang / 'jam dpal gnas pa'i mdo/byams pa seng ge sgra'i le'u/ blo gros bzang mos zhus pa/ blo gros rab gsal gyis zhus pa/ dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi mdo/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud sogs mdo rgyud mang bor rgya che bar gsungs pa ltar ro/ /bdag cag gi ston pa sngon tshong dpon gyi bu dri med dpung bar gyur pa na 'jam dpal chos smra ba ye shes rgyal por gyur pas byang chub tu sems thog mar bskyed du bcug pas/ ston pas kyang 'jam dpal ni nga'i slob dpon yin zhes gsungs pa ltar dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad la dang por sems bskyed pa/ bar du tshogs gsog pa/ tha mar chos 'khor bskor ba'i gnas skabs thams cad du slob dpon lta bu'i mdzad pa mdzad pas na rgyal ba kun gyi yab tu bsngags/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi dus su ma skyes dgras pha bsad pa dang /gzhan zhig gis ma bsad pa la 'di'i sprul bas dgra bcom pa thob par byas pa

318 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/dang / mnyan yod du mu ge byung tshe bdud kyi gnod pa tshar bcad pa dang /gcer bu ma'i bu gang bos zla ba gsum gyi ring la chos bstan pas ma smin pa 'di'i sprul bas de'i 'khor lnga brgya dang bcas pa skad cig la theg chen gyi bden pa la bkod pa dang / 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed du sprul te gshin rje yab yum 'khor bcas bstan srung du bkod pa sogs bgrang du med/mthar 'tshang rgya ba'i zhing rdul med cing dri ma dang bral ba yang dag bsags/de'i drung na bde ba can gyi snod bcud ni chu thigs phra mo dang mtshungs te/der 'jam dpal ma gtogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang gis kyang rngo mi thogs par gsungs/ mdor na sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes lha'i bzhin lag tu shar ba yin pas/ 'di la brten na thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i shes rab 'phel ba dang / khyad par du rnam par thar ba'i sgo gsum la sogs pa'i mkhyen rab rgyud la skye sla zhing mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zab gsal myur ba'i shes rab kyis spong bar 'gyur ba sogs kyi phan yon 'jam dpal gyi zhing mdo sogs las rgyas par gsungs pa ltar te/ mkhas pa dang grub pa'i yon tan che skyes chung skyes thams cad lha 'di'i 'phrin las las byung ba dang 'byung ba dang / bod kyi 'jam dbyangs rnam gsum dang / sa skya'i rin chen bdun brgyud/ dge ldan gtsang ba bdun brgyud/ chos rab tu rnam 'byed kyi dngos grub thams cad lha 'di bas lhag pa zhig las 'byung ba yang med ces shes par bya'o/ / 'jig rten 'di'i dbang du byas na gdul bya'i zhing khams mang na yang grags che ba ni ri bo rtse lnga ste/ de la'ang gnas dang gnas 'dra yod cing / byang phyogs sham bha la'i rigs ldan rim byon kyang 'jam dpal gyi sprul bar gsungs/ lha 'di la zhi ba dang khro bo/ zhi ma khro'i dkyil 'khor dang las tshogs rab 'byams bzhugs so/ /rje btsun 'jam dbyangs kyi bstod pa tam bu ra'i rgyud mangs kyi bsam

— bodakyiphyinar rtsom rig 319 blo'i nang don ni/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sku gsung thugs gsum gyi yon tan la mos gus dang bsngags brjod dang / snyan ngag mkhan gyis legs nyes blang dor la kun nas rmongs pa'i nyam thag 'gro ba rnams la snying rjes gzigs nas rjes su 'dzin par gsol ba dang / snying thag pa nas khong nyid la 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi rnam dpyod dang thos bsam sgom gsum sogs dngos grub stsol ba'i smon 'dun dang re 'dod zhus pa de yin no/ /bzhi ba/ rje btsun 'jamapa'i dbyangasakyi bstod pa tamabu ra'i rgyud mngasakyisna rtsalakhyad chos/deyang rgyal dbang lnga ba ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho mchog ni rgya gar shar lho gnyis kyi snyan ngag gi rtsom lugs la kun nas mnga' brnyes pa dang rang nyidakyithunamong ma yin rdo'i rtsorno rtsa: da/ rtsom /shikta rnaspraparachagasapa'i /spya )kā spra jigā shārnyi sde rtenā ༵de ji// / ṅge ṭā /yi/ ṭwāṃ/ tshod dngha snyan ngag la rmad 1 rab rtog dang nyams ldan sogs snyan ngag gi rgyan gyis legs par lha/nā 〉pa tā/ rtog pa 'char yan ring lugs kyi sgyu rtsal khyad chos yongs su 2 ril che la brjid chags pa'i tshig sbyor gyis ni blo spobs ldan la rang dbang thob pa'i rmad byung bsam blo mtshon par mdzad pa dang /2 snyan ngag la sgeg pa dang dpa' ba sogs nyams 'gyur gyis kun /sdu/rshakā zlo/ ṭā /da/ /da la mdzes sdug gi nyams snang dang bden stobs kyi

— bodakyiphyinar rtsom rig 319 blo'i nang don ni/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sku gsung thugs gsum gyi yon tan la mos gus dang bsngags brjod dang / snyan ngag mkhan gyis legs nyes blang dor la kun nas rmongs pa'i nyam thag 'gro ba rnams la snying rjes gzigs nas rjes su 'dzin par gsol ba dang / snying thag pa nas khong nyid la 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi rnam dpyod dang thos bsam sgom gsum sogs dngos grub stsol ba'i smon 'dun dang re 'dod zhus pa de yin no/ /bzhi ba/ rje btsun 'jamapa'i dbyangasakyi bstod pa tamabu ra'i rgyud mngasakyisna rtsalakhyad chos/deyang rgyal dbang lnga ba ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho mchog ni rgya gar shar lho gnyis kyi snyan ngag gi rtsom lugs la kun nas mnga' brnyes pa dang rang nyidakyithunamong ma yin rdo'i rtsorno rtsa: da/ rtsom /shikta rnaspraparachagasapa'i /spya )kā spra jigā shārnyi sde rtenā ༵de ji// / ṅge ṭā /yi/ ṭwāṃ/ tshod dngha snyan ngag la rmad 1 rab rtog dang nyams ldan sogs snyan ngag gi rgyan gyis legs par lha/nā 〉pa tā/ rtog pa 'char yan ring lugs kyi sgyu rtsal khyad chos yongs su 2 ril che la brjid chags pa'i tshig sbyor gyis ni blo spobs ldan la rang dbang thob pa'i rmad byung bsam blo mtshon par mdzad pa dang /2 snyan ngag la sgeg pa dang dpa' ba sogs nyams 'gyur gyis kun /sdu/rshakā zlo/ ṭā /da/ /da la mdzes sdug gi nyams snang dang bden stobs kyi
bya dka' ba'i rgyan te ka mad dang sgra rgyan la nye bar rtsal dang brjod don legs par bstan pa'o/ /

bod kyi phyi dar rtsom rig 321don tshan gsum pa/ dbyangs can ngag gi rol mcho yid kyi ngang mo rnam rtsen tshangs pa'i mgrin rgyan rab dga'i da mangs/dang po/ rtsomagapo'i lorgyusamador bstan pa/bod kyi snyan ngag pa chen po bod mkhas pa mi pham dge legs rnam rgyal ni/rab byung bcu ba'i sa rta ste sbyi lo 1618lor 'khrungs/ dgung lo re gcig pa rab byung bcu gcig pa'i sa rta spyi lo 1678lor snyan 'grel dartsi'i dgongs rgyan brtsams zhes bstan rtsis kun btus las gsungs/ /gnyisapa/ dbyangasacan ngag gi rolamatsho yid kyi ngang mornamartsen tshangasapa'i mgrin rgyan rab dga'i rgyud mngasadang de'i brjod don/rig 'dzin lha yi skyed tshal du/ / 'jug pa'i 'phrin yig thabs shes kyi/ / 'dab gshog g.yo ba'i zlos gar mkhan/ / yid kyi ngang mo rnam rtsen bzhugs/ / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes sprin/ / rab zhi chos kyi dbyangs bdun rdzogs pa'i glus/ / bde ba chen po'i dpyid 'jo bcom ldan

322 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin gye ba'i rol mtsho/ma/ /ngag dbang lha yi bu mor btud nas de'i/ / thugs rje'i 'dab yangs stong du 'dzum pa'i rlabs/ / 'gog med chos don zab mo'i bdud rtsi'i ro/ / bcud len snying bor sems pa'i rkang drug pa/ / ma brtags nyams dga'i snyan tshig mgrin pa 'degs/ /legs byas dpal gyi dum bu'i nags kyi ljongs/ / lang tshor smin pa dal 'byor bzang bo'i rten/ / 'thob par dka' yang lan cig brgya lam na/ / rnyed 'dir dam pa'i chos kyi 'bras ldan pas/ /dga' dang mos pa'i tshig sbyor gaṅgā'i rgyun/ / kun mkhyen ral ba'i nags su 'khor 'dod kyang / / dus gzhan skal ldan shing rtas nyer drangs tshe/ /'dir snang khyab 'jug zhabs kyang bsil bar byed/ / yul gyi mngon 'dodagasar ba'i rtse dga' mar/ / srid pas bcings pa'i nyam thag 'khor ba ba/ /sna tshogs myong ba'i khur gyis yongs dub rnams/ / rang sems ngal 'tsho'i stegs bu 'di long zhig / skye bar 'dris pa'i bag chags bzang bo yis/ /mdun nas bsus pa dbyangs kyi rgyal mo'i grogs/ / skal bzang dge legs rnam par rgyal ba'i lha/ / rang nyid nyer zhi'i dpal la yid chags shing / /gnyis med gsung rgyun yan lag brgyad ldan chab/ /lhag pa'i snying stobs 'dzin ma'i snod yangs por/ / dogs pa med par 'thung ba'i ma dros mtsho/ / rnam 'dren klu yi dbang bo'i thugs rje'i mthu/ / rnam dpyod mchu sgros byi ru'i tshal nang skyes/ /legs bshad ro brgya 'dzin pa'i padma 'di/ /rnam par grol ba'i nyi zer 'thung 'dod pas/ / dad dang brtson pa'i 'khri shing kun nas g.yo/ /gang tshe legs ldan 'bigs byed dga' ma'i mgrin/ /sngon goms rigs gzhung rgya mtsho'i chu ris can/ / kun gsal nam mkha'i phang bar gnas bcas te/ / gnas skabs bde bar rlom pa'i dus shig na/ /rig 'dzin lha yi skyed mos tshal 'gram nas/ /dri za'i na chung grub pa'i pho nya mos/ / bskul ba'i snyan tshig rgyud mangs las thon pa'i/ /'phrin yig

322 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin gye ba'i rol mtsho/ma/ /ngag dbang lha yi bu mor btud nas de'i/ / thugs rje'i 'dab yangs stong du 'dzum pa'i rlabs/ / 'gog med chos don zab mo'i bdud rtsi'i ro/ / bcud len snying bor sems pa'i rkang drug pa/ / ma brtags nyams dga'i snyan tshig mgrin pa 'degs/ /legs byas dpal gyi dum bu'i nags kyi ljongs/ / lang tshor smin pa dal 'byor bzang bo'i rten/ / 'thob par dka' yang lan cig brgya lam na/ / rnyed 'dir dam pa'i chos kyi 'bras ldan pas/ /dga' dang mos pa'i tshig sbyor gaṅgā'i rgyun/ / kun mkhyen ral ba'i nags su 'khor 'dod kyang / / dus gzhan skal ldan shing rtas nyer drangs tshe/ /'dir snang khyab 'jug zhabs kyang bsil bar byed/ / yul gyi mngon 'dodagasar ba'i rtse dga' mar/ / srid pas bcings pa'i nyam thag 'khor ba ba/ /sna tshogs myong ba'i khur gyis yongs dub rnams/ / rang sems ngal 'tsho'i stegs bu 'di long zhig / skye bar 'dris pa'i bag chags bzang bo yis/ /mdun nas bsus pa dbyangs kyi rgyal mo'i grogs/ / skal bzang dge legs rnam par rgyal ba'i lha/ / rang nyid nyer zhi'i dpal la yid chags shing / /gnyis med gsung rgyun yan lag brgyad ldan chab/ /lhag pa'i snying stobs 'dzin ma'i snod yangs por/ / dogs pa med par 'thung ba'i ma dros mtsho/ / rnam 'dren klu yi dbang bo'i thugs rje'i mthu/ / rnam dpyod mchu sgros byi ru'i tshal nang skyes/ /legs bshad ro brgya 'dzin pa'i padma 'di/ /rnam par grol ba'i nyi zer 'thung 'dod pas/ / dad dang brtson pa'i 'khri shing kun nas g.yo/ /gang tshe legs ldan 'bigs byed dga' ma'i mgrin/ /sngon goms rigs gzhung rgya mtsho'i chu ris can/ / kun gsal nam mkha'i phang bar gnas bcas te/ / gnas skabs bde bar rlom pa'i dus shig na/ /rig 'dzin lha yi skyed mos tshal 'gram nas/ /dri za'i na chung grub pa'i pho nya mos/ / bskul ba'i snyan tshig rgyud mangs las thon pa'i/ /'phrin yig
