bod kyi phyi dar rtsom rig 323kun dga' rgyas pa'i dbyangs ldan des/ / snying la bde ba'i dbugs 'byin lha brgya yi/ /gtam snyan ja yab nor bu'i yu ba can/ / snyan dang 'gyur bag stongagi bser bu'i rgyun/ / yid kyi shes pa bsil ba'i brten du 'bab/ /rang sems dri bral dar dkar chun po la/ / brtse sems mi phyed phyag rgya'i mdud ldan pa/ / gzhan rkyen sor rtses 'byed pa'i go skabs kyang / / nam mkha'i tshal gyi pad dkar dogs pa bzhin/ / nyi zer khu bas yongs smin utpala'i/ /'dab 'phreng rtse gar rgod pa'i khyim yangs por/ / bung ba'i na chung sbrang rtsis myos pa'i glu/ /sum rtsen tshal gyi gling bu'i sgra ltar snyan/ /'di na rngon pa'i glu las ri dwags bzhin/ /'khrul snang 'gog med myong ba'i mel tshe bas/ /sdug bsngal bde bar sems pas yid drangs te/ /lang tsho'i zer phreng nub rir 'chel la nye/ / yul gyi nags mthar rgyug pa yid shes kyi/ /bung ba las kyi bser bu'i gzhan dbang can/ / lha khyed dran pa'i sprang rtsis yin bkug ste/ / gzhan du mi g.yo phyogs der khar ma khor/ / ring nas goms pa'i bag chags nags kyi gzhir/ / smon lam dri bzang mngar bo 'thul ba'i grogs/ / kun las phul byung li shi'i gur khang na/ / rang snang bde ba'i bung ba kun dgar rgyu/ / mtha' med srid pa'i skyed tshal mngon yangs por/ / las snang 'khrul rtog ha la'i me tog gi/ / ro bcud duX kha rgyas pa'i kha zas 'di/ / rig sngags zab mos sman du byed nus sam/ / de skad glu yis gtams las rang gi sems/ / lhag pa'i bsam pa dkar phyogs zla ba'i cha/ / kun phan ga bur chu rgyas spro mkhas des/ / legs pa'i lam yangs gsal bzhin rab smras pa/ / mtshar sdug chu ris snying bos bkra ba'i 'dzum/ /snyan tshig 'chi med rnga dbyangs gsang mtho'i skyes/ /yid kyi 'dzin mar bde ba'i char 'bebs pa'i/ / ya mtshan kun dga'i sprin gyi rol rtsed mar/ / sngon 'dris mdza' ba ga bur dkar 'dzum gyi/ / reg pa mu tig 'khri

324 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/shing tshal gyi gzhir/ / dbyangs can sor rtses blangs pa snyan tshig gi/ / ro bcud smin pa'i 'phrin yig me tog 'phen/ / gsung gi lhug phran las thon tshon brgya ba'i/ /'phrin yig utpal gsar ba'i chun po zhig /mdza' ba'i dri bsung mngar bo 'bul bzhin du/ / rna ba'i dbyin du ring nas 'god pa snyam/ /nyams dang 'gyur bag stong gi ze'u 'bru'i rtser/ / don bzang zil ba tshar du dngar ba'i bcud/ / bdag blo dbyangs can grogs pos 'thungs pa'i mod/ /bde bas myos pa'i gar bcas glu yang len/ / sngon nas yongs 'dris bag chags yangs pa'i tshon/ / rang sems zla shel me long la 'gon pa/ /nam yang 'bral med snyan pa'i gtam gsar bas/ / mdza' ba dkar po'i bdud rtsis bran pa bzhin/ / g.yo med g.yung drung snying bos snyid chags pa'i/ /btso sbyangs gser ltar bzang ba'i sems kyi khams/ /mi 'gyur rdo ba'i ngos kyi re kha zhig /'di na bdag gi skal bar nye bar rgyu/ / snyigs ma rnam lnga'i lang tsho rdzogs ldan pa'i/ / dus ngan skye bo'i spyod tshul smyon pa'i gar/ / nges med g.yo yang yid brtan ma mchis pa/ / 'di 'drar bdag sems 'jog pa gang du bgyid/ / snyam sems skyo shas yus kyi shugs ring gi/ /dbugs kyis mchu 'dab dpal ni zil mnan cing / / utpal rna rgyan rnyings pa 'gram pa'i gzhir/ / lhung ba'i dri bsung phyogs la 'god pa bzhin/ /rang gi spyod tshul dang mtshungs g.yo ba'i mig / rig rig bgyis kyang lta ba'i yul bral ba'i/ / khyu nyams nags mthar 'phyan pa'i ri dwags mo/ / yid kyi shes pa skyo ba'i gar la 'jug / 'on kyang zla ba'i sring mos mchog sbyin pa'i/ / rig byed snyan ngag dam pa'i bsil yab dkar/ / dal bu dal bur g.yob 'di sems nyid kyi/ /skyo dub sel ba'i rten du bzang zhing bsil/ /dus 'dir dag pa'i mkha' la rang snang gi/ /skye mched dran pas smin pa'i lang tsho mas/ / phan pa'i snying gtam dang sbyar rdo rje'i glu/ / rgyud

bod kyi phyi dar rtsom rig 325mangs sgra las drangs te 'di skad zer/ / sna tshogs las kyi shing rta zhon pa'i sems/ /rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bur mi 'jigs na/ /lang tshos rdzogs pa'i mngon 'dod yon tan rnams/ / mda' lnga'i cho gas rtsen la cis mi 'jug /gzhon nu'i na tshod 'dzin pa'i mtshar sdug lus/ / gas dang 'chi ba'iganod pas reg min na/ / mthing 'od ral ba'i zur phud mdzes chags pa/ /nyes med spu gris bstol ba ji ltar rigs/ / rin chen rna rgyan 'khrol ba'i 'od ris kyis/ /mun pa'i phyogs las rgyal byed nor bu'i phreng / /lus sems mdzes pa rtag par gtong min na/ /rgyan med sna zhags 'phyang ba ci la 'os/ /'khri shing gzhon nu'i lus phra mig yangs ma'i/ /lang tsho'i myos bum mngon mtho'i nu rgyas zung / / reg pas bsil ba'i lag sor 'bras ldan na/ /dor nas lhung bzed dga' ba ji ltar skye/ / 'chi med bdud rtsi'i kha zas mngar po yis/ / lus kyi padma dar ba'i skal bzang cha/ / dus bzhi 'jig pa'i chom pos mi 'phrog na/ / bsod snyoms tsam gyi 'tsho bar su zhig brten/ /sum rtsen ljon pa las babs bde chen gyi/ /reg bya ster ba kun rtsa linda'i gos/ / 'bral med lus kyi nyer 'tshor rtag 'grogs na/ / sha na'i gos kyi gdung ba ci phyir bzod/ / mdzes ma'i kha yi chang gi dga' ldan pas/ /reg pa bdag gir byed nus pa sku la'i/ /me tog kun dgar chags bde mi 'gog na/ /su zhig tshangs spyod gdung ba don du gnyer/ / gser gyi bgam bzhan ldan phyogs kyi sgor/ / dril chung snyan sgrogs lha yi gzhal med khang / / rtag par longs su spyod pa'i mthu yod na/ / nges med bas mtha'i nags la su zhig sred/ / mdor na lang tsho'i dpal kun mi 'grib cing / /rang yid mdza' ba'i grogs dang mi 'bral bar/ / 'dod la gtan du rol ba'i gdengs yod na/ / dam pa'i spyod la su zhig gus par 'gyur/ /'dod yon dbang bo'i gzhu yi 'khri shing rgyud/ /lus med 'phrul gyis bdungs pa'i

326 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/mda' lnga ba/ / srid pa'i sdug bsngal ster ba'i mtshon cha ste/ / rnam par dpyad na 'jigs pa'i chos nyid can/ / de phyir rang sems glang bo dran shes gyis/ /rnal du 'god pa lcags kyu'i bsgyur stabs 'dis/ / kun rtog nyer zhi'isgom pa drang po'i stabs/ / bsam gtan nags mthar 'god la sems gtod cig /de skad smras pa'i mtha' der mkha' spyod kyi/ /rig 'dzin grub pa'i na chung smin legs ma/ / dran pa'i sems kyi lhag ma bzhag nas kyang / /ltar snang yul ni mi snang dbyings su song / / dus der kun rtog rang mdangs tshon lnga yis/ / legs bris dbang bo'i gzhu yi dpal 'dzin pa'i/ / skal bzang snyan ngag rma bya gdugs mtshar po/ / re zhig sems la bsil ba'i rten du byas/ /ngoms pa med par 'dod pa'i yul kun la/ / 'gyu ba'i rba rlabs 'grems pa yid kyi mtshor/ / dug gsum gdengs can glal ba'i ro 'dzin pa/ / thar 'dod rnams la 'jigs rung gshed ma yin/ / rtsod pa'i 'khor lo rnon po'i gzhan dbang can/ / snyigs ma'i phun tshogs chu shing nags myul bas/ / rang nyid bde bar rloms pa brgya lam na/ / 'dod pa'i 'bras bu grub kyang ya ma brla/ /de slad sdug bsngal rnam mang gar gyi ros/ / sems kyi rkang stabs brel ba'i muñdza skyes/ / 'dus byas rang mtshang blta bas yid brel ba'i/ /shugs ring rlung yab g.yob cing 'phen par byed/ / 'on kyang kun gzhi'i dar dkar ngos yangs la/ / sngon goms bag chags sor rtses bris pa'igazugs/ / legs spyad smon lam tshon brgya'i mdangs gsal ba/ / su zhig gis kyang 'gog pa nus sam ci/ / slar yang lhag bsam shar ri'i phang ba nas/ / gsung 'phrin nyin byed lha mo sgeg ldan ma/ / snying nas mdza' ba'i 'od zer gdu bu'i tshogs/ / 'khrol ba'i sgra snyan dbyangs su len pa thos/ /legs byas chu yi 'khri shing dog pa yi/ / pa tra mgrin par rol ba'i snyan ngag gtam/ /yid 'ong sbya phreng mu tig phon po can/ / ngang ba'i bu mo kun dga'i

bod kyi phyi dar rtsom rig 327do rar ni/ /rnyog pa'i dri ma rab bgrungs rnam dpyod kyi/ /rdzing bu rnam par 'phrul ba'i them skas can/ / rig byed gser gyi padma bzhan pa'i tshal/ /legs par sbyangs pa'i bsung zhim smos su btul/ / grogs dag yid shes dpyid kyi pho nya mo/ /mdza' ba'i nags klung yangs por bag phebs kyang / /'dod dgongs snying bo'i kha zas ma thob pas/ /mgrin pa'i pi wang sbreng ba rna bar snyan/ / sngon med snying gtam ga bur zegs ma yis/ / bsgos pa'i 'phrin yig mngar ba'i ro bro ba/ / ci yang dkar phyogs lha mo'i lag sor gyis/ /dga' mgur stabs pa yid kyi bcud du len/ / bag yod sbrang chang mngar pos snying myos pas/ / rang rang sems kyi do rar mngon 'dod kyi/ /gom pa 'degs 'jog mang ba'i stangs stabs kyang / / re zhig mdzes pa 'gog pa'i zol la brten/ / rig gzhung zab mo'i rdo rje rdul phreng rgyun/ /'dren bzhin dal gyis 'bab pa'i sī ta'i klung / /tshig don g.yas su bskor nas rang blo'i mtshor/ /rba rlabs so dkar 'dzum pa'i 'od snang 'grems/ /dpyadakyin bzang ba'i blo gros sa'i zla ba/ / kun bzod mngal du gab kyang rang bzhin nyid/ /'gyur med 'od kyi thig le mkhar 'god pa/ /sgrib bral dngos po'i che ba yin mod kyang / / las tshul lcags kyi srad bus 'ching ba dang / /lhagacig 'grogs pa'i margan 'dab ldan ma/ /gzhan dbang gzeb kyi snying bor lus bcings pas/ / gcig pu'i sems kyi kun rtog dbyangs su 'byin/ /'dod pa'i chung ma gzhan bzhin yid kyi nor/ /'phrog pa'i chom rkun lhan skyes ri dwags mig / ma 'dris mdza' ba dkar po'i la du zhig /phyogs kyi mgron por phrad skyes yin kyang slar/ /ring nas gnas kyang snying la 'bab pa yi/ / gtam snyan skad kyi rol mos yid bcug pa/ / dbyar skyes 'brug la rma bya'i bu mo bzhin/ / kun dgar rol ba srid na 'ga' 'gar shes/ /byams brtse'i dri bsung rgyas pa'i padma dkar/ /gsung gi gsang bas

328 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin gye ba'i rol mtsho/thos 'dzin nyer sim yang / / khyod sku mngon sum mthong ba 'gog byed pa'i/ /las dbang mun pa'i yol ba 'di ci zhig / sum rtsen tshal dang klu dbang grong mtshungs par/ / gnas kyi bskal bas rtag par khyod zhal gyi/ /padma tshar du dngar der lta 'dod kyang / /lha yi bdud rtsi'i gtam bzhin snyan pa tsam/ /gzhung lugs 'o ma'i rgya mtshor rtsen pas yid/ / cung zad bsil ba'i dngos pos bzung min na/ / mya ngan tsha zer 'bar ba'i gdung byed 'dis/ /'tsho ba'i srog kyang kham zas byed pa snyam/ /'on kyang snying stobs zla 'od dal bu'i rlung / /brten phyir smon lam dag pa'i 'khar ba la/ /rang sems ngal 'tsho'i stegs bu 'gog bzhin du/ / dran pa'i khye'u phyogs der yang yang rgyu/ /rig 'dzin dga' mas brten pa'i nags kyi ljongs/ / ha ri tsan dan 'khri shing rdul tshogs kyis/ / phyogs kun dri bzang khang par bzhan pa'i mtsho/ /mthong ba min kyang yid kyi shes pa 'gul/ / rang sems lta bur gtsang byed lha yi rdzing / /gser gyi padma bzhan pa'i snying bo'i rdul/ /dba' rlabs sor mos legs bris tshangs pa'i mtsho/ / sngo bsangs chu yi lha mo'i gdengs ka bzhin/ /yid 'phrog shel gyi lcag phran rlung bzhin gyis/ / g.yo ldan chags pa'i mig yangs me tog mda'/ / bgrang yas smin legs gzhu yi 'khri shing la/ / drangs te gdul bya'i snying la 'dir bsnun zhig / snyan pa'i nyams brgya ngag gi ku mu dar/ / rjes chags bka' yig ro ldan grub pa'i skyes/ / rnyog bral mos pa'i yid kyi mkha' lam las/ / rgyu skar 'dzum pa'i rlabs bzhin 'phen par mdzod/ /bzang min las dbang mun pa'i gos gyon te/ /'khrul snang khrag la rol ba'i phra men ma'i/ /mngal du 'phyan pa'i lhag bsam zla tshes 'di/ / lha khyod thugs rjes kun nas snang bar mdzod/ / de ltar snying gi padma can rol ba'i/ / lhag bsam ltar dkar 'phrin yig ngang ba'i rgyal/ /gtam snyan mgrin ja brdung ba'i zol bgyis te/ /rang snang lha

bod kyi phyi dar rtsom rig 329yi lam la zhon nas song / / der ni snga ma'i legs byas lhag ma yi/ / sbrang rtsis myos pa'i rnam shes rkang drug pa/ /yul gyi nags mthar rgyu bas thang chad nas/ /rtog tshogs nyer zhi'i dbyings su bde bar gnyid/ /snying gtam shalla ka yi nags kyi dpal/ / dran pas yid kyi glang bo rgyug rtsom dus/ /nyer zhi bsil ldan lcags kyu'i bslab pa yis/ /rnal du 'god thob kha lo bsgyur ba'i drin/ /rang nyid chos dang thar ba'i me long la/ / nye bar sems pa'i ltad mosayid g.yengs kyang / / tshangs pa'i bu mo'i sgra snyan glur len pa/ / dus gzhan zhig na dran pa'i gsos su gyur/ / snyan 'jebs ngag la 'phos pa'i dbyangs bdun gyi/ / dkyil 'khor phang bar 'jogs pa'i rgyud mangs mkhan/ /ro ldan 'khyog pa'i nyams kyi tshig sbyor slad/ / kun rtog gsar ba gsar ba'i gar la 'jug /'dir snang 'dod pa'i snying po ha la'i bcud/ /mngar pos khengs pa'i myong bya'i tshon bkra ba/ / srid pa'i nags klung dpyid dga'i me tog phreng / / bdud rtsir bsgyur te mgrin par cis mi len/ /mngon 'dod sgyu rtsal 'khri shing lding khang du/ /mi phyed phyag rgyas 'khor ba'i bslab pa mkhan/ /dran pa'i pho nya dang po tshu ta'i shing / /'o mas bcu gnyis khyim gyi 'khor lo'i mgon/ / shar ri'i gtsug na dal gyis rgod byed kyang / /mngaraba'i dri ldan padma'i 'dzum zhal las/ / skyugs pa'i rdul dmar 'thung bar des ma spobs/ / de lta na yang rjes chags dmar 'od kyi/ / phyi mig zhags pas grogs la skyed bsrings te/ / dal bus bgrod pas rang gnas chu lha po'i/ / gdengs ka mkha' la bkrams pa'i mal stan 'dzin/ / bral skyo'i mig chus phyin pa'i 'dren byed zung / / byang du lta ba'i ngal ba bsrung slad du/ / rnam pa gsal min 'od kyi rang gzugs shig / bdag gi mdun ngor lam lam 'khor ba snyam/ / de tshe gnyis 'thung dkar po'i lag pa ltar/ /g.yo yangs chu 'dzin lang tsho'i ri mo can/ /phyogs der bgrod pa mthong bas

37 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyusarig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/dran skyes te/ / ngal dub yus kyis brnangs pa'i 'phrin 'di gtam/ / kwa ye tshur shog lus sems bsil byed mkhan/ / nam mkha'i tshal na rgyu ba'i sa bsrung bu/ / rab zhi bdud rtsi'i bcud kyis mngar byas pa'i/ / 'dod dgongs snying po'i 'phrin 'di khyod kyis khyer/ /'khor ba'i khyon ltar yangs pa'i gser gyi snying / / gdung byed tsha bas nyen pa'i mya ngam thang / bzod dka'askyo shas gom pa'i 'degs 'jog gis/ / gzhal ba'i don mthun yid la bde ba ci/ / gya gyu'i yid kyis dga' ba'i nags ljongs su/ / rnam par 'khyams pa'i ngal bas gyid lug cing / /'khyog tshig 'khri shing ngogs la rten 'cha' ba/ /kye ma dbul bo'i rnam thar shin tu mtshar/ / mtshan dus dgung gi mal na rgyu skar gyi/ / phung bo bdud rtsi'i zegs mas lus bkra yang / /'dren byed yul na mi brtan g.yo ba'i gar/ /phyogs kyi 'khor lo'i pha mthar chas pa mthong / /'on kyang smon lam rdo rje'i nyag phran shugs/ / bskyod pas srid pa'i grong gsum mthar byed na/ / rang rang mos ngor mngon par 'du bya ba'i/ /'dod don shes la gzugs bzhin cis mi 'jug /mkha' la spyod pa yongs kyi 'bab stegs su/ / bkod pa'i legs ldan 'bras dkar snye ma'i tshal/ /mtha' yas bcud du len phyir chur sgrogs bu/ / yid kyi smon pa ma shor ngang gis 'bab/ /mgrin sta 'khyog por bskyod pa'i mig yangs zur/ /nan gyis blta bya'i yul la sems 'god kyang / /gzhin nu rtsa yi myu gus gdong bsgribs pa'i/ /zol la nye bar brten pa'i ri dwags mo'i/ / grogs su 'os pa nam zla'i rjes 'gro mkhan/ / 'dod pa'i tā la 'dab phreng shing rta'i rtser/ / gnas pa sbrang rtsi'i dbyangs snyan 'gyur khugs kyis/ / sa la kun dga' ster ba'i pho nyar 'ong / /sngo ljang 'khri shing mdzes ma'i stod kor du/ /me tog phreng tshogs bkram pas yid 'khyor ba/ / brten phyir sen rjes gsar du 'god rtsom pa'i/ /'dab chags gzhon nu snyan pa'i glu sgras khol/ / bag

bod kyi phyi dar rtsom rig 331phebs dpen sa grub pa'i bste gnas mchog /mdzes shing mngon dga' lha yi ri bor ni/ /rig 'dzin dga' mas lag pad kyis btud pa'i/ /rin chen gdub kor sil sil 'khrol rbezhin du/ / rnam pa kun ldan nor bu'i snod yangs su/ /rjes chags bcu drug dga' ba'i bdud rtsi mchog /rang bzhin shes pa'i klong du ro gcig pa'i/ / bde ba chen po'i myos byed longs su spyod/ /dus mthar phung khams nyi zla'i rgyu ba kun/ /kham zas byed pa nang gi sgra gcan 'dzin/ /yid lus phra ba'i 'ja' tshon zol bzung nas/ /srid zhi mnyam par sbyor ba'i dbyings su rtsen/ / tshul der spro ba'i legs smon 'ja' ris kyis/ / mig mang ris su bris pa yid kyi mkhar/ / rgyu ba'i lha gcig gtsug na zla mdzes mas/ /bdag gi snying la nyams brgya'i gar mdzod cig /rnam dpyod zla shel nor bu me long mchog / phyis pa min kyang rtag par rdul bral ba'i/ / gnas lugs bzhin gyi padma 'char ba'i snod/ / rang gi rtogs brjodaganyis pa deng 'dir snang / / tshur mthong blo yi srad bu dang 'tshams par/ / 'phrin yig tshar du dngar ba'i do shal 'dzum/ / blo gsal kun la rab dga'i skyes bzang por/ /sbyin gyi snying la bsil ba'i rten du zungs/ /gang 'dir 'bad pa'i legs byas yar ngo'i zla/ / lhag bsam dkar po'i 'od snang 'dzin pa'i mthu/ /mi nyams gong du 'phel bas srid par yang / /mtho ris yon tan bdun gyis mdzes gyur cig / rig byed g.yas su 'khyil ba mgrin pa'i dung / /gzhom med snyan tshig rdo rje'i sgra dbyangs can/ /chos don dri ma med pa'i ror gcags pas/ /smra ba thams cad don dang ldan gyur cig /lhag pa'i snying stobs mya ngan med pa'i tshal/ /shes bya kun la chags /// pazlo /sna // /shis/ ṭwāṃ 4 sdug zhabs rdul lhung ba'i sku bzhi yi/ / dog pa de ltar rnam pa 'jig rten dang mthun par 'jug pa'i 'phrin yig yid

332 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/kyi ngang mo rnam par rtsen pa zhes bya ba 'di yang / yul la ston kyi snyan ngag mkhan bod mkhas pa mi pham dge legs rnam par rgyal ba'i lhas ji ltar shar ba'i don yi ger bkod pa dge legs su gyur cig /gsum pa/ dbyangasacan ngag gi rolamatsho yid kyi ngang mornam rtsen tshangasapa'i mgrin rgyan rab dga'i rgyud mngasakyi bsamablo'i nang don/de yang snyan ngag 'di nyid kyi bsam blo'i nang don ni/ snyan ngag mkhan gyis 'phrin yig gi tshul dang rnam pa yis 'dod yon longs spyod mi rtag pa'i chos nyid legs par bstan pa dang / 'dod pa'i longs spyod kyi dbang dang khol bo ru gyur pa'i 'jig rten pa rnams la nyams rtogs mthon po'i sgo nas legs nyes spang blang gi gnas lugs zab mo gsungs pa dang / snyan ngag mkhan gyis rang nyid la snyan ngag gi dngos grub bstsal dang stsol bzhin pa'i 'phags ma dbyangs can ma nye bar bsten nas/ rang nyid kyis 'dod yon la tshul ji ltar blta ba sogs 'dod don rnam par gsol ba la/ lha mo dbyangs can mas kyang / 'dod yon dbang bo'i gzhu yi 'khri shing rgyud/ /lus med 'phrul gyis gdungs pa'i mda' lnga ba/ / srid pa'i sdug bsngal ster ba'i mtshon cha ste/ /rnam par dpyad na 'jig pa'i chos nyid can/ /de phyir rang sems glang bo dran shes kyis/ / rnal du 'god la lcags kyu'i bsgyur stabs 'dis/ /kun rtog nyer zhi'i gom pa drang po'i stabs/ /bsam gtan nags su 'gon la sems gtod cig / ces 'dod yon gyi nyes skyon gsungs pas na/ 'khor ba la nges 'byung dang 'dir snang la skyo shas skyes pa dang / lha mo

bod kyi phyi dar rtsom rig 333dbyangs can ma'i zab gsang legs bshad la shes rtogs skyes pa de'o/ /bzhi ba/ dbyangasacan ngag gi rolamatsho yid kyi ngang mornamartsen tshangasapa'i mgrin rgyan rab dga'i rgyud mngasakyisna rtsalakhyad chos/de yang snyan ngag mkhan bod mkhas pa mi pham dge legs rnam rgyal mchog ni rgya gar shar lho'i thun mong gi snyan ngag gzhung lugs sam rtsom srol la kun nas byang zhing rang nyid kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i rtsom rtsal dang rtsom gshis kun nas chags pa'i snyan ngag pa phul du byung ba zhig yin phyir/ khong nyid kyi snyan ngag la khyad du 'phags pa'i sgyu rtsal khyad chos kyis phyug pa yin no/ /1 gzugs rgyan dang rab rtog bsdus brjod dang ting nge 'dzin sogs snyan ngag gi rgyan gyis thog mtha' bar gsum du mdzes par brgyan pas na/ tshig sbyor rmad du byung zhing mdzes sdug ldan pa dang /2 tshig sbyor la lhod bag dang 'jam mnyen ldan pas na/ bklags pa tsam gyis rna bar 'jebs shing yid du 'ong ba dang /2 mdzes pa'i nyams dang brjid pa'i nyams/ spro ba'i nyams dang skyo ba'i nyams sogs snyan ngag gi nyams 'gyur kun nas rdzogs pas na/ yid kyi dbakā bo 'phrog par byed ṭwāṃ dang sems la sim tshor stob par ma zad/ yid la ma sna sdu/ rno // pa/sdo spyizlo /sdo su/ ma tshogs pa'i 'char snang dang shin tu rnoba'i tshor rtog mtshungs pa med pa'i blo spobs dang shugs drag pa'i yid brtse bcas la rnam par brten nas nyid kyi nang gi nyams rtogs rmad byung dpe

dang khyad mtshar nyams kyis phyi ru mngon par mdzad pas na/ dpyod ldan yin kyi mtsho mo'i brtse rlabs 'byo bar mdzad pa dang / blo la zad pa med pa'i bden stobs dang mdzes snang stsol bar byed pa'o/ /

bod kyi phyi dar rtsom rig 335don tshan bzhi ba/ gzhon guzla med0 gtam rgyud/dang po/ rtsomapa po'i lorgyusamador bstan pa/mdo mkhar ba tshe ring dbang rgyal ni bod rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i me glang (spyi lo1697)lor yab ngag dbang tshangs pa dang yum mdang drung gnyis kyisras su byang stag lung du sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo drug nas bcu bzhi'i bar bod kyi yi ge 'bri klog dang rtsis sogs sbyangs/ dgung lo bco lnga ba lcags yos (spyi lo1711)lo nas smin grol gling gi lo tsā ba dharma thi'i drung du snyan ngag dang sdeb sbyor/ rtsis/ sgra mdo dbyangs can ma'i ri mo yongs rdzogs bcas legs par sbyangs pas kun bshad kyi ming du tshangs sras dgyes pa'i blo ldan du btags/ dgung lo bcu bdun pa chu sprul (spyi lo1713)lor skabs de'i bod kyi srid 'dzin pa lha bzang khrang gi drung na spyod pa'i gras su zhugs/ dgung lo bcudagu ba shing lugs (spyi lo1715)lor gzhis ka rtser khral bsdu bar mngags/ khral rtsis zhib cing srid don sgrub par 'jon thang che bas/ dgung lo nyer gcig (spyi lo1717)par gzhis ka rtse'i rdzong dpon du bskos/ sbyi lo 1718la lcags rtse gru gu rdzong gi rdzong dpon gyi 'gan bzung ba dang gzhon nu zla med kyi gtam rgyud 'bri 'go bcoms/ dgung lo nyer drug pa chu stag (spyi lo1722)lor bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi drung 'khor gyi gras su zhugs/ de'i phyi lor gong dkar rdzong gi rdzong dpon gyi 'gan blangs/ rjes su (spyi lo1729)pho lha ba'i las rogs su dza sag tha'i ji'i go gnas dang sprags bka' blon du

3mo bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/bskos/ chu glang (spyi lo1733)lor (mi dbang rtogs brjod brtsams grub byung ba dang skad gnyis shan sbyar nor bu'i do shal bsgrigs/ khong gis lo ngo so gsum gyi ring la bka' blon mdzad de dga' ldan pho brang dang pod 'bangs phan bde'i lam la bkod par nyams pa med pa'i byas rjes bzhag dgung lo re drug pa (spyi lo1762)la rang nyid kyi rtogs pa brjod pa bka' blon rtogs brjod bcoms/ re bdun pa (spyi lo1763)la sku gshegs/gnyisapa/ gzhon nu blomed kyi gtamargyud kyi brjod don mdor bstan pa/de yang sngon rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul nas byang phyogs su sa 'dzin gyi phreng ba rim pa 'ga' 'das pa'i sa na srid pa'i rgyan zhes pa'i rgyal khab cig yod par/ yab rgyal po nyi ma'i blo gros dang yum rna cha 'dzin gnyis kyi sras gzhon nu zla med de na tshod dar la bab nas btsun mo bzhes ran pa'i dus su slebs pa na/ blon po rnams kyis brtag cing dpyad mthar srid pa'i rgyan gyi lho phyogs na gnas pa'i rgyal khab chen po bkod legs 'od snang gi rgyal po'i sras mo yin 'ong ma zhes pa de gzhon nu zla med kyi btsun mor thos pa'i gros kha mthun par gyur/ de nas yab rgyal po nyi ma'i blo gros kyis blon po mtshungs med blo gros ldan la rin thang gzhal du med pa'i skyes dang bcas te bkod legs 'od snang du yid 'ong ma slong ba'i pho nyar mngags/ 'on kyang /bkod legs 'od snang gi rgyal po gsal ldan la rigs sras med pas/ snang ba 'bum ldan zhes pa'i rgyal khab kyi rgyal po zla ba'i blo gros kyi sras lha las phul byungadang yid 'ong ma gnyis mdza' bar byas te rgyal khab phan tshun chab srid

3mo bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/bskos/ chu glang (spyi lo1733)lor (mi dbang rtogs brjod brtsams grub byung ba dang skad gnyis shan sbyar nor bu'i do shal bsgrigs/ khong gis lo ngo so gsum gyi ring la bka' blon mdzad de dga' ldan pho brang dang pod 'bangs phan bde'i lam la bkod par nyams pa med pa'i byas rjes bzhag dgung lo re drug pa (spyi lo1762)la rang nyid kyi rtogs pa brjod pa bka' blon rtogs brjod bcoms/ re bdun pa (spyi lo1763)la sku gshegs/gnyisapa/ gzhon nu blomed kyi gtamargyud kyi brjod don mdor bstan pa/de yang sngon rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul nas byang phyogs su sa 'dzin gyi phreng ba rim pa 'ga' 'das pa'i sa na srid pa'i rgyan zhes pa'i rgyal khab cig yod par/ yab rgyal po nyi ma'i blo gros dang yum rna cha 'dzin gnyis kyi sras gzhon nu zla med de na tshod dar la bab nas btsun mo bzhes ran pa'i dus su slebs pa na/ blon po rnams kyis brtag cing dpyad mthar srid pa'i rgyan gyi lho phyogs na gnas pa'i rgyal khab chen po bkod legs 'od snang gi rgyal po'i sras mo yin 'ong ma zhes pa de gzhon nu zla med kyi btsun mor thos pa'i gros kha mthun par gyur/ de nas yab rgyal po nyi ma'i blo gros kyis blon po mtshungs med blo gros ldan la rin thang gzhal du med pa'i skyes dang bcas te bkod legs 'od snang du yid 'ong ma slong ba'i pho nyar mngags/ 'on kyang /bkod legs 'od snang gi rgyal po gsal ldan la rigs sras med pas/ snang ba 'bum ldan zhes pa'i rgyal khab kyi rgyal po zla ba'i blo gros kyi sras lha las phul byungadang yid 'ong ma gnyis mdza' bar byas te rgyal khab phan tshun chab srid

bod kyi phyi dar rtsom rig 337gcig tu skyong ba'i dam rbeca' sngar nas bkod zin pa'i rkyen gyis srid pa'i rgyan gyi gnyen slong ba'i pho nya ba phyir mi ldog ka med byung / de nas rgyal blon rnams kyis legs par bgros mthar/ gzhon nu zla med dang na tshod mnyam pa'i blon po srid pa gzhin nu zhes pa gzhon nu zla med du brdzus nas 'bangs khol dang bcas bkod legs 'od snang du mngags pa dang / srid pa gzhon nus yid 'ong ma la zur 'phrin bsrings pa la kho mo'ang pho brang gi phyir thon te/gzhon nu zla med dang yun ring 'grogs pa'i skal ba thob chen yab yum la pa/sdo sdong pho chas spras nas srid pa gzhin nu dang mnyam du srid pa'i rgyan du stabasam legs pa zhig la lam bar du snang ba 'bum ldan gyi rgyal pos yin 'ong ma bsu bar mngags pa'i blon po blo rgod thar legs dpung dang bcas par 'phrad cing blon ngan 'bangs khol las gsang ba shor bas g.yul 'gyed byas pa la nyung bas mang sna ma brtan par g.yul pham ste srid pa gzhon nu dang yid thong ma bcas snang ba 'bum ldan gyi yul du khrid/ yin na'ang /yin 'ong mas g.yo zol gyi tshig gis lha las phul byung gi 'dod pa'i me dpung bcil bar byas shing nyin mtshan med par gzhon nu zla med yid la dran pa dang / srid pa gzhon nus rgyal po dang 'bangs rnams kyi mtshon cha med par byas pa sogs snang ba 'bum ldan pham par byed pa'i las mang bo zhig bcoms mtharasrid pa'i rgyan du bros/ de nas gzhon nu zla med kyis snang ba 'bum ldan du drangs pa'i yan lag bzhi ldan gyi dpung tshogs dang 'phrad cing /gzhon nu zla med dang srid pa gzhon nu gtso byas pa'i blon po rnams kyis snang ba 'bum ldan gyi rgyal khab dang g.yul bkye ste pham par byas shing / yid 'ong ma bskyabs nas gzhon nu zla med dang bkra shes pa'i gnyen bsgrigs/de'i tshe na srid pa'i rgyan du yab rgyal po nyi ma'i blo gros ni blon po padma'i

338 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/myu gu'i bu mo mdzes sdug me tog ces pa'i mdzes pa la chags nas der bu byung na rgyal srid du bkod pa'i dam bca' dang bcas btsun mor mngal gsol ba dang / gzhon nu zla med kyis snang ba 'bum ldan gyi rgyal srid re zhig srid pa gzhon nur gtad de yid 'ong ma blon po dang bcas pa rnams srid pa'i rgyan du 'byor nas gnyen nye dgyes 'dzoms kyi dga' ston la rol/ de nas ring bo ma 'gor bar mdzes sdug me tog la rigs sras yid du 'ong ba zhig btsas par ming la dga' ba'i rol mtsho btags/ de nas rgyal bu gzhon nu zla med 'khor ba la nges 'byung dang dam chos la blo kha phyogs nas sbyin pa rgya chen po btang zhing dben pa'i nags su dka' thub spyod pa'i 'dun pa bzlog tu med pa skyes/mthar gzhon nu zla med dang yid 'ong ma/ srid pa gzhon nu bcas kyis nags tshal chen po ru dam pa'i chos don du gnyer ba dang gzhon nu zla med mchog la byang chub sems dpa'i go 'phang brnyes nas phyir srid pa'i rgyan du phebs te rgyal blon skye bo'i tshogs la chos kyi dga' ston 'gyed do/ /gsumapa/ gzhon nu zla med kyi gtam rgyud kyi bsam blo'i rang bzhin/spyir brtsams chos gang zhig yin yang de'i bsam blo'i rang bzhin la dpyad dgos na thog mar rtsom pa po'i lo rgyus dang skabs de'i spyi tshogs kyi gnas tshul shes dgos/ rtsom pa po mdo mkhar ba 'tsho bzhugs kyi dus skabs de ni dbang bsgyur mkhan rnams kyis rtag tu srid dbang 'phrog gnyer gyi ched du 'khrug rtsod bslangs nas bod kyi spyi tshogs zang zing lang long du btang zhing chab 'bangs thams cad la dmag 'khrug gi sdug bsngal tshad med bzo bzhin

byed kyi phyi dar rtsom rig 339pa'i skabs yin/ de yang spyi lo 1705la lha bzang khrang gis sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho dang srid dbang 'phrog rtsod kyis 'khrug rtsod chen po bslangs pa dang /spyi lo 1717la jun gar ba tshe dbang rab brtan dang lha bzang bar khyod shi nga gson gyi dmag 'khrug byung / spyi lo 1720la khang chen pa dang pho lha bas gong ma'idamag gi ram 'degs la brten nas jun gar ba pham par byas te srid bskyangs pa/ sbyi lo 1727par dbus gtsang bka' blon bar gyi 'gal ba dza drag tu gyur te bka' blon nga lum sbyar gsum gyis khang chen pa bkrongs shing pho lha bar ngo rgol byas/ spyi lo 1728lor pho lha bas nga lum sbyar gsum tshar bcad nas bod kyi srid dbang bdag gir bzung ba/ spyi lo 1747la pho lha ba'i sras wang 'gyur med rnam rgyal gyis srid bzung ba nas chin gong mar rgyab 'gal dang rang gi gcen po lkog gsod byas pa sogs 'khrug zing bslangs/de ltar lo ngo sum cu lhag gi snga phyir bod la dbang bsgyur ba'i srid 'dzin mkhan lnga byung ba dang skabs re re'i srid dbang gi 'pho 'gyur de'ang mi shi rta 'gyel gyi ya nga ba'i 'khrug rtsod dang 'brel nas yod pas/ skabs de'i bod kyi sbyi tshogs zang zing lang long du bzos pa dang rgya che ba'i mi dmangs kyi tshe srog la gnod pa dang dpal 'byor la gyong gud tshabs chen thebs pa red/mdo mkhar ba tshe ring dbang rgyal gyis ni de lta bu'i 'khrug zing gi lo rgyus khrod du bod kyi bka' blon gyi 'gan khur ba yin pas mi dmangs kyi sdug bsngal dngadamag 'khrug gi nyes skyon dngos su mthong bar ma zad/ khong nyid rang bzhin bzang zhing rgyud drang ba/ bden don skyong zhing bod 'bangs rnams kyi bde sdug la sems khur byed pa'i bka' blon rnam dag cig yin pas/ dbang bsgyur mkhan 'ga' zhig gis srid dbang 'phrog gnyer gyi ched dang rang gi khe phan gyi chen du rgyun par 'khrug rtsod bslangs te mi dmangs la sdug bsngal dang spyi tshogs la 'khrug rtsod bslangs pa'i tshul de la sems gting nas khong khro skyes

yo0 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/shing zhi/ snan shi ṭwāṃ bye/ ṭwāṃ/ ga/tam rgyud ni de lta bu'i bsam blo la brten nas brtsams pa yin la/ bod kyi lo rgyus steng ches thog mar byung ba'i sgrung gtam ring mo 'di las gzhon nu zla med dang yid 'ong ma gnyis kyi lhan med brtse dung la bsngags brjod dang de gnyis kyi brtse dung la bar chad gtong mkhan zla ba'i blo gros yab sras gnyis kyi rmongs pa'i blo dang tshul min gyi bya spyod la mtshang 'byin byas yod pa dang / ya nga ba'i dmag 'khrug gis bzos pa'i 'bangs mi rnams kyi sdug bsngal gyi 'tsho bar snying rje dang gdung sems tshad med bcangs yod par ma zad/ rtsom pa pos gzhon nu zla med dang yid 'ong ma gnyis kyi brtse dung gi gtam rgyud la brten nas dus rabs bco brgyad pa'i bod kyi 'khrug zing gi lo rgyus de mtshon par byas yod la/ zhi bde dang rang ༵༵༵ blo/ /byen dzī da kyi 'tsho bar re snyeg dang brtson len byed pa'i rmad byung gzhan/ gtam rgyud 'di'i bsam blo'i rang bzhin ni 'khor ba la snying bo med pa dang chos kyi sgrub pa lhur len dgos pa'i chos lugs kyi lta ba khyab bsgrags kyang mdzad yod/ de ltar na/ gtam rgyud kyi phyed snga mar gzhon nu zla med kyis yid 'ong ma 'thob ched dang por 'jig rten lugs srol ltar gnyen slong ba'i pho nya mngags pa dang bar du g.yo sgyu'i sbyor bas 'khrul bar byas pa/ tha mar drag po'i sbyor ba bshams pa sogs ngal ba brgya phrag brten pa dang / gtam rgyud kyi phyed phyi mar gzhin nu zla med 'khor bar yin 'byung skyes te rgyal srid dang yab yum/ rang la mdza' zhing brtse ba'i yin 'ong ma bcas bskyur te nags khrod dben par dam chos don du gnyer bar song ba gnyis mi 'gal lam zhe na/ mi 'gal te/ rtsom pa pos gtam rgyud kyi phyed snga ma bris pa de gtam rgyud kyi phyed phyi mar zhabs 'degs zhu ba'i chen du'am phyed

bodakyiphyinamartsoms tsho4 phyi ma 'bur du thon par byed pa'i ched de/ gzhon nu zla med 'khor bar nges /byung skyes pa nges 'byung rnam dag yin pa gsal bshad byed pa'i chen du yin bzhi ba/ gzhon nu zamed kyi gtam rgyud kyi sgyu rtsalarang bzhin/de yang gtam rgyud 'di nyid kyi tshig gi sdeb sbyor legs shing rgyan phun sum tshogs la/ 'char yan gyi 'du 'god rnam par 'gyu bas mdzes rtog gi tshor ba kun nas bskyed pa dang / gtam rgyud kyi go rim cha tshang zhing byung rim la dza drag gi rang bzhin ldan pa/ yul ljongs zhib 'bri mdzad pa mdzes shing yid du 'ong la gson nyams ldan pa/ mi sna'i cha byad dang / mi sna'i rang gshes thun mong ma yin pa mang bo 'bri bzhings byas yod la/ g.yul gyi rnam pa zhib 'bri mdzad pa ni 'jigs rngam dang ldan pa bcas kyi khyad chos thon yod /pa sdig mkhan gyi yid dbang 'gug cing mdzes rtog gi longs spyod dpal du 'ong bag/cig yul ljongs zhib 'ji mdzad pa marjes sdug ldan zhing yid du gzhon nu zla med kyi gtam rgyud 'dir grong khyer dang pho brang / spang ljongs dang nags tshal/ mtsho rdzing dang lteng ka sogs yul ljongs zhib 'bri mdzad pa mdzes shing yid du 'ong la gson nyams ldan pas klog pa po yul ljongs der dngos su thon pa'i nyams snang khyad mtshar can bskyed thub cing yid kyi dbang bo cig car du 'gugs pa'i sgyu rtsal gyi zhing khams shig tu khrid

mo3 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyusarig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/par ba/bye spyad/ ba/// kāshā /mdun sa nor 'dzin dpal mo'i rgyan du byin pa dang kun nas 'dra ba'i pho brang mtho zhing yangs la lta bas chog mi shes pa yang dag par sbyangs pa'i sa le sbram gyi rgya phub dang / mda' yab dang/ bya 'dab 'od stong 'bar bas phyogs kyi 'khor lo 'gengs pa/ gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan lhab lhub g.yo ba las dpyangs pa'i g.yer dril gyi sgra dbyangs kyis rna ba bdud rtsi'i bang mdzod du byed pa/ de'i phyogs dang phyogs mtshams rnams su skyed mos tshal yid kyi brtan pa 'phrog par byed pa la ni ljon shing gi rim pa sā la dang / sā la shā dang / mya ngan med mchog rgya gro rta dang /gzhan yang 'bras ldan ljon pa dang / 'khri shing gi ra ba tshar du dngar ba chos bzang lha'i dga' tshal zol la 'gon pa/ nye bar gnas pa'i 'dab chags ka la spang ka la sogs pas gre 'gyur snyan dbyangs kyi rol mo bar med du 'khrol ba/ ljongs rnams ni'u gsing rnam par rgyas pas yongs su khebs pa ni tso'i 'dabagashog brkyangs pa lta bu la sna tshogs pa'i kha dog gi bye brag rnam par bkraba'i me tog gi tshom bu ched du bkod pa lta bus mdzes pa/ gzhan yang khrus kyi rdzing bu dang / mtsho dang / mtshe'u la sogs pa yan lag brgyad kyi yon tan gyi spa ba dag kyang phyogs dang phyogs mtshams rnams su mchis pa la skyes pa dar la babs pa dang / bu mo gzhon nu ma rnams khrus dang rtsed 'jos rol ba la sogs pa 'dod pa'i yon tan gyi rtse dga' la longs su spyod pas mdzes par rno sna pa/ srid pa'i rgyan zhes grags dkar gyi ba dan ring nas ring du skyong ba dang /zhesdus da pa'i rgyan gyi pho brang dang khor yug zhib 'bri mdzad pa lta bu nags tshal de'i phyogs shig na dben pa'i gnas su rung ba/ rtswa ljang ne

bod kyi phyi dar rtsom rig yo3tso'i 'dab gshog brkyangs pa lta bus sa gzhi khebs pa/ ljon shing chen po dang / 'khri shing gi ra ba tshar du bkod pa lta bu lo ma me tog dang 'bras bu phun sum tshogs pa bzar rung ba du mas mgo bo dud pa/ shing shun reg pa 'jam zhing rgya che la srab cing yang bas stan dang gyon par rung ba rnams kyi yal ga la chags pa'i 'dab chags ko ki la dang / ka la bang ka dang/ shang shang te'u dang / rma bya dang ni tso la sogs pa brgya stong mang bo mgrin snyan sgrog cing / mdzes pa'i gar gyis rol ba/ skye bo rgyu ba'i 'grul chad cing / sha ra bha dang ru ru dang / lag ldan gyi tshogs bag phebs pa mngon par rgyu ba/'jug ngogs dag tu dri ma med cing gtsang ba'i chu klung gi chab sgra lhung lhung snyan par sgrogs pa/ kho ra khor yug mchog tu yangs shing / 'jing zab mo dang ldan pa mtsho dri bsung can/ zhes bya ba yid du 'ong ba pad ma dang /utpal dang / ku mud dang / pad ma dkar bo la sogs pa dri bsung zhim po rlung bsil bur ldang bas kun nas bskyod par byed pa las/ bung ba gzhin nu rnams snyan pa'i sgra chung ngur dar dir du sgrog pa/ bya ngang ba dang / ngur ba ༵༵ ma/ /ṭī nākā sbyikā / pabazhan dang / mthing ril la sogs pa bag yangs su rgyu 'ozhes gzhon nu zla med kyi dka' thub spyod pa'i gnas zhib 'bri mdzad pa lta/ wa/nyi/kā/ mi sna'i cha byad dang snang brnyan zhib 'bri mdzad par ri mo'i mchos /snatre pa/ bye /mi sna gtso bo dag gi cha byad dang mdzes chas bris pa phra zhing zhib la za 'og thang ga'i zhal yol gsar du phye ba ltar tshon mdangs gsal /byi pa/ spya / pas lda/pe rjikā/ gzugs brnyan mngon sum pa zhig mig lam du

3———54rtsomarigalorgyusarigarjirwagyeba'irol༄ / ———da snag snum li ba'i sku'i zar bu phyed ltas par bcings pa la/ nor bu rin po che mthon ka chen po dang / ind+ra nī la dang / padma ra ga dang / mutta ka dang /byu ru dang / spug la sogs pas 'phra tshoms su spud pas mdzes par byas shing /sku'i lhag ma sil bur grol bas stod kyi cha shas yongs su khebs pa/ dpral ba dbyes che ba zla ba rgyas pa lta bu'i bye brag kha dog mtha' yas pas me tog kha 'bus pa 'i rnam pa can dbyibs legs su brgyus pa'i bar rnams mu tig gi zar tshags kyis mtha' mdzes par byas pa ni legs par dpyangs/ smin ma 'khyog cing ri mor bris pa'i rnam pa yid du 'ong ba ni bung ba'i tshogs ltar gnas bas yid 'gugs shing / rdzi ma stug cing mngon par g.yo ba'i skyibs na utpa la'i 'dab rme rgyas pa'i dbyibs can mig dkyus ring zhing bkra ba ni zur mig khu ba ldan pa 'i rnam 'gyur gyis kun nas mdzes pa dang / sna'i gzengs cung zad mtho zhing gtsang la dbyibs legs pa ni skye bo ma lus 'dud pa'i mchod sdong ltar drang bor gnas/ mkhur tshos nyi ma 'char kha'i mdangs 'dzin pa la chags pas myos pa'i khrag gi ri mo'i thig le ni mdzes par byas la/ban dzi ba ta'i ma dngas 'phrog pa'i mchu sgros rtas tu 'dzum pa'i bar nas rab da ra mu tis tshar du dgod pa'i so'i phreng ba ni thags bzang snyoms par gsal/ dbyibs legs rmad byung thos 'dzin zung la ni rin chen kunda'i phon po lta bu/ gser sayu mu tig gi 'phra tshoms dang 'phyang 'phrul ldan pa/ khyad par 'phags pa'i rna cha mdzes pas ni legs par spras/ mgrin pa sbom phra'i go skabs snyom sa shing / dung ltar 'khyil ba ni rin chen rin thang gzhal du med pa/ ṅka ta la dang / mgad dang/ ind+ra rnyil dang spur len la sogs pa'i do shal mu tig ji 'phyang 'phrul/ rin po che du ma dang ldan pa'i mgul rgyan ni mdzes par dpyangs/ rab dkar 'jam mnyen gzhon sha chags pa'i lag pad la ni rin po che sa le sbram dang khardzu ram la sogs pa'i gdu bu 'phra tshoms

bodakyiphyinamartsomarig ge geyodacan dang / mnyen lhag sor mo'i gdu bu la sogs pa'ang yid du 'ong bar spun/ mdzes sdug gi sgeg chas yongs su rdzogs pa'i lang tsho'i stod cha la ni rab dkar du 3 la'i bla gos srab mos mdzes par bklubs pa las nu ma dkar zlum mtho la mkhrang ba'i dbyibs gsal bar dod pas skye bo 'dod ldan ma lus chags pa'i gdung ba bskyed pa ltar byas/ sked skabs phra zhing sta zur ldem pa la ni dzam bu la ri'i 'og pag dang rin chen du ma'i dra ba dang dra phyed la sogs pa g.yer dril sil khrol gyi sgra dbyangs snyan par sgrogs pa ni go rim nges par byas te spud/ 'jo sgeg rnam 'gyur rmad du byung ba'i lang tsho'i smad cha la ni pañtsa li ga'i smad gos kyis bklubs pa las rab dkar mkhrang la zlum pa'i brla'i 'khri shing gi dbyibs 'char bas chags ldan ma lus 'dod pas smyo ba ltar byed/ byin pa dbyibs sdug cing byin gyis phra ba can bgrod byed zung la ni rin po che'i ma ras mdzes par byas pa las g.yer dril gyi sgra dang bcas te ngang ba'i 'gros ltar gom stabs sgyur bzhin par song nas/zhes gzhon nu zla med dang yid 'ong ma gnyis thog mar 'phrad pa'i skabs kyi yid 'ong ma'i cha byad dang mdzes sdug zhib 'bri byas pa lta bu'o/ /legs kāhā// pa/mi sna'i rang gagis thun mong ma yin pa 'bri bzhengs gang thun mong ma yin pa'i mi sna'i rang gshes 'bri bzhengs byed rgyu ni shin tu gal che ste/ rtsom pa pos mi sna'i rang gshes la brten nas rang nyid kyi dga' skyo chags sdang sogs yid brtse dang bsam blo mtshon par byas/ gzhon nu zla med kyi gtam rgyud 'dir gzhon nu zla med dang lha las phul byung gtso byas pa 'i dkar phyogs dang nag phyogs kyi mi sna mang bo'i rang gshes bzhengs bskrun byas yod/ dper na/ dkar phyogs kyi mi sna gzhon nu zla med ni dpa 'a 'ing rtul phod pa/ shes rab ldan la blo gros kyi 'jug pa yangs pa/ ya rabs spyod

yo6 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/tshul dang ldan zhing byams snying rje'i bdag nyid can gyi skyes bu dam pa zhig tu 'bri bzhengs byas yod pa dang / yid 'ong ma ni skye gzugs mdzes la bud med mdzangs ma'i yon tan dang ldan zhing blo rig gsal ba/ 'gyur ba med pa'i 'chang ba'i bud med cig tu 'bri bzhengs byas yod la/ srid pa gzhon nu ni 'jigs med dpa' bo'i brtul zhugs 'dzin zhing thabs la mkhas pa//sna tram̐ ṭwāṃ ༵༵ snamapa ya/ /sdo 3 zhing blo sems dkar ba'i blon po zhig tu 'bri nag phyogs kyi mi zlo la/ 'bangs khol ni blo gros kyi 'jug pa dman la sdar ma'i rang bzhin can dang / padma'i myu gu ni 'don ham dang g.yo sgyu'i bdag nyid can/ lha las phul byung ni 'jig rten gyi bya ba'i rnam bzhag la shin tu rmongs shing las 'bras la yin mi rton pa/ byams dang snying rje mi ldan par gsod pa dang deg pa/ 'ching ba la sogs pa'i mi dge ba'i las la bag med du spyod pa'i mi tha shal ba zhig tu 'bri bzhings byas yod pa lta bu'o/ /bzhi/ g.yul 'gyed pa'i rnam pa zhib 'khrimadzad pa/par zhi/ /rnyi sdi / lda trī sdo rnyi gswārdo drind pa'i rnam pa 'jigs jam dang ldan cang shes mgyogs 'gro yongs su ngal ba med pa dang / / sna rtser g.yul gyi mtshon cha 'dzin pa shugs drag can/ / glang bo dang ni stobs ldan shing rta'i 'phrul 'khor bskor/ /'jigs med gtum drag skyes bu dpag yas khro gnyer tshogs/ /smin mtshams bar bsdus ha ha'i gad rgyangs mthon por sgrogs/ /mtshon cha'i bye brag ral gri mdung thung dgra sta dang / / tho ba lcags kyo lcags sduda' dang nā mda'aboche/ji/ zhaswās pa la sogs thogās pa de rnamapa rgyu pa'i byer/ sna/sdu /la // // makā kās me sdo dī trī kār nas garna ba snyam/ / rjod byung

bod kyi phyi dar rtsom rig 347shā paX /dri /bo shing rtar bcas/ /'thab pa'i sgra yis sa gzhi yang / /'dar zhing g.yo ba'i nyams dang ldan/ / nyag phran bsnun pa'i sbyor ba yis/ / phan tshun skye bo go cha dang / / cod pan bzhin pa la sogs pa/ /'gyel zhing shin tu mi sdug gyur/ / zhags pas mgrin pa bcings gyur cing / / lcags kyos gnya' ba nas bzung ba/ / de dag rnams ni dud 'gro ltar/ /khyi bzhin 'brang ba'i brtul zhugs blangs/ /khrag gis dmar ba'i sa gzhi ni/ / gshin rje'i tshal ltar rgyas pa la/ / mgo dang lag pa rkang ba bcas/ / dum bur byas pa'i bam ro yis/ / rgyu ba'i lam yang dog por byas/ /dpa' bo dag gi go cha yang / /dpung ba'i bar brjes lag pa na/ /khrag sbags mtshon cha thogs nas ni/ / mche ba rab gtsigs khro gnyer can/ / 'jigs med ha ha'i gad rgyangs ni/ / sgrogs pas nyam chung snying 'gas bzhin/ / rab drag dpung gi sbyor ba yis/ / sa gzhi rdul gyis dkrigs gyur te/ / nyi ma'i snang ba pham par byas/ / phyogs kun 'jigs rung mu/ zlo ṭā trī rdzu/sa rna/ma par mtshon no/ /

348 wabodakyirtsomarig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/don tshan lnga ba/ chu shing gi bstan bcos/dang po/ rtsomapa bo'i lorgyusamador bstan pa/rtsom pa po gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me ni bod rab byung bcu gsum pa'i chu rta (spyi lo1762)lor mdo smad shar lho'i mdzod dge zhes pa'i yul du yab lcags po byams dang yum bo chog gnyis kyi sras su sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo bdun par khri chen dge 'dun phun tshogs kyi sku skye ru ngos bzung / 'jam dbyangs ba'ad pa sku phreng gnyis pa kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang bo las rab tu byung / dgung lo bcu bdun (spyi lo1778)gyi steng dbus su phebs te 'bras spungs sgo mang gi chos grwar zhugs/ hor skal bzang dngos grub dge rgan du bsten nas dbu ma dang mdzod/ 'dul ba gsan sbyong gtso bor mdzad nasagazhung bka' pod lnga la brdar sha chod par gyur/ dgung lo nyer gnyis steng dge bshes lha rams pa'i mtshan btags blangs/ dgung lo nyer lnga ba me rta (spyi lo1786)lor rang yul mdo smad bkra shes 'khyil du phebs/ dgung lo sum cu bzhes pa'i skabs chos sde chen po bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi gdan khrir byi tta kārnyi/ garshanā dī ṭwāṃ / /nyis pa (spyi lo1823)la sku gshegs/ gsung 'bum

bod kyi phyi dar rtsom rig yo9gnyisapa/ chu shing bstan bcosakyi brjod don/de yang chu shing gi bstan bcos zhes pa ni legs par bshad pa chu'i bstan bcos lugs gnyis rlabs phreng brgya ldan dang / legs par bshad pa shing gi bstan bcos lugs gnyis rlabs phreng brgya ldan zhes pa gnyis kyi bsdusatshig yin te/ chu'i bstan bcos la sho lo ka brgya dang so dgu yod pa )tā ba/ ༵ rno / zlos/ /cos la sho lo ka brgya dang drug ste khyon bsdoms sho lo ka des na/ chu shing gi bstan bcos kyi brjod don ni chu dang shing gi rtsa ba'i khyad chos sam chos nyid de brjod bde la go sla ba'i dpe ru sbyar te dam pa'i chos dang legs lam du rnam par skul cing legs nyes blang dor la mi rmongs pa'i zhal gdams mdzad pa gtsor byas nas/ dbang sgyur mkhan nam srid 'dzin pa khag cig gi tshul dang mi mthun pa'i bya spyod la mtshang 'byin dang /sdu /don byas te mi dmangs kyi dka' sdug la gdung sems bcangs yod pa gcig 'khor ba la snying bo med pas dkon mchog la skyabs su re dgos pa dang / las 'bras mi bsru ba yin pa bstan pa/ dper na/rnam bkra srid pa'i 'khor lo 'dir/ / don ldan snying bo 'ga' ma mchis/ces/shā /dro rlon pa'i sdong bo la/ /rtse rting kun na snying bo med/ /'jigs chen de las skyob pa'i skyabs/ / sru med dkon mchog gsum las med/ / chu bo'i rgyun gyis khyer ba de/ / sgrol byed mnyan pa kho nar

ngeX30 bodakyirtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho//sna // byen/ gyi myu gu las/ /'bras bu 'chol ba 'gar yang med/ /bye/ dang mi dge'i las las kyang / / 'bras bu gzhan 'byung gnas ma /lha/ lta /sbya /bo /ngan pa'am dbang sgyur mkhan khag cig gi ngan spyod ther 'don byas pa/ dper na/rgyal ngan 'bangs kyi zas nor kun/ /'phrogs kyang da dung ltogs shing sdu//sa/ / rgod ma kha yis rgya mtsho'i chu/ / 'thungs kyin rtag tu 'bar dang /rdzu kā ༷rsha / pa rtag bkur yang / / gsug dang bral ba tsam gyis /dro / / chu bo nyin zhag mang bskol kyang / / me dang bral ba'i mod la /pa ṭwāṃ ṭwāṃ trī / bar gnas pa'i mi/ / nyin mtshan kun tu bag phebs ༵༵ /gzi///tso bo ngan pa'i g.yog 'khor yang / / rtag tu sems khral gdung /lha rdo // /gan/sa shes bya'i gnas la brtson 'grus skyed dgos pa bstan zlos/ bye/ ga/spyan/ pa ma btang na/ / 'bras dus yon tan thams cad skye/ /rtsa ba rlon dang ma bral na/ /rtse mor lo 'bras smin par 'gyur/ /

bod kyi phyi dar rtsom rig 351zhes pa dang / rgyun chags brtson pa ma btang na/ / bags kyis sdu/ dīkā shā / sdu/ zlogrub/ /chu bo dal gyis 'bab pa yis/ /yangs pa'i sa tā/ lta/ sdong/ po slob bka' ba/ /shes bzhin med na nyams pa sla/ /tā //sa bsdu// sna/ 'o'agengs dka' yang / /bor na cig car nyid du gsumapa/ chu shing bstanabacosakyi rtsomastangasakhyad chos/rtsom pa po gung thang bstan pa'i sgron mes chu shing bstan bcos ni sa skya'i legs bshad ltar brtsams pa yin par bshad kyang / chu shing bstan bcos la sa skya'i legs bshad dang mi mthun pa'i rtsom stangs khyad chos khyad du 'phags pa zhig yod pa ni/ rtsom pa pos chu shing bstan bcos kyi mgo nas mjug bar/ chu dang shing gnyis la dpe blangs nas brjod par bya ba'i yul te/bstod pa dang bsngags brjod byed yul/ slob gso dang skul 'ded byed yul/dgag rgyag dang mtshang 'byin byed yul sogs/ gson nyams ldan zhing bden lugs yod pa'i sgo nas mngon par bstan pa de yin no/ /dper na/mkhas pa yon tan kun ldan de/ / rlom sems med par zhi zhing dul/ /snye ma'i khur gyis brjid pa yi/ /ljon pa'i rtse mo dud de gnas/ /zhes pa lta bur mtshon na/ 'bras bu'i khur gyis kun nas ljid pa'i ljon shing gi rtse mo mkha' la ma rengs bar sa la dud de gnas pa bzhin du/ mkhas pa rnams la bcu phrag rig pa'i yon tan ldan pas/ nam yin yang nga'o snyam pa'i khengs dregs dang rlom sems med par rtag tu spyod lam mdzes shing

—352 bodakyirtsomarigalorgyusariga'0byeba'irolamatsho/sems pa zhi zhing dul bar gnas pa yin no zhes snye ma'i khur gyis dud pa'i byinā hārsha bye // /sta sna /kā nas ༵༵/dri dro/ yul mkhas pa dpe can gyi khyad rje dpon gsar tshe byams byed kyang / /phyi nas bsgrub dka'i dpya khral ༵༵༵sa/ /shing la char skyob byed mod kyang / /rjes su thigs 'phreng lci bar zhes pa lta bur mtshon na/ char 'bab pa'i tshe na/ mi rnams kyis yal 'dab rnam par brkyangs pa'i ljon shing la char skyobs byed mod kyang / cang mi 'gor bar yal 'dab kyi gseb nas che zhing lci ba'i chu'i thigs pa phreng thag chad pa ltar 'bab pa de bzhin du/ rje dpon gsar du go sar 'gying ba'i tshe tshul 'chos kyi 'dzum mdangs gdong la gyon jing yag 'jam gyi skad cha kha nas bshad kyin/ mnga' 'bangs la byams khul dang brtse khul byed na'ang / cang mi 'gor ba'i rjes su/ btsan zhing bsgrub par dka' ba'i rnam mang dpya khral gyis kun nas gdung zhing mnar gcod la sbyor bar byed pa yin no zhes char /kāsna dzhai /sna // /sna sami/ra pa/ / nā /nga dpe la bzhag nas dpe can rje mdor na/ chu shing bstan bcos kyis ni/ bden la yid ches dang rdzun la sun 'byin/ bzang bo rgyun 'dzin dang ngan pa 'dor spong / shes bya la rtog zhib dang yon tan la brtsi bkur/ btsan shed la mgo gnon dang gnyom chung la ze 'then/ rgan pa la bkur bste dang gzhon pa la byams skyong / rnam kā dīkā /kā / lha spong dgos tshul sogs ya rabs sngon thon gyi bsam blo rgya chen

3—— da — nged༄phyinamartsomarig 3yodadon tshan drug pa/ gtam bad ma'i tshal gyi zlos gar/dang po/ rtsomapa po'i lorgyusamador bstan pa/de yang lha chos dang mthun pa'i gtam padma'i tshal gyi zlos gar zhes pa'i rtsom pa po ni dpal sprul 'jigs med chos kyi dbang bo yin la/ khong ni rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i sa 'brug (spyi lo1808)lor chab mdo rdzong khongs rdza stod du sku 'khrungs/ dpal dge bsam gtan phun tshogs kyi yang sprul du ngos 'dzin byas nas mtshan 'jigs med dbang bor btags/ gzhon nu'i dus nas sde dge rdzogs chen du slob gnyer mdzad/ de nas dpal spungs dgon gyi bshad grwar zhugs/ mkhan chen bkra shes 'od zer gyi zhabs la gtugs te gzhung bka' pod lnga dang sgra rig pa sogs la gsan sbyangs dpyis phyin par mdzad/dgung grangs bzhi bcu tsam ma phebs bar du gdan sa der bzhugs te gdul bya bskyangs/ de nas rdza stod rin chen brag sogs dben gnas nges med du bya bral gyi sgrub pa lhur bzhes mdzad/ khrid yig kun bzang bla ma'i zhal lung dang gtam padma'i tshal gyi zlos gar sogs gsung rtsom pod bdun tsam mdzad/rab byung bco lnga ba'i me phag (spyi lo1887)lor sku gshegs/

354 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/gnyisapa/ snyan rtsoma'adi'i brjod don dngabasamablo'i rang bzhin/deyang padma spungs pa'i skyed tshal zhes bya ba ljon shing gi ra bas bskor ba'i spang ljongs me long gi ngos ltar mnyam pa na padma rgyas pa'i tshal yod pa dang / de ru bung ba'i tshogs du ma 'phur lding g.yo zhing rtse ba/ khyad par du yang gsor gyi sbrang chung pad ma'i 'dab yangs zhes bya ba dang / g.yu'i srung chung padma'i ngag snyan zhes bya ba'i khyo khug gnyis kyang gnas te/ gser gyi sbrang ma de ni na tshod gzhon pa/ lang tsho dar ba/ shes rab gsal ba/ blo khog yangs pa/ gsar 'grogs med pa/ rgyu ba lhod pa/ gtong la dga' ba yin no/ /g.yu zing yang gtong phod che ba/ phan sems ldan pa/ ngang rgyud 'jam pa/ chos la dkar ba/ g.yo sgyu med pa/ phrag dog dang mig ser chung ba yin no/ / de gnyis drang srong don kun grub pa'i zhabs la gtugs nas chos la legs par gsan rjes/ spyod lam phal cher drang srong gi bka' bzhin du bsgrubs la/ res 'ga' ni bag med pa'i rtsed mo ni rtse zhing 'dod pa'i yul la chags te ring zhig 'das pa'i tshe/ ngag snyan gyis me tog gi zil mngar 'byung zhing / 'dab yangs kyis nam mkha' la 'phur lding g.yo ba'i skabs shig nyi ma'i mdangs 'od glo bur du nyams nas/ sprin nag gi sgrub ma sa la lhung ste pad mo rnams cig car du kha zum pas ngag snyan pad ma'i spubs su 'thums nas dbugs 'thums te 'jigs shing dngangs nas gtam brjod ma nus par bub bub bub zer zhing 'dug pa na/ 'dab yangs kyang 'jigs shing skrag ste ci bya gtol med par gyur nas pad ljon gyi drung du sa la babs

354 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/gnyisapa/ snyan rtsoma'adi'i brjod don dngabasamablo'i rang bzhin/deyang padma spungs pa'i skyed tshal zhes bya ba ljon shing gi ra bas bskor ba'i spang ljongs me long gi ngos ltar mnyam pa na padma rgyas pa'i tshal yod pa dang / de ru bung ba'i tshogs du ma 'phur lding g.yo zhing rtse ba/ khyad par du yang gsor gyi sbrang chung pad ma'i 'dab yangs zhes bya ba dang / g.yu'i srung chung padma'i ngag snyan zhes bya ba'i khyo khug gnyis kyang gnas te/ gser gyi sbrang ma de ni na tshod gzhon pa/ lang tsho dar ba/ shes rab gsal ba/ blo khog yangs pa/ gsar 'grogs med pa/ rgyu ba lhod pa/ gtong la dga' ba yin no/ /g.yu zing yang gtong phod che ba/ phan sems ldan pa/ ngang rgyud 'jam pa/ chos la dkar ba/ g.yo sgyu med pa/ phrag dog dang mig ser chung ba yin no/ / de gnyis drang srong don kun grub pa'i zhabs la gtugs nas chos la legs par gsan rjes/ spyod lam phal cher drang srong gi bka' bzhin du bsgrubs la/ res 'ga' ni bag med pa'i rtsed mo ni rtse zhing 'dod pa'i yul la chags te ring zhig 'das pa'i tshe/ ngag snyan gyis me tog gi zil mngar 'byung zhing / 'dab yangs kyis nam mkha' la 'phur lding g.yo ba'i skabs shig nyi ma'i mdangs 'od glo bur du nyams nas/ sprin nag gi sgrub ma sa la lhung ste pad mo rnams cig car du kha zum pas ngag snyan pad ma'i spubs su 'thums nas dbugs 'thums te 'jigs shing dngangs nas gtam brjod ma nus par bub bub bub zer zhing 'dug pa na/ 'dab yangs kyang 'jigs shing skrag ste ci bya gtol med par gyur nas pad ljon gyi drung du sa la babs

bod kyi phyi dar rtsom rig 355nas mya ngan gyi gdung bas snying la non te sa la 'gre ldog byed cing smre ngag bton nas 'dab chags dang ri dwags la skyabs bcol skabs/ rlung ni 'ur 'ur ldang ba dang 'brug sgra ldir ldir grag nas ser ba shag shag bab ste phyogs mtshams kun tu sha 'od brdol nas pad ma'i tshal ni rnam par bcom byung /char babs rjes nam mkha' dngas shing / padma rnams kyis slar yang 'dab ma brkyangs byung / g.yu sbrang ni padma'i ge sar khrod na shi ba mthong rjes gser sbrang sdug bsngal gyis gdung bar gyur pa dang / padma dgyes pa'i zhabs la gtugs nas chos la gsan pas/ 'khor ba ni sdug bsngal gyi gzhi ma dang //chi ba nam 'ongasdu sbya med yi/ pa kāng / phun tshogs ni mi rtag sgyu ma yin pa :sa na/ pro sna parnyi rdo trī ༵ /sdo rnyi sdo bye/ ba/sam blo'i rang bzhin ni/ khyo shug tu gyur pa'i gser sbrang dang g.yu sbrang gnyis kyi skyid sdug 'du 'bral gyi gtam rgyud la brten nas/ 'dus byas snying bo med cing 'dod yon mi rtag pa yin pas cis kyang dam pa'i chos don du gnyer na tshe 'di phyi gnyis gar sman zhing thar ba dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang brnyes pa yin pa de bstan la/chos sgor zhugs pa'i sngon 'gro'i rim pa dang / chos dang chos min gyi dbye ba // kā shāng mngon par bstan yod pa yin te/ de la/ drang srong don kun e ma 'khrul snang 'khor ba'i 'jig rten pa/ /'dus byas snying bo med la rtag par 'dzin/ / phyi snod snod kyi 'byung ba'i khams mi rtag / nang bcud skye 'gro sems can tshe mi rtag / bar du dus bzhi nam zla'i dpal mi rtag /rgyal dang de sras dam pa'i skyes bu yang / /mi rtag mya ngan 'da' tshul ston la gzigs/ / srid na che ba'i tshangs dbang skye dgu'i bdag / 'chi bdag zhags pas 'debs pa lta ci smos/ / su la'ang nam 'chi 'dir 'chi'i

356 bodakyirtso marigalorgyusariga'adzin ba'irolamatsho/ —nges pa med/ /'chi ba'i rkyen mang 'tsho rkyen nyung ba zhig /des na myur du chos lam ma gnyer na/ /'chi bdag nam 'ong cha med 'gro ba kun/ /'chi nges bshas rar tshud pa'i dud 'gro bzhin/ /e ma shi nas med du mi 'gro ste/ /'gro zhing 'khor ba'i gnas 'dir skye ba yin/ /zhes gsungs pa yis mtshon par nus so snyam/gsumapa/ snyanartsoma'adi'i sgyu rtsalagyi rang bzhin/snyan rtsom 'di'i rjod byed kyi tshig la snyan ngag gi rgyan dang mngon brjod brda rnying gis ma bcings par go sla zhing rtogs sla ba dang / brjod bde zhing nyams 'gyur ldan pa zhig yin pa dang / rdo chag btsan bsgrigs lta bu'i tshig sbyor min par rab dkar mu tig bstar la brgyus pa lta bu'i sdeb sbyor yin pas/nga tshos cis kyang slob sbyong byed pa'i ma dpe bla na med pa zhig red ces mtha' gcig tu bshad par spobs/ de la dper mtshon tsam bkod na/kye kye yid 'ong gzhon pa'i lang tsho/ /phun tshogs byed po'i pir gyis ma bris/ /legs byas sgyu ma'i 'phrul gyis bzhengs pa/ /lha yul lha la 'gran yang phod dam/ /dpal 'byor longs spyod rang gis ma bsags/ /'di na bkod pa sngon gyi las dbang / /me tog stan 'jam thags su ma btags/ /reg 'jam dang po rang gi nyer sbyad/ /ge sar zil mngar g.yo bskol ma byas/ /ro brgya'i btung ba 'chi med bdud rtsi/ /bde skyid dpal 'di 'bad pas ma yin/ /shugs kyis grub pa sngon bsags bsod nams/ /rang sems bsam blo chos la bkol na/ /dal 'byor lus kyang btags na chog gi /smra shes don go sdig sbyong sgrub pa'i/ /rkang gnyis gzhan la yid smon ma

ca bod kyi phyi dar rtsom rig 357dgos/ / kye kye gson dang yid thong snying sdug / 'di na me tog skyed tshal mdzes mdzes/ / zil mngar bdud rtsi'i ro bcud mang mang / / skad mthun bung ba'i khyu tshogs mang mang / / dbyar zla'i dpal 'di yud tsam yud tsam/dma/'chi basbya rkyen mang glo buswā / sduranye/ / bahā sdug /gyur ba skuspya ci/ /sdo ṭwāṃ // ///sdo // pa/ shā ṭwāṃ nga dbo rte tre /ga/ //0da 'a da ngang la — 'a shā/sdu ṭwāṃ ṭā /zlo so/ snying sdug khyod bden/ / bden no bden no yid 'dzin snying gtam/ /snying gtam snying gi bcud du btab pa/ /snying la 'chi med bdud rtsi de lags/ /lha yul ljongs nas 'di ru ma bos/ /mi yul yid 'ong me tog skyed tshal/ / skal bzang yid mthun bung bu'i longs spyod/ /rab dga' sbyin pa sngon gyi las dbang / / mdzes kyang mi rtag 'khor ba'i mtshan nyid/ / 'byor kyang mi rtag sgyu ma'i longs spyod/ / spyad kyang mi ngom 'dod yon bsru brid/ / snying bo med pa 'khor ba'i gnas lugs/ / khyed kyang sems la go cha gyon dang / / ngas kyang snying la ri mo bri yis/ / thag chod gros la 'gyur ba ci yod/ / skal bzang yid mthun chos lam snyegs 'gro/ /bsags pa'i nor la snying bo mi 'dug / 'bad pas btsal kyang gzhan gyis longs spyod/ /bskyangs pa'i 'khor la snying bo mi 'dug /brtse bas bskyangs kyang dgra yi g.yab mo/ / brtsegs pa'i mkhar la snying bo mi 'dug / phan par sems kyang srog gcod rbab rgod/ / rmos pa'i zhing la snying bo mi 'dugazhes/dīttabye / brtsi yang 'bu srin bshan khang / /

358 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/don tshan bdun pa/ rgyal po lugs kyi bstan bcos/dang po/ rtsomapa po'i lorgyusamador bstan pa/rgyal po lugs kyi bstan bcos sa gzhi skyong ba'i rgyan zhes pa'i rtsom pa po ni 'ju mi pham 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal rgya mtsho zhes mtshan snyan yongs su grags pa'i mkhas pa'i dbang bo de yin zhing / khong bod rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i me pho rta'i lor (spyi lo1846)dkar mdzes bod rigs rang skyong khul sde dge rdzong ya chu'i deng chung sa char sku bltams/ bod rab byung bco lnga ba'i chu pho byi ba'i lor (spyi lo1912)sku gshegs/ bla ma 'di'i gdung rgyud ni thog mar 'od gsal lha nas mched par bshad cing / gnam gyi dmu thag la 'jus nas mi yul du babs pa yin no zhes 'ju zhes pa'i tha snyad mtshan gyi thog mar sbyar ba yin zer/ 'ju mi pham sku na chung ngu'i dus nas rig pa bkra zhing shes yon la brtson sems che ba dang / dgung lo bcu gnyis steng khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung ngo / / rjes su dbus phyogs su gnas skor du phebs te mkhas pa gang mang legs par bsten nas slob gnyer mdzad pa dang / khyad par du 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang bo'i zhabs kyi padmo sbyi bo'i rgyan du blangs te/ mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i zab mo gzhung lugs rgya mtsho lta sdokā gsan sbyong gang /gas ma~Xd nasdu /zhu/lu/saraba'abyams smra rdzu hā spras bye /sdu /gāswā trī dī/kāsna ༵ rte kā pa' sang ba na du bag yangs su

bod kyi phyi dar rtsom rig 359'ju mi pham gyi gsung 'bum nang du mdo phyogs dang gsang sngags kyi gzhung / sgra dang tshad ma/ snyan ngag dang gso ba rig pa/ bzo rig pa dang rtsis gzhung sogs mchis shing bstan bcos khyon bsdoms pon sum cu so gnyis brtsams/ de dag ni brjod bya'i don legs shing tshig sbyor mdzes la nyams 'gyur ldan pa/ lung dang rigs pas legs par spras shing / dgongs don rgya che la gting zab pa bcas yin pas/ gangs can bod kyi rig gnas bang mdzod khrod kyi rin thang che ba'i nor bu'i phreng bar 'khums so/ /rgyal po lugs kyi bstan bcos gzhi skyong ba'i rgyan zhes pa'i legs bshad kyi bstan rsharsharsha 'di nyid ni khong gis sbyi lo 1895la bcoms nas legs par grub pa gnyisapa/ rgyalaXlugasakyi bstanabacosakyi brjod don dang bsamablo'i rang bzhin/le'u nyer gcig gis grub pa'i legs bshad kyi bstan bcos 'di'i brjodadon gtso bo ni/ sa gzhi skyong ba'i rgyal pos khrims lugs bden drang gisaskyong dgos pa dang mkhas blun mi 'dzol bar byed dgos pa/ srid don yang dag par thag gcod dgos pa dang 'bangs rnams chos bzhin skyong dgos pa/ legs nyes kyi dbye ba legs por 'byed dgos pa dang blang dor gyi gnas la mi rmongs shing / las don yod rgu phyin ci ma log par spyad nas/yul 'khor ram rgyal 'bangs/ rgyal srid chos bzhin skyong dgos pa la sogs shā /sdu pa/lda pa/ sbyikā nan gyis bstan pa de yin no/ /de yang rnam pa bzhi'i

tshom ge — sdodasdi rtsom — rigalorgyus riga'adzinabyeba'irolamatsho/ da wagacig rgyal po ngan pa'i bya spyod la zur za dang mtshang 'byin byas nas/sa gzhi skyong ba'i rgyal po ni blo gros ldan la ya rabs dam pa'i spyod tshul gyis mdzes pa'i mi zhig yin dgos pa'i dgongs pa bstan pa ni/ dper na/dbang dang 'byor ba ldan pa yi/ / rgyal rigs phal cher bag med pas/ /myos pa'i glang chen bzhin du 'khyams/ /de yi 'khor kyang de 'drar 'gyur/ /rgyal po nor la bskams gyur na/ /nor gyis rgyal khrims bsru bar rtsom/ /mi bdag g.yem la dga' gyur na/ /'phyon ma'i tshogs rnams mgo 'phang mtho/ /nyi ma lhun po sa gzhi dang / /chu gter lta bur bsngags 'os pa'i/ /mi bdag gang na gnas pa yi/ /'khor gyi skye bo nyer 'tsho'i gzhi/ /sa bdag blo gros ldan pa rnams/ /ya rabs lugs la shin tu mos/ /'od zer storno /zlo // sdo byi/ /nyi ma 'jig rten 'di na mdzes/ /gnyis/ jo gros dang yon tan med pa'i rgyal po la rgyal srid legs par skyong pa'i nus shugs dang mthu stobs med stabs/ mkhas pa nye bar bsten nas rig pa'i gnas la brtson dgos pa'i dgongs pa bstan pa ni/ dper na/brtson pa med la yon tan med/ / yon tan med na dpal 'byor la/ /re sgug byed pa 'bras med de/ /dgun gyi ljon shing ji bzhin no/ /shes rab med na 'byor ba sogs/ / yod kyang dgra yi gsos su 'gro/ /stobasadang ldan yang gzhan dbang 'gyur/ / lcags kyus glang chen bkol ba 'dra/ / mi yi bdag po mchog rnams kyis/ / lugs dang lugs min shes pa'i slad/ / sna tshogs bstan bcos bslab bya zhing / / yon tan can la bsten par bya/ /yon tan bslab pa'i dus nyid nas/ /che tshugs spangs te byā sna nab//la/ / dam pa rnams la bsten byas na/ / yon tan dbyar gyi chu

bod kyi phyi dar rtsom rig 36 de//sdu lta ༵ rsharsha skyo/ nga ba'i rgyal pos btsan dbang dang gdug tsub kyis mnga' 'bangs sdug bsngal la mi sbyor bar byams brtse dang snying rje bcangs /sdu/ra sna/na bde'i dpal gyis skyong dgos pa'i dgongs pa bstan pa ni rtsod pa'i dus kyi rgyal ngan rnams/ /'khor gyi phun tshogs mthong gyur na/ /sems la zug rngu skye ba ni/ /'chi ltas bzhin tu phyin ci log /snying rje med cing dug ldan pa'i/ /ma la'ang bu ni 'bros byed na/ /'khor gyi skye bo smos ci dgos/ / 'khor rnams 'grib na rgyal po dma'/ / gang la byams pa'i sems kyi dpal gnas pa/ / bsod nams stobs kyis lha rnams dgar gyuranas/ / mi ma yin pa rnams kyang srung byed na/ / mi yi skye bo'i tshogs rnamasatsās ci dgos/ /mi bdag snying rje ldan pa'i yul khams su/ / rnam mang 'byor ba dbyar gyi chu ltar 'phel/ /pha rol dpung gi tshogs kyis mi brdzi zhing /zhe/tram̐ // //dri rnams dga' bas phag phebs gyur/ /bzhi/ mi zlo bdag po rgyal pos bya ba ci zhig sgrub na'ang thog mar rnam dpyod dang ldan pa'i sgo nas gros bsdur byed dgos pa las/ 'ol tshod dang ci 'dodakyis bsgrubs pa'i las la mjug 'bras ci yang mi yong ba bstan pa ni/dper na/ legs par brtag dpyad ma byas na/ /smras pa 'ga' las nyes pa 'byung / / khyu mchog dang ni seng ge gnyis/ / shin tu mthun pa wa yis brlag /nam phugs rang don ma gzhal bar/ skyes bus gang bstab len mi bya/ / bag gsar bstab pa'i bkur ste yis/ / tha mar stong thub nyams la ltos/ / de phyir bya ba gang la yang / / mkhas thabs ldan pa'i gros kyis 'grub/ / sprel dmag mang du tshogs pa yis/ / rgya mtsho la'ang zam pa

yo2 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/btsugs/ /de slad blo dang ldan rnams kyis/ /mi 'os grogs dang gros sbyangs napa/ /'os pa'i grogs dang gros bsten na/ /dpal las nyams par — 'gyu/ sa ༵/ lta/ bu'o/ /gsumapa/ rgyalayolugasakyi bstan bcosakyi rtsomastangasakhyad chos/rtsom pa pos 'phags pa gser 'od dam pa dang sa snying 'khor lo bcu ba/mdo sde dran pa nyer bzhag dang byang chub sems dpa'i spyod yul la thabs kyis rnam par 'phrul ba bstan pa'i mdo/ klu yi rgyal po rnga sgra'i tshigs su bcad pa/skye bo gso thigs/ sa skya'i legs bshad sogs dpe cha bcu bzhi la zur lta byas shing / de dag las snying bcud nye bar blangs nas legs bshad kyi bstan bcos 'di legs par bcoms pa yin pas/ /bstan bcos 'di'i rjod byed kyi tshig la nyams 'gyur du ma ldan te/ legs bshad mang che ba zhig sa skya'i legasabashad dang 'dra bar sho lo ke'i tshig phreng rer yig 'bru bdun ma can yin yang / skabs 'gar yig 'bru dgu ma can dang / skabs 'gar yig 'bru bcu gnyis can yang mchis pa dang / skabs 'gar brjod don gcig tshig rkang drug ma'am bcu mas bstan pa'ang mchis pas/ legs bshad kyi bstan bcos gzhan la med pa'i nyams dang 'gyur bas khengs so snyam/legs bshad kyi bstan bcos 'di'i rtsom stangs sa skya'i legs bshad dang mi 'dra sa ni/ gong nas bshad zin pa'i yig 'bru'i mang nyung dang tshig rkangagi mang nyung ci rigs su snang ba las gzhan dpe dang dpe can gnyis kyi

yo2 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/btsugs/ /de slad blo dang ldan rnams kyis/ /mi 'os grogs dang gros sbyangs napa/ /'os pa'i grogs dang gros bsten na/ /dpal las nyams par — 'gyu/ sa ༵/ lta/ bu'o/ /gsumapa/ rgyalayolugasakyi bstan bcosakyi rtsomastangasakhyad chos/rtsom pa pos 'phags pa gser 'od dam pa dang sa snying 'khor lo bcu ba/mdo sde dran pa nyer bzhag dang byang chub sems dpa'i spyod yul la thabs kyis rnam par 'phrul ba bstan pa'i mdo/ klu yi rgyal po rnga sgra'i tshigs su bcad pa/skye bo gso thigs/ sa skya'i legs bshad sogs dpe cha bcu bzhi la zur lta byas shing / de dag las snying bcud nye bar blangs nas legs bshad kyi bstan bcos 'di legs par bcoms pa yin pas/ /bstan bcos 'di'i rjod byed kyi tshig la nyams 'gyur du ma ldan te/ legs bshad mang che ba zhig sa skya'i legasabashad dang 'dra bar sho lo ke'i tshig phreng rer yig 'bru bdun ma can yin yang / skabs 'gar yig 'bru dgu ma can dang / skabs 'gar yig 'bru bcu gnyis can yang mchis pa dang / skabs 'gar brjod don gcig tshig rkang drug ma'am bcu mas bstan pa'ang mchis pas/ legs bshad kyi bstan bcos gzhan la med pa'i nyams dang 'gyur bas khengs so snyam/legs bshad kyi bstan bcos 'di'i rtsom stangs sa skya'i legs bshad dang mi 'dra sa ni/ gong nas bshad zin pa'i yig 'bru'i mang nyung dang tshig rkangagi mang nyung ci rigs su snang ba las gzhan dpe dang dpe can gnyis kyi

bod kyi phyi dar rtsom rig yo3steng 'og gang bder brjes nas brtsams pa de red/ 'on kyang / skabs /// sna skya'i legs bshad dang cung mtshungs pa'i legs bshad kyang yod de/pha rol stobs dang ldan gyur kyang / / blo dang ldan na bkol du :shārnyi/sa// 'thab tshe mkha' lding rgyal na'ang / / tha mar khyab 'jug bzhon /sdu sdo/ dngha zhi/ nga gzhan 'dor ba/ /de la su zhig skyabs su 'dzin/ /'bras bye/ /trī tāzlo mi gtsang chu/ /blo ldan su yis bsten par byed/ /skabs 'dir sa skya'i legs bshad dang mi 'dra bar/ rig byed kyi gtam rgyud dang sbyar nas bcoms pa'ang yod de/ dper na/blo can rnams kyis rdzu bag gis/ / spung bo'ang mgo bo gdugs ltar bskor/ /khyab 'jug mi'u thung gzugs brdzus nas/ /stobs ldan sa yi 'og tu bcings/ /bye brag 'byed pa'i blo ldan la/ /dris na rang nyid dpal thob /ku/ ga/ stobs ldan dga' byed kyis kyang ni/ / ha nu man tha grogs su /sna/ ༵ sna 'o/le/gas bshad kyi bstan bcos 'di la sa skya'i legs bshad dang / dge ldan legs bshad chu shing / gi bstan bcos sogs legs bshad kyi bstan bcos gzhan dang ches mi 'dra ba'i rtsom stangs khyad chos shig ldan pa ni/ rab tu byed pa dag gi mjug mthar sho lo ka gnyis re brtsams nas/ rtsom pa po'i rlabs ltar 'phyo ba'i yid kyi 'gyur ba ste/ bsam blo'i brtse dung mngon par bstan pa yin te/ dper na/

bod kyi phyi dar rtsom rig yo3steng 'og gang bder brjes nas brtsams pa de red/ 'on kyang / skabs /// sna skya'i legs bshad dang cung mtshungs pa'i legs bshad kyang yod de/pha rol stobs dang ldan gyur kyang / / blo dang ldan na bkol du :shārnyi/sa// 'thab tshe mkha' lding rgyal na'ang / / tha mar khyab 'jug bzhon /sdu sdo/ dngha zhi/ nga gzhan 'dor ba/ /de la su zhig skyabs su 'dzin/ /'bras bye/ /trī tāzlo mi gtsang chu/ /blo ldan su yis bsten par byed/ /skabs 'dir sa skya'i legs bshad dang mi 'dra bar/ rig byed kyi gtam rgyud dang sbyar nas bcoms pa'ang yod de/ dper na/blo can rnams kyis rdzu bag gis/ / spung bo'ang mgo bo gdugs ltar bskor/ /khyab 'jug mi'u thung gzugs brdzus nas/ /stobs ldan sa yi 'og tu bcings/ /bye brag 'byed pa'i blo ldan la/ /dris na rang nyid dpal thob /ku/ ga/ stobs ldan dga' byed kyis kyang ni/ / ha nu man tha grogs su /sna/ ༵ sna 'o/le/gas bshad kyi bstan bcos 'di la sa skya'i legs bshad dang / dge ldan legs bshad chu shing / gi bstan bcos sogs legs bshad kyi bstan bcos gzhan dang ches mi 'dra ba'i rtsom stangs khyad chos shig ldan pa ni/ rab tu byed pa dag gi mjug mthar sho lo ka gnyis re brtsams nas/ rtsom pa po'i rlabs ltar 'phyo ba'i yid kyi 'gyur ba ste/ bsam blo'i brtse dung mngon par bstan pa yin te/ dper na/

364 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/nga rgyal med cing des par gyur pa'i skye bo gang / /'grogs na bde zhing mdza' bar rab tu brtan gyur pa/ /'bras ldan ljon shing bzang bo'i grib ma snum por ni/ / ngal gsos bzhin du brten rnams bde ba thob par byed/ /nga rgyal med cing dul ba dang ldan 'di ni zla ba min yang sa gsum kun dga' byed/ / 'grogs na shin tu bde ba'i 'jug ngogs dam pa yin yang bdud rtsi'i nga bur gyur ma lags/ / mtha' dag skye bo dga' zhing lta bas 'dun sa/ sdir kyaji /yi/ga'atsharwa/yin no / / gzhal med khang mchog min yang 'a 4sna /le/ tre pashe/ /byes / dzño /byed pa'i tshul dang ldan/ /

bodakyiphyidamartsomarig da 365don tshan brgyad pa/ bya mgrin sngon zla ba'i rtogs brjod/dang po/ rtsom pa po'i lorgyusamador bstan pa/bya mgrin sngon zla ba'i rtogs brjod kyi rtsom pa po ni stag phu ba blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan nam ming gzhan ngag dbang blo gros rgya mtsho zhu ba de nyid yin zhing / khong spyi lo 1725la nyang bo sa cha'i do bo mgo sde ba ru sku 'khrungs/'di ba ni thu'u bkwan chos kyi nyi ma dang lcang skya rol ba'i rdo rje rnam pa gnyis kyi yongs 'dzin yin zhing / bya mgrin sngon zla ba'i rtogs brjod 'di ni khong nyid kyis dgung lo rgan pa'i dus su ste/ spyi lo 1797la 'bras srungs dgon pa ru brtsams nas yongs su grub pa dang / rjes su thu'u bkwan chos kyi nyi ma gtsos lha sa ru shing dpar brkos nas legs par dpar ba'o/ /gnyisapa/ bya mgrin sngon zla ba'i rtogasabarjod kyi brjod don dang bsam blo'i rang bzhin/sgrung gtam ring mo bya mgrin sngon zla ba'i rtogs brjod la/ khyon bsdoms le'u dgu mchis te/ yab yum gyi rtogs pa brjod pa mdor bsdus pa dang / 'phos shing lhams su zhugs pa'i skabs te dang po'o/ / sku byis pa'i skabs dang / chos blon gsum nub phyogs su gshegs pa'i skabs te gnyis

3yo bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/pa'o/ / sku gzhon nu'i skabs dang / grong 'jug sbyangs shing yum zhi bar gshegs pa'i skabs te gsum pa'o/ / grong 'jug gi rkyen gyis bya'i lus su byung ba dang sprul ba'i bya dang mjal ba'i skabs te bzhi ba'o/ / bya rnams la thog mar chos gsungs pa dang / bla ma dri med dpal ldan las thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i gdams pa dang lung bstan thob pa'i skabs te lnga ba'o/ / 'phags pa thugs rje chen po yab yum gyis lung bstan cing dge 'dun rnams kyis shing rtar gdan drangs pa dang rgyal bu rdzun ma pham par mdzad cing gser bzang ma dang slar yang mjal ba'i skabs te drug pa'o/ /rangagi gdul bya rnams la tshigs bcad glu dbyangs su bsdebs pa rgya mtsho lta bu'i nang nas/ blo dman gyis go bde zhing / deng dus nye bar mkho ba 'ga' zhig smras pa'i skabs te bdun pa'o/ /slar yang wa ra ṇa sir 'dzoms te bla ma dri ma med pa'i dpal gyi zhal mjal zhing lung bstan thob pa sogs kyi skabs te brgyad pa'o/ /mthar sku gshegs pa'i skabs te dgu ba'o/ /byamagrin sngon zla ba'i rtogs brjod kyi brjod don gtso bo ni/ de yang sngon rgya gar sa cha ru grong khyer wa ra ṇa si zhes pa zhig yod pa de na/ rgyal po lha snang stobs ldan zhes pa zhig yod pa des/ mdzes sdug dpal gyis sgeg cing ya rabasaspyod pa ldan pa'i jo mo sgrol ma'i sprul ba btsun mo ma ti ma hā ni zer ba khab tu bzhes pa las sras chos kyi dga' ba zhes pa legs par 'khrungs so/ /rgyal bu chos kyi dga' ba cung zad nar son pa'i skabs de la/ rgyal po'i blon po yam she zhes pa yis rgyal bu chos kyi dga' ba'i chung grogs sam rtse grogs bzang bo ye shes 'dzin gyi go sa blangs nas rang nyid kyi bu la gā ā na zhes par byin te/ rgyal bu chos kyi dga' bar zhabs zhu sgrub tu bcug go /chos kyi dga' ba dam pa'i chos la pos shing ya rabs spyod par 'jug pa'i rgyal bu zhig yin na'ang / la gā ā na ni g.yo sgyu can dang ham sems can

bod kyi phyi dar rtsom rig yo7zhig yin pas rnam kun rgyal po'i go sa 'thob par ham sems bcangs/de nas rgyal bu chos kyi dga' ba dang la gā ā na gnyis kyis rnal 'byor ba rgan pa zhig legs par bsten nas/ zab lam grong 'jug dang / bde mchog la sogs pa'i sngags bla na med par sbyangs pa mdzad/ skabs der/rgyal bu chos kyi dga' ba'i btsun mo rnams kyi khrod na snga ra su ti ni zer ba'i btsun mo zhig yod pa des 'di ltar bsam ste/ gser bzang ma dang nged rnams btsun mo yin par mnyam na'ang / rgyal bu nam yang gser bzang ma dang lhan cig rol ba las/ nged rnams la zur mig tsam yang mi blta'o snyam nas/ phrag dog zug rngu yis snying la zin nas stong dpon yam she yi bu la gā ā na dang lus 'dres par byas te/ rgyal bu chos kyi dga' ba med par gtong dgos zhes la gā ā na yang yang bskul bas na/ la gā ā nas kyang dang du blangs nas rgyal bu med par gtong ba'i blo thabs btsal/nyin zhig la/ la gā ā nas/ pho brang gi byang phyogs kyi skyed mos tshal dang thag mi ring ba'i sa na chu bo ma hā dza na zhes pa zhig mchis pa dang chu bo'i pha mtha' na phun sum tshogs pa'i nags tshal zhig yod do zhes rgyal bu la bsnyad pa la/ rgyal bu chos kyi dga' ba skyo bsang gi ched du la gā ā na dang mnyam du chu bo ma hā dza na'i ngogs su song ngo / /yin na'ang chu bor brgal ba'i thabs ma rnyed par mchis pa na/ la gā ā nas sngar nas gra sgrig byas pa'i 'dab chags khu byug gi ro zhig yod pa bton nas rgyal bu la phul te/ lha sras lags/khu byug gi ro 'di la 'pho ba mdzad nas gshegs par 'tshal lo zhes zhus pa la/rgyal bu thugs mnyes nas khu byug gi ro la grong 'jug byas pa dang / la gā ā nas kyang bya ro zhig la grong 'jug byas rjes/ chu bo'i pha mthar 'phur nas ro brgya ldan pa'i shing rtog dang mdzes sdug ldan pa'i me tog la longs su spyod bzhin rang byung ltad mo la g.yeng ba'i skabs der/ la gā ā nas rgyal bus ma

368 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/rig par byas te/ myur ba myur bar phyir chu bo'i pha mthar 'phur nas/ rgyal bu'i sku gdung la grong 'jug byas nas rang gi mi ro chu la bskur rjes/ 'o dod dang smre ngag bton nas la gā ā na chus khur thal zhes 'ur brgyab tshe/ gzhon trī /shāshā /shārnyi rdodī dīkā bar thon nas la gā ā na la mya ngan byas rjes/ phyir de ltar/ la gā ā nas rang gi ro chu la bskur te rgyal bu chos kyi dga' ba'i sku gdung la grong 'jug byas te rgyal bu'i go sa blangs stabs/ rgyal bu chos kyi dga' bas khu byug gi lus mi len ka med byung /rgyal bu chos kyi dga' bas khu byug gi tshul gyis mtha' bral nags tshal du rnam par 'tsho skabs/ sprul ba'i 'dab chags shig gis zab gsang dam chos legs par gsungs pa la rtse gcig yid kyis gsan cing dad pa mos gus chen po byas pa dang / de nas 'dab chags rnams la chos gsungs pa dang / rjes su/ bla ma dri med dpal ldan la legs par mjal nas de las thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i gdams pa dang lung bstan rnam par thob bo/ /de ltar/ 'dab chags khu byug gi rnam pa can rgyal bu chos kyi dga' ba mchog gis byang chub sems dpa'i brtul zhugs nye bar bzung ba dang / grong khyer wa ra ṇa si'i dge 'dun rnams kyis dad pa chen pos gnan drangs te/grong khyer gyi skye 'gro kun la zab yangs chos kyi bdud rtsi rgya cher bstsal ba dang /sbyor ba ngan la ham sems che ba'i rgyal bu rdzun ma la gā ā na pham par mdzad nas/ rgyalasrid chos las bsgyur shāng rgya~X 'bangs bde la bkod rjes/ slar yang ma// /la kāXs dzem du py-i mi/ dī sdo/ nyid/ kyi bsam blo'i rang bzhin ni/rtsom pa pos rtsom par dam bca' ba ru/ gang zhig 'khor ba'i gnas la skyo ba rnams/ /skyo shas nges 'byung 'phel bar bya ba sogs/ / dgos pa ldan phyir

——— bodakyiphyinarastomarig — lta 'khor bar 'khyams skabs las/ / mgrin sngon zla bar skyes pa'i rtogs brjod 'bri/ /zhes pa yis mdor bstan pa yin te/ spyir 'jig rten 'khor ba ni nyon mongs dug lnga'i rlabs phreng 'phyo ba'i sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho lta bu yin pas na/ de na nam yang bde ba med pa dang / de la nam yang snying bo med pas/ci nas kyang 'khor ba la rgyab kyis phyogs shing dam chos la blo kha phyogs te/byang chub sems dpa'i brtul zhugs bzung nas gzhan la phan pa lhur len dgos pa dang / rgyal 'bangs chos kyis bskyangs nas 'jig rten la zhi bde dang legs tshogs bslun dgos pa mngon par bstan pa de yin no/ /gsumapa/ bya mgrin sngon zla ba'i rtogasabarjod kyi rtsom stangasakhud chos/sgo nas dā sdursha /dā //ma ring mo 'di nyid kyi rtsom stangs khyad chos rnam pa lnga'i gcig rtogs brjod kyi byung rim dang sgrig stangs gzhan dang mi sdushā nā /shā hā/ // sna/ /nga go rim gsal ba dang / mgo mjug yod cing gnyis/ rtsom pa por bsam pa'i 'char sgo phun sum tshogs pa zhig ldan te/ rtogs brjod khrod du mi sna mi 'dra ba mang bo zhig gi gzugs brnyan rtog bzo byas shing / mi sna re re'i yid kyi 'gyur ba so so yin pa legs par bkod zlo/nga /sna /zlo sdu /zlo //dro /ga sogs kyi rnam pa mi mthun pa sna tshogs bkod josum/ rtogs brjod la rtog pa 'char yan ring lugs kyi sgyu rtsal khyad

370 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/chos ldan te/ rtsom pa pos tshad mar bzung ba'i mi sna ste chos kyi dga' ba ni 'dab chags khu byug gi gzugs su byas te slob dpon sangs 'dzin (ne tso zhig)gtso byas pa'i 'dab chags kyi 'khor mang bo chos 'og tu bcug pa dang /de dag las 'dab chags sum cu lhag la sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob cing /gzhan bya thams cad chos la mos shing nges 'byung gi bsam pa skyes nas shi ba'i tshe na'ang / la la dag pa'i zhing du skyes pa dang / la la 'dod lha'i rigs su skyes pa dang / la lar mi'i lus rten bzang bo thob pa bcas bkod yod pa ni/rtsom pa pos 'jig rten 'di las 'das pa'i 'jig rten gzhan zhig la re mos byed phyir 'ud bstod dang sgro 'dogs byas nas bris pa yin/bzhi/ rtsom pa po ni phyi rol yul gyi bya dngos la dpyad par mkhas pa dang mi sna zhib 'bri byed pa'i sgyu rtsal la byang ba zhig yin/lnga/ rtogs brjod kyi rjod byed tshig ni rgya che ba'i ngal rtsol mi dmangs kyi blo kha dang 'tsham ste/ rtsom pa pos yang dag pa'i kha skad dang yul skad kyi rmang gzhi'i thog nas go sla ba'i gcig gyur gyi yig skad cig las snon byas te sgrung gtam 'di bris pa yin zhing / mi sna so so'i skad cha'i bshad stangs kyang mi sna /ṭā hā /sdo thang dang / lo chod/ rang gshis/ bsam blo dang 'tsham par

bod kyi phyi dar rtsom rig 371don tshan bcu ba/ lha mo dbyangs can ma'i bstod pa utpal phreng mdzes/dang po/ rtsomadzopo'i lorgyusamador bstan pa/thu'ubakwan blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma mchog ni pho rod lha gru'i phyogs phun tshogs lung bar pra rtsi'i rigs su yab dpung skyabs rgyal dang yum ba ri bza' chos mtsho skyid gnyis kyi sras su sbyi lo 1737lor bkra shes pa'i ltas dang bcas par sku 'khrungs pa dang / dgung lo drug bzhes pa'i chu khyi lor sku gong ma ngag dbang chos kyi rgya mtsho'i khri la legs par bkod/ bde dgu ngag dbang dge legs rgya mtsho'i drung du dge bsnyen bsgrubs/ dmar gtsang dpon chung blo bzang chos 'dzin las yi ge 'bri klog legs par bslabs/ dgung lo bcu gcig pa spyi lo 1747lor sum pa mkhan chen ye shes dpal 'byor las rab tu byung / de nas dgon lung byams pa gling gi chos grwar zhugs te/ skyes sbyangs kyi mkhyen rab thogs pa med pa'i steng du gus rtag sbyor ba'i brtson pa chen pos gsan sbyong dpyis phyin par mdzad pas/ rnam dpyod kyi rtsal kun nas rgyas paragyur/ dgung lo bcu gsum pa'i steng lcang skya rin po che rol ba'i rdo rje las dge tshul bsgrubs/ sbyi lo 1755lor dbus gtsang chos kyi mdun sar phebs nas 'bras spungs sgo mang chos grwar zhugs pa dang / kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang bo las lung chos man ngag mtha' yas ba gsan/ phur bu
