tshe —— spu ma470tshotshopo rdo/ sta —cos tu bla ma byam sa pa rin ngo che las 'jam dbyangs zhal lung dang bde lam gyi zab khrid/ bde sasang 'jigs sasum gyi bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid res mos gnang ba legs par sasan zhing / dgung lo nyer 0cig pa spyi lo 1757lor rje de las bsnyen rdzogs bsgru bas/ lo der lcang skya rin po che dbus su phebs pa las ba 'a chos rgya che ba sasan/ gzhan yang parṇa chen dpal ldan ye shes dang / stas phu ba'ad pa'i rdo rje/ 'bru la mkhan chen ye shes bstan pa'i sgron me/ ba ri ngag dbang don grub sogs mkhas pa mang bo las mdo sngags rig gnas gsan sbyo nga phul phyin mdzad/ dgung lo nyer gsum pa sa yos lor zhwa lu dgon pa 'i mkhan por bskos/ sa skya bdag chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' blo gros las zab chos mang du gsan/ dgung lo nyer lnga ba sbyi lo 1761lor mdo smad du phebs thing / sum pa mkhan chen sogs bla slob kyi thugs bzhed ltar dbon lu nga gi khrir bzhugs/ sbyi lo 1767lor 'jam dbyangs gong ma'i bka' ba'in rgya nas pe cin du phebs nas/ dpon dmangs la bka' chos sanang / gong ma chen pos rje 'di nyid la ho thog thu'i rgo sa dang chan zhi'i lung las gnang / bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i 'phrin las kyis sa steng khyab/ dgung lo so sanyis pa'i steng rang dbon du phebs/ chu sbrul lor slar yang gong ma'i ba 'a ba'in pe cin du phebs/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyis bstan 'gro'i ma dzad 'phrin rgya chen po bsgrubs/ sku tshe smad du gong ma la dgongs pa zhus te rmi do smad du phebs pa dang / dgung lo nga gsum pa spyi lo 1789lor sku 'bum byams pa gling gi cir bzhugs/ dge 'dun bgres gzhon kun la bka' chos rgya cher gsungs pas bstan 'dzin rnams kyis gang gsungs gus pas dang blangs kyis 'chad nyan yar zla bzhin rgyas par gyur pa dang / chos srid kyi bka' drin tshad med pas bskyangs pa bsam gyis mi khyab/ dgung lo re drug bzhes pa rab byung bcu gsum pa'i chu khyi ste spyi lo 1802lor sbu gshegs pa

bod kyi phyi dar rtsom rig 373dang / gsung rtsom pod bco lnga bzhugs so/ /gnyisapa/ 'phagasamadabyangasacan ma labastod pyo.utpal phreng mdzesadang de'i brjod don/na mo su ra su ste ya/ dge legs tshogs gnyis byed pos nyer bsgrun pa'i/ / gang sku'i dkyil 'khor rgyas pa'i gzi byin gyis/ / snying la phun tshogs dngos brgya ster ba'i dpal/ / dbyangs kyi rgyal mo deng 'dir snying dbus bzhugs/ / kun gyi mdzes sdug bsdus nas bdag gir byas/ / drag po'i gtsug rgyan brkus nas gdan du bting / / blo gsal gzhon nur 'grogs pa'i bag yangs can/ / tshangs pa'i bu mo khyod la zhe nas khrel/ /chags bral rnams kyang dka' thub 'jigs byed pa'i/ / mchog gi lang tsho 'chang ba des chog gi / rgyud stong dbyangs dang bsdebs pa'i snyan 'jebs glu/ / 'di yis lhag par ya mtshan gyur pa ci/ / rab rgyas dri med zhal gyi dkyil 'khor mchog /mthong ba tsam gyis kun yid 'phrog byed na/ /dkyus ring zur mig lcags kyus blo gsal gyi/ / snying la 'debs pa'i bslu brid 'dis ci bya/ / gtsang zhing dag pa'i dri med sku mchog ni/ / lang tsho gsar ba'i rgyan gyis sdud bzhin du/ / sna tshogs rgyan dang dar zab na bza' yis/ /klubs 'di'i mdzes chos khyad par gyur pa gang / / shel dkar lhun po'i dpal 'chang sku'i lang tshos/ / sa gsum kun dgar byed pa des chog gi/ zla ba'i gdong la utpal mig bkod de/ / lhag par yid 'phrog brtul zhugs bsten ci dgos/ /gang thugs 'gro la rjes su chags pa yis/ / zug jus gdung bas sku yi kha dog kyang / / cung zad dmar ba'i mdangs dang

374 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/'dres pa ni/ / pad dkar gsar ba'i dpal la co 'drir gyur/ / dka' thub la gnas drang srong rgan po 'ga'/ / gang sku'i mdzes sdug dpal gyis yid phrogs te/ /gnam sngon zhun mar 'khyil 'dra'i mtsho 'gram du/ /lhags te bsam gtan sgom pa'i rdzu la brten/ / lha klu dri za'i na chung du ma'i tshogs/ / khyod la 'gran phyir drung du nyer lhags kyang / / cha tsam zhig kyang 'gran par ma bzod nas/ / sna tshogs mchod sprin spro ba'i zol la brten/ /de tshe sna tshogs me tog gzhon nu rnams/ / dga' ba'i 'dzum dkar nye bar ston bzhin du/ / se'u 'bru dkar bo so yi phreng ba dag / de dag rnams la 'phya ba'i tshul du rgod/ /yid bzhin rgya mtshor 'khyil ba'i rlabs kyi phreng / /'phyur las snyan tshig rol mo nyer sgrogs dang / / lhan cig mgrin pa'i rdza rnga khrol ba yi/ / sna tshogs 'dab chags 'phur lding gar gyis rol/ / gang sku'i 'odadakar zer gyis bran pa las/ / snying la bsil ba'i dngos po nyer thog pa'i/ / gangs ri'i dum bu lta bu'i gnyis 'thung khyu/ / sngo ljang ni'u gsing ngogs su 'chags shing rol/ / tshogs gnyis zong gis nyos pa'i sku gsum gyi/ / ma smad yon tan nor bu'i bang mdzod las/ / nyin bzhin chos kyi dga' ston 'bum 'gyed pas/ / khyod ni blo gsal yongs kyi bshes su gyur/ /'di na longs spyod dpal thob tha mal ba/ /des kyang 'phongs pa nye bar skyob mthong na/ /dngos grub gter gyur khyod 'dra'i byin rlabs kyi/ /cha tsam bdag la bsgrun na cis ma legs/ /de phyir smra mkhas dran gsal blo rno zhing / /gtugs pa med pa'i shes rab dpal thob nas/ / thos bsam sgom pa'i them skas la 'jogs te/ / sku gsum khang bzang mchog tu bgrod par mdzod/ /pha rol smra ngan dpung la rgol ba'i tshe/ / thal 'gyur gtan tshigs mtshon cha'i 'khor lo can/ / lung rigs gnyis su 'thun pa'i dpal grub nas/ /phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba thob par mdzod/ / mkhas mang mdun

bod kyi snyi dar rtsom rig 375sar gzhung lugs 'chad pa'i tshe/ /skyon bral legs par bshad pas kun gyi yid/ /dbang med phrogs te grags snyan ba dag mchog /phyogs kun mngon par sgrong ba'i mthu grub mdzod/ /snyan dngags rtsom la nye bar zhugs pa na/ /don zab tshig snyan kun gyi yid tshim pa'i/ /legs bshad utpal gsar ba'i dga' ston gyis/ /blo ldan bung ba 'gugs la zla med mdzod/ /'jig rten dbang phyug zhal gyi chu mtsho las/ /legs 'khrungs ngang ba'i bu mo dbyangs can ma/ /cung zad bstod pa'i bsod nams rgya mtsho las/ /sku gsum rlabs kyi phreng ba 'phyur bar shog /ces btsun gzugs blo bzang chos kyi nyi mas legs bshad sgrogs pa'i dga' tshal 'bras srungs su sbyar ba'o/ /gsumapakyi/ba~X sdigārsha snang mdzesade yang sgra dbyangs lha mo dbyangs can ma sku mdog dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ skyil krung phyed pa tsog pu'i bzhugs stangs can dang / zhal ras zla ba nya gang ba lta bu dang / utpal ltar bkra ba'i spyan zung g.yo bas mdzes pa/ phyag g.yon pas beeḍūrya'i rgyud mangs 'dzin cing / /g.yas pa'i phyag sor gyi 'du byed kyis bskul bas sgra dbyangs rgya mtsho mngon par sgrub pa/ /bung ba ltar gnag pa'i sku tshogs phyed ltag par bcings shing / /phyed sil bur grol bas sku stod khebs pa/ /padma dkar po'i thod bcings pa dang /rinapo che sna tshogs pas skra'i zar bu mdzes pa/ bcu drug lon pa'i lang tsho can/ nu 'bur mtho la rgyas pa/ sked skabs phra zhing sgeg la 'dzum pa'i

376 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/nyams 'gyur can/ lha rdzas kyi stod g.yogs dkar po dang / smad g.yogs dbang bo'i gzhu ltar bkra ba'i lhab lhub g.yo ba/ nor bu rin po che'i rgyan du mas rnam par brgyan pa ni/ gtsug gi nor bu/ snyan rgyan/ mgul rgyan/phyag spyadub/ sor gdub/'oska rags/ do shal/ se mo do/ g.yer kha'i phreng ba la bye ṭwāṃ dro/ kta/ nā dri / grag/ sa su 'jig rten 'di chags nas mi ring ba rdzogs ldan thog ma'i dus su ri rab kyi lho phyogs rgya mtsho chen po bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gnas pa la/ phyogs kun nas rlung gi bkod pa mtha' yas pa langs te/ des rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs rnam pa du mar g.yos pa las srid pa gsum gyi brtan g.yos sgra skad thams cad snyan cing 'jibs par gnas so/ / de'i tshe tshangs pa chen po mi 'chi ba zhes pa'i grong khyer na spyod pas sgra de gsan nas lo stong phrag gi bar du rgya mtsho g.yo bar bltas shing / sgra de las dga' ba'i ro nyams su myong ngo / / de'i tshe srid pa gsum gyi snyan 'jebs sgra dbyangs thams cad 'dus pa las/ 'jo sgeg mdzes sdug gi cha yongs su rdzogs pa'i sa gsum na 'gran zla dang bral ba'i lha mo 'di byung ba yin no/ /zhes rig byed kyi gtam rgyud du grags la/ nang pa'i lugs la 'phags pa spyan rasagazigs kyi mche ba las sprul bar bzhed cing / rgya gar du phyi nang thun mong gi lhar gsungs te thun mong rig gnas skabs kyi gtam rgyud du nges/don la rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi yum dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs shes rab myur ba'i ye shes lha'i rnam par sprul ba dang / rgyal ba yum chen mo'i 'phrin las lhar shar ba yin par gsungs/ thun mong ltar lha mo 'di hākā shārnyirnyi ༷ kā /shā sdin ma yang bsten dgos pa dri za'i rgyal po dam bu ra'i bstod pa 'di nyid kyi bsam blo'i nang don ni/ rtsom pa pos lha mo

bod kyi phyi dar rtsom rig 377dbyangs can ma'i sku gsung thugs gsum kyi yon tan la bsngags brjod mdzad pa dang / mjug mthar/ de phyir smra mkhas dran gsal blo rno zhing / /gtugs pa med pa'i shes rab dpal thog nas/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i them skas la 'jogs te/ sku gsum khang bzang mchog tu bgrod par mdzod/ /pha rol smra ngan dpung la rgol ba'i tshe/ /thal 'gyur gtan tshigs mtshon cha'i 'khor lo can/ /lung rigs gnyis su 'thung ba'i dpal grub nas/ /phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba thob par mdzod/ /mkhas mang mdun sar gzhung lugs 'chad pa'i tshe/ /skyon bral legs par bshad pas kun gyi yid/ /dbang med 'phrogs te grags snyan ba dan mchog /phyogs kun mngon par sgreng ba'i mthu grub mdzod/ /snyan dngags rtsom la nye bar zhugs pa na/ /don zab tshig snyan kun gyi yin tshim pa'i/ /legs bshad utpal gsar ba'i tā/ pa// gyu di/ yin/ sdi lda/na bung ba 'gugs la zla med mdzod/ /ces legs bzhi ba/ bstod pa.utpalaphreng mdzesakyisna rtsalakhyad chos/de yang thu'u bkwan blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma mchog ni ches phul du byung ba'i snyan ngag mkhan zhig kyang yin te/ khong nyid kyis legs par bcoms pa'i bstod pa dang / rtogs brjod/ 'phrin yig sogs snyan ngag gi brjod bya phun sum tshogs shing rjod byed la nyams 'gyur rdzogs pas na/ gangs can rtsom rig lo rgyus khrod na nam yang khyad du 'phags pa'i sgyu rtsal gyi 'od snang 'phro'o/ /utpal phreng mdzes zhes bya ba ni lha mo dbyangs can ma'i bstod pa rmad du byung la thun mong ma yin pa zhig yin phyir/ de la sgyu rtsal gyi khyad chos

378 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/'di da) lda/ dro // /ga/sa /snyan ngag gi rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan pas na snyan ngag la mdzes pa'i nyams 'gyur kun nas thon pa dang /2 snyan tshig la snyan zhing 'jibs pa dang / kha tshig gsal ba/ dag ༵ /spya pa sogs khyad chos rnam par rdzogs pas na go bde zhing yid la 'thad 2 lha mo dbyangs can ma'i sku byad dang nyams stabs ni gson nyams ldan la mdzes sdug rdzogs par 'bri bzhings mdzad pas na yin la zad pa med pa'i dang ba dang mdzes snang skyed par byed pa'o/ /

bod kyi phyi dar rtsom rig 379don tshan bcu ba/ rje btsun shes rab rgya mcho'i snyan rtsom/dang po/ rtsomapapo'i lorgyusamador bstan pa/gangs can mkhas pa'i khyu mchog dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po rje btsun shes rab rgya mtsho ni/ mdo khams smad kyi char gtogs pa bkra shis pa'i gnas rdo sbis gser mo ljongs zhes grags pa'i yul gyi khongs gtogs/ hor gro ba zhes 'bod pa'i grong sde der yab lha lung skyabs dang / yum lha lung skyid pa/sdu tram̐ sras su rab byung bco lnga ba'i shing pho sprel gyi lo (spyi lo187)la sku dgung lo lnga'i tshe sgo mang dge bshes lha rams pa nor bu rin po che'i drung nas rab tu byung zhing dge tshul gyi sdom pa legs par bzhes te/ dge ldan byi(sdu shā ༵ /dro /ra sdidī / tshang gi chos sgor zhugs nas yi ge sbyor klog la dgung lo bcu drug gi ston khar chos sde chen po bla brang bkra shes 'khyil kyi chos grwar zhugs te slob gnyer la nyin mtshan sbrel ba'i brtson pa chen po gnang zhing / skabs der bse bsdus grwa dang / blo rtags mtha' dpyod gnyis/'grel ba don gsal/ rgyan 'jug gnyis dang bcas tshogs rgyugs su phul ba dang / lo de'i dgun chos chen mor dmigs bsal gyis 'dzin grwa gong du spar ba sogs kyis grwa ba rgan gzhon kun ngo mtshar ba'i don mang bo byung / a khu gung thang blo gros dang kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa sku phreng bzhi ba

380 bon kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/bskal bzang thub bstan dbang phyug sogs sde snod 'dzin pa'i bla ma du ma bsten pa dang / khyad par du a khu gung thang blo gros tshang gi mdun nas dge slong gi sdom pa yang dag par mnos/ rje btsun shes rab rgya mtsho khong ni sku tshe 'dir sdom gsum gyi bcag mtshapas phra /gas gang gi bahā la nyes ltung gi ṭwāṃ /rdzu ༵ tā kāswā/ shā /sna ༵ snye ༈ ༵ wa snas 4 phung bo mthar 4na par mdzad pa dgung lo nyer gcig gi tshe/ khong lha sar phebs te 'bras spungs sgo mang grwa tshang gi chos sgor zhugs shing mkhas pa'i dbang bo mchog grub dkar bo dang /bla ma 'bul sdud rin po che blo bzang ye shes bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang bo sogs dge ba'i bshes gnyen bcu phrag gsum lhag spyi bo'i cod pan du bsten te rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag dang mdo sngags kyi gzhung lugs rgya mtsho lta bu la thos bsam mthar phyin par mdzad nas 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum dang / mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi yon tan la mnga' brnyes shing sgo thams cad nas 'gran pa'i zla dang bral ba'i mkhas pa'i go 'phang mthon por gshegs/ de'i tshe khong gis legs bshad snying bo sogs nyin rer shog gu pa/kā shā kā sdu /sdokā / /ga med du blo 'dzin gnang nas gzhung po ti mang bo dgung lo so gsum gyi steng dmigs bsal gyis lha rams pa 'phar ma'i ming btags byung ba dang / nor bu gling ga'i rtsod rgyugs kyi skabs su yang dang po byung ba/ rtse gzims chung du tshogs langs dmigs bsal can gnang ba sogs ya mtshan pa'i mdzad bzang mang bo grub/ lo de'i smon lam nyi shu bzhi'i nyin nor bu gling gar gzhung gi sku drag ser skya tshang 'dzoms kyi dbus su rtse drung yig chen mo chos dar lags nas lha rams pa'i dam bca' yang grangs kyi rim pa sgrig skabs/ rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa'i bka' lung ltar

— bodakyiphyinar rtsom rig yo1rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas pa'i yang dang po ni 'bras spungs sgo mang klu 'bum dge bshes shes rab rgya mtsho'o zhes mtshan snyan me tog gi phreng ba dgung du chi/ // kā // sdozhugs tshogs pa kun gyis ngo mtshar ba dang rjes su yi rang dgung lo so bzhi bar/ rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa sku phreng bcu gsum pa thub bstan rgya mtsho'i bka' lung ltar bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa rin chen grub kyi gsung 'bum dpar gzhi gsar bzhings kyi zhu dag mdzad/lo drug tsam gyis gsung 'bum po ti nyer dgu'i zhu dag legs par grub/ de'i rjes su yang rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa'i bka' gsung spyi bor blangs te/rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog gi dpar gzhi gsar bzhings kyang zhu dag mdzad de lo brgyad tsam gyis dpar gzhi gsar bzhengs legs grub byung /khong rin po che ni sku na ches phra ba'i dus nas shes rab kyi klong brdol bas dgung lo bco lnga'i steng nas ljags rtsom gnang pa'ang yod/ khong gis bstan 'gro phyi'i don la dmigs nas bstan bcos gang mang zhig brtsams mod/ bstan pa 'phel 'grib dang dus kyi 'gyur ba'i dbang gis gsung rtsom gyi ma phyi po ti mang bo med brlag tu gyur la/ da lta yod pa rnams mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe spun khang gis gcig sdud gang thub kyis dpe bsgrun mdzad do/ /rje btsun shes rab rgya mtsho khong gis sku tshe 'dir sras kyi thu bo dge ba'i bshes gnyen lha rams pa skal bzang rgya mtsho dang / dge bshes gzhong ba tshul khrims sogs sde snod 'dzin pa'i bu slob bgrang gis mi lang ba bskyangs pa dang /de las gzhan pa'i skya ser slob gnyer la 'dun pa drag pa gang mang la sgra snyan ngag sum rtags dag gsum sogs khrid nas bskyed bsrings mdzad pas bod mi rigs kyi rig gnas mi nyams gong spel gyi 'phrin las rgya cher spel/dgung lo nga lnga la phebs tshe/ go min tang srid gzhung gis gdan drangs

382 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyusarig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/pa ltar rgya nag tu phebs nas chos srid zung gi bya ba mang bo mdzad pa dang /khyad par du rgyal khab gsar ba dbu brnyes rjes mi dmangs srid gzhung gi bka' ltar bstan 'gro spyi la phan pa'i thugs smon rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas /ktaswā tā shā hā/ /'i thad nas rnam par dkar ba'i mdzad bzang gi spu char dgung lo don gsum gyi tshe/ rgya gar dang / bal po'i rgyal khab gnyis kyis gnan zhus ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mya ngan las 'das nas lo nyis stong lnga brgya song ba'i rjes dran tshogs chen la zhugs/ gzhan yang de'i sngon gzhug tu 'bar ma dang / can pu'u kre/ sing ga la/ ros tan sogs chos ldan rgyal khab de dag la phebs nas de ga'i chos pa rnams la bka' chos sdu ༵ sdo /hākālda sdong bstan pa sbyi dang 'gro ba yongs la phan pa'i mdzad 'phrin chen po gārsha rdo sa ni kyi ra swā /spya nā kū rdorsha kā/ kā kā padī rnyisbyi /sbya bye ṭwāṃ pa/ sduX ngo'i dga' ba gsum pa'i nyin (spyi lo1968lo'i zla11tshes1)zhing 'di'i gdul bya rnams rtag 'dzin gyi 'ching ba dam po gcod par skul phyir dgongs pa chos dbyings su thim pa'i tshul bstan to/ /

bod kyi phyi dar rtsomarig 383gnyisapa/ rje btsunashesarabargya mtsho'i snyan rtsomadabade'i brjod don/deyang rje btsun shes rab rgya mtsho ni bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas kun la mnga' brnyes shing 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gang la'ang thogs pa med pa'i mkhas pa'i dbang bo zhig yin la/ lhag par du khong gi ljags rtsom la gzhan dang thun mong ma yin pa'i sgyu rtsal gyi khyad chos bla na ma mchis pa gang mang zhig yodade/ phun sum tshogs pa'i brjod bya'i don rnams sdud che zhing gnad du khelaba'i sgo nas ston thub pa dang / rjod byed tshig gi sdeb sbyor legs shing tshig nyams thon pa/ tshig shugs che zhing shin tu rno la gtan tshigs kyi rang bzhin gsal zhing dgag gzhag gi rigs pa 'bar ba/ ljags rtsom yongs la 'bol rtsom rang bzhin gyi khyad chos ldan pa/ khyad par du/ sngon byon mkhas ༵ /sdu/ /sdu /sdo // /sna / ba gsar ba'i sgo nas don legs par mtshon gzhan yang khong nyid snyan ngag gi sgra rgyan dang bya dka' ba'i rgyan la bcings te ljags rtsom gnang bar shin tu mkhas te/ dper na/ ka phreng ltar rtsom pa dang / bar chod ma chod kyi zung ldan gyi lam nas rtsom pa ming yig gtor nas rtsom pa/ dbyangs dang gsal byed nges par byas te rtsom pa sogs rtsom rtsal khyad par du 'phags pa du ma mchis so/ /ru/ rje bla ma'i bstod pa dad pa'i dri bsung 'bul ba'i spos kyi rdzing bu zhes pa phan bde'i gzugs 'char dngul dkar me long la/ /dag gtsang tsam

384 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/gyis nyin mtshan kha spyor 'ing / / mngon shes rdzu 'phrul sba ba'i thugs dam can/ /skyabs gcig drin chen bla ma blo bzang grags/ / bde skyong snod dang phur bu'i che ba med/ / chang dang bud med spyod pa'i 'phrul mdzangs med/ /skal ngan rmongs pa slu ba'i snying stobs med/ / 'brog ri'i dge sbyong de la bdag phyag 'tshal/ / rang shar rang grol dzig po'i rtogs pa med/ / dus gsumagazigs pa'i nyams dang lung bstan med/ / pha rol gsod pa'i mthu dang nus pa med/ / 'brog ri'i dge sbyong de la bdag phyag 'tshal/ / rang bzo'i brda chad spel ba'i gzhung 'grel med/ /'gal 'du'i stong gsob tshig bkra'i wu ba med/ / ma reg thug pa'i rgyus gtam kha pho med/ / 'brog ri'i dgesbyong de la bdag phyag 'tshal/ / grub rtags spyi bor spungs pa'i ral ba med/ / lus phra'i 'khor dang sha chang longs spyod med/ / dngas ma 'dod rgur 'jo ba'i bde chen med/ / 'brog ri'i dge sbyong de la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /lha mthong 'dre mthong spyan dang mngon shes med/ /blun dad 'dren pa'i ltas dang brtag dpyad med/ / rnyed bkur zab lam sgrub pa'i 'dag sbyar med/ / 'brog ri'i dge sbyong de la bdag phyag 'tshal/ / dben bzhis stong ba'i sku yi ting 'dzin med/ /'bru gsum ma dmigs ngag gi ting 'dzin med/ / nges shes bral ba'i thugs kyi ting 'dzin med/ / 'brog ri'i dge sbyong de la bdag phyag 'tshal/ / rang nyams khungs med 'doms pa'i spobs pa med/ / rgyal ba'i bka' las 'gongs pa'i snying stobs med/ / sa rdo mi lam lung gi chos gter med/ / 'brog ri'i dge sbyong de la bdag phyag 'tshal/ / 'dul ba'i khrims kyis ma gos lus gtsang med/ / dam pa sgrol ba'i phaṭa dang hūṃ sgra med/ /sor rtog dpyad sgom spong ba'i thom yor med/ /'brog ri'i dge sbyong de la bdag phyag 'tshal/ / mdo sngags nyams len gdan gos so sor med/ / phan tshun spong ba'i rwa dang mche ba med/ / bshad

bod kyi phyi dar rtsom rig 385srol mtha' dag 'dres pa'i khrus rdzing med/ / 'brog ri'i dge stong de la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /lag rjes rkang bas bsub pa'i sug bzhi med/ /dpyad na gtan so bral ba'i 'ja' ris med/ / rmongs yul brjid por chags pa'i sprin phung med/ /'brog ri'i dge sbyong de la bdag phyag 'tshal/ / tshad ldan mkhas pa smod pa'i lce rtsal med/ / chos mthun rgol ba'i thog gi 'jigs pa med/ /sdom gsum dri yis khor yug btang ba med/ /'brog ri'i dge sbyong de la bdag phyag 'tshal/ / ma sbyangs mkhas pa'i rang byung 'bras bu med/ /ma bsgoms grol ba'i rtogs pa klong rdol med/ / ma bshig zhig pa'i sgrib pa rang log med/ /'brog ri'i dge sbyong de la bdag phyag 'tshal/ / rang nyid ma grol gzhan sgrol gdams pa med/ / rang nyid mi shes gzhan slob 'chad rtsom med/ /rang tshod ma rtogs dus gsum rig pa med/ /'brog ri'i dge sbyong de la bdag phyag 'tshal/ / rtag chad mtha' ru gol ba'i lta ba min/ /bying phra'i slong du 'byams pa'i sgom pa min/ / bag med glang chen myos pa'i spyod pa min/ /'brog ri'i dge sbyong de la bdag phyag 'tshal/ / gnag rdzis phyugs ngo bgrang ba'i 'chad pa min/ / dmus long gzugs la rtog pa'i rtsod pa min/ /byis pas bye ma spungs pa'i rtsom pa min/ /'brog ri'i bla ma mchog la bdag phyag 'tshal/ / ma sbyangs ri nas brdol ba'i mkhas pa min/ / rkun po nor la 'jab pa'i btsun pa min/ / rang srog gcod la mdza' ba'i bzang bo min/ / 'brog ri'i bla ma mchog la bdag phyag 'tshal/ / 'khrul ba rang zhig ral ba'i rtogs ldan min/ / sman shar mkha' 'gros dbang bskur slob ma min/ / sbyor sgrol a ti gsang ba'i rig 'dzin min/ / 'brog ri'i bla ma mchog la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /rig pa'i snang ba ma mthong mig ser min/ /zer sgros ma ṇi 'don pa'i mchu dmar min/ /'gal 'du'i tshig nyams bkra ba'i mdongs mtha' min/ /'brog ri'i bla ma mchog la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /

386 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyusarig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/ma rtogs khung bur nyal ba'i sbrul nag min/ /log rtog smon rtser 'khyug pa'i spre'u min/ /som nyi'i 'bu srin za ba'i byi'u min/ /'brog ri'i bla ma mchog la bdag phyag 'tshal/ / 'jig rten pha rol 'joms pa'i dgra sta min/ /'di snang bde la rgyas pa'i padma min/ / mthong tshad bden par 'dzin pa'i lcags kyu min/ / 'brog ri'i bla ma mchog la bdag phyag 'tshal/ / dam pa smod la mi 'jigs rdo rje min/ / blun po'i 'khor mang sdud pa'i zhags pa min/ /phan bde'i brag ri gsil ba'i thog mda' min/ /'brog ri'i bla ma mchog la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /mang du thos pa'i lus rtsal zhum pa min/ /dri med rigs pa'i mche sder rtul ba min/ / legs par bshad pa'i g.yu ral gzi chung min/ /'brog ri'i seng chen de la bdag phyag 'tshal/ / phrag dog rmongs pa'i sa yis gnon nus min/ / spangs rtogs yal 'dab ra bar shong ba min/ /legs bshad dri bzang phyogs rer 'thul ba min/ /'brog ri'i dpagabasam de la bdag phyag 'tshal/ / mtha' bral gnam 'phang gcod la zhum pa min/ / kun mkhyen dag gsal gser mig ldongs pa min/ / gzhung ngan dug sbrul yan por gtong ba min/ /'brog ri'i mkha' lding de la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /rang byung tshangs pas ri mor spel ba min/ /blun po'i bstod bsngags rta yis drangs pa min/ / mkhas rlom chu rgyan smra ba'i go skabs min/ /'brog ri'i zla ba de la bdag phyag 'tshal/ / 'jam dbyangs mkhyen rab ral gri chag pa min/ / gsang dbang mthu nus rdo rje 'thor ba min/ /'phags mchog brtse chen me tog zum pa min/ / rigs gsum gcig bsdus bla ma blo bzang grags/ / snying nas dran pa'i gsol 'debs gling bu'i gdangs/ / dad gus sor rtses ldem por bsgyur ba ni/ / ngo mtshar dpag yasayin dga' chu 'dzin nas/ / yab gcig 'jam dpal snying bos gsan du gsol/ / 'jam dbyangs mkhyen rab nyi ma zhu ba'i ngogs/ / rgyal kun

bod kyi phyi dar rtsom rig 387dgongs pa'i padmo rnam rgyas pa/ / da dung smra mkhas dbyangs can bye bas bzung / /dgyes 'dzum gsar ba'i thigs phreng spro bar mdzod/ / brtse chen byinarlabs dri bzang 'dzin pa'i dpal/ /rnam dpyod dal gyis 'khyil ba'i lhangatsho ni/ /sprad ṭwāṃ legs gasdusas mtsho las mi 'pho zhing / / zab gsang mig pa /// /sdu bye/ sna par sna ṭwāṃ dgi/nga /spyor bde ba dang / don zab cing brjod legs pa/ phun sum tshogs la gson nyams ldan pa'i dpe la rnam par sbyar te/ brjod don snyan brjid dag gsum gyi sgo nas mtshon par mdzad pas na/ bklags pa tsam gyis yid 'phrog cing blor nges pa dang / dam pa'i chos kyi bden dngos dang mdzes snang stob par byed do/ /khyad par du/ chos dang chos min gyi rnam dbye 'byed skabs dgag gzhag gi rigs pa rno zhing chos nyid gyu /nga bzhin gsal ba dang / dpe don rmad du byung la phun sum tshogs rje btsun shes rab rgya mtsho ni mdo sngags gzhung lugs kyi rgya mtsho'i pha rol du son pa'i mkhas pa 'gran zla dang bral ba zhig yin phyir/ khong nyid la phra zhib rig pa'i blo gros mnga' zhing / legs bshad shar mar rtsom pa'i shes /sna ༵〉 / /du /khong nyid kyis mdzad pa'i bslab bya a ru rnam par rgyal ba'i gangs ri'i ljongs na seng ge srab med du/ / mkha' la 'phyo ba'i kun mkhyen tsong kha pa/ /shes nas dad pa'i spyi bor gus mchod de/ / mkhas pa mgu ba'i gtam 'ga' gleng bar bya/ /tshig gi go ba nam mkha'i mthongs ltar yangs/ / don gyi zhib cha ku sha'i rtse ltar phra/ / rigs pa'i gtad so grub mtha'i rdzong la 'khril/ /thub bstan mi 'gyur srog gi ka ba yin/ /'chad na bloyi rba rlabs dgung du 'phyur/ / rtsod na dus mtha'i me dpung 'bar ba'i

— 388 bodakyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/lce/ / rtsom na bdud rtsi'i gru char 'jo ba'i sprin/ / dpyod ldan yid dbang 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu yin/ / gang yang ma bslabs ci yang mi shes par/ /'o zob brag ca'i cod pan spur ba dang / / da dung phrag dog rmongs pa'i me sbar te/ / rang gzhan 'khri shing sreg pa mang 'dis skyo/ / rang bris mi dag gzhan la brda sprod 'chad/ / tshig sbyor mi thon snyan ngag 'dod rgyar 'khrid/ /rtsod rigs mi shes gzhung mang 'grel ba sogs/ /gzugs brnyan 'di dag gang du gtogs pa dpyad/ / da dung gson dang mkhyen bzhed sprul ba'i sku/ / phrad ma thag nas 'dzum gyi zer ma 'bebs/ / zhag gsum tsam yang mi 'khyongs 'gyur ldog byed/ / sgro skur du ba'i ral ba mkha' la bskyod/ /de 'dra mi yi gral nas 'phud pa gces/ /gal la thug tshe pha ma yin yang bsru/ / rang gi don la bla ma'i dbu yang bskor/ / nor gyis tshims na dkon mchog gsum yang gtong / /de 'dra rang gi bu ru skyes kyang spongs/ /la lar nyan 'os ma yin lhug por zlo/ / skabs 'gar dris pa'i lan yang 'debs mi byed/ /za zir sdod sa gcig tu'ang mi tshugs pa'i/ /mi de yang dag tshul gyi snod rung min/ /lung gi skyong sbyangs chu bo'i rgyun la lta/ /rigs pa'i tshul gsum me yi dbal dang mtshungs/ /grub mtha'i spobs pa lhan po'i spun du rigs/ / de 'dra thub bstan sa chen mdzes pa'i rgyan/ / nges pa'i tshig la go ba mkha' ltar yangs/ / gnad kyi don la dgag sgrub thog ltar rno/ / rang gi lugs la padma'i ljon ltar gtsang / / de 'dra mi 'jigs seng ge'i sgra sgrog yin/ /mchog gi yul la dad pa'i rtse mo mtho/ /dman pa'i yul lda snying rje'idri nga/ldang ri/—/bar ma'i sdul la mdza' ba'i yal ga brkyangs/ / 'dra rno// lha nā ṭī tsho/ sdon dan rnan/ /lhagapar du/ rje btsun mchog gi sgra rgyan la bcings pa'i snyan ngag ni

— 388 bodakyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/lce/ / rtsom na bdud rtsi'i gru char 'jo ba'i sprin/ / dpyod ldan yid dbang 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu yin/ / gang yang ma bslabs ci yang mi shes par/ /'o zob brag ca'i cod pan spur ba dang / / da dung phrag dog rmongs pa'i me sbar te/ / rang gzhan 'khri shing sreg pa mang 'dis skyo/ / rang bris mi dag gzhan la brda sprod 'chad/ / tshig sbyor mi thon snyan ngag 'dod rgyar 'khrid/ /rtsod rigs mi shes gzhung mang 'grel ba sogs/ /gzugs brnyan 'di dag gang du gtogs pa dpyad/ / da dung gson dang mkhyen bzhed sprul ba'i sku/ / phrad ma thag nas 'dzum gyi zer ma 'bebs/ / zhag gsum tsam yang mi 'khyongs 'gyur ldog byed/ / sgro skur du ba'i ral ba mkha' la bskyod/ /de 'dra mi yi gral nas 'phud pa gces/ /gal la thug tshe pha ma yin yang bsru/ / rang gi don la bla ma'i dbu yang bskor/ / nor gyis tshims na dkon mchog gsum yang gtong / /de 'dra rang gi bu ru skyes kyang spongs/ /la lar nyan 'os ma yin lhug por zlo/ / skabs 'gar dris pa'i lan yang 'debs mi byed/ /za zir sdod sa gcig tu'ang mi tshugs pa'i/ /mi de yang dag tshul gyi snod rung min/ /lung gi skyong sbyangs chu bo'i rgyun la lta/ /rigs pa'i tshul gsum me yi dbal dang mtshungs/ /grub mtha'i spobs pa lhan po'i spun du rigs/ / de 'dra thub bstan sa chen mdzes pa'i rgyan/ / nges pa'i tshig la go ba mkha' ltar yangs/ / gnad kyi don la dgag sgrub thog ltar rno/ / rang gi lugs la padma'i ljon ltar gtsang / / de 'dra mi 'jigs seng ge'i sgra sgrog yin/ /mchog gi yul la dad pa'i rtse mo mtho/ /dman pa'i yul lda snying rje'idri nga/ldang ri/—/bar ma'i sdul la mdza' ba'i yal ga brkyangs/ / 'dra rno// lha nā ṭī tsho/ sdon dan rnan/ /lhagapar du/ rje btsun mchog gi sgra rgyan la bcings pa'i snyan ngag ni

bod kyi phyi dar rtsom rig 389rang byung du thon pa'i nyal 'gro'i rgyun bzhin/ / brjod bde zhing don legs ༵ /sna // de la/ rta tshag rnam thar bsam 'phel nor bu'i bang mdzod kyi dag dag dag gsal gsal rdzogs blo gros gros bzang 'chad rtsod rtsom pas brel/ /brel ring zing po po tir longs pa pa ra mi ta'i lam du slong / /slong mo mo ma ma smad yin yang yang dag mkho rgya'i bdag por 'dren/ /'dren mkhas mkhas btsun btsun pa'i dbang phyug phyug dbul bar mas 'grub gyur cig / ma dag mtha' yas 'jig rten dag na na rga skye 'chis mnar ba'i ma/ /ma lus bde ba'i nor gyis mi phongs phongs pa kun skyob rje btsun ma/ /ma ltar brtse ba de yis yongs bzung bzung ba mi brjed mchog stsol ma/ / ma 'khrul rig pa'i lha mo bzhin du du ma'i dpal 'byor thob par smon/ /rtogs brjod bsam 'phel nor bu'i mdzod 'di 'di phyi'i re skong mchog gi 'phrin/ /'phrin 'dis theg gsum thar lam tshol de de ring nyid nas dpal gyis mdzes/ /mdzes sdug rgyal ba chos sku'i khang bzang bzang bor ma son de // trī/ga / du bas me bzhin zab rgyas chos tshul tshul dang mthun par mtshon cigartsom pa pos ngo mtshar yid las 'gongs pa'i rtsom rtsal la brten nas/ tshig rkang re re'i nang du bar ma chod pa'i zung ldan gyi yi ge gcig gam gsum re bkod yod par ma zad/ mtha' thog sbyar ba'i zung ldan dang rkang ba sdushā ga'i thog mtha' gnyis ka na yod pa'i zung ldan gyis legs par brtsams — nā/tha/ bya dka' ba'i rgyan gsal byed nges pa dang dbyangs nges pa'i sgo /padhi/ma pa ni/ rta tshag rnam thar bsam 'phel nor bu'i bang mdzod kyi

37 bod kyi rtsom rig lorgyusarig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/ka ma la dang rab dkar zla ba ltar/ /kha ba can na khyad 'phags 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /ga na'ang rgyal bstan gsal mdzad rta tshag par/ /nga snyam btang nas slar yang bdag phyag 'tshal/ / ca rtags dad pa'i sgam mang spras padang / / cha byad mtshar bas mkhas pa dga' bar dka'/ / ja zas rgyas pas rgyal ba'ang tha mal bas/ / nya gang zla ba la 'gran mdzad bzang bsngags/ / ta bhā ga tas brtags kyang 'byams klas pa/ / tha dad bsam yas mkha' khyab pha ma rnams/ / da nas bsgral bar bya snyam lhag bsam dang / / na rga spangs la drangs pa bgrang las 'das/ / pa sangs skar ma gzhan las zla bral bas/ / pha mtha' dpag yas dpal ldan bla ma gzhal/ /ba lang 'dra ba dag kyang thabs dam pas/ /ma smad sangs rgyas sa la bzhag pa mang / /tsa na ka yang chags pas ma bcangs par/ /tsha grang khyad bsad rnam dag lam bzang btsal/ /dza lang bya ba mdzangs pas bstan pa bskyangs/ /wa rgya bcad 'drar phra rgyas lta bas bsal/ /zha bas mjal yang yan lag ngan las 'da'/ /za ma bsam pa smin yang lhag par 'char/ /'a zha bas mtha' dag kyang thar lam 'tshal/ / ya mtshan mdzad pa bdag 'dras dpag par dka'/ / ra ba gangs dang ldan la lhag par yang / /la lar sngags dang la lar lam bzhin bskyangs/ /sha zad khrag zad dka' spyad mtha' yas pas/ /sa la bstan dang mnga' 'bangs dar bar mdzad/ / ha cang chags sdang can yang thabs mkhas rtsal/ /a ma 'dra bar mngar bas rnam par sbyangs/ / ha ha gang mtshan rnam par grags pas kyang / /a kṣa ra spangs zab lam lhang lhang 'char/ / 'grig 'grig tshig gis bsgrigs min srid zhi'i mig / bsil bsil zhi dbyings ji bzhin gzigs pa'i gzis/ / chil chil 'khyil zhing 'khrigs pa'i sgrib gnyis gzhil/ /'jigs 'jigs mi shis mi smin phyi phyir bsring / /mi shegs snying gi 'phrin yig springs pa'i dpyid/ /'dis ni 'di

bod kyi phyi dar rtsomarig 391phyi gnyis kyi gzi byin sbyin/ / zil gyis sgrib bzhi'i 'dzin khri gzir ba'i phyir/ / phyi mig mi bgyid rtsig pa'i mi ris bzhin/ / 'byin 'dzin rigs pa'i sprin dkrigs kirti'i mchid/ /zhing 'dir ting 'dzin pir gyis bris pa'i drin/ /zhi ba'i dbyings kyi mthil phyin ji srid snyi/ / ming sring ci mchis zhi sim bkris phyis min/ /ring 'dris snying gi yid gnyis rig bzhis gzhig /snyigs ma'i sdig sgrib ting 'dzin zil gyis 'jig / zhi ba'i dri zhim mi dmigs srid pa'i shing / / ji bzhin gzigs pa'i mi 'jigs gri yis gsil/ / kun tu bcu drug rgyu zung myur bsgrubs mthus/ / phul byung sku gsung thugs gsum rgyud du 'dzum/ / lhun 'grub zung 'jug sgyu 'phrul dus kun sprul/ /tshul gsum rgyun zhugs rgyu mthun sku ru sgrun/ /bdud 'dul sku gsung thugs sprul g.yung drung grus/ /sdug kun chu klung 'bum bskyur phul du 'dzud/ / tshul mthun lugs zung yul gru kun tu sgrub/ / rdzu 'phrul nus mthus bdud dpung khung bur 'jug /rgyu mthun gzugs phung sdug gu sku ru 'dus/ / dug gsum bdud 'dul 'bru gsum gsung du grub/ / phul byung sum cu bdun dgu thugs su chud/ / sku gsung thugs bsdus brgyud gsum sprul skur 'khums/ /zung 'jug gzhung drug glu ru lhung lhung rgyu/ / sku gsum lhun 'grub dbus 'gyur bu chung tshul/ / sprul sgyur rdzu 'phrul myur 'jug phu nu kun/ / dus su sku thugs zung 'jug sgrub tu skul/ / ches mdzes bder gshegs ye shes de brnyes te/ / dge legs gter chen mkhyen brtses sred len sel/ /bde dge re sems 'gengs ched theg chen spel/ /sems bskyed 'phel te nges legs rten 'brel mched/ /mdzes mdzes gser gyes nyer sgeg bshes gnyen ches/ /mdzes mdzes ye shes gegs med cher spel te/ /mdzes mdzes dge legs rtser 'dzegs dpe med des/ /mdzes mdzes bde gshegs dgyes skyed zer zegs 'gyed/ /g.yel g.yeng khe nyen sems med brjed nges

392 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/gter/ /khengs dregs mkhregs sgren sreg byed me brtsegs zhes/ /'jebs snyems cher bsnyegs sred 'dren dpe shel phreng / / rten legs mdzes sgeg ldem mer 'greng ste 'grem/ / sred len gshed 'dre nyer bsdebs skye mched skem/ / bkres bkren dben zhen ye shes mes bsregs te/ / yengs sems bde gshegs mkhyen brtser 'dren byed rje/ / brtse chen mkhyen gter dge legs bshes gnyen dpe/ / ston mchog dgongs don dngos stobs dngos pos rtogs/ /nyon mongs srog 'phrog chos 'khor rnon por bskor/ /stobs sogs chos 'byor yongs rdzogs mgon por 'jog / phongs skyob mgon khyod 'dod skong mthon por bstod/ /blo gros g.yor mos 'khor mtsho mgyogs por sgrol/ /'brog dgon gcong rong mchog rlom blo rmongs tshogs/ /yongs sbyong tshogs sbyor mthong sgom so sor 'god/ / slob dpon mthong thos don yod khyod dgongs gsol/ / mgon po gnod 'joms 'khor lo dkon mchog mdzod/ / mdzod mchog log smon yongs gnon tshogs gsog sbyor/ / sbyor sgrol 'dod log spyod 'dod mog por spyong / /sbyong chog mchog rtsol 'gro sgrol gtso bo dngos/ / dngos por sgro 'dogs blo gros rnon pos bcom mchog don mngon mthong mgon pos mgon por mdzod/ / 'gro skyob mchog 'tsho /snangs rdzogs log rtog spong / / rmongs blo gong 'pho smon don yongs thob ces pa lta bur mtshon na/ sdeb legs shing don zab pa dang / tshig mdzes shing ro nyams khyad du 'phags pa/ rdo chag btsan sgrig lta bu ma yin par rang bzhin lhun gyis mdzes par grub pa zhig go / 'di ni rje btsun shes rab rgya mtsho'i snyan ngag gi nying bcud dang yang rtse yin la/ bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus khrod byung ba'i snyan ngag gi dwangs ma yin no/ /

bod kyi phyi dar rtsom rig 393 —don tshanā dro/ swāhākā ༵/la zlo /sna )snang dge dang po/ rtsomathapo'i lorgyusamador bstan pa/mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel ni reb gong zho 'ong dbyi zhes pa'i grong tshor/ yab a lags rgyal po dang yum padma nyid gnyis kyi sras su rab byung bco lnga ba'i chu yos (spyi lo1903)lor sku 'khrungs/ chung dus nas g.ya' ma bkra shis 'khyil dgon par rgyun sdod byas shing / dgon pa de dang shel dgon sogs su sum rtags snyan ngag sogs la sbyangs pa mthil phyin mdzad/mkhan chen dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i drung nas rab tu byung ste mtshan la dge 'dun chos 'phel zhes su gsol/ spyi lo 1917lor chos sde chen po bla brang bkra shis 'khyil la phebs te bsdus grwa dang / blo rigs/ rtags rigs sogs nas phar phyin 'og ma'i bar slob gnyer dpyis phyin par mdzad/ yin na'ang 'jam bzhan yig char dogs slong mdzad pa'i rkyen gyis khong la dngos shugs gang thad nas sdang zug chen po byung bar brten nas der bzhugs ma spro zhing /yang dag pa'i rig gzhung gi phu thag gcod pa'i phyir spyi lo 1927lor dbus gtsang chos kyi zhing sar phebs shing / 'bras spungs sgo mang grwa tshang du rje btsun shes rab rgya mtsho sogs dge rgan du bsten nas slob gnyer mdzad pas mkhas pa'i grags pa ches cher 'phel/

394 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyusarig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/de ltar 'bras spungs su lo lnga drug tsam bzhugs rjes/ dgung lo so gnyisakyi steng rgya gar gyi paṇḍi ta ra hu la zhes pa zhig gis rgya gar du gdan drangs/ rgyal khams rig pas bskor ba'i gtam rgyud gser gyi thang ma 'bri 'gobartsams/ rgya gar du lo bcu gnyis tsam bzhugs pa'i ring la thog mar legs sbyar dang nyin rdu'i skad yig legs par gsan sbyong gnang rjes gnas gcig tu ma bzhugs par rgya gar gyi gnas chen khag dang / grong khyer/gna' shul grags can gang sar phebs te gnas bskor zin tho mdzad pa dang /sing ga la'i gnas brtan sde ba'i mdo dang legs sbyar bang mdzod snga phyir mdzad/ mu ru su'i ri mo mkhas pa ra'o ris zhes pa dang mnyam du deb sngon dbyin yig tu bsgyur/ sbyi lo 1945lo'i zla bzhi bar lha sar phebs/ deb ther dkar bo rtsom 'phro can de brtsams/ spyi lo 1947lor dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs dang bka' shag mnyam 'brel byas te ma nyes kha g.yog gi rkyen gyis btson du tshud/ spyi lo 1949lor btson nas phyung rjes blo gsal slob ma skor ṭwāṃ rsha ṅgi /zlo khrid mdzad cing / sbyi lo 1951lo'i hor zla brgyad par lha sa nas gnyisapa/ dge 'dun chosa'aphelagyi snyan ngagamakhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel ni rnam dpyod kyi dpal dang ldan pa'i lo rgyus smra ba bo bla na med pa zhig yin la/ brtse dung gi rba rlabs yid kyi mtshowa ru rtag tu 'phyo ba'i yid 'gyur mtshon pa'i snyan ngag mkhan zhig kyang yin pas/ khong gi snyan ngag la lhag bsam gyi 'o mtsho mkha' ru 'phyur zhing bden don gyi 'od snang lam lam 'bar la/ dngos yod 'tsho ba yi dri dod

bod kyi phyi dar rtsom rig 395 ldang ba dang / sdeb sbyor mdzes shing ngag la bde ba/ yid dbang 'phrog cing nyams 'gyur phun sum tshogs pa/ tshor 'du shugs drag pa/ rjod byed kyi tshig / sla zhing bab chags pa bcas bla na med pa'i sgyu rtsal gyi khyad chos dang ldan de yang dam pa nyid kyis bcoms pa'i deb dkar gyi mjug tu/ rang sde'i rigs la zhen pa dkar bo'i mdangs/ / rang byung snying gi dbus su gnas pa 'dis/ /rang yul kha ba can gyi rje 'bangs la/ /rang gi nus pas srid zhu cung zad sgrub/ / ces gsungs pa ltar/ dge 'dun chos 'phel ni mes rgyal dang mi rigs la lhag bsam dkar zhing / rang gi mi rigs la dga' zhen dang mi rigs kyi las dbang la thugs khur tshad med gnang mkhan zhig yin pas/ kha ba can la dga' zhing zhen pa'i bsam blo de dus dang rnam pa kun tu snying gi srog shing du bzung yod la/ khong gi snyan rtsom phal che ba'i brtse dung dang yid 'gyur shugs drag pa'i 'byung khungs kyang de la thug yod/khong gis bod spyi tshogs khrod kyi ngan rengs kyi rnam pa dang goms gshis ngan par mngon sum 'dzem med kyis sun 'byin byas shing de lta bu'i sbyi tshogs kyi rnam pa la skyo gdung dang thugs khur mdzad yod de/ dper na/ka li ka ta bal yul pe cin dang / / kha ba can gyi grong khyer lha sa sogs/ /ga sa ga ru yod pa'i mi 'di rnams/ /nga yis bltas na rang ba'in gcig par mthong / / ca co'i 'ur zing phyogs la mi dga' zhing / /cha lugs zhi dul gnang ba khong tsho yang / /ja mar gos dang pad shag mthong ba'i tshe /nya ba rgan po'i sems dang khyad mi 'dug / ta rin sku drag ngo bstod tshig la dga'/ /tha mal mi rnams g.yo dang sgyu la dga'/ / da lta phal cher tha mag chang la dga'/ /na chung rnams ni 'jo sgeg nyams la dga'/ /pa pha a ma'i phyogs la zhen ba dang / /pha rol rigs mi mthun la sdang ba sogs/ /ba lang

396 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/dang ni rang re'i mi rnams kyi/ / ma bcos sems kyi rgyu dag gcig par mthong / /tsa rir gnas skor byed pa ming gi don/ /tsha grang dka' thub byed pa lto yi don/ /dza ya'i gsung rab klog pa yon gyi don/ /wa ler bsams na thams cad nor gyi don/ /zhwa mo chos gos ba dan bla bre dang / / za rgyu 'thung rgyu'i mchod pa tshogs 'khor sogs/ / 'a cag rnams kyis ci dang ci byas pa/ /ya mtshan ltad mo tsam las gzhan ma mthong / / ra khang khyi khang nang du slebs pa bzhin/ /la lung gang na bde skyid mi 'dug kyang / /sha khrag sgyu ma'i lus 'di 'jig gi bar/ / sa steng 'di ru mi sdod ka med lags/ / ha cang drang bor bshad na 'di 'dra ste/ /a tsi gzhan tsho tshig pa za las che /zhes par mtshon na/ phan bde'i bgyi bar mi gzhol la legase lam du 'jug par mi brtson pa'i rul sungs kyi spyi tshogs la mtshang 'byin dang / de lta bu'i spyi tshogs kyis rtsom pa po'i sems la sdug bsngal dang skyo gdung gi sgrub ma bskyil ba sogs rnam par mtshon pa dang / khong nyid kyi yid kyi 'gyur bag snatshon pa'i snyan ngag gang mang zhig nga tsho'i dpal du bcoms yod de/ dper rgya chen don gnyis grub pa'i dga' ston la rol ba'i/ / ma 'dris 'gro ba'i rtsa lag zas gtsang gi sras po/ /mtha' dang zad du med pa'i byin rlabs kyi sbrang char/ /thugs rje'i chu 'dzin 'khrigs pa'i gur khang nas phob cig /thang chen pha mtha' med pa'i dud sprin gyi this ma/ /rkang gling skad brda bsgyur ba'i rgyus med kyi grogs po/ /kha dog sna lnga shar ba'i zhing chen gyi re'u mig /snang yul gang la bltas kyang skyo nyams shig 'dug pa/ / nye 'brel 'khor g.yog 'dzoms pa tshong 'dus kyi mgron po/ /stobs 'byor khengs dregs dar ba rmi lam gyi longs spyod/ / skyid sdug spel ma'i nyams myong dbyar dgun gyi 'gyur ldog /bsam zhing ma bcos shugs kyis glu dbyangs shig shor song / /

bod kyi phyi dar rtsom rig 397medan ltogs kyis dog pa'i bza' btung gi rtsol sgrub/ / yod na zad kyis dogs pa'i khe tshong gi 'du 'god/ /don chung las la 'bad pa'i phreng gog de bgrang nas/ / yun thung mi tshe phra mo'i phreng thag de zad song / / byas kyang 'dzad dus med pa'i 'jig rten gyi bya gzhag / byas byas las kyi mtha' la yid chad kyi snon pa/ / byas nas grub par rloms pa'i bde 'byor kun bsags kyang / /sdug bsngal phung bo 'di yi bcu cha las mi 'dug /khrim pa g.yo sgyu'i rtse mo dgu sgrig tu byas te/ /'bad pa brgya yis sgrub pa'i 'jig rten gyi 'dun mas/ / yun ring bsgugs pa'i mtha' la stong bslus su byas pas/ /lo gsum sdug las byas pa'i a thang ni chad song / /'byor tshe nye ba'i drung na zhum zhum du 'gro zhing / / rgyad tshe ring bo'i sa nas mdzub ker gyis 'phya ba/ /drin byas drin du mi go grogs ngan gyi gshis la/ /bsam zhing ngu ma dgod kyi snang ba zhig shar song / /zin med dbyar dgun dus bzhi'i so tshis la 'bad nas/ /don med g.yeng ba'i ngang du mi tshe phyed zad kyang / /da dung snang med gzhon pa'i 'phyor nyams de che ba/ /lus rgas sems ma rgas pa'i ngang tshul 'di skyo ba/ /tshogs drug snang ba yul gyi me tog gi thang du/ /gtol med rig pa'i bu chung phar phar la 'khyams pas/ /don chen gnas la sems pa'i dran 'dun gyi lam srol/ / da lta rjes med bor ba'i snang tshul 'di skyo ba/ / ri bo sgang drug ljongs nas ri dwags bzhin 'khyams te/ / thag ring rgyus med mi yi rgyal khams su slobs nas/ / mdo med 'phyor mo'i phyogs la rang se/sdu bye /dri /sdu// /yakhri sna can pha ma brjed pa'i bu rul nga skyo ba/ /ma rig rnam rtog 'dre mo'i gar stabs kyi rjes su/ / mi bden 'phrul ba'i chos 'di yom yom du g.yos pas/ /de ring mthong ba'i snang ba sang nyin ni brjed de/ / gang la gtad so med pa'i ngang tshul 'di skyo ba/ /bltas na

398 bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/skyidaskyid 'dra ba'i 'jig rten kyi phun tshogs/ / thob na rang rang skabs kyi sdug bsngal re 'dug pas/ /'phral snang bde ba'i gnas skabs mi lam tsam song rjes/ /cis kyang rang sems skyo ba'i rkyen snang re 'dug pa/ / re dogs 'og 'gyu'i rnam rtog sdug bsngal gyi skyur rtsi/ / shugs 'byung dga' ba'i nyamasakyi 'o ma dang 'dres pas/ / bza' btung longs spyod phyi yi skyid chas tsam 'a~X ghadī 'o/ /blo bde gu yangs nang gi skyid nyams de mi 'dug /rtsom pa pos rmongs rtul dang rjes lus kyi bsam blo/ mi rigs 'di'i pa/ trī gā // zlo/ sdon /shā sdo/sa la bden drang gi sgo nas ther 'don dang thams cad khong du sbed pa zab mor rlom/ /kun la dogs pa za ba grung borakhyed/ / rnying ba thams cad lha yi srol du bsgrags/ / gsar ba thams cad bdud kyi 'phrul du sems/ / ngo mtshar phal cher than ltas nyid du sgom/ /'di ni da lta'i bar du rang re'i srol/ / kun la phan pa'i ngo mtshar rdzas 'phrul dang / /yongs su gnod pa'i ltas ngan cho 'phrul gnyis/ /shes byeswā ral gri'i rno phyogs re re ste/ / gcig gi zla la gcig kyang slobs par swāswā/ /sdo /rtags kyi bden pa ngo sprad kyang / / ngam nag bzhin gyi gnyer ma mi sangs pa/ / mdor na phrag dog can gyi skyes bu de'i/ / dga' ba'i dngos po gzhan gyi rgyad pa nyid/ / phrag dog khrag gis myos pa'i mu tshugs stag / 'jigs pa'i nga ro sgrog pa'i tshang tshing na/ / gcig pur lus pa'i bden sna/ shā /rsha dṛ/ /shes rab can gyis snying rje'i yul du dgongs/ /

bod kyi phyi dar rtsom rig 37mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel gyi snyan rtsom rnams rab rtog dang 'ud bstod sogs kyi rgyan gyis ma bcings par rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan dang phal skad kho nas bris pa zhig yin na'ang / tshor 'du shugs drag pa'i rdotā /rnyi klogad ༵ // sems la bde sdug gi tshor ba rnam par bskyed pa'i nus srid pa'i 'byor ba la kha'i na bun/ / 'dus pa'i gnyen grogs tshong 'dus mgron po/ / ma nges skyid sdug mdang gi rmi lam/ / bsam zhing bsam na snying bo mi 'dug / rgyus med gshin rje'i pho nyas khrid nas/ / phyi ma'i 'phrang ring 'grim pa'i grogs la/ / skyabs kyi dam pa rtsa gsum lha yis/ /thugs rje'i spyan gyis skyel ma mdzod cig /skyes nas 'chi ba 'khor ba'i chos nyid/ / bsgyur du med pa sgyu ma'i rang mdangs/ / mi bzlog gshin rje rgyal po'i bka' yig /nyam chung grogs kyi stong du slobs song / / sngon smon las kyi char zim babs tshe/ / yod yod 'dra ba'i dgung gi 'ja' tshon/ / dung sems nyi ma gsal du song tshe/ / mi mthong nam mkha'i dbyings su yal song / /na gzhon lang tsho me tog rgyas dus/ /yid kyi chu bo gcig tu 'dres pa'i/ /'dris 'dris chung grogs sems kyi tsher ma/ /da lta rigs drug gang du yod na/ / skyid shod lha sa'i grog chu phra mo/ / zhag gsum 'dzoms pa 'grogs pa'i tha ma/ /mi ring 'phrad pa'i kha chad byas pa/ /rmi lam ngang nas mjal dus slebs song / /rgan dang bar ma'i skye bo thams cad/ /nges nges 'chi ba'i ngang tshul mthong yang / / chung skyes grogs kyis bor ba'i phyogs la/ / nang gi dung sems chod thabs mi 'dug / shes rjes 'gyod pa blun po'i ngang tshul/ /lus sems rgud pa'i rgyu las med kyang / /yun ring 'dris pa'i sems kyi bag chags/ / goms pa'i shugs 'di bzlog thabs mi 'dug/lus zungs zad pa'i keng rus gzugs brnyan/ gson du re ba'i kho thag

8① bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/chad de/ /'chi ba'i mig gis ce rer blta ba'i/ /gtam de bden na snying la gzan pa/ / ma brtags sems kyi char tshul zhig la/ / da dung drung na yod yod 'dra ba/ / dran pa'i gzhu mo nang du bkug tshe/ / snying khung stong ba'i rgyu las mi /dug /zhibartse zhing 'grogs pa'i phyi thag bsam ste/ / mchog /sug zlosnro zlo byershaswā skre ba zlo /sa/ so//dge ba'i dngos po cung zad sgrub pa/ / ma'i /lha sdo tā jing/ gang gis myi shes pa'i/ /g.yung drung lha yi rmu thag ring mo 'dis/ / mtha' myed chos dbyings rig pa'i dbyings su btags/ / rig pa'i bu chung lus kyi nang du btags/ / lus kyi tho yor zas dang skom la btags/ / zas dang skom ni phyi rol rkyen la btags/ / de ltar thag pa gcig la gcig 'thun pas/ / gcod pa'i sa mtshams gzhan ni yod ma yin/ / sa mtshams gcig ni kun gyis myi 'don pa/ / lus sems 'brel thag chod pa'i 'chi ba nyid/ / sa mtshams gcig ni kun gyis myi shes pa/ /thag pa dul nas dbyings rig 'dres pa nyid/ / sems 'di mtha' dang bral ba'i lha mo ste/ /lha mo'i pha yul 'jig rten 'di min mod/ /sems kyi lha mo'i zhabasakyi mthe chung gcig / skud pa lus po 'di la dam du btags/ / de nas skud pa 'di nyid chad kyi bar/ /lus kyis gang myong sems kyis myong bar snang / /mthe chung bsdams pas lha mo 'ching bar snang / /mthe chung na bas lha mo na bar snang / /mthe chung 'di la phan gnod gang byas pas/ /lha mo de la bde sdug myong bar zad/ /thag pa 'di de chad na legs mod kyang / /thag pa chad par 'jig rten thams cad skug / thag pas 'brel ba'i thabs la' 'bad pa na'/ /thag pa'i sne kun tsher mas dkris par mthong / /tsher ma'i rtse mo re re 'god slad du/ /shes rig las kyi rnam grangs re re bslab/ /des

bod kyi phyi dar rtsom rig 401na tsher ma 'gog pa'i khral las 'di/ / ma shi'i bar du brel bas byed par zad/ /tshar med spang du snyed pa'i brel ba 'di/ /kund kyi skye ba blangs pa'i don sgor snang / / mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems kyi cha shas gcig / sha khrag lusakyi 'dam du tshud pa na'/ / tsha grang bkres skom re dogs 'jigs skrag gi /sdug bsngal 'di la zad mtha' snyed pa snyam/ /'on kyang 'bad pa brgya yis bsgrubs bsgrubs pa'i/ /shes rig dpal gyis spras pa'i lus po 'di/ /rdopa spra/ gnam gyi rgyal mo'i bka' lung bzhin/ /sa steng 'di ru lo shas sdod ces btson nas blangs pa'i mgur lta bu la mtshon na/ dam pa de nyid la ma nyes kha g.yogs kyi rkyen gyis ya nga ba'i mun btson du mnar gcod myangs shing bzhugs pa'i skabs kyi khong gi myong tshor dang / sems 'gyu ches phra ba dag gzugs can bzhin du mtshon yod la/ ches dka' sdug dang nyam nga ba'i gnas skabs de dag tu'ang / mi rigs 'dir bcangs pa'i lhag bsam dang /sna/ /dad ༵ ༵ shā /kā shās gnang 'dod kyi sems shugs ma nyams par mdor na/ dge 'dun chos 'phel gyi snyan rtsom rnams 'khyog brjod dngagab sbas kyi lam nas brjod pa ma yin par rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan dang go sla ba'i tshig gis brjod pa dang / mngon brjod dang tshig rgyan nyung zhing phal skad kyis don 'dus shing go bde bar brtsams pa/ ka phreng dang sgra rgyan la bcings pa lhu 'grig cing sbyor bde bas snyan zhing 'jebs pa/ klog pa /sbya pa/ trī ༵ /spya sasdu ṭwāṃ gi tshor ba bskyed pa'i nus pa ldan pa bcas kyi rmad

402 bod gyi rtsom rig lo rgyus rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho/mjug gi gtam/bod kyi rtsom rig byung 'phel gyi lo rgyus dang khyad chos rig 'dzin bye ba'i rol mtsho zhes bya ba 'di nyid ni bdag gis spyi lo 1986lo nas bzung ste bod kyi skad cha dang rtsom rig sgyu rtsal chen du gnyer ba'i slob chen bod yig sde khag gi slob ma rnams la dmigs nas/ dpe khrid dang rtsom 'bri'i go rim ring du brgyud nas grub pa yin zhing / 1999lo'i zla gnyis par tan su'u mi rigs dpe bsgrun khang gis par bsgrun 'grem spel mdzad de nub byang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo dang mtsho sngon mi rigs slob grwa chen mo sogs kyi chen gnyer bslab deb tu gyur pa dang / ches thog mar byung ba'i bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus dang khyad chos kyi bslab deb gcig pur snang ngo / /da lan sngar yod kyi rmang gzhi'i steng du le'u dang sgrig rim cung zad legs bcos byas la/ don tshan dang dpyad brjod kha shas kha gsab bgyis pa dang / yang bskyar mno bsam dang dpyad bsdur gyis tshig tshogs dang rgyas spros 'dor ci thub bcas byas te/ ci nas kyang kha gsal zhing klog bde ba dang / kha tshang zhing phun sum tshogs pa/don dril cing snying bo thon pa/ bod kyi srol rgyun rtsom rig gi lo rgyus rgyab ljongs mtshar sdug spang thang bzhin thar chags su mngon pa dang / rmad byung bsam blo'i rang bzhin nyin byed sprin las grol ba bzhin thon pa dang / khyad 'phagasasgyu rtsal khyad chos mtho ris skyed tshal bzhin mtshon pa bcas la ngal rtsol cung zad byas shing / mi rigs dpe bskun khang gi bod yig rtsom —sgrig khangagi kru'u rin sku zhabs tshe ring rgyal lags kyis rgyab skyor dang mthun rkyen

mjug gi gtam/ 403gang legs bsgrubs pa la nye bar brten/ bslab deb 'di nyid yang bskyar par bsgrun 'grem spel mdzad pa yin no/ / slad ma'i char yang mkhyen dpyod rnam par yangs pa'i mkhas pa rnams kyis dgongs 'char gang legs gnang nani khengs skyungs chen pos sdud len byas nas/ ma 'ongs par bslab deb 'di nyid kyi spus ka dang chu tshad sngar las lhag par je legs dang je rgyas su gtong ba la bstud mar bkun pa bskyed pa'i mi phyed 'dun pa dang snying stobs ldan pa yin no/ /rtsom rig gi bslab deb 'di nyid kyang gangs can bod kyi /dro/shā shātā /lca // ci/ dṛ rig sgyu rtsal dang chab srid dpal 'byor dar tshes bgā rnyizlo zlo/ brgya /ge trī /kā /rnyi kto sbya /sa stong drug gi lo'i zla dang po'i

rtsam /ga 'gan 'khur pa/ skyu snyi/bo/sdu/rdorigazunga'apho///sdu/༷khyabacasarisadzirsā0ro sa khroX kha/sdu/ / snyu sde /sdi ṭwāṃ /khri ༷//ma yang 4pa//rje ṇḍapra/// ṭwāṃ sbyi kta sgyi ༷swāzlo // hūm̐ sde tna dū swā /khang /dhra snroX 7 chas/spyo/༷ smo pa/ ddhi srusna sdi kārji trī dris/swā/ po brgyab/
